```py
        return mod.read(a, size, signed=signed) & _mask(sz)
    raise _Unknown


def _const_mem(mod, a, n):
    """[a, a+n) lies in .text or .rodata (no relocations, never written)."""
    for off, size in (mod.nso.text, mod.nso.rodata):
        if mod.base + off <= a and a + n <= mod.base + off + size:
            return True
    return False


def _holds(cond, f):
    n, z, c, v = f
    r = (z, c, n, v, c and not z, n == v, n == v and not z, True)[cond >> 1]
    return r != bool(cond & 1 and cond != 15)


def _nzcv(kind, sz, x, y):
    m, top = _mask(sz), sz - 1
    if kind == 'logic':
        return x >> top & 1, x == 0, 0, 0
    if kind == 'add':
        r = (x + y) & m
        return r >> top & 1, r == 0, x + y > m, (~(x ^ y) & (x ^ r)) >> top & 1
    r = (x - y) & m
    return r >> top & 1, r == 0, x >= y, ((x ^ y) & (x ^ r)) >> top & 1


def _flags(mod, f, env):
    """Possible NZCV values of the flags record f under env; None for one that is not determined."""
    k = f[0]
    if k == 'ccmp':
        _, sz, a, b, add, cond, imm, prev = f
        compare = fixed = False
        for p in _flags(mod, prev, env) if prev is not None else (None,):
            if p is None or _holds(cond, p):
                compare = True
            if p is None or not _holds(cond, p):
                fixed = True
        out = [(imm >> 3 & 1, imm >> 2 & 1, imm >> 1 & 1, imm & 1)] if fixed else []
        if compare:
            out += _flags(mod, ('add' if add else 'sub', sz, a, b), env)
        return out
    try:
        if k == 'logic':
            return [_nzcv(k, f[1], _eval(mod, f[2], env), 0)]
        return [_nzcv(k, f[1], _eval(mod, f[2], env), _eval(mod, f[3], env))]
    except _Unknown:
        return [None]


def _violated(mod, rec, env):
    """The path condition rec is provably false under env."""
    try:
        if rec[0] == 'flags':
            _, f, cond, holds = rec
            opts = _flags(mod, f, env)
            return None not in opts and all(_holds(cond, o) != holds for o in opts)
        if rec[0] == 'zero':
            _, sz, x, holds = rec
            return ((_eval(mod, x, env) & _mask(sz)) == 0) != holds
        _, x, bit, holds = rec
        return bool(_eval(mod, x, env) >> bit & 1) != holds
    except _Unknown:
        return False


_SWAP = {HS: LS, LS: HS, HI: LO, LO: HI, 10: 13, 13: 10, 11: 12, 12: 11, 0: 0, 1: 1}


def _bounds(st):
    """[(expr, values)] that the path conditions bound: x <= N, x < N, x == N, x == 0."""
    out = []
    for rec in st.conds:
        if rec[0] == 'zero':
            if rec[3]:
                out.append((rec[2], (0,)))
            continue
        if rec[0] != 'flags':
            continue
        _, f, cond, holds = rec
        if f[0] == 'ccmp':
            _, sz, a, b, add, ccond, imm, _ = f
            if add or _holds(cond, (imm >> 3 & 1, imm >> 2 & 1, imm >> 1 & 1, imm & 1)) == holds:
                continue  # the fixed flags alone could take this edge
            f = ('sub', sz, a, b)
        if f[0] != 'sub':
            continue
        _, sz, a, b = f
        c = cond if holds else cond ^ 1
        if a[0] == 'c' and b[0] != 'c':
            a, b, c = b, a, _SWAP.get(c)
        if b[0] != 'c' or a[0] == 'c':
            continue
        n = b[1]
        vals = range(n + 1) if c == LS else range(n) if c == LO else (n,) if c == 0 else None
        if vals is not None and 0 < len(vals) <= MAX_COUNT:
            out.append((lo(a) if a[0] in ('zx', 'sx') else a, vals))
    return out


def _subexprs(e, out):
    if e[0] in ('c', 'r', 'u', 'v', 'vw'):
        return
    out.append(e)
    if e[0] == 'oneof':
        return
    for x in e[1:]:
        if isinstance(x, tuple):
            _subexprs(x, out)


def _indices(e, out):
    """Subexpressions of the addresses of the loads in e (candidate table indices)."""
    if e[0] == 'ld':
        _subexprs(e[4], out)
    if e[0] not in ('c', 'r', 'u', 'v', 'vw'):
        for x in e[1:]:
            if isinstance(x, tuple):
                _indices(x, out)


def _domain(e):
    """Values e can take by construction (masks, narrow extracts, selects of constants), or None."""
    k = e[0]
    if k == 'and' and e[3][0] == 'c' and bin(e[3][1]).count('1') <= 10:
        m, out, x = e[3][1], [], 0
        while True:  # every submask of m
            out.append(x)
            x = (x - m) & m
            if not x:
                return out
    if k == 'bfm' and not e[2] and e[3] <= e[4] < e[3] + 10:
        return range(1 << (e[4] - e[3] + 1))
    if k == 'bfm' and not e[2] and e[4] < e[3] and e[4] < 8:  # ubfiz
        return tuple((v << (e[1] - e[3])) & _mask(e[1]) for v in range(1 << (e[4] + 1)))
    if k in ('orr', 'add', 'eor'):
        a, b = (_domain(x) if x[0] != 'c' else (x[1],) for x in e[2:])
        if a is None or b is None or len(a) * len(b) > 256:
            return None
        return tuple(sorted({_BIN[k](x, y, e[1]) for x in a for y in b}))
    if k == 'lsr' and e[3] > e[1] - 10:
        return range(1 << (e[1] - e[3]))
    if (k == 'xt' and not e[2]) or (k == 'ld' and not e[2] and e[1] == 1):
        return range(256)
    if k == 'csel':
        a, b = (_domain(x) if x[0] != 'c' else (x[1],) for x in e[2:4])
        return tuple(sorted(set(a) | set(b))) if a is not None and b is not None and len(a) + len(b) <= 256 else None
    if k in ('zx', 'lo'):
        d = _domain(e[1])
        return d if d is None or k == 'zx' else tuple(sorted({v & M32 for v in d}))
    if k == 'lsl':
        d = _domain(e[2])
        return None if d is None else tuple(sorted({(v << e[3]) & _mask(e[1]) for v in d}))
    if k == 'oneof':
        return tuple(sorted(e[2]))
    if k == 'bfi':
        _, sz, immr, imms, dst, _ = e
        dom = (dst[1],) if dst[0] == 'c' else _domain(dst)
        width, at = (imms - immr + 1, immr) if imms >= immr else (imms + 1, 0)
        if dom is None or width > 4 or len(dom) << width > 256:
            return None
        return tuple(sorted({_bfi(sz, immr, imms, d, i << at) for d in dom for i in range(1 << width)}))
    return None


def _solve(mod, t, st, masks):
    """Targets of t over the values the path proves for the unknowns in it, or None.

    Candidates are values bounded by path conditions and, with masks, values bounded by construction. One, two
    or three candidates must together fix t; every assignment the path conditions rule out is dropped.
    """
    try:
        return {_eval(mod, t, ())}
    except _Unknown:
        pass
    cands = _bounds(st)
    if masks:
        # A mask is a sound bound but may far exceed the table; with a bounds check on the path (of some other
        # value) it is only taken if no larger than that check.
        limit = min((len(v) for _, v in cands if len(v) > 1), default=MAX_COUNT)
        subs = []
        _indices(t, subs)
        for e in subs:
            d = _domain(e)
            if d is not None and len(d) <= limit:
                cands.append((e, d))
    seen, uniq = set(), []
    for e, d in sorted(cands, key=lambda c: len(c[1])):
        if e not in seen:
            seen.add(e)
            uniq.append((e, d))
    for k in (1, 2, 3):
        for combo in itertools.combinations(uniq if k == 1 else uniq[:MAX_CANDS], k):
            size = 1
            for _, d in combo:
                size *= len(d)
            if size > MAX_COUNT:
                continue
            out = set()
            for values in itertools.product(*(d for _, d in combo)):
                _spend(1)
                env = list(zip((e for e, _ in combo), values))
                if any(_violated(mod, rec, env) for rec in st.conds):
                    continue
                try:
                    out.add(_eval(mod, t, env))
                except _Unknown:
                    if out:
                        return None  # fixes t for some values only
                    break  # the first feasible value leaves t unfixed: not this combination
            else:
                if out:
                    return out
    return None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- exception landing pads

def _uleb(img, o):
    v = sh = 0
    while True:
        b = img[o]
        o += 1
        v |= (b & 0x7F) << sh
        sh += 7
        if not b & 0x80:
            return v, o


def _sleb(img, o):
    v, o2 = _uleb(img, o)
    n = 7 * (o2 - o)
    return (v - (1 << n) if v >> (n - 1) & 1 else v), o2


def _enc(img, o, enc):
    """DWARF pointer encoding at image offset o: (value as image offset or plain number, next offset)."""
    if enc == 0xFF:
        return 0, o
    fmt = enc & 0x0F
    if fmt == 0x01:
        v, o2 = _uleb(img, o)
    elif fmt == 0x09:
        v, o2 = _sleb(img, o)
    else:
        n, signed = {0x00: (8, False), 0x02: (2, False), 0x03: (4, False), 0x04: (8, False), 0x0A: (2, True),
                     0x0B: (4, True), 0x0C: (8, True)}[fmt]
        v, o2 = int.from_bytes(img[o:o + n], 'little', signed=signed), o + n
    if enc & 0x70 == 0x10:
        v += o
    return v, o2


def landing_pads(mod):
    """{landing pad: [(start, end)]}: the call-site ranges of each pad, from .eh_frame and the LSDAs."""
    hit = _PADS.get(mod)
    if hit is not None:
        return hit
    img, hdr, pads = mod.image, mod.nso.eh_start, {}
    if hdr and hdr < len(img):
        o, _ = _enc(img, hdr + 4, img[hdr + 1])
        cies = {}
        while o + 8 <= len(img):
            length = int.from_bytes(img[o:o + 4], 'little')
            if length in (0, 0xFFFFFFFF):
                break
            nxt, cid = o + 4 + length, int.from_bytes(img[o + 4:o + 8], 'little')
            if cid == 0:
                p = o + 9
                aug = img[p:img.index(0, p)].decode('latin-1')
                p += len(aug) + 1
                _, p = _uleb(img, p)
                _, p = _sleb(img, p)
                p = p + 1 if img[o + 8] == 1 else _uleb(img, p)[1]
                info = {'R': 0, 'L': None}
                if aug.startswith('z'):
                    _, p = _uleb(img, p)
                    for ch in aug[1:]:
                        if ch == 'P':
                            _, p = _enc(img, p + 1, img[p])
                        elif ch in 'LR':
                            info[ch] = img[p]
                            p += 1
                cies[o] = info
            else:
                cie = cies.get(o + 4 - cid)
                if cie is not None and cie['L'] is not None:
                    start, p = _enc(img, o + 8, cie['R'])
                    _, p = _enc(img, p, cie['R'] & 0x0F)
                    _, p = _uleb(img, p)
                    lsda, _ = _enc(img, p, cie['L'])
                    if lsda:
                        _lsda(img, lsda, start, mod.base, pads)
            o = nxt
    _PADS[mod] = pads
    return pads


def _lsda(img, o, func, base, pads):
    lp_enc = img[o]
    lpstart, o = _enc(img, o + 1, lp_enc)
    if lp_enc == 0xFF:
        lpstart = func
    tt_enc = img[o]
    o += 1
    if tt_enc != 0xFF:
        _, o = _uleb(img, o)
    cs_enc = img[o]
    n, o = _uleb(img, o + 1)
    stop = o + n
    while o < stop:
        s, o = _enc(img, o, cs_enc & 0x0F)
        ln, o = _enc(img, o, cs_enc & 0x0F)
        lp, o = _enc(img, o, cs_enc & 0x0F)
        _, o = _uleb(img, o)
        if lp:
            pads.setdefault(base + lpstart + lp, []).append((base + func + s, base + func + s + ln))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- per-function resolution

def _explore(cfg, facts, br_pc):
    """Targets of the table jump at br_pc over every path into its dispatch block, or None."""
    mod = cfg.mod
    rn = bits(mod.word(br_pc), 5, 5)
    budget = [MAX_PATHS]

    def explore(path, depth):
        budget[0] -= 1
        if budget[0] < 0:
            return None
        st, t = _run(mod, path, rn, facts.get(path[0][0]))
        r = _solve(mod, t, st, False)
        if r is not None:
            return r
        preds = cfg.path_preds(path[0][0]) if depth < MAX_DEPTH else None
        if preds:
            out = set()
            for seg in preds:
                r = explore([seg] + path, depth + 1)
                if r is None:
                    break
                out |= r
            else:
                return out
        return _solve(mod, t, st, True)

    out = explore([(cfg.block(br_pc), br_pc, None)], 0)
    if not out or any(a % 4 or not mod.in_text(a) for a in out):
        return None
    return out


def _round(mod, entry, end, brs, tables, pads):
    """Resolution of every br in brs over the blocks, facts and predecessors that the table edges `tables` give."""
    cfg = _Cfg(mod, entry, end, tables, pads)
    facts, new = None, {}
    for a in brs:
        r = _explore(cfg, {}, a)
        if r is None:
            if facts is None:
                facts = _facts(cfg) or {}
            if facts:
                r = _explore(cfg, facts, a)
        new[a] = r
    return new


def _function(mod, entry, end):
    """{br: set of targets or None} for the table-shaped brs of [entry, end); cached for the last function.

    Table edges change the blocks, the facts and the predecessors the paths may take, so the function is resolved
    as a whole. Growth: start without table edges, resolve, add the targets found as edges, until no table grows
    (a table found unresolved here may still resolve once the blocks before it are reached). Check: give every
    unresolved table edges to every block, resolve again, drop any table that no longer resolves and grow any
    whose result its edges do not cover (an unresolved one included), until all are covered. By induction over an
    execution, the facts and every resolved table then hold together. The work is capped at MAX_STEPS evaluated
    instructions; a function that needs more gets no tables.
    """
    hit = _FUNCS.get(mod)
    if hit is not None and hit[0] == (entry, end):
        return hit[1]
    w = mod.words[(entry - mod.lo) >> 2:(end - mod.lo) >> 2]
    brs = [entry + 4 * int(i) for i in np.nonzero((w & 0xFFFFFC1F) == 0xD61F0000)[0]]
    brs = [a for a in brs if is_computed(mod, a, entry)]
    pads = {a: r for a, r in landing_pads(mod).items() if entry <= a < end}
    _budget[0] = MAX_STEPS
    try:
        result = _resolve_all(mod, entry, end, brs, pads)
    except _Exhausted:
        result = {a: None for a in brs}
    _FUNCS[mod] = ((entry, end), result)
    return result


def _resolve_all(mod, entry, end, brs, pads):
    tables, result = {}, {a: None for a in brs}
    for _ in range(MAX_ROUNDS if brs else 0):
        grown = False
        for a, r in _round(mod, entry, end, brs, tables, pads).items():
            if r is not None and not r <= tables.get(a, set()):
                tables[a] = tables.get(a, set()) | r
                grown = True
        if not grown:
            break
    dead = set()
    for _ in range(MAX_ROUNDS if brs else 0):
        full = {a: tables.get(a) for a in brs}
        new = _round(mod, entry, end, brs, full, pads)
        bad = [a for a in brs if new[a] is None and full[a] is not None or new[a] is not None and a not in dead
               and not new[a] <= (full[a] or set())]
        if not bad:
            result = {a: new[a] if full[a] is not None else None for a in brs}
            break
        for a in bad:
            if new[a] is None:
                del tables[a]
                dead.add(a)
            else:
                tables[a] = tables.get(a, set()) | new[a]
    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- interface

def table_targets(mod, br_pc, entry, end):
    """Every target the `br` at br_pc can reach through a proved table index, anywhere in .text; None if unproved."""
    if not is_computed(mod, br_pc, entry):
        return None
    t = _function(mod, entry, end).get(br_pc)
    return sorted(t) if t is not None else None


def resolve(mod, br_pc, entry, end):
    """Targets of the `br` at br_pc when it dispatches through a bounds-checked jump table inside [entry, end).

    mod is a recomp.module.Module. Returns a sorted list of distinct target addresses, every one in [entry, end)
    and 4-byte aligned, or None when the br is not a recognised table jump.
    """
    t = table_targets(mod, br_pc, entry, end)
    if t is None or t[0] < entry or t[-1] >= end:
        return None
    return t


def _table_shape(mod, t):
    """The br value is a code address, or address arithmetic over a loaded entry or an image address.

    A value loaded as a whole is a pointer (vtables, function-pointer arrays in .data): a call, not a table.
    """
    k = t[0]
    if k == 'c':
        return mod.in_text(t[1])
    if k in ('add', 'sub'):
        return _refers(mod, t)
    return False


def _refers(mod, e):
    """e contains a load or an image address and something unknown or loaded."""
    has_addr = has_var = False
    stack = [e]
    while stack:
        x = stack.pop()
        k = x[0]
        if k == 'c':
            has_addr |= mod.in_image(x[1])
        elif k in ('r', 'u', 'v', 'vw', 'ld'):
            has_var = True
            has_addr |= k == 'ld'
            if k == 'ld':
                stack.append(x[4])
        else:
            stack.extend(y for y in x[1:] if isinstance(y, tuple))
    return has_addr and has_var


def is_computed(mod, br_pc, entry):
    """True if the br register comes from address arithmetic (a table) rather than a load (a pointer call).

    Decided on the straight-line code before the br alone, so it does not depend on the function bounds.
    """
    w = mod.word(br_pc)
    if not _is_br(w):
        return False
    s = br_pc
    while s > entry and br_pc - s < 4 * MAX_BLOCK and not _ends_block(mod.word(s - 4)):
        s -= 4
    return _table_shape(mod, _run(mod, [(s, br_pc, None)], bits(w, 5, 5), None, spend=False)[1])

```

`recomp/layout.py`:

```py
"""Guest address layout of the loaded modules, computed from their sizes.

Guest addresses equal host addresses, and the lifter writes absolute addresses into the generated C, so the
generator and the runtime must agree on every module base. This is the single place that decides them: the generator
calls layout() and writes the result into generated/<version>/layout.h and layout.json, which the runtime and the
build read.

Modules are placed in Horizon's load order (rtld is dropped; the host links the modules):
main, subsdk0..9, sdk. Each base is aligned to 2 MiB. Everything must stay below 2^39, the limit of the addresses
IPC buffers can encode.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path

from nso import Nso

FIRST_BASE = 0x7000000000
ALIGN = 0x200000
ADDRESS_LIMIT = 1 << 39
ORDER = ['main'] + [f'subsdk{i}' for i in range(10)] + ['sdk']


def align_up(v, a=ALIGN):
    return (v + a - 1) & ~(a - 1)


def layout(exefs):
    """[(name, base, size)] for the modules present in the ExeFS directory, in load order."""
    exefs = Path(exefs)
    out, base = [], FIRST_BASE
    for name in ORDER:
        path = exefs / name
        if not path.exists():
            continue
        size = Nso(str(path)).size
        out.append((name, base, size))
        base = align_up(base + size)
    if base > ADDRESS_LIMIT:
        raise ValueError(f'modules end at {base:#x}, above 2^39')
    return out


def write(mods, outdir):
    """layout.json for Python tools and layout.h for the runtime."""
    outdir = Path(outdir)
    outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (outdir / 'layout.json').write_text(json.dumps(
        [{'name': n, 'base': f'{b:#x}', 'size': f'{s:#x}'} for n, b, s in mods], indent=1) + '\n')
    lines = ['// Module layout chosen by recomp/layout.py. Generated; do not edit.', '#pragma once', '']
    for n, b, s in mods:
        lines.append(f'#define MOD_{n.upper()}_BASE {b:#x}ull')
        lines.append(f'#define MOD_{n.upper()}_SIZE {s:#x}ull')
    lines += ['', f'#define MOD_COUNT {len(mods)}',
              '#define MOD_LIST(X) ' + ' '.join(f'X({n}, {n.upper()})' for n, _, _ in mods), '']
    (outdir / 'layout.h').write_text('\n'.join(lines))


def read(outdir):
    """[(name, base, size)] from a layout.json written by write()."""
    data = json.loads((Path(outdir) / 'layout.json').read_text())
    return [(m['name'], int(m['base'], 16), int(m['size'], 16)) for m in data]

```

`recomp/lifter.py`:

```py
# Adapted from LAS Recomp tools/lifter.py @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
"""AArch64 -> C static recompiler.

Integer, memory, and control flow are translated to C. FP/SIMD instructions (and CRC32) are
either re-emitted as inline assembly (simd='asm', AArch64 hosts), with guest V registers
loaded from / stored to the Cpu struct around each batch, so their semantics are
bit-exact by construction, or lowered to portable C (simd='c', tools/simd_c.py + runtime/simd.h).
"""
import struct

# Cpu struct offsets (must match runtime/cpu.h)
OFF_X = 0
OFF_SP = 256
OFF_PC = 264
OFF_NZCV = 272
OFF_V = 512

COND_NAMES = ['eq', 'ne', 'cs', 'cc', 'mi', 'pl', 'vs', 'vc', 'hi', 'ls', 'ge', 'lt', 'gt', 'le', 'al', 'nv']
SCRATCH = [9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17]


class Unsupported(Exception):
    pass


def bits(w, lo, n):
    return (w >> lo) & ((1 << n) - 1)


def sext(v, n):
    return v - (1 << n) if v & (1 << (n - 1)) else v


def ones(n):
    return (1 << n) - 1


def ror(v, r, size):
    r %= size
    return ((v >> r) | (v << (size - r))) & ones(size) if r else v


def replicate(v, esize, size):
    out = 0
    for i in range(0, size, esize):
        out |= v << i
    return out


def decode_bit_masks(N, imms, immr, size, immediate):
    x = (N << 6) | (~imms & 0x3F)
    if x == 0:
        raise Unsupported('reserved bitmask')
    length = x.bit_length() - 1
    if length < 1:
        raise Unsupported('reserved bitmask')
    levels = ones(length)
    if immediate and (imms & levels) == levels:
        raise Unsupported('reserved bitmask')
    S = imms & levels
    R = immr & levels
    diff = (S - R) & 0x3F
    esize = 1 << length
    d = diff & ones(length)
    welem = ones(S + 1)
    telem = ones(d + 1)
    wmask = replicate(ror(welem, R, esize), esize, size)
    tmask = replicate(telem, esize, size)
    return wmask, tmask


def hx(v):
    return f'0x{v:x}ull'


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- register helpers

def X(r):
    return '0ull' if r == 31 else f'c->x[{r}]'


def XS(r):
    return 'c->sp' if r == 31 else f'c->x[{r}]'


def W(r):
    return '0u' if r == 31 else f'(uint32_t)c->x[{r}]'


def WS(r):
    return '(uint32_t)c->sp' if r == 31 else f'(uint32_t)c->x[{r}]'


def R(sf, r, sp=False):
    if sf:
        return XS(r) if sp else X(r)
    return WS(r) if sp else W(r)


def set_reg(sf, r, expr, sp=False):
    """Statement writing expr to Rd (zero-extending 32-bit results)."""
    if r == 31 and not sp:
        return f'(void)({expr});'
    dst = 'c->sp' if r == 31 else f'c->x[{r}]'
    if sf:
        return f'{dst} = (uint64_t)({expr});'
    return f'{dst} = (uint32_t)({expr});'


def shift_expr(sf, val, typ, amt):
    if amt == 0 and typ != 3:
        return val
    if typ == 0:
        return f'({val} << {amt})'
    if typ == 1:
        return f'({val} >> {amt})'
    if typ == 2:
        return f'(uint64_t)((int64_t){val} >> {amt})' if sf else f'(uint32_t)((int32_t){val} >> {amt})'
    return f'ROR{64 if sf else 32}({val}, {amt})'


def extend_expr(r, option, shift):
    base = X(r)
    e = {
        0: f'(uint64_t)(uint8_t){base}',
        1: f'(uint64_t)(uint16_t){base}',
        2: f'(uint64_t)(uint32_t){base}',
        3: base,
        4: f'(uint64_t)(int64_t)(int8_t){base}',
        5: f'(uint64_t)(int64_t)(int16_t){base}',
        6: f'(uint64_t)(int64_t)(int32_t){base}',
        7: base,
    }[option]
    return f'({e} << {shift})' if shift else e


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- instruction classes

class Insn:
    """Result of lifting one instruction."""
    __slots__ = ('kind', 'code', 'target', 'cond', 'asm')

    def __init__(self, kind, code='', target=None, cond=None, asm=None):
        self.kind = kind      # 'op', 'asm', 'b', 'bcond', 'bl', 'blr', 'br', 'ret', 'trap'
        self.code = code      # C statements (for 'op'), or condition expr for 'bcond'
        self.target = target  # branch target (int) or register expr
        self.cond = cond
        self.asm = asm        # AsmInsn for 'asm'


class AsmInsn:
    """An FP/SIMD instruction to pass through as inline asm."""
    __slots__ = ('word', 'vregs', 'gprs', 'flags', 'consts')

    def __init__(self, word, vregs, gprs, flags=False, consts=None):
        self.word = word
        self.vregs = vregs    # set of V register numbers touched
        self.gprs = gprs      # list of (bit position, guest reg or 'sp')
        self.flags = flags
        self.consts = consts or []  # list of (bit position, constant) loaded into scratch


def is_fp_simd_dp(w):
    return bits(w, 25, 3) == 0b111


def is_ldst(w):
    return bits(w, 25, 1) == 0 and bits(w, 27, 1) == 1


class Lifter:
    def __init__(self, base, simd='asm'):
        self.base = base  # absolute load address of the module (guest == host)
        if simd not in ('asm', 'c'):
            raise ValueError(f'simd={simd!r}')
        self.sc = None
        if simd == 'c':
            # simd_c imports lifter at module level, so this import cannot move to the top.
            from simd_c import SimdC
            self.sc = SimdC()

    def lift(self, w, pc):
        """pc is absolute. Returns an Insn."""
        op0 = bits(w, 25, 4)
        if (op0 & 0b1110) == 0b1000:
            return self.dp_imm(w, pc)
        if (op0 & 0b1110) == 0b1010:
            return self.branch_sys(w, pc)
        if (op0 & 0b0101) == 0b0100:
            return self.ldst(w, pc)
        if (op0 & 0b0111) == 0b0101:
            return self.dp_reg(w, pc)
        if (op0 & 0b0111) == 0b0111:
            return self.fp_simd(w, pc)
        # padding, trap words (e7ffdefe), header data: trap if ever executed
        return Insn('trap', f'rt_udf(c, {hx(pc)});')

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ data processing (imm)

    def dp_imm(self, w, pc):
        op = bits(w, 23, 3)
        sf = bits(w, 31, 1)
        rd, rn = bits(w, 0, 5), bits(w, 5, 5)
        if op in (0, 1):  # PC-relative
            imm = sext((bits(w, 5, 19) << 2) | bits(w, 29, 2), 21)
            if bits(w, 31, 1):
                val = (pc & ~0xFFF) + (imm << 12)
            else:
                val = pc + imm
            return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rd, hx(val & ones(64))))
        if op == 2:  # add/sub imm
            opc, S, sh = bits(w, 30, 1), bits(w, 29, 1), bits(w, 22, 1)
            imm = bits(w, 10, 12) << (12 if sh else 0)
            a = R(sf, rn, sp=True)
            if S:
                fn = ('subs' if opc else 'adds') + ('64' if sf else '32')
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{fn}(c, {a}, {hx(imm)})'))
            return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{a} {"-" if opc else "+"} {hx(imm)}', sp=True))
        if op == 4:  # logical imm
            opc, N = bits(w, 29, 2), bits(w, 22, 1)
            if not sf and N:
                raise Unsupported('logical imm N=1 32-bit')
            size = 64 if sf else 32
            imm, _ = decode_bit_masks(N, bits(w, 10, 6), bits(w, 16, 6), size, True)
            a = R(sf, rn)
            if opc == 0:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{a} & {hx(imm)}', sp=True))
            if opc == 1:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{a} | {hx(imm)}', sp=True))
            if opc == 2:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{a} ^ {hx(imm)}', sp=True))
            return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'logic{size}(c, {a} & {hx(imm)})'))
        if op == 5:  # move wide
            opc, hw = bits(w, 29, 2), bits(w, 21, 2)
            if not sf and hw > 1:
                raise Unsupported('movw hw')
            imm = bits(w, 5, 16) << (hw * 16)
            if opc == 0:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, hx(~imm & ones(64 if sf else 32))))
            if opc == 2:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, hx(imm)))
            if opc == 3:
                mask = ~(0xFFFF << (hw * 16)) & ones(64)
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'({X(rd)} & {hx(mask)}) | {hx(imm)}'))
            raise Unsupported('movw opc')
        if op == 6:  # bitfield
            opc, N = bits(w, 29, 2), bits(w, 22, 1)
            immr, imms = bits(w, 16, 6), bits(w, 10, 6)
            size = 64 if sf else 32
            if N != sf:
                raise Unsupported('bitfield N')
            wmask, tmask = decode_bit_masks(N, imms, immr, size, False)
            src = R(sf, rn)
            rot = f'ROR{size}({src}, {immr})' if immr else src
            if opc == 2:  # UBFM
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{rot} & {hx(wmask & tmask)}'))
            if opc == 0:  # SBFM
                top = f'(uint{size}_t)(-(int{size}_t)(({src} >> {imms}) & 1))'
                return Insn('op', set_reg(
                    sf, rd, f'({top} & {hx(~tmask & ones(size))}) | ({rot} & {hx(wmask & tmask)})'))
            if opc == 1:  # BFM
                dst = R(sf, rd)
                bot = f'(({dst} & {hx(~wmask & ones(size))}) | ({rot} & {hx(wmask)}))'
                return Insn('op', set_reg(
                    sf, rd, f'({dst} & {hx(~tmask & ones(size))}) | ({bot} & {hx(tmask)})'))
            raise Unsupported('bitfield opc')
        if op == 7:  # EXTR
            rm, lsb = bits(w, 16, 5), bits(w, 10, 6)
            size = 64 if sf else 32
            if lsb == 0:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, R(sf, rm)))
            return Insn('op', set_reg(
                sf, rd, f'({R(sf, rm)} >> {lsb}) | ((uint{size}_t){R(sf, rn)} << {size - lsb})'))
        raise Unsupported(f'dp_imm {w:08x}')

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ branches / system

    def branch_sys(self, w, pc):
        if bits(w, 26, 5) == 0b00101:  # B / BL
            t = (pc + sext(bits(w, 0, 26), 26) * 4) & ones(64)
            return Insn('bl' if bits(w, 31, 1) else 'b', target=t)
        if bits(w, 25, 7) == 0b0101010 and not bits(w, 4, 1):  # B.cond
            t = pc + sext(bits(w, 5, 19), 19) * 4
            cond = bits(w, 0, 4)
            if cond >= 14:
                return Insn('b', target=t)
            return Insn('bcond', target=t, cond=f'COND_{COND_NAMES[cond].upper()}(c)')
        if bits(w, 25, 6) == 0b011010:  # CBZ/CBNZ
            sf, nz, rt = bits(w, 31, 1), bits(w, 24, 1), bits(w, 0, 5)
            t = pc + sext(bits(w, 5, 19), 19) * 4
            return Insn('bcond', target=t, cond=f'{R(sf, rt)} {"!=" if nz else "=="} 0')
        if bits(w, 25, 6) == 0b011011:  # TBZ/TBNZ
            b = (bits(w, 31, 1) << 5) | bits(w, 19, 5)
            nz, rt = bits(w, 24, 1), bits(w, 0, 5)
            t = pc + sext(bits(w, 5, 14), 14) * 4
            return Insn('bcond', target=t, cond=f'(({X(rt)} >> {b}) & 1) {"!=" if nz else "=="} 0')
        if bits(w, 25, 7) == 0b1101011:  # branch register
            opc, rn = bits(w, 21, 4), bits(w, 5, 5)
            op3 = bits(w, 10, 6)
            if bits(w, 16, 5) == 31 and op3 in (2, 3) and opc in (0, 1, 2, 8, 9):
                # Pointer authentication (ARMv8.3, Switch 2): BRA{A,B}[Z], BLRA{A,B}[Z], RETA{A,B}. The host never
                # signs pointers (PACIxSP and friends are hints, so NOPs), so these branch like BR/BLR/RET.
                opc &= 7
            elif bits(w, 16, 5) != 31 or op3 or bits(w, 0, 5):
                raise Unsupported('branch reg variant')
            if opc == 0:
                return Insn('br', target=X(rn))
            if opc == 1:
                return Insn('blr', target=X(rn))
            if opc == 2:
                return Insn('ret')
            raise Unsupported('branch reg opc')
        if bits(w, 24, 8) == 0b11010100:  # exception generation
            opc, ll, imm = bits(w, 21, 3), bits(w, 0, 5), bits(w, 5, 16)
            if opc == 0 and ll == 1:
                return Insn('op', f'rt_svc(c, {imm}, {hx(pc)});')
            if opc == 1 and ll == 0:
                return Insn('trap', f'rt_brk(c, {imm}, {hx(pc)});')
            raise Unsupported('exception')
        if bits(w, 22, 10) == 0b1101010100:
            return self.system(w, pc)
        raise Unsupported(f'branch_sys {w:08x}')

    def system(self, w, pc):
        L = bits(w, 21, 1)
        op0, op1, crn, crm, op2, rt = (bits(w, 19, 2), bits(w, 16, 3), bits(w, 12, 4),
                                       bits(w, 8, 4), bits(w, 5, 3), bits(w, 0, 5))
        if op0 == 0 and not L:
            if crn == 2 and op1 == 3 and rt == 31:  # hints
                return Insn('op', '/* hint */')
            if crn == 3 and op1 == 3 and rt == 31:  # barriers
                if op2 == 2:
                    return Insn('op', 'c->excl_addr = ~0ull;')
                return Insn('op', '__atomic_thread_fence(__ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);')
            raise Unsupported(f'pstate/system {w:08x}')
        if op0 == 1:  # SYS
            if not L and op1 == 3 and crn == 7 and crm == 4 and op2 == 1:  # DC ZVA
                return Insn('op', f'memset((void*)(uintptr_t)({X(rt)} & ~63ull), 0, 64);')
            return Insn('op', '/* cache maintenance */')
        key = (op0, op1, crn, crm, op2)
        if L:  # MRS
            src = {
                (3, 3, 13, 0, 3): 'c->tpidrro',
                (3, 3, 13, 0, 2): 'c->tpidr',
                (3, 3, 14, 0, 0): '19200000ull',
                (3, 3, 14, 0, 1): 'rt_ticks()',
                (3, 3, 14, 0, 2): 'rt_ticks()',
                (3, 3, 4, 2, 0): 'c->nzcv',
                (3, 3, 4, 4, 0): 'c->fpcr' if self.sc else 'rt_get_fpcr()',
                (3, 3, 4, 4, 1): 'c->fpsr' if self.sc else 'rt_get_fpsr()',
                (3, 3, 0, 0, 7): '4ull',
                (3, 3, 0, 0, 1): '0x8444c004ull',
            }.get(key)
            if src is None:
                raise Unsupported(f'mrs {key}')
            return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rt, src))
        dst = {
            (3, 3, 13, 0, 2): 'c->tpidr = {v};',
            (3, 3, 4, 2, 0): 'c->nzcv = {v} & 0xf0000000ull;',
            (3, 3, 4, 4, 0): 'c->fpcr = {v} & 0x7c00000ull; rt_fpcr_sync(c);' if self.sc else 'rt_set_fpcr({v});',
            (3, 3, 4, 4, 1): 'c->fpsr = {v} & 0xf800009full;' if self.sc else 'rt_set_fpsr({v});',
        }.get(key)
        if dst is None:
            raise Unsupported(f'msr {key}')
        return Insn('op', dst.format(v=X(rt)))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ loads / stores

    def ldst(self, w, pc):
        V = bits(w, 26, 1)
        if V:
            if self.sc:
                return Insn('op', self.sc.ldst(w, pc))
            return self.ldst_simd(w, pc)
        if bits(w, 24, 6) == 0b001000:
            return self.ldst_excl(w, pc)
        if bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b011 and bits(w, 24, 2) == 0:  # literal
            opc, rt = bits(w, 30, 2), bits(w, 0, 5)
            addr = pc + sext(bits(w, 5, 19), 19) * 4
            if opc == 0:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(0, rt, f'LD32({hx(addr)})'))
            if opc == 1:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rt, f'LD64({hx(addr)})'))
            if opc == 2:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rt, f'(int64_t)(int32_t)LD32({hx(addr)})'))
            return Insn('op', '/* prfm */')
        if bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b101:
            return self.ldst_pair(w)
        if bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b111:
            return self.ldst_reg(w)
        if (w & 0xFFE00000) == 0xD9200000 and bits(w, 10, 2):
            return self.stg(w)
        raise Unsupported(f'ldst {w:08x}')

    def stg(self, w):
        """STG (post-index, signed offset, pre-index). Horizon runs without MTE, so storing an allocation tag
        changes no memory; only the base writeback remains (1.4.3 sdk+0x640050)."""
        mode, rn = bits(w, 10, 2), bits(w, 5, 5)
        if mode == 2:
            return Insn('op', '/* stg */')
        off = sext(bits(w, 12, 9), 9) << 4
        dst = 'c->sp' if rn == 31 else f'c->x[{rn}]'
        return Insn('op', f'{dst} = {XS(rn)} + {hx(off & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)}; /* stg */')

    def ldst_excl(self, w, pc):
        size, o2, L, o1, rs, o0, rn, rt = (bits(w, 30, 2), bits(w, 23, 1), bits(w, 22, 1), bits(w, 21, 1),
                                           bits(w, 16, 5), bits(w, 15, 1), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 0, 5))
        nbits = 8 << size
        addr = XS(rn)
        if o1:
            if o2:
                return self.cas(size, rs, rt, addr)
            if bits(w, 31, 1):
                return self.excl_pair(bits(w, 30, 1), L, rs, bits(w, 10, 5), rt, addr)
            return self.casp(bits(w, 30, 1), rs, rt, addr)
        if o2 == 0:
            if L:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rt, f'ldx{nbits}(c, {addr})'))
            return Insn('op', f'{{ uint32_t st = stx{nbits}(c, {addr}, {X(rt)}); {set_reg(0, rs, "st")} }}')
        if L:
            return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rt, f'lda{nbits}({addr})'))
        return Insn('op', f'stl{nbits}({addr}, {X(rt)});')

    def excl_pair(self, sz, L, rs, rt2, rt, addr):
        """LDXP/LDAXP/STXP/STLXP. Two W registers form one 64-bit exclusive, two X registers one 128-bit."""
        if L:
            if sz:
                return Insn('op', f'{{ __uint128_t p = ldxp128(c, {addr}); '
                                  f'{set_reg(1, rt, "(uint64_t)p")} {set_reg(1, rt2, "(uint64_t)(p >> 64)")} }}')
            return Insn('op', f'{{ uint64_t p = ldx64(c, {addr}); '
                              f'{set_reg(0, rt, "p")} {set_reg(0, rt2, "p >> 32")} }}')
        if sz:
            st = f'stxp128(c, {addr}, {X(rt)}, {X(rt2)})'
        else:
            st = f'stx64(c, {addr}, (uint64_t){W(rt)} | ((uint64_t){W(rt2)} << 32))'
        return Insn('op', f'{{ uint32_t st = {st}; {set_reg(0, rs, "st")} }}')

    def cas(self, size, rs, rt, addr):
        """CAS{A}{L}{B,H}: Rs is the compare value and receives the old memory value."""
        t = f'uint{8 << size}_t'
        return Insn('op', f'{{ {t} e = ({t}){X(rs)}; __atomic_compare_exchange_n(({t} *)(uintptr_t)({addr}), &e, '
                          f'({t}){X(rt)}, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); {set_reg(size == 3, rs, "e")} }}')

    def casp(self, sz, rs, rt, addr):
        """CASP{A}{L}: register pairs (Rs, Rs+1) compared and (Rt, Rt+1) stored as one 64- or 128-bit access."""
        if rs & 1 or rt & 1:
            raise Unsupported('casp odd register')
        if sz:
            t = '__uint128_t'
            e = f'(({t}){X(rs + 1)} << 64) | {X(rs)}'
            v = f'(({t}){X(rt + 1)} << 64) | {X(rt)}'
            lo, hi = set_reg(1, rs, '(uint64_t)e'), set_reg(1, rs + 1, '(uint64_t)(e >> 64)')
        else:
            t = 'uint64_t'
            e = f'(uint64_t){W(rs)} | ((uint64_t){W(rs + 1)} << 32)'
            v = f'(uint64_t){W(rt)} | ((uint64_t){W(rt + 1)} << 32)'
            lo, hi = set_reg(0, rs, 'e'), set_reg(0, rs + 1, 'e >> 32')
        return Insn('op', f'{{ {t} e = {e}; __atomic_compare_exchange_n(({t} *)(uintptr_t)({addr}), &e, {v}, 0, '
                          f'__ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); {lo} {hi} }}')

    def atomic(self, w):
        """LSE LD<op>{A}{L}{B,H} and SWP{A}{L}{B,H}: Rt receives the old memory value, Rs is the operand."""
        size, A, R, rs, o3, opc, rn, rt = (bits(w, 30, 2), bits(w, 23, 1), bits(w, 22, 1), bits(w, 16, 5),
                                           bits(w, 15, 1), bits(w, 12, 3), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 0, 5))
        nbits = 8 << size
        t = f'uint{nbits}_t'
        p, v = f'({t} *)(uintptr_t)({XS(rn)})', f'({t}){X(rs)}'
        order = ('__ATOMIC_RELAXED', '__ATOMIC_RELEASE', '__ATOMIC_ACQUIRE', '__ATOMIC_ACQ_REL')[A << 1 | R]
        if o3:
            if opc == 4 and A and not R and rs == 31:  # LDAPR{B,H} (RCpc, ARMv8.3): acquire load
                return Insn('op', set_reg(size == 3, rt, f'__atomic_load_n({p}, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)'))
            if opc:
                raise Unsupported('ldapr')
            expr = f'__atomic_exchange_n({p}, {v}, {order})'
        elif opc < 4:
            fn, operand = (('add', v), ('and', f'({t})~{X(rs)}'), ('xor', v), ('or', v))[opc]
            expr = f'__atomic_fetch_{fn}({p}, {operand}, {order})'
        else:
            fn = ('smax', 'smin', 'umax', 'umin')[opc - 4]
            expr = f'atomic_{fn}{nbits}({XS(rn)}, {v})'
        return Insn('op', set_reg(size == 3, rt, expr))

    def ldst_pair(self, w):
        opc, mode, L = bits(w, 30, 2), bits(w, 23, 2), bits(w, 22, 1)
        imm7, rt2, rn, rt = sext(bits(w, 15, 7), 7), bits(w, 10, 5), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 0, 5)
        if opc == 3:
            raise Unsupported('pair opc 3')
        scale = 3 if opc == 2 else 2
        off = imm7 << scale
        base = XS(rn)
        post = mode == 1
        wb = mode in (1, 3)
        ea = base if post else (f'{base} + {off}' if off >= 0 else f'{base} - {-off}')
        lines = [f'uint64_t ea = {ea};']
        if L:
            if opc == 2:
                lines.append('uint64_t a = LD64(ea), b = LD64(ea + 8);')
            elif opc == 1:  # LDPSW
                lines.append('uint64_t a = (int64_t)(int32_t)LD32(ea), b = (int64_t)(int32_t)LD32(ea + 4);')
            else:
                lines.append('uint64_t a = LD32(ea), b = LD32(ea + 4);')
        else:
            if opc == 2:
                lines.append(f'ST64(ea, {X(rt)}); ST64(ea + 8, {X(rt2)});')
            else:
                lines.append(f'ST32(ea, {W(rt)}); ST32(ea + 4, {W(rt2)});')
        if wb:
            dst = 'c->sp' if rn == 31 else f'c->x[{rn}]'
            if not post:
                lines.append(f'{dst} = ea;')
            else:
                lines.append(f'{dst} = ea + {off};' if off >= 0 else f'{dst} = ea - {-off};')
        if L:
            lines.append(set_reg(1, rt, 'a'))
            lines.append(set_reg(1, rt2, 'b'))
        return Insn('op', '{ ' + ' '.join(lines) + ' }')

    def ldst_reg(self, w):
        size, opc, rn, rt = bits(w, 30, 2), bits(w, 22, 2), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 0, 5)
        base = XS(rn)
        wb = None
        if bits(w, 24, 2) == 1:
            ea = f'{base} + {hx(bits(w, 10, 12) << size)}'
        else:
            kind = bits(w, 10, 2)
            if bits(w, 21, 1):
                if kind == 0:
                    return self.atomic(w)
                if kind != 2:
                    raise Unsupported('ldst reg pac')
                rm, option, S = bits(w, 16, 5), bits(w, 13, 3), bits(w, 12, 1)
                if option not in (2, 3, 6, 7):
                    raise Unsupported('ldst reg option')
                ea = f'{base} + {extend_expr(rm, option, size if S else 0)}'
            else:
                imm9 = sext(bits(w, 12, 9), 9)
                sign_imm = f'+ {imm9}' if imm9 >= 0 else f'- {-imm9}'
                if kind in (0, 2):  # unscaled, unprivileged
                    ea = f'{base} {sign_imm}'
                elif kind == 1:  # post
                    ea = base
                    wb = f'{base} {sign_imm}'
                else:  # pre
                    ea = f'{base} {sign_imm}'
                    wb = 'ea'
        nbits = 8 << size
        if opc == 0:
            parts = [f'ST{nbits}(ea, {X(rt) if size == 3 else W(rt)});']
            load = None
        elif opc == 1:
            parts = [f'uint64_t v = LD{nbits}(ea);']
            load = set_reg(1, rt, 'v')
        elif size == 3:
            return Insn('op', '/* prfm */')
        elif size == 2 and opc == 3:
            raise Unsupported('ldst size2 opc3')
        else:
            parts = [f'uint64_t v = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int{nbits}_t)LD{nbits}(ea);']
            load = set_reg(1 if opc == 2 else 0, rt, 'v')
        parts.insert(0, f'uint64_t ea = {ea};')
        if wb:
            # writeback before the register load, so a load into rn wins
            parts.append(f'{"c->sp" if rn == 31 else f"c->x[{rn}]"} = {wb};')
        if load:
            parts.append(load)
        return Insn('op', '{ ' + ' '.join(parts) + ' }')

    def ldst_simd(self, w, pc):
        """FP/SIMD loads and stores are passed through as asm; GPR address regs are remapped."""
        rt = bits(w, 0, 5)
        if bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b011 and bits(w, 24, 2) == 0:  # literal -> LDR (imm, offset 0) via scratch
            opc = bits(w, 30, 2)
            size, o = {0: (2, 1), 1: (3, 1), 2: (0, 3)}[opc]
            addr = pc + sext(bits(w, 5, 19), 19) * 4
            new = (size << 30) | 0x3D000000 | (o << 22) | (31 << 5) | rt
            return Insn('asm', asm=AsmInsn(new, {rt}, [], consts=[(5, addr)]))
        if bits(w, 31, 1) == 0 and bits(w, 24, 6) in (0b001100, 0b001101):  # structures
            post = bits(w, 23, 1)
            rn, rm = bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 16, 5)
            if bits(w, 24, 1) == 0:
                n = {0: 4, 2: 4, 4: 3, 6: 3, 7: 1, 8: 2, 10: 2}.get(bits(w, 12, 4))
                if n is None:
                    raise Unsupported('ldst multiple opcode')
            else:
                n = ((bits(w, 13, 1) << 1) | bits(w, 21, 1)) + 1
            vregs = {(rt + i) % 32 for i in range(n)}
            gprs = [(5, 'sp' if rn == 31 else rn)]
            if post and rm != 31:
                gprs.append((16, rm))
            return Insn('asm', asm=AsmInsn(w, vregs, gprs))
        rn = bits(w, 5, 5)
        gprs = [(5, 'sp' if rn == 31 else rn)]
        vregs = {rt}
        if bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b101:  # pair
            vregs.add(bits(w, 10, 5))
        elif bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b111 and bits(w, 24, 2) == 0 and bits(w, 21, 1) and bits(w, 10, 2) == 2:
            rm = bits(w, 16, 5)
            if rm != 31:
                gprs.append((16, rm))
        return Insn('asm', asm=AsmInsn(w, vregs, gprs))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ data processing (reg)

    def dp_reg(self, w, pc):
        sf = bits(w, 31, 1)
        rd, rn, rm = bits(w, 0, 5), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 16, 5)
        size = 64 if sf else 32
        op1 = bits(w, 28, 1)
        if not op1:
            if bits(w, 24, 4) == 0b1010:  # logical shifted
                opc, sh, N, amt = bits(w, 29, 2), bits(w, 22, 2), bits(w, 21, 1), bits(w, 10, 6)
                if not sf and amt >= 32:
                    raise Unsupported('logical shift amount')
                b = shift_expr(sf, R(sf, rm), sh, amt)
                if N:
                    b = f'(uint{size}_t)~{b}'
                a = R(sf, rn)
                expr = {0: f'{a} & {b}', 1: f'{a} | {b}', 2: f'{a} ^ {b}', 3: f'{a} & {b}'}[opc]
                if opc == 3:
                    return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'logic{size}(c, (uint{size}_t)({expr}))'))
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, expr))
            if bits(w, 24, 4) == 0b1011:  # add/sub shifted or extended
                op, S = bits(w, 30, 1), bits(w, 29, 1)
                if bits(w, 21, 1) == 0:
                    sh, amt = bits(w, 22, 2), bits(w, 10, 6)
                    if sh == 3:
                        raise Unsupported('add shift ror')
                    a = R(sf, rn)
                    b = shift_expr(sf, R(sf, rm), sh, amt)
                    sp_ok = False
                else:
                    if bits(w, 22, 2):
                        raise Unsupported('add ext opt')
                    option, amt = bits(w, 13, 3), bits(w, 10, 3)
                    a = R(sf, rn, sp=True)
                    b = extend_expr(rm, option, amt)
                    if not sf:
                        b = f'(uint32_t)({b})'
                    sp_ok = not S
                if S:
                    fn = ('subs' if op else 'adds') + str(size)
                    return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{fn}(c, {a}, (uint{size}_t)({b}))'))
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{a} {"-" if op else "+"} {b}', sp=sp_ok))
            raise Unsupported(f'dp_reg {w:08x}')
        op2 = bits(w, 21, 4)
        if bits(w, 24, 4) == 0b1011:  # 3-source
            op54, op31, o0, ra = bits(w, 29, 2), bits(w, 21, 3), bits(w, 15, 1), bits(w, 10, 5)
            if op54:
                raise Unsupported('dp3 op54')
            sgn = '-' if o0 else '+'
            if op31 == 0:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{R(sf, ra)} {sgn} {R(sf, rn)} * {R(sf, rm)}'))
            if op31 == 1:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rd, f'{X(ra)} {sgn} (uint64_t)((int64_t)(int32_t){W(rn)} * (int64_t)(int32_t){W(rm)})'))
            if op31 == 5:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rd, f'{X(ra)} {sgn} (uint64_t){W(rn)} * (uint64_t){W(rm)}'))
            if op31 == 2:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(
                    1, rd, f'(uint64_t)(((__int128)(int64_t){X(rn)} * (__int128)(int64_t){X(rm)}) >> 64)'))
            if op31 == 6:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rd, f'(uint64_t)(((unsigned __int128){X(rn)} * {X(rm)}) >> 64)'))
            raise Unsupported('dp3')
        if op2 == 0:  # add/sub with carry
            op, S = bits(w, 30, 1), bits(w, 29, 1)
            fn = ('sbc' if op else 'adc') + ('s' if S else '') + str(size)
            return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{fn}(c, {R(sf, rn)}, {R(sf, rm)})'))
        if op2 == 2:  # conditional compare
            op, imm_form, cond, nzcv = bits(w, 30, 1), bits(w, 11, 1), bits(w, 12, 4), bits(w, 0, 4)
            b = hx(rm) if imm_form else R(sf, rm)
            fn = ('subs' if op else 'adds') + str(size)
            return Insn('op', f'if ({cond_expr(cond)}) (void){fn}(c, {R(sf, rn)}, {b}); '
                              f'else c->nzcv = {hx(nzcv << 28)};')
        if op2 == 4:  # conditional select
            op, o2, cond = bits(w, 30, 1), bits(w, 10, 2), bits(w, 12, 4)
            b = R(sf, rm)
            alt = {(0, 0): b, (0, 1): f'{b} + 1', (1, 0): f'~{b}', (1, 1): f'-{b}'}.get((op, o2))
            if alt is None:
                raise Unsupported('csel variant')
            return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'({cond_expr(cond)}) ? {R(sf, rn)} : (uint{size}_t)({alt})'))
        if op2 == 6:
            opcode = bits(w, 10, 6)
            if bits(w, 30, 1):  # 1-source
                if bits(w, 16, 5) == 1 and sf and opcode <= 17:
                    # PAC*/AUT* (opcode 0-15) and XPAC{I,D} (16, 17): pointers are never signed on the host, so
                    # signing, authenticating and stripping all leave the register as it is.
                    return Insn('op', '/* pac */')
                if bits(w, 16, 5):
                    raise Unsupported('dp1 opcode2')
                a = R(sf, rn)
                expr = {
                    0: f'rbit{size}({a})',
                    1: f'rev16_{size}({a})',
                    2: f'__builtin_bswap32({a})' if not sf else f'rev32_64({a})',
                    3: f'__builtin_bswap64({a})' if sf else None,
                    4: f'clz{size}({a})',
                    5: f'cls{size}({a})',
                }.get(opcode)
                if expr is None:
                    raise Unsupported('dp1')
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, expr))
            if 16 <= opcode <= 23:  # CRC32: host has the same instruction
                if self.sc:
                    return Insn('op', self.sc.crc(w))
                gprs = [(p, r) for p, r in ((0, rd), (5, rn), (16, rm)) if r != 31]
                return Insn('asm', asm=AsmInsn(w, set(), gprs))
            a, b = R(sf, rn), R(sf, rm)
            if sf and opcode == 12:  # PACGA (ARMv8.3): no pointer signing on host, return 0
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rd, '0ull'))
            expr = {
                2: f'udiv{size}({a}, {b})',
                3: f'sdiv{size}({a}, {b})',
                8: f'{a} << ({b} & {size - 1})',
                9: f'{a} >> ({b} & {size - 1})',
                10: f'(uint{size}_t)((int{size}_t){a} >> ({b} & {size - 1}))',
                11: f'ROR{size}({a}, {b} & {size - 1})',
            }.get(opcode)
            if expr is None:
                raise Unsupported('dp2')
            return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, expr))
        raise Unsupported(f'dp_reg {w:08x}')

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ FP / SIMD data processing

    def fp_simd(self, w, pc):
        if self.sc:
            return Insn('op', self.sc.dp(w, pc))
        rd, rn, rm, ra = bits(w, 0, 5), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 16, 5), bits(w, 10, 5)
        vregs = {rd, rn, rm, ra}
        gprs = []
        flags = False
        if (w & 0x5F20FC00) == 0x1E200000:  # FP <-> integer
            opcode = bits(w, 16, 3)
            if opcode in (0, 1, 4, 5, 6):
                gprs = [(0, rd)]
                vregs = {rn}
            else:
                gprs = [(5, rn)]
                vregs = {rd}
        elif (w & 0x5F200000) == 0x1E000000:  # FP <-> fixed point
            opcode = bits(w, 16, 3)
            if opcode in (0, 1):
                gprs = [(0, rd)]
                vregs = {rn}
            else:
                gprs = [(5, rn)]
                vregs = {rd}
        elif (w & 0x9FE08400) == 0x0E000400 and bits(w, 29, 1) == 0:  # AdvSIMD copy
            imm4 = bits(w, 11, 4)
            if imm4 in (1, 3):
                gprs = [(5, rn)]
                vregs = {rd}
            elif imm4 in (5, 7):
                gprs = [(0, rd)]
                vregs = {rn}
            else:
                vregs = {rd, rn}
        elif (w & 0xBFE08C00) == 0x0E000000:  # TBL/TBX
            n = bits(w, 13, 2) + 1
            vregs = {rd, rm} | {(rn + i) % 32 for i in range(n)}
        if (w & 0x5F203C00) == 0x1E202000 or (w & 0x5F200C00) in (0x1E200400, 0x1E200C00):
            flags = True
        gprs = [(p, r) for p, r in gprs if r != 31]  # register 31 is zr in these encodings
        return Insn('asm', asm=AsmInsn(w, vregs, gprs, flags))


def cond_expr(cond):
    return f'COND_{COND_NAMES[cond].upper()}(c)' if cond < 14 else '1'


def emit_asm_batch(batch):
    """Emit one inline-asm block for a run of FP/SIMD instructions."""
    vregs = set()
    gmap = {}
    flags = False
    consts = []
    words = []
    for a in batch:
        vregs |= a.vregs
        flags |= a.flags
        w = a.word
        for pos, g in a.gprs:
            if g not in gmap:
                if len(gmap) + len(consts) >= len(SCRATCH):
                    raise Unsupported('scratch exhausted')
                gmap[g] = SCRATCH[len(gmap) + len(consts)]
            w = (w & ~(31 << pos)) | (gmap[g] << pos)
        for pos, val in a.consts:
            s = SCRATCH[len(gmap) + len(consts)]
            consts.append((s, val))
            w = (w & ~(31 << pos)) | (s << pos)
        words.append(w)
    lines = []
    ins = ['"r"(c)']
    for g, s in gmap.items():
        off = OFF_SP if g == 'sp' else OFF_X + 8 * g
        lines.append(f'ldr x{s}, [%0, #{off}]')
    for i, (s, val) in enumerate(consts):
        ins.append(f'"r"({hx(val)})')
        lines.append(f'mov x{s}, %{len(ins) - 1}')
    for v in sorted(vregs):
        lines.append(f'ldr q{v}, [%0, #{OFF_V + 16 * v}]')
    if flags:
        lines.append(f'ldr x16, [%0, #{OFF_NZCV}]')
        lines.append('msr nzcv, x16')
    lines += [f'.inst 0x{x:08x}' for x in words]
    if flags:
        lines.append('mrs x16, nzcv')
        lines.append(f'str x16, [%0, #{OFF_NZCV}]')
    for v in sorted(vregs):
        lines.append(f'str q{v}, [%0, #{OFF_V + 16 * v}]')
    for g, s in gmap.items():
        off = OFF_SP if g == 'sp' else OFF_X + 8 * g
        lines.append(f'str x{s}, [%0, #{off}]')
    clob = [f'"v{v}"' for v in sorted(vregs)]
    clob += [f'"x{s}"' for s in sorted(set(gmap.values()) | {s for s, _ in consts} | ({16} if flags else set()))]
    clob += ['"cc"', '"memory"']
    body = '\\n\\t'.join(lines)
    return f'__asm__ volatile("{body}" :: {", ".join(ins)} : {", ".join(clob)});'

```

`recomp/module.py`:

```py
"""One loaded NSO module as the generator and its analyses see it: image at a guest base, .text as words,
function seeds, and bounded-cache instruction lifting.

The function seeds and the .eh_frame_hdr reader are adapted from LAS Recomp tools/analyze.py and tools/gen.py
@ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
"""
import struct
from collections import OrderedDict

import numpy as np

from lifter import Insn, Lifter, Unsupported, hx
from nso import Nso, R_AARCH64_RELATIVE

LIFT_CACHE = 1 << 16  # lifted instructions kept per module; analyses revisit nearby addresses only


def _read_encoded(img, off, enc, pc_base):
    fmt, app = enc & 0x0F, enc & 0x70
    if fmt == 0x0B:  # sdata4
        v, size = struct.unpack_from('<i', img, off)[0], 4
    elif fmt == 0x03:  # udata4
        v, size = struct.unpack_from('<I', img, off)[0], 4
    elif fmt in (0x0C, 0x04):  # sdata8, udata8
        v, size = struct.unpack_from('<q' if fmt == 0x0C else '<Q', img, off)[0], 8
    else:
        raise ValueError(f'unsupported pointer encoding {enc:#x}')
    if app == 0x10:  # pcrel
        v += off
    elif app == 0x30:  # datarel
        v += pc_base
    return v, size


class Module:
    def __init__(self, name, path, base, simd='c'):
        self.name = name
        self.nso = Nso(str(path))
        self.base = base
        n = self.nso
        self.image = bytes(n.image)
        self.lo = base + n.text[0]
        self.hi = self.lo + n.text[1]
        self.words = np.frombuffer(self.image, dtype='<u4', count=n.text[1] // 4, offset=n.text[0])
        self.lifter = Lifter(base, simd)
        self._cache = OrderedDict()

    # ---- memory

    def in_text(self, a):
        return self.lo <= a < self.hi and a % 4 == 0

    def in_image(self, a, n=1):
        return self.base <= a and a + n <= self.base + len(self.image)

    def word(self, a):
        return int(self.words[(a - self.lo) >> 2])

    def read(self, a, n, signed=False):
        """Little-endian integer of n bytes at guest address a (unrelocated image)."""
        o = a - self.base
        return int.from_bytes(self.image[o:o + n], 'little', signed=signed)

    # ---- lifting

    def lift(self, a):
        """Lifted instruction at a; Unsupported becomes an rt_udf trap."""
        ins = self._cache.get(a)
        if ins is not None:
            self._cache.move_to_end(a)
            return ins
        try:
            ins = self.lifter.lift(self.word(a), a)
        except Unsupported as e:
            ins = Insn('trap', f'rt_udf(c, {hx(a)}); /* {e} */')
        self._cache[a] = ins
        if len(self._cache) > LIFT_CACHE:
            self._cache.popitem(last=False)
        return ins

    # ---- function seeds

    def eh_frame_functions(self):
        """Function starts from .eh_frame_hdr's binary search table (absolute addresses)."""
        img, hdr = self.image, self.nso.eh_start
        if not hdr or hdr >= len(img):
            return []
        _, ptr_enc, cnt_enc, tbl_enc = img[hdr:hdr + 4]
        off = hdr + 4
        _, sz = _read_encoded(img, off, ptr_enc, hdr)
        off += sz
        count, sz = _read_encoded(img, off, cnt_enc, hdr)
        off += sz
        starts = []
        for _ in range(count):
            loc, sz = _read_encoded(img, off, tbl_enc, hdr)
            off += sz
            _, sz = _read_encoded(img, off, tbl_enc, hdr)
            off += sz
            starts.append(self.base + loc)
        return starts

    def seeds(self):
        """Known function starts: .eh_frame_hdr, exported FUNC symbols, R_AARCH64_RELATIVE targets in .text."""
        starts = set(self.eh_frame_functions())
        for _, info, shndx, value, _ in self.nso.syms:
            if shndx and (info & 0xF) == 2:
                starts.add(self.base + value)
        for _, typ, _, add in self.nso.relocs:
            if typ == R_AARCH64_RELATIVE:
                starts.add(self.base + add)
        return sorted(a for a in starts if self.in_text(a))

```

`recomp/nso.py`:

```py
# Adapted from LAS Recomp tools/nso.py @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
"""NSO loader: decompress segments, build the memory image, parse MOD0/dynamic info."""
import ctypes
import os
import struct
import sys
from collections import Counter

import lz4.block

_ZBIC_DLL = None


def _zbic_decompress(src, dec_size):
    global _ZBIC_DLL
    if _ZBIC_DLL is None:
        dll_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'zbic.dll')
        _ZBIC_DLL = ctypes.CDLL(dll_path)
        _ZBIC_DLL.ZSTD_decompress.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
        _ZBIC_DLL.ZSTD_decompress.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
    dst = ctypes.create_string_buffer(dec_size)
    res = _ZBIC_DLL.ZSTD_decompress(dst, dec_size, src, len(src))
    if res != dec_size:
        raise ValueError(f'ZBIC decompression failed: got {res:#x}, expected {dec_size:#x}')
    return dst.raw

DT_NULL, DT_NEEDED, DT_PLTRELSZ, DT_HASH, DT_STRTAB, DT_SYMTAB, DT_RELA, DT_RELASZ = 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8
DT_STRSZ, DT_JMPREL, DT_RELACOUNT = 10, 23, 0x6FFFFFF9
DT_RELRSZ, DT_RELR, DT_GNU_HASH = 0x23, 0x24, 0x6FFFFEF5
R_AARCH64_ABS64, R_AARCH64_GLOB_DAT, R_AARCH64_JUMP_SLOT, R_AARCH64_RELATIVE = 257, 1025, 1026, 1027


class Nso:
    def __init__(self, path):
        raw = open(path, 'rb').read()
        assert raw[:4] == b'NSO0', path
        flags = struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, 0xC)[0]
        self.build_id = raw[0x40:0x60].rstrip(b'\0').hex()
        segs = []
        for i in range(3):
            file_off, mem_off, dec_size = struct.unpack_from('<III', raw, 0x10 + i * 0x10)
            comp_size = struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, 0x60 + i * 4)[0]
            data = raw[file_off:file_off + comp_size]
            if flags & (1 << i):
                if flags & 0x80:
                    data = _zbic_decompress(data, dec_size)
                else:
                    data = lz4.block.decompress(data, uncompressed_size=dec_size)
            segs.append((mem_off, data))
        self.bss_size = struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, 0x3C)[0]
        self.text = (segs[0][0], len(segs[0][1]))
        self.rodata = (segs[1][0], len(segs[1][1]))
        self.data = (segs[2][0], len(segs[2][1]))
        end = segs[2][0] + len(segs[2][1]) + self.bss_size
        self.size = (end + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFF
        img = bytearray(self.size)
        for off, d in segs:
            img[off:off + len(d)] = d
        self.image = img
        self._parse_mod0()

    def u32(self, off): return struct.unpack_from('<I', self.image, off)[0]
    def u64(self, off): return struct.unpack_from('<Q', self.image, off)[0]

    def _parse_mod0(self):
        mod0 = self.u32(4)
        assert self.image[mod0:mod0 + 4] == b'MOD0'
        rel = lambda i: mod0 + struct.unpack_from('<i', self.image, mod0 + 4 + i * 4)[0]
        self.dynamic, self.bss_start, self.bss_end = rel(0), rel(1), rel(2)
        self.eh_start, self.eh_end, self.module_obj = rel(3), rel(4), rel(5)
        dyn = {}
        needed = []
        off = self.dynamic
        while True:
            tag, val = self.u64(off), self.u64(off + 8)
            off += 16
            if tag == DT_NULL:
                break
            if tag == DT_NEEDED:
                needed.append(val)
            dyn.setdefault(tag, val)
        self.dyn = dyn
        strtab = dyn.get(DT_STRTAB, 0)
        self.strtab = strtab
        self.needed = [self.cstr(strtab + n) for n in needed]
        # dynsym count from DT_HASH nchain, or from DT_GNU_HASH (1.4.3 sdk and subsdk0 have no DT_HASH)
        self.syms = []
        nsyms = self.symbol_count()
        if nsyms and DT_SYMTAB in dyn:
            st = dyn[DT_SYMTAB]
            for i in range(nsyms):
                o = st + i * 24
                name, info, other, shndx = struct.unpack_from('<IBBH', self.image, o)
                value, size = struct.unpack_from('<QQ', self.image, o + 8)
                self.syms.append((self.cstr(strtab + name), info, shndx, value, size))
        self.relocs = []
        for base_tag, size_tag in ((DT_RELA, DT_RELASZ), (DT_JMPREL, DT_PLTRELSZ)):
            if base_tag in dyn:
                b, n = dyn[base_tag], dyn[size_tag] // 24
                for i in range(n):
                    r_off, r_info, r_add = struct.unpack_from('<QQq', self.image, b + i * 24)
                    self.relocs.append((r_off, r_info & 0xFFFFFFFF, r_info >> 32, r_add))
        # DT_RELR (1.4.3): packed RELATIVE relocations whose addend is the word in place. An even entry is an address
        # (relocate it, continue after it); an odd entry is a bitmap of the next 63 words.
        if DT_RELR in dyn:
            where = 0
            for i in range(dyn[DT_RELRSZ] // 8):
                e = self.u64(dyn[DT_RELR] + i * 8)
                if e & 1 == 0:
                    self.relocs.append((e, R_AARCH64_RELATIVE, 0, self.u64(e)))
                    where = e + 8
                    continue
                for k in range(63):
                    if e >> (k + 1) & 1:
                        a = where + k * 8
                        self.relocs.append((a, R_AARCH64_RELATIVE, 0, self.u64(a)))
                where += 63 * 8

    def symbol_count(self):
        """Number of .dynsym entries: DT_HASH nchain, else one past the last symbol a DT_GNU_HASH chain reaches."""
        dyn = self.dyn
        if DT_HASH in dyn:
            return self.u32(dyn[DT_HASH] + 4)
        if DT_GNU_HASH not in dyn:
            return 0
        h = dyn[DT_GNU_HASH]
        nbuckets, symoffset, bloom_size = self.u32(h), self.u32(h + 4), self.u32(h + 8)
        buckets = h + 16 + bloom_size * 8
        last = max([self.u32(buckets + 4 * i) for i in range(nbuckets)] + [0])
        if last < symoffset:
            return symoffset
        chains = buckets + 4 * nbuckets
        while not self.u32(chains + 4 * (last - symoffset)) & 1:
            last += 1
        return last + 1

    def cstr(self, off):
        end = self.image.index(b'\0', off)
        return self.image[off:end].decode('utf-8', 'replace')

    def imports(self):
        return [s for s in self.syms if s[0] and s[2] == 0]

    def exports(self):
        return [s for s in self.syms if s[0] and s[2] != 0]


if __name__ == '__main__':
    for p in sys.argv[1:]:
        n = Nso(p)
        print(f'== {p}  build {n.build_id[:16]}  image 0x{n.size:x}')
        print(f'  text 0x{n.text[0]:x}+0x{n.text[1]:x}  ro 0x{n.rodata[0]:x}+0x{n.rodata[1]:x}  '
              f'data 0x{n.data[0]:x}+0x{n.data[1]:x}  bss 0x{n.bss_size:x}')
        print(f'  needed {n.needed}  syms {len(n.syms)}  imports {len(n.imports())}  exports {len(n.exports())}')
        print(f'  relocs {dict(Counter(r[1] for r in n.relocs))}')

```

```txt
# games/totk/runtime/game_patches.c (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames contributors) at upstream ebe621d, through
# its 1.2.1 addresses in game_version.h (2db612b); each one was located again in 1.1.1 by instruction-window matching
# and its original words checked against this build's main. The patch page holds two floats the runtime writes at every
# present (frame_rate.c): +0 the 30 Hz ratio (seconds * 30), +4 the frame step in seconds.

set fps60    TOTK_FPS60          1
set realtime TOTK_REALTIME       1
set cloth    TOTK_CLOTH_REALTIME 1
set bounce   TOTK_HIGHFPS_FIX    1
set output   TOTK_PATCH_OUTPUT   0

site bounce main bee7e0 bd402900 bd402900 bd403901 1e210800  # ldr s0, [x8, #0x28]; ldr s1, [x8, #0x38]; fmul s0, s0, s1

# The swapchain size nnMain writes before NvInitializeGraphics comes from page +48 ({w, h} as one 64-bit value), and
```

```txt
# 60 fps: the adaptive present-interval controller (main+0x8f26c8, 1.0.0 0x8f6bec) gets the minimum interval 1.
site fps60 main 8f273c 6b08015f 7100055f   # clamp: cmp w10, #1 (was cmp w10, w8 = minimum)
site fps60 main 8f2740 1a89b10a 1a9fa52a   # clamp: csinc w10, w9, wzr, ge (desired = max(desired, 1))
site fps60 main 8f2764 b9401a8a d503201f   # lower trigger: nop the stored-candidate load
site fps60 main 8f27f4 6b08015f 7100055f   # raise path: cmp w10, #1
site fps60 main 8f2804 1a88c1ac 1a9fc5ac   # raise path: csinc w12, w13, wzr, gt (next lower candidate floors at 1)
site fps60 main 8f2858 b9400288 52800028   # lower path: mov w8, #1 (minimum interval 1)
site fps60 main 8f2874 2a0a03f5 1a9fa555   # lower path: csinc w21, w10, wzr, ge (result never below 1)

# Real-time step: the VFR step (main+0x7ede6c, 1.0.0 0x7a83e4) and the global ratio after the controller call

# Equipment-switch cooldown (issue #18, found by JieML1100 on 1.4.3): the player update (main+0x852d24) steps the

# equipment gate (main+0xcae6f8) blocks weapon, shield and bow changes while it is above 0. A measured ratio can leave
# a remainder in (0, FLT_EPSILON] that is never stepped again; stepping while above 0 takes it below 0.

# Hair and cloth (upstream 290ec9f, 8f8022f): the actor animation update builds a second clock {seconds = factor / 30,

# store of the factor into the ratio slot, measured ratio * factor. The call of the shared update (main+0x89822c)
```

`recomp/patches-v143.txt`:

```txt
# Code patches for TotK 1.4.3 main (recomp/patches.py). Ported from MacNativeGames
# games/totk/runtime/game_patches_v143.c (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames contributors) at upstream 73c4821,
# each original word checked against the 1.4.3 main. MacNativeGames branches to veneers after the text; here a
# veneer's body is the site's replacement. The patch page holds three floats the runtime writes at every present
# (frame_rate.c): +0 the 30 Hz ratio (seconds * 30), +4 the frame step in seconds, +8 the step in 60 Hz ticks.

set fps60    TOTK_FPS60          1
set realtime TOTK_REALTIME       1
set cloth    TOTK_CLOTH_REALTIME 1
set bounce   TOTK_HIGHFPS_FIX    1
set output   TOTK_PATCH_OUTPUT   0
set scene    TOTK_PATCH_SCENE    0

# 60 fps: the adaptive present-interval controller (main+0x2db174, 1.2.1 0x8f26c8) gets the minimum interval 1.
site fps60 main 2db204 6b08015f 7100055f   # clamp: cmp w10, #1 (was cmp w10, w8 = minimum)
site fps60 main 2db208 1a89b10a 1a9fa52a   # clamp: csinc w10, w9, wzr, ge (desired = max(desired, 1))
site fps60 main 2db22c b940468a d503201f   # lower trigger: nop the stored-candidate load
site fps60 main 2db360 6b0801bf 710005bf   # raise path: cmp w13, #1
site fps60 main 2db36c 1a88c1ac 1a9fc5ac   # raise path: csinc w12, w13, wzr, gt (next lower candidate floors at 1)
site fps60 main 2db340 b9400288 52800028   # lower path: mov w8, #1 (minimum interval 1)
site fps60 main 2db34c 2a0a03f5 1a9fa555   # lower path: csinc w21, w10, wzr, ge (result never below 1)

# Real-time step. The frame-step producer feeds both FrameRateMgr call sites with s8 = nominal interval * a 0.5/1.0
# coefficient (sys+0x1da bit 0, fcsel above the site); the nominal interval comes from the patch page, the coefficient
# and FrameRateMgr's own arithmetic stay. x8 is free: the ldxr after the site loads it. The global ratio after the
# controller call (1.2.1 0x8f2394) reads the ratio from the page instead of 60 / interval * 0.5.
site realtime main 3e5658 1e210808 @page:x8 bd400900 1e210808   # fmul s8, s0, s1: s0 = [page+8] first
site realtime main 2daa54 bd425260 @page:x9   # ldr s0, [x19, #0x250] -> adrp x9, page
site realtime main 2daa58 52a84e08 bd400120   # mov w8, #60.0 -> ldr s0, [x9] (global ratio)
site realtime main 2daa6c 5e21d800 d503201f   # scvtf s0, s0 -> nop
site realtime main 2daa70 1e201820 d503201f   # fdiv s0, s1, s0 -> nop
site realtime main 2daa74 1e2c1001 d503201f   # fmov s1, #0.5 -> nop
site realtime main 2daa78 1e210800 d503201f   # fmul s0, s0, s1 -> nop

# Equipment-switch cooldown (issue #18, found by JieML1100): the player update (main+0x2b0368) steps the countdown at
# player state +0x109c through the timer step (main+0x1b0834, value += ratio * rate) only while it is above FLT_EPSILON,
# but the equipment gate (main+0x31cc7c) blocks weapon, shield and bow changes while it is above 0. Whole 30 Hz steps
# reach exactly 0; a measured ratio leaves a rounding remainder, and one in (0, FLT_EPSILON] is never stepped again and
# keeps equipment locked until a load. Stepping while above 0 takes the remainder below 0 like any other last step.
site realtime main 2b036c 0f016681 0f000401   # movi v1.2s, #0x34, lsl #24 (FLT_EPSILON) -> movi v1.2s, #0

# Hair and cloth: the actor animation update builds a second clock {seconds = factor / 30, ratio = factor} per
# rendered frame. 1.4.3 inlines it in two actor paths, where the factor was just stored to the ratio slot: the
# replacement stores measured ratio * factor there and computes measured seconds * factor. Two other callers share the
# out-of-line update (main+0x2a0e40), whose s2 (seconds) and s3 (ratio) are scaled by the measured ratio; its third
# caller already passes measured time and stays. x8 and s4 are free at all four sites.
site cloth main 246eac 1e200940 @page:x8 bd400100 1e200940 bd0367e0 bd400500 1e200940   # fmul s0, s10, s0
site cloth main 345904 1e210801 @page:x8 bd400101 1e210801 bd0117e1 bd400501 1e210801   # fmul s1, s0, s1
site cloth main 24944c 94015e7d @page:x8 bd400104 1e240842 1e240863 94015e7d   # bl 0x2a0e40
site cloth main 28bc98 9400546a @page:x8 bd400104 1e240842 1e240863 9400546a   # bl 0x2a0e40

# Trampolines: the contact code scales the bounce vector by 0.1 when time object +0x28 (30 / (ratio * time scale)) is
# over 100; compare +0x28 * +0x38 (30 / time scale) instead, the same value at 30 Hz and independent of the frame rate.
# s1 is set again by the fmov two instructions on.
site bounce main 562a64 bd402920 bd402920 bd403921 1e210800   # ldr s0, [x9, #0x28]; ldr s1, [x9, #0x38]; fmul s0, s0, s1

# Fades (MacNativeGames game_patches_v143.c patch_fade_increment, upstream 3e9e7f67): the distance/LOD mesh fades and
# the pre-actor fades add trunc(2.1 * ratio) to a counter each frame: 2 at 30 fps, 1 at 60, 0 above about 63.5 fps
# (ratio below 1 / 2.1), where a fade stops and its object stays translucent or invisible until a slower frame moves
# it on. Each site floors the increment at 1 without the flags: clz is 32 only for 0, so increment += clz >> 5. The
# scratch register is one the next instruction writes (w10 at 0x0a7ac4: ldrb w10; w11 at the pre-actor sites: add
# w11), or at 0x95dd24 a temporary the function no longer reads (add, strb, return).
set fade     TOTK_HIGHFPS_FIX    1
site fade main 0a7ac4 1e380008 1e380008 5ac0110a 53057d4a 0b0a0108   # fcvtzs w8, s0; clz w10, w8; lsr w10, w10, #5; add w8, w8, w10
site fade main 95dd24 1e380008 1e380008 5ac0110a 53057d4a 0b0a0108   # the same, second mesh fade
site fade main 6155e4 1e38000a 1e38000a 5ac0114b 53057d6b 0b0b014a   # fcvtzs w10, s0; clz w11, w10; lsr w11, w11, #5; add w10, w10, w11
site fade main 615660 1e38000a 1e38000a 5ac0114b 53057d6b 0b0b014a   # the same, second pre-actor fade path

# Output size (upstream game_patches_v143.c patch_output_res; runtime/resolution.c switches the set on). The swapchain
# size nnMain writes comes from page +48; the display configuration's canvas (+0x10) and active output (+0x508) from
# page +32, and the configuration goes to page +40. x9 is dead at the publication point.
site output main bdb578 d280f008 @page:x8   # mov x8, #0x780 -> adrp x8, page (x9 is built in between)
site output main bdb584 f2c08708 f9401908   # movk x8, #0x438, lsl #32 -> ldr x8, [x8, #48]
site output main 3dcb28 d360fc64 @page:x9 f9001533 f9401123 f9000a63 d360fc64   # lsr x4, x3, #32: x3 = [page+32] first

# Scene render size (upstream patch_render_res): every path that picks the size meets at main+0x585e48; the renderer's
# +0xcc4 / +0xcc8 take two floats from page +16. x3 is scratch in this function; w9 still holds the output size.
site scene main 585e48 1e220160 @page:x3    # scvtf s0, w11 -> adrp x3, page
site scene main 585e50 bd0cc660 2d420460    # str s0, [x19, #0xcc4] -> ldp s0, s1, [x3, #16]
site scene main 585e54 1e220140 bd0cc660    # scvtf s0, w10 -> str s0, [x19, #0xcc4]
site scene main 585e60 bd0cca60 bd0cca61    # str s0, [x19, #0xcc8] -> str s1, [x19, #0xcc8]

# Camera aspect ratio for a game resolution that is not 16:9 (upstream game_patches_v143.c and aspect_patch.h
# aspect_install / aspect_stub; runtime/resolution.c res_init writes the output's width / height to page +56 and
# switches the set on). Each site leaves the ratio sead's perspective projection (+0xb0) takes in s0: two camera sites
# (update and setup) load the camera's copy of DefaultAspect 1.777778, two viewport routines divide width by height.
# The replacement loads the ratio from the page instead, so a 21:9 output shows more of the world at the sides with
# the vertical view kept (Hor+). x10 is kept on the stack, so no register liveness is assumed.
set aspect   TOTK_ASPECT_PATCH   0
site aspect main 628c74 bd414260 f81f0fea @page:x10 bd403940 f84107ea   # ldr s0, [x19, #0x140] (camera update)
site aspect main b43460 bd406ac0 f81f0fea @page:x10 bd403940 f84107ea   # ldr s0, [x22, #0x68] (camera setup)
site aspect main 1ff04f4 1e211800 f81f0fea @page:x10 bd403940 f84107ea  # fdiv s0, s0, s1 (viewport)
site aspect main 253fbb0 1e211800 f81f0fea @page:x10 bd403940 f84107ea  # fdiv s0, s0, s1 (viewport)

# Field of view (runtime/resolution.c res_fov_live writes TOTK_FOV / 100 to page +60 and switches the set). The same two
# camera routines as the aspect set load the camera's vertical view angle (radians) a few words before the ratio and
# hand it to sead's perspective projection (+0xa0, then sin / cos / tan of half of it at +0xa4..+0xac). The replacement
# loads the angle as before and multiplies it by the factor on the page; s8 holds the factor because the next
# instruction (fmul s8, s0, s1) overwrites it. Zooms the game makes itself (the bow, the scope) scale with it.
set fov      TOTK_FOV_PATCH      0
site fov    main 628c3c bd413e60 f81f0fea @page:x10 bd413e60 bd403d48 1e280800 f84107ea   # ldr s0, [x19, #0x13c] (camera update)
site fov    main b4342c bd4066c0 f81f0fea @page:x10 bd4066c0 bd403d48 1e280800 f84107ea   # ldr s0, [x22, #0x64] (camera setup)

# The game's zstd decoder (BSD zstd, statically linked into main) through the host's libzstd (runtime/ov_zstd.c):
# every call of ZSTD_decompressMultiFrame (main+0x3a1f0: dctx, dst, capacity, src, size, dict, dict size, ddict) and of
# its wrapper ZSTD_decompress_usingDDict (main+0x3a1e0, which tail-branches to it) goes to a host function on the patch
# page (+0xff0 and +0xfe0). The lifted decoder runs its copy loops as chains of small functions; the host decodes the
# same frames several times faster and gives the virtual core up for large inputs. Not main+0x547a04: that caller
# (main+0x547964) resets a static DCtx of its own with which the game's zstd rejects some valid frames
# (corruption_detected on a 473 KB frame the host decodes), and the game relies on that result.
set zstd     TOTK_ZSTD_NATIVE    1
site zstd   main 5f5358 97e913a6 94d3ab26   # bl ZSTD_decompressMultiFrame -> page+0xff0
site zstd   main 6d7788 97e58a9a 94d0221a   # bl ZSTD_decompressMultiFrame -> page+0xff0
```

`recomp/patches.py`:

```py
"""Code patch table for the generator: guest instructions replaced in the lifted C, switchable at run time.

Lifted code cannot be byte-patched when the game runs, so a patch is applied when the C is generated. A patch file
(gen.py --patches) has two kinds of lines; `#` starts a comment, fields are separated by whitespace:

  set  <name> <env> <default>               a patch set: a run-time switch <env>=0/1, <default> when it is unset
  site <set> <module> <address> <original> <replacement> [<replacement> ...]

  spin <module> <head> <back-edge> [<back-edge> ...]

<address> is a module offset (hex), <original> the instruction word the module has there (checked; a mismatch stops
the generator), each <replacement> an instruction word (hex) or `@page:x<n>`, which is `adrp x<n>, <patch page>`
```
