`runtime/audren.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/audio_renderer.c @ b75be8c (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026
// MacNativeGames contributors). Its voice lifetime (play state, wave buffer release, flush) is ported from
// Ryujinx.Audio VoiceInfo / DataSourceHelper (MIT, Copyright (c) Ryujinx Team and Contributors).
// audren:u. The SDK's nn::audio client builds RequestUpdate input unchanged; this
// service validates every section against the header, keeps server-side voice state, advances it in real time (one
// frame of sample_count / sample_rate seconds per render tick, signalling the renderer's event) and writes the output
// status the client expects. The mixer behind it is audio_mixer.c.
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "audren.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "ipc.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

static volatile int32_t g_live;

long audren_renderers_live(void) { return plat_cas32(&g_live, 0, 0); }

static int revision_number(uint32_t rev) { return (int)(rev >> 24) - '0'; }

static void need(int ok, const char *what) {
    if (ok) return;
    ipc_backtrace();
    rt_fatal("audren: %s", what);
}

static AudioRenderer *renderer_new(const AudrenParameter *p) {
    need(p->sample_rate == 48000 || p->sample_rate == 32000, "unsupported output rate");
    need(p->sample_count > 0 && p->sample_count <= 4800, "sample count");
    need(p->voice_count > 0 && p->voice_count <= 1024 && p->sink_count > 0 && p->sink_count <= 256 &&
             p->effect_count >= 0 && p->effect_count <= 4096 && p->submix_count >= 0 && p->submix_count < 256,
         "renderer counts");
    AudioRenderer *r = calloc(1, sizeof *r);
    need(r != NULL, "renderer allocation");
    r->param = *p;
    r->revision = p->revision;
    r->voices = calloc((size_t)p->voice_count, sizeof *r->voices);
    r->pools = calloc((size_t)p->effect_count + 4u * (size_t)p->voice_count, sizeof *r->pools);
    r->mixes = calloc((size_t)p->submix_count + 1, sizeof *r->mixes);
    r->sinks = calloc((size_t)p->sink_count, sizeof *r->sinks);
    r->effects = calloc((size_t)(p->effect_count ? p->effect_count : 1), sizeof *r->effects);
    r->channels = calloc((size_t)p->voice_count * 6, sizeof *r->channels);
    need(r->voices && r->pools && r->mixes && r->sinks && r->effects && r->channels, "renderer tables");
    plat_mutex_init(&r->lock);
    r->event = kern_event_new();
    r->state = 1;   // stopped
    return r;
}

static void renderer_free(AudioRenderer *r) {
    free(r->voices);
    free(r->pools);
    free(r->mixes);
    free(r->sinks);
    free(r->effects);
    free(r->channels);
    free(r);
}

// ---- RequestUpdate
typedef struct { const uint8_t *p, *end; } Reader;

static const uint8_t *take(Reader *in, uint32_t n, const char *what) {
    if ((size_t)(in->end - in->p) < n) {
        rt_log("audren: input section %s (%u bytes) overruns the request", what, n);
        need(0, "update input section size");
    }
    const uint8_t *p = in->p;
    in->p += n;
    return p;
}

static void voice_reset(ServerVoice *v) {
    memset(v->valid, 0, sizeof v->valid);
    memset(v->pending, 0, sizeof v->pending);
    v->state = SV_STOPPED;
    v->flush = v->flush_from = 0;
    v->index = 0;
    v->offset = 0;
    v->fraction = 0;
    v->played = 0;
    v->consumed = 0;
    v->loops_done = 0;
    memset(&v->adpcm, 0, sizeof v->adpcm);
    memset(v->biquad_state, 0, sizeof v->biquad_state);
}

static void update_voice(AudioRenderer *r, const AudrenVoiceIn *in) {
    need(in->id < (uint32_t)r->param.voice_count, "voice id out of range");
    ServerVoice *v = &r->voices[in->id];
    if (in->is_new || !in->in_use) voice_reset(v);
    v->in = *in;
    v->use_float_biquads = 0;
    if (!in->in_use) return;
    need(in->wave_buffer_index < 4, "wave buffer index");
    // The play state as the DSP keeps it (Ryujinx VoiceInfo.UpdatePlayState): Stop on a voice that is not stopped
    // becomes Stopping, which the next render frame turns into Stopped after giving back every queued buffer.
    if (in->play_state == PLAY_STARTED) v->state = SV_STARTED;
    else if (in->play_state == PLAY_PAUSED) v->state = SV_PAUSED;
    else if (v->state != SV_STOPPED) v->state = SV_STOPPING;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) {   // a new buffer waits until a render frame finds the voice playing
        const AudrenWaveBuffer *w = &in->wave_buffers[i];
        if (!w->sent) {
            v->buffers[i] = *w;
            v->pending[i] = 1;
        }
    }
    v->flush += in->flush_wave_buffer_count;
    v->flush_from = in->wave_buffer_index;
    if (in->clear_voice_drop) v->drops = 0;
}

// No samples (no memory, no size or an empty range): the DSP counts the buffer as played when it reaches it, so a
// stream's empty last buffer does not hold up the buffers queued behind it.
int audio_buffer_empty(const AudrenWaveBuffer *b) { return !b->address || !b->size || b->end <= b->start; }

static void skip_empty(AudioRenderer *r, ServerVoice *v) {
    while (v->valid[v->index] && audio_buffer_empty(&v->buffers[v->index])) {
        const AudrenWaveBuffer *b = &v->buffers[v->index];
        if (b->loop && b->loop_count < 0) break;   // an endless empty loop starves the voice, as on the DSP
        v->valid[v->index] = 0;
        v->consumed++;
        v->offset = 0;
        v->loops_done = 0;
        v->index = (v->index + 1) & 3;
        r->empty_played++;
        if (b->end_of_stream) {
            v->played = 0;
            break;
        }
    }
}

// Each render frame, before mixing (Ryujinx VoiceInfo.UpdateParametersForCommandGeneration): flush, stop, start.
static void voices_prepare(AudioRenderer *r) {
    for (int k = 0; k < r->param.voice_count; k++) {
        ServerVoice *v = &r->voices[k];
        if (!v->in.in_use) continue;
        if (v->flush) {   // FlushWaveBuffers: from the client's current buffer, the queued ones count as played
            unsigned i = v->flush_from & 3;
            for (uint32_t n = v->flush; n; n--, i = (i + 1) & 3) {
                v->pending[i] = 0;
                if (v->valid[i]) {
                    v->valid[i] = 0;
                    v->consumed++;
                    v->index = (v->index + 1) & 3;
                    v->offset = 0;
                    v->loops_done = 0;
                    r->flushed++;
                }
            }
            v->flush = 0;
        }
        if (v->state == SV_STOPPING) {   // every queued buffer counts as played; unsent ones are dropped
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                if (v->valid[i]) {
                    v->consumed++;
                    v->index = (v->index + 1) & 3;
                    r->stop_released++;
                }
                v->valid[i] = 0;
                v->pending[i] = 0;
            }
            v->offset = 0;
            v->played = 0;
            v->fraction = 0;
            v->loops_done = 0;
            v->state = SV_STOPPED;
            continue;
        }
        if (v->state == SV_STARTED) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
                if (v->pending[i]) {
                    v->pending[i] = 0;
                    v->valid[i] = 1;
                    if ((unsigned)i == v->index) {
                        v->offset = 0;
                        v->loops_done = 0;
                    }
                }
            skip_empty(r, v);
        }
    }
}

static uint32_t effect_out_bytes(const AudioRenderer *r) { return revision_number(r->revision) >= 9 ? 0x90u : 0x10u; }

static void request_update(AudioRenderer *r, const uint8_t *input, uint64_t in_size, uint8_t *output,
                           uint64_t out_size, uint64_t perf_size) {
    need(in_size >= sizeof(AudrenHeader), "update input too small");
    AudrenHeader h;
    memcpy(&h, input, sizeof h);
    need(h.total <= in_size, "update total size");
    Reader in = {input + sizeof h, input + h.total};
    plat_mutex_lock(&r->lock);
    r->revision = h.revision;
    const int vc = r->param.voice_count, ec = r->param.effect_count, sc = r->param.sink_count,
              mc = r->param.submix_count + 1;
    const uint32_t npools = (uint32_t)ec + 4u * (uint32_t)vc;
    if (!r->logged) {
        r->logged = 1;
        rt_log("audren: update REV%d sizes behavior=%u pools=%u voices=%u channels=%u effects=%u mixes=%u sinks=%u "
               "perf=%u splitters=%u render=%u total=%u out=%llu perf_out=%llu",
               revision_number(h.revision), h.behavior, h.memory_pools, h.voices, h.voice_resources, h.effects,
               h.mixes, h.sinks, h.performance, h.splitters, h.render_info, h.total, (unsigned long long)out_size,
               (unsigned long long)perf_size);
    }
    need(h.behavior == 0x10, "behavior section size");
    const uint8_t *behavior = take(&in, h.behavior, "behavior");
    memcpy(&r->behavior_flags, behavior + 8, 8);
    need(h.memory_pools == npools * sizeof(AudrenPoolIn), "memory pool section size");
    const AudrenPoolIn *pools = (const AudrenPoolIn *)take(&in, h.memory_pools, "memory pools");
    need(h.voice_resources % sizeof(AudrenChannelIn) == 0 &&
             h.voice_resources / sizeof(AudrenChannelIn) <= (uint32_t)vc * 6,
         "voice channel section size");
    const AudrenChannelIn *chans = (const AudrenChannelIn *)take(&in, h.voice_resources, "voice channels");
    const int float_voices = revision_number(h.revision) >= 15;
    const size_t voice_stride = float_voices ? sizeof(AudrenVoiceInV2) : sizeof(AudrenVoiceIn);
    need(h.voices == (uint32_t)vc * voice_stride, "voice section size");
    const uint8_t *voices = take(&in, h.voices, "voices");
    need(h.effects == (uint32_t)ec * sizeof(AudrenEffectIn), "effect section size");
    const AudrenEffectIn *effects = (const AudrenEffectIn *)take(&in, h.effects, "effects");
    const uint8_t *splitters = take(&in, h.splitters, "splitters");
    const uint8_t *mixes = take(&in, h.mixes, "mixes");
    need(h.sinks == (uint32_t)sc * sizeof(AudrenSinkIn), "sink section size");
    const AudrenSinkIn *sinks = (const AudrenSinkIn *)take(&in, h.sinks, "sinks");
    take(&in, h.performance, "performance");
    take(&in, h.render_info, "render info");
    need(in.p == in.end, "unconsumed update input");

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < h.voice_resources / sizeof(AudrenChannelIn); i++) {
        need(chans[i].id < (uint32_t)vc * 6, "channel resource id");
        r->channels[chans[i].id] = chans[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < vc; i++) {
        AudrenVoiceIn v;
        AudrenVoiceInV2 v2;
        if (float_voices) {
            memcpy(&v2, voices + i * voice_stride, sizeof v2);
            memset(&v, 0, sizeof v);
            memcpy(&v, v2.prefix, sizeof v2.prefix);
            memcpy((uint8_t *)&v + 0x3c, v2.tail, sizeof v2.tail);
            for (unsigned f = 0; f < 2; f++) {
                v.biquads[f].enable = v2.biquads[f].enable;
                if (!v.biquads[f].enable) continue;
                for (unsigned c = 0; c < 3; c++) need(isfinite(v2.biquads[f].numerator[c]), "voice biquad numerator");
                for (unsigned c = 0; c < 2; c++)
                    need(isfinite(v2.biquads[f].denominator[c]), "voice biquad denominator");
            }
        } else
            memcpy(&v, voices + i * voice_stride, sizeof v);
        // A record that is not in use can be all zero, id included (the NVN 2 reference title leaves the records of voices it never used
        // untouched). Its id then names voice 0 and the reset below would wipe that voice on every update, silencing
        // the left half of a stereo pair (#63). Eglantine audio_core/renderer/behavior/info_updater.cpp,
        // InfoUpdater::UpdateVoices, skips such a record; here it applies to the slot it occupies.
        if (!v.in_use) v.id = (uint32_t)i;
        update_voice(r, &v);
        ServerVoice *server = &r->voices[v.id];
        server->use_float_biquads = (uint8_t)float_voices;
        if (float_voices) memcpy(server->float_biquads, v2.biquads, sizeof v2.biquads);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < ec; i++) r->effects[i] = effects[i];
    audio_mixer_update_effects(r);
    audio_mixer_update_routing(r, splitters, h.splitters, mixes, h.mixes, mc);
    for (int i = 0; i < sc; i++) r->sinks[i] = sinks[i];

    // ---- output
    const uint32_t eo = effect_out_bytes(r);
    AudrenHeader o = {0};
    o.revision = AUDREN_REV(revision_number(h.revision) >= 1 ? revision_number(h.revision) : 1);
    o.memory_pools = npools * sizeof(AudrenPoolOut);
    o.voices = (uint32_t)vc * sizeof(AudrenVoiceOut);
    o.effects = (uint32_t)ec * eo;
    o.sinks = (uint32_t)sc * sizeof(AudrenSinkOut);
    o.performance = 0x10;
    o.behavior = AUDREN_BEHAVIOR_OUT;
    o.render_info = AUDREN_RENDER_INFO_OUT;
    o.total = (uint32_t)sizeof o + o.memory_pools + o.voices + o.effects + o.sinks + o.performance + o.behavior +
              o.render_info;
    if (o.total > out_size) {
        rt_log("audren: output needs %u bytes, the client gave %llu (effect out %u)", o.total,
               (unsigned long long)out_size, eo);
        need(0, "update output size");
    }
    memset(output, 0, out_size);
    uint8_t *w = output;
    memcpy(w, &o, sizeof o);
    w += sizeof o;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < npools; i++) {
        uint32_t s = pools[i].state;
        if (s == POOL_REQUEST_ATTACH) s = POOL_ATTACHED;
        else if (s == POOL_REQUEST_DETACH) s = POOL_DETACHED;
        r->pools[i] = pools[i];
        r->pools[i].state = s;
        AudrenPoolOut po = {s, {0}};
        memcpy(w, &po, sizeof po);
        w += sizeof po;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < vc; i++) {
        AudrenVoiceOut vo = {r->voices[i].played, r->voices[i].consumed, r->voices[i].drops};
        memcpy(w, &vo, sizeof vo);
        w += sizeof vo;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < ec; i++) {   // EffectStatus Enabled 3 / Disabled 4
        w[0] = effects[i].enabled ? 3 : 4;
        if (eo > 16) audio_mixer_effect_result(r, i, w + 16, eo - 16);
        w += eo;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < sc; i++) {
        AudrenSinkOut so = {0};
        if (r->sinks[i].type == SINK_CIRCULAR) so.last_written_offset = audio_mixer_sink_written(r, i);
        memcpy(w, &so, sizeof so);
        w += sizeof so;
    }
    w += 0x10;                    // performance: nothing written
    w += AUDREN_BEHAVIOR_OUT;     // behavior: no errors
    memcpy(w, &r->elapsed_frames, 8);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&r->lock);
}

// ---- render tick: one frame each time the output device has taken the ring below its target (audio_mixer_pace_ns),
// or every sample_count / sample_rate seconds of the host clock without a device, while stopped or while it stalls
static void advance_voice(AudioRenderer *r, ServerVoice *v, double out_seconds) {
    if (!v->in.in_use || v->state != SV_STARTED || !v->in.sample_rate) return;
    double want = v->fraction + out_seconds * v->in.sample_rate * (v->in.pitch > 0 ? v->in.pitch : 1.0);
    uint64_t samples = (uint64_t)want;
    v->fraction = want - (double)samples;
    while (samples && v->valid[v->index]) {
        AudrenWaveBuffer *b = &v->buffers[v->index];
        uint64_t length = (uint64_t)(b->end - b->start), left = length - v->offset;
        uint64_t step = samples < left ? samples : left;
        v->offset += step;
        v->played += step;
        samples -= step;
        if (v->offset < length) break;
        if (b->loop && (b->loop_count < 0 || v->loops_done < b->loop_count)) {
            v->loops_done++;
            v->offset = b->loop_start > b->start && b->loop_start < b->end ? (uint64_t)(b->loop_start - b->start) : 0;
            continue;
        }
        v->valid[v->index] = 0;
        v->consumed++;
        v->offset = 0;
        v->loops_done = 0;
        v->index = (v->index + 1) & 3;
        if (b->end_of_stream) {
            v->played = 0;
            break;
        }
        skip_empty(r, v);
    }
}

static void render_thread(void *p) {
    AudioRenderer *r = p;
    plat_thread_priority(PLAT_PRIO_HIGHEST);
    const uint64_t frame_ns = (uint64_t)r->param.sample_count * 1000000000ull / (uint64_t)r->param.sample_rate;
    const double frame = (double)r->param.sample_count / r->param.sample_rate;
    uint64_t next = kern_now_ns();
    while (plat_cas32(&r->running, 0, 0)) {
        uint64_t now = kern_now_ns();
        int64_t pace = audio_mixer_pace_ns(r, now);
        if (pace > 0) {
            plat_wait_ns((uint64_t)pace);
            continue;
        }
        if (pace == 0) {
            next = now + frame_ns;   // where the timer goes on if the device stops pacing
        } else {
            if (next > now) plat_wait_ns(next - now);
            else if (now - next > 100000000ull) next = now;   // fell far behind (debugger, sleep): resynchronise
            next += frame_ns;
        }
        plat_mutex_lock(&r->lock);
        if (r->state == 0) {
            voices_prepare(r);
            audio_mixer_render(r, frame);
            for (int i = 0; i < r->param.voice_count; i++) advance_voice(r, &r->voices[i], frame);
            r->elapsed_frames++;
            uint64_t given = r->stop_released + r->empty_played + r->flushed;
            if ((rt_trace & RT_TRACE_IPC) && given != r->logged_released && r->elapsed_frames % 1000 == 0) {
                r->logged_released = given;
                rt_log("audren: wave buffers given back: %llu by stopped voices, %llu without samples, %llu flushed",
                       (unsigned long long)r->stop_released, (unsigned long long)r->empty_played,
                       (unsigned long long)r->flushed);
            }
        }
        plat_mutex_unlock(&r->lock);
        kern_event_signal(r->event);
    }
}

// ---- IAudioRenderer
static IpcBuffer pick(const IpcBuffer *a, unsigned na, const IpcBuffer *b, unsigned nb, unsigned i) {
    IpcBuffer x = i < na ? a[i] : (IpcBuffer){0}, y = i < nb ? b[i] : (IpcBuffer){0};
    return x.size ? x : y;
}

static float voice_drop = 1.0f;   // IAudioRenderer 12/13

static void renderer_handler(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs) {
    AudioRenderer *r = s->state;
    switch (rq->cmd) {
    case 0: { int32_t v = r->param.sample_rate; IPC_OUT(rs, v); return; }       // GetSampleRate
    case 1: { int32_t v = r->param.sample_count; IPC_OUT(rs, v); return; }      // GetSampleCount
    case 2: { int32_t v = r->param.mix_buffer_count; IPC_OUT(rs, v); return; }  // GetMixBufferCount
    case 3: { uint32_t v = r->state; IPC_OUT(rs, v); return; }                  // GetState
    case 4: case 10: {   // RequestUpdate(Auto): out(output), out(performance), in(input)
        IpcBuffer in = pick(rq->a, rq->na, rq->x, rq->nx, 0);
        IpcBuffer out = pick(rq->b, rq->nb, rq->c, rq->nc, 0), perf = pick(rq->b, rq->nb, rq->c, rq->nc, 1);
        if (!r->logged)
            rt_log("audren: RequestUpdate cmd %u in=%#llx+%#llx out=%#llx+%#llx perf=%#llx+%#llx (a%u b%u x%u c%u)",
                   rq->cmd, (unsigned long long)in.addr, (unsigned long long)in.size, (unsigned long long)out.addr,
                   (unsigned long long)out.size, (unsigned long long)perf.addr, (unsigned long long)perf.size, rq->na,
                   rq->nb, rq->nx, rq->nc);
        need(in.size && out.size, "RequestUpdate buffers");
        request_update(r, ipc_guest(in.addr, in.size), in.size, ipc_guest(out.addr, out.size), out.size, perf.size);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < rq->nc && rq->cmd == 10; i++)
            if (rq->c[i].size && (i >= rq->nb || !rq->b[i].size))
                rs->xout[rs->nxout++] = (IpcBuffer){rq->c[i].addr, rq->c[i].size, i};
        return;
    }
    case 5:   // Start
        plat_mutex_lock(&r->lock);
        r->state = 0;
        audio_mixer_set_running(r, 1);
        plat_mutex_unlock(&r->lock);
        return;
    case 6:   // Stop
        plat_mutex_lock(&r->lock);
        r->state = 1;
        audio_mixer_set_running(r, 0);
        plat_mutex_unlock(&r->lock);
        return;
    case 7: rs->copy[rs->ncopy++] = kern_event_readable(r->event); return;   // QuerySystemEvent
    case 8: r->time_limit = IPC_ARG(rq, uint32_t, 0); return;                // SetRenderingTimeLimit
    case 9: { uint32_t v = r->time_limit ? r->time_limit : 100; IPC_OUT(rs, v); return; }   // GetRenderingTimeLimit
    // [15.0.0+] Set/GetVoiceDropParameter (a float, as nn::audio::SetAudioRendererVoiceDropParameter takes): the host
    // mixer drops no voices, so the value is only kept for the getter. One renderer is open at a time.
    case 12: voice_drop = IPC_ARG(rq, float, 0); return;
    case 13: { float v = voice_drop; IPC_OUT(rs, v); return; }
    case 14: return;   // [23.0.0+] SetAsyncMemoryPoolControlEnabled(bool): memory pools are always synchronous here
    default: ipc_unimplemented(s, rq);
    }
}

static void renderer_close(void *p) {
    AudioRenderer *r = p;
    plat_xchg32(&r->running, 0);
    int away = kern_core_away();
    plat_thread_join(r->thread);
    kern_core_back(&away);
    plat_dec32(&g_live);
    audio_mixer_close(r);
    kern_handle_close(r->event);
    rt_log("audren: renderer closed after %llu frames", (unsigned long long)r->elapsed_frames);
    renderer_free(r);
}

// ---- aud:u, nn::audio::IUserClientSession (Switch 2): the SDK reaches the audio managers through it
// (nn::audio::CreateUserClientSessionByHipc) instead of opening audren:u itself. Switchbrew, "Audio services": command
// 2 returns an IAudioRendererManager. 0 (IAudioInManager), 1 (IAudioOutManager), 3 and 4 are not served yet.
void aud_user_handler(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs) {
    switch (rq->cmd) {
    case 2:
        rs->move[rs->nmove++] = ipc_session_new("audren:u", audren_manager_handler, NULL, NULL);
        return;
    default: ipc_unimplemented(s, rq);
    }
}

// ---- IAudioRendererManager
void audren_manager_handler(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs) {
    switch (rq->cmd) {
    case 0: {   // OpenAudioRenderer(param, pad, work size, aruid; copy tmem, process; pid)
        AudrenParameter p = IPC_ARG(rq, AudrenParameter, 0);
        uint64_t work = IPC_ARG(rq, uint64_t, 0x38);
        need(rq->ncopy >= 1, "OpenAudioRenderer without a transfer memory handle");
        IpcTransferMemory *tm = kern_handle_get(rq->copy[0], KERN_TMEM);
        need(tm && tm->size >= work, "OpenAudioRenderer work buffer is not a transfer memory of the stated size");
        AudioRenderer *r = renderer_new(&p);
        r->running = 1;
        audio_mixer_open(r);
        r->thread = plat_thread_new(render_thread, r, "audren");
        if (!r->thread) rt_fatal("audren: cannot start the render thread");
        plat_inc32(&g_live);
        rt_log("audren: renderer open %d Hz x%d, mix buffers %d, voices %d, effects %d, submixes %d, sinks %d, "
               "splitters %d/%d, REV%d, work buffer %#llx+%#llx",
               p.sample_rate, p.sample_count, p.mix_buffer_count, p.voice_count, p.effect_count, p.submix_count,
               p.sink_count, p.splitter_count, p.splitter_destination_count, revision_number(p.revision),
               (unsigned long long)tm->addr, (unsigned long long)work);
        rs->move[rs->nmove++] = ipc_session_new("IAudioRenderer", renderer_handler, r, renderer_close);
        return;
    }
    case 1: {   // GetWorkBufferSize(param) -> u64
        AudrenParameter p = IPC_ARG(rq, AudrenParameter, 0);
        need(p.sample_rate == 48000 || p.sample_rate == 32000, "GetWorkBufferSize: unsupported output rate");
        uint64_t v = AUDREN_WORK_BUFFER_BYTES;
        IPC_OUT(rs, v);
        return;
    }
    case 2: case 4:   // GetAudioDeviceService(aruid), GetAudioDeviceServiceWithRevisionInfo(revision, aruid)
        rs->move[rs->nmove++] = ipc_session_new("IAudioDevice", audio_device_handler, NULL, NULL);
        return;
    default: ipc_unimplemented(s, rq);
    }
}
```

`runtime/audren.h`:

```h
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/audio_renderer.h and audio_mixer.h @ b75be8c (MIT, Copyright (c)
// 2026 MacNativeGames contributors). Wire layouts follow the public libnx audren.h description.
// audren:u, the audio renderer service: RequestUpdate wire formats, the server-side
// renderer state, and the mixer interface (audio_mixer.c: the real mixer with SDL3 output).
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

#include "ipc.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

typedef struct {
    int32_t sample_rate, sample_count, mix_buffer_count, submix_count, voice_count, sink_count, effect_count,
        performance_frame_count;
    uint8_t voice_drop_enabled, unknown, rendering_device, execution_mode;
    int32_t splitter_count, splitter_destination_count;
    uint32_t external_context_size, revision;
} AudrenParameter;
_Static_assert(sizeof(AudrenParameter) == 0x34, "AudioRendererParameterInternal");

typedef struct {
    uint32_t revision, behavior, memory_pools, voices, voice_resources, effects, mixes, sinks, performance,
        splitters, render_info, reserved[4], total;
} AudrenHeader;
_Static_assert(sizeof(AudrenHeader) == 0x40, "UpdateDataHeader");

typedef struct { uint64_t address, size; uint32_t state, pad[3]; } AudrenPoolIn;
typedef struct { uint32_t state, pad[3]; } AudrenPoolOut;
enum { POOL_INVALID, POOL_NEW, POOL_REQUEST_DETACH, POOL_DETACHED, POOL_REQUEST_ATTACH, POOL_ATTACHED, POOL_RELEASED };

typedef struct { uint32_t id; float mix[24]; uint8_t in_use, pad[11]; } AudrenChannelIn;
_Static_assert(sizeof(AudrenChannelIn) == 0x70, "voice channel resource");

typedef struct { uint8_t enable, pad; int16_t numerator[3], denominator[2]; } AudrenBiquad;
typedef struct { uint8_t enable, pad[3]; float numerator[3], denominator[2]; } AudrenBiquadFloat;
_Static_assert(sizeof(AudrenBiquadFloat) == 0x18, "REV15 float biquad");

typedef struct {
    uint64_t address, size;
    int32_t start, end;
    uint8_t loop, end_of_stream, sent, pad;
    int32_t loop_count;
    uint64_t context_address, context_size;
    int32_t loop_start, loop_end;
} AudrenWaveBuffer;
_Static_assert(sizeof(AudrenWaveBuffer) == 0x38, "wave buffer");

typedef struct {
    uint32_t id, node_id;
    uint8_t is_new, in_use, play_state, sample_format;
    uint32_t sample_rate;
    int32_t priority, sort_order;
    uint32_t channel_count;
    float pitch, volume;
    AudrenBiquad biquads[2];
    uint32_t wave_buffer_count;
    uint16_t wave_buffer_index, pad0;
    uint32_t pad1;
    uint64_t extra_address, extra_size;
    int32_t mix_id;
    uint32_t splitter_id;
    AudrenWaveBuffer wave_buffers[4];
    int32_t channel_ids[6];
    uint8_t clear_voice_drop, flush_wave_buffer_count, pad2[2], flags, pad3, src_quality, pad4[17];
} AudrenVoiceIn;
_Static_assert(sizeof(AudrenVoiceIn) == 0x170, "voice in parameter");
// REV15 widens only the two filter records (Q14 -> float); the fields after them move by 24 bytes.
typedef struct { uint8_t prefix[0x24]; AudrenBiquadFloat biquads[2]; uint8_t tail[0x134]; } AudrenVoiceInV2;
_Static_assert(sizeof(AudrenVoiceInV2) == 0x188, "REV15 voice in parameter");
typedef struct { uint64_t played_samples; uint32_t wave_buffers_consumed, voice_drops; } AudrenVoiceOut;
enum { PLAY_STARTED, PLAY_STOPPED, PLAY_PAUSED };
enum { FMT_INVALID, FMT_PCM8, FMT_PCM16, FMT_PCM24, FMT_PCM32, FMT_PCMF32, FMT_ADPCM };

typedef struct {
    float volume;
    uint32_t sample_rate;
    int32_t buffer_count;
    uint8_t in_use, dirty, pad0[2];
    int32_t mix_id;
    uint32_t effect_count, node_id, pad1[2];
    float mix[24][24];
    int32_t dest_mix_id;
    uint32_t dest_splitter_id, pad2;
} AudrenMixIn;
_Static_assert(sizeof(AudrenMixIn) == 0x930, "mix in parameter");

typedef struct {
    uint8_t type, in_use, pad0[2];
    uint32_t node_id;
    uint64_t pad1[3];
    char name[0x100];
    uint32_t input_count;
    int8_t inputs[6];
    uint8_t pad2, downmix_enabled;
    float downmix[4];
} AudrenSinkIn;
_Static_assert(sizeof(AudrenSinkIn) == 0x140, "sink in parameter");
typedef struct { uint32_t last_written_offset, pad0; uint64_t pad1[3]; } AudrenSinkOut;
enum { SINK_INVALID, SINK_DEVICE, SINK_CIRCULAR };

typedef struct {
    uint8_t type, is_new, enabled, pad0;
    int32_t mix_id;
    uint64_t buffer_address, buffer_size;
    int32_t order;
    uint32_t pad1;
    uint8_t specific[0xa0];
} AudrenEffectIn;
_Static_assert(sizeof(AudrenEffectIn) == 0xc0, "effect in parameter");

typedef struct {
    uint8_t input[6], output[6]; uint16_t channel_max, channels;
    int32_t sample_rate, lookahead_max, attack_time, release_time, lookahead;
    float attack, release, threshold, input_gain, output_gain;
    int32_t delay_min, delay_max; uint8_t status, statistics_enabled, statistics_reset, reserved;
} AudrenLimiterParam;
_Static_assert(sizeof(AudrenLimiterParam) == 68, "limiter effect wire layout");

typedef struct {
    uint8_t input[24], output[24]; uint32_t channels, sample_rate, capacity, channel_max;
    uint64_t send_info, send_storage, return_info, return_storage;
    uint32_t sample_size, total_samples, frame_samples;
} AudrenAuxParam;
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(AudrenAuxParam, send_info) == 64, "auxiliary effect wire layout");

#define AUDREN_REV(n) (0x30564552u + ((uint32_t)(n) << 24))   // "REVn"
#define AUDREN_WORK_BUFFER_BYTES 0x10000u                     // the host keeps its state in host memory
#define AUDREN_BEHAVIOR_OUT 0xb0u
#define AUDREN_RENDER_INFO_OUT 0x10u

// Server-side voice: the DSP's view of one client voice (Ryujinx.Audio VoiceInfo, as ported in MacNativeGames).
typedef struct {
    AudrenVoiceIn in;
    AudrenBiquadFloat float_biquads[2];
    uint8_t use_float_biquads;
    AudrenWaveBuffer buffers[4];
    uint8_t valid[4];
    uint8_t pending[4];            // sent while the voice was not playing: valid once it plays
    uint8_t state;                 // SV_*: the client's Start / Stop / Pause, plus Stopping until the next frame
    uint32_t flush, flush_from;    // FlushWaveBuffers since the last frame, from the client's current buffer
    unsigned index;
    uint64_t offset;
    double fraction;
    int32_t loops_done;
    uint64_t played;
    uint32_t consumed, drops;
    struct { int16_t history[2]; int32_t buffer; uint64_t at; } adpcm;   // DSP-ADPCM decode cursor (buffer slot, next sample) and history
    float biquad_state[2][6][2];   // filter, channel: transposed direct-form II delays
} ServerVoice;
enum { SV_STOPPED, SV_STARTED, SV_PAUSED, SV_STOPPING };

typedef struct AudioRenderer {
    AudrenParameter param;
    PlatMutex lock;
    PlatThread *thread;
    volatile int32_t running;
    uint32_t state, revision, time_limit, event;   // state 0 started, 1 stopped; event: writable handle
    int logged;
    uint64_t behavior_flags, elapsed_frames;
    uint64_t stop_released, empty_played, flushed, logged_released;
    ServerVoice *voices;
    AudrenPoolIn *pools;
    AudrenMixIn *mixes;
    AudrenSinkIn *sinks;
    AudrenEffectIn *effects;
    AudrenChannelIn *channels;
    void *mixer;
} AudioRenderer;

// IAudioRendererManager, served under "audren:u" (ipc.c's service table).
void audren_manager_handler(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs);
void aud_user_handler(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs);   // aud:u (Switch 2)
long audren_renderers_live(void);      // renderers whose render tick runs

// Mixer interface (audio_mixer.c). Every call but open/close/set_running runs with r->lock held.
void audio_mixer_open(AudioRenderer *r);
void audio_mixer_set_running(AudioRenderer *r, int running);
void audio_mixer_close(AudioRenderer *r);
void audio_mixer_update_routing(AudioRenderer *r, const uint8_t *splitters, uint32_t splitter_bytes,
                                const uint8_t *mixes, uint32_t mix_bytes, int mix_count);
void audio_mixer_update_effects(AudioRenderer *r);
void audio_mixer_effect_result(AudioRenderer *r, int id, void *output, unsigned size);
uint32_t audio_mixer_sink_written(AudioRenderer *r, int id);
void audio_mixer_render(AudioRenderer *r, double seconds);   // after audio_voices_prepare, before voices advance
// Device pacing for the render thread at kern_now_ns `now`: 0 renders the next frame now, a positive value waits that
// many ns (the ring is at its target), -1 leaves the pace to the render thread's timer (no device, renderer stopped,
// device stalled).
int64_t audio_mixer_pace_ns(AudioRenderer *r, uint64_t now);
int audio_buffer_empty(const AudrenWaveBuffer *b);   // no samples to decode: played as soon as it is reached
void audio_device_handler(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs);   // IAudioDevice

```


`runtime/boot.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/loader.c (lines 456-477) and services.c (lines 219-235) @ b75be8cf
// (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames contributors) and LAS Recomp runtime/main.c (lines 16-35, 141-159) @
// da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
// The boot driver: the guest main thread runs the game's own nn::init::Start
// with three host callbacks, the second of which runs DT_INIT of main, subsdk0 and sdk; Start then calls nnMain.
// --boot checks two checkpoints on the way and ends at the first nvnBootstrapLoader call, at the return address of
// each in main (1.1.1, 1.2.1, 1.4.3):
//   SetFocusHandlingMode   main+0xeb8c14 (1.2.1: +0xe7a954, 1.4.3: +0xbdb48c) in nnMain, every module's constructor
//                          flag reads 2
//   nvnBootstrapLoader     main+0xebcdec (1.2.1: +0xe7eb2c, 1.4.3: +0xbe0360) in the graphics bring-up; logs the
//                          run statistics, exits 0
// With --seconds S the run continues past that call; rt_frame_presented ends it once the world clock passed S.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "fs.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "ov.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "vk.h"


#define SYM_INIT_START "_ZN2nn4init5StartEmmPFvvES2_S2_"
// main: return addresses of nnMain's SetFocusHandlingMode call (1.1.1 and 1.2.1 from this port's analysis of main;
// 1.4.3 from MacNativeGames' scripts/verify_boot.py) and of the first nvnBootstrapLoader call, per game version.
#define CHECKPOINT_RET (RT_V143 ? 0xbdb48cull : RT_V111 ? 0xeb8c14ull : 0xe7a954ull)
#define NVN_RET (RT_V143 ? 0xbe0360ull : RT_V111 ? 0xebcdecull : 0xe7eb2cull)
#define CTOR_DONE 2                      // a module's constructor flag after its DT_INIT ran the init_array

// The init_array sizes (1.1.1 and 1.2.1: counted in the modules; 1.4.3: DT_INIT_ARRAYSZ); MacNativeGames' boot check
// expects the same. The three tables carry the same rows, so cb_module_inits walks them by the size of one.
typedef struct { const char *name; uint64_t entries; } InitCount;
static const InitCount inits_111[] = {{"main", 10668}, {"subsdk0", 45}, {"sdk", 116}};
static const InitCount inits_121[] = {{"main", 10673}, {"subsdk0", 45}, {"sdk", 116}};
static const InitCount inits_143[] = {{"main", 10717}, {"subsdk0", 45}, {"sdk", 83}};
#define expected_inits (RT_V143 ? inits_143 : RT_V111 ? inits_111 : inits_121)

static volatile int32_t inits_done, checkpoint_seen;
uint64_t rt_guest_start_ns;

static const RtLoaded *module_named(const char *name) {
    for (int i = 0; i < ldr_count(); i++)
        if (!strcmp(ldr_module(i)->name, name)) return ldr_module(i);
    rt_fatal("boot: module %s is not loaded", name);
}

static uint32_t ctor_state(const RtLoaded *m) { return LD32(m->ctor_flag); }

static const char *caller(const Cpu *c, char *buf, int n) { return ldr_describe(c->x[30] - 4, buf, n); }

// main.npdm META: the main thread's priority (+0xE), core (+0xF) and stack size (+0x1C). kernel.c builds the main
// thread with the 1.2.1 values; a different npdm means a different game build.
static void check_npdm(void) {
    size_t n;
    uint8_t *npdm = ldr_read_verified(rt_config()->exefs, "main.npdm", &n);
    if (n < 0x80 || memcmp(npdm, "META", 4)) rt_fatal("boot: main.npdm has no META header");
    uint32_t stack;
    memcpy(&stack, npdm + 0x1C, 4);
    int prio = npdm[0xE], core = npdm[0xF];
    free(npdm);
    if (prio != 44 || core != 0 || stack != 0x100000)
        rt_fatal("boot: main.npdm asks for priority %d, core %d, stack %#x; kernel.c builds 44, 0, 0x100000", prio,
                 core, stack);
}

// ---- the three callbacks of nn::init::Start (rtld's job on hardware)
static void cb_loader_ready(Cpu *c) {
    (void)c;
    rt_log("boot: rtld callback: modules linked");
}

// DT_INIT registers the module with musl (__nnmusl_init_dso) and runs its init_array; the constructor flag reads 2
// afterwards (MacNativeGames loader.c:458-462).
// The init_array size a TotK build expects of module name, or 0 for another game (rt_game_version 0: the NVN 2 reference title), whose
// counts are not pinned.
static uint64_t expected_entries(const char *name) {
    if (!rt_game_version) return 0;
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < sizeof inits_121 / sizeof *inits_121; k++)
        if (!strcmp(expected_inits[k].name, name)) return expected_inits[k].entries;
    rt_fatal("boot: module %s is not one of this game version's", name);
}

static void cb_module_inits(Cpu *c) {
    if (plat_cas32(&inits_done, 0, 0)) rt_fatal("boot: module constructors requested twice");
    if (rt_game_version)   // TotK: the three modules must all be there
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < sizeof inits_121 / sizeof *inits_121; k++) module_named(expected_inits[k].name);
    // Load order (main, subsdk*, sdk), as rtld runs them. the NVN 2 reference title has no subsdk0.
    for (int k = 0; k < ldr_count(); k++) {
        const RtLoaded *m = ldr_module(k);
        uint64_t entries = m->init_array_size / 8, want = expected_entries(m->name);
        if (!m->init) rt_fatal("boot: %s has no DT_INIT", m->name);
        rt_log("boot: ENTER %s DT_INIT (%llu init_array entries)", m->name, (unsigned long long)entries);
        rt_call(c, m->init, 0);
        uint32_t state = ctor_state(m);
        rt_logf("boot: DT_INIT %s state=%u (%llu)\n", m->name, state, (unsigned long long)entries);
        if (state != CTOR_DONE) rt_fatal("boot: %s DT_INIT left its constructor flag at %u, not 2", m->name, state);
        if (want && entries != want)
            rt_fatal("boot: %s has %llu init_array entries, this game version has %llu", m->name, (unsigned long long)entries,
                     (unsigned long long)want);
    }
    ov_system_on_inits_done();
    plat_xchg32(&inits_done, 1);
}

static void cb_module_finis(Cpu *c) {
    char lr[128];
    rt_fatal("boot: the game asked for module finalizers (from %s): the guest exited", caller(c, lr, sizeof lr));
}

// ---- checkpoints (host.h)
static void stats_line(void) {
    RtStats s = rt_stats();
    rt_logf("boot: passed (%llu SVCs, %llu threads, %llu host calls)\n", (unsigned long long)s.svcs,
           (unsigned long long)s.threads, (unsigned long long)s.host_calls);
}

void rt_boot_event(const char *what, Cpu *c, const char *detail) {
    if (!rt_game_version) return;   // the expected call sites are TotK's main; the NVN 2 reference title has none pinned
    char at[128];
    const RtLoaded *main_mod = module_named("main");
    uint64_t ret = c->x[30];
    caller(c, at, sizeof at);
    if (!strcmp(what, "checkpoint")) {
        if (ret != main_mod->base + CHECKPOINT_RET)
            rt_fatal("boot: checkpoint %s reached from %s, expected main+%#llx", detail, at,
                     (unsigned long long)CHECKPOINT_RET);
        if (!plat_cas32(&inits_done, 0, 0)) rt_fatal("boot: checkpoint %s before DT_INIT", detail);
        for (int i = 0; i < ldr_count(); i++)
            if (ctor_state(ldr_module(i)) != CTOR_DONE)
                rt_fatal("boot: checkpoint %s: %s constructor flag reads %u", detail, ldr_module(i)->name,
                         ctor_state(ldr_module(i)));
        plat_xchg32(&checkpoint_seen, 1);
        rt_logf("boot: checkpoint %s from main+%#llx\n", detail, (unsigned long long)(ret - main_mod->base));
        return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(what, "nvn")) {
        if (ret != main_mod->base + NVN_RET)
            rt_fatal("boot: first NVN call %s(\"%s\") from %s, expected main+%#llx", "nvnBootstrapLoader", detail, at,
                     (unsigned long long)NVN_RET);
        if (!plat_cas32(&checkpoint_seen, 0, 0))
            rt_fatal("boot: first NVN call before the SetFocusHandlingMode checkpoint");
        rt_logf("boot: first NVN call nvnBootstrapLoader(\"%s\") from main+%#llx\n", detail,
               (unsigned long long)(ret - main_mod->base));
        if (rt_config()->seconds) return;   // --seconds: the run goes on into the world
        if (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_HOSTCALL) hostfn_report();
        stats_line();
        fflush(stdout);
        fflush(stderr);
        plat_exit(0);   // other guest threads are still running; nothing of theirs needs an orderly end
    }
    rt_fatal("boot: unknown boot event %s (%s) from %s", what, detail ? detail : "", at);
}

// ---- --seconds S
// A PNG with stored (uncompressed) deflate blocks: no compression library, and the shot is only read by tools.
// rt_write_png (declared in vk.h) is shared with the TOTK_DUMP frame dump (vk_dump.c).
static uint32_t crc32_update(uint32_t crc, const uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    static uint32_t table[256];
    if (!table[1])
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
            uint32_t c = i;
            for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xEDB88320u ^ (c >> 1) : c >> 1;
            table[i] = c;
        }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) crc = table[(crc ^ p[i]) & 0xFF] ^ (crc >> 8);
    return crc;
}

static void png_chunk(FILE *f, const char *type, const uint8_t *data, uint32_t n) {
    uint8_t hdr[8] = {(uint8_t)(n >> 24), (uint8_t)(n >> 16), (uint8_t)(n >> 8), (uint8_t)n};
    memcpy(hdr + 4, type, 4);
    uint32_t crc = crc32_update(crc32_update(~0u, hdr + 4, 4), data, n) ^ ~0u;
    uint8_t tail[4] = {(uint8_t)(crc >> 24), (uint8_t)(crc >> 16), (uint8_t)(crc >> 8), (uint8_t)crc};
    fwrite(hdr, 1, 8, f);
    if (n) fwrite(data, 1, n, f);
    fwrite(tail, 1, 4, f);
}

void rt_write_png(const char *path, const uint8_t *rgba, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    uint64_t row = 1 + 4ull * w, raw_n = row * h;
    uint8_t *raw = malloc(raw_n);
    if (!raw) rt_fatal("boot: out of memory for the shot");
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        raw[y * row] = 0;   // filter: none
        memcpy(raw + y * row + 1, rgba + 4ull * w * y, 4ull * w);
    }
    uint64_t blocks = (raw_n + 65534) / 65535;
    uint8_t *z = malloc(2 + raw_n + 5 * blocks + 4);
    if (!z) rt_fatal("boot: out of memory for the shot");
    uint64_t zn = 0;
    z[zn++] = 0x78, z[zn++] = 0x01;
    uint32_t a = 1, b = 0;
    for (uint64_t off = 0; off < raw_n; off += 65535) {
        uint32_t k = raw_n - off > 65535 ? 65535 : (uint32_t)(raw_n - off);
        z[zn++] = off + k >= raw_n;
        z[zn++] = (uint8_t)k, z[zn++] = (uint8_t)(k >> 8), z[zn++] = (uint8_t)~k, z[zn++] = (uint8_t)(~k >> 8);
        memcpy(z + zn, raw + off, k);
        zn += k;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < k; i++) a = (a + raw[off + i]) % 65521, b = (b + a) % 65521;
    }
    uint32_t ad = b << 16 | a;
    z[zn++] = (uint8_t)(ad >> 24), z[zn++] = (uint8_t)(ad >> 16), z[zn++] = (uint8_t)(ad >> 8), z[zn++] = (uint8_t)ad;
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) rt_fatal("boot: cannot write %s", path);
    static const uint8_t sig[8] = {0x89, 'P', 'N', 'G', 13, 10, 26, 10};
    uint8_t ihdr[13] = {(uint8_t)(w >> 24), (uint8_t)(w >> 16), (uint8_t)(w >> 8), (uint8_t)w,
                        (uint8_t)(h >> 24), (uint8_t)(h >> 16), (uint8_t)(h >> 8), (uint8_t)h, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0};
    fwrite(sig, 1, 8, f);
    png_chunk(f, "IHDR", ihdr, 13);
    png_chunk(f, "IDAT", z, (uint32_t)zn);
    png_chunk(f, "IEND", NULL, 0);
    if (fclose(f)) rt_fatal("boot: cannot write %s", path);
    free(z);
    free(raw);
}

static void save_shot(const tex_t *t, const char *path) {
    int fmt = t->d.format;
    int bgra = fmt == NVN_FORMAT_BGRA8 || fmt == NVN_FORMAT_BGRA8_SRGB;
    if (!bgra && fmt != NVN_FORMAT_RGBA8 && fmt != NVN_FORMAT_RGBA8_SRGB)
        rt_fatal("boot: --shot supports 8-bit RGBA and BGRA targets, the presented texture has NVN format %#x", fmt);
    uint32_t w = t->d.width, h = t->d.height;
    uint8_t *px = malloc(4ull * w * h);
    if (!px) rt_fatal("boot: out of memory for the shot");
    view_t view;
    memset(&view, 0, sizeof view);
    NVNcopyRegion r = {.width = (int)w, .height = (int)h, .depth = 1};
    if (gfx_replay_async()) gfx_backend()->finish();   // the presented frame may still be queued for the replay
    gfx_backend()->read_texels(t, &view, &r, px, 4ull * w, 4ull * w * h);
    if (bgra)
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < 4ull * w * h; i += 4) {
            uint8_t x = px[i];
            px[i] = px[i + 2];
            px[i + 2] = x;
        }
    if (w == 3840 && h == 2160) {
        // Match nvnQueuePresentTexture's MKW DRS default crop (title often 1704×960).
        int active_w = 1704, active_h = 960;
        uint8_t *crop_px = malloc(4ull * active_w * active_h);
        if (crop_px) {
            for (int y = 0; y < active_h; y++)
                memcpy(crop_px + 4ull * y * active_w, px + 4ull * y * w, 4ull * active_w);
            rt_write_png(path, crop_px, active_w, active_h);
            free(crop_px);
            free(px);
            rt_logf("boot: shot %s (%ux%u cropped from %ux%u)\n", path, active_w, active_h, w, h);
            return;
        }
    }
    rt_write_png(path, px, w, h);
    free(px);
    rt_logf("boot: shot %s (%ux%u)\n", path, w, h);
}

// TOTK_SHOTS=lo-hi:step [TOTK_SHOTS_DIR=dir]: every step-th present in [lo, hi] saved as <dir>/f<n>.png (n the
// present), box-filtered to 480x270; TOTK_SHOTS=w<lo>-<hi>:<step> takes them by world-clock seconds instead, the first
// present at or after each step (full size with TOTK_SHOTS_FULL=1), for finding short glitches. Pipeline builds stay asynchronous, so the
// pictures show what a player sees.
static void series_shot(const tex_t *t, uint64_t n) {
    static int parsed;
    static unsigned long long lo, hi, step, next;
    static const char *dir;
    static int full, world;
    if (!parsed) {
        full = cfg_get("TOTK_SHOTS_FULL") != NULL;
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_SHOTS");
        double wl, wh, ws;
        if (e && e[0] == 'w' && sscanf(e + 1, "%lf-%lf:%lf", &wl, &wh, &ws) == 3 && ws > 0)   // world-clock seconds
            world = 1, lo = (unsigned long long)(wl * 1e6), hi = (unsigned long long)(wh * 1e6),
            step = (unsigned long long)(ws * 1e6), next = lo;
        else if (!e || sscanf(e, "%llu-%llu:%llu", &lo, &hi, &step) != 3 || !step) hi = 0;
        dir = cfg_get("TOTK_SHOTS_DIR") ? cfg_get("TOTK_SHOTS_DIR") : ".";
        if (hi) plat_file_mkdir_p(dir);
        parsed = 1;
    }
    if (world) {   // the first present at or after each step of the world clock
        int64_t w = frame_step_world_us();
        if (w < 0 || (unsigned long long)w < next || next > hi) return;
        while (next <= (unsigned long long)w) next += step;
    } else if (n < lo || n > hi || (n - lo) % step) {
        return;
    }
    int fmt = t->d.format;
    int bgra = fmt == NVN_FORMAT_BGRA8 || fmt == NVN_FORMAT_BGRA8_SRGB;
    if (!bgra && fmt != NVN_FORMAT_RGBA8 && fmt != NVN_FORMAT_RGBA8_SRGB) return;
    uint32_t w = t->d.width, h = t->d.height;
    // MKW DRS presents into a 3840×2160 target with the active tile in the top-left (title ~1704×960).
    // FULL series used to dump the whole black frame; crop like --shot so night fallbacks are usable.
    uint32_t src_w = w, src_h = h, crop_x = 0, crop_y = 0;
    if (full && w == 3840 && h == 2160) src_w = 1704, src_h = 960;
    uint32_t ow = full ? src_w : 480, oh = full ? src_h : 270;
    uint8_t *px = malloc(4ull * w * h), *out = malloc(4ull * ow * oh);
    if (!px || !out) rt_fatal("boot: out of memory for a TOTK_SHOTS frame");
    view_t view;
    memset(&view, 0, sizeof view);
    NVNcopyRegion r = {.width = (int)w, .height = (int)h, .depth = 1};
    if (gfx_replay_async()) gfx_backend()->finish();   // the presented frame may still be queued for the replay
    gfx_backend()->read_texels(t, &view, &r, px, 4ull * w, 4ull * w * h);
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < oh; y++)
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < ow; x++) {
            uint32_t x0 = crop_x + x * src_w / ow, x1 = crop_x + (x + 1) * src_w / ow;
            uint32_t y0 = crop_y + y * src_h / oh, y1 = crop_y + (y + 1) * src_h / oh;
            if (x1 <= x0) x1 = x0 + 1;
            if (y1 <= y0) y1 = y0 + 1;
            if (x1 > w) x1 = w;
            if (y1 > h) y1 = h;
            uint32_t sum[4] = {0}, k = 0;
            for (uint32_t sy = y0; sy < y1; sy++)
                for (uint32_t sx = x0; sx < x1; sx++, k++)
                    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) sum[c] += px[4ull * (sy * (uint64_t)w + sx) + (uint32_t)c];
            if (!k) k = 1;
            uint8_t *o = out + 4ull * (y * ow + x);
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) o[c] = (uint8_t)(sum[bgra && c != 3 ? 2 - c : c] / k);
            o[3] = 255;
        }
    char path[PLAT_PATH_MAX];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/f%05llu.png", dir, (unsigned long long)n);
    rt_write_png(path, out, ow, oh);
    free(out);
    free(px);
}

// A --seconds run ends at the first present after the world clock (game time since the save's first frame,
// frame_step_world_us) passed S seconds, so a run covers the same game time at any frame rate; any other frame is
// counted by the back end only.
void rt_frame_presented(const tex_t *t, uint64_t n) {
    const RtConfig *cfg = rt_config();
    series_shot(t, n);
    int64_t w = cfg->seconds ? frame_step_world_us() : -1;
    if (w < 0 || (double)w < cfg->seconds * 1e6) return;
    if (cfg->shot) save_shot(t, cfg->shot);
    GfxStats g = gfx_stats();
    rt_logf("boot: frames %llu presented (nvn calls %llu, distinct %llu, unimplemented %llu, validation errors %llu, "
           "shader failures %llu, draws skipped %llu)\n", (unsigned long long)g.frames,
           (unsigned long long)g.nvn_calls, (unsigned long long)g.nvn_distinct, (unsigned long long)g.unimplemented,
           (unsigned long long)g.validation_errors, (unsigned long long)g.shader_failures,
           (unsigned long long)g.draws_skipped);
    stats_line();
    if (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_HOSTCALL) hostfn_report();   // which host functions the run leaned on
    fflush(stdout);
    fflush(stderr);
    fs_save_flush();
    vk_pipeline_save();   // no-op without the Vulkan back end
    prof_write();
    fflush(stderr);
    plat_exit(0);
}

// ---- steps 9-14
static uint64_t cb_addr[3];

static void guest_main(Cpu *c) {
    uint32_t handle = kern_main_thread(&c);
    uint64_t start = ldr_symbol(SYM_INIT_START);
    if (!start) rt_fatal("boot: %s is not exported", SYM_INIT_START);
    char d[128];
    rt_log("boot: ENTER nn::init::Start at %s, main thread %#x", ldr_describe(start, d, sizeof d), handle);
    // nn::init::Start(main thread handle, arguments region, loader_ready, module_inits, module_finis)
    rt_call(c, start, 5, (uint64_t)handle, (uint64_t)0, cb_addr[0], cb_addr[1], cb_addr[2]);
    rt_fatal("boot: nn::init::Start returned");
}

static void prewarm_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    vk_pipeline_prewarm();
    const char *prep = cfg_get("TOTK_TEST_PREPARE_SHADERS");   // Task 2.3 test hook; Task 2.6 builds the preparation
    if (prep && !strcmp(prep, "1")) {
        int cpus = (int)plat_cpu_usable();
        gfx_shader_prepare_recorded(cpus, cpus / 2 > 16 ? 16 : cpus / 2 < 1 ? 1 : cpus / 2);
    }
    return;
}

void rt_boot(void) {
    check_npdm();
    if (!rt_config()->shot) vk_pipeline_async_enable();   // a --shot image must not depend on build timing
    // Shaders and pipelines recorded in earlier runs are made ready while the modules load; the guest waits for them.
    PlatThread *warm = plat_thread_new(prewarm_main, NULL, "prewarm");
    ldr_load(rt_config()->exefs);
    rt_patches_init();
    frame_step_init();
    res_init();
    cb_addr[0] = hostfn_register("<rtld loader_ready>", cb_loader_ready);
    cb_addr[1] = hostfn_register("<rtld module_inits>", cb_module_inits);
    cb_addr[2] = hostfn_register("<rtld module_finis>", cb_module_finis);
    ov_system_post_load();
    hostfn_seal();
    uint64_t held = plat_now_ms();
    if (warm) plat_thread_join(warm);
    else vk_pipeline_prewarm();
    held = plat_now_ms() - held;
    rt_log("boot: guest starts %llu ms after process start (%llu ms of it waiting for the prewarm)",
           (unsigned long long)(plat_process_uptime_ns() / 1000000), (unsigned long long)held);
    rt_guest_start_ns = kern_now_ns();
    kern_run_on_guest_main(guest_main);
    rt_fatal("boot: the guest main thread ended");
}

```

`runtime/cfg.c`:

```c
// mkw.ini: file-backed defaults for the TOTK_* environment variables (docs/controls.md, mkw.ini.example).
// Format: "key = value" lines, '#' or ';' at the start of a line begins a comment, [sections] only group. A key is a
// variable name without "TOTK_" (an optional TOTK_ prefix is accepted), case-insensitive. A value is the rest of the
// line, trimmed, optionally in double quotes; an empty value counts as unset. The environment wins over the file.
//
// Live settings: cfg_set changes a value in memory (readers see the new pointer; the old string is kept, so a pointer
// cfg_get handed out stays valid) and cfg_save writes only the changed keys back, keeping the rest of the file.
// Readers take no lock: an entry is complete before n_entries counts it, and value pointers are swapped atomically.

static int is_known(const char *key) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof known / sizeof *known; i++)
        if (!strcmp(known[i], key)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static void clear(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n_entries; i++) free(entries[i].key), free(entries[i].value);
    n_entries = 0;
}

static char *trim(char *s) {
    while (*s == ' ' || *s == '\t') s++;
    char *e = s + strlen(s);
    while (e > s && (e[-1] == ' ' || e[-1] == '\t' || e[-1] == '\r')) *--e = 0;
    return s;
}

static const char *unprefix(const char *name) {
    if (!name) return NULL;
    if (!strncmp(name, "MKW_", 4)) return name + 4;
    if (!strncmp(name, "MKW_", 4)) return name + 4;
    if (!strncmp(name, "TOTK_", 5)) return name + 5;
    return NULL;
}

// The upper-case key without the prefix, in place.
static char *norm_key(char *key) {
    for (char *p = key; *p; p++) *p = (char)toupper((unsigned char)*p);
    const char *u = unprefix(key);
    return u ? (char *)u : key;
}

static void add(char *key, char *value, int line) {
    key = norm_key(key);
    size_t vl = strlen(value);
    if (vl >= 2 && value[0] == '"' && value[vl - 1] == '"') value[vl - 1] = 0, value++;
    if (!*key) return;
    if (!is_known(key)) rt_log("cfg: mkw.ini line %d: unknown key '%s'", line, key);
    if (!*value) return;   // "key =" leaves the setting at its default
    for (int i = 0; i < n_entries; i++)
        if (!strcmp(entries[i].key, key)) {   // a repeated key: the later line wins
            free(entries[i].value);
            entries[i].value = strdup(value);
            return;
        }
    if (n_entries == CFG_MAX_KEYS) return;
    entries[n_entries++] = (CfgEntry){strdup(key), strdup(value), 0, 0};
}

int cfg_load(const char *path) {
    clear();
    uint64_t size = 0;
    uint8_t *data = plat_file_read(path, &size);
    if (!data) return 0;
    char *p = (char *)data;
    if (size >= 3 && !memcmp(p, "\xEF\xBB\xBF", 3)) p += 3;   // editors add a BOM
    for (int line = 1; *p; line++) {
        char *eol = strchr(p, '\n');
        if (eol) *eol = 0;
        char *s = trim(p);
        char *eq = strchr(s, '=');
        if (*s && *s != '#' && *s != ';' && *s != '[') {
            if (!eq) rt_log("cfg: mkw.ini line %d: no '=' in '%s'", line, s);
            else {
                *eq = 0;
                add(trim(s), trim(eq + 1), line);
            }
        }
        if (!eol) break;
        p = eol + 1;
    }
    free(data);
    return 1;
}

// ---- device profiles: defaults for a known machine, below the environment and mkw.ini and above the table, so any
// key the player sets wins and resetting a key in the menu returns to the profile's value. MKW_DEVICE_PROFILE = auto
// (default: the Steam Deck when the firmware says so), desktop (none) or deck.
//
// The Steam Deck (LCD Jupiter, OLED Galileo; 1280x800, 16:10, 4 Zen 2 cores, RDNA 2 with 8 CUs sharing 16 GB): the game
// at the screen's 1280x800 with its own 5/6 scene (the aspect patch gives the camera its 16:10, resolution.c, and the
// romfs-patches-1280x800 overlay the HUD's);
// fullscreen and vsync, as gamescope composes Game Mode; 40 fps, which divides 40 Hz (and 120 Hz on the OLED).
// Starting points to replace with measured ones (docs/tester-guide.md, Steam Deck).
static const struct { const char *key, *value; } DECK[] = {
    {"FULLSCREEN", "1"}, {"WINDOW_SIZE", "1280x800"}, {"OUTPUT_RES", "1280x800"}, {"RENDER_SCALE", "game"},
    {"VK_PRESENT", "fifo"}, {"FPS_LIMIT", "40"},
};
static int profile = -1;   // 0 none, 1 Steam Deck

static int read_line(const char *path, char *out, size_t n) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (!f) return 0;
    int ok = fgets(out, (int)n, f) != NULL;
    fclose(f);
    out[ok ? strcspn(out, "\r\n") : 0] = 0;
    return ok;
}

// The Steam Deck: Valve's board, product Jupiter or Galileo (/sys/class/dmi/id); SteamDeck=1, which Steam sets on it.
static int on_steam_deck(void) {
    const char *env = getenv("SteamDeck");
    if (env && !strcmp(env, "1")) return 1;
    char vendor[64], product[64];
    return read_line("/sys/class/dmi/id/board_vendor", vendor, sizeof vendor) && !strcmp(vendor, "Valve") &&
           read_line("/sys/class/dmi/id/product_name", product, sizeof product) &&
           (!strcmp(product, "Jupiter") || !strcmp(product, "Galileo"));
}

static const char *raw_get(const char *name);

static int profile_of(void) {
    int p = __atomic_load_n(&profile, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (p >= 0) return p;
    const char *set = raw_get(PREFIX "DEVICE_PROFILE");
    if (set && !strcmp(set, "deck")) p = 1;
    else if (set && *set && strcmp(set, "auto")) p = 0;
    else p = on_steam_deck();
    __atomic_store_n(&profile, p, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    return p;
}

const char *cfg_device_profile(void) { return profile_of() ? "deck" : "desktop"; }

// MKW_X in the environment stands for TOTK_X and wins over it: the TOTK_ names come from TotK Recomp and stay, so its
// fixes keep applying without a rename.
static const char *mkw_alias(const char *name) {
    char alias[96];
    const char *u = unprefix(name);
    if (!u || strlen(u) >= sizeof alias - 6) return NULL;
    snprintf(alias, sizeof alias, "MKW_%s", u);
    const char *e = getenv(alias);
    if (e) return e;
    snprintf(alias, sizeof alias, "MKW_%s", u);
    e = getenv(alias);
    if (e) return e;
    snprintf(alias, sizeof alias, "TOTK_%s", u);
    return getenv(alias);
}

static const char *env_of(const char *name) {
    const char *u = unprefix(name);
    if (u) return mkw_alias(name);
    return getenv(name);
}

static const char *raw_get(const char *name) {
    const char *e = env_of(name);
    const char *u = unprefix(name);
    if (e || !u) return e;
    int n = __atomic_load_n(&n_entries, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!strcasecmp(entries[i].key, u)) return __atomic_load_n(&entries[i].value, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    return NULL;
}

const char *cfg_get(const char *name) {
    const char *v = raw_get(name);
    const char *u = unprefix(name);
    if (v || !u || !profile_of()) return v;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof DECK / sizeof *DECK; i++)
        if (!strcasecmp(DECK[i].key, u)) return DECK[i].value;
    return NULL;
}

// Whether name's value comes from the player (the environment or mkw.ini), not a profile or the table.
int cfg_is_set(const char *name) { return raw_get(name) != NULL; }

unsigned cfg_version(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&version, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

int cfg_from_env(const char *name) { return env_of(name) != NULL; }

void cfg_set(const char *name, const char *value) {
    const char *u = unprefix(name);
    if (!u || !value) return;
    char key[64];
    snprintf(key, sizeof key, "%s", u);
    for (char *p = key; *p; p++) *p = (char)toupper((unsigned char)*p);
    plat_mutex_lock(&set_lock);
    int i = 0, n = n_entries;
    while (i < n && strcmp(entries[i].key, key)) i++;
    if (i < n) {
        if (!entries[i].value || strcmp(entries[i].value, value)) {
            __atomic_store_n(&entries[i].value, strdup(value), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);   // the old string stays for readers
            entries[i].dirty = 1;
        }
        entries[i].removed = 0;   // a value set after cfg_reset replaces the line instead of deleting it
    } else if (n < CFG_MAX_KEYS) {
        entries[n] = (CfgEntry){strdup(key), strdup(value), 1, 0};
        __atomic_store_n(&n_entries, n + 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    __atomic_add_fetch(&version, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&set_lock);
}

int cfg_reset(const char *const *keys, int n) {
    int done = 0;
    plat_mutex_lock(&set_lock);
    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        char key[64], var[80];
        snprintf(key, sizeof key, "%s", keys[k]);
        const char *name = norm_key(key);
        snprintf(var, sizeof var, PREFIX "%s", name);
        if (env_of(var)) continue;   // the environment wins; the file line stays
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n_entries && strcmp(entries[i].key, name)) i++;
        if (i == n_entries) {   // no value in memory ("key =" in the file): the line still has to go
            if (i == CFG_MAX_KEYS) continue;
            entries[i] = (CfgEntry){strdup(name), NULL, 0, 1};
            __atomic_store_n(&n_entries, i + 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        } else if (entries[i].value) {
            __atomic_store_n(&entries[i].value, NULL, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);   // the old string stays for readers
            entries[i].dirty = 0;
            entries[i].removed = 1;   // cfg_save_to deletes the key's lines
            done++;
        } else {
            entries[i].removed = 1;
        }
    }
    if (done) __atomic_add_fetch(&version, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&set_lock);
    return done;
}

int cfg_last_save_ok(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&save_ok, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

void cfg_each_active(void (*cb)(const char *key, const char *value, int from_env, void *ctx), void *ctx) {
    int n = __atomic_load_n(&n_entries, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const char *v = __atomic_load_n(&entries[i].value, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
        if (v) cb(entries[i].key, v, 0, ctx);
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof known / sizeof *known; i++) {
        char var[80];
        snprintf(var, sizeof var, PREFIX "%s", known[i]);
        const char *e = env_of(var);
        if (e) cb(known[i], e, 1, ctx);
    }
}

const CfgMeta *cfg_meta(const char *key) {
    char k[64];
    snprintf(k, sizeof k, "%s", key);
    const char *name = norm_key(k);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof metas / sizeof *metas; i++)
        if (!strcmp(metas[i].key, name)) return &metas[i];
    return NULL;
}

const CfgMeta *cfg_meta_at(int i) { return i >= 0 && (size_t)i < sizeof metas / sizeof *metas ? &metas[i] : NULL; }

const char *cfg_value(const char *name) {
    const char *e = cfg_get(name);
    if (e && *e) return e;
    const CfgMeta *m = cfg_meta(name);
    if (!m) {
        rt_log("cfg: warning: %s has no row in the settings table", name);
        return "";
    }
    return m->def ? m->def : "";
}

// The row's default as a number, for a set value that does not parse.
static double default_number(const char *name) {
    const CfgMeta *m = cfg_meta(name);
    return m && m->def ? strtod(m->def, NULL) : 0.0;
}

double cfg_double(const char *name) {
    const char *v = cfg_value(name);
    char *end;
    double d = strtod(v, &end);
    return end == v || *end || d != d ? default_number(name) : d;
}

int cfg_int(const char *name) {
    const char *v = cfg_value(name);
    char *end;
    long l = strtol(v, &end, 10);
    return end == v || *end ? (int)default_number(name) : (int)l;
}

int cfg_bool(const char *name) { return strcmp(cfg_value(name), "0") != 0; }

// ---- cfg_save: the file as lines, each with its line ending
typedef struct { const char *s; size_t n; } Line;   // n includes the '\n' (and '\r') when present

static int line_count(const char *p, size_t size) {
    int n = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; i++) n += p[i] == '\n';
    return n + 1;
}

// The line's text without its ending, BOM and surrounding blanks, into out.
static void line_text(const Line *l, int first, char *out, size_t cap) {
    size_t n = l->n;
    const char *s = l->s;
    if (first && n >= 3 && !memcmp(s, "\xEF\xBB\xBF", 3)) s += 3, n -= 3;
    while (n && (s[n - 1] == '\n' || s[n - 1] == '\r')) n--;
    if (n >= cap) n = cap - 1;
    memcpy(out, s, n);
    out[n] = 0;
    char *t = trim(out);
    memmove(out, t, strlen(t) + 1);
}

// The key of a "key = value" line (comment = 0) or of a commented "# key = value" line (comment = 1), normalised,
// into key; 0 when the line is not one.
static int line_key(const char *text, int comment, char *key, size_t cap) {
    if (comment) {
        if (*text != '#' && *text != ';') return 0;
        text++;
        while (*text == ' ' || *text == '\t') text++;
    }
    if (!*text || *text == '#' || *text == ';' || *text == '[') return 0;
    const char *eq = strchr(text, '=');
    if (!eq) return 0;
    size_t n = (size_t)(eq - text);
    while (n && (text[n - 1] == ' ' || text[n - 1] == '\t')) n--;
    if (!n || n >= cap) return 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!isalnum((unsigned char)text[i]) && text[i] != '_') return 0;
    char tmp[128];
    memcpy(tmp, text, n);
    tmp[n] = 0;
    snprintf(key, cap, "%s", norm_key(tmp));
    return 1;
}

// The section name of a "[name]" line, lower-case, into out; 0 when the line is not one.
static int line_section(const char *text, char *out, size_t cap) {
    if (*text != '[') return 0;
    const char *e = strchr(text, ']');
    if (!e) return 0;
    char tmp[128];
    size_t n = (size_t)(e - text - 1);
    if (n >= sizeof tmp) n = sizeof tmp - 1;
    memcpy(tmp, text + 1, n);
    tmp[n] = 0;
    snprintf(out, cap, "%s", trim(tmp));
    for (char *p = out; *p; p++) *p = (char)tolower((unsigned char)*p);
    return 1;
}

typedef struct { char *buf; size_t n, cap; } Out;
static void put(Out *o, const char *s, size_t n) {
    if (o->n + n + 1 > o->cap) {
        o->cap = (o->n + n + 1) * 2;
        o->buf = realloc(o->buf, o->cap);
        if (!o->buf) rt_fatal("cfg: out of memory writing mkw.ini");
    }
    memcpy(o->buf + o->n, s, n);
    o->n += n;
}
static void puts_(Out *o, const char *s) { put(o, s, strlen(s)); }

static const char *section_of(const char *key) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof sections / sizeof *sections; i++)
        if (!strcmp(sections[i].key, key)) return sections[i].section;
    return NULL;
}

// "key = value" + eol for entry e (key lower-case)
static void put_entry(Out *o, const CfgEntry *e, const char *eol) {
    char k[64];
    snprintf(k, sizeof k, "%s", e->key);
    for (char *p = k; *p; p++) *p = (char)tolower((unsigned char)*p);
    puts_(o, k);
    puts_(o, " = ");
    puts_(o, e->value);
    puts_(o, eol);
}

int cfg_save_to(const char *path) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&set_lock);
    int n = n_entries, any = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) any |= entries[i].dirty | entries[i].removed;
    if (!any) {
        __atomic_store_n(&save_ok, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        plat_mutex_unlock(&set_lock);
        return 1;
    }
    uint64_t size = 0;
    uint8_t *data = plat_file_read(path, &size);
    if (!data && plat_file_exists(path) && plat_file_size(path) != 0) {
        // the file is there but unreadable (locked, transient error): rebuilding it from nothing would lose its lines
        rt_log("cfg: cannot read %s, nothing written", path);
        __atomic_store_n(&save_ok, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        plat_mutex_unlock(&set_lock);
        return 0;
    }
    const char *text = data ? (const char *)data : "";
    int nl = data ? line_count(text, size) : 0;
    Line *lines = calloc((size_t)nl + 1, sizeof *lines);
    // after[i]: entries to write after line i (-1 = none); replace[i]: the entry whose value line i now carries
    int *replace = malloc(sizeof(int) * ((size_t)nl + 1)), *after_key = malloc(sizeof(int) * (size_t)(n + 1));
    char *drop = calloc((size_t)nl + 1, 1);   // lines of a reset key
    if (!lines || !replace || !after_key || !drop) rt_fatal("cfg: out of memory writing mkw.ini");
    for (int i = 0, at = 0; i < nl; i++) {
        size_t start = (size_t)at;
        while ((uint64_t)at < size && text[at] != '\n') at++;
        if ((uint64_t)at < size) at++;
        lines[i] = (Line){text + start, (size_t)at - start};
        replace[i] = -1;
    }
    if (nl && !lines[nl - 1].n) nl--;   // the text ended with a newline: no last empty line
    const char *eol = data && strstr(text, "\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n";
    char t[1024], k[128], sec[128];
    for (int e = 0; e < n; e++) {
        after_key[e] = -2;   // -2 clean, -1 append in a new section at the end, >= 0 insert after that line
        if (entries[e].removed)
            for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++) {
                line_text(&lines[i], i == 0, t, sizeof t);
                if (line_key(t, 0, k, sizeof k) && !strcmp(k, entries[e].key)) drop[i] = 1;
            }
        if (!entries[e].dirty) continue;
        int last = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++) {
            line_text(&lines[i], i == 0, t, sizeof t);
            if (line_key(t, 0, k, sizeof k) && !strcmp(k, entries[e].key)) last = i;
        }
        if (last >= 0) {
            replace[last] = e;
            continue;
        }
        const char *want = section_of(entries[e].key);
        int in = 0, example = -1, tail = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < nl && want; i++) {
            line_text(&lines[i], i == 0, t, sizeof t);
            if (line_section(t, sec, sizeof sec)) {
                in = !strcmp(sec, want);
                if (in) tail = i;
                continue;
            }
            if (!in) continue;
            if (*t) tail = i;
            if (line_key(t, 1, k, sizeof k) && !strcmp(k, entries[e].key)) example = i;
        }
        after_key[e] = example >= 0 ? example : tail;
    }
    Out o = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++) {
        if (drop[i]) {
            // the line leaves the file; keys inserted after it still need a line ending before them
        } else if (replace[i] >= 0) {
            // keep the line's indentation and key spelling, put the new value after " = "
            const char *s = lines[i].s;
            size_t len = lines[i].n;
            if (i == 0 && len >= 3 && !memcmp(s, "\xEF\xBB\xBF", 3)) put(&o, s, 3), s += 3, len -= 3;
            const char *eq = memchr(s, '=', len);
            size_t kn = (size_t)(eq - s);
            while (kn && (s[kn - 1] == ' ' || s[kn - 1] == '\t')) kn--;
            put(&o, s, kn);
            puts_(&o, " = ");
            puts_(&o, entries[replace[i]].value);
            int had_eol = len && s[len - 1] == '\n';
            if (had_eol) puts_(&o, eol);
        } else {
            put(&o, lines[i].s, lines[i].n);
        }
        for (int e = 0; e < n; e++)
            if (after_key[e] == i) {
                if (o.n && o.buf[o.n - 1] != '\n') puts_(&o, eol);
                put_entry(&o, &entries[e], eol);
            }
    }
    // keys whose section the file lacks: one new section each, at the end
    for (int e = 0; e < n; e++) {
        if (after_key[e] != -1) continue;
        const char *want = section_of(entries[e].key);
        if (o.n && o.buf[o.n - 1] != '\n') puts_(&o, eol);
        if (want) {
            if (o.n) puts_(&o, eol);
            puts_(&o, "[");
            puts_(&o, want);
            puts_(&o, "]");
            puts_(&o, eol);
        }
        put_entry(&o, &entries[e], eol);
        // the following keys of the same new section go right after this one
        for (int f = e + 1; f < n && want; f++)
            if (after_key[f] == -1 && section_of(entries[f].key) && !strcmp(section_of(entries[f].key), want)) {
                put_entry(&o, &entries[f], eol);
                after_key[f] = -3;
            }
    }
    int ok = plat_file_write_atomic(path, o.buf ? o.buf : "", o.n);
    if (ok)
        for (int e = 0; e < n; e++) entries[e].dirty = entries[e].removed = 0;
    else
        rt_log("cfg: cannot write %s", path);
    __atomic_store_n(&save_ok, ok ? 1 : 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    free(o.buf);
    free(drop);
    free(after_key);
    free(replace);
    free(lines);
    free(data);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&set_lock);
    return ok;
}

static char ini_path[1024];

static int find_ini(void) {
    if (ini_path[0]) return 1;
    char path[1024];
    if (!plat_exe_path(path, sizeof path)) return 0;
    char *cut = plat_last_sep(path);
    if (!cut) cut = strrchr(path, '/');
    if (!cut || cut + 12 >= path + sizeof path) return 0;
    strcpy(cut + 1, "mkw.ini");
    if (plat_file_exists(path)) {
        snprintf(ini_path, sizeof ini_path, "%s", path);
        return 1;
    }
    strcpy(cut + 1, "mkw.ini");
    if (plat_file_exists(path)) {
        snprintf(ini_path, sizeof ini_path, "%s", path);
        return 1;
    }
    strcpy(cut + 1, "mkw.ini");
    snprintf(ini_path, sizeof ini_path, "%s", path);
    return 1;
}

int cfg_save(void) {
    if (find_ini()) return cfg_save_to(ini_path);
    __atomic_store_n(&save_ok, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    return 0;
}

static void load_ini(void) {
    if (!find_ini()) return;
    if (!cfg_load(ini_path)) {
        rt_log("cfg: no settings file at %s", ini_path);
        return;
    }
    rt_log("cfg: read %s: %d keys", ini_path, n_entries);
    for (int i = 0; i < n_entries; i++) {
        char var[128];
        snprintf(var, sizeof var, PREFIX "%s", entries[i].key);
        if (env_of(var)) rt_log("cfg: %s (or its MKW_ name) is set in the environment and overrides mkw.ini", var);
    }
}

void cfg_init(void) {
    load_ini();
    if (profile_of())
        rt_log("cfg: device profile Steam Deck: defaults for the keys mkw.ini does not set (MKW_DEVICE_PROFILE=desktop "
               "turns it off)");
}
```
