```c
// ---- --probe-fs
// Every check calls the overrides the way guest code does: by synthetic address through rt_call, with AAPCS64
// arguments in a Cpu, on this (probe) thread. Prints counts only, never RomFS paths.
static const char *const probe_symbols[] = {
    S_OPEN_FILE, S_FILE_SIZE, S_CLOSE_FILE, S_ENTRY_TYPE, S_READ_FILE, S_READ_OPTIONS, S_READ_EXACT, S_WRITE_FILE,
    S_SET_FILE_SIZE, S_FLUSH_FILE, S_CREATE_FILE, S_DELETE_FILE, S_RENAME_FILE, S_CREATE_DIRECTORY, S_DELETE_RECURSIVE,
    S_OPEN_DIRECTORY, S_READ_DIRECTORY, S_CLOSE_DIRECTORY, S_MOUNT_SAVE, S_MOUNT_SAVE_RO, S_SAVE_EXISTS, S_MOUNT_TEMP,
    S_UNMOUNT, S_COMMIT, S_CREATE_CACHE, S_DELETE_CACHE, S_MOUNT_CACHE, S_OPEN_CACHE_LIST, S_READ_CACHE_LIST,
    S_CLOSE_CACHE_LIST, S_SET_PRIORITY, S_MOUNT_ROM, S_QUERY_CACHE, S_INITIALIZE, S_IS_MOUNTED};
#define NPROBE ((int)(sizeof probe_symbols / sizeof *probe_symbols))
#define SAMPLES 64
#define HEAD_BYTES (8u << 20)      // a sampled file is compared whole up to this size, else head and tail
#define TAIL_BYTES (64u << 10)

static uint64_t probe_addr[NPROBE];
static Cpu *pcpu;
static int failures, checks;
#define CHECK(cond, ...) \
    do { checks++; if (!(cond)) { failures++; printf("  FAIL: " __VA_ARGS__); putchar('\n'); } } while (0)

static uint64_t U(const void *p) { return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p; }

// The override registered for sym, called through its synthetic address with up to 6 arguments. Returns x0.
static uint64_t fs_call(const char *sym, const uint64_t a[6]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < NPROBE; i++)
        if (!strcmp(probe_symbols[i], sym)) {
            for (int r = 0; r < 19; r++) pcpu->x[r] = 0xdead0000 + r;   // caller-saved garbage
            return rt_call(pcpu, probe_addr[i], 6, a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5]);
        }
    rt_fatal("probe-fs: %s is not a probed symbol", sym);
}
#define CALL(sym, ...) fs_call(sym, (const uint64_t[6]){__VA_ARGS__})
#define RES(sym, ...) ((uint32_t)CALL(sym, __VA_ARGS__))

static int64_t independent_read(PlatFile *f, uint8_t *buf, uint64_t n, uint64_t off) {
    uint64_t done = 0;
    while (done < n) {
        int64_t r = host_read_at(f, buf + done, (uint32_t)(n - done), off + done);
        if (r <= 0) return -1;
        done += (uint64_t)r;
    }
    return (int64_t)done;
}

// Read [pos, pos+n) of the open RomFS handle h through one of the three ReadFile overloads, and compare it with an
// independent read of romfs.bin at the index offset.
static int compare_range(PlatFile *image, uint64_t h, uint64_t offset, uint64_t pos, uint64_t n, int variant,
                         uint8_t *a, uint8_t *b) {
    uint64_t got = ~0ull;
    uint32_t r;
    int32_t option = 0;
    if (variant == 0) r = RES(S_READ_FILE, U(&got), h, pos, U(a), n);
    else if (variant == 1) r = RES(S_READ_OPTIONS, U(&got), h, pos, U(a), n, U(&option));
    else r = RES(S_READ_EXACT, h, pos, U(a), n), got = r ? ~0ull : n;
    if (r || got != n) return 0;
    if (independent_read(image, b, n, offset + pos) != (int64_t)n) return 0;
    return !memcmp(a, b, n);
}

static void probe_paths(void) {
    static const struct { const char *path, *want; } cases[] = {
        {"rom:/a/b.bin", "a/b.bin"}, {"rom://a/b.bin", "a/b.bin"}, {"rom:///a/b.bin", "a/b.bin"},
        {"rom:/a", "a"},             {"rom:/../main", NULL},       {"rom://../a", NULL},
        {"rom:/a/../b", NULL},       {"rom:/a/./b", NULL},         {"rom:/a//b", NULL},
        {"rom:/a\\b", NULL},         {"rom:/", NULL},              {"rom://", NULL},
        {"rom:a", NULL},             {"ro:/a", NULL},              {"romx:/a", NULL},
        {"rom:/.", NULL},            {"rom:/..", NULL},            {"ROM:/a", NULL},
    };
    int bad = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof cases / sizeof *cases; i++) {
        const char *got = romfs_path_relative("rom", cases[i].path);
        if (cases[i].want ? !got || strcmp(got, cases[i].want) : got != NULL) {
            bad++;
            printf("  FAIL: romfs_path_relative(\"rom\", \"%s\") = %s%s%s\n", cases[i].path, got ? "\"" : "",
                   got ? got : "NULL", got ? "\"" : "");
        }
    }
    checks++;
    failures += bad > 0;
    CHECK(!romfs_path_relative(NULL, "rom:/a") && !romfs_path_relative("", ":/a") && !romfs_path_relative("rom", NULL),
          "romfs_path_relative accepts an empty mount or path");
    printf("paths: %u romfs_path.h normalisation cases: %s\n", (unsigned)(sizeof cases / sizeof *cases),
           bad ? "FAIL" : "ok");
}

static uint64_t probe_romfs(void) {
    uint64_t count = romfs_file_count(), cache = ~0ull;
    CHECK(!CALL(S_IS_MOUNTED, U("rom")) && !CALL(S_IS_MOUNTED, 0) &&
          !CALL(S_IS_MOUNTED, U("rom:")), "IsMounted rejects absent/invalid names");
    CHECK(RES(S_QUERY_CACHE, U(&cache)) == 0 && cache == 0, "QueryMountRomCacheSize");
    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_ROM, U("rom"), 0, 0) == 0, "MountRom(\"rom\")");
    CHECK(CALL(S_IS_MOUNTED, U("rom")) == 1 && !CALL(S_IS_MOUNTED, U("romx")), "IsMounted RomFS exact name");
    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_ROM, U("rom"), 0, 0) == 0, "MountRom(\"rom\") again");
    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_ROM, U("../x"), 0, 0) == FS_R_INVALID, "MountRom with a bad name");
    probe_paths();

    PlatFile *image = plat_file_open(romfs_image_path());
    if (!image) rt_fatal("probe-fs: cannot open the RomFS image");
    uint8_t *a = malloc(HEAD_BYTES), *b = malloc(HEAD_BYTES);
    need(a && b, "probe buffers");
    uint64_t step = count / SAMPLES, bytes = 0, sampled = 0, deep = 0, high = 0, largest = 0, lsize = 0;
    char path[4200], sample[4200] = "";
    for (uint64_t i = 0, size; i < count; i++)
        if (romfs_entry(i, NULL, &size) && size > lsize) largest = i, lsize = size;
    for (uint64_t k = 0; k <= SAMPLES && step; k++) {   // k == SAMPLES: the largest file, beyond the 64
        uint64_t i = k < SAMPLES ? k * step : largest, off, size, h = 0;
        int64_t fsize = -1;
        int type = -1;
        const char *name = romfs_entry(i, &off, &size);
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "rom:/%s", name);
        if (!*sample && strchr(name, '/') && size >= 256) snprintf(sample, sizeof sample, "%s", name);
        int ok = RES(S_ENTRY_TYPE, U(&type), U(path)) == 0 && type == FS_ENTRY_FILE;
        ok = ok && RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U(path), FS_OPEN_READ) == 0 && romfs_handle(h);
        ok = ok && RES(S_FILE_SIZE, U(&fsize), h) == 0 && (uint64_t)fsize == size;
        uint64_t head = size < HEAD_BYTES ? size : HEAD_BYTES;
        ok = ok && compare_range(image, h, off, 0, head, (int)(k % 3), a, b);
        bytes += head;
        if (size > HEAD_BYTES) {
            uint64_t tail = size - TAIL_BYTES;
            ok = ok && compare_range(image, h, off, tail, TAIL_BYTES, (int)((k + 1) % 3), a, b);
            bytes += TAIL_BYTES;
            deep += k < SAMPLES;
        }
        high += k < SAMPLES && off >= (1ull << 32);
        uint64_t got = ~0ull;
        ok = ok && RES(S_READ_FILE, U(&got), h, size, U(a), 1) == 0 && got == 0;          // at EOF: 0 bytes
        ok = ok && RES(S_READ_FILE, U(&got), h, size + 1, U(a), 1) == FS_R_INVALID;      // past EOF
        if (h) CALL(S_CLOSE_FILE, h);
        CHECK(ok, "sampled RomFS file %llu (index row %llu)", (unsigned long long)k, (unsigned long long)i);
        sampled += ok && k < SAMPLES;
    }
    printf("romfs: %llu of %d sampled files equal romfs.bin at their index offset (%llu at offsets past 4 GiB, %llu "
           "over 8 MiB compared by head and tail, %.1f MiB compared), EOF reads ok\n", (unsigned long long)sampled,
           SAMPLES, (unsigned long long)high, (unsigned long long)deep, bytes / 1048576.0);
    printf("romfs: largest file (%.1f MiB): head and tail equal romfs.bin\n", lsize / 1048576.0);

    // The same file under "rom:/", "rom://" and "rom:///"; its folder is a directory; traversal and writes refused.
    uint64_t h = 0, off, size, got = 0;
    int type = -1;
    need(*sample, "no sampled file in a folder");
    uint64_t si = 0;
    while (strcmp(romfs_entry(si, &off, &size), sample)) si++;
    int same = 1;
    for (int slashes = 1; slashes <= 3; slashes++) {
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "rom:%.*s%s", slashes, "///", sample);
        same &= RES(S_ENTRY_TYPE, U(&type), U(path)) == 0 && type == FS_ENTRY_FILE;
        if (RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U(path), FS_OPEN_READ)) {
            same = 0;
            continue;
        }
        same &= RES(S_READ_FILE, U(&got), h, 0, U(a), 256) == 0 && got == 256;
        same &= independent_read(image, b, 256, off) == 256 && !memcmp(a, b, 256);
        CALL(S_CLOSE_FILE, h);
    }
    CHECK(same, "rom:/, rom:// and rom:/// do not open the same file");
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "rom:/%.*s", (int)(strrchr(sample, '/') - sample), sample);
    CHECK(RES(S_ENTRY_TYPE, U(&type), U(path)) == 0 && type == FS_ENTRY_DIRECTORY, "a sampled file's folder");
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "rom://../%s", sample);
    CHECK(RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U(path), FS_OPEN_READ) == FS_R_PATH_NOT_FOUND, "rom://../<file> opens");
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "rom:/%s.absent", sample);
    CHECK(RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U(path), FS_OPEN_READ) == FS_R_PATH_NOT_FOUND, "an absent file opens");
    uint32_t traversal = RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U("rom:/../main"), FS_OPEN_READ);
    uint32_t write_open = RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U("rom:/absent"), FS_OPEN_WRITE);
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "rom:/%s", sample);
    uint32_t write_existing = RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U(path), FS_OPEN_READ | FS_OPEN_WRITE);
    printf("romfs: rom:/, rom://, rom:/// same file: %s; rom:/../main -> %#x; write open -> %#x, %#x\n",
           same ? "ok" : "FAIL", traversal, write_open, write_existing);
    CHECK(traversal == FS_R_PATH_NOT_FOUND, "rom:/../main -> %#x, expected 0x202", traversal);
    CHECK(write_open == FS_R_UNSUPPORTED_OPEN && write_existing == FS_R_UNSUPPORTED_OPEN,
          "write open -> %#x/%#x, expected 0x6402", write_open, write_existing);

    // Overlays (TOTK_ROMFS_PATCHES, TOTK_ROMFS_MODS): served in place of the original, added files and their folders
    // exist, bytes equal the overlay file.
    size_t nov = romfs_overlay_count(), ovok = 0;
    for (size_t k = 0; k < nov; k++) {
        const char *file;
        uint64_t osize;
        int is_added;
        const char *name = romfs_overlay(k, &file, &osize, &is_added);
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "rom:/%s", name);
        int ok = RES(S_ENTRY_TYPE, U(&type), U(path)) == 0 && type == FS_ENTRY_FILE;
        char *slash = strrchr(path, '/');
        if (is_added && slash > path + 5) {
            *slash = 0;
            ok = ok && RES(S_ENTRY_TYPE, U(&type), U(path)) == 0 && type == FS_ENTRY_DIRECTORY;
            *slash = '/';
        }
        int64_t fsize = -1;
        uint64_t n = osize < HEAD_BYTES ? osize : HEAD_BYTES;
        ok = ok && RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U(path), FS_OPEN_READ) == 0;
        if (ok) {
            ok = RES(S_FILE_SIZE, U(&fsize), h) == 0 && (uint64_t)fsize == osize &&
                 RES(S_READ_FILE, U(&got), h, 0, U(a), n) == 0 && got == n;
            CALL(S_CLOSE_FILE, h);
        }
        PlatFile *of = plat_file_open(file);
        ok = ok && of && independent_read(of, b, n, 0) == (int64_t)n && !memcmp(a, b, n);
        if (of) plat_file_close(of);
        CHECK(ok, "overlay %zu (%s)", k, is_added ? "added" : "replacement");
        ovok += ok;
    }
    if (nov) printf("romfs: %zu of %zu overlay files served from their overlay\n", ovok, nov);
    plat_file_close(image);
    free(a);
    free(b);
    return count;
}

// ---- save transactions: restarts, uncommitted and committed changes, a crash at every step of a Commit
// The process dies here: the save mount goes without Unmount, and the next start runs save_recover and mounts again.
static void probe_restart(const uint64_t *uid) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < NMOUNTS; i++)
        if (mounts[i].kind == M_SAVE) mounts[i].kind = M_FREE;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    save_mounts = tx_crash_at = tx_dead = 0;
    plat_xchg32(&save_dirty, 0);
    save_recover();
    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_SAVE, U("save"), U(uid)) == 0, "MountSaveData after a restart");
}

// Commit through the override, then wait for its background thread, as the checks read the disk next.
static uint32_t tx_commit(void) {
    uint32_t r = RES(S_COMMIT, U("save"));
    fs_save_flush();
    return r;
}

#define TX_SIZE 4096
static uint8_t tx_buf[TX_SIZE];

// Fill a save file, created when absent, with byte g through the overrides.
static int tx_write(const char *path, int g) {
    uint64_t h = 0;
    int32_t no_flush = 0;
    memset(tx_buf, g, sizeof tx_buf);
    uint32_t r = RES(S_CREATE_FILE, U(path), TX_SIZE);
    if ((r && r != FS_R_ALREADY_EXISTS) || RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U(path), FS_OPEN_WRITE)) return 0;
    int ok = RES(S_WRITE_FILE, h, 0, U(tx_buf), TX_SIZE, U(&no_flush)) == 0;
    CALL(S_CLOSE_FILE, h);
    return ok;
}

static int tx_byte(int ok) {
    for (int i = 1; ok && i < TX_SIZE; i++) ok = tx_buf[i] == tx_buf[0];
    return ok ? tx_buf[0] : -2;
}

// The byte a save file is filled with, read through the overrides; -1 absent, -2 short or mixed.
static int tx_read(const char *path) {
    uint64_t h = 0, got = 0;
    if (RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U(path), FS_OPEN_READ)) return -1;
    int ok = RES(S_READ_FILE, U(&got), h, 0, U(tx_buf), TX_SIZE) == 0 && got == TX_SIZE;
    CALL(S_CLOSE_FILE, h);
    return tx_byte(ok);
}

// The same, read from the committed save on disk.
static int tx_read_committed(const char *name) {
    char *p = join(save_root, name);
    PlatFile *f = plat_file_open(p);
    free(p);
    if (!f) return -1;
    int ok = independent_read(f, tx_buf, TX_SIZE, 0) == TX_SIZE;
    plat_file_close(f);
    return tx_byte(ok);
}

// Hard links of a file of the committed save on disk; 0 when absent.
static int tx_links_committed(const char *name) {
    char *p = join(save_root, name);
    int links = plat_fs_links(p);
    free(p);
    return links;
}

static int count_dirs(const char *dir) {
    Listing l;
    list_dir(dir, &l);
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l.n; i++) n += l.e[i].kind == PLAT_FS_DIR && l.e[i].name[0] != '.';
    listing_free(l.e, l.n);
    return n;
}

static void probe_save_tx(const uint64_t *uid) {
    const char *a = "save:/tx_a.sav", *b = "save:/tx_b.sav";
    uint64_t h = 0;
    CHECK(tx_write(a, 1) && tx_write(b, 1) && tx_commit() == 0 && tx_read_committed("tx_a.sav") == 1,
          "Commit of generation 1");

    // uncommitted changes: the game reads them; the committed save and the next start do not see them
    CHECK(tx_write(a, 2) && tx_write("save:/tx_c.sav", 2), "uncommitted writes");
    CHECK(tx_read(a) == 2 && tx_read("save:/tx_c.sav") == 2, "reads do not see the game's uncommitted writes");
    CHECK(tx_read_committed("tx_a.sav") == 1 && tx_read_committed("tx_c.sav") == -1,
          "an uncommitted write reached the committed save");
    probe_restart(uid);
    CHECK(tx_read(a) == 1 && tx_read("save:/tx_c.sav") == -1, "an uncommitted write survived a restart");

    // committed changes survive a restart; an Unmount without Commit drops changes
    CHECK(tx_write(a, 3) && tx_write(b, 3) && tx_commit() == 0, "Commit of generation 3");
    probe_restart(uid);
    CHECK(tx_read(a) == 3 && tx_read(b) == 3, "a commit lost in a restart");
    CHECK(tx_write(a, 4), "write before Unmount");
    CALL(S_UNMOUNT, U("save"));
    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_SAVE, U("save"), U(uid)) == 0 && tx_read(a) == 3, "Unmount without Commit kept the change");

    // a crash at step k of a Commit, k = 1, 2, ... until a Commit completes: the next start sees all of the old
    // generation or all of the new one
    int committed = 3, gen = 4, steps = 0, olds = 0, news = 0, mixed = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k < 64; k++) {
        int next = ++gen, ok = tx_write(a, next) && tx_write(b, next);
        tx_crash_at = k;
        uint32_t r = tx_commit();
        int died = tx_dead;
        tx_crash_at = 0;
        if (!died) {
            steps = k - 1;
            CHECK(ok && r == 0 && tx_read_committed("tx_a.sav") == next && tx_read_committed("tx_b.sav") == next,
                  "Commit after the crash points");
            committed = next;
            break;
        }
        probe_restart(uid);
        int va = tx_read(a), vb = tx_read(b);
        if (va == committed && vb == committed) olds++;
        else if (va == next && vb == next) news++, committed = next;
        else mixed++;
        CHECK(ok && (va == vb) && (va == committed), "crash at commit step %d: tx_a %d, tx_b %d (old %d, new %d)", k,
              va, vb, committed, next);
        CHECK(!exists(new_root) && !exists(old_root) && !*ready_root, "crash at commit step %d: staging left after "
              "recovery", k);
    }
    CHECK(steps >= 4 && olds && news && !mixed, "crash points: %d (%d old, %d new, %d mixed)", steps, olds, news,
          mixed);
    int backups = count_dirs(backup_root);
    CHECK(backups == SAVE_BACKUPS, "save-backup holds %d saves", backups);

    // a Commit writes the changed file and links the unchanged one to the committed save it replaces
    int kept = committed;
    CHECK(tx_write(a, ++gen) && tx_commit() == 0 && tx_read_committed("tx_a.sav") == gen &&
          tx_read_committed("tx_b.sav") == kept && tx_links_committed("tx_b.sav") >= 2 &&
          tx_links_committed("tx_a.sav") == 1, "Commit of one changed file: tx_a %d links, tx_b %d links",
          tx_links_committed("tx_a.sav"), tx_links_committed("tx_b.sav"));
    committed = gen;

    // a Commit that changed no byte (the game rewrites its files at start) makes no new save and no backup
    static char backups_before[64][48], backups_after[64][48];
    int nbefore = backup_names(backups_before);
    CHECK(tx_write(a, committed) && tx_commit() == 0 && tx_read_committed("tx_a.sav") == committed &&
          backup_names(backups_after) == nbefore && !memcmp(backups_before, backups_after, sizeof backups_before),
          "a Commit of unchanged bytes made a backup");

    // the background commit: a write right after Commit waits for it and stays out of it; an Unmount right after
    // Commit waits for it and keeps it
    int queued = ++gen;
    CHECK(tx_write(a, queued) && RES(S_COMMIT, U("save")) == 0 && tx_write(a, ++gen) && tx_read(a) == gen &&
          tx_read_committed("tx_a.sav") == queued, "a write right after Commit: committed tx_a %d, expected %d",
          tx_read_committed("tx_a.sav"), queued);
    CHECK(RES(S_COMMIT, U("save")) == 0, "Commit before Unmount");
    CALL(S_UNMOUNT, U("save"));
    CHECK(tx_read_committed("tx_a.sav") == gen && RES(S_MOUNT_SAVE, U("save"), U(uid)) == 0 && tx_read(a) == gen,
          "an Unmount right after Commit lost it");
    committed = gen;

    // a file of the committed save held open by another program (a virus scanner, Explorer's preview, a sync tool):
    // Windows refuses to rename a directory with an open file under it, so the committed save cannot be swapped out.
    // The game and a restart still see every Commit, and the first start after the file is closed swaps them in.
    char *held_path = join(save_root, "tx_b.sav");
    PlatFile *held = plat_fs_open(held_path, 0, NULL);
    free(held_path);
    int pending = ++gen;
    CHECK(held && tx_write(a, pending) && tx_commit() == 0, "Commit with a committed file held open");
    probe_restart(uid);
    CHECK(tx_read(a) == pending, "a Commit made while a committed file was held open, after a restart: tx_a %d, "
          "expected %d", tx_read(a), pending);
    pending = ++gen;
    CHECK(tx_write(a, pending) && tx_commit() == 0 && tx_read(a) == pending, "a second Commit while held open");
    if (held) plat_file_close(held);
    probe_restart(uid);
    CHECK(tx_read(a) == pending && tx_read_committed("tx_a.sav") == pending && tx_read_committed("tx_b.sav") == kept,
          "the held-open Commits after the file was closed and a restart: tx_a %d, on disk %d, expected %d",
          tx_read(a), tx_read_committed("tx_a.sav"), pending);
    committed = pending;

    // the read-only mount shows the committed save and refuses changes
    CHECK(tx_write(a, 99) && RES(S_MOUNT_SAVE_RO, U("ro"), TOTK_APPLICATION_ID, U(uid)) == 0 &&
          tx_read("ro:/tx_a.sav") == committed && RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U("ro:/tx_a.sav"), FS_OPEN_WRITE) ==
          FS_R_UNSUPPORTED_OPEN && RES(S_CREATE_FILE, U("ro:/x"), 0) == FS_R_UNSUPPORTED_OPEN &&
          RES(S_RENAME_FILE, U("save:/tx_a.sav"), U("ro:/y")) == FS_R_INVALID_PATH, "MountSaveDataReadOnly");
    CALL(S_UNMOUNT, U("ro"));
    CHECK(RES(S_DELETE_FILE, U(a)) == 0 && RES(S_DELETE_FILE, U(b)) == 0 && tx_commit() == 0 &&
          tx_read_committed("tx_a.sav") == -1, "Commit of deletions");
    printf("save tx: uncommitted writes visible to the game and dropped by a restart and by Unmount, commits kept; a "
           "crash at each of %d commit steps recovers to the old save %d times, the new one %d times, mixed %d "
           "times; %d backups\n", steps, olds, news, mixed, backups);
}

static void probe_storage(void) {
    char tmp[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 3], dir[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 3 + 64];
    need(plat_temp_dir(tmp, sizeof tmp), "temporary directory");
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/totk-probe-fs-%u", tmp, plat_process_id());
    remove_tree(dir);
    fs_host_set_profile(dir);
    uint64_t uid[2], other[2], h = 0, h2 = 0, d = 0, l = 0;
    account_uid(uid);
    other[0] = uid[0] ^ 1, other[1] = uid[1];
    static uint8_t data[65536], back[65536];
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof data; i++) data[i] = (uint8_t)(i * 7 + (i >> 8));
    int32_t no_flush = 0, flush = 1;
    int64_t size = -1, count = -1;
    uint64_t got = 0;
    int type = -1;

    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_SAVE, U("save"), U(other)) == FS_R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND, "MountSaveData for another user");
    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_SAVE, U("save"), U(uid)) == 0, "MountSaveData");
    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_SAVE, U("save"), U(uid)) == FS_R_ALREADY_EXISTS, "MountSaveData twice");
    CHECK((CALL(S_SAVE_EXISTS, TOTK_APPLICATION_ID, U(uid)) & 0xff) == 1 &&
          (CALL(S_SAVE_EXISTS, TOTK_APPLICATION_ID + 0x1000, U(uid)) & 0xff) == 0, "IsSaveDataExisting");
    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_SAVE_RO, U("other"), TOTK_APPLICATION_ID + 0x1000, U(uid)) == FS_R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND,
          "MountSaveDataReadOnly of another title");
    CHECK(!fs_save_busy(), "idle at start");

    // create, write, commit
    CHECK(RES(S_CREATE_FILE, U("save:/probe.sav"), 0) == 0 && fs_save_busy(), "CreateFile");
    CHECK(RES(S_CREATE_FILE, U("save:/probe.sav"), 0) == FS_R_ALREADY_EXISTS, "CreateFile twice");
    CHECK(RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U("save:/probe.sav"), FS_OPEN_WRITE) == 0, "OpenFile for writing");
    CHECK(RES(S_WRITE_FILE, h, 0, U(data), 16, U(&no_flush)) == FS_R_APPEND_REQUIRED, "a growing write without append");
    CALL(S_CLOSE_FILE, h);
    CHECK(RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U("save:/probe.sav"), FS_OPEN_WRITE | FS_OPEN_APPEND) == 0, "OpenFile for append");
    CHECK(RES(S_WRITE_FILE, h, 0, U(data), sizeof data / 2, U(&no_flush)) == 0 &&
          RES(S_WRITE_FILE, h, sizeof data / 2, U(data + sizeof data / 2), sizeof data / 2, U(&flush)) == 0,
          "WriteFile");
    CHECK(RES(S_FILE_SIZE, U(&size), h) == 0 && size == sizeof data, "GetFileSize after writing");
    CHECK(RES(S_READ_FILE, U(&got), h, 0, U(back), 16) == FS_R_OPEN_MODE, "ReadFile on a write-only handle");
    CHECK(RES(S_FLUSH_FILE, h) == 0, "FlushFile");
    CHECK(fs_save_busy(), "a save file open for writing does not count as a save in progress");
    CALL(S_CLOSE_FILE, h);
    CHECK(fs_save_busy(), "closed but uncommitted save data does not count as a save in progress");
    CHECK(tx_commit() == 0 && !fs_save_busy(), "Commit");
    CHECK(RES(S_COMMIT, U("nomount")) == FS_R_PATH_NOT_FOUND, "Commit of an unknown mount");

    // paths
    CHECK(RES(S_CREATE_FILE, U("save:/../x"), 0) == FS_R_INVALID_PATH, "save:/../x");
    CHECK(RES(S_CREATE_FILE, U("save:/a\\b"), 0) == FS_R_INVALID_PATH, "save:/a\\b");
    CHECK(RES(S_CREATE_FILE, U("save:/a:b"), 0) == FS_R_INVALID_PATH, "save:/a:b");
    CHECK(RES(S_CREATE_FILE, U("save:/a."), 0) == FS_R_INVALID_PATH, "save:/a.");
    CHECK(RES(S_CREATE_FILE, U("nomount:/x"), 0) == FS_R_PATH_NOT_FOUND, "a path on no mount");

    // directories
    CHECK(RES(S_CREATE_DIRECTORY, U("save:/dir")) == 0 && RES(S_CREATE_FILE, U("save:/dir/inner.bin"), 8) == 0,
          "CreateDirectory");
    CHECK(RES(S_ENTRY_TYPE, U(&type), U("save:/dir")) == 0 && type == FS_ENTRY_DIRECTORY, "GetEntryType (directory)");
    static DirectoryEntry ents[8];
    CHECK(RES(S_OPEN_DIRECTORY, U(&d), U("save:/"), 3) == 0, "OpenDirectory");
    CHECK(RES(S_READ_DIRECTORY, U(&count), U(ents), d, 8) == 0 && count == 2, "ReadDirectory count %lld",
          (long long)count);
    int seen = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < count && i < 8; i++) {
        if (!strcmp(ents[i].name, "dir") && ents[i].type == FS_ENTRY_DIRECTORY) seen |= 1;
        if (!strcmp(ents[i].name, "probe.sav") && ents[i].type == FS_ENTRY_FILE && ents[i].size == sizeof data)
            seen |= 2;
    }
    CHECK(seen == 3, "ReadDirectory entries");
    CHECK(RES(S_READ_DIRECTORY, U(&count), U(ents), d, 8) == 0 && count == 0, "ReadDirectory at the end");
    CALL(S_CLOSE_DIRECTORY, d);
    CHECK(RES(S_OPEN_DIRECTORY, U(&d), U("save:/"), 2) == 0 && RES(S_READ_DIRECTORY, U(&count), U(ents), d, 8) == 0 &&
          count == 1 && ents[0].type == FS_ENTRY_FILE, "ReadDirectory, files only");
    CALL(S_CLOSE_DIRECTORY, d);

    CHECK(tx_commit() == 0, "Commit of the directories");

    // reopen after unmount: the bytes come back through the overrides and are on disk
    CALL(S_UNMOUNT, U("save"));
    CHECK(RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U("save:/probe.sav"), FS_OPEN_READ) == FS_R_PATH_NOT_FOUND, "open after Unmount");
    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_SAVE, U("save"), U(uid)) == 0, "MountSaveData again");
    CHECK(RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U("save:/probe.sav"), FS_OPEN_READ) == 0, "reopen");
    memset(back, 0, sizeof back);
    CHECK(RES(S_FILE_SIZE, U(&size), h) == 0 && size == sizeof data &&
          RES(S_READ_EXACT, h, 0, U(back), sizeof back) == 0 && !memcmp(back, data, sizeof data), "reopened bytes");
    CHECK(RES(S_READ_FILE, U(&got), h, sizeof data - 10, U(back), 100) == 0 && got == 10, "short read at the end");
    CHECK(RES(S_WRITE_FILE, h, 0, U(data), 1, U(&no_flush)) == FS_R_OPEN_MODE, "WriteFile on a read-only handle");
    CALL(S_CLOSE_FILE, h);
    char host[1200];
    snprintf(host, sizeof host, "%s/save/%016llx%016llx/probe.sav", dir, (unsigned long long)uid[1],
             (unsigned long long)uid[0]);
    PlatFile *f = plat_file_open(host);
    memset(back, 0, sizeof back);
    CHECK(f && independent_read(f, back, sizeof back, 0) == sizeof back && !memcmp(back, data, sizeof data),
          "the save file on disk");
    if (f) plat_file_close(f);

    // resize, rename, delete
    CHECK(RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h), U("save:/probe.sav"), FS_OPEN_READ | FS_OPEN_WRITE) == 0 &&
          RES(S_SET_FILE_SIZE, h, 100) == 0 && RES(S_FILE_SIZE, U(&size), h) == 0 && size == 100, "SetFileSize");
    CHECK(RES(S_OPEN_FILE, U(&h2), U("save:/probe.sav"), FS_OPEN_READ) == 0, "a second handle on one file");
    CALL(S_CLOSE_FILE, h2);
    CALL(S_CLOSE_FILE, h);
    CHECK(RES(S_RENAME_FILE, U("save:/probe.sav"), U("save:/dir/inner.bin")) == FS_R_ALREADY_EXISTS,
          "RenameFile over an existing file");
    CHECK(RES(S_RENAME_FILE, U("save:/probe.sav"), U("save:/renamed.sav")) == 0 &&
          RES(S_ENTRY_TYPE, U(&type), U("save:/renamed.sav")) == 0 && type == FS_ENTRY_FILE &&
          RES(S_ENTRY_TYPE, U(&type), U("save:/probe.sav")) == FS_R_PATH_NOT_FOUND, "RenameFile");
    CHECK(RES(S_DELETE_FILE, U("save:/renamed.sav")) == 0 &&
          RES(S_DELETE_FILE, U("save:/renamed.sav")) == FS_R_PATH_NOT_FOUND, "DeleteFile");
    CHECK(RES(S_DELETE_RECURSIVE, U("save:/dir")) == 0 &&
          RES(S_ENTRY_TYPE, U(&type), U("save:/dir")) == FS_R_PATH_NOT_FOUND, "DeleteDirectoryRecursively");
    CHECK(tx_commit() == 0 && !fs_save_busy(), "Commit after the changes");
    probe_save_tx(uid);

    // temporary and cache storage
    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_TEMP, U("temp")) == 0 && RES(S_CREATE_FILE, U("temp:/t.bin"), 4) == 0 && !fs_save_busy(),
          "temporary storage");
    CHECK(RES(S_CREATE_CACHE, 3, 1 << 20, 1 << 20) == 0 && RES(S_CREATE_CACHE, 3, 1 << 20, 1 << 20) ==
          FS_R_ALREADY_EXISTS, "CreateCacheStorage");
    CHECK(RES(S_MOUNT_CACHE, U("cache"), 3) == 0 && RES(S_MOUNT_CACHE, U("cache9"), 9) == FS_R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND,
          "MountCacheStorage");
    CacheStorageInfo infos[4];
    int ncache = -1;
    CHECK(RES(S_OPEN_CACHE_LIST, U(&l)) == 0 && RES(S_READ_CACHE_LIST, U(&ncache), U(infos), l, 4) == 0 &&
          ncache == 1 && infos[0].index == 3, "cache storage list");
    CALL(S_CLOSE_CACHE_LIST, l);
    CALL(S_SET_PRIORITY, 1);
    CALL(S_UNMOUNT, U("cache"));
    CHECK(CALL(S_IS_MOUNTED, U("temp")) == 1 && !CALL(S_IS_MOUNTED, U("cache")), "IsMounted host mounts");
    CALL(S_UNMOUNT, U("temp"));
    CHECK(!CALL(S_IS_MOUNTED, U("temp")), "IsMounted after unmount");
    CHECK(RES(S_DELETE_CACHE, 3) == 0, "DeleteCacheStorage");
    CALL(S_UNMOUNT, U("save"));

    int removed = !remove_tree(dir) && !exists(dir);
    CHECK(removed, "the temporary profile was not deleted");
    printf("storage: save create/write/commit/reopen, directories, rename/delete, temporary and cache storage in a "
           "temporary profile: %s; profile deleted: %s\n", failures ? "see FAIL lines" : "ok", removed ? "yes" : "no");
}

int probe_fs(void) {
    fs_init();
    for (int i = 0; i < NPROBE; i++) {
        GuestFn fn = hostfn_override(probe_symbols[i]);
        if (!fn) rt_fatal("probe-fs: no HOST_OVERRIDE for %s", probe_symbols[i]);
        probe_addr[i] = hostfn_register(probe_symbols[i], fn);
    }
    printf("overrides: %d nn::fs overrides registered\n", NPROBE);
    pcpu = plat_aligned_alloc(sizeof(Cpu), 64);
    need(pcpu != NULL, "probe Cpu");
    memset(pcpu, 0, sizeof *pcpu);
    uint8_t *stack = mem_kernel_alloc(0x10000, 16);
    pcpu->sp = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)stack + 0x10000;
    pcpu->excl_addr = ~0ull;
    for (int r = 19; r < 30; r++) pcpu->x[r] = 0x1900 + r;
    CALL(S_INITIALIZE, 0);   // nn::fs::InitializeForApplication: fs_init again, idempotent
    uint64_t files = probe_romfs();
    probe_storage();
    int kept = 1;
    for (int r = 19; r < 30; r++) kept &= pcpu->x[r] == 0x1900u + r;
    CHECK(kept && pcpu->sp == (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)stack + 0x10000, "an override lost a callee-saved register");
    mem_kernel_free(stack, 0x10000);
    plat_aligned_free(pcpu);
    if (failures) {
        printf("probe-fs: FAILED (%d of %d checks)\n", failures, checks);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("probe-fs: passed (%llu files, %d sampled)\n", (unsigned long long)files, SAMPLES);
    return 0;
}
```

`runtime/gfx_abi_probe.c`:

```c
// --probe-gfx-abi: every host object of nvn_obj.h fits the storage nvn.h reserves
// for its NVN type, the layouts the game reads directly (NVNtextureView, the command buffer's inline fast-path
// fields) sit where TOTK's NVN 55 code expects them, and the GPU address window lies above every guest region.
// The same facts are static assertions in nvn_obj.h; this mode prints the sizes so a change shows its margin.
// Needs no game files.
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#include "gfx.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

static int failures, checks;
#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { checks++; if (!(cond)) { failures++; printf("  FAIL: " __VA_ARGS__); putchar('\n'); } } while (0)

typedef struct { const char *host, *nvn; size_t size, reserved; } Fit;
#define FIT(T, H) {#T, #H, sizeof(T), sizeof(H)}
static const Fit fits[] = {
    FIT(dev_builder_t, NVNdeviceBuilder),       FIT(dev_t_, NVNdevice),
    FIT(queue_builder_t, NVNqueueBuilder),      FIT(queue_t, NVNqueue),
    FIT(pool_builder_t, NVNmemoryPoolBuilder),  FIT(pool_t, NVNmemoryPool),
    FIT(dpool_t, NVNtexturePool),               FIT(dpool_t, NVNsamplerPool),
    FIT(tex_builder_t, NVNtextureBuilder),      FIT(tex_t, NVNtexture),
    FIT(view_t, NVNtextureView),
    FIT(samp_builder_t, NVNsamplerBuilder),     FIT(samp_t, NVNsampler),
    FIT(prog_t, NVNprogram),
    FIT(sync_t, NVNsync),
    FIT(ev_builder_t, NVNeventBuilder),         FIT(ev_t, NVNevent),
    FIT(win_builder_t, NVNwindowBuilder),       FIT(win_t, NVNwindow),
    FIT(cmd_t, NVNcommandBuffer),
    FIT(color_st, NVNcolorState),               FIT(chmask_st, NVNchannelMaskState),
    FIT(blend_st, NVNblendState),               FIT(ms_st, NVNmultisampleState),
    FIT(poly_st, NVNpolygonState),              FIT(ds_st, NVNdepthStencilState),
    FIT(va_st, NVNvertexAttribState),           FIT(vs_st, NVNvertexStreamState),
};

_Static_assert(sizeof(NVNtextureView) == 16, "NVNtextureView is 16 bytes in TOTK's NVN 55");
_Static_assert(offsetof(cmd_t, inline_cur) == 0x20 && offsetof(cmd_t, inline_end) == 0x28, "cmd_t inline fields");
_Static_assert(RT_GPU_VA_BASE >= RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT, "GPU address window overlaps the guest address space");

// Write watch: a committed heap page and an alias page, written once, are reported once.
static void check_write_watch(void) {
    const RtGuestLayout *g = mem_layout();
    uint64_t heap = 0, pages[8], n;
    CHECK(mem_set_heap_size(0x200000, &heap) == 0 && heap == g->heap.base, "SetHeapSize 2 MiB");
    mem_written_pages(heap, 0x200000, pages, 8);   // drop whatever the commit itself marked
    volatile uint8_t *p = (volatile uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)heap;
    p[0x5000] = 1;
    n = mem_written_pages(heap, 0x200000, pages, 8);
    CHECK(n == 1 && pages[0] == heap + 0x5000, "heap write: %llu pages reported (want 1 at %#llx)",
          (unsigned long long)n, (unsigned long long)(heap + 0x5000));
    printf("write-watch: heap page written once: %llu reported at +%#llx\n", (unsigned long long)n,
           n ? (unsigned long long)(pages[0] - heap) : 0ull);
    n = mem_written_pages(heap, 0x200000, pages, 8);
    CHECK(n == 0, "second call reported %llu pages (want 0)", (unsigned long long)n);
    printf("write-watch: second call: %llu reported\n", (unsigned long long)n);
    p[0x7000] = 2;
    p[0x9000] = 3;
    p[0xA000] = 4;
    n = mem_written_pages(heap, 0x200000, pages, 2);
    uint64_t m = mem_written_pages(heap, 0x200000, pages + 2, 6);
    printf("write-watch: three pages written, max 2: %llu then %llu\n", (unsigned long long)n, (unsigned long long)m);
    CHECK(n == 2 && m == 1, "max 2 reported %llu, then %llu (want 2, 1)", (unsigned long long)n, (unsigned long long)m);

    // Frozen region: read-only until the first write thaws it (the write lands and is reported); mem_thaw (a file
    // read) thaws it and holds it thawed; SetHeapSize below decommits it.
    mem_written_pages(heap, 0x200000, pages, 8);
    CHECK(mem_freeze(heap) == 1 && mem_frozen(heap), "freeze of an idle committed 2 MiB region");
    uint64_t end;
    CHECK(plat_mem_state(heap, heap + 1, &end) == PLAT_PROT_READ, "frozen region is not read-only");
    p[0x3000] = 7;
    CHECK(!mem_frozen(heap) && p[0x3000] == 7, "a write into a frozen region did not thaw it");
    n = mem_written_pages(heap, 0x200000, pages, 8);
    CHECK(n == 1 && pages[0] == heap + 0x3000, "write after a thaw: %llu pages reported (want 1)", (unsigned long long)n);
    CHECK(mem_freeze(heap) == 1, "refreeze after a write thaw");
    mem_thaw(heap + 0x6000, 0x1000);
    CHECK(!mem_frozen(heap) && mem_freeze(heap) == 0, "mem_thaw did not thaw and hold the region");
    p[0x6000] = 8;
    printf("write-watch: frozen region thawed by a write (reported once) and by mem_thaw (held)\n");

    uint64_t a = g->alias.base + 0x10000;
    CHECK(mem_map_physical(a, 0x4000) == 0, "MapPhysicalMemory");
    mem_written_pages(a, 0x4000, pages, 8);
    *(volatile uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(a + 0x1000) = 1;
    n = mem_written_pages(a, 0x4000, pages, 8);
    CHECK(n == 1 && pages[0] == a + 0x1000, "alias write: %llu pages reported (want 1)", (unsigned long long)n);
    CHECK(mem_written_pages(a, 0x4000, pages, 8) == 0, "alias: second call reported pages");

    // A region with reserved holes freezes its committed pages only, and a write thaws them without committing a hole.
    uint64_t ra = a & ~0x1fffffull;
    CHECK(mem_freeze(ra) == 1 && mem_frozen(ra), "freeze of a 2 MiB region with reserved holes");
    CHECK(plat_mem_state(a, a + 1, &end) == PLAT_PROT_READ, "its committed pages are not read-only");
    *(volatile uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(a + 0x2000) = 9;
    CHECK(!mem_frozen(ra) && *(volatile uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(a + 0x2000) == 9, "a write did not thaw the region with holes");
    CHECK(plat_mem_state(a, a + 0x10000, &end) == PLAT_PROT_RW && end == a + 0x4000, "the thawed pages are not read-write");
    CHECK(plat_mem_state(a + 0x4000, a + 0x4001, &end) == PLAT_MEM_RESERVED, "a hole got committed");
    printf("write-watch: region with reserved holes frozen and thawed by a write\n");
    CHECK(mem_unmap_physical(a, 0x4000) == 0, "UnmapPhysicalMemory");
    CHECK(mem_written_pages(RT_KERNEL_BASE, 0x1000, pages, 8) == UINT64_MAX, "kernel region is not write-watched");
    CHECK(mem_set_heap_size(0, &heap) == 0, "SetHeapSize 0");
    printf("write-watch: alias page written once: reported once, then not\n");
}

int probe_gfx_abi(void) {
    size_t tightest = (size_t)-1;
    const char *tight = "";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof fits / sizeof *fits; i++) {
        const Fit *f = &fits[i];
        CHECK(f->size <= f->reserved, "%s is %zu bytes, %s reserves %zu", f->host, f->size, f->nvn, f->reserved);
        if (f->reserved - f->size < tightest) tightest = f->reserved - f->size, tight = f->host;
    }
    CHECK(sizeof(NVNtextureView) == 16 && sizeof(view_t) == 16, "NVNtextureView %zu bytes, view_t %zu (want 16)",
          sizeof(NVNtextureView), sizeof(view_t));
    CHECK(offsetof(cmd_t, guest_flags) == 0x10, "cmd_t.guest_flags at %#zx (want 0x10)", offsetof(cmd_t, guest_flags));
    CHECK(offsetof(cmd_t, inline_cur) == 0x20, "cmd_t.inline_cur at %#zx (want 0x20)", offsetof(cmd_t, inline_cur));
    CHECK(offsetof(cmd_t, inline_end) == 0x28, "cmd_t.inline_end at %#zx (want 0x28)", offsetof(cmd_t, inline_end));
    CHECK(sizeof(samp_par) == 44, "samp_par is %zu bytes (want 44)", sizeof(samp_par));
    CHECK(RT_GPU_VA_BASE >= RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT && RT_GPU_VA_SIZE > 0, "GPU address window %#llx overlaps the guest space",
          RT_GPU_VA_BASE);
    check_write_watch();
    printf("gfx-abi: %d layouts fit (tightest %s, %zu bytes spare), cmd_t inline fields at +0x20/+0x28, "
           "NVNtextureView %zu bytes\n", (int)(sizeof fits / sizeof *fits), tight, tightest, sizeof(NVNtextureView));
    if (failures) {
        printf("probe-gfx-abi: FAILED (%d of %d checks)\n", failures, checks);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("probe-gfx-abi: passed\n");
    return 0;
}
```

`runtime/gfx_geometry_probe.c`:

```c
// --probe-shader-geometry: original Maxwell GS -> real translator child -> runtime reflection/cache.
// The launcher supplies an empty owned cache and the translator. No GPU, census, game data or cache deletion.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gfx.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

uint64_t gfx_shader_requests(void);
uint64_t gfx_shader_cache_hits(void);
void gfx_shader_drop_memory(void);

enum { TOPOLOGIES = 5, CONTROL_BYTES = 0x880, CODE_SKIP = 0x30, PROGRAM_BYTES = 0x30 + 0x50 + 5 * 32 };
#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { if (!(cond)) { printf("probe-shader-geometry: FAILED: " __VA_ARGS__); puts(""); return 1; } } while (0)

static void word32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t value) { memcpy(p, &value, sizeof value); }
static void word64(uint8_t *p, uint64_t value) { memcpy(p, &value, sizeof value); }

static uint64_t movi(unsigned reg, uint32_t value) {
    return 0x0100000000000000ull | ((uint64_t)value << 20) | (15ull << 12) | (7ull << 16) | reg;
}

static uint64_t ast(unsigned reg, unsigned address, unsigned count) {
    return 0xeff0000000000000ull | (255ull << 39) | ((uint64_t)(count - 1) << 47) |
           ((uint64_t)address << 20) | (7ull << 16) | (255ull << 8) | reg;
}

// Same original authoring pattern as tests/geometry_shader_fixture.py::program(store=False): write Position and
// a red color, emit/cut one point, exit. Every primitive-input topology is accepted; no input vertex is fetched.
static void original_program(uint8_t control[CONTROL_BYTES], uint8_t code[PROGRAM_BYTES]) {
    memset(control, 0, CONTROL_BYTES), memset(code, 0, PROGRAM_BYTES);
    word32(code + CODE_SKIP, 1u | (3u << 5) | (4u << 10));  // Maxwell SPH v3, ordinary GS
    word32(code + CODE_SKIP + 8, 1u << 24);                // one invocation
    word32(code + CODE_SKIP + 12, 1u << 24);               // output points
    word32(code + CODE_SKIP + 16, 1);                     // one output vertex
    uint64_t insn[13];
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; i++) insn[i] = movi(i, i == 3 || i == 4 || i == 7 ? 0x3f800000u : 0);
    insn[8] = ast(0, 0x70, 4), insn[9] = ast(3, 0x6c, 1), insn[10] = ast(4, 0x80, 4);
    insn[11] = 0xf6e0000000000000ull | (3ull << 39) | (7ull << 16) | (255ull << 8) | 255;
    insn[12] = 0xe30000000000000full | (7ull << 16);
    for (unsigned group = 0; group < 5; group++) {
        uint8_t *p = code + CODE_SKIP + 0x50 + group * 32;
        word64(p, 0x001f8000fc0007e0ull);
        for (unsigned lane = 0; lane < 3; lane++) {
            unsigned i = group * 3 + lane;
            word64(p + 8 + lane * 8, i < 13 ? insn[i] : 0);
        }
    }
    word32(control + 0x700, PROGRAM_BYTES), word32(control + 0x704, PROGRAM_BYTES);
    word32(control + 0x714, 2);                            // NVN geometry stage, distinct from GFX_STAGE_GS
}

static int cache_entry(const char *name, int kind, uint64_t size, void *context) {
    (void)name; (void)kind; (void)size;
    *(int *)context = 1;
    return 0;
}

static int shader_valid(const GfxShader *s, unsigned input, const uint8_t *key, const uint8_t *iid) {
    static const unsigned vertices[TOPOLOGIES] = {1, 2, 4, 3, 6};
    if (!s || gfx_shader_stage(s) != GFX_STAGE_GS) return 0;
    const GfxShaderGeometry *g = gfx_shader_geometry(s);
    if (!g || g->version != GFX_GEOMETRY_VERSION || g->input != input || g->input_vertices != vertices[input - 1] ||
        g->output != GFX_GEOMETRY_OUTPUT_POINTS || g->invocations != 1 || g->max_output_vertices != 1 || g->passthrough ||
        gfx_shader_c0_layout(s)) return 0;
    uint64_t words = 0;
    const uint32_t *spv = gfx_shader_spirv(s, &words);
    return spv && words >= 5 && spv[0] == 0x07230203u &&
           (!key || !memcmp(key, gfx_shader_key(s), 32)) && (!iid || !memcmp(iid, gfx_shader_input_id(s), 32));
}

static int stored_input_valid(const char *cache, const uint8_t iid[32], unsigned input,
                              const uint8_t control[CONTROL_BYTES], const uint8_t code[PROGRAM_BYTES]) {
    char hex[65], path[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2];
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 32; i++) snprintf(hex + 2 * i, 3, "%02x", iid[i]);
    int n = snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/in/%s.in", cache, hex);
    if (n < 0 || (size_t)n >= sizeof path) return 0;
    uint64_t bytes = 0;
    uint8_t *file = plat_file_read(path, &bytes);
    uint32_t head[6];
    int ok = file && bytes == sizeof head + 148 + CONTROL_BYTES + PROGRAM_BYTES;
    if (ok) {
        memcpy(head, file, sizeof head);
        uint8_t answers[148] = {0};
        answers[147] = (uint8_t)input;
        ok = head[0] == 0x49534b54u && head[1] == 2 && head[2] == GFX_STAGE_GS && head[3] == PROGRAM_BYTES &&
             head[4] == 0 && head[5] == 148 && !memcmp(file + sizeof head, answers, sizeof answers) &&
             !memcmp(file + sizeof head + 148, control, CONTROL_BYTES) &&
             !memcmp(file + sizeof head + 148 + CONTROL_BYTES, code, PROGRAM_BYTES);
    }
    free(file);
    return ok;
}

int probe_geometry_shader(void) {
    const char *cache = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_CACHE"), *translator = getenv("TOTK_XLATE");
    CHECK(cache && *cache && strlen(cache) < 1024, "launcher must set TOTK_SHADER_CACHE to a fresh owned directory");
    CHECK(translator && *translator && strlen(translator) < 1024 && plat_file_exists(translator),
          "launcher must set TOTK_XLATE to the native translator");
    int nonempty = 0;
    CHECK(plat_fs_kind(cache) == PLAT_FS_DIR && plat_fs_list(cache, cache_entry, &nonempty) == PLAT_FS_OK && !nonempty,
          "cache must already exist and be empty; no existing cache is deleted");
    uint64_t keys, translated;
    gfx_shader_counts(&keys, &translated);
    CHECK(!keys && !translated && !gfx_shader_requests() && !gfx_shader_failures(), "probe needs a fresh shader client");
    const uint32_t subgroup[3] = {32, 32, 32};
    gfx_shader_set_host(1, 0, subgroup, 0), gfx_shader_set_geometry_host(32);
    uint8_t control[CONTROL_BYTES], code[PROGRAM_BYTES], key[TOPOLOGIES][32], iid[TOPOLOGIES][32];
    original_program(control, code);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < TOPOLOGIES; i++) {
        GfxShaderAnswers a = {.geometry_input = (uint8_t)(i + 1)};
        const GfxShader *s = gfx_shader_get(GFX_STAGE_GS, control, code, sizeof code, NULL, &a);
        CHECK(shader_valid(s, i + 1, NULL, NULL), "fresh topology %u failed", i + 1);
        memcpy(key[i], gfx_shader_key(s), 32), memcpy(iid[i], gfx_shader_input_id(s), 32);
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < i; j++)
            CHECK(memcmp(key[i], key[j], 32) && memcmp(iid[i], iid[j], 32), "topologies %u/%u share identity", i + 1, j + 1);
        CHECK(stored_input_valid(cache, iid[i], i + 1, control, code), "stored input %u is not an exact GS v2 record", i + 1);
    }
    gfx_shader_counts(&keys, &translated);
    CHECK(keys == TOPOLOGIES && translated == TOPOLOGIES && gfx_shader_requests() == TOPOLOGIES,
          "fresh pass expected exactly five cached shaders, translations and child requests");

    gfx_shader_drop_memory();
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < TOPOLOGIES; i++) {
        int owned = 0;
        const GfxShader *s = gfx_shader_load_private(iid[i], &owned);
        int ok = owned == 1 && shader_valid(s, i + 1, key[i], iid[i]);
        if (owned) gfx_shader_release_private(s);
        CHECK(ok, "private disk load %u did not return a valid owned module", i + 1);
    }
    gfx_shader_counts(&keys, &translated);
    CHECK(!keys && translated == TOPOLOGIES && gfx_shader_requests() == TOPOLOGIES, "private loads inserted or translated shaders");
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < TOPOLOGIES; i++) {
        const GfxShader *s = gfx_shader_load_input(iid[i], 0);
        CHECK(shader_valid(s, i + 1, key[i], iid[i]), "by-IID disk load %u failed", i + 1);
        int owned = 1;
        const GfxShader *borrowed = gfx_shader_load_private(iid[i], &owned);
        int ok = !owned && borrowed == s;
        if (owned) gfx_shader_release_private(borrowed);
        CHECK(ok, "private memory load %u did not borrow the cached module", i + 1);
    }

    gfx_shader_drop_memory();
    uint64_t hits = gfx_shader_cache_hits();
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < TOPOLOGIES; i++) {
        GfxShaderAnswers a = {.geometry_input = (uint8_t)(i + 1)};
        const GfxShader *s = gfx_shader_get(GFX_STAGE_GS, control, code, sizeof code, NULL, &a);
        CHECK(shader_valid(s, i + 1, key[i], iid[i]), "request-keyed disk load %u failed", i + 1);
        CHECK(gfx_shader_get(GFX_STAGE_GS, control, code, sizeof code, NULL, &a) == s,
              "memory repeat %u returned a different module", i + 1);
    }
    gfx_shader_counts(&keys, &translated);
    CHECK(keys == TOPOLOGIES && translated == TOPOLOGIES && gfx_shader_requests() == TOPOLOGIES &&
          gfx_shader_cache_hits() - hits == 2 * TOPOLOGIES && !gfx_shader_failures(),
          "warm passes expected ten hits, zero new child requests/translations/failures");
    gfx_shader_drop_memory();
    puts("probe-shader-geometry: passed (5 topologies, 5 real child requests/translations, 5 owned + 5 borrowed private loads, 10 warm hits)");
    puts("probe-shader-geometry: ordinary Maxwell translation/cache only; native lowering, passthrough, GPU pipelines, replay and terrain remain unverified");
    return 0;
}
```

`runtime/gfx_null.c`:

```c
// The null graphics back end: no GPU. Every submit completes at
// once and advances the fence value, pools always initialise, presents are only counted, texel reads return zeros.
// A submit performs the CPU-visible side effects of its op streams in order: event signals, counter reports (timestamp
// ticks, counter 0), buffer-to-buffer copies and uniform updates.
// It is the CPU-side gate for the NVN front end. Also the back-end choice (gfx_backend) and the statistics (gfx_stats).
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"

GfxStats gfx_counters;

GfxStats gfx_stats(void) {
    GfxStats s;
    s.frames = __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    s.nvn_calls = __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.nvn_calls, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    s.nvn_distinct = __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.nvn_distinct, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    s.unimplemented = __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.unimplemented, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    s.validation_errors = __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.validation_errors, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    s.shader_failures = __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.shader_failures, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    s.draws_skipped = __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.draws_skipped, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    return s;
}

// TOTK_GPU=null|vulkan, default vulkan (rt_config); chosen once.
const GfxBackend *gfx_backend(void) {
    static const GfxBackend *chosen;
    const GfxBackend *b = __atomic_load_n(&chosen, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (b) return b;
    const char *gpu = rt_config()->gpu;
    b = gpu && !strcmp(gpu, "null") ? &gfx_null_backend : &gfx_vulkan_backend;
    __atomic_store_n(&chosen, b, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    return b;
}

static uint64_t fence;

static int null_pool_init(pool_t *p) { (void)p; return 1; }
static void null_pool_fini(pool_t *p) { (void)p; }
static int null_pool_map_virtual(pool_t *v, int n, const void *requests) { (void)v, (void)n, (void)requests; return 1; }
static void null_texture_register(const dpool_ref *pool, int id, const tex_t *t, const view_t *v) { (void)pool, (void)id, (void)t, (void)v; }
static void null_sampler_register(const dpool_ref *pool, int id, const samp_par *s) { (void)pool, (void)id, (void)s; }
static void null_texture_release(const tex_t *t) { (void)t; }
static void null_program_release(const prog_t *p) { (void)p; }

// The CPU-visible side effects of one op stream, in stream order (MNG nvn_mtl.m mtl_exec and the commit handler:
// 10618-10642, 1677-1678, 1960-1985). Everything else (draws, dispatches, clears, texture copies) has no effect here.
// Addresses of CPU-invisible pools (the GPU window) hold no host memory, so those writes are dropped.
static void *null_cpu_addr(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, const char *what) {
    if (nvn_gpu_only(addr)) return NULL;
    if (!nvn_pool_find(addr, size ? size : 1)) rt_fatal("gfx: null back end: %s at %#llx (%llu bytes) is in no memory pool", what,
                                                        (unsigned long long)addr, (unsigned long long)size);
    return (void *)(uintptr_t)addr;
}

// NVNcounterData = {counter, timestamp}. Timestamps are guest counter ticks (rt_tick_hz), the base of GetSystemTick; every counter
// type the null GPU cannot measure (all but the timestamps, samples passed included) reports 0.
static void null_report(uint64_t addr) {
    NVNcounterData *d = null_cpu_addr(addr, sizeof *d, "counter report");
    if (!d) return;
    uint64_t rec[2] = {0, rt_ns_to_ticks(kern_now_ns())};
    memcpy(d, rec, sizeof rec);
}

static void null_replay(uint64_t handle) {
    for (const op_hdr *h = nvn_op_first(handle);; h = nvn_op_next(h)) {
        const void *a = nvn_op_payload(h);
        switch (h->op) {
        case OP_END: return;
        case OP_WAIT_SYNC: break;   // fulfilled by submit preparation; never reread its source here
        case OP_SIGNAL_EVENT: {
            const p_signal_event *e = a;
            if (e->mode == NVN_EVENT_SIGNAL_MODE_ADD) __atomic_fetch_add(e->val, e->value, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            else __atomic_store_n(e->val, e->value, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            break;
        }
        case OP_REPORT_COUNTER: null_report(((const p_report_counter *)a)->addr); break;
        case OP_COPY_B2B: {
            const p_copy_b2b *b = a;
            void *s = null_cpu_addr(b->src, b->size, "buffer copy source"), *d = null_cpu_addr(b->dst, b->size, "buffer copy target");
            if (s && d) memmove(d, s, b->size);
            break;
        }
        case OP_CLEAR_BUF: {
            const p_clear_buf *f = a;
            uint32_t *d = null_cpu_addr(f->addr, f->size, "buffer fill");
            for (uint64_t i = 0; d && i < f->size / 4; i++) d[i] = f->value;
            break;
        }
        case OP_UPDATE_UB: {
            const p_update_ub *u = a;
            void *d = null_cpu_addr(u->dst, u->size, "uniform update");
            if (d) memcpy(d, u->data, u->size);
            break;
        }
        default: break;
        }
    }
}

static uint64_t null_submit(const uint64_t *handles, int n, uint64_t submitted_ticks) {
    (void)submitted_ticks;   // the null back end keeps its immediate CPU-side counter behavior
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) null_replay(handles[i]);
    return __atomic_add_fetch(&fence, 1, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL);
}

static int null_fence_wait(uint64_t value, uint64_t timeout_ns) {
    (void)timeout_ns;
    return value <= __atomic_load_n(&fence, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);   // a value never submitted is never reached
}

static uint64_t null_fence_done(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&fence, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

static void null_present(const tex_t *t, const int crop[4], uint64_t at_ns) {
    (void)t, (void)crop, (void)at_ns;
    __atomic_fetch_add(&gfx_counters.frames, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

static void null_finish(void) {}

static void null_read_texels(const tex_t *t, const view_t *v, const NVNcopyRegion *r, uint8_t *dst, uint64_t row,
                             uint64_t img) {
    (void)t, (void)v;
    int h = r->height > 0 ? r->height : 1, d = r->depth > 0 ? r->depth : 1;
    for (int z = 0; z < d; z++) memset(dst + (uint64_t)z * img, 0, row * (uint64_t)h);
}

static void null_write_texels(const tex_t *t, const view_t *v, const NVNcopyRegion *r, const uint8_t *src,
                              uint64_t row, uint64_t img) {
    (void)t, (void)v, (void)r, (void)src, (void)row, (void)img;
}

static void null_guest_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) { (void)addr, (void)size; }
static void null_guest_read(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) { (void)addr, (void)size; }
static void null_cpu_synced(uint64_t fence) { (void)fence; }

const GfxBackend gfx_null_backend = {
    .name = "null",
    .pool_init = null_pool_init,
    .pool_fini = null_pool_fini,
    .pool_map_virtual = null_pool_map_virtual,
    .texture_register = null_texture_register,
    .sampler_register = null_sampler_register,
    .texture_release = null_texture_release,
    .program_release = null_program_release,
    .submit = null_submit,
    .fence_wait = null_fence_wait,
    .fence_done = null_fence_done,
    .present = null_present,
    .finish = null_finish,
    .read_texels = null_read_texels,
    .write_texels = null_write_texels,
    .guest_written = null_guest_written,
    .guest_read = null_guest_read,
    .cpu_synced = null_cpu_synced,
};
```

`runtime/gfx_present.c`:

```c
// Vulkan surface and swapchain, present blit, 60 Hz vsync thread, focus: the window-system-free half of the window
// (the other half: gfx_window_win.c with Win32, gfx_window_sdl.c with SDL, through gfx_wsys.h).
// Swapchain set-up ported from LAS Recomp, runtime/nvn/vulkan/device.c:254-330 (https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp @
// da35b83a9611d046a9a681aae668d7085954d37f, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai). Focus and vsync behaviour from
// MacNativeGames, games/totk/runtime/frontend.m:88-97, 175-176, 350-352 (https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames @
// b75be8cfa704df3701e86130c8ced268e79d6b11, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames contributors).
//
// Threads: the window thread (the back end's) owns the window and never runs guest code. The vsync thread signals the
// bound system events. Presents come from any host thread (the back end's present worker) and take g_pl; every queue
// submission takes the recursive queue lock (vk_queue_lock). The swapchain is rebuilt lazily: a resize only marks it
// dirty (gfx_window_mark_dirty), the next present (or gfx_window_resize) rebuilds it.
//
// The in-game menu (ui/menu.h) draws over the game image in the present's command buffer, after the blit. The window's
// size and fullscreen state are the settings MKW_WINDOW_SIZE and MKW_FULLSCREEN, which the back end applies at start
// and whenever a cfg_set changes them (window_settings_live -> gfx_window_apply_settings).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "flight.h"
#include "fs.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "gfx_wsys.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "ui/menu.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define FRAMES 2
#define MAX_IMAGES 16
#define VSYNC_NS 1000000000ull
#define VSYNC_HZ 60

// ---- queue lock
static PlatRMutex g_ql;
void vk_queue_lock(void) { plat_rmutex_lock(&g_ql); }
void vk_queue_unlock(void) { plat_rmutex_unlock(&g_ql); }

// ---- window state shared with the back end
static VkSurfaceKHR g_surface;
static volatile int32_t g_dirty;               // the window was resized; swapchain stale
static volatile int32_t g_focused = 1;
static volatile int32_t g_focus_msgs;
static PlatRMutex g_start_lock;       // gfx_window_start / vsync start
static int g_started;

void gfx_window_mark_dirty(void) { plat_xchg32(&g_dirty, 1); }

// The window gained or lost the focus: the game hears it as nn::oe's focus state and a notification message.
void gfx_window_focus_changed(int in) {
    plat_xchg32(&g_focused, in);
    oe_set_focus(in);                          // pinned to 1 by MKW_ASSUME_FOCUS inside
    oe_push_message(OE_MSG_FOCUS_STATE_CHANGED);
    plat_inc32(&g_focus_msgs);
    rt_log("gfx: window %s the focus", in ? "gained" : "lost");
}

// The window was closed: the process ends with it, as in MNG, once a save Commit still running in the background is
// done.
void gfx_window_closed(void) {
    rt_log("gfx: window closed; exiting");
    fs_save_flush();
    vk_pipeline_save();
    prof_write();   // plat_exit runs no atexit handlers
    plat_exit(0);
}

// MKW_FULLSCREEN=1: borderless window over the monitor. MKW_WINDOW_SIZE=<w>x<h>: client area of the window (the
// swapchain follows the window; the game image is scaled to it).
int gfx_cfg_fullscreen(void) { return cfg_bool("MKW_FULLSCREEN"); }

void gfx_cfg_window_size(int *w, int *h) {
    int x = 0, y = 0;
    if (sscanf(cfg_value("MKW_WINDOW_SIZE"), "%dx%d", &x, &y) != 2 || x < 640 || y < 360 || x > 7680 || y > 4320)
        sscanf(cfg_meta("WINDOW_SIZE")->def, "%dx%d", &x, &y);   // unparsable or out of range: the default
    *w = x;
    *h = y;
}

// The refresh rate of the window's monitor (MKW_FPS_LIMIT=display), measured by the back end's window thread when the
// window opens, lands on another monitor or the display mode changes; readers take the stored value.
static volatile int32_t g_rate_mhz;   // millihertz, 0 unknown

void gfx_window_set_refresh(double hz) {
    int32_t mhz = (int32_t)(hz * 1000 + 0.5);
    if (plat_xchg32(&g_rate_mhz, mhz) != mhz) rt_log("gfx: monitor refresh rate %.3f Hz", hz);
}

double gfx_window_refresh_hz(void) { return plat_cas32(&g_rate_mhz, 0, 0) / 1000.0; }

// ---- swapchain and present state (g_pl)
static PlatRMutex g_pl;
static VkSwapchainKHR g_sc;
static VkFormat g_sc_fmt;
static VkExtent2D g_sc_ext;
static int g_scaler;                        // the last present: 0 the game image 1:1, 1 scaled by the blit, 2 by FSR
static uint32_t g_sc_n;
static VkImage g_sc_img[MAX_IMAGES];
static VkImageView g_sc_view[MAX_IMAGES];   // colour attachment views for the menu overlay
static VkSemaphore g_render_done[MAX_IMAGES];
static VkCommandPool g_pool;
static VkCommandBuffer g_cb[FRAMES];
static VkFence g_fence[FRAMES];
static VkSemaphore g_acquire[FRAMES];
// The perf line's present figure (perf_present_gpu): the blit, colour adjustment, FSR and overlay go to the queue
// outside vk_sync.c's timed submissions. Each slot's pair is read when its fence is waited for again.
static VkQueryPool g_ts_pool;
static int g_ts_state;   // 0 not set up, 1 ready, -1 no timestamps
static float g_ts_period;
static uint8_t g_ts_on[FRAMES];
static unsigned g_frame;
static int g_capture;
static VkBuffer g_cap_buf;
static VmaAllocation g_cap_alloc;
static uint8_t *g_cap_ptr;
static VkDeviceSize g_cap_size;
static int g_cap_w, g_cap_h, g_cap_valid;
static int g_flip_on;            // vk_present_blit submitted the blit of swapchain image g_flip_idx; vk_present_flip presents it
static uint32_t g_flip_idx;

// ---- MKW_FLIGHT thumbnails (flight.c; g_pl): each present also blits the swapchain image down into slot frame % g_th_n
// of a host-visible ring. A slot's tag names the frame it holds complete; recording a new frame clears the tag first,
// and the tag is set once the fence of that present has signalled.
#define TH_BYTES ((VkDeviceSize)FLIGHT_THUMB_W * FLIGHT_THUMB_H * 4)
static int g_th_n, g_th_failed;
static uint64_t g_th_frame;                // frame of the next vk_present_image call (vk_thumbs_frame)
static uint64_t *g_th_tag;                 // per ring slot
static uint64_t g_th_pending[FRAMES];      // per fence slot: the frame whose thumbnail its submission writes
static VkImage g_th_img;
static VmaAllocation g_th_img_alloc;
static VkFormat g_th_fmt;
static VkBuffer g_th_buf;
static VmaAllocation g_th_alloc;
static uint8_t *g_th_ptr;

// ---- vsync
static PlatMutex g_vs_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
static uint64_t g_vs_ev[16];
static int g_vs_nev;
static volatile int32_t *g_vs_ctr[4];
static int g_vs_nctr;
static volatile int64_t g_ticks;
static volatile int64_t g_vs_start_ns;
static int g_vs_started;

static void vsync_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    plat_thread_priority(PLAT_PRIO_HIGHEST);
    uint64_t n = 0;
    for (;;) {
        uint64_t start = (uint64_t)g_vs_start_ns;
        uint64_t due = start + (n + 1) * VSYNC_NS / VSYNC_HZ;
        uint64_t now = kern_now_ns();
        if (now > due + 100000000ull) {                  // the process stalled: restart the schedule, no catch-up burst
            g_vs_start_ns = (int64_t)(now - (n + 1) * VSYNC_NS / VSYNC_HZ);
        } else if (due > now) {
            plat_wait_ns(due - now);
        }
        n++;
        plat_xchg64(&g_ticks, (int64_t)n);
        uint64_t ev[16];
        volatile int32_t *ctr[4];
        int ne, nc;
        plat_mutex_lock_shared(&g_vs_lock);
        ne = g_vs_nev;
        nc = g_vs_nctr;
        memcpy(ev, g_vs_ev, sizeof ev);
        memcpy(ctr, g_vs_ctr, sizeof ctr);
        plat_mutex_unlock_shared(&g_vs_lock);
        for (int i = 0; i < nc; i++) plat_inc32(ctr[i]);
        for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) kern_signal_system_event(ev[i]);
    }
    return;
}

static void vsync_ensure(void) {
    plat_rmutex_lock(&g_start_lock);
    if (!g_vs_started) {
        g_vs_started = 1;
        g_vs_start_ns = (int64_t)kern_now_ns();
        if (!plat_thread_spawn(vsync_main, NULL, "vsync", 0)) rt_fatal("gfx: cannot start the vsync thread");
    }
    plat_rmutex_unlock(&g_start_lock);
}

void gfx_vsync_bind(uint64_t system_event) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_vs_lock);
    int have = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_vs_nev; i++) have |= g_vs_ev[i] == system_event;
    if (!have) {
        if (g_vs_nev == 16) rt_fatal("gfx: more than 16 vsync events");
        g_vs_ev[g_vs_nev++] = system_event;
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_vs_lock);
    vsync_ensure();
}

void gfx_vsync_bind_counter(volatile int32_t *counter) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_vs_lock);
    if (g_vs_nctr == 4) rt_fatal("gfx: more than 4 vsync counters");
    g_vs_ctr[g_vs_nctr++] = counter;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_vs_lock);
    vsync_ensure();
}

uint64_t gfx_vsync_ticks(void) { return (uint64_t)plat_cas64(&g_ticks, 0, 0); }
uint64_t gfx_vsync_time_ns(uint64_t tick) { return (uint64_t)g_vs_start_ns + tick * VSYNC_NS / VSYNC_HZ; }

// ---- focus
int gfx_window_focused(void) { return g_focused; }
unsigned gfx_window_focus_messages(void) { return (unsigned)g_focus_msgs; }

// Present path (g_pl held): a settings change (cfg_version) reaches the window thread, which applies a changed size or
// fullscreen; a changed MKW_VK_PRESENT rebuilds the swapchain at this present.
static void window_settings_live(void) {
    static unsigned seen;
    static int started;
    static char present[16];   // the MKW_VK_PRESENT the swapchain was made with
    unsigned v = cfg_version();
    if (started && v == seen) return;
    seen = v;
    res_fov_live();
    const char *e = cfg_value("MKW_VK_PRESENT");
    if (!started || strncmp(e, present, sizeof present - 1)) {
        snprintf(present, sizeof present, "%s", e);
        if (started) plat_xchg32(&g_dirty, 1);
    }
    if (started) gfx_window_apply_settings();
    started = 1;
}

// ---- swapchain
static const char *g_present_got = "";   // the MKW_VK_PRESENT value of the mode the swapchain got; "" before one

static VkPresentModeKHR pick_present_mode(VkPhysicalDevice pd) {
    const char *e = cfg_value("MKW_VK_PRESENT");
    VkPresentModeKHR want = !strcmp(e, "mailbox") ? VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR
                          : !strcmp(e, "immediate") ? VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR : VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR;
    uint32_t n = 0;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR(pd, g_surface, &n, NULL);
    VkPresentModeKHR m[16];
    if (n > 16) n = 16;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR(pd, g_surface, &n, m);
    VkPresentModeKHR got = VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (m[i] == want) got = want;
    const char *name = got == VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR ? "mailbox" : got == VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR ? "immediate" : "fifo";
    __atomic_store_n(&g_present_got, name, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    static int logged = -1;   // the mode last logged: a change from the menu shows in the log
    if ((int)got != logged) {
        logged = (int)got;
        rt_log("gfx: present mode %s (MKW_VK_PRESENT=%s)", name, e);
    }
    return got;
}

const char *gfx_window_present_mode(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&g_present_got, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

// Queues the present of a blit vk_present_blit left waiting (g_pl held). A swapchain rebuild and the next blit flush it
// first; the device release drops it.
static void flip_locked(void) {
    if (!g_flip_on) return;
    g_flip_on = 0;
    if (!g_sc) return;
    VkPresentInfoKHR pi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PRESENT_INFO_KHR,
                           .waitSemaphoreCount = 1,
                           .pWaitSemaphores = &g_render_done[g_flip_idx], .swapchainCount = 1, .pSwapchains = &g_sc,
                           .pImageIndices = &g_flip_idx};
    vk_queue_lock();
    VkResult r = vkQueuePresentKHR(vk_ctx()->gfx_queue, &pi);
    vk_queue_unlock();
    vk_device_fault_report(r);
    if (r == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR || r == VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) plat_xchg32(&g_dirty, 1);
}

static void free_capture(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (g_cap_buf && c) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, g_cap_buf, g_cap_alloc);
    g_cap_buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    g_cap_ptr = NULL;
    g_cap_size = 0;
    g_cap_valid = 0;
}

// Returns 1 with a usable swapchain, 0 when the window has no area (minimised). Called with g_pl held.
static int create_swapchain(void) {
    flip_locked();   // the acquired image goes out before its swapchain is replaced
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR caps;
    if (vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR(c->phys, g_surface, &caps) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    int cw = 0, ch = 0;
    wsys_client_size(&cw, &ch);
    VkExtent2D ext = caps.currentExtent.width != UINT32_MAX ? caps.currentExtent
                                                            : (VkExtent2D){(uint32_t)cw, (uint32_t)ch};
    if (!ext.width || !ext.height) return 0;
    uint32_t nf = 0;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(c->phys, g_surface, &nf, NULL);
    VkSurfaceFormatKHR fmts[64];
    if (nf > 64) nf = 64;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(c->phys, g_surface, &nf, fmts);
    if (!nf) return 0;
    // UNORM: the blit writes the bytes the game wrote (no sRGB encode).
    VkSurfaceFormatKHR sf = fmts[0];
    int found = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nf && !found; i++)
        if (fmts[i].format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM && fmts[i].colorSpace == VK_COLOR_SPACE_SRGB_NONLINEAR_KHR) { sf = fmts[i]; found = 1; }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nf && !found; i++)
        if (fmts[i].format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM && fmts[i].colorSpace == VK_COLOR_SPACE_SRGB_NONLINEAR_KHR) { sf = fmts[i]; found = 1; }
    uint32_t count = caps.minImageCount + 1;
    if (caps.maxImageCount && count > caps.maxImageCount) count = caps.maxImageCount;
    if (count > 8) count = 8;

    vk_queue_lock();
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(c->device);
    VkSwapchainKHR old = g_sc;
    VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR ci = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_CREATE_INFO_KHR, .surface = g_surface, .minImageCount = count,
        .imageFormat = sf.format, .imageColorSpace = sf.colorSpace, .imageExtent = ext, .imageArrayLayers = 1,
        .imageUsage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT |
                      VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT,   // every surface supports it (the menu overlay draws into it)
        .imageSharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE, .preTransform = caps.currentTransform,
        .compositeAlpha = VK_COMPOSITE_ALPHA_OPAQUE_BIT_KHR, .presentMode = pick_present_mode(c->phys), .clipped = VK_TRUE,
        .oldSwapchain = old};
    VkResult r = vkCreateSwapchainKHR(c->device, &ci, NULL, &g_sc);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        rt_log("gfx: vkCreateSwapchainKHR failed (%d)", (int)r);
        g_sc = old;
        vk_queue_unlock();
        return 0;
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_sc_n; i++) {
        vkDestroySemaphore(c->device, g_render_done[i], NULL);
        if (g_sc_view[i]) vkDestroyImageView(c->device, g_sc_view[i], NULL);
        g_sc_view[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    if (old) vkDestroySwapchainKHR(c->device, old, NULL);
    g_sc_fmt = sf.format;
    g_sc_ext = ext;
    g_sc_n = MAX_IMAGES;
    vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(c->device, g_sc, &g_sc_n, g_sc_img);
    VkSemaphoreCreateInfo semi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_sc_n; i++) {
        vkCreateSemaphore(c->device, &semi, NULL, &g_render_done[i]);
        VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = g_sc_img[i],
                                    .viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, .format = sf.format,
                                    .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
        if (vkCreateImageView(c->device, &vi, NULL, &g_sc_view[i]) != VK_SUCCESS) g_sc_view[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    free_capture();
    vk_queue_unlock();
    plat_xchg32(&g_dirty, 0);
    return 1;
}

static void sync_barrier(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage img, VkImageLayout from, VkImageLayout to, VkPipelineStageFlags2 s0,
                         VkAccessFlags2 a0, VkPipelineStageFlags2 s1, VkAccessFlags2 a1) {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier2 b = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = s0, .srcAccessMask = a0,
                               .dstStageMask = s1, .dstAccessMask = a1, .oldLayout = from, .newLayout = to,
                               .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                               .image = img, .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
    VkDependencyInfo d = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1, .pImageMemoryBarriers = &b};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &d);
}

static int ensure_capture_buffer(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    VkDeviceSize need = (VkDeviceSize)g_sc_ext.width * g_sc_ext.height * 4;
    if (g_cap_buf && g_cap_size == need) return 1;
    free_capture();
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = need, .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_HOST,
                                  .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT};
    VmaAllocationInfo info;
    if (vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &ai, &g_cap_buf, &g_cap_alloc, &info) != VK_SUCCESS) { g_cap_buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; return 0; }
    g_cap_ptr = info.pMappedData;
    g_cap_size = need;
    return g_cap_ptr != NULL;
}

void vk_thumbs_enable(int n) {
    plat_rmutex_lock(&g_pl);
    if (!g_th_n && n > 0 && (g_th_tag = calloc((size_t)n, sizeof *g_th_tag))) g_th_n = n;
    plat_rmutex_unlock(&g_pl);
}

void vk_thumbs_frame(uint64_t frame) {
    plat_rmutex_lock(&g_pl);
    g_th_frame = frame;
    plat_rmutex_unlock(&g_pl);
}

static void free_thumbs(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (g_th_img && c) vmaDestroyImage(c->vma, g_th_img, g_th_img_alloc);
    if (g_th_buf && c) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, g_th_buf, g_th_alloc);
    g_th_img = VK_NULL_HANDLE, g_th_buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE, g_th_ptr = NULL;
    if (g_th_tag) memset(g_th_tag, 0, sizeof *g_th_tag * (size_t)g_th_n);
    memset(g_th_pending, 0, sizeof g_th_pending);
}

// The ring and the blit target in the swapchain's format; allocated on the first present, the image again when the
// swapchain format changes. A failure turns the thumbnails off for the session.
static int ensure_thumbs(void) {
    if (!g_th_n || g_th_failed || !g_th_frame) return 0;
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!g_th_buf) {
        VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = TH_BYTES * (VkDeviceSize)g_th_n,
                                 .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
        VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_HOST,
                                      .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT};
        VmaAllocationInfo info;
        if (vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &ai, &g_th_buf, &g_th_alloc, &info) != VK_SUCCESS || !info.pMappedData) {
            if (g_th_buf) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, g_th_buf, g_th_alloc);
            g_th_buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            g_th_failed = 1;
            rt_log("gfx: flight thumbnails off: no host-visible ring of %llu MB", (unsigned long long)(bi.size >> 20));
            return 0;
        }
        g_th_ptr = info.pMappedData;
    }
    if (g_th_img && g_th_fmt != g_sc_fmt) {
        vmaDestroyImage(c->vma, g_th_img, g_th_img_alloc);   // the previous present's fence was waited for: idle
        g_th_img = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    if (!g_th_img) {
        VkImageCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, .format = g_sc_fmt,
                                .extent = {FLIGHT_THUMB_W, FLIGHT_THUMB_H, 1}, .mipLevels = 1, .arrayLayers = 1,
                                .samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
                                .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT,
                                .initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED};
        VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
        if (vmaCreateImage(c->vma, &ci, &ai, &g_th_img, &g_th_img_alloc, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) {
            g_th_img = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            g_th_failed = 1;
            rt_log("gfx: flight thumbnails off: no %ux%u image", FLIGHT_THUMB_W, FLIGHT_THUMB_H);
            return 0;
        }
        g_th_fmt = g_sc_fmt;
    }
    return 1;
}

// dst (TRANSFER_SRC, the swapchain image just written) -> thumbnail image -> ring slot of g_th_frame.
static void record_thumb(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage dst, unsigned fence_slot) {
    uint64_t f = g_th_frame;
    unsigned ring = (unsigned)(f % (uint64_t)g_th_n);
    g_th_tag[ring] = 0;   // under g_pl: vk_thumbs_read no longer hands this slot out
    sync_barrier(cb, g_th_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT,
                 0, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT);
    VkImageBlit region = {
        .srcSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, .srcOffsets = {{0, 0, 0}, {(int)g_sc_ext.width, (int)g_sc_ext.height, 1}},
        .dstSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, .dstOffsets = {{0, 0, 0}, {FLIGHT_THUMB_W, FLIGHT_THUMB_H, 1}}};
    vkCmdBlitImage(cb, dst, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, g_th_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &region,
                   VK_FILTER_LINEAR);
    sync_barrier(cb, g_th_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
                 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT,
                 VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT);
    VkBufferImageCopy bc = {.bufferOffset = TH_BYTES * ring, .imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                            .imageExtent = {FLIGHT_THUMB_W, FLIGHT_THUMB_H, 1}};
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, g_th_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, g_th_buf, 1, &bc);
    VkMemoryBarrier2 mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT,
                           .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT,
                           .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT};
    VkDependencyInfo d = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &mb};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &d);
    g_th_pending[fence_slot] = f;
    g_th_frame = 0;
}

int vk_thumbs_read(uint64_t frame, uint8_t *rgba) {
    int ok = 0;
    plat_rmutex_lock(&g_pl);
    if (g_th_n && g_th_ptr && frame) {
        unsigned ring = (unsigned)(frame % (uint64_t)g_th_n);
        if (g_th_tag[ring] == frame) {
            VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
            vmaInvalidateAllocation(c->vma, g_th_alloc, TH_BYTES * ring, TH_BYTES);
            memcpy(rgba, g_th_ptr + TH_BYTES * ring, TH_BYTES);
            ok = g_th_fmt == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM || g_th_fmt == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB ? 2 : 1;
        }
    }
    plat_rmutex_unlock(&g_pl);
    if (ok == 2)
        for (size_t i = 0; i < TH_BYTES; i += 4) {
            uint8_t t = rgba[i];
            rgba[i] = rgba[i + 2], rgba[i + 2] = t;
        }
    return ok != 0;
}

void vk_present_capture(int on) {
    plat_rmutex_lock(&g_pl);
    g_capture = on;
    if (!on) g_cap_valid = 0;
    plat_rmutex_unlock(&g_pl);
}

int vk_present_captured(const uint8_t **px, int *w, int *h, VkFormat *fmt) {
    plat_rmutex_lock(&g_pl);
    int ok = g_cap_valid;
    if (ok) { *px = g_cap_ptr; *w = g_cap_w; *h = g_cap_h; *fmt = g_sc_fmt; }
    plat_rmutex_unlock(&g_pl);
    return ok;
}

// The captured swapchain image as a PNG (the menu's test hook), RGBA with opaque alpha.
static void save_capture(const char *path) {
    size_t n = (size_t)g_cap_w * (size_t)g_cap_h * 4;
    uint8_t *px = malloc(n);
    if (!px) return;
    int bgra = g_sc_fmt == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM || g_sc_fmt == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i += 4) {
        px[i] = g_cap_ptr[i + (bgra ? 2 : 0)];
        px[i + 1] = g_cap_ptr[i + 1];
        px[i + 2] = g_cap_ptr[i + (bgra ? 0 : 2)];
```
