```c
             RC.ans_path);
    uint8_t *ab = NULL, *pb = NULL;
    size_t an = 0, pn = 0;
    plat_mutex_lock(&rec_io);                      // no append meanwhile
    answers_read(RC.ans_path, &ab, &an, 0);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&rec_io);
    rec_read(prp, "TOTKSPRP", PRP_VERSION, PRP_REC, &pb, &pn);
    size_t na = an / ANS_REC, np = pn / PRP_REC, n = 0;
    GfxWarmEnt *e = calloc(na + np + 1, sizeof *e);
    Set64 seen = {0};
    for (size_t i = 0; e && i < na; i++) {
        const uint8_t *r = ab + i * ANS_REC;
        if (!set_add(&seen, hash8(r + 36))) continue;
        memcpy(e[n].iid, r + 36, 32), e[n].stage = r[0], e[n].prio = 0, n++;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; e && i < np; i++) {
        const uint8_t *r = pb + i * PRP_REC;
        if (!set_add(&seen, hash8(r + 4))) continue;
        memcpy(e[n].iid, r + 4, 32), e[n].stage = r[0], e[n].prio = (uint8_t)(1 + r[1]), n++;
    }
    free(seen.v), free(ab), free(pb);
    rt_log("gfx_shader: warm list: %zu variants (%zu met in play, %zu prepared)", n, na, np);
    *out = e;
    return n;
}

```

`runtime/gfx_shader_probe.c`:

```c
// --probe-shader: the shader service client (gfx_shader.c) against 32 census shaders. Needs build/xlate/totk_xlate.exe and
// a census, build/<version>/shaders/ (tools/shader_census.py, probe_census_dir); uses a throwaway cache directory.
//   1. Translate 32 shaders (mixed stages) through gfx_shader_get; each SPIR-V starts with the magic 0x07230203.
//   2. Drop the memory cache and ask again: 32 hits from disk, 0 service requests. A third pass returns the same pointers.
//   3. Send a malformed line straight to the service: it answers with an error line and still serves a valid request.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

int gfx_shader_raw_request(const char *line, char *reply, size_t reply_size);
uint64_t gfx_shader_requests(void);
uint64_t gfx_shader_cache_hits(void);
void gfx_shader_drop_memory(void);

#define WANT 32
#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { if (!(cond)) { printf("probe-shader: FAILED: " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); return 1; } } while (0)

typedef struct { char key[65]; int stage; const char *c1; size_t c1_len; uint32_t local[3]; } Entry;

static char *slurp(const char *path, size_t *size) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    char *b = malloc((size_t)n + 1);
    if (b && fread(b, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) free(b), b = NULL;
    fclose(f);
    if (b) b[n] = 0, *size = (size_t)n;
    return b;
}

// Value of `"name": "` inside [from, to), NULL when absent; *len is the value length.
static const char *str_field(const char *from, const char *to, const char *name, size_t *len) {
    char pat[32];
    snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "\"%s\": \"", name);
    const char *p = strstr(from, pat);
    if (!p || p >= to) return NULL;
    p += strlen(pat);
    const char *e = memchr(p, '"', (size_t)(to - p));
    if (!e) return NULL;
    *len = (size_t)(e - p);
    return p;
}

static int hexval(char c) { return c <= '9' ? c - '0' : (c | 32) - 'a' + 10; }

// The shader census the probes translate (tools/shader_census.py --version <ver>): build/<ver>/shaders in the nearest
// parent of totk.exe that has one with a jobs.json, the running game version's first, then the others' (any census
// serves a probe). 1 with that folder in dir.
int probe_census_dir(char *dir, size_t n) {
    const char *const versions[3] = {RT_V111 ? "v111" : RT_V143 ? "v143" : "v121",
                                     RT_V111 ? "v121" : RT_V143 ? "v121" : "v143",
                                     RT_V111 ? "v143" : RT_V143 ? "v111" : "v111"};
    for (int v = 0; v < 3; v++) {
        char exe[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2];
        int len = plat_exe_path(exe, sizeof exe);
        if (!len || len >= sizeof exe) return 0;
        for (char *cut = plat_last_sep(exe); cut; cut = plat_last_sep(exe)) {
            *cut = 0;
            char p[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2 + 40];
            snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/build/%s/shaders/jobs.json", exe, versions[v]);
            if (plat_file_exists(p)) return snprintf(dir, n, "%s/build/%s/shaders", exe, versions[v]) < (int)n;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static int pick_entries(const char *jobs, Entry *out) {
    enum { MAXN = 20000 };
    Entry *all = malloc(sizeof(Entry) * MAXN);
    int n = 0, per_stage[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    for (const char *p = jobs; n < MAXN && (p = strstr(p, "\"job\": {")); p += 8) {
        const char *end = strstr(p, "\"source\": ");
        if (!end) break;
        size_t kl, sl, cl;
        const char *k = str_field(p, end, "key", &kl), *s = str_field(p, end, "stage", &sl), *c = str_field(p, end, "c1", &cl);
        if (!k || !s || !c || kl != 64) continue;
        Entry *e = &all[n];
        memcpy(e->key, k, 64), e->key[64] = 0;
        e->stage = !strncmp(s, "vs", sl) ? GFX_STAGE_VS : !strncmp(s, "ps", sl) ? GFX_STAGE_FS : GFX_STAGE_CS;
        e->c1 = c, e->c1_len = cl / 2;
        e->local[0] = e->local[1] = e->local[2] = 1;
        const char *l = strstr(p, "\"local\": [");
        if (l && l < end) sscanf(l + 10, "%u , %u , %u", &e->local[0], &e->local[1], &e->local[2]);
        if (l && l < end && e->local[1] == 1 && e->local[2] == 1) sscanf(l + 10, "%u,%u,%u", &e->local[0], &e->local[1], &e->local[2]);
        per_stage[e->stage == GFX_STAGE_VS ? 0 : e->stage == GFX_STAGE_FS ? 1 : 2]++;
        n++;
    }
    // 11 vertex, 11 fragment, 10 compute shaders, spread evenly over each stage's list
    int want[3] = {11, 11, 10}, taken[3] = {0, 0, 0}, seen[3] = {0, 0, 0}, got = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int s = all[i].stage == GFX_STAGE_VS ? 0 : all[i].stage == GFX_STAGE_FS ? 1 : 2;
        if (per_stage[s] < want[s]) want[s] = per_stage[s];
        if (taken[s] < want[s] && seen[s] == (int)((long long)taken[s] * per_stage[s] / want[s])) out[got++] = all[i], taken[s]++;
        seen[s]++;
    }
    free(all);
    return got;
}

static char root[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2];   // the census folder (probe_census_dir)

// Builds the program the game would hand NVN for a census entry and translates it.
static const GfxShader *translate(const Entry *e, int *err) {
    char path[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2 + 64];
    uint8_t c1[8192], control[0x880] = {0};
    if (e->c1_len > sizeof c1) return *err = 1, NULL;
    for (size_t b = 0; b < e->c1_len; b++) c1[b] = (uint8_t)(hexval(e->c1[b * 2]) << 4 | hexval(e->c1[b * 2 + 1]));
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/code/%s.code", root, e->key);
    size_t body_size;
    char *body = slurp(path, &body_size);
    if (!body) return *err = 1, NULL;
    size_t skip = e->stage == GFX_STAGE_CS ? 0 : 0x30, total = skip + body_size;
    uint8_t *code = calloc(1, total);
    memcpy(code + skip, body, body_size);
    free(body);
    uint32_t c1_off = (uint32_t)(total - e->c1_len), length = (uint32_t)total;
    memcpy(control + 0x700, &c1_off, 4), memcpy(control + 0x704, &length, 4);
    GfxShaderAnswers a = {0};
    if (e->stage == GFX_STAGE_CS) for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) a.local[k] = (uint16_t)e->local[k];
    const GfxShader *s = gfx_shader_get(e->stage, control, code, total, c1, &a);
    free(code);
    return s;
}

static int remove_entry(const char *name, int kind, uint64_t size, void *dir) {
    (void)size;
    char f[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2];
    snprintf(f, sizeof f, "%s/%s", (const char *)dir, name);
    if (kind == PLAT_FS_FILE) plat_fs_unlink(f);
    return 1;
}

static void remove_dir(const char *dir) {
    plat_fs_list(dir, remove_entry, (void *)dir);
    plat_fs_rmdir(dir);
}

#define FAIL_IF(cond, ...) do { if (cond) { printf("probe-shader: FAILED: " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); remove_dir(dir); return 1; } } while (0)

int probe_shader(void) {
    char path[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2 + 64];
    CHECK(probe_census_dir(root, sizeof root),
          "no build/v%d/shaders/jobs.json above the exe (run tools/shader_census.py --version v%d)", rt_game_version,
          rt_game_version);
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/jobs.json", root);
    size_t jobs_size;
    char *jobs = slurp(path, &jobs_size);
    CHECK(jobs, "cannot read %s", path);
    static Entry entries[WANT];
    int count = pick_entries(jobs, entries);
    CHECK(count == WANT, "only %d census shaders usable", count);

    char dir[PLAT_PATH_MAX];
    char tmp[PLAT_PATH_MAX];
    if (!plat_temp_dir(tmp, sizeof tmp)) strcpy(tmp, ".");
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/totk-shader-probe-%u", tmp, plat_process_id());
    CHECK(plat_setenv("TOTK_SHADER_CACHE", dir), "cannot set TOTK_SHADER_CACHE");

    // pass 1: translate through the service
    const GfxShader *first[WANT];
    uint64_t req0 = gfx_shader_requests();
    for (int i = 0; i < WANT; i++) {
        int err = 0;
        first[i] = translate(&entries[i], &err);
        FAIL_IF(!first[i], "shader %s did not translate", entries[i].key);
        uint64_t words;
        const uint32_t *w = gfx_shader_spirv(first[i], &words);
        FAIL_IF(words < 5 || w[0] != 0x07230203, "shader %s: bad SPIR-V magic", entries[i].key);
    }
    FAIL_IF(gfx_shader_requests() - req0 != WANT, "pass 1 sent %llu requests, expected %d",
            (unsigned long long)(gfx_shader_requests() - req0), WANT);

    // pass 2: memory cache dropped, so every answer comes from the disk cache
    gfx_shader_drop_memory();
    req0 = gfx_shader_requests();
    uint64_t hits0 = gfx_shader_cache_hits();
    const GfxShader *second[WANT];
    for (int i = 0; i < WANT; i++) {
        int err = 0;
        second[i] = translate(&entries[i], &err);
        FAIL_IF(!second[i], "shader %s missing from the disk cache", entries[i].key);
        uint64_t words;
        const uint32_t *w = gfx_shader_spirv(second[i], &words);
        FAIL_IF(words < 5 || w[0] != 0x07230203, "shader %s: bad SPIR-V magic from disk", entries[i].key);
    }
    int hits = (int)(gfx_shader_cache_hits() - hits0);
    FAIL_IF(gfx_shader_requests() != req0, "pass 2 contacted the service");
    FAIL_IF(hits != WANT, "pass 2 had %d cache hits", hits);

    // pass 3: memory hits return the same pointer
    for (int i = 0; i < WANT; i++) {
        int err = 0;
        FAIL_IF(translate(&entries[i], &err) != second[i], "repeat call for %s returned another pointer", entries[i].key);
    }
    FAIL_IF(gfx_shader_requests() != req0, "pass 3 contacted the service");
    FAIL_IF(gfx_shader_failures() != 0, "%llu translation failures", (unsigned long long)gfx_shader_failures());

    // the service survives a malformed line and still translates a valid one
    char reply[4096];
    FAIL_IF(!gfx_shader_raw_request("this is not json", reply, sizeof reply), "service gone after the malformed line");
    FAIL_IF(strncmp(reply, "fail ", 5), "malformed line answered with \"%s\"", reply);
    FAIL_IF(!gfx_shader_raw_request("{\"job\":{\"stage\":\"ps\"},\"out\":\"x\"}", reply, sizeof reply) || strncmp(reply, "fail ", 5),
            "job without key not rejected");
    char dir_json[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2], line[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 4 + 1024], *o = dir_json;
    for (const char *s = dir; *s; s++) { if (*s == '\\') *o++ = '\\'; *o++ = *s; }
    *o = 0;
    char esc_root[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2];
    o = esc_root;
    for (const char *s = root; *s; s++) { if (*s == '\\') *o++ = '\\'; *o++ = *s; }
    *o = 0;
    const Entry *e = &entries[0];
    snprintf(line, sizeof line,
             "{\"job\":{\"key\":\"%.64sa\",\"stage\":\"%s\",\"debug\":false,\"c1\":\"%.*s\",\"code\":\"%s/code/%.64s.code\"},\"out\":\"%s\"}",
             e->key, e->stage == GFX_STAGE_VS ? "vs" : e->stage == GFX_STAGE_FS ? "ps" : "cs", (int)(e->c1_len * 2), e->c1,
             esc_root, e->key, dir_json);
    FAIL_IF(!gfx_shader_raw_request(line, reply, sizeof reply), "service did not answer a valid request after the malformed one");
    FAIL_IF(strncmp(reply, "ok ", 3), "valid request after the malformed one answered \"%s\"", reply);

    remove_dir(dir);
    printf("probe-shader: passed (%d shaders, %d cache hits, service survived malformed request)\n", count, hits);
    return 0;
}
```

`runtime/gfx_window_probe.c`:

```c
// --probe-window: presents 300 frames of a cycling clear colour through vk_present_image, reads the swapchain image back
// and compares every pixel, measures the vsync rate, flips the focus state and drives the cursor release with synthetic
// window events (the window back end's wsys_probe_*, gfx_wsys.h) and resizes the window. Run with TOTK_VK_VALIDATION=1
// to count validation errors.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gfx.h"
#include "gfx_wsys.h"
#include "input.h"
#include "ui/menu.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define SRC_W 640
#define SRC_H 360
#define FRAMES 300

typedef struct {
    VkImage img;
    VmaAllocation alloc;
    VkCommandPool pool;
    VkCommandBuffer cb;
    VkFence fence;
} Source;

static int fail(const char *what) {
    printf("probe-window: FAILED (%s)\n", what);
    return 1;
}

static void barrier(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage img, VkImageLayout from, VkImageLayout to, VkPipelineStageFlags2 s0,
                    VkAccessFlags2 a0, VkPipelineStageFlags2 s1, VkAccessFlags2 a1) {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier2 b = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = s0, .srcAccessMask = a0,
                               .dstStageMask = s1, .dstAccessMask = a1, .oldLayout = from, .newLayout = to,
                               .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                               .image = img, .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
    VkDependencyInfo d = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1, .pImageMemoryBarriers = &b};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &d);
}

static int source_create(Source *s) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    VkImageCreateInfo ii = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D,
                            .format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, .extent = {SRC_W, SRC_H, 1}, .mipLevels = 1, .arrayLayers = 1,
                            .samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
                            .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT,
                            .initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
    if (vmaCreateImage(c->vma, &ii, &ai, &s->img, &s->alloc, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo pi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO,
                                  .flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT, .queueFamilyIndex = c->gfx_family};
    if (vkCreateCommandPool(c->device, &pi, NULL, &s->pool) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ba = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO, .commandPool = s->pool,
                                      .level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY, .commandBufferCount = 1};
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(c->device, &ba, &s->cb) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkFenceCreateInfo fi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO};
    return vkCreateFence(c->device, &fi, NULL, &s->fence) == VK_SUCCESS;
}

static void source_destroy(Source *s) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (s->fence) vkDestroyFence(c->device, s->fence, NULL);
    if (s->pool) vkDestroyCommandPool(c->device, s->pool, NULL);
    if (s->img) vmaDestroyImage(c->vma, s->img, s->alloc);
}

// Clears the source to rgba and leaves it in TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; the GPU work is waited for here, which is stricter
// than the vk_present_image contract needs.
static int source_clear(Source *s, int first, const float rgba[4]) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    vkResetCommandBuffer(s->cb, 0);
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO,
                                   .flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT};
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(s->cb, &bi);
    barrier(s->cb, s->img, first ? VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED : VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
            VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT, first ? 0 : VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT,
            VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT);
    VkClearColorValue cv;
    memcpy(cv.float32, rgba, sizeof cv.float32);
    VkImageSubresourceRange rng = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
    vkCmdClearColorImage(s->cb, s->img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, &cv, 1, &rng);
    barrier(s->cb, s->img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
            VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT,
            VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT);
    vkEndCommandBuffer(s->cb);
    VkCommandBufferSubmitInfo cbi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_SUBMIT_INFO, .commandBuffer = s->cb};
    VkSubmitInfo2 si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO_2, .commandBufferInfoCount = 1, .pCommandBufferInfos = &cbi};
    vk_queue_lock();
    VkResult r = vkQueueSubmit2(c->gfx_queue, 1, &si, s->fence);
    vk_queue_unlock();
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    r = vkWaitForFences(c->device, 1, &s->fence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull);
    vkResetFences(c->device, 1, &s->fence);
    return r == VK_SUCCESS;
}

static uint8_t to_byte(float f) { return (uint8_t)(f * 255.0f + 0.5f); }

// Presents one colour and checks every pixel of the readback. Returns 0 when it matches.
static int present_and_check(Source *s, int first, int i, int *w_out, int *h_out) {
    float rgba[4] = {(float)((i * 7) & 255) / 255.0f, (float)((i * 13) & 255) / 255.0f, (float)((i * 29) & 255) / 255.0f, 1.0f};
    if (!source_clear(s, first, rgba)) return 1;
    vk_present_image(s->img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, SRC_W, SRC_H, NULL);
    const uint8_t *px;
    int w, h;
    VkFormat fmt;
    if (!vk_present_captured(&px, &w, &h, &fmt)) { printf("probe-window: frame %d was not presented\n", i); return 2; }
    uint8_t rgb[3] = {to_byte(rgba[0]), to_byte(rgba[1]), to_byte(rgba[2])};
    uint8_t want[4];
    if (fmt == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM) { want[0] = rgb[2]; want[1] = rgb[1]; want[2] = rgb[0]; }
    else if (fmt == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) { want[0] = rgb[0]; want[1] = rgb[1]; want[2] = rgb[2]; }
    else { printf("probe-window: swapchain format %d is not UNORM RGBA/BGRA\n", (int)fmt); return 3; }
    want[3] = 255;
    uint32_t wv, black = 0xff000000u;   // opaque black in both byte orders
    memcpy(&wv, want, 4);
    int r[4];   // the picture's rectangle; bars of black around it when the window's shape differs
    gfx_fit_rect(SRC_W, SRC_H, w, h, r);
    const uint32_t *p = (const uint32_t *)px;
    for (long k = 0, n = (long)w * h; k < n; k++) {
        int x = (int)(k % w), y = (int)(k / w);
        uint32_t e = x >= r[0] && x < r[0] + r[2] && y >= r[1] && y < r[1] + r[3] ? wv : black;
        if (p[k] != e) {
            printf("probe-window: frame %d pixel %ld (%d, %d) is %08x, expected %08x\n", i, k, x, y, p[k], e);
            return 4;
        }
    }
    *w_out = w;
    *h_out = h;
    return 0;
}

int probe_window(void) {
    if (!menu_font_check()) return fail("the menu's font check takes a damaged font or refuses a good one");
    gfx_window_start();
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!c) return fail("no Vulkan device");
    vk_present_capture(1);
    Source s = {0};
    if (!source_create(&s)) return fail("source image");

    int w = 0, h = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < FRAMES; i++)
        if (present_and_check(&s, i == 0, i, &w, &h)) return fail("presented pixels differ");
    printf("probe-window: %d presents, readback %dx%d exact\n", FRAMES, w, h);

    // Focus: synthetic focus loss and gain, delivered synchronously on the window thread.
    unsigned m0 = gfx_window_focus_messages();
    wsys_probe_focus(0);
    int off = gfx_window_focused();
    wsys_probe_focus(1);
    int on = gfx_window_focused();
    unsigned m1 = gfx_window_focus_messages();
    if (off != 0 || on != 1 || m1 - m0 != 2) {
        printf("probe-window: focus off=%d on=%d messages=%u\n", off, on, m1 - m0);
        return fail("focus");
    }
    printf("probe-window: focus off/on pushed 2 messages (15)\n");

    // Cursor release: Esc releases, a client click recaptures, a title bar activation releases (where the window system
    // reports one). The probe window may not be the foreground window, so this checks the release flag, not the capture.
    wsys_probe_escape();
    int esc = input_cursor_released();
    wsys_probe_click(0);
    int click = input_cursor_released();
    wsys_probe_click(1);
    int client = input_cursor_released();
    int caption = wsys_probe_click(2) ? input_cursor_released() : 1;
    wsys_probe_focus(0);
    wsys_probe_focus(1);
    int back = input_cursor_released();
    if (menu_is_open()) menu_toggle();   // Esc opened the menu: the presents below compare the bare game image
    if (!esc || click || client || !caption || back) {
        printf("probe-window: released esc=%d click=%d client=%d caption=%d reactivated=%d\n", esc, click, client, caption, back);
        return fail("cursor release");
    }
    printf("probe-window: cursor released by Esc and title bar activation, recaptured by a click\n");

    // Resize: the client area changes, the swapchain follows, presenting still reads back exact.
    gfx_window_resize(1280, 720);
    int cw = 0, ch = 0;
    wsys_client_size(&cw, &ch);
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
        if (present_and_check(&s, 0, FRAMES + i, &w, &h)) return fail("presents after resize");
    if (w != cw || h != ch) {
        printf("probe-window: readback %dx%d, client area %dx%d\n", w, h, cw, ch);
        return fail("swapchain size after resize");
    }
    printf("probe-window: resized to %dx%d, presents still exact\n", w, h);
    vk_present_capture(0);

    // Vsync: count ticks between two tick edges about 5 s apart.
    static volatile int32_t ticks;
    gfx_vsync_bind_counter(&ticks);
    long a = ticks;
    while (ticks == a) plat_sleep_ms(1);
    uint64_t t0 = plat_now_ns();
    long n0 = ticks;
    plat_sleep_ms(5000);
    long b = ticks;
    while (ticks == b) plat_sleep_ms(1);
    uint64_t t1 = plat_now_ns();
    long n1 = ticks;
    double rate = (double)(n1 - n0) * 1e9 / (double)(t1 - t0);
    printf("probe-window: vsync %ld ticks in %.3f s = %.3f Hz\n", n1 - n0, (double)(t1 - t0) / 1e9, rate);
    if (rate < 60.0 * 0.995 || rate > 60.0 * 1.005) return fail("vsync rate");

    source_destroy(&s);
    vk_shutdown();
    long errors = vk_validation_errors_total();
    if (errors) {
        printf("probe-window: FAILED (%ld validation errors)\n", errors);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("probe-window: passed (%d frames, %ld validation errors, vsync %.1f Hz)\n", FRAMES, errors, rate);
    return 0;
}

```

`runtime/gfx_window_sdl.c`:

```c
// The SDL3 back end of the window (gfx_wsys.h), for hosts without Win32: the window on a thread of its own that also
// runs SDL's event loop, F11 fullscreen (borderless, the desktop's mode), the settings TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE and
// TOTK_FULLSCREEN, the display's refresh rate, focus, the Vulkan surface. The swapchain and the present are
// gfx_present.c's. Keyboard and mouse events go to input_sdl.c and to the menu (ui/menu_sdl.cpp).
//
// SDL wants its video calls on the thread that initialised video, so this thread does them all: the others hand it
// work through run_on_window (a user event and a wait) or post a user event. Video is initialised before the window
// exists: the Vulkan instance asks for SDL's surface extensions first (gfx_window_vk_extensions), the window comes with
// gfx_window_start (wsys_open).
//
// TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE is in pixels. On a display that scales windows (Wayland, HiDPI) the window asks for its pixels in
// the display's units (SDL_GetWindowDisplayScale), and SDL reports mouse positions in those units: input_sdl.c and the
// menu scale them back (gfx_window_sdl_density).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <SDL3/SDL_vulkan.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "gfx_wsys.h"
#include "input.h"
#include "input_sdl.h"
#include "ui/menu.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

static SDL_Window *g_win;
static uint32_t g_ev_base;               // SDL_RegisterEvents: the user events below
enum { EV_RUN, EV_SETTINGS, EV_CLOSE, EV_COUNT };
static PlatEvent g_video_ready;          // manual-reset: SDL video is up (or failed)
static int g_video_ok;
static PlatOnce g_thread_once = PLAT_ONCE_INIT;
static uint32_t g_window_tid;            // the window thread, which runs the video calls
static volatile int32_t g_density_milli = 1000;   // pixels per window unit, x1000

// ---- work on the window thread
typedef struct {
    void (*fn)(void *arg);
    void *arg;
    PlatEvent done;
} RunReq;

static void run_on_window(void (*fn)(void *arg), void *arg) {
    if (plat_thread_id() == g_window_tid) {
        fn(arg);
        return;
    }
    RunReq r = {fn, arg};
    plat_event_init(&r.done, 1, 0);
    SDL_Event e = {.user = {.type = g_ev_base + EV_RUN, .data1 = &r}};
    if (!SDL_PushEvent(&e)) rt_fatal("gfx: cannot reach the window thread (%s)", SDL_GetError());
    plat_event_wait(&r.done);
}

static void post(int ev) {
    SDL_Event e = {.user = {.type = g_ev_base + (uint32_t)ev}};
    SDL_PushEvent(&e);
}

double gfx_window_sdl_density(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&g_density_milli, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) / 1000.0; }

SDL_Window *gfx_window_sdl(void) { return g_win; }

// ---- settings: size and fullscreen
static char g_applied_size[32];
static int g_applied_fs;

static void note_applied(void) {
    snprintf(g_applied_size, sizeof g_applied_size, "%s", cfg_value("TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE"));
    g_applied_fs = gfx_cfg_fullscreen();
}

static int is_fullscreen(void) { return (SDL_GetWindowFlags(g_win) & SDL_WINDOW_FULLSCREEN) != 0; }

// The display scale as a DPI, 96 at 100% (the menu's text size floor); 96 before the window exists.
unsigned gfx_window_dpi(void) {
    float scale = g_win ? SDL_GetWindowDisplayScale(g_win) : 0;
    return scale > 0 ? (unsigned)(scale * 96 + 0.5f) : 96;
}

// The window's size in its units for w x h pixels.
static void set_pixel_size(int w, int h) {
    float scale = SDL_GetWindowDisplayScale(g_win);
    if (!(scale > 0)) scale = 1;
    SDL_SetWindowSize(g_win, (int)(w / scale + 0.5f), (int)(h / scale + 0.5f));
}

static void set_fullscreen(int on) {
    input_cursor_suspend(1);
    SDL_SetWindowFullscreen(g_win, on);   // the desktop's mode: borderless over the display
    SDL_SyncWindow(g_win);
    input_cursor_suspend(0);
}

// Window thread: the window takes the size and fullscreen state of the settings when they changed. A window resized by
// hand keeps its size when another setting changes.
static void apply_settings(void) {
    int size_changed = strcmp(cfg_value("TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE"), g_applied_size) != 0, fs = gfx_cfg_fullscreen();
    int fs_changed = fs != g_applied_fs;
    note_applied();
    if (size_changed) {
        int w, h;
        gfx_cfg_window_size(&w, &h);
        if (is_fullscreen()) SDL_SetWindowFullscreen(g_win, false);
        set_pixel_size(w, h);
        if (is_fullscreen() || (fs && !fs_changed)) SDL_SetWindowFullscreen(g_win, true);
    }
    if (fs_changed && fs != is_fullscreen()) set_fullscreen(fs);
}

void gfx_window_apply_settings(void) {
    if (g_win) post(EV_SETTINGS);
}

void gfx_window_request_close(void) {
    if (g_win) post(EV_CLOSE);
}

// ---- the display's refresh rate and size
static void refresh_rate_update(void) {
    const SDL_DisplayMode *m = SDL_GetCurrentDisplayMode(SDL_GetDisplayForWindow(g_win));
    double hz = 0;
    if (m && m->refresh_rate_denominator) hz = (double)m->refresh_rate_numerator / m->refresh_rate_denominator;
    else if (m) hz = m->refresh_rate;
    gfx_window_set_refresh(hz);
}

int gfx_window_monitor_size(int *w, int *h) {
    if (!g_win) return 0;
    const SDL_DisplayMode *m = SDL_GetCurrentDisplayMode(SDL_GetDisplayForWindow(g_win));
    if (!m) return 0;
    *w = (int)(m->w * m->pixel_density + 0.5f);
    *h = (int)(m->h * m->pixel_density + 0.5f);
    return 1;
}

static void density_update(void) {
    float d = SDL_GetWindowPixelDensity(g_win);
    __atomic_store_n(&g_density_milli, (int32_t)((d > 0 ? d : 1) * 1000 + 0.5f), __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

// ---- the window thread
static void handle(const SDL_Event *e) {
    if (e->type == g_ev_base + EV_RUN) {
        RunReq *r = e->user.data1;
        r->fn(r->arg);
        plat_event_set(&r->done);
        return;
    }
    if (e->type == g_ev_base + EV_SETTINGS) {
        if (g_win) apply_settings();
        return;
    }
    if (e->type == g_ev_base + EV_CLOSE) gfx_window_closed();
    if (!g_win) return;
    input_sdl_event(e);
    menu_sdl_event(e);
    switch (e->type) {
    case SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN:
        if (e->key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_F11 && !e->key.repeat) {
            set_fullscreen(!is_fullscreen());
            cfg_set("TOTK_FULLSCREEN", is_fullscreen() ? "1" : "0");   // the menu shows it; the next start keeps it
            cfg_save();
            note_applied();
        }
        break;
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_PIXEL_SIZE_CHANGED:
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_RESIZED:
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_RESTORED:
        density_update();
        gfx_window_mark_dirty();
        break;
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_DISPLAY_CHANGED:
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_DISPLAY_SCALE_CHANGED:
    case SDL_EVENT_DISPLAY_CURRENT_MODE_CHANGED:
        density_update();
        refresh_rate_update();
        gfx_window_mark_dirty();
        break;
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FOCUS_GAINED:
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FOCUS_LOST:
        gfx_window_focus_changed(e->type == SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FOCUS_GAINED);
        break;
    case SDL_EVENT_QUIT:
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_CLOSE_REQUESTED:
        gfx_window_closed();
        break;
    }
}

static void window_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    g_window_tid = plat_thread_id();
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_APP_ID, "totk-recomp");   // Wayland's app id: the desktop file and the taskbar match it
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_VIDEO_ALLOW_SCREENSAVER, "0");
    g_video_ok = SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO);
    if (!g_video_ok) rt_log("gfx: SDL video init failed (%s)", SDL_GetError());
    // SDL's Vulkan queries need its Vulkan loader, which a window would load at creation: the instance and the device
    // are made before the window.
    else if (!SDL_Vulkan_LoadLibrary(NULL)) {
        rt_log("gfx: SDL cannot load Vulkan (%s)", SDL_GetError());
        g_video_ok = 0;
    } else {
        g_ev_base = SDL_RegisterEvents(EV_COUNT);
        rt_log("gfx: SDL %d.%d.%d, video driver %s", SDL_VERSIONNUM_MAJOR(SDL_GetVersion()),
               SDL_VERSIONNUM_MINOR(SDL_GetVersion()), SDL_VERSIONNUM_MICRO(SDL_GetVersion()), SDL_GetCurrentVideoDriver());
    }
    plat_event_set(&g_video_ready);
    if (!g_video_ok) return;
    for (;;) {
        SDL_Event e;
        if (SDL_WaitEventTimeout(&e, 100)) handle(&e);
        else input_sdl_idle();   // a cursor change requested from another thread meanwhile
    }
}

static void video_start(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    plat_event_init(&g_video_ready, 1, 0);
    if (!plat_thread_spawn(window_main, NULL, "window", 0)) rt_fatal("gfx: cannot start the window thread");
    plat_event_wait(&g_video_ready);
}

static int video_up(void) {
    plat_once(&g_thread_once, video_start, NULL);
    return g_video_ok;
}

int gfx_window_vk_extensions(const char **out, int max) {
    if (!video_up()) return 0;
    Uint32 n = 0;
    const char *const *ext = SDL_Vulkan_GetInstanceExtensions(&n);
    if (!ext) {
        rt_log("gfx: SDL_Vulkan_GetInstanceExtensions failed (%s)", SDL_GetError());
        return 0;
    }
    int k = 0;
    for (Uint32 i = 0; i < n && k < max; i++) out[k++] = ext[i];
    return k;
}

int gfx_window_vk_presentable(VkInstance inst, VkPhysicalDevice pd, uint32_t family) {
    return video_up() && SDL_Vulkan_GetPresentationSupport(inst, pd, family);
}

// ---- gfx_wsys.h
static int open_ok;

static void open_window(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    int w, h;
    gfx_cfg_window_size(&w, &h);
    g_win = SDL_CreateWindow("Mario Kart World", w, h, SDL_WINDOW_VULKAN | SDL_WINDOW_RESIZABLE | SDL_WINDOW_HIGH_PIXEL_DENSITY);
    if (!g_win) {
        rt_log("gfx: SDL_CreateWindow failed (%s)", SDL_GetError());
        return;
    }
    set_pixel_size(w, h);   // w x h were window units; the setting is in pixels
    density_update();
    note_applied();
    refresh_rate_update();
    if (cfg_get("TOTK_BACKGROUND_WINDOW")) rt_log("gfx: TOTK_BACKGROUND_WINDOW has no effect with SDL windows");
    if (gfx_cfg_fullscreen()) SDL_SetWindowFullscreen(g_win, true);
    SDL_SyncWindow(g_win);
    input_sdl_window(g_win);
    open_ok = 1;
}

int wsys_open(void) {
    if (!video_up()) return 0;
    if (!g_win) run_on_window(open_window, NULL);
    return open_ok;
}

typedef struct { VkInstance inst; VkSurfaceKHR surface; } SurfaceReq;

static void make_surface(void *arg) {
    SurfaceReq *r = arg;
    if (!SDL_Vulkan_CreateSurface(g_win, r->inst, NULL, &r->surface)) {
        rt_log("gfx: SDL_Vulkan_CreateSurface failed (%s)", SDL_GetError());
        r->surface = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
}

VkSurfaceKHR wsys_surface(VkInstance inst) {
    SurfaceReq r = {inst, VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    run_on_window(make_surface, &r);
    return r.surface;
}

void wsys_client_size(int *w, int *h) {
    *w = *h = 0;
    if (g_win) SDL_GetWindowSizeInPixels(g_win, w, h);
}

int wsys_minimized(void) { return g_win && (SDL_GetWindowFlags(g_win) & (SDL_WINDOW_MINIMIZED | SDL_WINDOW_HIDDEN)); }

static void resize_window(void *arg) {
    const int *wh = arg;
    set_pixel_size(wh[0], wh[1]);
    SDL_SyncWindow(g_win);
}

void wsys_resize(int w, int h) {
    int wh[2] = {w, h};
    run_on_window(resize_window, wh);
}

// ---- --probe-window: synthetic events through the event handler, on the window thread
static void probe_event(void *arg) { handle(arg); }

void wsys_probe_focus(int in) {
    SDL_Event e = {.window = {.type = in ? SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FOCUS_GAINED : SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FOCUS_LOST,
                              .windowID = SDL_GetWindowID(g_win)}};
    run_on_window(probe_event, &e);
}

void wsys_probe_escape(void) {
    SDL_Event e = {.key = {.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN, .scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE, .key = SDLK_ESCAPE, .down = true,
                           .windowID = SDL_GetWindowID(g_win)}};
    run_on_window(probe_event, &e);
    e.key.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_UP, e.key.down = false;
    run_on_window(probe_event, &e);
}

// SDL reports no activation by a title bar click: only the client click exists.
int wsys_probe_click(int where) {
    if (where == 2) return 0;
    SDL_Event e = {.button = {.type = SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN, .button = SDL_BUTTON_LEFT, .down = true,
                              .windowID = SDL_GetWindowID(g_win)}};
    run_on_window(probe_event, &e);
    e.button.type = SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_UP, e.button.down = false;
    run_on_window(probe_event, &e);
    return 1;
}

```

`runtime/gfx_window_win.c`:

```c
// The Win32 back end of the window (gfx_wsys.h): the window and its message loop on a thread of their own, F11
// fullscreen, the settings TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE and TOTK_FULLSCREEN, the monitor's refresh rate, focus, the Vulkan surface.
// The swapchain and the present are gfx_present.c's. The in-game menu's keyboard and mouse come from the window
// procedure (ui/menu_win.cpp), and so do the game's (input_win.c).
//
// The process is per-monitor DPI aware (totk.manifest): every size here is physical pixels, TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE included,
// and the swapchain matches the screen pixel for pixel. A window moved to a monitor at another display scale keeps its
// client size (WM_GETDPISCALEDSIZE); the menu takes its text size floor from the window's DPI (gfx_window_dpi).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <imm.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "flight.h"
#include "fs.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "gfx_wsys.h"
#include "input.h"
#include "input_win.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "ui/menu.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include <vulkan/vulkan_win32.h>

// ---- window state
static HWND g_hwnd;
static PlatEvent g_wnd_ready;   // manual-reset: the window thread made the window or gave up
static int g_wnd_failed;
static int g_background;                   // TOTK_BACKGROUND_WINDOW: the window stays behind the user's windows
static int g_fs_pending;                   // window thread: TOTK_FULLSCREEN waits for the first activation
static volatile int32_t g_dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;   // the window's DPI, set by the window thread

HWND gfx_window_handle(void) { return g_hwnd; }

int gfx_window_vk_extensions(const char **out, int max) {
    if (max < 2) return 0;
    out[0] = VK_KHR_SURFACE_EXTENSION_NAME;
    out[1] = VK_KHR_WIN32_SURFACE_EXTENSION_NAME;
    return 2;
}

int gfx_window_vk_presentable(VkInstance inst, VkPhysicalDevice pd, uint32_t family) {
    (void)inst;
    return vkGetPhysicalDeviceWin32PresentationSupportKHR(pd, family) != VK_FALSE;
}

// ---- window thread
#define WND_STYLE WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW
#define WM_APP_SETTINGS (WM_APP + 1)
#define WM_APP_FULLSCREEN (WM_APP + 2)   // the fullscreen setting, held back until the window is first activated

static WINDOWPLACEMENT g_saved_place = {sizeof g_saved_place};   // the window behind fullscreen (window thread)

static int is_fullscreen(HWND h) { return !(GetWindowLongW(h, GWL_STYLE) & WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW); }

#define cfg_fullscreen gfx_cfg_fullscreen
#define cfg_window_size gfx_cfg_window_size

unsigned gfx_window_dpi(void) { return (unsigned)plat_cas32(&g_dpi, 0, 0); }

// The outer size of a framed window whose client area is cw x ch. The frame is measured at the window's DPI, or the
// system DPI before the window exists: plain AdjustWindowRect always takes the system DPI, which is wrong on a monitor
// at another display scale.
static void outer_size(HWND h, int cw, int ch, int *ow, int *oh) {
    RECT r = {0, 0, cw, ch};
    AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&r, WND_STYLE, FALSE, 0, h ? GetDpiForWindow(h) : GetDpiForSystem());
    *ow = r.right - r.left;
    *oh = r.bottom - r.top;
}

// Windows turns the display off and sleeps after the idle timeout, and gamepad input does not count as activity. While
// the window is up and not minimized it holds the display and the system on, as other games do. The state belongs to
// the calling thread, so only the window thread (window_main and wnd_proc) calls this; the process exit releases it.
static void keep_awake(int on) {
    static int cur = -1;
    if (on == cur) return;
    cur = on;
    SetThreadExecutionState(on ? ES_CONTINUOUS | ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED | ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED : ES_CONTINUOUS);
}

// F11: borderless window over the whole monitor, and back to the saved window. The swapchain follows through WM_SIZE.
// Not Alt+Enter: Enter is the Plus button (input_win.c). A background window (test runs) keeps its place behind the
// user's windows and takes no focus.
static void toggle_fullscreen(HWND h) {
    LONG style = GetWindowLongW(h, GWL_STYLE);
    if (style & WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW) {
        MONITORINFO mi = {sizeof mi};
        if (!GetWindowPlacement(h, &g_saved_place) || !GetMonitorInfoW(MonitorFromWindow(h, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY), &mi))
            return;
        SetWindowLongW(h, GWL_STYLE, (style & ~WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW) | WS_POPUP);
        SetWindowPos(h, HWND_TOP, mi.rcMonitor.left, mi.rcMonitor.top, mi.rcMonitor.right - mi.rcMonitor.left,
                     mi.rcMonitor.bottom - mi.rcMonitor.top,
                     SWP_NOOWNERZORDER | SWP_FRAMECHANGED | (g_background ? SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE : 0));
    } else {
        SetWindowLongW(h, GWL_STYLE, (style & ~WS_POPUP) | WND_STYLE);
        if (g_background) g_saved_place.showCmd = SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE;
        SetWindowPlacement(h, &g_saved_place);
        SetWindowPos(h, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                     SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOOWNERZORDER | SWP_FRAMECHANGED |
                         (g_background ? SWP_NOACTIVATE : 0));
    }
}

// The window size and fullscreen state last taken from the settings (window thread). apply_settings acts on a change of
// either value only, so a window resized by hand keeps its size when another setting changes.
static char g_applied_size[32];
static int g_applied_fs;

static void note_applied(void) {
    snprintf(g_applied_size, sizeof g_applied_size, "%s", cfg_value("TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE"));
    g_applied_fs = cfg_fullscreen();
}

// Window thread: the window takes the size and fullscreen state of the settings when they changed. In fullscreen the
// size goes into the placement restored when fullscreen ends.
static void apply_settings(HWND h) {
    int size_changed = strcmp(cfg_value("TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE"), g_applied_size) != 0, fs = cfg_fullscreen(), fs_changed = fs != g_applied_fs;
    note_applied();
    if (size_changed) {
        int cw, ch, ow, oh;
        cfg_window_size(&cw, &ch);
        outer_size(h, cw, ch, &ow, &oh);
        if (is_fullscreen(h)) {
            RECT *n = &g_saved_place.rcNormalPosition;
            n->right = n->left + ow;
            n->bottom = n->top + oh;
        } else {
            RECT have;
            if (GetClientRect(h, &have) && (have.right != cw || have.bottom != ch)) {
                if (IsZoomed(h)) ShowWindow(h, SW_RESTORE);
                SetWindowPos(h, NULL, 0, 0, ow, oh, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
            }
        }
    }
    if (fs_changed && fs != is_fullscreen(h)) {
        input_cursor_suspend(1);
        toggle_fullscreen(h);
        input_cursor_suspend(0);
    }
}

void gfx_window_apply_settings(void) {
    if (g_hwnd) PostMessageW(g_hwnd, WM_APP_SETTINGS, 0, 0);
}


void gfx_window_request_close(void) {
    if (g_hwnd) PostMessageW(g_hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
}

// ---- refresh rate of the window's monitor (TOTK_FPS_LIMIT=display), measured when the window opens, lands on another
// monitor or the display mode changes (gfx_window_set_refresh keeps it). QueryDisplayConfig gives the exact rational
// rate (59.94, 143.998); EnumDisplaySettings' whole hertz is the fallback.
static HMONITOR g_rate_mon;

static double monitor_rate_hz(HMONITOR mon) {
    MONITORINFOEXW mi = {.cbSize = sizeof mi};
    if (!GetMonitorInfoW(mon, (MONITORINFO *)&mi)) return 0;
    double hz = 0;
    UINT32 np = 0, nm = 0;
    if (GetDisplayConfigBufferSizes(QDC_ONLY_ACTIVE_PATHS, &np, &nm) == ERROR_SUCCESS && np && nm) {
        DISPLAYCONFIG_PATH_INFO *paths = calloc(np, sizeof *paths);
        DISPLAYCONFIG_MODE_INFO *modes = calloc(nm, sizeof *modes);
        if (paths && modes && QueryDisplayConfig(QDC_ONLY_ACTIVE_PATHS, &np, paths, &nm, modes, NULL) == ERROR_SUCCESS)
            for (UINT32 i = 0; i < np && !hz; i++) {
                DISPLAYCONFIG_SOURCE_DEVICE_NAME src = {.header = {.type = DISPLAYCONFIG_DEVICE_INFO_GET_SOURCE_NAME,
                                                                   .size = sizeof src,
                                                                   .adapterId = paths[i].sourceInfo.adapterId,
                                                                   .id = paths[i].sourceInfo.id}};
                DISPLAYCONFIG_RATIONAL r = paths[i].targetInfo.refreshRate;
                if (DisplayConfigGetDeviceInfo(&src.header) == ERROR_SUCCESS && !wcscmp(src.viewGdiDeviceName, mi.szDevice) &&
                    r.Denominator)
                    hz = (double)r.Numerator / r.Denominator;
            }
        free(paths);
        free(modes);
    }
    DEVMODEW dm = {.dmSize = sizeof dm};
    if (!hz && EnumDisplaySettingsW(mi.szDevice, ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS, &dm) && dm.dmDisplayFrequency > 1)
        hz = dm.dmDisplayFrequency;   // 0 and 1 mean the hardware default
    return hz;
}

// Window thread. force: the display mode changed, measure even on the same monitor.
static void refresh_rate_update(HWND h, int force) {
    HMONITOR mon = MonitorFromWindow(h, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY);
    if (!force && mon == g_rate_mon) return;
    g_rate_mon = mon;
    gfx_window_set_refresh(monitor_rate_hz(mon));
}

int gfx_window_monitor_size(int *w, int *h) {
    MONITORINFO mi = {sizeof mi};
    if (!g_hwnd || !GetMonitorInfoW(MonitorFromWindow(g_hwnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY), &mi)) return 0;
    *w = mi.rcMonitor.right - mi.rcMonitor.left;
    *h = mi.rcMonitor.bottom - mi.rcMonitor.top;
    return 1;
}

void vk_dump_key(void);   // vk_dump.c: TOTK_DUMP=key
static LRESULT CALLBACK wnd_proc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    LRESULT input_res;
    if (m == WM_KEYDOWN && w == VK_F12 && !(l & (1 << 30))) vk_dump_key();
    if (input_window_msg(h, m, w, l, &input_res)) return input_res;
    if (menu_window_msg(h, m, w, l, &input_res)) return input_res;
    switch (m) {
    case WM_KEYDOWN:
        if (w == VK_F11 && !(l & (1 << 30))) {   // bit 30: auto-repeat
            input_cursor_suspend(1);
            toggle_fullscreen(h);
            input_cursor_suspend(0);
            cfg_set("TOTK_FULLSCREEN", is_fullscreen(h) ? "1" : "0");   // the menu shows it; the next start keeps it
            cfg_save();
            note_applied();   // what cfg_get reads now (the environment may still override it)
        }
        break;
    case WM_APP_SETTINGS:
        apply_settings(h);
        return 0;
    case WM_APP_FULLSCREEN:
        if (cfg_fullscreen() && !is_fullscreen(h)) {
            input_cursor_suspend(1);
            toggle_fullscreen(h);
            input_cursor_suspend(0);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:
        keep_awake(w != SIZE_MINIMIZED);
        if (w != SIZE_MINIMIZED) gfx_window_mark_dirty();
        refresh_rate_update(h, 0);
        return 0;
    case WM_EXITSIZEMOVE:   // dragged onto another monitor
        refresh_rate_update(h, 0);
        break;
    case WM_DISPLAYCHANGE:
        refresh_rate_update(h, 1);
        break;
    case WM_GETDPISCALEDSIZE:   // a framed window keeps its client size in pixels on a monitor at another scale
        if (!is_fullscreen(h) && !IsZoomed(h)) {
            RECT c, r;
            if (GetClientRect(h, &c)) {
                r = (RECT){0, 0, c.right, c.bottom};
                if (AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&r, WND_STYLE, FALSE, 0, LOWORD(w))) {
                    *(SIZE *)l = (SIZE){r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top};
                    return TRUE;
                }
            }
        }
        break;   // DefWindowProc: Windows scales the size with the DPI
    case WM_DPICHANGED: {   // display scale changed, or the window reached a monitor at another scale
        const RECT *s = (const RECT *)l;
        plat_xchg32(&g_dpi, LOWORD(w));
        rt_log("gfx: window DPI %u (%u%%)", LOWORD(w), LOWORD(w) * 100u / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
        if (is_fullscreen(h)) {   // keep covering the monitor the suggested rect lies on
            MONITORINFO mi = {sizeof mi};
            if (GetMonitorInfoW(MonitorFromRect(s, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST), &mi))
                SetWindowPos(h, NULL, mi.rcMonitor.left, mi.rcMonitor.top, mi.rcMonitor.right - mi.rcMonitor.left,
                             mi.rcMonitor.bottom - mi.rcMonitor.top, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
        } else {
            SetWindowPos(h, NULL, s->left, s->top, s->right - s->left, s->bottom - s->top, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_ACTIVATEAPP: {
        int in = w != 0;
        gfx_window_focus_changed(in);
        if (in && g_fs_pending) {
            g_fs_pending = 0;
            PostMessageW(h, WM_APP_FULLSCREEN, 0, 0);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_CLOSE:
        gfx_window_closed();
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}

// Brings the game window to the front. Windows refuses SetForegroundWindow to a process that was not the last to get
// input, which is the case for a game started by a frontend; attaching this thread's input queue to the foreground
// window's thread for the call is the documented way around it. The window is not left topmost.
static void raise_window(HWND h) {
    HWND fg = GetForegroundWindow();
    DWORD me = GetCurrentThreadId(), other = fg ? GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg, NULL) : 0;
    int attached = other && other != me && AttachThreadInput(me, other, TRUE);
    ShowWindow(h, IsIconic(h) ? SW_RESTORE : SW_SHOW);
    BringWindowToTop(h);
    SetForegroundWindow(h);
    SetActiveWindow(h);
    if (attached) AttachThreadInput(me, other, FALSE);
    if (GetForegroundWindow() != h) {   // still refused: a topmost toggle puts it above the others without keeping it there
        SetWindowPos(h, HWND_TOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE);
        SetWindowPos(h, HWND_NOTOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE);
    }
}

static void window_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    HINSTANCE inst = GetModuleHandleW(NULL);
    // Icon resource 1 of totk.rc (runtime/totk.ico): the title bar, the taskbar button and Alt+Tab.
    WNDCLASSEXW wc = {.cbSize = sizeof wc, .lpfnWndProc = wnd_proc, .hInstance = inst,
                      .hIcon = LoadImageW(inst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(1), IMAGE_ICON, GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXICON),
                                          GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYICON), LR_SHARED),
                      .hIconSm = LoadImageW(inst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(1), IMAGE_ICON, GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSMICON),
                                            GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSMICON), LR_SHARED),
                      .hCursor = LoadCursorW(NULL, (LPCWSTR)IDC_ARROW), .lpszClassName = L"MarioKartWorldWindow"};
    RegisterClassExW(&wc);
    int cw, ch, ow, oh;
    cfg_window_size(&cw, &ch);
    outer_size(NULL, cw, ch, &ow, &oh);
    // The window opens behind the user's windows without taking focus: it shows the game's blank loading frames for a
    // while, and must not cover what the player works on meanwhile. The game still counts itself in focus until the
    // first WM_ACTIVATEAPP, so loading goes on, and keyboard input waits for the foreground (input_win.c). Its taskbar
    // button flashes until it is brought up, and TOTK_FULLSCREEN waits for that first activation.
    // TOTK_BACKGROUND_WINDOW=1 (test runs): no flashing, never fullscreen at start, and F11 keeps the window's place.
    int background = g_background = cfg_get("TOTK_BACKGROUND_WINDOW") && atoi(cfg_get("TOTK_BACKGROUND_WINDOW"));
    g_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, wc.lpszClassName, L"Mario Kart World", WND_STYLE, CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, ow, oh, NULL,
                             NULL, inst, NULL);
    if (!g_hwnd) {
        rt_log("gfx: CreateWindowEx failed (%lu)", GetLastError());
        g_wnd_failed = 1;
    } else {
        // An IME switched on over the game attaches to this window and then shows its candidate window and eats the keys
        // it composes, although there is nothing here to type into (a Chinese IME takes Shift, the B button by default).
        // Detaching the game's window leaves the software keyboard alone: its edit box sits in a window of its own
        // (swkbd_win.c) and gets the IME it needs.
        ImmAssociateContext(g_hwnd, NULL);
        // The frame was measured at the system DPI; the window may have opened on a monitor at another scale.
        plat_xchg32(&g_dpi, (int32_t)GetDpiForWindow(g_hwnd));
        outer_size(g_hwnd, cw, ch, &ow, &oh);
        SetWindowPos(g_hwnd, HWND_BOTTOM, 0, 0, ow, oh, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW);
        if (!background) {
            g_fs_pending = cfg_fullscreen();
            raise_window(g_hwnd);   // a frontend's player may have no way to reach a window left behind
            FLASHWINFO fw = {.cbSize = sizeof fw, .hwnd = g_hwnd, .dwFlags = FLASHW_TRAY | FLASHW_TIMERNOFG};
            FlashWindowEx(&fw);
            if (g_fs_pending) {
                g_fs_pending = 0;
                PostMessageW(g_hwnd, WM_APP_FULLSCREEN, 0, 0);
            }
        }
        note_applied();
        refresh_rate_update(g_hwnd, 1);
        keep_awake(1);
    }
    plat_event_set(&g_wnd_ready);
    if (g_wnd_failed) return;
    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessageW(&msg, NULL, 0, 0) > 0) {
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessageW(&msg);
    }
    return;
}

// ---- gfx_wsys.h
// Makes the window on its thread and waits until it is there.
int wsys_open(void) {
    g_wnd_failed = 0;
    plat_event_init(&g_wnd_ready, 1, 0);
    if (!plat_thread_spawn(window_main, NULL, "window", 0)) rt_fatal("gfx: cannot start the window thread");
    plat_event_wait(&g_wnd_ready);
    return !g_wnd_failed;
}

VkSurfaceKHR wsys_surface(VkInstance inst) {
    VkWin32SurfaceCreateInfoKHR si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WIN32_SURFACE_CREATE_INFO_KHR,
                                      .hinstance = GetModuleHandleW(NULL), .hwnd = g_hwnd};
    VkSurfaceKHR surface = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkResult r = vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR(inst, &si, NULL, &surface);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) rt_log("gfx: vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR failed (%d)", (int)r);
    return r == VK_SUCCESS ? surface : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
}

void wsys_client_size(int *w, int *h) {
    RECT rc = {0};
    GetClientRect(g_hwnd, &rc);
    *w = rc.right, *h = rc.bottom;
}

int wsys_minimized(void) { return IsIconic(g_hwnd) != 0; }

void wsys_resize(int cw, int ch) {
    int ow, oh;
    outer_size(g_hwnd, cw, ch, &ow, &oh);
    SetWindowPos(g_hwnd, NULL, 0, 0, ow, oh, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
}

void wsys_probe_focus(int in) { SendMessageW(g_hwnd, WM_ACTIVATEAPP, in ? TRUE : FALSE, 0); }

void wsys_probe_escape(void) { SendMessageW(g_hwnd, WM_KEYDOWN, VK_ESCAPE, 0); }

int wsys_probe_click(int where) {
    if (where == 0) SendMessageW(g_hwnd, WM_LBUTTONDOWN, MK_LBUTTON, 0);
    else SendMessageW(g_hwnd, WM_MOUSEACTIVATE, (WPARAM)g_hwnd, MAKELPARAM(where == 1 ? HTCLIENT : HTCAPTION, WM_LBUTTONDOWN));
    return 1;
}

```

`runtime/gfx_wsys.h`:

```h
// Between gfx_present.c (swapchain, present, vsync) and the window system's back end (gfx_window_win.c with Win32,
// gfx_window_sdl.c with SDL). Host threads only.
#pragma once
#include "vk.h"

// ---- what the back end provides
int wsys_open(void);                       // makes the window (and its thread); 0 on failure. Once.
VkSurfaceKHR wsys_surface(VkInstance inst);   // a new Vulkan surface of the window; VK_NULL_HANDLE on failure
void wsys_client_size(int *w, int *h);     // the drawable area in pixels
int wsys_minimized(void);                  // nothing to present into
void wsys_resize(int w, int h);            // gfx_window_resize: the drawable area becomes w x h
// --probe-window (gfx_window_probe.c): synthetic window events, handled on the window thread before these return.
void wsys_probe_focus(int in);             // the window gains (1) or loses (0) the focus
void wsys_probe_escape(void);              // Esc pressed
// A left click: 0 in the client area, 1 activating the window from its client area, 2 activating it from the title bar.
// 0 when the window system has no such event (then the caller skips that check).
int wsys_probe_click(int where);

// ---- what gfx_present.c provides the back end
void gfx_window_mark_dirty(void);          // the window changed size: the next present rebuilds the swapchain
void gfx_window_focus_changed(int in);     // the window gained (1) or lost (0) the focus
void gfx_window_closed(void);              // the player closed the window: saves, then ends the process
void gfx_window_set_refresh(double hz);    // the refresh rate of the window's monitor, 0 unknown
int gfx_cfg_fullscreen(void);              // TOTK_FULLSCREEN
void gfx_cfg_window_size(int *w, int *h);  // TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE, the default when unparsable or out of range

```

`runtime/host.h`:

```h
// Interface of the host runtime: guest memory, modules, kernel, IPC, file system and boot.
//
// Guest addresses are host addresses. Every guest-visible region lies below 2^39 (IPC buffer descriptors carry 39
// address bits). Fixed parts of the guest address map:
//   modules           MOD_<X>_BASE from layout.h, from 0x70_0000_0000
//   kernel region     RT_KERNEL_BASE, 256 MiB: TLR, TLS blocks, host objects the guest reads (mem_kernel_alloc)
//   host functions    RT_HOSTFN_BASE, 1 MiB, never accessible: synthetic addresses of host functions
// The stack, heap and alias regions are placed at start-up (mem_layout).
#pragma once
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cpu.h"
#include "dispatch.h"

// ---- logging and results
void rt_log(const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));   // "[host] <msg>\n" to the log, one write
// The log is stderr plus, in a game run whose stderr is not a file, logs\totk.log next to totk.exe (main.c log_open).
// rt_logf and rt_log_raw write to both without the prefix and the newline: crash reports, fatal errors, guest output.
void rt_logf(const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
void rt_vlogf(const char *fmt, va_list ap);
void rt_log_raw(const char *p, size_t n);
const char *rt_log_path(void);                  // the log file, NULL when this run writes none
enum { RT_TRACE_SVC = 1, RT_TRACE_HOSTCALL = 2, RT_TRACE_IPC = 4, RT_TRACE_FS = 8, RT_TRACE_GFX = 16, RT_TRACE_PERF = 32,
       RT_TRACE_SCHED = 64, RT_TRACE_AUDIO = 128, RT_TRACE_PRESENT = 256, RT_TRACE_CODEC = 512 };
extern unsigned rt_trace;                       // from TOTK_TRACE=svc,host,ipc,fs,gfx,perf,sched,audio,present,codec (or all)
// prof_win.c: TOTK_PROFILE=<path> sampling profiler; TOTK_TRACE=perf frame timing (waits of the render thread)
// PERF_TEX: texture uploads on the render thread (deswizzle, decode, staging), PERF_ASTC included
enum { PERF_PACE, PERF_FENCE, PERF_DRAIN, PERF_PIPE, PERF_XLATE, PERF_TEX, PERF_ASTC, PERF_N };
void prof_start(void);
void prof_write(void);                          // idempotent; boot.c calls it before _exit
uint64_t perf_begin(void);                      // start time of a wait; pair with perf_end
void perf_end(int kind, uint64_t t0);           // counts render-thread time only
void perf_replay(uint64_t t0);                  // replay (NVN -> Vulkan recording) time on any thread, waits inside it included
void perf_replay_thread(void);                  // the calling thread replays for the render thread: perf_end counts its waits
void perf_main_thread(void);                    // the calling thread is the guest main thread (TOTK_PROFILE_MAIN)
// Events per 60-frame window: graphics pipelines finished by the background workers, draws skipped while pending,
// first texture uploads and re-uploads after CPU writes, draws skipped while a shader translates in the background,
// draws that waited for their pending pipeline and got it, draws into a target the previous frame did not render that
// waited for their pending shader or pipeline instead of being skipped (vk_exec_draw.c prepare_draw). The rest feed only
// the flight recorder (flight.c): graphics pipelines created on any thread, texture images created, images created at an
// address where a live image of another descriptor already starts, write-backs done and skipped because the CPU
// rewrote the storage after the GPU render (vk_texture.c vk_texture_write_back).
enum { PERF_CNT_PIPE_ASYNC, PERF_CNT_PIPE_SKIP, PERF_CNT_TEX_UP, PERF_CNT_TEX_REUP, PERF_CNT_SHADER_SKIP,
       PERF_CNT_PIPE_WAIT, PERF_CNT_ONESHOT_WAIT, PERF_CNT_PIPE_BUILT, PERF_CNT_TEX_NEW, PERF_CNT_TEX_ALIAS,
       PERF_CNT_WB, PERF_CNT_WB_SKIP, PERF_CNT_N };
void perf_count(int kind);
void perf_present(uint64_t frame);
void perf_summary_flush(void);                  // prints the frame-time summary of the running period (exit); the 60 s lines come from perf_present
void gfx_exit_log(void);                        // back end's lines for the exit summary (weak no-op in prof_win.c)
int vk_backend_selftest(void);                  // replay write-back deduplication cases; failures (vk_backend.c)
void perf_gpu_wait(uint64_t t0);                // a wait for a GPU fence ended (any thread; the render thread's also counts as PERF_FENCE)
// GPU side of the 60-frame perf line, filled by the graphics back end when it set perf_gpu_stats. gpu_ns: GPU busy time
// since the previous call (timestamp queries, overlaps counted once), have_gpu 0 when the device has no timestamps.
typedef struct {
    int have_gpu, have_vram, vram_exact;
    uint64_t gpu_ns, gpu_parts, gpu_missed;     // busy time, submission parts timed, parts left untimed
    uint64_t vram_used, vram_budget;
    uint64_t up_gpu_ns, up_timed, up_batches, up_wait_ns, up_bytes;   // upload batches (vk_memory.c, vk_upload_perf)
} PerfGpu;
extern void (*perf_gpu_stats)(PerfGpu *out);
// The performance overlay (perfmon.c): mode 0 off, 1 fps, 2 full. While it is on, perf_present hands every frame to
// perfmon_frame; full also takes the event counts (perf_count) and the GPU timestamps as TOTK_TRACE=perf does.
void perf_set_overlay(int mode);
int perf_gpu_timing(void);                      // GPU timestamps wanted: TOTK_TRACE=perf or the full overlay
void perf_gpu_busy(uint64_t ns);                // GPU busy time of a timed submission part (vk_sync.c, any thread)
void perf_present_gpu(uint64_t ns);             // GPU time of one present submission (gfx_present.c), for the perf line
uint64_t perf_gpu_busy_total(void);             // its running total (the overlay's GPU time per frame)
#define RT_RESULT(module, desc) ((uint32_t)(module) | ((uint32_t)(desc) << 9))
void rt_sha256(const void *p, size_t n, uint8_t out[32]);   // BCrypt; fatal if the provider fails

// ---- guest address map (fixed part)
#define RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT (1ull << 39)
#define RT_KERNEL_BASE 0x7010000000ull
#define RT_KERNEL_SIZE 0x10000000ull
#define RT_HOSTFN_BASE 0x7020000000ull
// The game's application/program id (main.npdm ACI0): the NVN 2 reference title. GetInfo 18 returns it and save data is
// kept for it alone.
extern const uint64_t rt_application_id;
#define RT_APPLICATION_ID rt_application_id
#define RT_HOSTFN_SIZE 0x100000ull

// ---- AAPCS64 argument access for host functions (section 2.2)
static inline uint64_t arg_x(const Cpu *c, int i) { return i < 8 ? c->x[i] : LD64(c->sp + 8 * (uint64_t)(i - 8)); }
static inline void *arg_p(const Cpu *c, int i) { return (void *)(uintptr_t)arg_x(c, i); }
static inline float arg_s(const Cpu *c, int i) { uint32_t b = (uint32_t)c->v[i]; float f; memcpy(&f, &b, 4); return f; }
static inline double arg_d(const Cpu *c, int i) { uint64_t b = (uint64_t)c->v[i]; double d; memcpy(&d, &b, 8); return d; }
static inline void ret_x(Cpu *c, uint64_t v) { c->x[0] = v; }
static inline void ret_s(Cpu *c, float f) { uint32_t b; memcpy(&b, &f, 4); c->v[0] = b; }
static inline void ret_d(Cpu *c, double d) { uint64_t b; memcpy(&b, &d, 8); c->v[0] = b; }

// ---- host functions (hostfn.c)
// Every host function is a GuestFn at a synthetic address RT_HOSTFN_BASE + 16*i. It runs on the calling guest thread,
// may clobber x0-x18, v0-v7, v16-v31, must preserve x19-x29, sp, v8-v15, tpidr, and returns to the guest BL site with
// a C return. On entry c->pc holds the function's own synthetic address.
typedef struct { const char *name; GuestFn fn; } RtHostEntry;
#define RT_CAT2(a, b) a##b
#define RT_CAT(a, b) RT_CAT2(a, b)
// File-scope declarations; fn must be declared before. The loader binds them by symbol name. The entries of every
// object file meet in one section per kind, which hostfn.c walks: on PE/COFF ".ovr$m", which the linker sorts between
// hostfn.c's ".ovr$a" and ".ovr$z" markers; on ELF "totk_ovr", which the linker brackets with __start_totk_ovr and
// __stop_totk_ovr.
#ifdef _WIN32
#define RT_HOST_SECTION(kind) section("." #kind "$m")
#else
#define RT_HOST_SECTION(kind) section("totk_" #kind)
#endif
#define HOST_OVERRIDE(sym, fn) /* replaces sym in every GOT/GLOB_DAT/ABS64 of every module */                  \
    __attribute__((used, RT_HOST_SECTION(ovr))) static const RtHostEntry RT_CAT(rt_ovr_, __COUNTER__) = {sym, fn}
#define HOST_OBSERVER(sym, fn) /* JUMP_SLOT only; fn calls rt_original(c) */                                    \
    __attribute__((used, RT_HOST_SECTION(obs))) static const RtHostEntry RT_CAT(rt_obs_, __COUNTER__) = {sym, fn}
uint64_t hostfn_register(const char *name, GuestFn fn);    // synthetic address; before hostfn_seal only. The same
                                                           // (name, fn) pair returns the same address
GuestFn hostfn_override(const char *name);                 // NULL if none
GuestFn hostfn_observer(const char *name);                 // NULL if none
void hostfn_add_override(const char *name, GuestFn fn);    // an override outside the linker table (probes); before
                                                           // ldr_load
const char *hostfn_name(uint64_t addr);                    // name registered at a synthetic address, NULL if none
void hostfn_seal(void);                                    // build the dispatch table (rt_dispatch_init over every
                                                           // linked module); idempotent; registration ends here
uint64_t hostfn_calls(void);                               // host-function calls so far, all threads
void hostfn_report(void);                                  // call count per host function to stderr, busiest first
int hostfn_table_size(int observers);                      // linked HOST_OVERRIDE (0) / HOST_OBSERVER (1) entries
const char *hostfn_table_name(int observers, int i);       // symbol of linked entry i, NULL past the end
uint64_t rt_original(Cpu *c);                              // inside an observer: call the guest definition with the
                                                           // current x0..x7, return x0. Uses c->pc, so call it before
                                                           // anything that changes c->pc (rt_call restores it)
uint64_t rt_call(Cpu *c, uint64_t fn, int n, ...);         // host -> guest, section 2.3. n <= 8 arguments, each read
                                                           // as uint64_t: cast every argument. Seals the dispatch
                                                           // table on first use. Sets x30 = RT_RET_HOST, restores
                                                           // x30 and pc, returns x0. Does not touch sp
#define RT_RET_HOST 0x70200ff000ull                        // x30 sentinel inside the host-function window; a jump to
                                                           // it is a named fatal

// ---- guest memory (memory.c)
typedef struct { uint64_t base, size; } RtRange;
typedef struct { RtRange aslr, stack, heap, alias, kernel, hostfn; uint64_t pool; } RtGuestLayout;
typedef struct { uint64_t base, size; uint32_t state, attr, perm, ipc, device, pad; } RtMemoryInfo;   // Horizon layout
void mem_init(void);                                       // reserve every region; on a collision re-run the process
                                                           // (up to 20 times, TOTK_REEXEC), then fatal
const RtGuestLayout *mem_layout(void);
uint32_t mem_set_heap_size(uint64_t size, uint64_t *addr);                      // 0x01
void mem_expand_heap(uint64_t new_end);
uint32_t mem_set_permission(uint64_t a, uint64_t n, uint32_t perm);             // 0x02
uint32_t mem_set_attribute(uint64_t a, uint64_t n, uint32_t mask, uint32_t at); // 0x03
uint32_t mem_map(uint64_t dst, uint64_t src, uint64_t n);                       // 0x04
uint32_t mem_unmap(uint64_t dst, uint64_t src, uint64_t n);                     // 0x05
uint32_t mem_query(uint64_t a, RtMemoryInfo *out);                              // 0x06
uint32_t mem_map_physical(uint64_t a, uint64_t n);                              // 0x2C
uint32_t mem_unmap_physical(uint64_t a, uint64_t n);                            // 0x2D
int mem_info(uint32_t id, uint64_t *out);                  // GetInfo memory ids 2-7, 12-17, 21, 22, 28; 0 if not a memory id
void *mem_kernel_alloc(uint64_t size, uint64_t align);     // zeroed, guest-visible, in the kernel region; align <= 64 KiB
uint64_t mem_written_pages(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *pages, uint64_t max);
                                                           // GetWriteWatch(RESET): fills pages[] (4 KiB addresses)
                                                           // with the pages of [addr, addr+size) written since the
                                                           // last call, returns their count (at most max; a page
                                                           // past max stays reported next time). The range must lie
                                                           // inside the stack/heap block or the alias region
                                                           // (write watch); otherwise returns UINT64_MAX
uint64_t mem_written_peek(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *pages, uint64_t max);
                                                           // the same without the reset: the bits stay for the next
                                                           // mem_written_pages (verify checks only)
int mem_freeze(uint64_t a);                                // makes the 2 MiB region at a (2 MiB aligned, watched,
                                                           // committed PAGE_READWRITE) read-only until a write or
                                                           // mem_thaw thaws it; 1 frozen (or already), 0 refused
int mem_frozen(uint64_t a);                                // the 2 MiB region of a is frozen: no page in it changed
                                                           // since its freeze
void mem_thaw(uint64_t a, uint64_t n);                     // makes the frozen regions over [a, a+n) writable again;
                                                           // before a kernel write (file read) into guest memory
void mem_freeze_stats(uint64_t *frozen, uint64_t *freezes, uint64_t *fault_thaws, uint64_t *other_thaws);
                                                           // regions frozen now; freezes and thaws since the last call
void mem_kernel_free(void *p, uint64_t size);              // TLR/TLS reuse after thread exit

// ---- modules (loader.c)
typedef struct {
    const char *name; uint64_t base, size, text_end, data_off;   // text_end, data_off: offsets from base
    uint64_t init, init_array, init_array_size, ctor_flag;  // absolute guest addresses; init_array_size in bytes
} RtLoaded;
void ldr_load(const char *exefs_dir);                      // load, relocate (overrides applied), seal; once
int ldr_count(void);

                                                           // modules.c (fatal on mismatch); free() it

// Written by tools/build_game.py into build/<version>/modules.c.
typedef struct { const char *file, *sha256; } RtFileHash;

extern const int rt_exefs_sha256_count;

#define RT_V111 (rt_game_version == 111)                    // 1.1.1: its own boot constants and data slots
#define RT_V143 (rt_game_version >= 143)

typedef struct RtThread RtThread;

                                                           // (main.npdm: 1 MiB stack at the top of the stack region,
                                                           // priority 44, core 0); on the main thread: its handle

                                                           // svc.c reports it to QueryMemory, memory.c does not know it

void kern_core_back(int *away);
void kern_checkpoint(void);                                // preemption point, at every SVC and indirect call
// A preempt request is pending for the thread (Cpu.thread): its RtThread starts with the flag (kernel.c).
static inline int kern_preempt_pending(const void *thread) { return __atomic_load_n((const int *)thread, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); }
// Set once before guest threads start (TOTK_CORE_DIAG, TOTK_ASYNC_PREEMPT): host calls (hostfn.c) and SVCs (svc.c) count their depth in
// the thread's second int, so the kernel knows whether a core owner runs game code at the top level.
extern int kern_host_track;
static inline int *kern_host_depth(void *thread) { return (int *)thread + 1; }

                                                           // (TOTK_FPS_LIMIT, live)
uint64_t frame_step_ticks(void);                           // game time since the first present in 60 Hz ticks (input scripts)
// In-launch A/B measurement: TOTK_AB=<seconds> splits the world clock (frame_step_world_us) into blocks of that much
// game time in the order A B B A (repeated); rt_ab() is 1 in the B blocks, 0 in A blocks, before the world clock and
// without TOTK_AB. rt_knob(name, def) reads the switch
// TOTK_<name> once per call (def when unset): 0 off, 2 for "ab" (on in the B blocks only), 1 for anything else;
// callers keep it and test it with RT_KNOB_ON. The perf line counts the B frames of its window (tools/ab_summary.py
// compares the windows that are wholly A or wholly B).
int rt_ab(void);

                                                           // present interval (60 Hz ticks)
// ---- boot (boot.c, main.c)
```
