```c
        RtThread *t = cur(imm);
        if (ns > 0) {
            lock();
            core_put(t);
            acct(t, S_SLEEP);
            t->wobj = (uint64_t)ns;
            t->nblk++;
            unlock();
            uint64_t t0 = kern_now_ns();
            sleep_ns(t, ns);
            uint64_t took = kern_now_ns() - t0;
            lock();
            t->sl_n++;
            t->sl_req += (uint64_t)ns;
            t->sl_act += took;
            core_take(t);
            unlock();
            return 1;
        }
        // Yield: hand the core to a waiting thread of equal or better priority.
        lock();
        int give = 0;
        int tp = prio_of(t);
        for (RtThread *w = g_core_wait; w && !give; w = w->cnext)
            give = t->cur_core >= 0 && core_allowed(w, t->cur_core) && prio_of(w) <= tp;
        if (give) {
            core_put(t);
            core_take(t);
        }
        unlock();
        if (!give) plat_yield();
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x0C: {   // GetThreadPriority(w1 handle -> w1)
        lock();
        RtThread *t = h_get((uint32_t)x[1], O_THREAD);
        x[0] = t ? R_OK : R_BAD_HANDLE;
        if (t) x[1] = (uint64_t)t->prio;
        unlock();
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x0D: {   // SetThreadPriority(w0 handle, w1 priority)
        if ((uint32_t)x[1] < 28 || (uint32_t)x[1] > 59) {
            x[0] = R_BAD_STATE;
            return 1;
        }
        lock();
        RtThread *t = h_get((uint32_t)x[0], O_THREAD);
        if (t) t->prio = (int)x[1];
        x[0] = t ? R_OK : R_BAD_HANDLE;
        unlock();
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x0E: {   // GetThreadCoreMask(w2 handle -> w1 core, x2 mask)
        lock();
        RtThread *t = h_get((uint32_t)x[2], O_THREAD);
        x[0] = t ? R_OK : R_BAD_HANDLE;
        if (t) {
            x[1] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)t->core;
            x[2] = t->mask;
        }
        unlock();
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x0F: {   // SetThreadCoreMask(w0 handle, w1 ideal core, x2 mask): -1 process default, -2/-3 keep the ideal core
        lock();
        RtThread *t = h_get((uint32_t)x[0], O_THREAD);
        if (t) {
            int core = (int)x[1];
            if (core >= 0) t->core = core;
            else if (core == -1) t->core = MAIN_CORE;
            if (x[2]) t->mask = x[2];
            if (t == tcur && t->cur_core >= 0 && !core_allowed(t, t->cur_core)) {   // move off a forbidden core
                core_put(t);
                core_take(t);
            }
        }
        x[0] = t ? R_OK : R_BAD_HANDLE;
        unlock();
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x10: {   // GetCurrentProcessorNumber: the virtual core held
        RtThread *t = cur(imm);
        x[0] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(t->cur_core >= 0 ? t->cur_core : t->core);
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x36: {   // SynchronizePreemptionState: the SDK's spin locks call it after clearing TLR+0x100 (disable_count)
                   // when TLR+0x102 (interrupt_flag) is set; rt_svc's checkpoint has already honoured a pending preempt
        RtThread *t = cur(imm);
        volatile uint16_t *flag = (volatile uint16_t *)(t->tlr + 0x102);
        __atomic_fetch_add(&g_sync36, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        if (*flag) __atomic_fetch_add(&g_sync36_flag, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        *flag = 0;
        ap_sync(t);
        x[0] = R_OK;
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x25: {   // GetThreadId(w1 handle -> x1)
        lock();
        RtThread *t = h_get((uint32_t)x[1], O_THREAD);
        x[0] = t ? R_OK : R_BAD_HANDLE;
        if (t) x[1] = t->id;
        unlock();
        return 1;
    }

    case 0x1A: {   // ArbitrateLock(w0 owner handle, x1 address, w2 tag)
        RtThread *t = cur(imm);
        uint64_t addr = x[1];
        uint32_t r = R_OK;
        lock();
        if (ld32(addr) == ((uint32_t)x[0] | WAITERS_BIT)) {
            t->waddr = addr;
            t->wtag = (uint32_t)x[2];
            t->wobj = (uint32_t)x[0];
            r = block(t, W_LOCK, -1);
        }
        unlock();
        x[0] = r;
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x1B:   // ArbitrateUnlock(x0 address)
        lock();
        lock_handoff(x[0]);
        unlock();
        x[0] = R_OK;
        return 1;
    case 0x1C: {   // WaitProcessWideKeyAtomic(x0 lock, x1 key, w2 tag, x3 timeout)
        // The key is set before the lock is released. The SDK's Signal reads the key in user mode and skips svc 0x1D
        // when it is 0, and user mode takes the lock without G: releasing first lets another thread take the lock,
        // change the condition, read key 0 and wake nobody, after which this thread waits forever (MNG threads.c
        // 439-446). Linking into the wait list happens in block, still holding G, so svc 0x1D cannot come between.
        RtThread *t = cur(imm);
        uint64_t addr = x[0], key = x[1];
        lock();
        if (!kern_test_cv_old_order) {
            st32(key, 1);
            t->wkey = key;
            t->waddr = addr;
            t->wtag = (uint32_t)x[2];
            lock_handoff(addr);
            cv_hook();
        } else {   // the probe's negative control: MNG's pre-fix order
            lock_handoff(addr);
            cv_hook();
            st32(key, 1);
            t->wkey = key;
            t->waddr = addr;
            t->wtag = (uint32_t)x[2];
        }
        t->wobj = key;
        uint32_t r = block(t, W_CONDVAR, (int64_t)x[3]);   // on timeout user mode takes the lock itself
        unlock();
        x[0] = r;
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x1D: {   // SignalProcessWideKey(x0 key, w1 count; <= 0 all)
        uint64_t key = x[0];
        int cnt = (int)x[1], n = 0;
        lock();
        for (RtThread *w; (cnt <= 0 || n < cnt) && (w = pick(W_CONDVAR, key)); n++) lock_acquire_for(w, w->waddr, w->wtag);
        int left = 0;
        for (RtThread *w = g_wait; w && !left; w = w->next) left = w->wkind == W_CONDVAR && w->wkey == key;
        if (!left) st32(key, 0);
        unlock();
        x[0] = R_OK;
        return 1;
    }

    case 0x34: {   // WaitForAddress(x0 address, w1 type, w2 value, x3 timeout): 0 if less, 1 decrement if less, 2/3 if equal
        RtThread *t = cur(imm);
        uint64_t addr = x[0];
        int type = (int)x[1];
        int32_t val = (int32_t)x[2];
        if (type < 0 || type > 3) {
            x[0] = R_INVALID_ENUM;
            return 1;
        }
        lock();
        uint32_t r, v = ld32(addr);
        int ok = (type == 2 || type == 3) ? (int32_t)v == val : (int32_t)v < val;
        if (ok && type == 1)
            while (!cas32(addr, &v, v - 1))
                if (!((int32_t)v < val)) {
                    ok = 0;
                    break;
                }
        if (!ok) r = R_BAD_STATE;
        else {
            t->waddr = addr;
            t->wobj = addr;
            r = block(t, W_ADDRESS, (int64_t)x[3]);
        }
        unlock();
        x[0] = r;
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x35: {   // SignalToAddress(x0 address, w1 type, w2 value, w3 count): 0 wake, 1 increment if equal,
                   // 2 if equal modify by the number of waiters
        uint64_t addr = x[0];
        int type = (int)x[1], cnt = (int)x[3];
        int32_t val = (int32_t)x[2];
        if (type < 0 || type > 2) {
            x[0] = R_INVALID_ENUM;
            return 1;
        }
        lock();
        int nw = 0;
        for (RtThread *w = g_wait; w; w = w->next) nw += w->wkind == W_ADDRESS && w->waddr == addr;
        uint32_t r = R_OK;
        if (type != 0) {
            int32_t nv = val + 1;
            if (type == 2) {
                if (cnt <= 0) nv = nw > 0 ? val - 1 : val + 1;
                else nv = nw == 0 ? val + 1 : nw <= cnt ? val - 1 : val;
            }
            uint32_t e = (uint32_t)val;
            if (!cas32(addr, &e, (uint32_t)nv)) r = R_BAD_STATE;
        }
        if (!r)
            for (int n = 0; cnt <= 0 || n < cnt; n++) {
                RtThread *w = pick(W_ADDRESS, addr);
                if (!w) break;
                wake(w, 0);
            }
        unlock();
        x[0] = r;
        return 1;
    }

    case 0x45: {   // CreateEvent(-> w1 writable, w2 readable)
        Event *e = calloc(1, sizeof *e);
        if (!e) rt_fatal("kernel: event allocation");
        e->refs = 2;
        lock();
        uint32_t hw = h_new(O_EVENT_W, e), hr = h_new(O_EVENT_R, e);
        unlock();
        x[0] = R_OK;
        x[1] = hw;
        x[2] = hr;
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x11: case 0x12: case 0x17: {   // SignalEvent(writable), ClearEvent(either end), ResetSignal(readable)
        uint32_t h = (uint32_t)x[0];
        uint32_t r = R_OK;
        lock();
        Event *e = imm == 0x11 ? h_peek(h, O_EVENT_W) : imm == 0x17 ? h_peek(h, O_EVENT_R)
                 : h_peek(h, O_EVENT_W) ? h_peek(h, O_EVENT_W) : h_peek(h, O_EVENT_R);
        if (!e) {
            r = imm == 0x17 && h_peek(h, O_THREAD) ? R_BAD_STATE : R_BAD_HANDLE;
            if (r == R_BAD_HANDLE) rt_log("kernel: event svc %#x: invalid handle %#x", imm, h);
        } else if (imm == 0x11) {
            e->signaled = 1;
            wake_sync_waiters();
        } else if (imm == 0x17 && !e->signaled) {
            r = R_BAD_STATE;
        } else {
            e->signaled = 0;
        }
        unlock();
        x[0] = r;
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x18: {   // WaitSynchronization(-> w1 index; x1 handles, w2 count, x3 timeout)
        RtThread *t = cur(imm);
        const uint32_t *hs = (const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)x[1];
        int n = (int)x[2];
        int64_t ns = (int64_t)x[3];
        if (n < 0 || n > 64 || (!hs && n)) {
            x[0] = R_BAD_STATE;
            return 1;
        }
        uint64_t start = kern_now_ns();
        uint32_t r;
        int idx = -1, slept = 0;
        lock();
        g_sync_calls++;
        for (;;) {
            if (t->cancel) {
                t->cancel = 0;
                r = R_CANCELLED;
                break;
            }
            int bad = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n && idx < 0; i++)
                if (sig_obj(hs[i], &bad)) idx = i;
            if (bad) {
                r = R_BAD_HANDLE;
                break;
            }
            if (idx >= 0) {
                r = R_OK;
                break;
            }
            int64_t left = ns;
            if (ns > 0) {
                uint64_t spent = kern_now_ns() - start;
                if (spent >= (uint64_t)ns) {
                    r = R_TIMEOUT;
                    break;
                }
                left = ns - (int64_t)spent;
            }
            t->wobj = n ? hs[0] | (uint64_t)n << 32 : 0;
            g_sync_blocks++;
            slept |= left != 0;
            if (block(t, W_SYNC, left) == R_TIMEOUT) {
                r = R_TIMEOUT;
                break;
            }
        }
        {   // Diagnostic (OoT loading-screen hang: 7 threads at 100% in the SDK's MultiWait loop): a thread whose waits
            // keep coming back without sleeping is spinning. The first run of 50000 in a row is logged once per host
            // thread with what the wait saw: timeout, result, index and each handle's kind and signaled state.
            static _Thread_local uint32_t spins;
            static _Thread_local int logged;
            if (slept) {
                spins = 0;
            } else if (++spins == 50000 && !logged) {
                logged = 1;
                rt_log("kernel: WaitSynchronization spin: thread %#x, %d waits in a row without sleeping; this one: "
                       "%d handles, timeout %lld ns, result %#x, index %d, lr %#llx",
                       t->handle, (int)spins, n, (long long)ns, r, idx, (unsigned long long)x[30]);
                for (int i = 0; i < n && i < 16; i++) {
                    unsigned k = hs[i] - 0x1000;
                    int kind = hs[i] == H_CUR_THREAD ? -1 : k && k < MAX_H ? g_h[k].type : -2;
                    int sig = kind == O_EVENT_R ? ((Event *)g_h[k].obj)->signaled
                            : kind == O_THREAD ? ((RtThread *)g_h[k].obj)->exited : -1;
                    rt_log("kernel:   handle[%d] %#x kind %d (1 thread, 2 readable event, 3 writable event) signaled %d",
                           i, hs[i], kind, sig);
                }
            }
        }
        unlock();
        x[0] = r;
        x[1] = idx >= 0 ? (uint64_t)idx : 0;
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x19: {   // CancelSynchronization(w0 thread)
        lock();
        RtThread *t = h_get((uint32_t)x[0], O_THREAD);
        if (t) {
            t->cancel = 1;
            if (t->wkind == W_SYNC) wake(t, (uint32_t)-1);
        }
        unlock();
        x[0] = t ? R_OK : R_BAD_HANDLE;
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x16:   // CloseHandle(w0)
        x[0] = handle_close((uint32_t)x[0]);
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

// ---- handles and events for host services (ipc.c and the service overrides)
uint32_t kern_handle_new(int kind, void *obj) {
    if (kind != KERN_SESSION && kind != KERN_TMEM) rt_fatal("kern_handle_new: kind %d", kind);
    lock();
    uint32_t h = h_new(kind, obj);
    unlock();
    return h;
}

void *kern_handle_get(uint32_t h, int kind) {
    lock();
    void *o = h_peek(h, kind);
    unlock();
    return o;
}

struct IpcSession *kern_session_acquire(uint32_t h) {
    lock();
    struct IpcSession *s = h_peek(h, O_SESSION);
    if (s) ipc_session_retain(s);
    unlock();
    return s;
}

uint32_t kern_event_new(void) {
    Event *e = calloc(1, sizeof *e);
    if (!e) rt_fatal("kernel: event allocation");
    e->refs = 1;
    lock();
    uint32_t hw = h_new(O_EVENT_W, e);
    unlock();
    return hw;
}

// Copy-handle transfer of the readable end: each call gives the client its own handle to the same event.
uint32_t kern_event_readable(uint32_t hw) {
    lock();
    Event *e = h_peek(hw, O_EVENT_W);
    if (!e) rt_fatal("kern_event_readable: %#x is not a writable event handle", hw);
    e->refs++;
    uint32_t hr = h_new(O_EVENT_R, e);
    unlock();
    return hr;
}

void kern_event_signal(uint32_t hw) {
    lock();
    Event *e = h_peek(hw, O_EVENT_W);
    if (!e) rt_fatal("kern_event_signal: %#x is not a writable event handle", hw);
    e->signaled = 1;
    wake_sync_waiters();
    unlock();
}

// System events of host services: the SDK's own nn::os::CreateSystemEvent creates the kernel event (SVC 0x45) on a
// guest thread; the writable handle is kept, so any thread (host audio tick included) can signal it later.
static struct { uint64_t ev; uint32_t wh; } g_se[512];
static int g_nse;
static PlatMutex g_se_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;

static uint32_t se_find(uint64_t ev) {
    plat_mutex_lock_shared(&g_se_lock);
    uint32_t wh = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nse && !wh; i++)
        if (g_se[i].ev == ev) wh = g_se[i].wh;
    plat_mutex_unlock_shared(&g_se_lock);
    return wh;
}

void kern_bind_system_event(Cpu *c, uint64_t ev, int autoclear) {
    if (se_find(ev)) return;
    if (!tcur || !c) rt_fatal("kern_bind_system_event(%#llx) on a host thread", (unsigned long long)ev);
    static uint64_t create, getw;
    if (!create) {
        create = ldr_symbol("_ZN2nn2os17CreateSystemEventEPNS0_15SystemEventTypeENS0_14EventClearModeEb");
        getw = ldr_symbol("_ZN2nn2os30GetWritableHandleOfSystemEventEPKNS0_15SystemEventTypeE");
        if (!create || !getw) rt_fatal("kern_bind_system_event: the SDK's system event functions are not loaded");
    }
    uint32_t r = (uint32_t)rt_call(c, create, 3, ev, (uint64_t)(autoclear ? 1 : 0), (uint64_t)1);
    if (r) rt_fatal("kern_bind_system_event: CreateSystemEvent(%#llx) failed %#x", (unsigned long long)ev, r);
    uint32_t wh = (uint32_t)rt_call(c, getw, 1, ev);
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_se_lock);
    if (g_nse == (int)(sizeof g_se / sizeof *g_se)) rt_fatal("kern_bind_system_event: table full");
    g_se[g_nse].ev = ev;
    g_se[g_nse++].wh = wh;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_se_lock);
}

// An event not bound yet is bound on the spot with manual clear, which needs a guest thread.
void kern_signal_system_event(uint64_t ev) {
    uint32_t wh = se_find(ev);
    if (!wh) {
        kern_bind_system_event(kern_cpu(), ev, 0);
        wh = se_find(ev);
    }
    kern_event_signal(wh);
}

// ---- fibers
// The SDK switches fibers by swapping register context, which breaks "RET = C return". Each guest fiber gets a host
// fiber (own 256 MiB reserved host stack) and its own Cpu, so a suspended fiber's registers and host frames stay
// untouched while others run, and a fiber may resume on another thread. A switch carries the thread state (TLR, TLS
// pointer, FPCR/FPSR) over to the target's Cpu and clears the exclusive monitor.
enum { F_NEW, F_STARTED, F_DONE };
struct Fiber {
    uint64_t addr, func, arg, stack, size;
    Cpu *cpu;
    PlatFiber *host;
    int state;
    volatile int running;
};
static Fiber *g_fibers[FIBER_MAX];
static PlatMutex g_fiber_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;

static Fiber *fiber_find(uint64_t addr) {
    Fiber *f = NULL;
    plat_mutex_lock_shared(&g_fiber_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < FIBER_MAX && !f; i++)
        if (g_fibers[i] && g_fibers[i]->addr == addr) f = g_fibers[i];
    plat_mutex_unlock_shared(&g_fiber_lock);
    return f;
}

static void fiber_switch_to(RtThread *t, const Cpu *from, Fiber *to);

// After a host fiber switch: release the context left behind, and finish an ExitThread issued on a fiber.
static void fiber_resumed(void) {
    RtThread *t = tcur;
    rt_fpcr_sync(t->cur);   // the host fiber resumes with its own MXCSR (platform.h fibers switch it)
    if (t->leaving) {
        __atomic_store_n(&t->leaving->running, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        t->leaving = NULL;
    }
    if (t->exit_pending && !t->fiber) exit_now(t);
}

static void fiber_main(void *p) {
    Fiber *f = p;
    fiber_resumed();
    Cpu *c = f->cpu;
    tcur->host_depth = 0;   // a new fiber starts at the top level; each context restores its own depth on resume
    uint64_t next = rt_call(c, f->func, 1, f->arg);
    f->state = F_DONE;
    Fiber *n = NULL;
    if (next && !(n = fiber_find(next)))
        rt_fatal("fiber %#llx returned %#llx, which is not an initialized fiber", (unsigned long long)f->addr,
                 (unsigned long long)next);
    fiber_switch_to(tcur, c, n);   // NULL: back to the thread's own context
    rt_fatal("fiber %#llx resumed after it finished", (unsigned long long)f->addr);
}

static void fiber_switch_to(RtThread *t, const Cpu *from, Fiber *to) {
    if (!t->base_fiber) {
        t->base_fiber = plat_fiber_self();
        if (!t->base_fiber) rt_fatal("kernel: cannot make the thread a fiber");
    }
    Cpu *dst = to ? to->cpu : t->cpu;
    if (to) {
        if (to->state == F_DONE) rt_fatal("SwitchToFiber(%#llx): the fiber has finished", (unsigned long long)to->addr);
        int idle = 0;
        if (!__atomic_compare_exchange_n(&to->running, &idle, 1, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE))
            rt_fatal("SwitchToFiber(%#llx): the fiber is running", (unsigned long long)to->addr);
        if (to->state == F_NEW) {
            dst->sp = (to->stack + to->size) & ~15ull;
            to->state = F_STARTED;
        }
    }
    dst->tpidr = from->tpidr;
    dst->tpidrro = from->tpidrro;
    dst->fpcr = from->fpcr;
    dst->fpsr = from->fpsr;
    dst->excl_addr = ~0ull;
    dst->thread = t;
    t->leaving = t->fiber;
    t->fiber = to;
    t->cur = dst;
    int depth = t->host_depth;
    plat_fiber_switch(to ? to->host : t->base_fiber);
    t->host_depth = depth;
    fiber_resumed();
}

// InitializeFiber(x0 FiberType*, x1 function, x2 argument, x3 stack, x4 stack size, w5 flags)
void kern_fiber_initialize(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t addr = c->x[0];
    Fiber *f = fiber_find(addr);
    if (f && f->running) rt_fatal("InitializeFiber(%#llx): the fiber is running", (unsigned long long)addr);
    if (!f) {
        f = calloc(1, sizeof *f);
        Cpu *fc = plat_aligned_alloc(sizeof(Cpu), 64);
        if (!f || !fc) rt_fatal("kernel: fiber allocation");
        f->cpu = fc;
        plat_mutex_lock(&g_fiber_lock);
        int i = 0;
        while (i < FIBER_MAX && g_fibers[i]) i++;
        if (i == FIBER_MAX) rt_fatal("kernel: more than %d fibers", FIBER_MAX);
        g_fibers[i] = f;
        plat_mutex_unlock(&g_fiber_lock);
    } else if (f->host) {
        plat_fiber_free(f->host);
    }
    memset(f->cpu, 0, sizeof *f->cpu);
    f->cpu->excl_addr = ~0ull;
    f->addr = addr;
    f->func = c->x[1];
    f->arg = c->x[2];
    f->stack = c->x[3];
    f->size = c->x[4];
    f->state = F_NEW;
    f->running = 0;
    f->host = plat_fiber_new(HOST_STACK, fiber_main, f);
    if (!f->host) rt_fatal("kernel: cannot create a host fiber");
}

// FinalizeFiber(x0 FiberType*)
void kern_fiber_finalize(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t addr = c->x[0];
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_fiber_lock);
    Fiber *f = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < FIBER_MAX && !f; i++)
        if (g_fibers[i] && g_fibers[i]->addr == addr) {
            f = g_fibers[i];
            g_fibers[i] = NULL;
        }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_fiber_lock);
    if (!f) rt_fatal("FinalizeFiber(%#llx): not an initialized fiber", (unsigned long long)addr);
    if (f->running) rt_fatal("FinalizeFiber(%#llx): the fiber is running", (unsigned long long)addr);
    plat_fiber_free(f->host);
    plat_aligned_free(f->cpu);
    free(f);
}

// SwitchToFiber(x0 FiberType*)
void kern_fiber_switch(Cpu *c) {
    RtThread *t = tcur;
    if (!t) rt_fatal("SwitchToFiber on a host thread");
    Fiber *to = c->x[0] ? fiber_find(c->x[0]) : NULL;
    if (c->x[0] && !to) rt_fatal("SwitchToFiber(%#llx): not an initialized fiber", (unsigned long long)c->x[0]);
    if (to == t->fiber) return;
    fiber_switch_to(t, c, to);
}

// GetCurrentFiber() -> x0, NULL on the thread's own context
void kern_fiber_current(Cpu *c) {
    RtThread *t = tcur;
    c->x[0] = t && t->fiber ? t->fiber->addr : 0;
}

HOST_OVERRIDE(KERN_SYM_INITIALIZE_FIBER, kern_fiber_initialize);
HOST_OVERRIDE(KERN_SYM_FINALIZE_FIBER, kern_fiber_finalize);
HOST_OVERRIDE(KERN_SYM_SWITCH_TO_FIBER, kern_fiber_switch);
HOST_OVERRIDE(KERN_SYM_GET_CURRENT_FIBER, kern_fiber_current);

```

`runtime/kernel.h`:

```h
// Kernel internals shared by kernel.c, svc.c and the kernel probe (kernel_probe.c). Not part of the host.h contract.
#pragma once
#include "host.h"

// Horizon kernel results (module 1).
#define KERN_R_OUT_OF_RESOURCE 0xCE01u
#define KERN_R_INVALID_STATE_MEM 0xD401u
#define KERN_R_BAD_HANDLE 0xE401u
#define KERN_R_TIMEOUT 0xEA01u
#define KERN_R_CANCELLED 0xEC01u
#define KERN_R_INVALID_ENUM 0xF001u
#define KERN_R_BAD_STATE 0xFA01u
#define KERN_H_CURRENT_THREAD 0xFFFF8000u
#define KERN_WAITERS_BIT 0x40000000u

// Fiber overrides, linked as HOST_OVERRIDE entries in kernel.c.
#define KERN_SYM_INITIALIZE_FIBER "_ZN2nn2os15InitializeFiberEPNS0_9FiberTypeEPFS2_PvES3_S3_mi"
#define KERN_SYM_FINALIZE_FIBER "_ZN2nn2os13FinalizeFiberEPNS0_9FiberTypeE"
#define KERN_SYM_SWITCH_TO_FIBER "_ZN2nn2os13SwitchToFiberEPNS0_9FiberTypeE"

// The guest frame-pointer chain from c->x[29] to stderr.
void kern_backtrace(const Cpu *c);

// ---- probe support

#define KERN_THREAD_EXITED 100
int kern_thread_state(uint32_t handle);               // KERN_WAIT_*, KERN_THREAD_EXITED, or -1 for a bad handle
void kern_core_stats(int *held_now, int *held_max);   // virtual-core holders now and the most ever at once

                                                      // the key (MNG's pre-fix order, the negative control)

extern void (*volatile svc_test_exit_hook)(unsigned code);   // svc 0x07 calls it instead of ExitProcess (probes)
```

`runtime/kernel_probe.c`:

```c
// --probe-kernel: the kernel's waits, wake orders, virtual cores, fibers and
// ExitThread on guest threads whose entries are host functions, then real lifted code on four guest threads: main's
// PLT stub for nn::os::GetSystemTick, through the lifted sdk function, to rt_ticks.
//
// Every probe thread is created with SVC 0x08 and drives the kernel through rt_svc, the entry the lifted code uses.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define STACK 0x10000
#define JOIN_NS 10000000000ll
#define TICK_SYMBOL "_ZN2nn2os13GetSystemTickEv"
#define FIBER_SWITCHES 10000
#define CORE_WORKERS 8
#define CORE_RUNS 300
#define TICK_THREADS 4
#define TICK_CALLS 1000

static int failures;
#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { if (!(cond)) { failures++; printf("  FAIL: " __VA_ARGS__); putchar('\n'); } } while (0)

static uint64_t a_lock_waiter, a_cv_waiter, a_cv_order_waiter, a_arb_waiter, a_event_waiter, a_core_worker,
    a_exit_entry, a_exit_nested, a_fiber_fn, a_fiber_exit_thread, a_fiber_exit_fn, a_tick_worker;
static uint64_t a_fib_init, a_fib_fin, a_fib_switch, a_fib_cur, tick_stub;

// ---- helpers: SVCs through rt_svc, thread start and join
static uint32_t sv(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t a0, uint64_t a1, uint64_t a2, uint64_t a3) {
    c->x[0] = a0;
    c->x[1] = a1;
    c->x[2] = a2;
    c->x[3] = a3;
    rt_svc(c, imm, 0);
    return (uint32_t)c->x[0];
}

static void sleep_ms(Cpu *c, int ms) { sv(c, 0x0B, (uint64_t)ms * 1000000, 0, 0, 0); }
static __attribute__((noreturn)) void exit_thread(Cpu *c) {
    sv(c, 0x0A, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    rt_fatal("probe-kernel: ExitThread returned");
}
static uint64_t ga(const volatile void *p) { return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p; }

static uint32_t create(Cpu *c, uint64_t entry, void *arg, int prio, int core) {
    uint8_t *stack = mem_kernel_alloc(STACK, 16);
    c->x[1] = entry;
    c->x[2] = ga(arg);
    c->x[3] = ga(stack + STACK);
    c->x[4] = (uint64_t)prio;
    c->x[5] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)core;
    rt_svc(c, 0x08, 0);
    if (c->x[0]) rt_fatal("probe-kernel: CreateThread failed %#llx", (unsigned long long)c->x[0]);
    return (uint32_t)c->x[1];
}

static void start(Cpu *c, uint32_t h) { CHECK(sv(c, 0x09, h, 0, 0, 0) == 0, "StartThread %#x", h); }

static uint32_t wait1(Cpu *c, uint32_t h, int64_t ns) {
    uint32_t hs[1] = {h};
    return sv(c, 0x18, 0, ga(hs), 1, (uint64_t)ns);
}

static void join(Cpu *c, uint32_t h) {
    uint32_t r = wait1(c, h, JOIN_NS);
    if (r) rt_fatal("probe-kernel: thread %#x did not end (wait result %#x)", h, r);
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x16, h, 0, 0, 0) == 0, "CloseHandle(thread %#x)", h);
}

// Poll (sleeping, so the virtual core is free) until the thread reaches a state; 5 s at most.
static int wait_state(Cpu *c, uint32_t h, int want) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 5000; i++) {
        if (kern_thread_state(h) == want) return 1;
        sleep_ms(c, 1);
    }
    CHECK(0, "thread %#x never reached state %d (now %d)", h, want, kern_thread_state(h));
    return 0;
}

static double ms_since(uint64_t t0) { return (double)(kern_now_ns() - t0) / 1e6; }

// ---- user-mode lock of the SDK: tag word = owner handle | waiters bit
static uint32_t ld(volatile uint32_t *a) { return __atomic_load_n(a, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); }
static int cas(volatile uint32_t *a, uint32_t *e, uint32_t v) {
    return __atomic_compare_exchange_n(a, e, v, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
}

static void user_lock(Cpu *c, volatile uint32_t *a, uint32_t tag) {
    for (;;) {
        uint32_t v = 0;
        if (cas(a, &v, tag)) return;
        if (!(v & KERN_WAITERS_BIT)) {
            if (!cas(a, &v, v | KERN_WAITERS_BIT)) continue;
            v |= KERN_WAITERS_BIT;
        }
        sv(c, 0x1A, v & ~KERN_WAITERS_BIT, ga(a), tag, 0);
        if ((ld(a) & ~KERN_WAITERS_BIT) == tag) return;
    }
}

static void user_unlock(Cpu *c, volatile uint32_t *a, uint32_t tag) {
    uint32_t v = tag;
    if (cas(a, &v, 0)) return;
    sv(c, 0x1B, ga(a), 0, 0, 0);
}

// ---- lock handoff order
typedef struct { volatile uint32_t *lock, *key; uint32_t tag, r; int idx, held; } LockJob;
static volatile uint32_t g_lockw __attribute__((aligned(8))), g_keyw __attribute__((aligned(8)));
static volatile int32_t g_order_n;
static int g_order[8];

static void record(int idx) { g_order[plat_inc32(&g_order_n) - 1] = idx; }

static void lock_waiter(Cpu *c) {
    LockJob *j = arg_p(c, 0);
    user_lock(c, j->lock, j->tag);
    record(j->idx);
    user_unlock(c, j->lock, j->tag);
    exit_thread(c);
}

static int order_is(const int *want, int n, char *buf, size_t size) {
    int ok = g_order_n == n;
    buf[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_order_n && i < 8; i++) {
        snprintf(buf + strlen(buf), size - strlen(buf), "%s%d", i ? " " : "", g_order[i]);
        ok &= i < n && g_order[i] == want[i];
    }
    return ok;
}

static void test_lock(Cpu *c, uint32_t me) {
    static const int prio[] = {40, 30, 40, 30, 35}, want[] = {1, 3, 4, 0, 2};
    LockJob j[5];
    uint32_t h[5];
    g_lockw = me;
    g_order_n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        j[i] = (LockJob){.lock = &g_lockw, .idx = i};
        h[i] = create(c, a_lock_waiter, &j[i], prio[i], -2);
        j[i].tag = h[i];
        start(c, h[i]);
        wait_state(c, h[i], KERN_WAIT_LOCK);
    }
    CHECK(ld(&g_lockw) == (me | KERN_WAITERS_BIT), "lock word %#x with 5 waiters", ld(&g_lockw));
    user_unlock(c, &g_lockw, me);
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) join(c, h[i]);
    char got[64];
    int ok = order_is(want, 5, got, sizeof got);
    printf("lock handoff: priorities 40 30 40 30 35 registered in order, woken %s (expected 1 3 4 0 2): %s\n", got,
           ok ? "ok" : "FAIL");
    CHECK(ok, "lock handoff order");
    CHECK(ld(&g_lockw) == 0, "lock word %#x after the last unlock", ld(&g_lockw));
}

// ---- condition variables
static void cv_waiter(Cpu *c) {   // waits forever; woken holding the lock
    LockJob *j = arg_p(c, 0);
    user_lock(c, j->lock, j->tag);
    j->r = sv(c, 0x1C, ga(j->lock), ga(j->key), j->tag, (uint64_t)-1);
    j->held = (ld(j->lock) & ~KERN_WAITERS_BIT) == j->tag;
    record(j->idx);
    user_unlock(c, j->lock, j->tag);
    exit_thread(c);
}

static void test_cv_wake_order(Cpu *c) {
    static const int prio[] = {45, 35, 40}, want[] = {1, 2, 0};
    LockJob j[3];
    uint32_t h[3];
    g_lockw = 0;
    g_keyw = 0;
    g_order_n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        j[i] = (LockJob){.lock = &g_lockw, .key = &g_keyw, .idx = i};
        h[i] = create(c, a_cv_waiter, &j[i], prio[i], -2);
        j[i].tag = h[i];
        start(c, h[i]);
        wait_state(c, h[i], KERN_WAIT_CONDVAR);
    }
    CHECK(ld(&g_keyw) == 1, "condvar key %u with 3 waiters", ld(&g_keyw));
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) CHECK(sv(c, 0x1D, ga(&g_keyw), 1, 0, 0) == 0, "SignalProcessWideKey");
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) join(c, h[i]);
    char got[64];
    int ok = order_is(want, 3, got, sizeof got);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) ok &= j[i].r == 0 && j[i].held;
    printf("condvar wake order: priorities 45 35 40, signalled one at a time, woken %s holding the lock (expected "
           "1 2 0): %s\n", got, ok ? "ok" : "FAIL");
    CHECK(ok, "condvar wake order");
    CHECK(ld(&g_keyw) == 0 && ld(&g_lockw) == 0, "key %u lock %#x after the last waiter", ld(&g_keyw), ld(&g_lockw));
}

// Another thread's user-mode critical section and Signal, run inside the waiter's svc 0x1C right after the lock
// release: take the lock, read the key (the SDK's Signal skips svc 0x1D on 0), release.
static volatile int g_seen_key;
static void cv_signaller(void) {
    uint32_t e = 0;
    if (cas(&g_lockw, &e, 0x7777)) {
        g_seen_key = (int)ld(&g_keyw);
        __atomic_store_n(&g_lockw, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    }
    kern_test_cv_hook = NULL;
}

static void cv_order_waiter(Cpu *c) {
    LockJob *j = arg_p(c, 0);
    user_lock(c, j->lock, j->tag);
    j->r = sv(c, 0x1C, ga(j->lock), ga(j->key), j->tag, 200000000);
    if (!j->r) user_unlock(c, j->lock, j->tag);
    exit_thread(c);
}

static uint32_t cv_order_case(Cpu *c, int old) {
    LockJob j = {.lock = &g_lockw, .key = &g_keyw};
    g_lockw = 0;
    g_keyw = 0;
    g_seen_key = -1;
    kern_test_cv_old_order = old;
    kern_test_cv_hook = cv_signaller;
    uint32_t h = create(c, a_cv_order_waiter, &j, 44, -2);
    j.tag = h;
    start(c, h);
    while (kern_thread_state(h) != KERN_WAIT_CONDVAR && kern_thread_state(h) != KERN_THREAD_EXITED) sleep_ms(c, 1);
    if (g_seen_key != 0) sv(c, 0x1D, ga(&g_keyw), 1, 0, 0);   // what the SDK's Signal does
    join(c, h);
    kern_test_cv_old_order = 0;
    kern_test_cv_hook = NULL;
    return j.r;
}

static void test_cv_key_order(Cpu *c) {
    uint32_t r = cv_order_case(c, 0);
    int seen = g_seen_key;
    printf("condvar key order: key set before the lock release; a signaller between release and wait saw key %d, "
           "waiter result %#x: %s\n", seen, r, seen == 1 && r == 0 ? "ok" : "FAIL");
    CHECK(seen == 1 && r == 0, "condvar key order");
    r = cv_order_case(c, 1);
    seen = g_seen_key;
    int lost = seen == 0 && r == KERN_R_TIMEOUT;
    printf("condvar key order, negative control (MNG's old order, release then set the key): signaller saw key %d, "
           "waiter result %#x: %s\n", seen, r, lost ? "lost wakeup, fails as expected" : "FAIL (the control did not "
           "fail)");
    CHECK(lost, "the old-order negative control did not lose the wakeup");
}

// ---- address arbiter
typedef struct { int type, value, idx; int64_t timeout; uint32_t r; } ArbJob;
static volatile uint32_t g_arb __attribute__((aligned(8)));

static void arb_waiter(Cpu *c) {
    ArbJob *j = arg_p(c, 0);
    j->r = sv(c, 0x34, ga(&g_arb), (uint64_t)j->type, (uint64_t)(int64_t)j->value, (uint64_t)j->timeout);
    exit_thread(c);
}

static uint32_t arb_spawn(Cpu *c, ArbJob *j) {
    uint32_t h = create(c, a_arb_waiter, j, 44, -2);
    start(c, h);
    wait_state(c, h, KERN_WAIT_ADDRESS);
    return h;
}

static uint32_t sig(Cpu *c, int type, int value, int count) {
    return sv(c, 0x35, ga(&g_arb), (uint64_t)type, (uint64_t)(int64_t)value, (uint64_t)(int64_t)count);
}

static void test_arbiter(Cpu *c) {
    int before = failures;
    uint64_t arb = ga(&g_arb);
    // wait type 0, if less than
    g_arb = 0;
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x34, arb, 0, 0, (uint64_t)-1) == KERN_R_BAD_STATE, "wait type 0 with value not less");
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x34, arb, 0, 1, 0) == KERN_R_TIMEOUT, "wait type 0 with timeout 0");
    ArbJob j0 = {.type = 0, .value = 1, .timeout = -1};
    uint32_t h = arb_spawn(c, &j0);
    CHECK(sig(c, 0, 0, 1) == 0, "signal type 0");
    join(c, h);
    CHECK(j0.r == 0, "wait type 0 woken by signal type 0: %#x", j0.r);
    // wait type 1, decrement if less than; signal type 1, increment if equal
    g_arb = 0;
    ArbJob j1 = {.type = 1, .value = 1, .timeout = -1};
    h = arb_spawn(c, &j1);
    CHECK((int32_t)g_arb == -1, "wait type 1 did not decrement (%d)", (int32_t)g_arb);
    CHECK(sig(c, 1, 0, 1) == KERN_R_BAD_STATE && (int32_t)g_arb == -1 && kern_thread_state(h) == KERN_WAIT_ADDRESS,
          "signal type 1 with a different value");
    CHECK(sig(c, 1, -1, 1) == 0 && g_arb == 0, "signal type 1 did not increment (%d)", (int32_t)g_arb);
    join(c, h);
    CHECK(j1.r == 0, "wait type 1 woken by signal type 1: %#x", j1.r);
    // wait type 2, if equal; signal type 2, modify by the number of waiters if equal
    g_arb = 5;
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x34, arb, 2, 6, (uint64_t)-1) == KERN_R_BAD_STATE, "wait type 2 with a different value");
    ArbJob ja = {.type = 2, .value = 5, .timeout = -1}, jb = ja;
    uint32_t ha = arb_spawn(c, &ja), hb = arb_spawn(c, &jb);
    CHECK(sig(c, 2, 5, 1) == 0 && g_arb == 5, "signal type 2, 2 waiters, count 1: value %d (want 5)", (int32_t)g_arb);
    wait_state(c, ha, KERN_THREAD_EXITED);
    CHECK(kern_thread_state(hb) == KERN_WAIT_ADDRESS, "signal type 2 woke more than one, or not the first");
    CHECK(sig(c, 2, 5, 1) == 0 && g_arb == 4, "signal type 2, 1 waiter, count 1: value %d (want 4)", (int32_t)g_arb);
    join(c, ha);
    join(c, hb);
    CHECK(sig(c, 2, 4, 1) == 0 && g_arb == 5, "signal type 2, no waiter: value %d (want 5)", (int32_t)g_arb);
    CHECK(sig(c, 2, 5, 0) == 0 && g_arb == 6, "signal type 2, no waiter, count 0: value %d (want 6)", (int32_t)g_arb);
    ArbJob jc = {.type = 2, .value = 6, .timeout = -1};
    h = arb_spawn(c, &jc);
    CHECK(sig(c, 2, 6, -1) == 0 && g_arb == 5, "signal type 2, 1 waiter, count -1: value %d (want 5)", (int32_t)g_arb);
    join(c, h);
    CHECK(ja.r == 0 && jb.r == 0 && jc.r == 0, "wait type 2 results %#x %#x %#x", ja.r, jb.r, jc.r);
    CHECK(sig(c, 2, 7, 1) == KERN_R_BAD_STATE, "signal type 2 with a different value");
    // timeout, invalid type
    uint64_t t0 = kern_now_ns();
    uint32_t r = sv(c, 0x34, arb, 2, 5, 5000000);
    double ms = ms_since(t0);
    CHECK(r == KERN_R_TIMEOUT && ms >= 5.0, "wait type 2 with a 5 ms timeout: %#x after %.2f ms", r, ms);
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x34, arb, 3, 0, 0) == KERN_R_INVALID_ENUM && sig(c, 3, 0, 0) == KERN_R_INVALID_ENUM, "type 3");
    printf("address arbiter: wait types 0-2 (less, decrement-less, equal), signal types 0-2 (wake, increment, modify by "
           "waiters), 5 ms timeout after %.2f ms: %s\n", ms, failures == before ? "ok" : "FAIL");
}

// ---- events
typedef struct { uint32_t h, r, idx; int64_t timeout; volatile int delay, go; } EvJob;

static void event_waiter(Cpu *c) {
    EvJob *j = arg_p(c, 0);
    while (j->delay && !j->go) sleep_ms(c, 1);
    uint32_t hs[1] = {j->h};
    j->r = sv(c, 0x18, 0, ga(hs), 1, (uint64_t)j->timeout);
    j->idx = (uint32_t)c->x[1];
    exit_thread(c);
}

static void test_events(Cpu *c) {
    int before = failures;
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x45, 0, 0, 0, 0) == 0, "CreateEvent");
    uint32_t hw = (uint32_t)c->x[1], hr = (uint32_t)c->x[2];
    uint64_t t0 = kern_now_ns();
    uint32_t r = wait1(c, hr, 10000000);
    double ms = ms_since(t0);
    CHECK(r == KERN_R_TIMEOUT && ms >= 10.0, "wait with a 10 ms timeout: %#x after %.2f ms", r, ms);
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x17, hr, 0, 0, 0) == KERN_R_BAD_STATE, "ResetSignal of an unsignalled event");

    EvJob e = {.h = hr, .timeout = -1};
    uint32_t h = create(c, a_event_waiter, &e, 44, -2);
    start(c, h);
    wait_state(c, h, KERN_WAIT_SYNC);
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x11, hw, 0, 0, 0) == 0, "SignalEvent");
    join(c, h);
    CHECK(e.r == 0 && e.idx == 0, "waiter woken by SignalEvent: %#x index %u", e.r, e.idx);

    CHECK(sv(c, 0x45, 0, 0, 0, 0) == 0, "CreateEvent");
    uint32_t hw2 = (uint32_t)c->x[1], hr2 = (uint32_t)c->x[2];
    uint32_t two[2] = {hr2, hr};
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x18, 0, ga(two), 2, 0) == 0 && c->x[1] == 1, "wait on two handles, the second signalled");
    CHECK(wait1(c, hw, 0) == KERN_R_BAD_HANDLE, "wait on a writable event handle");
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x12, hr, 0, 0, 0) == 0 && wait1(c, hr, 0) == KERN_R_TIMEOUT, "ClearEvent");
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x11, hr, 0, 0, 0) == KERN_R_BAD_HANDLE, "SignalEvent on the readable end");
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x11, hw, 0, 0, 0) == 0 && sv(c, 0x17, hr, 0, 0, 0) == 0 && sv(c, 0x17, hr, 0, 0, 0) == KERN_R_BAD_STATE,
          "ResetSignal");

    EvJob f = {.h = hr, .timeout = -1};
    h = create(c, a_event_waiter, &f, 44, -2);
    start(c, h);
    wait_state(c, h, KERN_WAIT_SYNC);
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x19, h, 0, 0, 0) == 0, "CancelSynchronization");
    join(c, h);
    CHECK(f.r == KERN_R_CANCELLED, "cancelled wait: %#x", f.r);

    EvJob g = {.h = hr, .timeout = -1, .delay = 1};
    h = create(c, a_event_waiter, &g, 44, -2);
    start(c, h);
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x19, h, 0, 0, 0) == 0, "CancelSynchronization before the wait");
    g.go = 1;
    join(c, h);
    CHECK(g.r == KERN_R_CANCELLED, "wait after a cancel: %#x", g.r);

    uint32_t sw = kern_event_new(), sr = kern_event_readable(sw);
    CHECK(wait1(c, sr, 0) == KERN_R_TIMEOUT, "service event before the signal");
    kern_event_signal(sw);
    CHECK(wait1(c, sr, 0) == 0, "service event after kern_event_signal");
    uint32_t handles[] = {sr, sw, hr2, hw2, hr, hw};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 6; i++) CHECK(sv(c, 0x16, handles[i], 0, 0, 0) == 0, "CloseHandle %#x", handles[i]);
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x16, hr, 0, 0, 0) == KERN_R_BAD_HANDLE, "CloseHandle twice");
    printf("events: signal, clear, reset, two handles, cancel while waiting and before, service events, 10 ms "
           "timeout after %.2f ms: %s\n", ms, failures == before ? "ok" : "FAIL");
}

// ---- virtual cores: count the threads running guest code at once, and that no two of them share a core number
static volatile int32_t g_running, g_run_max, g_core_use[3], g_core_clash;

static void core_worker(Cpu *c) {
    for (int i = 0; i < CORE_RUNS; i++) {
        uint32_t core = sv(c, 0x10, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        if (core > 2 || plat_inc32(&g_core_use[core > 2 ? 0 : core]) != 1) plat_inc32(&g_core_clash);
        long n = plat_inc32(&g_running), m;
        while (n > (m = g_run_max) && plat_cas32(&g_run_max, n, m) != m) {}
        uint64_t until = kern_now_ns() + 20000;
        while (kern_now_ns() < until) {}
        plat_dec32(&g_running);
        plat_dec32(&g_core_use[core > 2 ? 0 : core]);
        sv(c, 0x0B, i % 8 == 7 ? 50000 : 0, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    exit_thread(c);
}

static void test_cores(Cpu *c) {
    uint32_t h[CORE_WORKERS];
    g_running = g_run_max = g_core_clash = 0;
    kern_core_stats_reset();
    for (int i = 0; i < CORE_WORKERS; i++) {
        h[i] = create(c, a_core_worker, NULL, 44, -2);
        start(c, h[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < CORE_WORKERS; i++) join(c, h[i]);
    int now, held_max;
    kern_core_stats(&now, &held_max);
    uint32_t cpus = plat_cpu_usable();
    int gate = !cfg_bool("TOTK_FREE_CORES");   // the kernel's own switch
    int ok = g_run_max <= 3 && held_max <= 3 && !g_core_clash && (cpus < 4 || g_run_max == 3);
    printf("virtual cores: %d threads x %d runs on %u host CPUs: at most %d running guest code at once, at most %d "
           "core holders (kernel count), %d core-number clashes: %s\n", CORE_WORKERS, CORE_RUNS, cpus, g_run_max,
           held_max, g_core_clash, !gate ? "not checked (TOTK_FREE_CORES is set)" : ok ? "ok" : "FAIL");
    CHECK(ok || !gate, "virtual cores");
}

// ---- fibers: two fibers switch to each other; each checks its callee-saved registers, sp and tpidr survive
typedef struct { uint64_t self, other; int id; } FiberJob;
static volatile int32_t g_switches, g_runs[3];
static volatile int g_last_fiber;
static long g_fiber_bad, g_fiber_turns;

static void set_regs(Cpu *c, uint64_t seed, uint64_t *save, __uint128_t *vsave) {
    for (int r = 19; r <= 28; r++) save[r - 19] = c->x[r] = seed * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull + (uint64_t)r;
    for (int r = 8; r <= 15; r++)
        vsave[r - 8] = c->v[r] = ((__uint128_t)(seed ^ 0xABCDull) << 64) | (seed * 31u + (uint64_t)r);
}

static int same_regs(const Cpu *c, const uint64_t *save, const __uint128_t *vsave) {
    for (int r = 19; r <= 28; r++)
        if (c->x[r] != save[r - 19]) return 0;
    for (int r = 8; r <= 15; r++)
        if (c->v[r] != vsave[r - 8]) return 0;
    return 1;
}

static void fiber_fn(Cpu *c) {
    FiberJob *j = arg_p(c, 0);
    uint64_t save[10];
    __uint128_t vsave[8];
    for (;;) {
        long n = g_switches;
        if (n >= FIBER_SWITCHES) {
            ret_x(c, 0);   // back to the thread
            return;
        }
        g_switches = n + 1;
        g_runs[j->id]++;
        set_regs(c, (uint64_t)n * 2 + (uint64_t)j->id, save, vsave);
        uint64_t sp = c->sp, tp = c->tpidr, tlr = c->tpidrro;
        g_last_fiber = j->id;
        rt_call(c, a_fib_switch, 1, j->other);
        if (g_last_fiber != 3 - j->id) g_fiber_turns++;   // the other fiber did not run in between
        if (!same_regs(c, save, vsave) || c->sp != sp || c->tpidr != tp || c->tpidrro != tlr) g_fiber_bad++;
        if (rt_call(c, a_fib_cur, 0) != j->self) g_fiber_bad++;
    }
}

static void test_fibers(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t fa = ga(mem_kernel_alloc(0x100, 16)), fb = ga(mem_kernel_alloc(0x100, 16));
    uint64_t sa = ga(mem_kernel_alloc(STACK, 16)), sb = ga(mem_kernel_alloc(STACK, 16));
    FiberJob ja = {fa, fb, 1}, jb = {fb, fa, 2};
    rt_call(c, a_fib_init, 6, fa, a_fiber_fn, ga(&ja), sa, (uint64_t)STACK, (uint64_t)0);
    rt_call(c, a_fib_init, 6, fb, a_fiber_fn, ga(&jb), sb, (uint64_t)STACK, (uint64_t)0);
    g_switches = g_runs[1] = g_runs[2] = 0;
    g_fiber_bad = g_fiber_turns = 0;
    uint64_t save[10];
    __uint128_t vsave[8];
    set_regs(c, 0x5555, save, vsave);
    uint64_t sp = c->sp, tp = c->tpidr;
    uint64_t t0 = kern_now_ns();
    rt_call(c, a_fib_switch, 1, fa);
    double ms = ms_since(t0);
    int base_ok = same_regs(c, save, vsave) && c->sp == sp && c->tpidr == tp && rt_call(c, a_fib_cur, 0) == 0;
    rt_call(c, a_fib_fin, 1, fa);
    rt_call(c, a_fib_fin, 1, fb);
    int ok = g_switches == FIBER_SWITCHES && g_runs[1] == FIBER_SWITCHES / 2 && g_runs[2] == FIBER_SWITCHES / 2 &&
             !g_fiber_turns && !g_fiber_bad && base_ok;
    printf("fibers: %d switches (fiber 1 %d, fiber 2 %d, %ld out of turn) in %.1f ms (%.3f us each), %ld register "
           "mismatches, thread context %s: %s\n", g_switches, g_runs[1], g_runs[2], g_fiber_turns, ms,
           ms * 1000.0 / (double)(g_switches ? g_switches : 1), g_fiber_bad, base_ok ? "preserved" : "CHANGED",
           ok ? "ok" : "FAIL");
    CHECK(ok, "fiber ping-pong");
}

// ---- ExitThread unwinding: from three nested host calls deep, and from a fiber
typedef struct { int stage, depth, bad; uint64_t fiber, stack; } ExitJob;

static void exit_nested(Cpu *c) {
    ExitJob *j = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (++j->depth < 3) {
        rt_call(c, a_exit_nested, 1, ga(j));
        j->bad = 1;
        return;
    }
    j->stage = 2;
    sv(c, 0x0A, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    j->bad = 2;
}

static void exit_entry(Cpu *c) {
    ExitJob *j = arg_p(c, 0);
    j->stage = 1;
    rt_call(c, a_exit_nested, 1, ga(j));
    j->bad = 3;
    exit_thread(c);
}

static void fiber_exit_fn(Cpu *c) {
    ExitJob *j = arg_p(c, 0);
    j->stage = 3;
    sv(c, 0x0A, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    j->bad = 4;
}

static void fiber_exit_thread(Cpu *c) {
    ExitJob *j = arg_p(c, 0);
    rt_call(c, a_fib_init, 6, j->fiber, a_fiber_exit_fn, ga(j), j->stack, (uint64_t)STACK, (uint64_t)0);
    rt_call(c, a_fib_switch, 1, j->fiber);
    j->bad = 5;
    exit_thread(c);
}

static void test_exit(Cpu *c) {
    ExitJob a = {0};
    uint32_t h = create(c, a_exit_entry, &a, 44, -2);
    start(c, h);
    join(c, h);
    CHECK(wait1(c, h, 0) == KERN_R_BAD_HANDLE, "wait on a closed thread handle");
    ExitJob b = {.fiber = ga(mem_kernel_alloc(0x100, 16)), .stack = ga(mem_kernel_alloc(STACK, 16))};
    h = create(c, a_fiber_exit_thread, &b, 44, -2);
    start(c, h);
    join(c, h);
    rt_call(c, a_fib_fin, 1, b.fiber);
    int ok = a.stage == 2 && a.depth == 3 && !a.bad && b.stage == 3 && !b.bad;
    printf("ExitThread: unwound from %d nested host calls (stage %d) and from a fiber (stage %d), nothing ran after "
           "it: %s\n", a.depth, a.stage, b.stage, ok ? "ok" : "FAIL");
    CHECK(ok, "ExitThread unwinding (bad %d %d)", a.bad, b.bad);
}

// ---- lifted code: main's PLT stub for nn::os::GetSystemTick -> lifted sdk -> rt_ticks
typedef struct { uint64_t first, last; long bad; } TickJob;

static void tick_worker(Cpu *c) {
    TickJob *j = arg_p(c, 0);
    uint64_t prev = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < TICK_CALLS; i++) {
        uint64_t t = rt_call(c, tick_stub, 0);
        if (!t || t < prev) j->bad++;
        if (!i) j->first = t;
        prev = t;
    }
    j->last = prev;
    exit_thread(c);
}

static void test_lifted_ticks(Cpu *c) {
    TickJob j[TICK_THREADS] = {0};
    uint32_t h[TICK_THREADS];
    uint64_t calls0 = hostfn_calls(), before = rt_ticks();
    for (int i = 0; i < TICK_THREADS; i++) h[i] = create(c, a_tick_worker, &j[i], 44, -2);
    for (int i = 0; i < TICK_THREADS; i++) start(c, h[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < TICK_THREADS; i++) join(c, h[i]);
    uint64_t after = rt_ticks(), calls = hostfn_calls() - calls0;
    char stub[128], def[128];
    printf("lifted GetSystemTick: %d guest threads x %d calls of %s -> %s:\n", TICK_THREADS, TICK_CALLS,
           ldr_describe(tick_stub, stub, sizeof stub), ldr_describe(ldr_symbol(TICK_SYMBOL), def, sizeof def));
    int ok = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < TICK_THREADS; i++) {
        int in = j[i].first >= before && j[i].last <= after && j[i].last > j[i].first;
        printf("  thread %d: ticks %llu .. %llu, %ld out of order, inside the host's rt_ticks window: %s\n", i,
               (unsigned long long)j[i].first, (unsigned long long)j[i].last, j[i].bad, in ? "yes" : "NO");
        ok &= !j[i].bad && in;
    }
    // Host functions entered by dispatch meanwhile: only the four thread entries, so no call reached a host override.
    int lifted = calls == TICK_THREADS;
    printf("  monotonic per thread: %s; host-function calls meanwhile %llu (the %d thread entries): %s\n",
           ok ? "ok" : "FAIL", (unsigned long long)calls, TICK_THREADS, lifted ? "all ticks came from lifted code"
                                                                                : "FAIL");
    CHECK(ok && lifted, "lifted GetSystemTick");
}

// svc 0x07 ExitProcess: the path up to the final ExitProcess (logged, pipeline cache saved, logs flushed) runs with the
// test hook in its place, which must see exit code 0; the SVC then returns to the probe.
static volatile int32_t exit_calls;
static volatile unsigned exit_code = 99;
static void exit_hook(unsigned code) { exit_code = code, exit_calls++; }
static void test_exit_process(Cpu *c) {
    svc_test_exit_hook = exit_hook;
    sv(c, 0x07, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    svc_test_exit_hook = NULL;
    CHECK(exit_calls == 1 && exit_code == 0, "ExitProcess reached the exit %d times with code %u", exit_calls, exit_code);
    printf("ExitProcess: exit path reached once with code %u\n", exit_code);
}

static void probe_main(Cpu *c) {
    Cpu *again;
    uint32_t me = kern_main_thread(&again);
    uint64_t mb, ms;
    kern_main_stack(&mb, &ms);
    printf("main thread %#x: prio 44 core 0, guest stack %#llx+%#llx, sp %#llx, TLR %#llx (+0x1F8 -> %#llx)\n", me,
           (unsigned long long)mb, (unsigned long long)ms, (unsigned long long)c->sp, (unsigned long long)c->tpidrro,
           (unsigned long long)LD64(c->tpidrro + 0x1F8));
    CHECK(again == c && c->sp == mb + ms && LD64(c->tpidrro + 0x1F8) == c->tpidrro + 0x200, "main thread set-up");
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x25, 0, KERN_H_CURRENT_THREAD, 0, 0) == 0 && c->x[1] == 0x51, "GetThreadId(current) %#llx",
          (unsigned long long)c->x[1]);
    test_lock(c, me);
    test_cv_wake_order(c);
    test_cv_key_order(c);
    test_arbiter(c);
    test_events(c);
    test_cores(c);
    test_fibers(c);
    test_exit(c);
    test_lifted_ticks(c);
    test_exit_process(c);
}

// ---- platform layer (platform/win32.c): a thread handing values over a condition variable, and plat_sleep_ns(1 ms)
// overshoot (median of 21 under 0.5 ms; frame pacing depends on it).
static PlatMutex g_pm = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
static PlatCond g_pc = PLAT_COND_INIT;
static int g_pv;

static void plat_worker(void *arg) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_pm);
    g_pv = (int)(intptr_t)arg;
    plat_cond_broadcast(&g_pc);
    while (g_pv != 2) plat_cond_wait(&g_pc, &g_pm);
    g_pv = 3;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_pm);
}

static int cmp_u64(const void *a, const void *b) {
    uint64_t x = *(const uint64_t *)a, y = *(const uint64_t *)b;
    return x < y ? -1 : x > y;
}

static void test_platform(void) {
    PlatThread *t = plat_thread_new(plat_worker, (void *)(intptr_t)1, "probe-kernel plat");
    CHECK(t, "plat_thread_new");
    if (t) {
        plat_mutex_lock(&g_pm);
        int timed_out = 0;
        while (g_pv != 1 && !timed_out) timed_out = !plat_cond_wait_ns(&g_pc, &g_pm, 5000000000ull);
        CHECK(g_pv == 1, "plat thread did not start (%d)", g_pv);
        g_pv = 2;
        plat_cond_broadcast(&g_pc);
        plat_mutex_unlock(&g_pm);
        plat_thread_join(t);
        CHECK(g_pv == 3, "plat thread did not finish (%d)", g_pv);
    }
    PlatMutex m = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
    PlatCond c = PLAT_COND_INIT;
    plat_mutex_lock(&m);
    uint64_t t0 = plat_now_ns();
    CHECK(plat_cond_wait_ns(&c, &m, 2000000) == 0 && plat_now_ns() - t0 >= 1000000, "plat_cond_wait_ns timeout");
    plat_mutex_unlock(&m);
    CHECK(plat_mutex_trylock(&m), "plat_mutex_trylock");
    plat_mutex_unlock(&m);

    enum { N = 21 };
    uint64_t over[N];
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        uint64_t a = plat_now_ns();
        plat_sleep_ns(1000000);
        uint64_t d = plat_now_ns() - a;
        CHECK(d >= 1000000, "plat_sleep_ns(1 ms) returned after %llu ns", (unsigned long long)d);
        over[i] = d > 1000000 ? d - 1000000 : 0;
    }
    qsort(over, N, sizeof *over, cmp_u64);
    printf("  plat_sleep_ns(1 ms) overshoot: median %.3f ms, max %.3f ms\n", over[N / 2] / 1e6, over[N - 1] / 1e6);
    CHECK(over[N / 2] < 500000, "plat_sleep_ns(1 ms) median overshoot %.3f ms (want < 0.5)", over[N / 2] / 1e6);
}

int probe_kernel(void) {
    a_lock_waiter = hostfn_register("probe-kernel lock waiter", lock_waiter);
    a_cv_waiter = hostfn_register("probe-kernel condvar waiter", cv_waiter);
    a_cv_order_waiter = hostfn_register("probe-kernel condvar order waiter", cv_order_waiter);
    a_arb_waiter = hostfn_register("probe-kernel arbiter waiter", arb_waiter);
    a_event_waiter = hostfn_register("probe-kernel event waiter", event_waiter);
    a_core_worker = hostfn_register("probe-kernel core worker", core_worker);
    a_exit_entry = hostfn_register("probe-kernel exit entry", exit_entry);
    a_exit_nested = hostfn_register("probe-kernel exit nested", exit_nested);
    a_fiber_fn = hostfn_register("probe-kernel fiber", fiber_fn);
    a_fiber_exit_thread = hostfn_register("probe-kernel fiber exit thread", fiber_exit_thread);
    a_fiber_exit_fn = hostfn_register("probe-kernel fiber exit", fiber_exit_fn);
    a_tick_worker = hostfn_register("probe-kernel tick worker", tick_worker);
    a_fib_init = hostfn_register(KERN_SYM_INITIALIZE_FIBER, kern_fiber_initialize);   // the loader's addresses
    a_fib_fin = hostfn_register(KERN_SYM_FINALIZE_FIBER, kern_fiber_finalize);
    a_fib_switch = hostfn_register(KERN_SYM_SWITCH_TO_FIBER, kern_fiber_switch);
    a_fib_cur = hostfn_register(KERN_SYM_GET_CURRENT_FIBER, kern_fiber_current);
    ldr_load(rt_config()->exefs);
    tick_stub = ldr_plt_stub("main", TICK_SYMBOL);
    if (!tick_stub || !ldr_symbol(TICK_SYMBOL)) {
        printf("probe-kernel: FAILED (no PLT stub for %s in main)\n", TICK_SYMBOL);
        return 1;
    }
    test_platform();
    kern_run_on_guest_main(probe_main);
    RtStats s = rt_stats();
    printf("stats: %llu SVCs, %llu threads, %llu host calls\n", (unsigned long long)s.svcs,
           (unsigned long long)s.threads, (unsigned long long)s.host_calls);
    if (failures) {
        printf("probe-kernel: FAILED (%d failures)\n", failures);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("probe-kernel: passed\n");
    return 0;
}

```

`runtime/loader.c`:

```c
// Adapted from LAS Recomp runtime/loader.c @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai) and MacNativeGames
// games/totk/runtime/loader.c and scripts/prepare_runtime.py @ b75be8c (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames
// contributors).
// NSO loading at the fixed layout bases, dynamic linking with host overrides, the nnMain identity check, sealing,
// and --probe-loader.
//
// The lifted C was generated from the unrelocated words of .text and .rodata and embeds absolute guest addresses, so
// each module must sit at its layout base and relocations may only write the data segment.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "layout.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

// hostfn.c, for the loader only.
uint64_t hostfn_register_observer(const char *name, GuestFn fn, uint64_t original);

enum { DT_NULL = 0, DT_PLTRELSZ = 2, DT_HASH = 4, DT_STRTAB = 5, DT_SYMTAB = 6, DT_RELA = 7, DT_RELASZ = 8,
       DT_INIT = 12, DT_FINI = 13, DT_JMPREL = 23, DT_INIT_ARRAY = 25, DT_FINI_ARRAY = 26, DT_INIT_ARRAYSZ = 27,
       DT_FINI_ARRAYSZ = 28, DT_RELRSZ = 0x23, DT_RELR = 0x24, DT_GNU_HASH = 0x6ffffef5 };
enum { R_ABS64 = 257, R_GLOB_DAT = 1025, R_JUMP_SLOT = 1026, R_RELATIVE = 1027 };
enum { K_RELATIVE, K_ABS64, K_GLOB_DAT, K_JUMP_SLOT, K_COUNT };
enum { STB_WEAK = 2, STT_FUNC = 2 };

typedef struct { uint32_t name; uint8_t info, other; uint16_t shndx; uint64_t value, size; } Elf64Sym;
typedef struct { uint64_t off, info; int64_t addend; } Elf64Rela;

// How a symbol of a relocation was bound.
enum { RES_UNSET, RES_GUEST, RES_OVERRIDE, RES_OBSERVER, RES_WEAK, RES_STUB };
typedef struct { uint64_t value; uint8_t kind; } Res;

typedef struct {
    RtLoaded pub;
    uint32_t seg_off[3], seg_size[3];   // text, rodata, data (data without bss)
    const Elf64Sym *syms;
    const char *strtab;
    uint32_t nsyms;
    const Elf64Rela *rela, *jmprel;
    uint64_t nrela, njmprel;
    const uint64_t *relr;               // DT_RELR (1.4.3): packed RELATIVE relocations
    uint64_t nrelr, relr_count;
    uint32_t *hash, hash_mask;          // defined symbols by name
    Res *res_plain, *res_jump;          // per symbol; JUMP_SLOT may bind an observer
    uint32_t *funcs, nfuncs;            // defined functions sorted by value (ldr_describe)
    uint64_t *plt_slot, *plt_stub, nplt;   // PLT stubs sorted by GOT slot (ldr_plt_stub), built on first use
    // statistics
    uint64_t kinds[K_COUNT], sym_import, sym_own;
    uint32_t imports, import_to[MOD_COUNT], weak_unresolved, strong_unresolved;
    uint32_t init_off;
} Mod;

static Mod mods[MOD_COUNT];
static int nmods;
static uint64_t identity_refs, stubs;
static int *ovr_used, *obs_used;   // per linked table entry, plus probe overrides counted separately
static PlatMutex plt_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;

int ldr_count(void) { return nmods; }
const RtLoaded *ldr_module(int i) { return i >= 0 && i < nmods ? &mods[i].pub : NULL; }

static uint32_t rd32(uint64_t a) { return LD32(a); }

// ---- files
static uint8_t *read_file(const char *path, size_t *len) {
    uint64_t size = 0;
    uint8_t *p = plat_file_read(path, &size);
    if (p) *len = (size_t)size;
    return p;
}

static void hex32(const uint8_t d[32], char out[65]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) snprintf(out + 2 * i, 3, "%02x", d[i]);
}

uint8_t *ldr_read_verified(const char *dir, const char *file, size_t *len) {
    const char *want = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < rt_exefs_sha256_count; i++)
        if (!strcmp(rt_exefs_sha256[i].file, file)) want = rt_exefs_sha256[i].sha256;
    if (!want) rt_fatal("loader: no expected SHA-256 for %s in modules.c", file);
    char path[1024];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s", dir, file);
    uint8_t *p = read_file(path, len);
    if (!p) rt_fatal("loader: cannot read %s (extract the game first: tools/extract.py)", path);
    uint8_t d[32];
    char hex[65];
    rt_sha256(p, *len, d);
    hex32(d, hex);
    if (strcmp(hex, want)) rt_fatal("loader: %s has SHA-256 %s, expected %s", path, hex, want);
    return p;
}

// ---- NSO
static size_t lz4_decompress(const uint8_t *src, size_t srclen, uint8_t *dst, size_t dstlen) {
    const uint8_t *s = src, *se = src + srclen;
    uint8_t *d = dst, *de = dst + dstlen;
    while (s < se) {
        uint8_t tok = *s++;
        size_t lit = tok >> 4;
        if (lit == 15) { uint8_t b; do { if (s >= se) return 0; b = *s++; lit += b; } while (b == 255); }
        if ((size_t)(de - d) < lit || (size_t)(se - s) < lit) return 0;
        memcpy(d, s, lit);
        d += lit;
        s += lit;
        if (s >= se) break;
        if (se - s < 2) return 0;
        size_t off = s[0] | (s[1] << 8);
        s += 2;
        size_t ml = tok & 15;
        if (ml == 15) { uint8_t b; do { if (s >= se) return 0; b = *s++; ml += b; } while (b == 255); }
        ml += 4;
        if (!off || off > (size_t)(d - dst) || (size_t)(de - d) < ml) return 0;
        uint8_t *m = d - off;
        while (ml--) *d++ = *m++;
    }
    return (size_t)(d - dst);
}

typedef struct { uint32_t file_off, mem_off, size, csize; int compressed, zbic; } Seg;
size_t rt_zbic_decompress(void *dst, size_t dstCap, const void *src, size_t srcSize);


static uint64_t nso_segments(const uint8_t *raw, size_t len, const char *name, Seg seg[3]) {
    if (len < 0x100 || memcmp(raw, "NSO0", 4)) rt_fatal("loader: %s is not an NSO", name);
    uint32_t flags = *(const uint32_t *)(raw + 0xC);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        memcpy(&seg[i], raw + 0x10 + i * 0x10, 12);
        seg[i].csize = *(const uint32_t *)(raw + 0x60 + i * 4);
        seg[i].compressed = (flags >> i) & 1;
        seg[i].zbic = (flags & 0x80) != 0;
        if ((uint64_t)seg[i].file_off + (seg[i].compressed ? seg[i].csize : seg[i].size) > len)
            rt_fatal("loader: %s segment %d lies outside the file", name, i);
    }
    uint32_t bss = *(const uint32_t *)(raw + 0x3C);
    return ((uint64_t)seg[2].mem_off + seg[2].size + bss + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFull;
}

static void nso_segment(const uint8_t *raw, const Seg *s, uint8_t *dst, const char *name, int i) {
    if (!s->compressed) {
        memcpy(dst, raw + s->file_off, s->size);
    } else if (s->zbic) {
        if (rt_zbic_decompress(dst, s->size, raw + s->file_off, s->csize) != s->size)
            rt_fatal("loader: %s segment %d: ZBIC data is corrupt", name, i);
    } else if (lz4_decompress(raw + s->file_off, s->csize, dst, s->size) != s->size) {
        rt_fatal("loader: %s segment %d: LZ4 data is corrupt", name, i);
    }
}

// ---- symbols
static const char *sym_name(const Mod *m, uint32_t i) { return m->strtab + m->syms[i].name; }
static int sym_defined(const Mod *m, uint32_t i) { return m->syms[i].shndx != 0; }

static uint32_t fnv(const char *s) {
    uint32_t h = 2166136261u;
    for (; *s; s++) h = (h ^ (uint8_t)*s) * 16777619u;
    return h;
}

static void make_hash(Mod *m) {
    uint32_t cap = 16;
    while (cap < m->nsyms * 2) cap <<= 1;
    m->hash = calloc(cap, sizeof *m->hash);
    if (!m->hash) rt_fatal("loader: symbol hash allocation");
    m->hash_mask = cap - 1;
    for (uint32_t i = 1; i < m->nsyms; i++) {
        if (!sym_defined(m, i) || !*sym_name(m, i)) continue;
        const char *s = sym_name(m, i);
        uint32_t p = fnv(s) & m->hash_mask;
        while (m->hash[p] && strcmp(s, sym_name(m, m->hash[p]))) p = (p + 1) & m->hash_mask;
        if (!m->hash[p]) m->hash[p] = i;
    }
}

static uint64_t module_symbol(const Mod *m, const char *name) {
    for (uint32_t p = fnv(name) & m->hash_mask; m->hash[p]; p = (p + 1) & m->hash_mask) {
        uint32_t i = m->hash[p];
        if (!strcmp(name, sym_name(m, i))) return m->pub.base + m->syms[i].value;
    }
    return 0;
}

// The defined symbol in load order (main, subsdk0, sdk); *which is its module index.
static uint64_t find_symbol(const char *name, int *which) {
    for (int i = 0; i < nmods; i++) {
        uint64_t a = module_symbol(&mods[i], name);
        if (a) {
            if (which) *which = i;
            return a;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

uint64_t ldr_symbol(const char *name) { return find_symbol(name, NULL); }

static const Mod *sort_mod;
static int by_value(const void *a, const void *b) {
    uint64_t x = sort_mod->syms[*(const uint32_t *)a].value, y = sort_mod->syms[*(const uint32_t *)b].value;
    return x < y ? -1 : x > y;
}

static void make_funcs(Mod *m) {
    m->funcs = malloc((m->nsyms ? m->nsyms : 1) * sizeof *m->funcs);
    if (!m->funcs) rt_fatal("loader: function table allocation");
    for (uint32_t i = 1; i < m->nsyms; i++)
        if (sym_defined(m, i) && (m->syms[i].info & 0xF) == STT_FUNC && *sym_name(m, i)) m->funcs[m->nfuncs++] = i;
    sort_mod = m;
    qsort(m->funcs, m->nfuncs, sizeof *m->funcs, by_value);
}

// ---- loading
static void parse_dynamic(Mod *m) {
    uint64_t base = m->pub.base;
    uint64_t mod0 = base + rd32(base + 4);
    if (memcmp((const void *)(uintptr_t)mod0, "MOD0", 4)) rt_fatal("loader: %s has no MOD0 header", m->pub.name);
    uint64_t dyn = mod0 + (int64_t)(int32_t)rd32(mod0 + 4);
    uint64_t rela = 0, relasz = 0, jmprel = 0, pltsz = 0, hash = 0, gnu_hash = 0, relr = 0, relrsz = 0;
    for (const uint64_t *d = (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)dyn; d[0] != DT_NULL; d += 2) {
        switch (d[0]) {
        case DT_SYMTAB: m->syms = (const Elf64Sym *)(uintptr_t)(base + d[1]); break;
        case DT_STRTAB: m->strtab = (const char *)(uintptr_t)(base + d[1]); break;
        case DT_HASH: hash = base + d[1]; break;
        case DT_GNU_HASH: gnu_hash = base + d[1]; break;
        case DT_RELR: relr = base + d[1]; break;
        case DT_RELRSZ: relrsz = d[1]; break;
        case DT_RELA: rela = base + d[1]; break;
        case DT_RELASZ: relasz = d[1]; break;
        case DT_JMPREL: jmprel = base + d[1]; break;
        case DT_PLTRELSZ: pltsz = d[1]; break;
        case DT_INIT: m->pub.init = base + d[1]; m->init_off = (uint32_t)d[1]; break;
        case DT_INIT_ARRAY: m->pub.init_array = base + d[1]; break;
        case DT_INIT_ARRAYSZ: m->pub.init_array_size = d[1]; break;
        }
    }
    if (!m->syms || !m->strtab || (!hash && !gnu_hash))
        rt_fatal("loader: %s lacks DT_SYMTAB, DT_STRTAB or a symbol hash", m->pub.name);
    if (hash) {
        m->nsyms = rd32(hash + 4);   // nchain
    } else {
        // DT_GNU_HASH only (1.4.3 sdk, subsdk0): one past the last symbol the highest bucket's chain reaches.
        uint32_t nbuckets = rd32(gnu_hash), symoffset = rd32(gnu_hash + 4), bloom = rd32(gnu_hash + 8);
        uint64_t buckets = gnu_hash + 16 + 8ull * bloom, chains = buckets + 4ull * nbuckets;
        uint32_t last = 0;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nbuckets; i++)
            if (rd32(buckets + 4ull * i) > last) last = rd32(buckets + 4ull * i);
        if (last < symoffset) {
            m->nsyms = symoffset;
        } else {
            while (!(rd32(chains + 4ull * (last - symoffset)) & 1)) last++;
            m->nsyms = last + 1;
        }
    }
    m->relr = (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)relr;
    m->nrelr = relrsz / 8;
    m->rela = (const Elf64Rela *)(uintptr_t)rela;
    m->nrela = relasz / sizeof(Elf64Rela);
    m->jmprel = (const Elf64Rela *)(uintptr_t)jmprel;
    m->njmprel = pltsz / sizeof(Elf64Rela);
}

// The constructor state flag DT_INIT checks: ADRP xN at DT_INIT+16, LDR wM, [xN, #imm] at +20 or +24
// (MNG scripts/prepare_runtime.py). Switch 2 code opens every function with PACIBSP, which moves the ADRP to +20 and
// the LDR to +24 or +28.
static uint64_t decode_ctor_flag(const Mod *m) {
    uint64_t init = m->pub.init;
    if (!init) return 0;
    int adrp_at = rd32(init) == 0xd503237fu ? 20 : 16;   // PACIBSP
    uint32_t a = rd32(init + adrp_at);
    if ((a & 0x9f000000u) != 0x90000000u) return 0;
    uint32_t reg = a & 31;
    for (int at = adrp_at + 4; at <= adrp_at + 8; at += 4) {
        uint32_t w = rd32(init + at);
        if ((w & 0xffc00000u) != 0xb9400000u || ((w >> 5) & 31) != reg) continue;
        int64_t imm = (int64_t)(((a >> 29) & 3) | (((a >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2));
        imm = (imm ^ (1 << 20)) - (1 << 20);
        uint64_t flag = ((init + adrp_at) & ~0xFFFull) + (uint64_t)(imm << 12) + ((w >> 10) & 0xfff) * 4;
        uint64_t data = m->pub.base + m->pub.data_off;
        return flag >= data && flag < m->pub.base + m->pub.size ? flag : 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

static void load_module(Mod *m, const char *dir, const RtLayoutEntry *lay) {
    size_t len;
    uint8_t *raw = ldr_read_verified(dir, lay->name, &len);
    Seg seg[3];
    uint64_t size = nso_segments(raw, len, lay->name, seg);
    if (size != lay->size)
        rt_fatal("loader: %s image is %#llx bytes, layout.h says %#llx: generated C and game files differ", lay->name,
                 (unsigned long long)size, (unsigned long long)lay->size);
    if (!plat_mem_commit(lay->base, size))
        rt_fatal("loader: cannot commit %s at %#llx", lay->name, (unsigned long long)lay->base);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if ((uint64_t)seg[i].mem_off + seg[i].size > size) rt_fatal("loader: %s segment %d exceeds the image", lay->name, i);
        nso_segment(raw, &seg[i], (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(lay->base + seg[i].mem_off), lay->name, i);
        m->seg_off[i] = seg[i].mem_off;
        m->seg_size[i] = seg[i].size;
    }
    free(raw);
    m->pub.name = lay->name;
    m->pub.base = lay->base;
    m->pub.size = size;
    m->pub.text_end = seg[0].mem_off + seg[0].size;
    m->pub.data_off = seg[2].mem_off;
    if (m->pub.data_off & 0xFFF) rt_fatal("loader: %s data segment is not page aligned", lay->name);
    if (seg[1].mem_off < m->pub.text_end || seg[1].mem_off + seg[1].size > m->pub.data_off)
        rt_fatal("loader: %s segments are out of order", lay->name);
    parse_dynamic(m);
    make_hash(m);
    make_funcs(m);
    m->res_plain = calloc(m->nsyms, sizeof(Res));
    m->res_jump = calloc(m->nsyms, sizeof(Res));
    if (!m->res_plain || !m->res_jump) rt_fatal("loader: resolution table allocation");
}

// ---- relocation
// A strong import nothing defines: calling it is fatal with its name (expected count 0).
static void unresolved_stub(Cpu *c) {
    char lr[96];
    rt_fatal("call to unresolved import %s from %s", hostfn_name(c->pc), ldr_describe(c->x[30] - 4, lr, sizeof lr));
}

static void mark_used(int observers, const char *name) {
    int n = hostfn_table_size(observers);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!strcmp(hostfn_table_name(observers, i), name)) (observers ? obs_used : ovr_used)[i] = 1;
}

// Order (MNG loader.c:216-224): observer (JUMP_SLOT only), override by name, own definition, other modules in load
// order, weak -> 0, strong -> named fatal stub. Overrides also replace a module's own symbols.
static Res resolve(Mod *m, uint32_t si, int jump) {
    Res *cache = jump ? &m->res_jump[si] : &m->res_plain[si];
    if (cache->kind != RES_UNSET) return *cache;
    const char *name = sym_name(m, si);
    uint64_t guest = sym_defined(m, si) ? m->pub.base + m->syms[si].value : find_symbol(name, NULL);
    GuestFn f;
    Res r;
    if (jump && (f = hostfn_observer(name))) {
        r = (Res){hostfn_register_observer(name, f, guest), RES_OBSERVER};
        mark_used(1, name);
    } else if ((f = hostfn_override(name))) {
        r = (Res){hostfn_register(name, f), RES_OVERRIDE};
        mark_used(0, name);
    } else if (guest) {
        r = (Res){guest, RES_GUEST};
    } else if ((m->syms[si].info >> 4) == STB_WEAK) {
        r = (Res){0, RES_WEAK};
    } else {
        r = (Res){hostfn_register(name, unresolved_stub), RES_STUB};
        stubs++;
        rt_log("%s: strong import %s is unresolved", m->pub.name, name);
    }
    *cache = r;
    return r;
}

static void relocate_table(Mod *m, const Elf64Rela *r, uint64_t n) {
    uint64_t base = m->pub.base;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint32_t type = (uint32_t)r[i].info, si = (uint32_t)(r[i].info >> 32);
        if (r[i].off < m->pub.data_off || r[i].off > m->pub.size - 8)
            rt_fatal("loader: %s relocation %llu writes +%#llx, outside the data segment", m->pub.name,
                     (unsigned long long)i, (unsigned long long)r[i].off);
        uint64_t v;
        if (type == R_RELATIVE) {
            m->kinds[K_RELATIVE]++;
            v = base + (uint64_t)r[i].addend;
        } else {
            int k = type == R_ABS64 ? K_ABS64 : type == R_GLOB_DAT ? K_GLOB_DAT : type == R_JUMP_SLOT ? K_JUMP_SLOT : -1;
            if (k < 0) rt_fatal("loader: %s relocation %llu has type %u", m->pub.name, (unsigned long long)i, type);
            if (si == 0 || si >= m->nsyms) rt_fatal("loader: %s relocation %llu names symbol %u", m->pub.name,
                                                    (unsigned long long)i, si);
            m->kinds[k]++;
            if (sym_defined(m, si)) m->sym_own++;
            else m->sym_import++;
            Res s = resolve(m, si, type == R_JUMP_SLOT);
            v = s.kind == RES_WEAK ? 0 : s.value + (type == R_JUMP_SLOT ? 0 : (uint64_t)r[i].addend);
        }
        ST64(base + r[i].off, v);
    }
}

// DT_RELR: an even entry is an offset to relocate (the next bitmap starts after it); an odd entry is a bitmap of the
// 63 words that follow. Each relocated word holds its addend, as R_AARCH64_RELATIVE with an implicit addend.
static void relocate_relr(Mod *m) {
    uint64_t base = m->pub.base, where = 0;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < m->nrelr; i++) {
        uint64_t e = m->relr[i];
        for (int k = -1; k < 63; k++) {
            uint64_t off;
            if (k < 0) {
                if (e & 1) continue;
                off = e;
                where = e + 8;
            } else {
                if (!(e & 1) || !((e >> (k + 1)) & 1)) continue;
                off = where + 8ull * k;
            }
            if (off < m->pub.data_off || off > m->pub.size - 8)
                rt_fatal("loader: %s RELR entry %llu writes +%#llx, outside the data segment", m->pub.name,
                         (unsigned long long)i, (unsigned long long)off);
            ST64(base + off, base + LD64(base + off));
            m->kinds[K_RELATIVE]++;
            m->relr_count++;
        }
        if (e & 1) where += 63 * 8;
    }
}

// Import table statistics: every undefined named symbol, bound by guest definition (overrides aside).
static void count_imports(Mod *m) {
    for (uint32_t i = 1; i < m->nsyms; i++) {
        if (sym_defined(m, i) || !*sym_name(m, i)) continue;
        m->imports++;
        int which = -1;
        if (find_symbol(sym_name(m, i), &which)) m->import_to[which]++;
        else if ((m->syms[i].info >> 4) == STB_WEAK) m->weak_unresolved++;
        else m->strong_unresolved++;
    }
}

// Every non-JUMP_SLOT reference to nnMain holds the real address (MNG loader.c:229-239).
static void verify_identity(void) {
    uint64_t real = ldr_symbol("nnMain");
    if (!real) rt_fatal("loader: nnMain is not defined");
    for (int i = 0; i < nmods; i++) {
        Mod *m = &mods[i];
        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            const Elf64Rela *r = t ? m->jmprel : m->rela;
            uint64_t n = t ? m->njmprel : m->nrela;
            for (uint64_t j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                uint32_t type = (uint32_t)r[j].info, si = (uint32_t)(r[j].info >> 32);
                if (type == R_RELATIVE || type == R_JUMP_SLOT || strcmp(sym_name(m, si), "nnMain")) continue;
                uint64_t actual = LD64(m->pub.base + r[j].off);
                if (actual != real)
                    rt_fatal("loader: %s +%#llx refers to nnMain as %#llx, not %#llx", m->pub.name,
                             (unsigned long long)r[j].off, (unsigned long long)actual, (unsigned long long)real);
                identity_refs++;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!identity_refs) rt_fatal("loader: no reference to nnMain to check");
}

// .text and .rodata read-only: guest code never executes from guest memory, and nothing may write them.
static void seal(Mod *m) {
    if (!plat_mem_protect(m->pub.base, m->pub.data_off, PLAT_PROT_READ))
        rt_fatal("loader: cannot seal %s", m->pub.name);
}

void ldr_load(const char *exefs_dir) {
    if (nmods) rt_fatal("ldr_load called twice");
    if (!mem_layout()->pool) rt_fatal("ldr_load before mem_init");
    if (rt_layout_count > MOD_COUNT) rt_fatal("loader: %d modules in the layout", rt_layout_count);
    for (int i = 0; i < rt_layout_count; i++) load_module(&mods[i], exefs_dir, &rt_layout[i]);
    nmods = rt_layout_count;
    ovr_used = calloc(hostfn_table_size(0) + 1, sizeof(int));
    obs_used = calloc(hostfn_table_size(1) + 1, sizeof(int));
    for (int i = 0; i < nmods; i++) {
        relocate_table(&mods[i], mods[i].rela, mods[i].nrela);
        relocate_table(&mods[i], mods[i].jmprel, mods[i].njmprel);
        relocate_relr(&mods[i]);
        count_imports(&mods[i]);
        mods[i].pub.ctor_flag = decode_ctor_flag(&mods[i]);
    }
    verify_identity();
    for (int i = 0; i < nmods; i++) seal(&mods[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < nmods; i++) {
        const Mod *m = &mods[i];
        rt_log("loaded %-8s at %#llx size %#llx: %llu relocations, %u imports", m->pub.name,
               (unsigned long long)m->pub.base, (unsigned long long)m->pub.size,
               (unsigned long long)(m->nrela + m->njmprel + m->relr_count), m->imports);
    }
}

// ---- lookups
static int module_of(uint64_t a) {
    for (int i = 0; i < nmods; i++)
        if (a - mods[i].pub.base < mods[i].pub.size) return i;
    return -1;
}

const char *ldr_describe(uint64_t a, char *buf, int n) {
    int i = module_of(a);
    if (i < 0) {
        const char *h = hostfn_name(a);
        if (h) snprintf(buf, n, "host %s", h);
        else snprintf(buf, n, "%#llx", (unsigned long long)a);
        return buf;
    }
    const Mod *m = &mods[i];
    uint64_t off = a - m->pub.base;
    uint32_t lo = 0, hi = m->nfuncs;   // last function with value <= off
    while (lo < hi) {
        uint32_t mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (m->syms[m->funcs[mid]].value <= off) lo = mid + 1;
        else hi = mid;
    }
    if (lo) {
        const Elf64Sym *s = &m->syms[m->funcs[lo - 1]];
        if (off - s->value < (s->size ? s->size : 0x100000)) {
            snprintf(buf, n, "%s+%#llx (%s+%#llx)", m->pub.name, (unsigned long long)off, m->strtab + s->name,
                     (unsigned long long)(off - s->value));
            return buf;
        }
    }
    snprintf(buf, n, "%s+%#llx", m->pub.name, (unsigned long long)off);
    return buf;
}

static int by_slot(const void *a, const void *b) {
    uint64_t x = ((const uint64_t *)a)[0], y = ((const uint64_t *)b)[0];
    return x < y ? -1 : x > y;
}

// PLT stubs: adrp x16, page; ldr x17, [x16, #slot]; add x16, x16, #slot; br x17.
static void find_plt(Mod *m) {
    uint64_t text = m->pub.base + m->seg_off[0], end = text + m->seg_size[0];
    uint64_t cap = 1024, n = 0, *pairs = malloc(cap * 16);
    for (uint64_t a = text; a + 16 <= end && pairs; a += 4) {
        uint32_t w0 = rd32(a), w1 = rd32(a + 4), w3 = rd32(a + 12);
        if ((w0 & 0x9f00001fu) != 0x90000010u || (w1 & 0xffc003ffu) != 0xf9400211u || w3 != 0xd61f0220u) continue;
        int64_t imm = (int64_t)(((w0 >> 29) & 3) | (((w0 >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2));
        imm = (imm ^ (1 << 20)) - (1 << 20);
        uint64_t slot = (a & ~0xFFFull) + (uint64_t)(imm << 12) + ((w1 >> 10) & 0xfff) * 8;
        if (n == cap) pairs = realloc(pairs, (cap *= 2) * 16);
        if (!pairs) break;
        pairs[2 * n] = slot;
        pairs[2 * n + 1] = a;
        n++;
    }
    if (!pairs) rt_fatal("loader: PLT table allocation");
    qsort(pairs, n, 16, by_slot);
    m->plt_slot = pairs;
    m->nplt = n;
}

uint64_t ldr_plt_stub(const char *module, const char *name) {
    Mod *m = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < nmods; i++)
        if (!strcmp(mods[i].pub.name, module)) m = &mods[i];
    if (!m) return 0;
    plat_mutex_lock(&plt_lock);
    if (!m->plt_slot) find_plt(m);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&plt_lock);
    for (uint64_t j = 0; j < m->njmprel; j++) {
        uint32_t si = (uint32_t)(m->jmprel[j].info >> 32);
        if ((uint32_t)m->jmprel[j].info != R_JUMP_SLOT || strcmp(sym_name(m, si), name)) continue;
        uint64_t slot = m->pub.base + m->jmprel[j].off;
        uint64_t lo = 0, hi = m->nplt;
        while (lo < hi) {
            uint64_t mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (m->plt_slot[2 * mid] < slot) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        if (lo < m->nplt && m->plt_slot[2 * lo] == slot) return m->plt_slot[2 * lo + 1];
    }
    return 0;
}

// ---- --probe-loader
// Expected values, measured on the 1.1.1, 1.2.1 and 1.4.3 modules; the 1.4.3 relocation totals match the ones
// MacNativeGames' port notes give for that version. 1.1.1 shares subsdk0 and sdk with 1.2.1 down to every count.
typedef struct {
    const char *name;
    uint64_t kinds[K_COUNT], total, sym_import, sym_own;
    uint32_t imports, to[MOD_COUNT], weak, init_off, init_array;
} Expect;
static const Expect expect_121[] = {
    {"main", {508816, 1415, 32, 641}, 510904, 2088, 0, 675, {0, 16, 647}, 12, 0x30, 10673},
    {"subsdk0", {1623, 12820, 1030, 3924}, 19397, 6576, 11198, 667, {9, 0, 654}, 4, 0x30, 45},
    {"sdk", {10917, 13976, 1207, 8932}, 35032, 16, 24099, 13, {8, 0, 0}, 5, 0x30, 116},
};
static const Expect expect_111[] = {
```
