`runtime/movie_probe.c`:

```c
// totk.exe --probe-movie: the host movie::Decoder (ov_movie.c) on one TotK movie from the RomFS.
// A small Matroska/WebM demuxer reads the VP9 frames of Event/Movie/<name>.webm (the smallest one, or the first whose
// path contains TOTK_PROBE_MOVIE). The probe then drives the decoder through the same HOST_OVERRIDE entries the game
// calls, with a Cpu of its own; the guest functions the decoder calls (nn::os::SignalEvent, movie::Buffer,
// movie::MediaData) are host stand-ins registered as host functions, so rt_call reaches them as it reaches the SDK's.
//   1. unpaced: every frame in, every frame out: frame count, size, output format, PTS order, events, decode cost;
//   2. paced at 60 presents per second (fake clock): at most one frame per present, one frame per 2 presents, no drops;
//   3. paced at 15 presents per second: late frames are dropped, the frame handed over is the one due.
// Without the RomFS (no game data) it prints why and exits 0. TOTK_PROBE_MOVIE_SHOT=<file.ppm> saves the middle frame.
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "fs.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "movie.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define CHECK(cond, ...)                                                                                                \
    do {                                                                                                               \
        if (!(cond)) {                                                                                                 \
            printf("probe-movie: FAILED: ");                                                                           \
            printf(__VA_ARGS__);                                                                                       \
            printf("\n");                                                                                              \
            return 1;                                                                                                  \
        }                                                                                                              \
    } while (0)
#define U(x) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(x))

// ---- WebM: the VP9 track's frames
typedef struct { uint32_t off, size; int64_t pts; } Frame;   // pts in microseconds
typedef struct {
    Frame *f;
    int n, cap, w, h;
    char codec[32];
} Track;

// EBML variable-length integer: an element ID keeps its length marker, a size drops it (all ones = unknown size).
static int vint(const uint8_t *p, const uint8_t *end, int id, uint64_t *v, int *len, int *unknown) {
    if (p >= end) return 0;
    int n = 1;
    uint8_t mask = 0x80;
    while (n <= 8 && !(p[0] & mask)) { mask >>= 1; n++; }
    if (n > 8 || p + n > end) return 0;
    uint64_t x = id ? p[0] : (uint64_t)(p[0] & (mask - 1));
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) x = x << 8 | p[i];
    *v = x;
    *len = n;
    if (unknown) *unknown = !id && x == (1ull << (7 * n)) - 1;
    return 1;
}
static uint64_t be_uint(const uint8_t *p, uint64_t n) {
    uint64_t x = 0;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n && i < 8; i++) x = x << 8 | p[i];
    return x;
}

// Walks the file linearly, entering the master elements on the way to the frames and skipping the rest.
static const char *demux(const uint8_t *d, size_t size, Track *t) {
    const uint8_t *end = d + size, *p = d;
    uint64_t scale = 1000000, cluster = 0, cur_track = 0, vtrack = 0;
    int have_cluster = 0;
    while (p < end) {
        uint64_t id, n;
        int il, sl, unknown;
        if (!vint(p, end, 1, &id, &il, NULL) || !vint(p + il, end, 0, &n, &sl, &unknown)) return "bad element header";
        const uint8_t *body = p + il + sl;
        switch (id) {
        case 0x18538067: case 0x1549A966: case 0x1654AE6B: case 0xAE: case 0xE0: case 0xA0:   // Segment, Info, Tracks,
            p = body;                                                                         // TrackEntry, Video,
            continue;                                                                         // BlockGroup
        case 0x1F43B675: p = body; have_cluster = 1; continue;                               // Cluster
        }
        if (unknown || n > (uint64_t)(end - body)) return "element past the end of the file";
        switch (id) {
        case 0x2AD7B1: scale = be_uint(body, n); break;                                      // TimecodeScale (ns)
        case 0xD7: cur_track = be_uint(body, n); break;                                      // TrackNumber
        case 0x86:                                                                           // CodecID
            if (n < sizeof t->codec && !t->codec[0]) {
                memcpy(t->codec, body, n);
                t->codec[n] = 0;
                vtrack = cur_track;
            }
            break;
        case 0xB0: t->w = (int)be_uint(body, n); break;                                      // PixelWidth
        case 0xBA: t->h = (int)be_uint(body, n); break;                                      // PixelHeight
        case 0xE7: cluster = be_uint(body, n); break;                                        // Cluster Timecode
        case 0xA3: case 0xA1: {                                                              // SimpleBlock, Block
            uint64_t track;
            int tl;
            if (!have_cluster || !vint(body, body + n, 0, &track, &tl, NULL) || n < (uint64_t)tl + 3) return "bad block";
            if (track != vtrack) break;
            int16_t rel = (int16_t)(body[tl] << 8 | body[tl + 1]);
            if (body[tl + 2] & 0x06) return "laced video block";
            if (t->n == t->cap) {
                t->cap = t->cap ? 2 * t->cap : 1024;
                if (!(t->f = realloc(t->f, (size_t)t->cap * sizeof *t->f))) return "frame list allocation";
            }
            int64_t tc = (int64_t)cluster + rel;
            t->f[t->n++] = (Frame){(uint32_t)(body + tl + 3 - d), (uint32_t)(n - tl - 3), tc * (int64_t)scale / 1000};
            break;
        }
        }
        p = body + n;
    }
    return NULL;
}

// ---- stand-ins for the guest functions
typedef struct { uint64_t base, cap; int off, size; } PBuf;    // movie::Buffer
typedef struct {
    int n;
    struct { char key[32]; int kind; int i; int r[4]; char s[64]; } e[32];
} PMd;                                                         // movie::MediaData
enum { K_INT = 1, K_STR, K_RECT };

static void *md_slot(PMd *m, const char *k, int create) {
    for (int i = 0; i < m->n; i++)
        if (!strcmp(m->e[i].key, k)) return &m->e[i];
    if (!create || m->n == 32 || strlen(k) >= 32) return NULL;
    memset(&m->e[m->n], 0, sizeof m->e[0]);
    strcpy(m->e[m->n].key, k);
    return &m->e[m->n++];
}
#define MDE(p) ((__typeof__(&((PMd *)0)->e[0]))(p))
static void s_signal(Cpu *c) { plat_inc32((volatile int32_t *)arg_p(c, 0)); }
static void s_set_range(Cpu *c) { PBuf *b = arg_p(c, 0); b->off = (int)arg_x(c, 1); b->size = (int)arg_x(c, 2); }
static void s_set_data(Cpu *c) { PBuf *b = arg_p(c, 0); b->base = arg_x(c, 1); b->cap = arg_x(c, 2); }
static void s_base(Cpu *c) { ret_x(c, ((PBuf *)arg_p(c, 0))->base); }
static void s_capacity(Cpu *c) { ret_x(c, ((PBuf *)arg_p(c, 0))->cap); }
static void s_find_int32(Cpu *c) {
    void *e = md_slot(arg_p(c, 0), arg_p(c, 1), 0);
    int ok = e && MDE(e)->kind == K_INT;
    if (ok) *(int *)arg_p(c, 2) = MDE(e)->i;
    ret_x(c, (uint64_t)ok);
}
static void s_find_string(Cpu *c) {
    void *e = md_slot(arg_p(c, 0), arg_p(c, 1), 0);
    int ok = e && MDE(e)->kind == K_STR;
    if (ok) *(uint64_t *)arg_p(c, 2) = U(MDE(e)->s);
    ret_x(c, (uint64_t)ok);
}
static void s_set_int32(Cpu *c) {
    void *e = md_slot(arg_p(c, 0), arg_p(c, 1), 1);
    if (e) { MDE(e)->kind = K_INT; MDE(e)->i = (int)arg_x(c, 2); }
}
static void s_set_rect(Cpu *c) {
    void *e = md_slot(arg_p(c, 0), arg_p(c, 1), 1);
    if (e) {
        MDE(e)->kind = K_RECT;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) MDE(e)->r[i] = (int)arg_x(c, 2 + i);
    }
}
static void s_set_string(Cpu *c) {
    void *e = md_slot(arg_p(c, 0), arg_p(c, 1), 1);
    if (e) {
        MDE(e)->kind = K_STR;
        snprintf(MDE(e)->s, sizeof MDE(e)->s, "%s", (const char *)arg_p(c, 2));
    }
}
static volatile int32_t g_d0, g_d2;
static void s_orig_d0(Cpu *c) { (void)c; plat_inc32(&g_d0); }   // the library's deleting destructor
static void s_orig_d2(Cpu *c) { (void)c; plat_inc32(&g_d2); }
static void s_vtable(Cpu *c) { (void)c; rt_fatal("probe-movie: the decoder vtable was called"); }

// ---- driving the entries as the game does
static GuestFn E[MOVIE_ENTRIES];
static Cpu *C;
static uint64_t call(int which, int n, ...) {
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) C->x[i] = va_arg(ap, uint64_t);
    va_end(ap);
    E[which](C);
    return C->x[0];
}
static uint64_t fake_now;
static uint64_t fake_clock(void) { return fake_now; }
static int md_int(PMd *m, const char *k) {
    void *e = md_slot(m, k, 0);
    return e && MDE(e)->kind == K_INT ? MDE(e)->i : -1;
}

// TOTK_PROBE_MOVIE_SHOT=<file.ppm>: the middle frame as RGB (BT.709, limited range), to look at the NV12 output.
static void save_ppm(const char *path, const uint8_t *nv12, int w, int h) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) { printf("probe-movie: cannot write %s\n", path); return; }
    fprintf(f, "P6\n%d %d\n255\n", w, h);
    const uint8_t *uv = nv12 + (size_t)w * h;
    for (int y = 0; y < h; y++)
        for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) {
            double Y = 1.164 * (nv12[(size_t)y * w + x] - 16), u = uv[(size_t)(y / 2) * w + (x & ~1)] - 128.0,
                   v = uv[(size_t)(y / 2) * w + (x & ~1) + 1] - 128.0;
            double rgb[3] = {Y + 1.793 * v, Y - 0.213 * u - 0.533 * v, Y + 2.112 * u};
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) fputc(rgb[k] < 0 ? 0 : rgb[k] > 255 ? 255 : (int)rgb[k], f);
        }
    fclose(f);
    printf("probe-movie: middle frame written to %s\n", path);
}

static int wait_quiet(uint64_t obj) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 5000; i++) {
        if (movie_quiet(obj)) return 1;
        plat_sleep_ms(1);
    }
    return 0;
}

static int feed(uint64_t obj, const uint8_t *data, const Track *t, int *sent, int limit, int *eos_sent) {
    int idx, rem;
    while (*sent < limit && (uint32_t)call(MOVIE_ACQUIRE_INPUT, 3, obj, U(&idx), U(&rem)) == 0) {
        PBuf in = {0};
        CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_GET_INPUT, 3, obj, (uint64_t)idx, U(&in)) == 0 && in.base,
              "GetInputBuffer(%d)", idx);
        const Frame *f = &t->f[*sent];
        CHECK(in.cap >= f->size, "input buffer of %llu bytes for a %u-byte frame", (unsigned long long)in.cap, f->size);
        memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)in.base, data + f->off, f->size);
        CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_SEND_INPUT, 6, obj, (uint64_t)idx, (uint64_t)0, (uint64_t)f->size, (uint64_t)f->pts,
                             (uint64_t)0) == 0, "SendInputBufferForDecode frame %d", *sent);
        ++*sent;
    }
    if (*sent == limit && !*eos_sent && (uint32_t)call(MOVIE_ACQUIRE_INPUT, 3, obj, U(&idx), U(&rem)) == 0) {
        CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_SEND_INPUT, 6, obj, (uint64_t)idx, (uint64_t)0, (uint64_t)0,
                             (uint64_t)t->f[limit - 1].pts, (uint64_t)MOVIE_FLAG_EOS) == 0, "end of stream input");
        *eos_sent = 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

// Paced run over the first `limit` frames with a present every `period` ns of fake time; returns 0 on success and
// fills the per-present counts.
static int paced(uint64_t obj, const uint8_t *data, const Track *t, int limit, uint64_t period, int *got, int *ticks,
                 int *max_per_tick, int64_t *worst_lag_us) {
    CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_FLUSH, 1, obj) == 0, "Flush");
    movie_set_pace(1);
    int sent = 0, eos_sent = 0, eos = 0;
    *got = *ticks = *max_per_tick = 0;
    *worst_lag_us = 0;
    int64_t pts0 = 0;
    uint64_t t0 = 0;
    while (!eos) {
        CHECK(*ticks < 100000, "paced run did not end");
        if (feed(obj, data, t, &sent, limit, &eos_sent)) return 1;
        CHECK(wait_quiet(obj), "decoder stalled");
        fake_now += period;
        ++*ticks;
        movie_tick(C);
        int idx, rem, n = 0;
        int64_t time;
        unsigned flags;
        while ((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_ACQUIRE_OUTPUT, 5, obj, U(&idx), U(&time), U(&flags), U(&rem)) == 0) {
            if (flags & MOVIE_FLAG_EOS) eos = 1;
            else {
                if (!*got) { pts0 = time; t0 = fake_now; }
                int64_t lag = (int64_t)(fake_now - t0) / 1000 - (time - pts0);   // how late the frame is shown (us)
                if (lag > *worst_lag_us) *worst_lag_us = lag;
                CHECK(lag >= 0, "frame at %lld us handed over %lld us early", (long long)time, (long long)-lag);
                ++*got;
                n++;
            }
            CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_RELEASE_OUTPUT, 2, obj, (uint64_t)idx) == 0, "ReleaseOutputBufferIndex(%d)", idx);
        }
        if (n > *max_per_tick) *max_per_tick = n;
    }
    return 0;
}

int probe_movie(void) {
    const char *dir = rt_config()->romfs;
    char image[PLAT_PATH_MAX];
    snprintf(image, sizeof image, "%s/romfs.bin", dir);
    if (!plat_file_exists(image)) {
        printf("probe-movie: skipped: no RomFS image at %s (game data absent; extract it with tools/extract.py)\n", image);
        return 0;
    }
    fs_init();
    const char *want = cfg_get("TOTK_PROBE_MOVIE");
    const char *name = NULL;
    uint64_t best = UINT64_MAX;
    int movies = 0;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < romfs_file_count(); i++) {
        uint64_t size;
        const char *p = romfs_entry(i, NULL, &size);
        size_t n = p ? strlen(p) : 0;
        if (!p || strncmp(p, "Event/Movie/", 12) || n < 5 || strcmp(p + n - 5, ".webm")) continue;
        movies++;
        if (want ? strstr(p, want) && !name : size < best) { name = p; best = size; }
    }
    if (!name) {
        printf("probe-movie: skipped: no Event/Movie/*.webm%s%s in the RomFS index (%d movies)\n",
               want ? " matching " : "", want ? want : "", movies);
        return 0;
    }
    printf("probe-movie: %d movies in Event/Movie; decoding %s (%.1f MiB)\n", movies, name, best / 1048576.0);

    CHECK(romfs_mount("probe") == 0, "RomFS mount");
    char path[512];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "probe:/%s", name);
    uint64_t h, got_bytes;
    int64_t size;
    CHECK(romfs_open(&h, path, FS_OPEN_READ) == 0 && romfs_size(&size, h) == 0 && size > 0, "open %s", path);
    uint8_t *data = malloc((size_t)size);
    CHECK(data, "file buffer");
    CHECK(romfs_read(&got_bytes, h, 0, data, (uint64_t)size) == 0 && got_bytes == (uint64_t)size, "read %s", path);
    romfs_close(h);

    Track t = {0};
    const char *err = demux(data, (size_t)size, &t);
    CHECK(!err, "WebM: %s", err);
    CHECK(!strcmp(t.codec, "V_VP9") && t.n > 0 && t.w > 0 && t.h > 0, "WebM: codec %s, %d frames, %dx%d", t.codec, t.n,
          t.w, t.h);
    printf("probe-movie: WebM %s %dx%d, %d frames, %.2f s, first PTS %lld us\n", t.codec, t.w, t.h, t.n,
           (t.f[t.n - 1].pts - t.f[0].pts) / 1e6, (long long)t.f[0].pts);

    // Stand-ins and entries. The vtable the constructor stores is a host address nothing calls.
    MovieGuest g = {
        .signal_event = hostfn_register("probe nn::os::SignalEvent", s_signal),
        .buf_set_range = hostfn_register("probe movie::Buffer::SetRange", s_set_range),
        .buf_set_data = hostfn_register("probe movie::Buffer::SetDataAndCapacity", s_set_data),
        .buf_base = hostfn_register("probe movie::Buffer::Base", s_base),
        .buf_capacity = hostfn_register("probe movie::Buffer::Capacity", s_capacity),
        .md_find_int32 = hostfn_register("probe movie::MediaData::FindInt32", s_find_int32),
        .md_find_string = hostfn_register("probe movie::MediaData::FindString", s_find_string),
        .md_set_int32 = hostfn_register("probe movie::MediaData::SetInt32", s_set_int32),
        .md_set_rect = hostfn_register("probe movie::MediaData::SetRect", s_set_rect),
        .md_set_string = hostfn_register("probe movie::MediaData::SetString", s_set_string),
        .vptr = hostfn_register("probe movie::Decoder vtable", s_vtable),
    };
    g.orig[MOVIE_D0] = hostfn_register("probe movie::Decoder::~Decoder D0", s_orig_d0);
    g.orig[MOVIE_D2] = hostfn_register("probe movie::Decoder::~Decoder D2", s_orig_d2);
    for (int i = 0; i < MOVIE_ENTRIES; i++) CHECK((E[i] = hostfn_override(movie_symbols[i])), "no override for %s",
                                                  movie_symbols[i]);
    hostfn_seal();
    movie_set_guest(&g);
    C = plat_aligned_alloc(sizeof(Cpu), 64);
    CHECK(C, "Cpu allocation");
    memset(C, 0, sizeof *C);

    uint64_t obj_mem[2] = {0}, obj = U(obj_mem);
    volatile int32_t ev[4] = {0};
    uint64_t events[4] = {U(&ev[0]), U(&ev[1]), U(&ev[2]), U(&ev[3])};
    PMd cfg = {0};
    C->x[0] = U(&cfg);
    C->x[1] = U("mime");
    C->x[2] = U("video/x-vnd.on2.vp9");
    s_set_string(C);
    C->x[1] = U("width");
    C->x[2] = (uint64_t)t.w;
    s_set_int32(C);
    C->x[1] = U("height");
    C->x[2] = (uint64_t)t.h;
    s_set_int32(C);

    call(MOVIE_CTOR, 5, obj, (uint64_t)MOVIE_TYPE_VP9, (uint64_t)MOVIE_FORMAT_NV12, (uint64_t)MOVIE_MODE_BUFFER,
         (uint64_t)0);
    CHECK(obj_mem[0] == g.vptr && obj_mem[1], "constructor: object holds %#llx %#llx", (unsigned long long)obj_mem[0],
          (unsigned long long)obj_mem[1]);
    CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_REGISTER_EVENTS, 2, obj, U(events)) == 0, "RegisterClientEvents");
    CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_CONFIGURE, 2, obj, U(&cfg)) == 0, "Configure");
    int osize = 0, ocount = 0, fb = t.w * t.h * 3 / 2;
    CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_SIZE, 3, obj, U(&osize), U(&ocount)) == 0 && osize == fb && ocount == 1,
          "GetOutputBufferSize %d x %d, want %d", osize, ocount, fb);
    PMd fmt = {0};
    CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_FORMAT, 2, obj, U(&fmt)) == 0, "GetOutputFormat");
    CHECK(md_int(&fmt, "width") == t.w && md_int(&fmt, "height") == t.h && md_int(&fmt, "stride") == t.w &&
              md_int(&fmt, "color-format") == 21 && md_int(&fmt, "nv12-uv-offset") == t.w * t.h,
          "output format %d x %d stride %d colour %d", md_int(&fmt, "width"), md_int(&fmt, "height"),
          md_int(&fmt, "stride"), md_int(&fmt, "color-format"));
    CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_START, 1, obj) == 0, "Start");

    // 1. unpaced
    movie_set_pace(0);
    uint8_t *frame = malloc((size_t)fb);
    CHECK(frame, "frame buffer");
    int sent = 0, eos_sent = 0, got = 0, eos = 0, formats = 0;
    int64_t prev = INT64_MIN;
    double luma_lo = 255, luma_hi = 0;
    uint64_t f0 = plat_now_ns();
    for (int idle = 0; !eos;) {
        if (feed(obj, data, &t, &sent, t.n, &eos_sent)) return 1;
        movie_tick(C);
        int idx, rem, progress = 0;
        int64_t time;
        unsigned flags;
        while ((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_ACQUIRE_OUTPUT, 5, obj, U(&idx), U(&time), U(&flags), U(&rem)) == 0) {
            progress = 1;
            if (flags & MOVIE_FLAG_EOS) eos = 1;
            else {
                PBuf out = {.base = U(frame), .cap = (uint64_t)fb};
                PMd of = {0};
                if (!got) {
                    CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_MD, 4, obj, (uint64_t)idx, U(&out), U(&of)) == 0,
                          "GetOutputBuffer with format");
                    formats = md_int(&of, "width") == t.w && md_int(&of, "nv12-uv-stride") == t.w;
                } else CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT, 3, obj, (uint64_t)idx, U(&out)) == 0, "GetOutputBuffer");
                CHECK(out.off == 0 && out.size == fb, "frame %d: output range %d+%d, want %d bytes", got, out.off,
                      out.size, fb);
                CHECK(time > prev, "frame %d: PTS %lld after %lld", got, (long long)time, (long long)prev);
                CHECK(time == t.f[got].pts, "frame %d: PTS %lld, the container says %lld", got, (long long)time,
                      (long long)t.f[got].pts);
                prev = time;
                if (got == t.n / 2 && cfg_get("TOTK_PROBE_MOVIE_SHOT")) save_ppm(cfg_get("TOTK_PROBE_MOVIE_SHOT"), frame, t.w, t.h);
                if (got % 30 == 0) {   // mean luma of a centre row band: a decoded picture, not a blank buffer
                    uint64_t sum = 0;
                    for (int y = t.h / 2 - 8; y < t.h / 2 + 8; y++)
                        for (int x = 0; x < t.w; x++) sum += frame[(size_t)y * t.w + x];
                    double mean = (double)sum / (16.0 * t.w);
                    if (mean < luma_lo) luma_lo = mean;
                    if (mean > luma_hi) luma_hi = mean;
                }
                got++;
            }
            CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_RELEASE_OUTPUT, 2, obj, (uint64_t)idx) == 0, "ReleaseOutputBufferIndex(%d)", idx);
        }
        if (progress) idle = 0;
        else {
            CHECK(++idle < 20000, "no output for 20 s (%d of %d frames out, %d in)", got, t.n, sent);
            plat_sleep_ms(1);
        }
    }
    double wall = (double)(plat_now_ns() - f0) / 1e9;
    MovieStats st;
    CHECK(movie_stats(obj, &st), "stats");
    CHECK(got == t.n, "%d frames out of %d in", got, t.n);
    CHECK(st.frames == (uint64_t)t.n && st.errors == 0, "decoder counted %llu frames, %llu errors",
          (unsigned long long)st.frames, (unsigned long long)st.errors);
    CHECK(formats, "GetOutputBuffer's format does not describe the NV12 frame");
    CHECK(ev[MOVIE_EV_INPUT] > 0 && ev[MOVIE_EV_OUTPUT] > 0 && ev[MOVIE_EV_FORMAT] == 1 && ev[MOVIE_EV_ERROR] == 0,
          "events: input %d output %d format %d error %d", ev[0], ev[1], ev[2], ev[3]);
    CHECK(luma_hi - luma_lo > 1 || luma_hi > 4, "decoded pictures look blank (centre luma %.1f-%.1f)", luma_lo, luma_hi);
    double avg = st.decode_ns / 1e6 / (double)st.frames;
    printf("probe-movie: unpaced: %d frames, %dx%d NV12, PTS in order, events input %d output %d format %d; centre "
           "luma %.1f-%.1f\n", got, t.w, t.h, ev[0], ev[1], ev[2], luma_lo, luma_hi);
    printf("probe-movie: decode %.2f ms per frame (max %.2f ms) on the worker; %.1f frames/s through the API\n", avg,
           st.max_ns / 1e6, got / wall);
    CHECK(avg < 33.0, "decoding is slower than 30 fps (%.2f ms per frame)", avg);

    // 2. paced at 60 presents per second: one frame every second present
    int limit = t.n < 150 ? t.n : 150, n, ticks, maxn;
    int64_t lag;
    movie_set_clock(fake_clock);
    fake_now = 1000000000ull;
    MovieStats s0 = st;
    if (paced(obj, data, &t, limit, 1000000000ull / 60, &n, &ticks, &maxn, &lag)) return 1;
    CHECK(movie_stats(obj, &st), "stats");
    double span = (t.f[limit - 1].pts - t.f[0].pts) / 1e6 * 60.0;   // presents the frames span at 60 per second
    CHECK(n == limit && maxn == 1 && st.dropped == s0.dropped, "60 Hz: %d of %d frames, up to %d per present, %llu dropped",
          n, limit, maxn, (unsigned long long)(st.dropped - s0.dropped));
    CHECK(ticks >= span - 1 && ticks <= span + 4, "60 Hz: %d presents for %.1f presents of movie", ticks, span);
    CHECK(lag <= 16667, "60 Hz: a frame was shown %lld us late", (long long)lag);
    printf("probe-movie: paced at 60 Hz: %d frames in %d presents (movie spans %.1f), at most 1 per present, worst lag "
           "%.1f ms, none dropped\n", n, ticks, span, lag / 1000.0);

    // 3. paced at 15 presents per second: about every second frame is dropped, the shown one stays in time
    limit = t.n < 120 ? t.n : 120;
    s0 = st;
    if (paced(obj, data, &t, limit, 1000000000ull / 15, &n, &ticks, &maxn, &lag)) return 1;
    CHECK(movie_stats(obj, &st), "stats");
    uint64_t dropped = st.dropped - s0.dropped;
    CHECK(maxn == 1 && dropped > 0 && n + (int)dropped == limit && lag <= 100000,
          "15 Hz: %d shown, %llu dropped of %d, up to %d per present, worst lag %lld us", n, (unsigned long long)dropped,
          limit, maxn, (long long)lag);
    printf("probe-movie: paced at 15 Hz: %d shown, %llu dropped of %d, worst lag %.1f ms\n", n,
           (unsigned long long)dropped, limit, lag / 1000.0);
    movie_set_clock(NULL);

    CHECK((uint32_t)call(MOVIE_STOP, 1, obj) == 0, "Stop");
    call(MOVIE_D0, 1, obj);
    CHECK(!movie_stats(obj, &st) && g_d0 == 1 && obj_mem[1] == 0, "deleting destructor left the host decoder");
    free(frame);
    free(data);
    free(t.f);
    plat_aligned_free(C);
    printf("probe-movie: passed\n");
    return 0;
}
```

`runtime/nvn2_c0.h`:

```h
// NVN 2 compute parameter block: driver head, padded root tables, buffer tables and handles.
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "nvn_obj.h"

// 0x800 covered VS/FS/CS/GS; task SSBO table ends at 0x770, mesh at 0x870, Hookshot pointer table at 0x880.
#define NVN2_C0_BYTES 0x900u
#define NVN2_ROOT_TABLES 8
#define NVN2_ROOT_WORDS 64

typedef struct {
    uint8_t images, ubos, ssbos, textures;
    uint8_t roots[NVN2_ROOT_TABLES];   // declared words, each table padded to four words in c0
} Nvn2C0Layout;

// Parts: 0 roots, 1 uniform buffers, 2 storage buffers, 3 texture handles, 4 image handles, 5 end.
static inline size_t nvn2_c0_part(const Nvn2C0Layout *l, unsigned part) {
    size_t at = 0x10;
    if (!part) return at;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < NVN2_ROOT_TABLES; i++) at += ((l->roots[i] + 3u) & ~3u) * 4u;
    if (part == 1) return at;
    at += 16u * l->ubos;
    if (part == 2) return at;
    at += 16u * l->ssbos;
    if (part == 3) return at;
    at += 8u * l->textures;
    return part == 4 ? at : at + 8u * l->images;
}

static inline int nvn2_c0_valid(const Nvn2C0Layout *l, size_t capacity) {
    if (l->ubos > 16 || l->ssbos > 16 || l->images > 32 || l->textures > 128) return 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < NVN2_ROOT_TABLES; i++) if (l->roots[i] > NVN2_ROOT_WORDS) return 0;
    return nvn2_c0_part(l, 5) <= capacity;
}

// Shader control +0xa9..+0xb0 supplies the root counts. SDK 5ebbb0 writes these root words, padded to 16 bytes,
// before its uniform/storage tables; shader 02c2ed10e8623721 reads root table 0 at c0+0x10..0x2c. The roots are
// command-stream state, not dimensions inferred from the bound images. Unwritten root state starts at zero.
static inline int nvn2_c0_pack(uint8_t *bank, size_t capacity, const Nvn2C0Layout *l,
                               const uint32_t roots[NVN2_ROOT_TABLES][NVN2_ROOT_WORDS],
                               const p_bind_buf ssbo[16], const p_bind_buf ubo[16]) {
    if (!nvn2_c0_valid(l, capacity)) return 0;
    memset(bank, 0, capacity);
    size_t at = nvn2_c0_part(l, 0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < NVN2_ROOT_TABLES; i++) {
        memcpy(bank + at, roots[i], 4u * l->roots[i]);
        at += ((l->roots[i] + 3u) & ~3u) * 4u;
    }
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
        const p_bind_buf *b = k ? ssbo : ubo;
        unsigned n = k ? l->ssbos : l->ubos;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++, at += 16) {
            uint32_t bytes = (uint32_t)b[i].size;
            memcpy(bank + at, &b[i].addr, 8);
            memcpy(bank + at + 8, &bytes, 4);
        }
    }
    return 1;   // handles stay zero: the translator resolves their declarations to host descriptor slots
}

```

`runtime/nvn2_lower.cpp`:

```cpp
// NVN 2 program stage -> the NVN 1 shape the rest of the host takes (gfx_shader.c, vk_exec_draw.c): Eglantine's
// lowering (runtime/third_party/eglantine, GPL-3.0-or-later) rewrites the Ampere code as Maxwell, laid out as TotK's
// translator reads it, and a synthetic control block carries the fields the host reads.
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#include "shader_recompiler/frontend/ampere/program_capture.h"

extern "C" void rt_log(const char *fmt, ...);
extern "C" uint64_t gfx_shader_nvn2_hash(const uint8_t *control, const uint8_t *code);

namespace {
constexpr size_t kControl = 0x880;   // gfx_shader.c CONTROL_SIZE
constexpr size_t kC0Layout = 0x860;  // "DKC1" + compute parameter layout (gfx_shader.c NVN2_C0_LAYOUT)
constexpr uint64_t kMaxwellNop = 0x50b0000000070f00ull;
constexpr uint64_t kMaxwellExit = 0xe30000000007000full;

struct Lowered { std::vector<uint8_t> control; std::vector<uint64_t> code; uint64_t origin; };
std::mutex lock;
// Keyed by content, not by address: a game frees program memory and loads other shaders at the same place (a scene
// change), and an address key handed those the old lowering. The key is gfx_shader_nvn2_hash (the dump name).
// ponytail: kept for the process (a few thousand small stages); free with the program if memory ever matters
std::map<uint64_t, Lowered *> cache;
// Lowered code buffer -> its key, for nvn2_origin: the draw path asks it on every draw (vk_exec_draw.c
// light_quad_fault_skip), and a scan of the cache there cost most of the render thread in heavy scenes.
std::unordered_map<const uint8_t *, uint64_t> origins;

void put32(std::vector<uint8_t> &c, size_t at, uint32_t v) { std::memcpy(c.data() + at, &v, 4); }

Lowered *lower(const uint8_t *control, const uint8_t *code) {
    uint32_t code_len, w0;
    std::memcpy(&code_len, control + 0x38, 4), std::memcpy(&w0, code, 4);
    const bool gfx = ((w0 & 31) == 1 || (w0 & 31) == 2) && ((w0 >> 5) & 31) == 4;   // SPH v4
    const uint32_t hdr = gfx ? 0x80 : 0;
    if (code_len <= hdr) {
        rt_log("nvn2: stage with %#x bytes of code (header %#x, word 0 %#x): nothing to lower", code_len, hdr, w0);
        return nullptr;
    }

    std::vector<Shader::Ampere::Instruction> native;
    Shader::Ampere::ProgramCaptureState capture;
    const char *capture_stop = "eof";
    for (uint32_t at = hdr; at + 16 <= code_len; at += 16) {
        Shader::Ampere::Instruction insn;
        std::memcpy(insn.words.data(), code + at, 16);
        native.push_back(insn);
        const auto r = capture.Observe(insn, static_cast<uint32_t>(native.size() - 1));
        // eden_mesh.cpp: InvalidTarget is a hard fail (do not truncate and lower a partial program — that yields
        // "no unconditional EXIT" for a BRA.U / bad offset mid-stream). Complete ends the capture window.
        if (r == Shader::Ampere::ProgramCaptureState::Result::InvalidTarget) {
            const auto &i = native.back();
            rt_log("nvn2: Ampere capture invalid branch/call shader %016llx stage %u at +%#x: "
                   "[%08x %08x %08x %08x] (op=%#x)",
                   (unsigned long long)gfx_shader_nvn2_hash(control, code), (w0 >> 10) & 15, at,
                   i.words[0], i.words[1], i.words[2], i.words[3], i.Bits(0, 12));
            return nullptr;
        }
        if (r == Shader::Ampere::ProgramCaptureState::Result::Complete) {
            capture_stop = "complete";
            break;
        }
    }
    const auto lowered = Shader::Ampere::LowerToMaxwell(native, "full");
    if (!lowered) {
        rt_log("nvn2: Ampere lowering failed shader %016llx stage %u code %#x captured %zu (%s) at +%#x: %.*s",
               (unsigned long long)gfx_shader_nvn2_hash(control, code), (w0 >> 10) & 15, code_len,
               native.size(), capture_stop, lowered.error_offset, (int)lowered.error.size(), lowered.error.data());
        if (lowered.error_offset / 16 < native.size()) {
            const auto &i = native[lowered.error_offset / 16];
            rt_log("nvn2: failed insn words: [%08x %08x %08x %08x] (op=%#x rd=%u ra=%u)",
                   i.words[0], i.words[1], i.words[2], i.words[3],
                   i.Bits(0, 12), i.Bits(16, 8), i.Bits(24, 8));
        }
        if (lowered.error == "native texture dimension query mode" && lowered.error_offset / 16 < native.size()) {
            const auto &i = native[lowered.error_offset / 16];
            rt_log("nvn2: TXQ fields op=%#x rd=%u ra=%u mask=%#x second_rd=%u tex=%u off=%#x mode=%#x reserved=%#x bit91=%u",
                   i.Bits(0, 12), i.Bits(16, 8), i.Bits(24, 8), i.Bits(72, 4), i.Bits(64, 8), i.Bits(54, 5),
                   i.Bits(40, 14), i.Bits(76, 14), i.Bits(59, 5), i.Bits(91, 1));
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    auto *out = new Lowered;
    auto &m = out->code;
    // The lowering places instruction 0 at 0x10 modulo 32 with a scheduling word at every 32-byte boundary. Ryujinx
    // decodes from the code start (graphics: SPH+0x50, compute: 0) and takes every 32-byte boundary counted from there
    // as a scheduling word, so the code starts with a scheduling word and a NOP and instruction 0 lands 0x10 in. For
    // graphics, the 0x30 bytes the host skips and the first 0x50 bytes of the SPH come first. (Instruction 0 straight
    // at SPH+0x50 was decoded as a scheduling word and shifted every group: one real instruction in four was lost.)
    if (gfx) {
        m.assign(6, 0);
        m.resize(16);
        std::memcpy(m.data() + 6, code, 0x50);
        // MKW_NATIVE_GS (vk_exec_draw.c, native_gs_control): the portable geometry contract reads a kind-1 version-3
        // header. The fields it reads sit at the same offsets in the native header, so a lowered geometry stage is
        // relabelled.
        if (((w0 >> 10) & 15) == 4) {
            const uint32_t relabelled = (w0 & ~uint32_t{0x3ff}) | 1u | 3u << 5;
            std::memcpy(m.data() + 6, &relabelled, 4);
        }
    }
    m.push_back(0), m.push_back(kMaxwellNop);
    size_t pos = 0x10;   // from the code start
    // A full scheduling group of EXITs closes the program: Ryujinx's decoder runs on until a block ends, and a lowered
    // program whose last native instruction is a conditional exit or a self-branch would read past the buffer.
    // The compiler's end marker, an unconditional branch to itself after the last EXIT, becomes an EXIT too: Ryujinx's
    // structuring can join it to the exit path, and the empty endless loop it then emits hangs the GPU (device lost).
    for (size_t i = 0; i < lowered.instructions.size() + 4; i++) {
        if (pos % 32 == 0) m.push_back(0), pos += 8;
        uint64_t insn = i < lowered.instructions.size() ? lowered.instructions[i] : kMaxwellExit;
        if ((insn >> 52) == 0xe24 && ((insn >> 20) & 0xffffff) == 0xfffff8 && ((insn >> 16) & 15) == 7) insn = kMaxwellExit;
        m.push_back(insn), pos += 8;
    }

    // Inline constants (c[0x1]) follow the code in the NVN 2 buffer, from control +0x40 to +0x44; they go after the
    // Maxwell code, where control +0x700 points as in NVN 1. A BRX jump table in them holds native instruction offsets
    // (index * 16, as the lowering requires); the lowered BRX jumps to Maxwell addresses, so those are rewritten.
    uint32_t c1_at, c1_end;
    std::memcpy(&c1_at, control + 0x40, 4), std::memcpy(&c1_end, control + 0x44, 4);
    const uint32_t c1_off = static_cast<uint32_t>(m.size() * 8);
    if (c1_end > c1_at && c1_end - c1_at <= 0x10000) {
        std::vector<uint32_t> c1((c1_end - c1_at) / 4);
        std::memcpy(c1.data(), code + c1_at, c1.size() * 4);
        bool brx = false;
        for (const auto &insn : native) brx |= insn.Bits(0, 12) == 0x949 || insn.Bits(0, 12) == 0x958;
        // ponytail: any 16-aligned word inside the program counts as a table entry; an integer constant that happens to
        // be one would be rewritten too. Track the LDC base of each BRX if that ever bites.
        if (brx)
            for (uint32_t &w : c1)
                if (w % 16 == 0 && w / 16 < lowered.source_instruction_offsets.size()) {
                    const uint32_t i = lowered.source_instruction_offsets[w / 16];
                    // The lowering's address_of (0x50-based). Instruction i sits at address_of(i) - 0x40 from the code
                    // start, and the lowered BRX's base works out to -0x40, so the value lands on instruction i
                    // (Ryujinx FindBrxTargets: target = BRX base + table value).
                    w = 0x50 + i * 8 + ((i + 1) / 3) * 8;
                }
        c1.resize((c1.size() + 1) & ~size_t{1});
        m.resize(m.size() + c1.size() / 2);
        std::memcpy(m.data() + c1_off / 8, c1.data(), c1.size() * 4);
    }

    out->control.assign(kControl, 0);
    const uint32_t len = static_cast<uint32_t>(m.size() * 8);
    const uint32_t type = (w0 >> 10) & 15;   // SPH shader type -> NVN stage
    const uint32_t stage = !gfx ? 5 : type == 5 ? 1 : type == 4 ? 2 : type == 2 ? 3 : type == 3 ? 4 : 0;
    put32(out->control, 0x700, c1_off);
    put32(out->control, 0x704, len);
    put32(out->control, 0x714, stage);
    if (!gfx) {
        std::memcpy(out->control.data() + 0x748, control + 0x58, 12);   // local size (NVN 2 control +0x58)
        // The compute driver bank is packed per program from these counts (gfx_shader.c, "NVN 2 compute c0"):
        // images +0xb6, uniform buffers +0xb1, storage buffers +0xb2, textures +0xb3.
        // DKC1 adds the eight root-table word counts. The marker and counts enter the code/cache hash, so an older
        // DKC0 translation cannot be reused with the new parameter-block layout.
        const uint8_t lay[8] = {'D', 'K', 'C', '1', control[0xb6], control[0xb1], control[0xb2], control[0xb3]};
        std::memcpy(out->control.data() + kC0Layout, lay, sizeof lay);
        // Shared memory bytes (NVN 2 control +0x64; the NVN 2 reference title's upscaling network uses 0x2a88): the translator sizes the
        // workgroup's shared array from it, and with 0 every LDS read back nothing.
        std::memcpy(out->control.data() + kC0Layout + 8, control + 0x64, 4);
        std::memcpy(out->control.data() + kC0Layout + 12, control + 0xa9, 8);
    }
    return out;
}
}  // namespace

// 1 and the replacement control and code for an NVN 2 stage, 0 when it does not lower.
extern "C" int nvn2_lower(const uint8_t *control, const uint8_t *code, const uint8_t **out_control,
                          const uint8_t **out_code) {
    const uint64_t key = gfx_shader_nvn2_hash(control, code);
    if (!key) {
        uint32_t w[6];
        std::memcpy(w, control + 0x30, sizeof w);
        rt_log("nvn2: stage with a control block of unexpected sizes (+0x30 %#x +0x38 %#x +0x44 %#x, code %p): not "
               "lowered", w[0], w[2], w[5], (const void *)code);
        return 0;
    }
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock);
    auto [it, fresh] = cache.try_emplace(key, nullptr);
    if (fresh && (it->second = lower(control, code))) {
        it->second->origin = key;
        origins.emplace(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(it->second->code.data()), key);
    }
    if (!it->second) return 0;
    *out_control = it->second->control.data();
    *out_code = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(it->second->code.data());
    return 1;
}

// The dump name (gfx_shader_nvn2_hash) of the NVN 2 stage a lowered code buffer came from, or 0. Lowered buffers live
// for the process, so their addresses never name another stage.
extern "C" uint64_t nvn2_origin(const uint8_t *code) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock);
    auto it = origins.find(code);
    return it == origins.end() ? 0 : it->second;
}
```

```h
                                                           // the back end's present; nvn_calls/nvn_distinct: NVN_API

// ---- nvn_api_cmd.c, nvn_ext.c: command buffers and their replay contract
// A command handle (what QueueSubmitCommands receives) points at a host copy of one recording: a flat sequence of
// 8-byte-aligned records {op_hdr, payload}, OP_BEGIN first and OP_END last. Called recordings are inlined, so a copy
// holds no OP_CALL or OP_JUMP. Texture pointers in payloads (p_set_rt, p_copy_b2t, p_copy_t2t, p_clear_tex) are
// immutable host copies that live for the run, one per tex_t.serial. Deferred binds and pushes (payload src != 0)
// hold the source data read at submit (nvn_submit_prepare). Payloads of the ops nvn_obj.h does not define:
typedef struct { volatile uint32_t *val; uint32_t mode, value; } p_signal_event;   // OP_SIGNAL_EVENT; mode: NVNeventSignalMode
typedef struct { uint64_t type, addr; } p_report_counter;  // OP_REPORT_COUNTER: NVNcounterType, NVNcounterData address

typedef struct { uint64_t src, dst, size; } p_copy_b2b;    // OP_COPY_B2B: GPU addresses
typedef struct { uint64_t dst, size; uint8_t data[]; } p_update_ub;   // OP_UPDATE_UB: size bytes written at dst
typedef struct { int32_t bits, pad; } p_barrier;           // OP_BARRIER: NVNbarrierBits
// OP_WAIT_SYNC retains the source until submit preparation, as the SDK's control record does. The caller keeps
// the sync alive through each submit; the backend never dereferences it after preparation returns.
typedef struct { const sync_t *sync; } p_wait_sync;
typedef struct { uint64_t target; } p_jump;                // OP_JUMP / OP_CALL: next record / called recording
// OP_DRAW_IDX_IND: DrawElementsIndirect; ind = GPU address of {count, instances, first index, base vertex, base
// instance} (VkDrawIndexedIndirectCommand's layout), read by the GPU when the draw runs
typedef struct { int32_t prim, itype; uint64_t ibuf, ind; } p_draw_idx_ind;

// VkDrawIndexedIndirectCommand records of stride bytes; count is a GPU uint32 draw count.
typedef struct {
    int32_t prim, itype, max_count, stride;
    uint64_t ibuf, ind, count;
} p_draw_idx_ind_count;

// OP_CLEAR_BUF: size bytes at addr filled with the 32-bit value in GPU order (ClearBuffer; ReportValue is a 4-byte one)

// (compute 0) or compute (compute 1) pipeline. Shaders read the root table as constant bank 24 (nvn_api_nvn2.c).
// src: direct data pointer for *Deferred, read into w at submit; 0 for immediate pushes copied at record time.

               sizeof(p_update_ub) == 16, "op payload layouts of hle_nvn.c");

// device-side copies of pool memory (vk_memory.c's VRAM mirror) defines it and copies the range again.
```

`runtime/nvn_api_cmd.c`:

```c
// NVN front end, command-buffer slice: command buffers, their memory, recording
// as op records (nvn_obj.h), recording copies behind command handles, and the submit-time resolution of deferred binds
// (nvn_submit_prepare, called by nvnQueueSubmitCommands in nvn_api_core.c). Ported from MacNativeGames
// games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/hle_nvn.c @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 jhaizhou; origin d2r-mobile),
// lines 647-1062, 1261-1286, 1486-1760 and 1975-1990, and the *Deferred and memory-callback entry points of
// totk_nvn_ext.c in the same directory. Metal, mach, the translation thread, Apple diagnostics, the per-frame
// statistics and the long-session sweeps (copy marks in control memory, texture pin sweep) dropped.
//
// Records are written into a growable host buffer per command buffer, never into the game's command memory: games hand
// the same command memory to several command buffers recording at once (budgeted for real NVN encodings), and our
// records are larger. The game's command and control memory is accounted only. EndRecording copies the finished
// recording into host memory; the handle is that copy (a flat OP_BEGIN ... OP_END sequence) and lives until the game
// adds the same control memory again. CallCommands and CopyCommands inline the called recording, so copies hold no
// OP_CALL or OP_JUMP.
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "nvn_hmap.h"
#include "nvn_mode_trace.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define CMD_MAGIC MAGIC('C', 'M', 'D', 'B')
#define COPY_MAGIC 0x59504f43444d43ull     // "CMDCOPY": prefix of a live recording copy
#define OP_RESERVE 24                       // room always kept at the end of the recording buffer
#define MIN_COMMAND_SIZE 512                // NVN_DEVICE_INFO_COMMAND_BUFFER_MIN_COMMAND_SIZE (nvn_api_core.c devinfo)
#define MIN_CONTROL_SIZE 256                // NVN_DEVICE_INFO_COMMAND_BUFFER_MIN_CONTROL_SIZE
#define CTL_PER_RECORDING 64                // control memory one recording is reported to use
#define COPY_PAGE_SHIFT 16                  // recording copy index granularity (release_copies)

static cmd_t *cmd_of(const Cpu *c) { return arg_p(c, 0); }

// ---------- memory callbacks
// NVN calls the game's memory callback when a recording needs command or control memory and none is left. Records
// live in host memory here, so the callback is called only where the hardware certainly would: a recording starts
// without any command memory, or ends without any control memory. It runs on the calling guest thread through
// rt_call; whatever memory it adds is accounted. Set{Command,Control}MemoryCallbackEnabled(false) suppress it.
enum { CB_NO_COMMAND = 1, CB_NO_CONTROL = 2 };
static PlatMutex cb_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
static nvn_hmap cb_off = {.klen = 8};       // command buffer -> disabled callback kinds | 0x100

static unsigned cb_disabled(const cmd_t *o) {
    plat_mutex_lock_shared(&cb_lock);
    uintptr_t v = (uintptr_t)nvn_hm_get(&cb_off, &o);
    plat_mutex_unlock_shared(&cb_lock);
    return (unsigned)v & 0xff;
}

static void cb_set_disabled(const cmd_t *o, unsigned kind, int disabled) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&cb_lock);
    unsigned v = (unsigned)(uintptr_t)nvn_hm_get(&cb_off, &o) & 0xff;
    v = disabled ? v | kind : v & ~kind;
    if (v) nvn_hm_put(&cb_off, &o, (void *)(uintptr_t)(v | 0x100));
    else nvn_hm_del(&cb_off, &o);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&cb_lock);
}

static void memory_event(Cpu *c, cmd_t *o, int event, uint64_t min) {
    if (!o->cb || (cb_disabled(o) & (event == NVN_COMMAND_BUFFER_MEMORY_EVENT_OUT_OF_COMMAND_MEMORY ? CB_NO_COMMAND
                                                                                                     : CB_NO_CONTROL)))
        return;
    NVN_LOG("command buffer %p: memory callback %p (%s memory, %llu bytes)", (void *)o, (void *)o->cb,
            event == NVN_COMMAND_BUFFER_MEMORY_EVENT_OUT_OF_COMMAND_MEMORY ? "command" : "control",
            (unsigned long long)min);
    rt_call(c, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)o->cb, 4, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)o, (uint64_t)event, min,
            (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)o->cb_data);
}

// ---------- recording buffer
static void put_hdr(uint8_t *p, uint32_t op, uint32_t size) {
    op_hdr h = {op, size};
    memcpy(p, &h, sizeof h);
}

static void cmd_reserve(cmd_t *o, size_t need) {
    if (o->seg && o->cur + need + OP_RESERVE <= o->end) return;
    size_t used = o->seg ? (size_t)(o->cur - o->seg) : 0;
    size_t cap = o->seg ? (size_t)(o->end - o->seg) : 0;
    if (!cap) cap = 64 << 10;
    while (used + need + OP_RESERVE > cap) cap *= 2;
    uint8_t *b = realloc(o->seg, cap);
    // A block this size fails only without commit (the fatal report states it) or when seg is no block of ours: a
    // command buffer object the game overwrote or copied shows a wrong magic or more used than its old size.
    if (!b)
        rt_fatal("nvn: command recording buffer of %zu bytes (command buffer %p, magic %#x, buffer %p of %zu bytes, %zu "
                 "used, %zu asked)", cap, (void *)o, o->magic, (void *)o->seg, o->seg ? (size_t)(o->end - o->seg) : 0,
                 used, need);
    o->seg = b;
    o->cur = b + used;
    o->end = b + cap;
}

// Space for one record (header included); the header's op is filled by the caller.
static uint8_t *cmd_alloc(cmd_t *o, uint32_t size) {
    size = (size + 7) & ~7u;
    cmd_reserve(o, size);
    uint8_t *p = o->cur;
    o->cur += size;
    o->cmd_used += size;
    o->hw_used += size;
    o->last_rec = size;
    put_hdr(p, 0, size);
    return p;
}

// The game sums nvnCommandBufferGetCommandMemoryUsed over recordings to size resource heaps, so usage must be what the
// real NVN push-buffer encoding takes, not our record size. Known encodings (Maxwell methods, from a real recording):
// DrawElements 12 words, DrawElementsBaseVertex 11, BindVertexAttribState 1+16, BindVertexStreamState 16+n,
// BindVertexBuffer 6 words each.
static void hw_fix(cmd_t *o, size_t bytes) {
    o->hw_used += bytes;
    o->hw_used -= o->last_rec;
    o->last_rec = bytes;
}

// A zeroed payload of one record.
static void *rec(cmd_t *o, uint32_t op, size_t payload) {
    uint32_t sz = (uint32_t)((8 + payload + 7) & ~(size_t)7);
    uint8_t *p = cmd_alloc(o, sz);
    put_hdr(p, op, sz);
    memset(p + 8, 0, sz - 8);
    return p + 8;
}
#define REC(o, OP, T) ((T *)rec((o), (OP), sizeof(T)))
// Array-carrying binds take the prefix fields plus n elements; the replay reads only the first n.
#define RECN(o, OP, T, ARR, N) ((T *)rec((o), (OP), offsetof(T, ARR) + sizeof(((T *)0)->ARR[0]) * (size_t)(N)))

static void copy_view(view_t *dst, uint8_t *has, const NVNtextureView *v) {
    *has = v != NULL;
    if (v) *dst = *(const view_t *)v;
}

// ---------- texture pins
// Recordings refer to textures by pointer, but the game may finalize or reuse an NVNtexture after recording and before
// the submit (NVN itself captured only GPU state). Records therefore point at an immutable host copy per texture
// initialization (tex_t.serial). The copies are kept for the whole run (MacNativeGames sweeps them for long sessions).
static PlatMutex pin_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
static nvn_hmap pins = {.klen = 8};         // serial -> tex_t copy

static const tex_t *tex_pin(const NVNtexture *nt) {
    const tex_t *t = (const tex_t *)nt;
    if (!t) return NULL;
    uint64_t serial = t->serial;
    if (!serial) rt_fatal("nvn: a recording references the uninitialized texture object %p", (const void *)t);
    plat_mutex_lock_shared(&pin_lock);
    const tex_t *r = nvn_hm_get(&pins, &serial);
    plat_mutex_unlock_shared(&pin_lock);
    if (r) return r;
    plat_mutex_lock(&pin_lock);
    r = nvn_hm_get(&pins, &serial);
    if (!r) {
        tex_t *copy = malloc(sizeof *copy);
        if (!copy) rt_fatal("nvn: texture pin copy");
        *copy = *t;
        nvn_hm_put(&pins, &serial, copy);
        r = copy;
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&pin_lock);
    return r;
}

// ---------- recording copies
// A handle points just past a copy_prefix. Copies are indexed by the 64 KiB block of their control-memory position, so
// adding control memory again releases the copies recorded there without walking every live copy. 4 KiB pages cost
// about 500 lookups per AddControlMemory under the exclusive lock (1.4.3 field: 53 calls a frame, 2 MiB ranges, 3.7
// copies per page), and the recording threads waited on it.
typedef struct { uint64_t magic, bytes, made_at, used_at, deferred; } copy_prefix;   // deferred: 0 unknown, 1 none, 2 some
_Static_assert(sizeof(copy_prefix) % 8 == 0, "records stay 8-byte aligned");
typedef struct { uintptr_t lo, hi; uint8_t *copy; } cmd_copy;
typedef struct { cmd_copy *v; uint32_t n, cap; } copy_bucket;
static PlatMutex copy_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;    // guards the two maps, the counters and every prefix
static nvn_hmap copy_pages = {.klen = 8};   // page -> copy_bucket
static nvn_hmap copy_live = {.klen = 8};    // handle -> copy_prefix of a live copy
static uint64_t ncopies, copy_bytes, copies_made, nsubmits;
// Asynchronous replay: copies released by the game, and per-submission clones, that a queued submission still reads.
// Freed once gfx_replayed_submits() reaches their used_at. Empty with synchronous replay.
static copy_prefix **zombies;
static uint32_t nzombies, cap_zombies;

static void zombie_add(copy_prefix *pf) {   // copy_lock held
    if (nzombies == cap_zombies) {
        cap_zombies = cap_zombies ? cap_zombies * 2 : 64;
        zombies = realloc(zombies, sizeof *zombies * cap_zombies);
        if (!zombies) rt_fatal("nvn: out of memory (released recording copies)");
    }
    zombies[nzombies++] = pf;
}

static void zombie_sweep(uint64_t replayed) {   // copy_lock held
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nzombies;) {
        if (zombies[i]->used_at <= replayed) {
            free(zombies[i]);
            zombies[i] = zombies[--nzombies];
        } else {
            i++;
        }
    }
}

static copy_prefix *copy_find(uint64_t handle) {   // copy_lock held
    return nvn_hm_get(&copy_live, &handle);
}

int nvn_handle_live(uint64_t handle) {
    plat_mutex_lock_shared(&copy_lock);
    int live = copy_find(handle) != NULL;
    plat_mutex_unlock_shared(&copy_lock);
    return live;
}

uint64_t nvn_handle_bytes(uint64_t handle) {
    plat_mutex_lock_shared(&copy_lock);
    const copy_prefix *pf = copy_find(handle);
    uint64_t n = pf ? pf->bytes : 0;
    plat_mutex_unlock_shared(&copy_lock);
    return n;
}

// Marks a live copy used by submission now; its size from OP_BEGIN to OP_END inclusive.
static uint64_t copy_touch(uint64_t handle, uint64_t now, const char *what) {
    plat_mutex_lock_shared(&copy_lock);
    copy_prefix *pf = copy_find(handle);
    uint64_t bytes = 0;
    if (pf) __atomic_store_n(&pf->used_at, now, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), bytes = pf->bytes;
    plat_mutex_unlock_shared(&copy_lock);
    if (!pf) rt_fatal("nvn: %s: command handle %#llx is not a live recording (released or never recorded)", what,
                      (unsigned long long)handle);
    return bytes;
}

// The recording [p, p + n), OP_BEGIN to OP_END (the recording buffer is one block: recording emits no OP_JUMP), copied
// into one host block of its exact size. One allocation and one copy: growing the copy record by record cost the
// game's main thread about 1 ms a frame in reallocations and small copies (1.4.3, field).
static uint8_t *flatten_recording(const uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    uint8_t *out = malloc(sizeof(copy_prefix) + n);
    if (!out) rt_fatal("nvn: command copy allocation");
    memcpy(out + sizeof(copy_prefix), p, n);
    for (size_t at = 0;;) {   // the records stay checked: a corrupt one stops here, not in the replay
        op_hdr h;
        memcpy(&h, p + at, sizeof h);
        if (h.size < 8 || (h.size & 7) || h.op >= OP_COUNT_ || h.op == OP_JUMP || h.op == OP_CALL || at + h.size > n ||
            (!at && h.op != OP_BEGIN))
            rt_fatal("nvn: corrupt recording at %p (op %u size %u)", (const void *)(p + at), h.op, h.size);
        at += h.size;
        if (h.op == OP_END) {
            if (at != n) rt_fatal("nvn: recording at %p ends at %zu of %zu bytes", (const void *)p, at, n);
            break;
        }
    }
    *(copy_prefix *)out = (copy_prefix){COPY_MAGIC, n, 0, 0};
    return out + sizeof(copy_prefix);
}

static void copy_add(uintptr_t lo, uintptr_t hi, uint8_t *copy) {
    copy_prefix *pf = (copy_prefix *)copy - 1;
    uint64_t handle = (uintptr_t)copy;
    uintptr_t page = lo >> COPY_PAGE_SHIFT;
    plat_mutex_lock(&copy_lock);
    pf->made_at = nsubmits;
    copy_bucket *b = nvn_hm_get(&copy_pages, &page);
    if (!b) {
        b = calloc(1, sizeof *b);
        if (!b) rt_fatal("nvn: command copy index");
        nvn_hm_put(&copy_pages, &page, b);
    }
    if (b->n == b->cap) {
        b->cap = b->cap ? b->cap * 2 : 8;
        b->v = realloc(b->v, b->cap * sizeof *b->v);
        if (!b->v) rt_fatal("nvn: command copy index");
    }
    b->v[b->n++] = (cmd_copy){lo, hi, copy};
    nvn_hm_put(&copy_live, &handle, pf);
    ncopies++;
    copy_bytes += pf->bytes;
    if (++copies_made % 20000 == 0)
        NVN_LOG("recording copies: %llu made, %llu live, %.1f MiB, submit %llu", (unsigned long long)copies_made,
                (unsigned long long)ncopies, copy_bytes / 1048576.0, (unsigned long long)nsubmits);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&copy_lock);
}

// Adding control memory again retires every recording copy made in it (the driver's handle lived there).
static void release_copies(uintptr_t lo, uintptr_t hi) {
    if (hi <= lo) return;
    uint64_t replayed = gfx_replayed_submits();
    plat_mutex_lock(&copy_lock);
    if (nzombies) zombie_sweep(replayed);
    for (uintptr_t pg = lo >> COPY_PAGE_SHIFT; pg <= (hi - 1) >> COPY_PAGE_SHIFT; pg++) {
        copy_bucket *b = nvn_hm_get(&copy_pages, &pg);
        if (!b) continue;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < b->n;) {
            cmd_copy *k = &b->v[i];
            if (!(k->lo < hi && lo < k->hi)) { i++; continue; }
            uint64_t handle = (uintptr_t)k->copy;
            copy_prefix *pf = (copy_prefix *)k->copy - 1;
            nvn_hm_del(&copy_live, &handle);
            ncopies--;
            copy_bytes -= pf->bytes;
            pf->magic = 0;
            if (pf->used_at > replayed) zombie_add(pf);   // a queued submission still reads it
            else free(pf);
            b->v[i] = b->v[--b->n];
        }
        if (!b->n) {
            nvn_hm_del(&copy_pages, &pg);
            free(b->v);
            free(b);
        }
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&copy_lock);
}

// ---------- CommandBuffer: object and memory
// NVNboolean nvnCommandBufferInitialize(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, NVNdevice *device): the inline fast-path fields are kept
// at ~0 / 0 so NVN 55 inline code never finds room and calls the API (nvn_obj.h cmd_t)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferInitialize) {
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    // Initialize over an object that was never finalized drops its recording buffer (seg lives in host memory). Logged
    // only: the old bytes may be a copy whose buffer another object owns, so freeing it here is not safe.
    static uint32_t reinits;
    if (o->magic == CMD_MAGIC && o->seg && __atomic_fetch_add(&reinits, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) < 8)
        rt_log("nvn: Initialize over the command buffer %p, which was not finalized; its %zu-byte recording buffer %p "
               "is dropped", (void *)o, (size_t)(o->end - o->seg), (void *)o->seg);
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    o->magic = CMD_MAGIC;
    o->dev = arg_p(c, 1);
    o->inline_cur = ~0ull;
    o->inline_end = 0;
    cb_set_disabled(o, CB_NO_COMMAND | CB_NO_CONTROL, 0);
    nvn_mode_trace(NVN_MODE_INIT, (uintptr_t)o, 0, 0, 0);
    ret_x(c, 1);
}
// void nvnCommandBufferFinalize(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd): handles outlive their recorder
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferFinalize) {
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    free(o->seg);
    o->seg = o->cur = o->end = NULL;
    o->magic = 0;
    cb_set_disabled(o, CB_NO_COMMAND | CB_NO_CONTROL, 0);
    nvn_mode_trace(NVN_MODE_FINALIZE, (uintptr_t)o, 0, 0, 0);
}
// void nvnCommandBufferSetMemoryCallback(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, PFNNVNCOMMANDBUFFERMEMORYCALLBACKPROC callback)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetMemoryCallback) { cmd_of(c)->cb = arg_p(c, 1); }
// void nvnCommandBufferSetMemoryCallbackData(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, void *data)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetMemoryCallbackData) { cmd_of(c)->cb_data = arg_p(c, 1); }
// PFNNVNCOMMANDBUFFERMEMORYCALLBACKPROC nvnCommandBufferGetMemoryCallback(const NVNcommandBuffer *cmd)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferGetMemoryCallback) { ret_x(c, (uintptr_t)cmd_of(c)->cb); }
// void *nvnCommandBufferGetMemoryCallbackData(const NVNcommandBuffer *cmd) (nvn.h declares it void)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferGetMemoryCallbackData) { ret_x(c, (uintptr_t)cmd_of(c)->cb_data); }
// void nvnCommandBufferSetCommandMemoryCallbackEnabled / SetControlMemoryCallbackEnabled(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd,
// NVNboolean enabled) (NVN 55, no prototype in nvn.h)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetCommandMemoryCallbackEnabled) { cb_set_disabled(cmd_of(c), CB_NO_COMMAND, !nvn_arg_bool(c, 1)); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetControlMemoryCallbackEnabled) { cb_set_disabled(cmd_of(c), CB_NO_CONTROL, !nvn_arg_bool(c, 1)); }
// void nvnCommandBufferAddCommandMemory(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, const NVNmemoryPool *pool, ptrdiff_t offset, size_t size):
// accounting only; command memory can be shared by independent recordings with distinct control memory
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferAddCommandMemory) {
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    const pool_t *p = arg_p(c, 1);
    o->cmd_base = (uintptr_t)(p ? p->mem : NULL) + (uintptr_t)arg_x(c, 2);
    o->game_size = arg_x(c, 3);
    o->cmd_used = 0;
    o->hw_used = 0;
}
// void nvnCommandBufferAddControlMemory(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, void *memory, size_t size): the SDK encodes handles in
// control memory (sdk+0x444530), so reusing that storage retires the copies recorded there
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferAddControlMemory) {
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    void *m = arg_p(c, 1);
    size_t n = arg_x(c, 2);
    release_copies((uintptr_t)m, (uintptr_t)m + n);
    o->ctl = m;
    o->ctl_size = n;
    o->ctl_used = 0;
}
// size_t nvnCommandBufferGet{Control,Command}Memory{Size,Used,Free}(const NVNcommandBuffer *cmd): usage is bounded by
// the memory the game gave, so the game never sees more used than it provided
static size_t min_size(size_t a, size_t b) { return a < b ? a : b; }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferGetControlMemorySize) { ret_x(c, cmd_of(c)->ctl_size); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferGetControlMemoryUsed) { const cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c); ret_x(c, min_size(o->ctl_used, o->ctl_size)); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferGetControlMemoryFree) { const cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c); ret_x(c, o->ctl_size - min_size(o->ctl_used, o->ctl_size)); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferGetCommandMemorySize) { ret_x(c, cmd_of(c)->game_size); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferGetCommandMemoryUsed) { const cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c); ret_x(c, min_size(o->hw_used, o->game_size)); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferGetCommandMemoryFree) { const cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c); ret_x(c, o->game_size - min_size(o->hw_used, o->game_size)); }

// ---------- CommandBuffer: recording
// void nvnCommandBufferBeginRecording(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBeginRecording) {
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    if (o->recording) rt_log("nvn: BeginRecording on command buffer %p while it records", (void *)o);
    o->recording = 1;
    o->cur = o->seg;   // the previous recording was copied at EndRecording
    o->rec_start = o->cmd_used;
    put_hdr(cmd_alloc(o, 8), OP_BEGIN, 8);
    o->hw_used -= 8;   // BEGIN and END have no hardware equivalent
    o->hw_start = o->hw_used;
    nvn_mode_trace(NVN_MODE_BEGIN, (uintptr_t)o, 0, 0, 0);
    if (!o->game_size) memory_event(c, o, NVN_COMMAND_BUFFER_MEMORY_EVENT_OUT_OF_COMMAND_MEMORY, MIN_COMMAND_SIZE);
}
// NVNcommandHandle nvnCommandBufferEndRecording(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferEndRecording) {
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    if (!o->recording || !o->seg) rt_fatal("nvn: EndRecording on command buffer %p, which does not record", (void *)o);
    if (!o->ctl_size) memory_event(c, o, NVN_COMMAND_BUFFER_MEMORY_EVENT_OUT_OF_CONTROL_MEMORY, MIN_CONTROL_SIZE);
    put_hdr(cmd_alloc(o, 8), OP_END, 8);
    o->hw_used -= 8;
    o->recording = 0;
    uint8_t *copy = flatten_recording(o->seg, (size_t)(o->cur - o->seg));
    // Finalizing the recorder does not retire its handle; only reusing the control memory it was recorded in does.
    uintptr_t lo = (uintptr_t)o->ctl + (o->ctl_used < o->ctl_size ? o->ctl_used : 0);
    uintptr_t hi = o->ctl ? lo + 1 : 0;
    o->ctl_used += CTL_PER_RECORDING;
    copy_add(lo, hi, copy);
    nvn_mode_trace(NVN_MODE_END, (uintptr_t)o, (uintptr_t)copy, 0, 0);
    ret_x(c, (uintptr_t)copy);
}
// NVNboolean nvnCommandBufferIsRecording(const NVNcommandBuffer *cmd)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferIsRecording) { ret_x(c, cmd_of(c)->recording != 0); }

// The called recording is copied into the caller at the call position: the game recycles command memory in small steps,
// so a handle may be gone by the time the caller is submitted. Deferred binds stay deferred. A copy is OP_BEGIN, its
// records and OP_END (flatten_recording checked them), so the records go over as one block; usage grows by the same
// bytes as record by record.
static void inline_recording(cmd_t *o, uint64_t handle, const char *what) {
    if (!handle) rt_fatal("nvn: %s with a null handle", what);
    uint64_t bytes = copy_touch(handle, __atomic_load_n(&nsubmits, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), what);
    if (bytes <= 16) return;
    size_t body = (size_t)bytes - 16;
    cmd_reserve(o, body);
    memcpy(o->cur, (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)handle + 8, body);
    o->cur += body;
    o->cmd_used += body;
    o->hw_used += body;
    o->last_rec = 0;
}
// void nvnCommandBuffer{Call,Copy}Commands(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, int n, const NVNcommandHandle *handles)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferCallCommands) {
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    int n = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    const uint64_t *h = arg_p(c, 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) inline_recording(o, h[i], "CallCommands");
}
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferCopyCommands) {
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    int n = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    const uint64_t *h = arg_p(c, 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) inline_recording(o, h[i], "CopyCommands");
}

// ---------- CommandBuffer: commands with CPU-visible results (performed by the back end in GPU order)
// void nvnCommandBufferSignalEvent(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, const NVNevent *event, NVNeventSignalMode mode,
// NVNeventSignalLocation location, int flags, uint32_t value)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSignalEvent) {
    const ev_t *e = arg_p(c, 1);
    *REC(cmd_of(c), OP_SIGNAL_EVENT, p_signal_event) = (p_signal_event){e->val, (uint32_t)arg_x(c, 2), (uint32_t)arg_x(c, 5)};
}
// void nvnCommandBufferResetCounter(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, NVNcounterType type)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferResetCounter) { REC(cmd_of(c), OP_RESET_COUNTER, p_reset_counter)->type = (uint32_t)arg_x(c, 1); }
// void nvnCommandBufferReportCounter(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, NVNcounterType type, NVNbufferAddress address)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferReportCounter) {
    *REC(cmd_of(c), OP_REPORT_COUNTER, p_report_counter) = (p_report_counter){(uint32_t)arg_x(c, 1), arg_x(c, 2)};
}
// void nvnCommandBufferCopyBufferToBuffer(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, NVNbufferAddress src, NVNbufferAddress dst,
// size_t size, int flags)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferCopyBufferToBuffer) {
    *REC(cmd_of(c), OP_COPY_B2B, p_copy_b2b) = (p_copy_b2b){arg_x(c, 1), arg_x(c, 2), arg_x(c, 3)};
}
// void nvnCommandBufferUpdateUniformBuffer(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, NVNbufferAddress buffer, size_t buffer_size,
// ptrdiff_t offset, size_t size, const void *data): the data is copied at record time (the caller may change it
// afterwards) and written into the buffer at replay
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferUpdateUniformBuffer) {
    uint64_t dst = arg_x(c, 1) + arg_x(c, 3), n = arg_x(c, 4);
    const void *data = arg_p(c, 5);
    if (n > (16u << 20)) rt_fatal("nvn: UpdateUniformBuffer of %#llx bytes", (unsigned long long)n);
    p_update_ub *r = rec(cmd_of(c), OP_UPDATE_UB, offsetof(p_update_ub, data) + n);
    r->dst = dst;
    r->size = n;
    memcpy(r->data, data, n);
}

// ---------- CommandBuffer: render state, payloads of nvn_obj.h
// void nvnCommandBufferSetRenderTargets(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, int n, const NVNtexture *const *colors,
// const NVNtextureView *const *color_views, const NVNtexture *depth, const NVNtextureView *depth_view)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetRenderTargets) {
    int n = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    const NVNtexture *const *ct = arg_p(c, 2);
    const NVNtextureView *const *cv = arg_p(c, 3);
    const NVNtexture *dt = arg_p(c, 4);
    const NVNtextureView *dv = arg_p(c, 5);
    if (n < 0 || n > 8) {
        rt_log("nvn: SetRenderTargets with %d colour targets", n);
        n = n < 0 ? 0 : 8;
    }
    p_set_rt *r = REC(cmd_of(c), OP_SET_RT, p_set_rt);
    r->n = n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        r->color[i] = ct ? tex_pin(ct[i]) : NULL;
        copy_view(&r->cview[i], &r->has_cview[i], cv ? cv[i] : NULL);
    }
    r->depth = tex_pin(dt);
    copy_view(&r->dview, &r->has_dview, dv);
}
// void nvnCommandBufferClearColor(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, int index, const float *rgba, int mask)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferClearColor) {
    p_clear_color *r = REC(cmd_of(c), OP_CLEAR_COLOR, p_clear_color);
    r->index = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    r->mask = (int)arg_x(c, 3);
    memcpy(r->rgba, arg_p(c, 2), 16);
}
// void nvnCommandBufferClearDepthStencil(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, float depth, NVNboolean depth_mask, int stencil,
// int stencil_mask)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferClearDepthStencil) {
    *REC(cmd_of(c), OP_CLEAR_DS, p_clear_ds) = (p_clear_ds){arg_s(c, 0), nvn_arg_bool(c, 1), (int)arg_x(c, 2), (int)arg_x(c, 3)};
}
static void set_viewports(cmd_t *o, int first, int n, const float *v) {
    if (first < 0 || n < 0 || first + n > 16) {
        rt_log("nvn: SetViewports first %d n %d", first, n);
        return;
    }
    p_viewports *r = REC(o, OP_VIEWPORTS, p_viewports);
    r->first = first;
    r->n = n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) memcpy(r->v[i], v + 4 * i, 16);
}
// void nvnCommandBufferSetViewports(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, int first, int n, const float *xywh)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetViewports) { set_viewports(cmd_of(c), (int)arg_x(c, 1), (int)arg_x(c, 2), arg_p(c, 3)); }
// void nvnCommandBufferSetViewport(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, int x, int y, int w, int h)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetViewport) {
    float v[4] = {(float)(int)arg_x(c, 1), (float)(int)arg_x(c, 2), (float)(int)arg_x(c, 3), (float)(int)arg_x(c, 4)};
    set_viewports(cmd_of(c), 0, 1, v);
}
static void set_scissor(cmd_t *o, int x, int y, int w, int h) { *REC(o, OP_SCISSOR, p_scissor) = (p_scissor){x, y, w, h}; }
// void nvnCommandBufferSetScissor(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, int x, int y, int w, int h)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetScissor) {
    set_scissor(cmd_of(c), (int)arg_x(c, 1), (int)arg_x(c, 2), (int)arg_x(c, 3), (int)arg_x(c, 4));
}
// void nvnCommandBufferSetScissors(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, int first, int n, const int *xywh): the replay keeps one
// scissor (index 0); other indices matter only to shaders that select a viewport index, so differing ones are reported
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetScissors) {
    int first = (int)arg_x(c, 1), n = (int)arg_x(c, 2);
    const int *r = arg_p(c, 3);
    if (first < 0 || n < 0 || first + n > 16) rt_fatal("nvn: SetScissors first %d n %d", first, n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)
        if (memcmp(r + 4 * i, r, 16)) {
            static int once;
            if (!once++) rt_log("nvn: SetScissors: differing scissor %d ignored (single-scissor replay)", first + i);
        }
    if (first == 0 && n > 0) set_scissor(cmd_of(c), r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3]);
}
static void set_depth_range(cmd_t *o, float n, float f) { *REC(o, OP_DEPTH_RANGE, p_depth_range) = (p_depth_range){n, f}; }
// void nvnCommandBufferSetDepthRange(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, float near, float far)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetDepthRange) { set_depth_range(cmd_of(c), arg_s(c, 0), arg_s(c, 1)); }
// void nvnCommandBufferSetDepthRanges(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, int first, int n, const float *ranges)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetDepthRanges) {
    int first = (int)arg_x(c, 1), n = (int)arg_x(c, 2);
    const float *r = arg_p(c, 3);
    if (first < 0 || n < 0 || first + n > 16) rt_fatal("nvn: SetDepthRanges first %d n %d", first, n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)
        if (memcmp(r + 2 * i, r, 8)) {
            static int once;
            if (!once++) rt_log("nvn: SetDepthRanges: differing range %d ignored (single-range replay)", first + i);
        }
    if (first == 0 && n > 0) set_depth_range(cmd_of(c), r[0], r[1]);
}

// void nvnCommandBufferSetRenderEnableConditional(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, NVNconditionalRenderMode mode,

// void nvnCommandBufferBind{Blend,Color,ChannelMask,Multisample,Polygon,DepthStencil}State(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd,
// const NVN*State *state): the state object's bytes are copied (p_bind_state.kind order)

}

static void bind_vertex_buffers(cmd_t *o, int first, int n, const NVNbufferRange *rg) {
    if (first < 0 || n < 0 || first + n > 16) { rt_log("nvn: BindVertexBuffers first %d n %d", first, n); return; }
    p_bind_vbuf *r = RECN(o, OP_BIND_VBUF, p_bind_vbuf, r, n);
    r->first = first;
    r->n = n;
    memcpy(r->r, rg, sizeof *rg * (size_t)n);
    hw_fix(o, 24 * (size_t)n);
}
// void nvnCommandBufferBindVertexBuffers(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, int first, int n, const NVNbufferRange *ranges)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindVertexBuffers) { bind_vertex_buffers(cmd_of(c), (int)arg_x(c, 1), (int)arg_x(c, 2), arg_p(c, 3)); }

NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindVertexBuffer) {
    NVNbufferRange r = {arg_x(c, 2), arg_x(c, 3)};

}
// Uniform and storage buffers: one record per binding (CB_SIZE/ADDRESS 4 words + CB_BIND 1 on hardware).
// NVN2 task (6) / mesh (7) bind in the tessellation slots 3 and 4 (nxnative hle_nvn.c st_host).
static int st_host(int st) { return st == 6 ? 3 : st == 7 ? 4 : st; }
static void bind_buffers(const Cpu *c, uint32_t op) {   // (cmd, stage, first, n, const NVNbufferRange *ranges)
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    int st = st_host((int)arg_x(c, 1)), first = (int)arg_x(c, 2), n = (int)arg_x(c, 3);
    const NVNbufferRange *rg = arg_p(c, 4);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        *REC(o, op, p_bind_buf) = (p_bind_buf){st, first + i, rg[i].address, rg[i].size};
        hw_fix(o, 20);
    }
}
static void bind_buffer(const Cpu *c, uint32_t op) {    // (cmd, stage, index, NVNbufferAddress address, size_t size)
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    *REC(o, op, p_bind_buf) = (p_bind_buf){st_host((int)arg_x(c, 1)), (int)arg_x(c, 2), arg_x(c, 3), arg_x(c, 4)};
    hw_fix(o, 20);
}
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindUniformBuffer) { bind_buffer(c, OP_BIND_UBO); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindUniformBuffers) { bind_buffers(c, OP_BIND_UBO); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindStorageBuffer) { bind_buffer(c, OP_BIND_SSBO); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindStorageBuffers) { bind_buffers(c, OP_BIND_SSBO); }
// void nvnCommandBufferPush{Graphics,Compute}Constants(NVNcommandBuffer *, int table, int offset, int bytes,
// const void *data), NVN 2. The driver (sdk+0x5d34b0 graphics, sdk+0x5d3a30 compute) clamps bytes to 0x100, drops
// calls under 4 bytes and writes words: graphics as SET_ROOT_TABLE_SELECTOR (method 0x504, table & 7 | offset << 8)
// plus LOAD_ROOT_TABLE (0x508), compute through MME macro 0x53. Graphics shaders read table 0 as constant bank 24:
// the full-screen blits get their texel size and size this way (1/w, 1/h, w, h at 0x0..0xc in the NVN 2 reference title's runs). Where
// compute shaders read their pushes is not known yet; no the NVN 2 reference title compute stage reads bank 24.
// The Deferred entry points (sdk+0x5d3670 graphics, sdk+0x5d3df0 compute) have the same five arguments, but store the
// direct data pointer and the low byte of offset without reading data. The submit interpreter reloads that pointer.
// Keep the host's 256-byte table bound for both pipelines; the deferred compute helper itself does not clamp bytes.
static void push_constants(const Cpu *c, int compute, int deferred) {
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    int table = (int)(arg_x(c, 1) & 7), offset = deferred ? (uint8_t)arg_x(c, 2) : (int)arg_x(c, 2);
    uint32_t bytes = (uint32_t)arg_x(c, 3);
    if (bytes > 0x100) bytes = 0x100;
    if (bytes < 4) return;
    if (offset < 0 || offset + bytes > 0x100 || (offset & 3)) {
        rt_log("nvn: Push%sConstants offset %#x bytes %#x past the 256-byte root table", compute ? "Compute" : "Graphics",
               offset, bytes);
        return;
    }
    uint32_t n = bytes / 4;
    p_push_const *r = RECN(o, OP_PUSH_CONST, p_push_const, w, n);   // holds only n words of w: set fields one by one
    r->compute = compute, r->table = table, r->offset = offset, r->bytes = (int32_t)(n * 4);
    r->src = deferred ? arg_x(c, 4) : 0;
    if (!deferred) memcpy(r->w, arg_p(c, 4), n * 4);
    hw_fix(o, 4 * ((size_t)n + 2));   // method header, selector or macro parameter, n words
}
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferPushGraphicsConstants) { push_constants(c, 0, 0); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferPushComputeConstants) { push_constants(c, 1, 0); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferPushGraphicsConstantsDeferred) { push_constants(c, 0, 1); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferPushComputeConstantsDeferred) { push_constants(c, 1, 1); }
// Texture, image and separate handle binds. A deferred bind (NVN 55 *Deferred entry points, the fallback of the inline
// fast paths) keeps the pointer to the game's handle array: the original driver (sdk+0x46cc00 BindTexturesDeferred)
// reads the handles when the command buffer is submitted, and the game fills its material handle tables after
// recording and before the submit (nvn_submit_prepare). hw_bytes: the hardware size of the plain variant.
static void bind_handles(cmd_t *o, uint32_t op, int st, int first, int n, const uint64_t *h, int deferred, size_t hw_bytes) {
    if (n < 0 || n > 32) { rt_log("nvn: bind of %d handles", n); return; }
    p_bind_handles *r = RECN(o, op, p_bind_handles, h, n);
    r->stage = st;
    r->first = first;
    r->n = n;
    r->src = deferred ? (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)h : 0;
    memcpy(r->h, h, 8 * (size_t)n);
    hw_fix(o, hw_bytes ? hw_bytes : 16 + 4 * (size_t)n);   // macro 7 + method 0x1a2c + CB_POS + one word per binding
}
static void bind_handle_array(const Cpu *c, uint32_t op, int deferred, int wide) {   // (cmd, stage, first, n, handles)
    int n = (int)arg_x(c, 3);
    bind_handles(cmd_of(c), op, st_host((int)arg_x(c, 1)), (int)arg_x(c, 2), n, arg_p(c, 4), deferred,
                 wide && n >= 0 && n <= 32 ? 16 + 8 * (size_t)n : 0);
}
static void bind_one_handle(const Cpu *c, uint32_t op, size_t hw_bytes) {   // (cmd, stage, index, handle)
    uint64_t v = arg_x(c, 3);
    bind_handles(cmd_of(c), op, st_host((int)arg_x(c, 1)), (int)arg_x(c, 2), 1, &v, 0, hw_bytes);
}
// Combined texture handles share the texture slots with separate textures (sampler id in bits 20 and up). Images
// (writable textures): handle = texture pool index; the game does not call RegisterImage, images and textures share
// their registration.
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindTexture) { bind_one_handle(c, OP_BIND_TEX, 0); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindTextures) { bind_handle_array(c, OP_BIND_TEX, 0, 0); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindImage) { bind_one_handle(c, OP_BIND_IMG, 24); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindImages) { bind_handle_array(c, OP_BIND_IMG, 0, 1); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindSeparateTexture) { bind_one_handle(c, OP_BIND_TEX, 24); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindSeparateTextures) { bind_handle_array(c, OP_BIND_TEX, 0, 1); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindSeparateSampler) { bind_one_handle(c, OP_BIND_SAMP, 24); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindSeparateSamplers) { bind_handle_array(c, OP_BIND_SAMP, 0, 1); }

NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBindTexturesDeferred) { bind_handle_array(c, OP_BIND_TEX, 1, 0); }
```
