```c
// void nvnCommandBufferReportValue(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, uint32_t value, NVNbufferAddress addr): the value lands when
// the GPU reaches this point. Recorded as a 4-byte ClearBuffer, so it stays in GPU order with the ClearBuffer resets of
// the same counter (main+0x7b9274 modes 1-3) and works in CPU-invisible pools; the CPU sees it after the fence, as a
// counter report.
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferReportValue) {
    *REC(cmd_of(c), OP_CLEAR_BUF, p_clear_buf) = (p_clear_buf){arg_x(c, 2), 4, (uint32_t)arg_x(c, 1), 0};
}
// Colour reduction is a Maxwell bandwidth hint for blending into compressed targets: no effect on the result.
// void nvnCommandBufferSetColorReductionEnable(cmd, NVNboolean enable), SetColorReductionThresholds(cmd, class, const int *)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetColorReductionEnable) { (void)c; }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetColorReductionThresholds) { (void)c; }
// void nvnCommandBufferBarrier(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, int bits)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferBarrier) { REC(cmd_of(c), OP_BARRIER, p_barrier)->bits = (int)arg_x(c, 1); }
// void nvnCommandBufferSetTexturePool / SetSamplerPool(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, const NVNtexturePool / NVNsamplerPool *)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetTexturePool) {
    dpool_ref pool;
    if (!nvn_dpool_snapshot(arg_p(c, 1), 1u << 20, &pool)) rt_fatal("nvn: invalid texture descriptor pool");
    REC(cmd_of(c), OP_SET_TEX_POOL, p_set_pool)->pool = pool;
}
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetSamplerPool) {
    dpool_ref pool;
    if (!nvn_dpool_snapshot(arg_p(c, 1), 1u << 12, &pool)) rt_fatal("nvn: invalid sampler descriptor pool");
    REC(cmd_of(c), OP_SET_SAMP_POOL, p_set_pool)->pool = pool;
}
// void nvnCommandBufferCopyBufferToTexture(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, NVNbufferAddress src, const NVNtexture *dst,
// const NVNtextureView *view, const NVNcopyRegion *region, int flags)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferCopyBufferToTexture) {
    p_copy_b2t *o = REC(cmd_of(c), OP_COPY_B2T, p_copy_b2t);
    o->src = arg_x(c, 1);
    o->tex = tex_pin(arg_p(c, 2));
    copy_view(&o->view, &o->has_view, arg_p(c, 3));
    o->r = *(const NVNcopyRegion *)arg_p(c, 4);
    o->flags = (int)arg_x(c, 5);
}
// void nvnCommandBufferCopyTextureToBuffer(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, const NVNtexture *src, const NVNtextureView *view,
// const NVNcopyRegion *region, NVNbufferAddress dst, int flags): p_copy_b2t with src = the destination address
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferCopyTextureToBuffer) {

    copy_view(&o->view, &o->has_view, arg_p(c, 2));
    o->r = *(const NVNcopyRegion *)arg_p(c, 3);
    o->flags = (int)arg_x(c, 5);
}
// void nvnCommandBufferClearTexture{,ui}(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, const NVNtexture *tex, const NVNtextureView *view,
// const NVNcopyRegion *region, const float / uint32_t *rgba, int mask)
static void clear_texture(const Cpu *c, int is_uint) {
    p_clear_tex *o = REC(cmd_of(c), OP_CLEAR_TEX, p_clear_tex);
    o->tex = tex_pin(arg_p(c, 1));
    copy_view(&o->view, &o->has_view, arg_p(c, 2));
    o->r = *(const NVNcopyRegion *)arg_p(c, 3);
    o->mask = (int)arg_x(c, 5);
    o->is_uint = (uint8_t)is_uint;
    memcpy(o->c.u, arg_p(c, 4), 16);
}
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferClearTexture) { clear_texture(c, 0); }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferClearTextureui) { clear_texture(c, 1); }
// void nvnCommandBufferCopyTextureToTexture(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, const NVNtexture *src, const NVNtextureView *src_view,
// const NVNcopyRegion *src_region, const NVNtexture *dst, const NVNtextureView *dst_view,
// const NVNcopyRegion *dst_region, int flags)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferCopyTextureToTexture) {
    p_copy_t2t *o = REC(cmd_of(c), OP_COPY_T2T, p_copy_t2t);
    o->src = tex_pin(arg_p(c, 1));
    o->dst = tex_pin(arg_p(c, 4));
    copy_view(&o->sv, &o->has_sv, arg_p(c, 2));
    copy_view(&o->dv, &o->has_dv, arg_p(c, 5));
    o->sr = *(const NVNcopyRegion *)arg_p(c, 3);
    o->dr = *(const NVNcopyRegion *)arg_p(c, 6);
    o->flags = (int)arg_x(c, 7);
}
// void nvnCommandBufferDownsample(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, const NVNtexture *src, const NVNtexture *dst): level 0 of src
// into level 0 of dst, whole extents, filtered. Recorded as a linear-filter texture copy: copy_t2t resolves a
// multisample source into an equal-size target and blits (2x2 average at half size) between sizes. As nxnative
// hle_nvn.c and SavageWindRecomp cmdbuf.c record it; docs/maxwell.md 1.19.
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferDownsample) {
    p_copy_t2t *o = REC(cmd_of(c), OP_COPY_T2T, p_copy_t2t);
    o->src = tex_pin(arg_p(c, 1));
    o->dst = tex_pin(arg_p(c, 2));
    if (o->src) o->sr = (NVNcopyRegion){0, 0, 0, (int)o->src->d.width, (int)o->src->d.height, 1};
    if (o->dst) o->dr = (NVNcopyRegion){0, 0, 0, (int)o->dst->d.width, (int)o->dst->d.height, 1};
    o->flags = NVN_COPY_FLAGS_LINEAR_FILTER_BIT;
}

NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetCopyRowStride) { REC(cmd_of(c), OP_COPY_STRIDE, p_copy_stride)->stride = (int64_t)arg_x(c, 1); }

NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetBlendColor) { memcpy(REC(cmd_of(c), OP_BLEND_COLOR, p_blend_color)->rgba, arg_p(c, 1), 16); }

// void nvnCommandBufferWaitSync(NVNcommandBuffer *cmd, const NVNsync *sync): the SDK retains the pointer at record
// time and reads the sync's current producer at submit. Preparation fulfils the wait before consumer CPU snapshots.
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferWaitSync) {
    cmd_t *o = cmd_of(c);
    REC(o, OP_WAIT_SYNC, p_wait_sync)->sync = arg_p(c, 1);
    hw_fix(o, 0);   // the SDK records a CPU control entry here; GPU wait commands are emitted at submit
}
// Commands without an effect on this replay (hle_nvn.c g_nops). WaitEvent still relies on in-order replay; shader
// scratch memory and the tessellation patch size have no host counterpart the replay needs.
// void nvnCommandBufferWaitEvent(cmd, const NVNevent *event,
// NVNeventWaitMode mode, uint32_t value), SetShaderScratchMemory(cmd, const NVNmemoryPool *pool, ptrdiff_t offset,
// size_t size), SetPatchSize(cmd, int size)
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferWaitEvent) { (void)c; }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetShaderScratchMemory) { (void)c; }
NVN_API(nvnCommandBufferSetPatchSize) { (void)c; }

// ---------- submit
// What the console reads at the submit call is read here, on the game thread: every handle must be a live recording,
// and deferred binds and pushes take the data the game's arrays hold now (the game fills its tables for the next frame
// as soon as the submit returns). The result is written into the recording copy.
static uint64_t def_reads, def_changed, n_clones;

// Only QueueFenceSync and window acquire currently produce syncs: both name work outside this submission that is
// already queued (or complete). Recorded FenceSync and imported/external producers remain unimplemented.
// Waiting for their maximum before the whole batch is conservative: it orders CPU completion callbacks as well
// as GPU work before *any* deferred read or backend snapshot, including those before a wait in another handle.
static uint64_t wait_target(const uint8_t *p, int depth) {
    uint64_t target = 0;
    for (;;) {
        op_hdr h;
        memcpy(&h, p, sizeof h);
        if (h.size < 8 || (h.size & 7) || h.op >= OP_COUNT_)
            rt_fatal("nvn: corrupt recording at %p while preparing WaitSync (op %u size %u)", (const void *)p, h.op, h.size);
        if (h.op == OP_END) return target;
        if (h.op == OP_JUMP) {
            if (h.size < 16) rt_fatal("nvn: short WaitSync jump record at %p", (const void *)p);
            memcpy(&p, p + 8, 8);
            continue;
        }
        uint64_t value = 0;
        if (h.op == OP_CALL) {
            if (h.size < 16) rt_fatal("nvn: short WaitSync call record at %p", (const void *)p);
            uint64_t called;
            memcpy(&called, p + 8, 8);
            if (depth >= 16) rt_fatal("nvn: WaitSync preparation: call depth over 16");
            value = wait_target((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)called, depth + 1);
        } else if (h.op == OP_WAIT_SYNC) {
            if (h.size < 8 + sizeof(p_wait_sync)) rt_fatal("nvn: short WaitSync record at %p", (const void *)p);
            const sync_t *source = ((const p_wait_sync *)(const void *)(p + 8))->sync;
            if (!source) rt_fatal("nvn: CommandBufferWaitSync with a null sync");
            sync_t snapshot;
            memcpy(&snapshot, source, sizeof snapshot);   // one value-at-submit read; never reread while waiting
            if (snapshot.magic != MAGIC('S', 'Y', 'N', 'C') ||
                (snapshot.fenced != 0 && snapshot.fenced != 1 && snapshot.fenced != 3))
                rt_fatal("nvn: CommandBufferWaitSync with an invalid sync state");
            if (snapshot.fenced) value = snapshot.fence;   // an unfenced SDK sync emits no GPU wait
        }
        if (value > target) target = value;
        p += h.size;
    }
}

static void wait_submission(const uint64_t *handles, int n) {
    uint64_t target = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t value = wait_target((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)handles[i], 0);
        if (value > target) target = value;
    }
    if (!target) return;
    const GfxBackend *b = gfx_backend();
    // No copy/backend lock is held here. QueueSubmitCommands has given its virtual core up. The async front
    // submit lock does not stop an already-enqueued producer: replay/completion never acquire that lock.
    // fence_done/fence_wait include completion callbacks, unlike the raw Vulkan timeline.
    if (b->fence_done() < target && !b->fence_wait(target, UINT64_MAX))
        rt_fatal("nvn: CommandBufferWaitSync could not reach producer fence %llu", (unsigned long long)target);
}

static int resolve_deferred(const uint8_t *p, int depth) {   // returns the number of deferred binds and pushes
    int nd = 0;
    for (;;) {
        op_hdr h;
        memcpy(&h, p, sizeof h);
        if (h.size < 8 || (h.size & 7) || h.op >= OP_COUNT_)
            rt_fatal("nvn: corrupt recording at %p while resolving deferred binds (op %u size %u)", (const void *)p,
                     h.op, h.size);
        if (h.op == OP_END) return nd;
        if (h.op == OP_JUMP) {
            memcpy(&p, p + 8, 8);
            continue;
        }
        if (h.op == OP_CALL) {
            uint64_t t;
            memcpy(&t, p + 8, 8);
            if (depth >= 16) rt_fatal("nvn: deferred bind resolution: call depth over 16");
            nd += resolve_deferred((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)t, depth + 1);
        } else if (h.op == OP_PUSH_CONST) {
            if (h.size < 8 + offsetof(p_push_const, w)) rt_fatal("nvn: short push-constant record at %p", (const void *)p);
            p_push_const *b = (p_push_const *)(uintptr_t)(p + 8);
            if (b->src) {
                if (b->bytes <= 0 || b->bytes > (int)sizeof b->w || (b->bytes & 3) ||
                    h.size < 8 + offsetof(p_push_const, w) + (size_t)b->bytes)
                    rt_fatal("nvn: invalid deferred push-constant record at %p", (const void *)p);
                nd++;
                memcpy(b->w, (const void *)(uintptr_t)b->src, (size_t)b->bytes);
            }
        } else if (h.op == OP_BIND_TEX || h.op == OP_BIND_IMG || h.op == OP_BIND_SAMP) {
            p_bind_handles *b = (p_bind_handles *)(uintptr_t)(p + 8);
            if (b->src && b->n > 0 && b->n <= 32) {
                nd++;
                uint64_t cur[32];
                memcpy(cur, (const void *)(uintptr_t)b->src, 8 * (size_t)b->n);
                __atomic_fetch_add(&def_reads, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
                if (memcmp(cur, b->h, 8 * (size_t)b->n)) {
                    if (__atomic_fetch_add(&def_changed, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) < 6)
                        NVN_LOG("deferred bind read new handles at submit: stage %d slot %d, %#llx at record -> %#llx",
                                b->stage, b->first, (unsigned long long)b->h[0], (unsigned long long)cur[0]);
                    memcpy(b->h, cur, 8 * (size_t)b->n);
                }
            }
        }
        p += h.size;
    }
}

void nvn_submit_prepare(const uint64_t *handles, int n) {
    uint64_t now = __atomic_add_fetch(&nsubmits, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    nvn_mode_trace(NVN_MODE_PREPARE, 0, 0, (uint32_t)n, now);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t handle = handles[i];
        copy_touch(handle, now, "QueueSubmitCommands");
        nvn_mode_trace(NVN_MODE_HANDLE, 0, handle, (uint32_t)i, now);
    }
    wait_submission(handles, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) resolve_deferred((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)handles[i], 0);
}

// Asynchronous replay. A copy a queued submission still reads keeps that submission's deferred binds: when it holds
// deferred binds (or is not known to hold none), this submission gets a clone, resolved here and freed after its replay.
void nvn_submit_prepare_async(const uint64_t *handles, uint64_t *out, int n) {
    uint64_t now = __atomic_add_fetch(&nsubmits, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    nvn_mode_trace(NVN_MODE_PREPARE, 0, 0, (uint32_t)n, now);
    uint64_t replayed = gfx_replayed_submits();
    plat_mutex_lock(&copy_lock);
    if (nzombies) zombie_sweep(replayed);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t handle = handles[i];
        copy_prefix *pf = copy_find(handle);
        if (!pf) {
            plat_mutex_unlock(&copy_lock);
            rt_fatal("nvn: QueueSubmitCommands: command handle %#llx is not a live recording (released or never recorded)",
                     (unsigned long long)handle);
        }
        nvn_mode_trace(NVN_MODE_HANDLE, 0, handle, (uint32_t)i, now);
        out[i] = handle;
        if (pf->used_at > replayed && pf->used_at != now && pf->deferred != 1) {
            size_t sz = sizeof *pf + pf->bytes;
            copy_prefix *cl = malloc(sz);
            if (!cl) rt_fatal("nvn: out of memory (recording clone, %zu bytes)", sz);
            memcpy(cl, pf, sz);
            cl->magic = 0;   // not a live handle: the game never sees it
            cl->used_at = now;
            zombie_add(cl);
            out[i] = (uintptr_t)(cl + 1);
            __atomic_fetch_add(&n_clones, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        } else {
            pf->used_at = now;
        }
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&copy_lock);
    wait_submission(out, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int nd = resolve_deferred((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)out[i], 0);
        if (out[i] == handles[i]) ((copy_prefix *)(uintptr_t)out[i] - 1)->deferred = nd ? 2 : 1;
    }
    if (now % 7200 == 0)
        rt_log("nvn: asynchronous replay at submit %llu: %llu recording clones so far, %u copies waiting for the replay",
               (unsigned long long)now, (unsigned long long)__atomic_load_n(&n_clones, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), nzombies);
}

uint64_t nvn_submit_count(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&nsubmits, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); }

const char *nvn_op_name(uint32_t op) {
    static const char *const names[] = {
        "END", "JUMP", "BEGIN", "CALL", "SIGNAL_EVENT", "REPORT_COUNTER", "COPY_B2B", "UPDATE_UB", "SET_RT",
        "CLEAR_COLOR", "CLEAR_DS", "VIEWPORTS", "SCISSOR", "DEPTH_RANGE", "BIND_PROGRAM", "BIND_STATE", "BIND_VATTR",
        "BIND_VSTREAM", "BIND_VBUF", "BIND_UBO", "BIND_SSBO", "BIND_TEX", "BIND_SAMP", "STENCIL", "POLY_OFFSET", "DRAW",
        "DRAW_IDX", "DISPATCH", "BARRIER", "SET_TEX_POOL", "SET_SAMP_POOL", "COPY_B2T", "COPY_STRIDE", "BLEND_COLOR",
        "COPY_T2B", "BIND_IMG", "COPY_T2T", "RESET_COUNTER", "CLEAR_TEX", "DEPTH_CLAMP", "RENDER_ENABLE",
        "RASTER_DISCARD", "RENDER_COND", "PRIM_RESTART", "DRAW_IDX_IND", "DISPATCH_IND", "CLEAR_BUF", "PUSH_CONST", "WAIT_SYNC",
        "DRAW_IDX_IND_COUNT", "GEO_MODE", "DRAW_MESH",
    };
    _Static_assert(sizeof names / sizeof *names == OP_COUNT_, "one name per op");
    return op < OP_COUNT_ ? names[op] : "?";
}
```

`runtime/nvn_api_core.c`:

```c
// NVN front end, first slice: device, queue, memory pool, buffer, sync and
// event objects. Ported from MacNativeGames games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/hle_nvn.c @ b75be8cf (MIT,
// Copyright (c) 2026 jhaizhou; origin d2r-mobile), lines 137-253, 534-645 and 1975-2001; Metal, mach, the translation
// thread and Apple diagnostics dropped. Calls that reached Metal go to gfx_backend() (gfx.h). nvnQueuePresentTexture
// belongs to the window slice; nvnDeviceGetProcAddress lives in nvn_procs.c.
//
// Objects are stored in place in the NVN object memory the game provides (nvn_obj.h); every argument is read from the
// AAPCS64 registers (host.h arg_x / arg_p) and every result returned with ret_x.
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "nvn_pool_index.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define DEV_MAGIC MAGIC('D', 'E', 'V', 0)
#define QUEUE_MAGIC MAGIC('Q', 'U', 'E', 'U')
#define BUF_MAGIC MAGIC('B', 'U', 'F', 0)
#define SYNC_MAGIC MAGIC('S', 'Y', 'N', 'C')
#define EVENT_MAGIC MAGIC('E', 'V', 'N', 'T')

// ---------- shared helpers (nvn_api.h)
// The call count goes to the shared counter 1024 at a time: the main thread and the job workers all record command
// buffers, and one locked add per call kept the counter's cache line moving between their cores (0.8k samples a
// fight). The count lags by at most 1023 calls per thread.
void nvn_called(uint8_t *seen, const char *name) {
    static _Thread_local uint32_t calls;
    if (++calls == 1024) {
        __atomic_fetch_add(&gfx_counters.nvn_calls, calls, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        calls = 0;
    }
    if (__atomic_load_n(seen, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) || __atomic_exchange_n(seen, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) return;
    uint64_t n = __atomic_add_fetch(&gfx_counters.nvn_distinct, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    NVN_LOG("first call %llu: %s", (unsigned long long)n, name);
}

uint64_t nvn_new_serial(void) {
    static uint64_t n;
    return __atomic_add_fetch(&n, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

static uint64_t last_fence;
uint64_t nvn_fence_last(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&last_fence, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

static int depth_minus_w;
int nvn_depth_minus_w(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&depth_minus_w, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); }

void nvn_guest_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (size) gfx_backend()->guest_written(addr, size);
}

// memcpy of pool storage the GPU rendered into must copy what the GPU wrote: TotK moves its generated grass maps
// between pools with memcpy. Copies below 1 KiB skip the check; the copy itself is memmove, as overlapping
// arguments are undefined for memcpy anyway.
static void ov_memcpy(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t dst = arg_x(c, 0), src = arg_x(c, 1), n = arg_x(c, 2);
    if (n >= 1024) gfx_backend()->guest_read(src, n);
    memmove((void *)(uintptr_t)dst, (const void *)(uintptr_t)src, n);
    ret_x(c, dst);
}
HOST_OVERRIDE("memcpy", ov_memcpy);

__attribute__((weak)) void nvn_submit_prepare(const uint64_t *handles, int n) { (void)handles, (void)n; }
__attribute__((weak)) void nvn_submit_prepare_async(const uint64_t *handles, uint64_t *out, int n) {
    memcpy(out, handles, sizeof *out * (size_t)n);
}
__attribute__((weak)) int gfx_replay_async(void) { return 0; }
__attribute__((weak)) uint64_t gfx_replayed_submits(void) { return nvn_submit_count(); }

// ---------- pools: GPU window (section 3.1) and the address index
static PlatMutex pool_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;   // guards gva and index
typedef struct { uint64_t lo, hi; } Span;
enum { GVA_MAX = 1024 };
static Span gva[GVA_MAX];   // ranges handed out in the GPU window, sorted by lo
static int ngva;
static pidx pool_index;

// First fit in [RT_GPU_VA_BASE, +RT_GPU_VA_SIZE); size is a multiple of NVN_VPOOL_PAGE.
static uint64_t gva_alloc(uint64_t size) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&pool_lock);
    uint64_t at = RT_GPU_VA_BASE, r = 0;
    int i = 0;
    for (; i < ngva && gva[i].lo - at < size; i++) at = gva[i].hi;
    if (ngva < GVA_MAX && size <= RT_GPU_VA_BASE + RT_GPU_VA_SIZE - at) {
        memmove(gva + i + 1, gva + i, (size_t)(ngva - i) * sizeof *gva);
        gva[i] = (Span){at, at + size};
        ngva++;
        r = at;
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&pool_lock);
    return r;
}

static void gva_free(uint64_t lo) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&pool_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < ngva; i++)
        if (gva[i].lo == lo) {
            memmove(gva + i, gva + i + 1, (size_t)(ngva - i - 1) * sizeof *gva);
            ngva--;
            break;
        }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&pool_lock);
}

static void index_add(const pool_t *o) {
    uintptr_t lo = (uintptr_t)o->mem;
    pidx_ent e = {.lo = lo, .hi = lo + o->size, .base = lo, .gpu = lo, .key = o};
    plat_mutex_lock(&pool_lock);
    pidx_remove(&pool_index, o, NULL);   // a pool object initialized again without Finalize
    int ok = pidx_insert(&pool_index, &e);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&pool_lock);
    if (!ok) rt_fatal("nvn: out of memory for the pool index");
}

static void index_del(const pool_t *o) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&pool_lock);
    pidx_remove(&pool_index, o, NULL);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&pool_lock);
}

const pool_t *nvn_pool_find(uint64_t addr, uint64_t len) {
    plat_mutex_lock_shared(&pool_lock);
    const pidx_ent *e = pidx_find(&pool_index, (uintptr_t)addr, len);
    const pool_t *p = e ? e->key : NULL;
    plat_mutex_unlock_shared(&pool_lock);
    return p;
}

// Physical and virtual pools (MacNativeGames totk_vpool.c checks). A CPU-invisible one gets a GPU window range.
// A CPU-visible physical pool (1.4.3: flags 0x18c, GPU_NO_ACCESS) keeps the game's storage for the CPU; the back end
// gives it device memory as any physical pool (vk_memory.c vk_pool_init), which the GPU reaches through virtual pools.
static int pool_place(pool_t *o) {
    int phys = (o->flags & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_PHYSICAL) != 0, virt = (o->flags & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_VIRTUAL) != 0;
    if (!phys && !virt) return 1;
    const char *kind = phys ? "physical" : "virtual";
    if (phys && virt) { rt_log("nvn: pool flags %#x are both PHYSICAL and VIRTUAL", o->flags); return 0; }
    if (!o->size || o->size % NVN_VPOOL_PAGE) {
        rt_log("nvn: %s pool size %#llx is not a multiple of the pool page (%#llx)", kind,
               (unsigned long long)o->size, (unsigned long long)NVN_VPOOL_PAGE);
        return 0;
    }
    if (virt && o->mem) { rt_log("nvn: virtual pool given storage %p", (void *)o->mem); return 0; }
    if (phys && !o->mem) { rt_log("nvn: physical pool without storage"); return 0; }
    if (!(o->flags & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_CPU_NO_ACCESS)) {
        if (virt) {
            rt_log("nvn: CPU-visible virtual pool (flags %#x, size %#llx) refused", o->flags, (unsigned long long)o->size);
            return 0;
        }
        rt_log("nvn: CPU-visible physical pool %p (flags %#x, size %#llx) keeps the game's storage", (void *)o->mem,
               o->flags, (unsigned long long)o->size);
        return 1;
    }
    uint64_t a = gva_alloc(o->size);
    if (!a) {
        rt_log("nvn: GPU address window full, %s pool of %#llx bytes refused", kind, (unsigned long long)o->size);
        return 0;
    }
    o->mem = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)a;
    o->span = o->size;
    return 1;
}

static int pool_gpu_visible(const pool_t *o) { return !(o->flags & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_GPU_NO_ACCESS); }

// void nvnDeviceBuilderSetDefaults(NVNdeviceBuilder *b)

// NVNboolean nvnDeviceInitialize(NVNdevice *d, const NVNdeviceBuilder *b)
NVN_API(nvnDeviceInitialize) {
    dev_t_ *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    const dev_builder_t *b = arg_p(c, 1);
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    o->magic = DEV_MAGIC;
    o->flags = b->flags;
    NVN_LOG("DeviceInitialize %p flags %#x, back end %s", (void *)o, o->flags, gfx_backend()->name);
    ret_x(c, 1);
}
// void nvnDeviceFinalize(NVNdevice *d)
NVN_API(nvnDeviceFinalize) { ((dev_t_ *)arg_p(c, 0))->magic = 0; }
// void nvnDeviceGetInteger(const NVNdevice *d, NVNdeviceInfo what, int *out)
NVN_API(nvnDeviceGetInteger) {
    unsigned w = (unsigned)arg_x(c, 1);
    int *out = arg_p(c, 2);
    if (w == 0x67) {   // NVN 2 shader-copy alignment; observed by VideoDecoderBuffer::Initialize
        *out = 256;
        NVN_LOG("DeviceGetInteger %#x -> %d", w, *out);
        return;
    }
    if (w >= sizeof devinfo / sizeof *devinfo) {   // NVN 2 properties past the NVN 1 table: 0 (feature absent) until known
        if (w > 0x100) rt_fatal("nvn: unsupported NVN device property %#x", w);
        rt_log("nvn: NVN 2 device property %#x not known, answering 0", w);
        *out = 0;
        return;
    }
    *out = devinfo[w];
    NVN_LOG("DeviceGetInteger %#x -> %d", w, *out);
}

NVN_API(nvnDeviceRegisterFastClearColorui) { ret_x(c, 0); }
NVN_API(nvnDeviceRegisterFastClearDepth) { ret_x(c, 0); }

// NVNtextureHandle nvnDeviceGetTextureHandle(const NVNdevice *d, int texture_id, int sampler_id):
// texture id (20 bits) | sampler id << 20, the encoding the replay decodes (NVN_HANDLE_TEX / NVN_HANDLE_SAMP)
NVN_API(nvnDeviceGetTextureHandle) {
    int tid = (int)arg_x(c, 1), sid = (int)arg_x(c, 2);
    if (tid < 0 || tid >= (1 << 20) || sid < 0 || sid >= (1 << 12)) rt_fatal("nvn: texture handle ids out of range %d/%d", tid, sid);
    ret_x(c, (uint64_t)tid | (uint64_t)sid << 20);
}
// NVNtextureHandle nvnDeviceGetTexelFetchHandle(const NVNdevice *d, int texture_id)
NVN_API(nvnDeviceGetTexelFetchHandle) {
    int tid = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    if (tid < 0 || tid >= (1 << 20)) rt_fatal("nvn: texel fetch id out of range %d", tid);
    ret_x(c, (uint64_t)tid);
}

NVN_API(nvnDeviceGetSeparateSamplerHandle) { ret_x(c, (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int)arg_x(c, 1) << 20); }

}

}

    ((dev_t_ *)arg_p(c, 0))->depth_mode = m;
    __atomic_store_n(&depth_minus_w, m == NVN_DEPTH_MODE_NEAR_IS_MINUS_W, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    NVN_LOG("depth mode %s", m ? "near is 0 (as D3D and Vulkan)" : "near is -w (GL): vertex shaders map z to (z+w)/2");
}

// ---------- Memory pools
// void nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults(NVNmemoryPoolBuilder *b)
NVN_API(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults) { memset(arg_p(c, 0), 0, sizeof(pool_builder_t)); }
// void nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice(NVNmemoryPoolBuilder *b, NVNdevice *d)
NVN_API(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice) { ((pool_builder_t *)arg_p(c, 0))->dev = arg_p(c, 1); }
// void nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage(NVNmemoryPoolBuilder *b, void *memory, size_t size)
NVN_API(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage) {
    pool_builder_t *b = arg_p(c, 0);
    b->mem = arg_p(c, 1);
    b->size = arg_x(c, 2);
}
// void nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags(NVNmemoryPoolBuilder *b, int flags)
NVN_API(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags) { ((pool_builder_t *)arg_p(c, 0))->flags = (uint32_t)arg_x(c, 1); }
// NVNboolean nvnMemoryPoolInitialize(NVNmemoryPool *p, const NVNmemoryPoolBuilder *b)
// Pool setup imports, mirrors and maps memory in the back end (the driver, VirtualAlloc): up to 20 ms on the game's
// loader threads, which held a virtual core through it while job workers waited (TOTK_CORE_DIAG). The thread gives
// the core up, as for any blocking host call.
NVN_API(nvnMemoryPoolInitialize) {
    NVN_BLOCKING();
    pool_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    const pool_builder_t *s = arg_p(c, 1);
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    o->magic = NVN_POOL_MAGIC;
    o->flags = s->flags;
    o->mem = o->game_mem = s->mem;
    o->size = s->size;
    int ok = pool_place(o);
    if (ok && !o->mem) {
        rt_log("nvn: MemoryPoolInitialize: pool without storage, flags %#x size %#llx", o->flags,
               (unsigned long long)o->size);
        ok = 0;
    }
    if (ok && !gfx_backend()->pool_init(o)) {
        rt_log("nvn: MemoryPoolInitialize: the %s back end refused pool %p (flags %#x, size %#llx)", gfx_backend()->name,
               (void *)o->mem, o->flags, (unsigned long long)o->size);
        ok = 0;
    }
    if (ok && pool_gpu_visible(o)) index_add(o);
    if (!ok) {
        if (nvn_gpu_only((uintptr_t)o->mem)) gva_free((uintptr_t)o->mem);
        o->magic = 0;
    }
    NVN_LOG("MemoryPool %p mem %p size %#llx flags %#x storage %p%s", (void *)o, (void *)o->mem,
            (unsigned long long)o->size, o->flags, (void *)o->game_mem, ok ? "" : " failed");
    ret_x(c, ok);
}
// void nvnMemoryPoolFinalize(NVNmemoryPool *p)
NVN_API(nvnMemoryPoolFinalize) {
    NVN_BLOCKING();   // as nvnMemoryPoolInitialize
    pool_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (o->magic != NVN_POOL_MAGIC) return;
    if (pool_gpu_visible(o)) index_del(o);
    gfx_backend()->pool_fini(o);
    if (nvn_gpu_only((uintptr_t)o->mem)) gva_free((uintptr_t)o->mem);
    o->mem = o->game_mem;
    o->span = 0;
    o->magic = 0;
}
static uint64_t flush_stat[2][3][2];   // nvn_flush_stats

static void flush_note(int kind, const pool_t *p, uint64_t size) {
    uint32_t f = p ? p->flags : 0;
    int k = f & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_CPU_NO_ACCESS ? 2 : f & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_CPU_CACHED ? 0
          : f & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_CPU_UNCACHED ? 1 : 2;
    __atomic_fetch_add(&flush_stat[kind][k][0], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_fetch_add(&flush_stat[kind][k][1], size, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

void nvn_flush_stats(uint64_t out[2][3][2]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) out[i][k][j] = __atomic_exchange_n(&flush_stat[i][k][j], 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

// void nvnMemoryPoolFlushMappedRange(const NVNmemoryPool *p, ptrdiff_t offset, size_t size): storage is coherent; a
// back end with device-side copies hears of it (nvn_pool_flushed)
NVN_API(nvnMemoryPoolFlushMappedRange) {
    const pool_t *p = arg_p(c, 0);
    int64_t off = (int64_t)arg_x(c, 1);
    uint64_t size = arg_x(c, 2);
    if (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_PERF) flush_note(0, p, size);
    if (p && off >= 0 && (uint64_t)off < p->size) nvn_pool_flushed(p, (uint64_t)off, size < p->size - (uint64_t)off ? size : p->size - (uint64_t)off);
}
// NVNmemoryPoolFlags nvnMemoryPoolGetFlags(const NVNmemoryPool *p)
NVN_API(nvnMemoryPoolGetFlags) { ret_x(c, ((const pool_t *)arg_p(c, 0))->flags); }
// void *nvnMemoryPoolMap(const NVNmemoryPool *p): NULL for CPU_NO_ACCESS
NVN_API(nvnMemoryPoolMap) {
    const pool_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (o->magic != NVN_POOL_MAGIC || (o->flags & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_CPU_NO_ACCESS)) { ret_x(c, 0); return; }
    ret_x(c, (uintptr_t)o->mem);
}
// MacNativeGames totk_vpool.c: every request is checked before any mapping changes.
static int check_request(const pool_t *v, const nvn_mapping_t *r, int i) {
    uint64_t end = (uint64_t)r->virtual_offset + r->size;
    if (r->virtual_offset < 0 || r->physical_offset < 0 || !r->size) {
        rt_log("nvn: MapVirtual request %d has a negative or empty range", i);
        return 0;
    }
    if (((uint64_t)r->virtual_offset | (uint64_t)r->physical_offset | r->size) % NVN_VPOOL_PAGE) {
        rt_log("nvn: MapVirtual request %d not pool-page aligned (page %#llx; v %#llx p %#llx n %#llx)", i,
               (unsigned long long)NVN_VPOOL_PAGE, (unsigned long long)r->virtual_offset,
               (unsigned long long)r->physical_offset, (unsigned long long)r->size);
        return 0;
    }
    if (end < r->size || end > v->size) {
        rt_log("nvn: MapVirtual request %d exceeds the virtual pool (%#llx > %#llx)", i, (unsigned long long)end,
               (unsigned long long)v->size);
        return 0;
    }
    if (!r->physical_pool) return 1;   // unmap
    const pool_t *p = (const pool_t *)(const void *)r->physical_pool;
    if (p->magic != NVN_POOL_MAGIC || !(p->flags & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_PHYSICAL)) {
        rt_log("nvn: MapVirtual request %d source %p is not a physical pool", i, (const void *)p);
        return 0;
    }
    uint64_t pend = (uint64_t)r->physical_offset + r->size;
    if (pend < r->size || pend > p->size) {
        rt_log("nvn: MapVirtual request %d exceeds the physical pool (%#llx > %#llx)", i, (unsigned long long)pend,
               (unsigned long long)p->size);
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}
// NVNboolean nvnMemoryPoolMapVirtual(NVNmemoryPool *p, int n, const NVNmappingRequest *requests)
NVN_API(nvnMemoryPoolMapVirtual) {
    NVN_BLOCKING();   // as nvnMemoryPoolInitialize
    pool_t *v = arg_p(c, 0);
    int n = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    const nvn_mapping_t *r = arg_p(c, 2);
    if (v->magic != NVN_POOL_MAGIC || !(v->flags & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_VIRTUAL) || !v->mem) {
        rt_log("nvn: MapVirtual target %p is not a virtual pool", (void *)v);
        ret_x(c, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (n < 0 || (n && !r)) { rt_log("nvn: MapVirtual with %d requests at %p", n, (const void *)r); ret_x(c, 0); return; }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!check_request(v, &r[i], i)) { ret_x(c, 0); return; }
    if (!gfx_backend()->pool_map_virtual(v, n, r))
        rt_fatal("nvn: MapVirtual of %d requests failed after validation; virtual pool %p is inconsistent", n, (void *)v);
    NVN_LOG("MapVirtual pool %p, %d requests", (void *)v->mem, n);
    ret_x(c, 1);
}
// NVNbufferAddress nvnMemoryPoolGetBufferAddress(const NVNmemoryPool *p)
NVN_API(nvnMemoryPoolGetBufferAddress) { ret_x(c, (uintptr_t)((const pool_t *)arg_p(c, 0))->mem); }

// ---------- Buffers: they reference their pool and own no storage
// void nvnBufferBuilderSetDevice(NVNbufferBuilder *b, NVNdevice *d)
NVN_API(nvnBufferBuilderSetDevice) { ((buf_builder_t *)arg_p(c, 0))->dev = arg_p(c, 1); }
// void nvnBufferBuilderSetDefaults(NVNbufferBuilder *b): keeps the device
NVN_API(nvnBufferBuilderSetDefaults) {
    buf_builder_t *b = arg_p(c, 0);
    NVNdevice *d = b->dev;
    memset(b, 0, sizeof *b);
    b->dev = d;
}
// void nvnBufferBuilderSetStorage(NVNbufferBuilder *b, NVNmemoryPool *p, ptrdiff_t offset, size_t size)
NVN_API(nvnBufferBuilderSetStorage) {
    buf_builder_t *b = arg_p(c, 0);
    b->pool = arg_p(c, 1);
    b->off = (int64_t)arg_x(c, 2);
    b->size = arg_x(c, 3);
}
// NVNboolean nvnBufferInitialize(NVNbuffer *b, const NVNbufferBuilder *builder)
NVN_API(nvnBufferInitialize) {
    buf_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    const buf_builder_t *s = arg_p(c, 1);
    if (!s->pool || s->pool->magic != NVN_POOL_MAGIC || s->off < 0 || (uint64_t)s->off > s->pool->size ||
        s->size > s->pool->size - (uint64_t)s->off) {
        ret_x(c, 0);
        return;
    }
    *o = (buf_t){BUF_MAGIC, s->pool, s->off, s->size};
    ret_x(c, 1);
}
// void nvnBufferFinalize(NVNbuffer *b)
NVN_API(nvnBufferFinalize) { memset(arg_p(c, 0), 0, sizeof(buf_t)); }
static uint64_t buf_address(const buf_t *o) { return o->pool && o->pool->mem ? (uintptr_t)o->pool->mem + (uint64_t)o->off : 0; }
// void *nvnBufferMap(const NVNbuffer *b): NULL in a GPU-window pool, which has no CPU view
NVN_API(nvnBufferMap) {
    uint64_t a = buf_address(arg_p(c, 0));
    ret_x(c, nvn_gpu_only(a) ? 0 : a);
}
// NVNbufferAddress nvnBufferGetAddress(const NVNbuffer *b)
NVN_API(nvnBufferGetAddress) { ret_x(c, buf_address(arg_p(c, 0))); }
// NVNmemoryPool *nvnBufferGetMemoryPool(const NVNbuffer *b)
NVN_API(nvnBufferGetMemoryPool) { ret_x(c, (uintptr_t)((const buf_t *)arg_p(c, 0))->pool); }
// ptrdiff_t nvnBufferGetMemoryOffset(const NVNbuffer *b)
NVN_API(nvnBufferGetMemoryOffset) { ret_x(c, (uint64_t)((const buf_t *)arg_p(c, 0))->off); }
// size_t nvnBufferGetSize(const NVNbuffer *b)
NVN_API(nvnBufferGetSize) { ret_x(c, ((const buf_t *)arg_p(c, 0))->size); }
// void nvnBufferFlushMappedRange(const NVNbuffer *b, ptrdiff_t offset, size_t size): the back end re-reads the range
NVN_API(nvnBufferFlushMappedRange) {
    const buf_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    int64_t off = (int64_t)arg_x(c, 1);
    uint64_t size = arg_x(c, 2);
    if (off < 0 || (uint64_t)off > o->size || size > o->size - (uint64_t)off)
        rt_fatal("nvn: BufferFlushMappedRange %#llx+%#llx outside the buffer (%#llx bytes)", (unsigned long long)off,
                 (unsigned long long)size, (unsigned long long)o->size);
    if (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_PERF) flush_note(1, o->pool, size);
    uint64_t a = buf_address(o);
    if (a && !nvn_gpu_only(a)) nvn_guest_written(a + (uint64_t)off, size);
}

// ---------- Sync and events
// A sync is a fence value: fenced = 1 after QueueFenceSync (the newest submit), 3 after WindowAcquireTexture (fence 0).
// NVNboolean nvnSyncInitialize(NVNsync *s, NVNdevice *d)
NVN_API(nvnSyncInitialize) {
    *(sync_t *)arg_p(c, 0) = (sync_t){SYNC_MAGIC, 0, 0};
    ret_x(c, 1);
}
// void nvnSyncFinalize(NVNsync *s)
NVN_API(nvnSyncFinalize) { ((sync_t *)arg_p(c, 0))->magic = 0; }
// void nvnQueueFenceSync(NVNqueue *q, NVNsync *s, NVNsyncCondition condition, int flags): "every command submitted to
// the queue so far has completed"
NVN_API(nvnQueueFenceSync) {
    sync_t *s = arg_p(c, 1);
    s->fenced = 1;
    s->fence = nvn_fence_last();
}
// NVNboolean nvnQueueWaitSync(NVNqueue *q, const NVNsync *s): GPU queue ordering is already sequential on the host
NVN_API(nvnQueueWaitSync) {
    (void)c;
    ret_x(c, 1);
}
// NVNsyncWaitResult nvnSyncWait(const NVNsync *s, uint64_t timeout_ns): a sync never fenced reports a timeout at once;
// a fenced one is released only after the back end completed that fence value
NVN_API(nvnSyncWait) {
    const sync_t *s = arg_p(c, 0);
    uint64_t timeout = arg_x(c, 1);
    if (!s->fenced) { ret_x(c, NVN_SYNC_WAIT_RESULT_TIMEOUT_EXPIRED); return; }
    const GfxBackend *b = gfx_backend();
    if (b->fence_done() >= s->fence) { b->cpu_synced(s->fence); ret_x(c, NVN_SYNC_WAIT_RESULT_ALREADY_SIGNALED); return; }
    int ok;
    {
        NVN_BLOCKING();
        ok = b->fence_wait(s->fence, timeout);
    }
    if (ok) b->cpu_synced(s->fence);
    ret_x(c, ok ? NVN_SYNC_WAIT_RESULT_CONDITION_SATISFIED : NVN_SYNC_WAIT_RESULT_TIMEOUT_EXPIRED);
}
// void nvnEventBuilderSetDefaults(NVNeventBuilder *b)
NVN_API(nvnEventBuilderSetDefaults) { memset(arg_p(c, 0), 0, sizeof(ev_builder_t)); }
// void nvnEventBuilderSetStorage(NVNeventBuilder *b, const NVNmemoryPool *p, int64_t offset)
NVN_API(nvnEventBuilderSetStorage) { *(ev_builder_t *)arg_p(c, 0) = (ev_builder_t){arg_p(c, 1), (int64_t)arg_x(c, 2)}; }
// NVNboolean nvnEventInitialize(NVNevent *e, const NVNeventBuilder *b): the value lives in pool storage
NVN_API(nvnEventInitialize) {

    }
    *(ev_t *)arg_p(c, 0) = (ev_t){EVENT_MAGIC, (volatile uint32_t *)(s->pool->mem + s->off)};
    ret_x(c, 1);
}

// ---------- Submit latency guard for TotK 1.2.1's per-object uniform double buffer
// NVN starts the GPU when QueueSubmitCommands returns, within microseconds; here the replay into Vulkan takes 15-30 ms
// first, and the GPU reads uniform memory only after it. The game's producer f_70008c6460 (thread 0x103e, p56)
// rewrites the half of its per-object uniform blocks that was front until the last flip, 14-23 ms after the submit
// that still reads it, with no fence: on hardware the GPU has read that half by then. Here the rewrite lands inside
// the replay, and that frame draws other objects' matrices (phantom rocks, flat far field).
// The guard makes the producer wait, at its commit point, until the newest submit has been replayed and completed.
// lod_entered / lod_issued count submits that entered QueueSubmitCommands / reached the back end; lod_fence holds
// the fence of the last LOD_RING. TOTK_LOD_GUARD=0 turns the wait off.
#define LOD_RING 64
static uint64_t lod_entered, lod_issued, lod_fence[LOD_RING];

// void nvnQueueSubmitCommands(NVNqueue *q, int n, const NVNcommandHandle *handles): replayed on this thread with its
// core given up (section 2.2), or queued for the replay thread (TOTK_REPLAY_ASYNC, vk_backend.c); the newest fence
// value is what QueueFenceSync records. With the queue the fence covers replay and GPU, so the LOD guard below waits
// for both.
NVN_API(nvnQueueSubmitCommands) {
    queue_t *q = arg_p(c, 0);
    uint64_t submitted = rt_ticks();
    int n = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    const uint64_t *h = arg_p(c, 2);
    if (n < 0 || (n && !h)) rt_fatal("nvn: QueueSubmitCommands with %d handles at %p", n, (const void *)h);
    NVN_BLOCKING();
    uint64_t no = __atomic_add_fetch(&lod_entered, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    q->submits++;
    uint64_t f;
    if (gfx_replay_async()) {
        // Prepare and queue under one lock: submit numbers follow queue order (gfx_replayed_submits).
        static PlatMutex submit_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
        uint64_t local[32], *hs = n <= 32 ? local : malloc(sizeof *hs * (size_t)n);
        if (!hs) rt_fatal("nvn: out of memory (submit of %d handles)", n);
        plat_mutex_lock(&submit_lock);
        nvn_submit_prepare_async(h, hs, n);
        f = gfx_backend()->submit(hs, n, submitted);
        plat_mutex_unlock(&submit_lock);
        if (hs != local) free(hs);
    } else {
        nvn_submit_prepare(h, n);
        f = gfx_backend()->submit(h, n, submitted);
    }
    uint64_t prev = __atomic_load_n(&last_fence, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    while (f > prev && !__atomic_compare_exchange_n(&last_fence, &prev, f, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) {}
    __atomic_store_n(&lod_fence[no % LOD_RING], f, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&lod_issued, no, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    // TOTK_SUBMIT_WAIT=1 (diagnostic): the GPU finishes each submission before the game continues, as NVN's GPU has
    // consumed the frame's per-object data long before the game rewrites it; tells a CPU/GPU race from a shader bug.
    static int submit_wait = -1;
    if (submit_wait < 0) {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_SUBMIT_WAIT");
        submit_wait = e && *e && *e != '0';
        if (submit_wait) rt_log("nvn: TOTK_SUBMIT_WAIT: every submission waits for the GPU");
    }
    if (submit_wait && gfx_backend()->fence_done() < f) gfx_backend()->fence_wait(f, 2000000000ull);
}

// The producer (1.2.1 main f_70008c6460) releases the read lock on obj+0x538 at lr 0x70008c70c8; when
// [obj+0x529] == [obj+0x528] (x19 = obj) it goes on to rewrite the back half. Waits off the core, at most ~400 ms.
static void obs_release_read(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t lr = c->x[30], obj = c->x[19];
    rt_original(c);
    if (lr != 0x70008c70c8ull) return;
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) {
        on = cfg_bool("TOTK_LOD_GUARD");
    }
    if (!on || *(volatile uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(obj + 0x528) != *(volatile uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(obj + 0x529)) return;
    uint64_t e = __atomic_load_n(&lod_entered, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    if (!e) return;
    NVN_BLOCKING();
    for (int i = 0; i < 200 && __atomic_load_n(&lod_issued, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) < e; i++) plat_sleep_ms(1);
    uint64_t f = __atomic_load_n(&lod_fence[e % LOD_RING], __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (gfx_backend()->fence_done() < f) gfx_backend()->fence_wait(f, 200000000ull);
}
HOST_OBSERVER("_ZN2nn2os15ReleaseReadLockEPNS0_20ReaderWriterLockTypeE", obs_release_read);

```

```c
// ---- Command buffer calls new in NVN 2. Until the Vulkan back end learns them (mesh shaders, ray tracing, DLSS,
// variable-rate shading, conditional enables, device command buffers), they are accepted and
// recorded nowhere, and the first call of each is logged, so a run lists what the back end still has to do. None of
// them returns a value.
#define NVN2_NOT_RECORDED(n)                                                                                         \
    NVN_API(n) {                                                                                                     \
        static volatile int32_t logged;                                                                              \
        (void)c;                                                                                                     \
        if (!__atomic_exchange_n(&logged, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) rt_log("nvn2: " #n " accepted, not recorded yet");   \
    }
// A mode call whose values up to `ok` are handled by doing nothing, with the reason in docs/nvn2-command-modes.md; a
// larger value is logged once with its number, so a scene that needs more than the host gives shows up in the log.
#define NVN2_MODE_HANDLED(n, kind, ok)                                                                                \
    NVN_API(n) {                                                                                                    \
        static volatile int32_t logged;                                                                             \
        uint32_t mode = (uint32_t)arg_x(c, 1);                                                                      \
        nvn_mode_trace(kind, arg_x(c, 0), 0, mode, 0);                                                              \
        if (mode > (ok) && !__atomic_exchange_n(&logged, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED))                                      \
            rt_log("nvn2: " #n " mode %u is not supported (handled: 0..%u); accepted, not recorded", mode, (unsigned)(ok)); \
    }
// Recording mode: 0 and 1 are what the tutorial and cave call. 1 selects the SDK's compute synchronization path,
// which the host's barriers around dispatches and passes already cover. 2 (copy fence) to 4 (packing) are not.
NVN2_MODE_HANDLED(nvnCommandBufferSetRecordingMode, NVN_MODE_RECORDING, 1)
```

```c
// NVN front end, second slice: descriptor pools, textures, samplers, programs,
// windows with present pacing, and the state objects. Ported from MacNativeGames
// games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/hle_nvn.c @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 jhaizhou; origin d2r-mobile),
// lines 254-535, 1775-1829, 2070-2215 and 2579-2727, and nvn_pace.h; Metal, mach, the translation thread, frame
// interpolation and Apple diagnostics dropped. Calls that reached Metal go to gfx_backend() (gfx.h).
//
// Objects are stored in place in the NVN object memory the game provides (nvn_obj.h); every argument is read from the
// AAPCS64 registers (host.h arg_x / arg_s / arg_p) and every result returned with ret_x. Command-buffer procs are in
// nvn_api_cmd.c, the TOTK extension procs in nvn_ext.c.
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "nvn_hmap.h"
#include "nvn_geometry_control.h"
#include "nvn_tex.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

// ---------- Descriptor pools
// NVNboolean nvnTexturePoolInitialize(NVNtexturePool *tp, const NVNmemoryPool *p, ptrdiff_t offset, int n)
NVN_API(nvnTexturePoolInitialize) {
    dpool_t p = {arg_p(c, 1), (int64_t)arg_x(c, 2), (int32_t)arg_x(c, 3)};
    dpool_ref ref;
    int ok = nvn_dpool_snapshot(&p, 1u << 20, &ref);
    *(dpool_t *)arg_p(c, 0) = ok ? p : (dpool_t){0};
    NVN_LOG("TexturePool n=%d", (int)arg_x(c, 3));
    ret_x(c, ok);
}
// void nvnTexturePoolFinalize(NVNtexturePool *tp)
NVN_API(nvnTexturePoolFinalize) { memset(arg_p(c, 0), 0, sizeof(dpool_t)); }
// void nvnTexturePoolRegisterTexture(const NVNtexturePool *tp, int id, const NVNtexture *t, const NVNtextureView *v)
NVN_API(nvnTexturePoolRegisterTexture) {
    dpool_ref pool;
    if (!nvn_dpool_snapshot(arg_p(c, 0), 1u << 20, &pool)) rt_fatal("nvn: invalid texture descriptor pool");
    gfx_backend()->texture_register(&pool, (int)arg_x(c, 1), arg_p(c, 2), arg_p(c, 3));
}
// NVNboolean nvnSamplerPoolInitialize(NVNsamplerPool *sp, const NVNmemoryPool *p, ptrdiff_t offset, int n)
NVN_API(nvnSamplerPoolInitialize) {
    dpool_t p = {arg_p(c, 1), (int64_t)arg_x(c, 2), (int32_t)arg_x(c, 3)};
    dpool_ref ref;
    int ok = nvn_dpool_snapshot(&p, 1u << 12, &ref);
    *(dpool_t *)arg_p(c, 0) = ok ? p : (dpool_t){0};
    NVN_LOG("SamplerPool n=%d", (int)arg_x(c, 3));
    ret_x(c, ok);
}
// void nvnSamplerPoolFinalize(NVNsamplerPool *sp)
NVN_API(nvnSamplerPoolFinalize) { memset(arg_p(c, 0), 0, sizeof(dpool_t)); }
// void nvnSamplerPoolRegisterSampler(const NVNsamplerPool *sp, int id, const NVNsampler *s)
NVN_API(nvnSamplerPoolRegisterSampler) {
    dpool_ref pool;
    if (!nvn_dpool_snapshot(arg_p(c, 0), 1u << 12, &pool)) rt_fatal("nvn: invalid sampler descriptor pool");
    gfx_backend()->sampler_register(&pool, (int)arg_x(c, 1), &((const samp_t *)arg_p(c, 2))->p);
}

// data, copied into the texture's pool storage at Initialize

// Storage classes are opaque compatibility identifiers: all texture storage lives in byte-addressed pools and is decoded
// per texture description, so class 1 names that convention; buffer textures use class 0. Not a Tegra memory kind.
static uint64_t storage_class(const nvn_texdesc *d) { return d->target == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_BUFFER ? 0 : 1; }
NVN_API(nvnTextureBuilderGetStorageClass) { ret_x(c, storage_class(&TB(c)->d)); }

    nvn_tex_layout(&TB(c)->d, &L);
    if (!L.bpb) rt_log("nvn: TextureBuilderGetStorageSize: unknown format %#x", TB(c)->d.format);
    ret_x(c, L.size);
}
// size_t nvnTextureBuilderGetStorageAlignment(const NVNtextureBuilder *b)
NVN_API(nvnTextureBuilderGetStorageAlignment) {
    nvn_texlayout L;
    nvn_tex_layout(&TB(c)->d, &L);
    ret_x(c, L.align);
}

// ---------- Textures
// The game re-initializes transient textures (G-buffer and the like) every frame at the same pool memory without
// registering the descriptor again, as an NVN descriptor refers to memory and stays valid on hardware. The table maps
// storage address -> a copy of the live texture so the back end can redirect a registration whose serial was finalized.
static nvn_hmap live = {.klen = 8};
static PlatMutex live_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;

static void live_put(const tex_t *o) {
    if (!o->mem) return;
    uint64_t k = (uintptr_t)o->mem;
    tex_t *copy = malloc(sizeof *copy);
    if (!copy) rt_fatal("nvn: out of memory for the live texture table");
    *copy = *o;
    plat_mutex_lock(&live_lock);
    tex_t *old = nvn_hm_put(&live, &k, copy);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&live_lock);
    free(old);
}

static void live_del(const tex_t *o) {
    if (!o->mem) return;
    uint64_t k = (uintptr_t)o->mem;
    plat_mutex_lock(&live_lock);
    tex_t *cur = nvn_hm_get(&live, &k);
    if (cur && cur->serial == o->serial) nvn_hm_del(&live, &k);
    else cur = NULL;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&live_lock);
    free(cur);
}

int nvn_tex_live_at(const void *mem, tex_t *out) {
    if (!mem) return 0;
    uint64_t k = (uintptr_t)mem;
    plat_mutex_lock_shared(&live_lock);
    const tex_t *cur = nvn_hm_get(&live, &k);
    if (cur) *out = *cur;
    plat_mutex_unlock_shared(&live_lock);
    return cur != NULL;
}

// Releases the back end's texture and the live entry of an initialized texture object.
static void tex_release(tex_t *o) {
    live_del(o);
    gfx_backend()->texture_release(o);
}

// NVNboolean nvnTextureInitialize(NVNtexture *t, const NVNtextureBuilder *b)
NVN_API(nvnTextureInitialize) {
    tex_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    const tex_builder_t *s = arg_p(c, 1);
    if (o->magic == NVN_TEX_MAGIC && o->serial) {   // initialized again without Finalize: release the old serial
        NVN_LOG("texture %p initialized again without Finalize (serial %llu released)", (void *)o,
                (unsigned long long)o->serial);
        tex_release(o);
    }
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    o->magic = NVN_TEX_MAGIC;
    o->d = s->d;
    o->pool = s->pool;
    o->off = s->off;
    o->has_layout = s->has_layout;
    memcpy(o->layout, s->layout, 8);
    nvn_tex_layout(&o->d, &o->L);
    o->mem = s->pool && s->pool->mem ? s->pool->mem + s->off : NULL;
    if (s->pkg_data) {
        if (!o->mem || nvn_gpu_only((uintptr_t)o->mem))
            rt_fatal("nvn: packaged texture data without CPU-visible storage");
        memcpy(o->mem, s->pkg_data, (size_t)o->L.size);
        nvn_guest_written((uintptr_t)o->mem, o->L.size);
    }
    o->serial = nvn_new_serial();
    live_put(o);
    NVN_LOG("Texture %p %ux%ux%u lv%u fmt=%#x tgt=%d flags=%#x size=%#llx", (void *)o, o->d.width, o->d.height,
            o->d.depth, o->d.levels, o->d.format, o->d.target, o->d.flags, (unsigned long long)o->L.size);
    ret_x(c, 1);
}
// void nvnTextureFinalize(NVNtexture *t)
NVN_API(nvnTextureFinalize) {
    tex_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (o->magic == NVN_TEX_MAGIC && o->serial) tex_release(o);
    o->magic = 0;
}
#define CTX(c) ((const tex_t *)arg_p(c, 0))
NVN_API(nvnTextureGetStorageClass) { ret_x(c, storage_class(&CTX(c)->d)); }
NVN_API(nvnTextureGetFlags) { ret_x(c, (uint32_t)CTX(c)->d.flags); }
NVN_API(nvnTextureGetWidth) { ret_x(c, CTX(c)->d.width); }
NVN_API(nvnTextureGetHeight) { ret_x(c, CTX(c)->d.height); }
NVN_API(nvnTextureGetDepth) { ret_x(c, CTX(c)->d.depth); }
NVN_API(nvnTextureGetStorageSize) { ret_x(c, (uint32_t)(int)CTX(c)->L.size); }
// NVNboolean nvnTextureCompare(const NVNtexture *a, const NVNtexture *b)
NVN_API(nvnTextureCompare) {
    const tex_t *x = arg_p(c, 0), *y = arg_p(c, 1);
    ret_x(c, !memcmp(&x->d, &y->d, sizeof x->d) && x->mem == y->mem);
}
// int nvnTextureGetRawStorageClass(const NVNtexture *t): no prototype in nvn.h. Call sites compare the result with 1
// and set a status bit when it differs; the meaning is unverified, so 1.
NVN_API(nvnTextureGetRawStorageClass) { ret_x(c, 1); }

uint64_t nvn_tex_view_offset(const tex_t *t, const view_t *v) {
    if (!v) return 0;
    uint64_t off = v->set_levels ? nvn_tex_level_offset(&t->d, v->base_level) : 0;
    if (v->set_layers) off += (uint64_t)v->min_layer * t->L.layer_size;
    return off;
}

NVN_API(nvnTextureGetViewOffset) { ret_x(c, nvn_tex_view_offset(arg_p(c, 0), arg_p(c, 1))); }

// ---------- Texel access: the back end decodes the view's level and layer
// row / img: 0 means tightly packed
static void texel_strides(const tex_t *o, const NVNcopyRegion *r, uint64_t *row, uint64_t *img, const char *what) {
    int bw, bh, bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(o->d.format, &bw, &bh);
    if (!bpb) rt_fatal("nvn: %s: unknown format %#x", what, o->d.format);
    uint64_t wb = (uint64_t)(((uint32_t)r->width + bw - 1) / bw) * bpb, hb = ((uint32_t)r->height + bh - 1) / bh;
    if (!*row) *row = wb;
    if (!*img) *img = *row * hb;
    if (*row < wb || *img < *row * hb) rt_fatal("nvn: %s: stride smaller than the region", what);
}
// void nvnTextureReadTexels[Strided](const NVNtexture *t, const NVNtextureView *v, const NVNcopyRegion *r, void *dst
// [, ptrdiff_t row, ptrdiff_t img])
static void read_texels(Cpu *c, int strided) {
    const tex_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    const NVNcopyRegion *r = arg_p(c, 2);
    uint64_t row = strided ? arg_x(c, 4) : 0, img = strided ? arg_x(c, 5) : 0;
    texel_strides(o, r, &row, &img, "ReadTexels");
    NVN_BLOCKING();
    gfx_backend()->read_texels(o, arg_p(c, 1), r, arg_p(c, 3), row, img);
}
// void nvnTextureWriteTexels[Strided](const NVNtexture *t, const NVNtextureView *v, const NVNcopyRegion *r, const void
// *src[, ptrdiff_t row, ptrdiff_t img])
static void write_texels(Cpu *c, int strided) {
    const tex_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    const view_t *v = arg_p(c, 1);
    const NVNcopyRegion *r = arg_p(c, 2);
    uint64_t row = strided ? arg_x(c, 4) : 0, img = strided ? arg_x(c, 5) : 0;
    texel_strides(o, r, &row, &img, "WriteTexels");
    if (v && v->set_format && v->format != o->d.format) rt_fatal("nvn: WriteTexels: format-reinterpreting view not supported");
    NVN_BLOCKING();
    gfx_backend()->write_texels(o, v, r, arg_p(c, 3), row, img);
}
NVN_API(nvnTextureReadTexels) { read_texels(c, 0); }
NVN_API(nvnTextureReadTexelsStrided) { read_texels(c, 1); }
NVN_API(nvnTextureWriteTexels) { write_texels(c, 0); }
NVN_API(nvnTextureWriteTexelsStrided) { write_texels(c, 1); }
// void nvnTexture{Flush,Invalidate}Texels(const NVNtexture *t, const NVNtextureView *v, const NVNcopyRegion *r): texel
// access is coherent
NVN_API(nvnTextureFlushTexels) { (void)c; }
NVN_API(nvnTextureInvalidateTexels) { (void)c; }

// ---------- Programs
// NVNboolean nvnProgramInitialize(NVNprogram *p, NVNdevice *d)
NVN_API(nvnProgramInitialize) {
    prog_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    o->magic = NVN_PROG_MAGIC;

static void prog_release(prog_t *o) {
    if (o->serial) gfx_backend()->program_release(o);
    o->serial = 0;
    free(o->owned_control);
    o->owned_control = NULL;
}
// void nvnProgramFinalize(NVNprogram *p)
NVN_API(nvnProgramFinalize) {
    prog_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    prog_release(o);
    o->magic = 0;
}
static int prog_set_shaders(prog_t *o, int n, const NVNshaderData *sd) {
    if (n < 0 || n > 6 || (n && !sd)) {
        rt_log("nvn: ProgramSetShaders with %d stages at %p", n, (const void *)sd);
        return 0;
    }
    NVNshaderData next[6] = {0};
    uint8_t *owned = NULL;
    if (n) memcpy(next, sd, (size_t)n * sizeof *sd);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {   // NVN 2 stages are lowered to the NVN 1 shape (nvn2_lower.cpp)
        const uint8_t *ctl = next[i].control, *code = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)next[i].data, *nctl, *ncode;
        gfx_shader_nvn2_dump(ctl, code);   // only with MKW_SHADER_DUMP
        // NVN2 task (6) / mesh (7): keep the raw control+code for Eden mesh SPIR-V (eden_mesh.c). Map the
        // host stage to tessellation slots 3/4 (nxnative st_host) and tag the owned control with DKMESH.
        if (gfx_shader_is_nvn2(ctl) && ctl[0x56] >= 6 && ctl[0x56] <= 7) {
            // +0x704 must cover code and the trailing c1 block (end at +0x44), same as nvn2_sizes:
            // Eden's mesh translate reads constants from [c1_off, area_end).
            uint32_t code_len = 0, c1_end = 0, host_stage = ctl[0x56] == 6 ? 3u : 4u;
            memcpy(&code_len, ctl + 0x38, 4);
            memcpy(&c1_end, ctl + 0x44, 4);
            if (c1_end > code_len && c1_end - code_len <= 0x10000u) code_len = c1_end;
            if (!owned && !(owned = malloc((size_t)n * 0x880))) goto fail;
            uint8_t *slot = owned + (size_t)i * 0x880;
            memset(slot, 0, 0x880);
            memcpy(slot, ctl, 0xd8 < 0x880 ? 0xd8 : 0x880);
            memset(slot + 0x700, 0, 4);
            memcpy(slot + 0x704, &code_len, 4);
            memcpy(slot + 0x714, &host_stage, 4);
            memcpy(slot + 0x870, "DKMESH", 6);
            next[i].control = slot;
            continue;
        }
        if (gfx_shader_is_nvn2(ctl) && nvn2_lower(ctl, code, &nctl, &ncode))
            next[i] = (NVNshaderData){(NVNbufferAddress)(uintptr_t)ncode, nctl};
        ctl = next[i].control;
        code = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)next[i].data;
        // Raw NVN2 controls have a different compact layout. Only the host's
        // explicitly tagged legacy-shaped controls are copied here.
        if (!ctl || !code || gfx_shader_is_nvn2(ctl) ||
            memcmp(ctl + NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_OFFSET, "TKGSMETA", 8)) continue;
        uint32_t length = nvn_geometry_control_u32(ctl + 0x704);
        if (nvn_geometry_control_get(ctl, 0x880, code, length, NULL) != 1) goto fail;
        if (!owned && !(owned = malloc((size_t)n * 0x880))) goto fail;
        memcpy(owned + (size_t)i * 0x880, ctl, 0x880);
        next[i].control = owned + (size_t)i * 0x880;
    }
    // Prepare first: sd may alias the old stage list or its owned controls.
    // The back end drains replay before the old snapshot is freed.
    prog_release(o);
    o->nstage = (uint32_t)n;
    memcpy(o->sd, next, sizeof next);
    o->owned_control = owned;
    o->serial = nvn_new_serial();
    NVN_LOG("ProgramSetShaders %p n=%d data0=%#llx", (void *)o, n, n ? (unsigned long long)next[0].data : 0ull);
    // Mesh programs: Hookshot keeps a header-only stage (code len ≤ SPH+16) as the per-primitive
    // output map. Log once when a mesh/task set arrives so we can see if MKW ever passes it.
    {
        int has_mesh = 0, header_only = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const uint8_t *ctl = next[i].control;
            if (!ctl) continue;
            uint16_t st = 0;
            uint32_t len = 0;
            memcpy(&st, ctl + 0x56, 2);
            memcpy(&len, ctl + 0x38, 4);
            if (st == 6 || st == 7) has_mesh = 1;
            // SPH is 0x50. Header-only ≤ 0x50+16 including len==0 (Hookshot parse_code; MKW foliage).
            if (st <= 4 && len <= 0x50 + 16) header_only = 1;
        }
        if (has_mesh) {
            static int mesh_prog_log;
            if (mesh_prog_log < 8) {
                char inv[192];
                size_t pos = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < n && pos + 28 < sizeof inv; i++) {
                    const uint8_t *ctl = next[i].control;
                    uint16_t st = 0;
                    uint32_t len = 0;
                    if (ctl) {
                        memcpy(&st, ctl + 0x56, 2);
                        memcpy(&len, ctl + 0x38, 4);
                    }
                    pos += (size_t)snprintf(inv + pos, sizeof inv - pos, "%s%d:t%u/l%u", pos ? " " : "", i, st, len);
                }
                rt_log("nvn: mesh ProgramSetShaders n=%d header_only=%d [%s]", n, header_only, inv);
                mesh_prog_log++;
            }
        }
    }
    return 1;
fail:
    free(owned);
    return 0;
}
// NVNboolean nvnProgramSetShaders(NVNprogram *p, int n, const NVNshaderData *sd)
NVN_API(nvnProgramSetShaders) {
    NVN_BLOCKING();
    ret_x(c, prog_set_shaders(arg_p(c, 0), (int)arg_x(c, 1), arg_p(c, 2)));
}
// ---- NVN 2 program builder (the NVN 2 reference title). The game zeroes a 0x80-byte NVNprogramBuilder on the stack, calls
// SetDefaults, SetDevice and SetShaders(b, n, NVNshaderData[n]) and then nvnProgramInitializeFromBuilder(program, b)
// (main+0x88be28 sub_710088BDCC; programs 0xa0 apart). The builder keeps its own copy of the stage list, so the
// initialize step is NVN 1's Initialize + SetShaders.
#define NVN_PROG_BUILDER_MAGIC 0x50424e32u   // "2NBP"
typedef struct { uint32_t magic, nstage; void *dev; NVNshaderData sd[6]; } prog_builder_t;
_Static_assert(sizeof(prog_builder_t) <= 0x80, "NVNprogramBuilder is 0x80 bytes in the NVN 2 reference title");
static prog_builder_t *prog_builder(Cpu *c, const char *fn) {
    prog_builder_t *b = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (!b) rt_fatal("nvn: %s: null program builder", fn);
    return b;
}
// void nvnProgramBuilderSetDefaults(NVNprogramBuilder *b)
NVN_API(nvnProgramBuilderSetDefaults) {
    prog_builder_t *b = prog_builder(c, "ProgramBuilderSetDefaults");
    void *dev = b->magic == NVN_PROG_BUILDER_MAGIC ? b->dev : NULL;   // like the other builders, keep the device
    memset(b, 0, sizeof *b);
    b->magic = NVN_PROG_BUILDER_MAGIC;
    b->dev = dev;
}
// void nvnProgramBuilderSetDevice(NVNprogramBuilder *b, NVNdevice *d), NVNdevice *...GetDevice(const ... *b)
NVN_API(nvnProgramBuilderSetDevice) { prog_builder(c, "ProgramBuilderSetDevice")->dev = arg_p(c, 1); }
NVN_API(nvnProgramBuilderGetDevice) { ret_x(c, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)prog_builder(c, "ProgramBuilderGetDevice")->dev); }
// void nvnProgramBuilderSetShaders(NVNprogramBuilder *b, int n, const NVNshaderData *sd)
NVN_API(nvnProgramBuilderSetShaders) {
    prog_builder_t *b = prog_builder(c, "ProgramBuilderSetShaders");
    int n = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    const NVNshaderData *sd = arg_p(c, 2);
    if (n < 0 || n > 6 || (n && !sd)) rt_fatal("nvn: ProgramBuilderSetShaders with %d stages at %p", n, (const void *)sd);
    b->nstage = (uint32_t)n;
    if (n) memcpy(b->sd, sd, (size_t)n * sizeof *sd);
}
// int nvnProgramBuilderGetShaderCount(const NVNprogramBuilder *b)
NVN_API(nvnProgramBuilderGetShaderCount) { ret_x(c, prog_builder(c, "ProgramBuilderGetShaderCount")->nstage); }
// Per-sample shading, debug data hashes, subroutine linkage and ray-tracing modules: the Vulkan path has no use for
// them yet; each is logged so a game that depends on one shows up in a gfx trace.
NVN_API(nvnProgramBuilderSetSampleShading) { NVN_LOG("ProgramBuilderSetSampleShading %d", (int)arg_x(c, 1)); }
NVN_API(nvnProgramBuilderSetDebugDataHashes) { (void)c; }
NVN_API(nvnProgramBuilderSetSubroutineLinkage) { NVN_LOG("ProgramBuilderSetSubroutineLinkage %p", arg_p(c, 1)); }
NVN_API(nvnProgramBuilderSetRayTracingModules) { NVN_LOG("ProgramBuilderSetRayTracingModules %p", arg_p(c, 1)); }
// NVNboolean nvnProgramInitializeFromBuilder(NVNprogram *p, const NVNprogramBuilder *b)
NVN_API(nvnProgramInitializeFromBuilder) {
    NVN_BLOCKING();
    prog_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    const prog_builder_t *b = arg_p(c, 1);
    if (!o || !b || b->magic != NVN_PROG_BUILDER_MAGIC) rt_fatal("nvn: ProgramInitializeFromBuilder(%p, %p)", (void *)o, (const void *)b);
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    o->magic = NVN_PROG_MAGIC;
    ret_x(c, prog_set_shaders(o, (int)b->nstage, b->sd));
}

// NVNboolean nvnProgramSetShadersExt(NVNprogram *p, int n, const NVNshaderDataExt *sd): no prototype in nvn.h; the
// entries are {data, control, reserved} (0x18 bytes, reserved observed 0)
typedef struct { NVNbufferAddress data; const void *control; uint64_t reserved; } shader_data_ext;
_Static_assert(sizeof(shader_data_ext) == 0x18, "NVNshaderDataExt stride");
NVN_API(nvnProgramSetShadersExt) {
    NVN_BLOCKING();
    prog_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    int n = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    const shader_data_ext *sd = arg_p(c, 2);
    if (n < 0 || n > 6 || (n && !sd)) {
        rt_log("nvn: ProgramSetShadersExt with %d stages at %p", n, (const void *)sd);
        ret_x(c, 0);
        return;
    }
    NVNshaderData plain[6];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (sd[i].reserved)
            rt_fatal("nvn: ProgramSetShadersExt: unknown non-zero field %#llx in stage %d", (unsigned long long)sd[i].reserved, i);
        plain[i] = (NVNshaderData){sd[i].data, sd[i].control};
    }
    ret_x(c, prog_set_shaders(o, n, plain));
}

    const tex_t *t0 = (const tex_t *)o->tex[0];
    NVN_LOG("WindowInitialize %d textures, interval %d, first %ux%u format %#x", o->ntex, o->interval,
            t0 ? t0->d.width : 0, t0 ? t0->d.height : 0, t0 ? t0->d.format : 0);
    ret_x(c, 1);
}

// ---------- Present pacing
// The vsync thread ticks at a fixed 60 Hz whatever the monitor does, so one game frame lasts `interval` ticks. With
// the real-time frame step (frame_rate.c) game speed does not depend on the interval, so a frame is shown when it is
// ready, at most at the frame limit (TOTK_FPS_LIMIT: 30 to 360 per second or the monitor's rate): holding it to the
// 2nd or 3rd tick would only add latency and 50 ms frames.
#define VSYNC_HZ 60ull
static uint64_t present_period(const win_t *o) {
    if (frame_step_realtime()) return frame_step_cap_ns();
    return (o->interval > 0 ? (uint64_t)o->interval : 1ull) * 1000000000ull / VSYNC_HZ;
}

// MacNativeGames nvn_pace.h: the present slot is the previous slot plus one period. Early: wait for the slot. Late by
// less than a period: present at once and keep the phase. Behind by a period or more: restart from now, no catch-up
// burst. Returns the ns to wait.
static uint64_t pace(uint64_t *target, uint64_t now, uint64_t period) {
    if (!period || !*target) { *target = now; return 0; }
    uint64_t next = *target + period;
    if (now <= next) { *target = next; return next - now; }
    *target = now - next < period ? next : now;
    return 0;
}

static void sleep_until(uint64_t deadline) {
    for (;;) {
        uint64_t now = kern_now_ns();
        if (now >= deadline) return;
        uint64_t d = deadline - now;
        if (d >= 2000000) plat_sleep_ms((uint32_t)(d / 1000000 - 1));
        else plat_yield();
    }
}

// NVNwindowAcquireTextureResult nvnWindowAcquireTexture(NVNwindow *w, NVNsync *s, int *index): blocks here, not in the
// present, until the image's previous present plus one period has passed (the game often presents with a lock held).
// That is the time the next frame goes to the display, so the image is free as soon as that time is reached.
NVN_API(nvnWindowAcquireTexture) {
    win_t *o = arg_p(c, 0);
    sync_t *s = arg_p(c, 1);
    int *out = arg_p(c, 2);
    NVN_BLOCKING();
    int idx = o->active ? o->next++ % o->active : 0;
    *out = idx;
    uint64_t at = idx < 4 ? o->avail[idx] : 0;
    if (at) {
        uint64_t p0 = perf_begin();
        sleep_until(at);
        perf_end(PERF_PACE, p0);
    }
    // The sync means "the display no longer reads this image". Presents are copies queued in submit order, so it is
    // already satisfied: fenced = 3 with fence 0.
    if (s) {
        s->fenced = 3;
        s->fence = 0;
    }
    ret_x(c, NVN_WINDOW_ACQUIRE_TEXTURE_RESULT_SUCCESS);
}

// void nvnQueuePresentTexture(NVNqueue *q, NVNwindow *w, int index): queues the copy and returns at once. The display
// time comes from the pacer: the back end's present thread holds the host present until then (back-edge pacing, as the
// Switch's display flips at vblank), so the present cadence does not follow the replay time; one period later the
// image is free for the next acquire. Added latency: the slack of the frame (period minus its work), as on the Switch.
NVN_API(nvnQueuePresentTexture) {
    win_t *o = arg_p(c, 1);
    int idx = (int)arg_x(c, 2);
    movie_tick(c);   // ov_movie.c: hand over decoded movie frames that are due; needs the core, so before the wait
    NVN_BLOCKING();
    if (o->magic != NVN_WIN_MAGIC || idx < 0 || idx >= o->ntex || idx >= 4 || !o->tex[idx])
        rt_fatal("nvn: QueuePresentTexture of image %d on window %p", idx, (void *)o);
    o->presents++;
    const tex_t *t = (const tex_t *)o->tex[idx];
    uint64_t period = present_period(o), now = kern_now_ns();
    uint64_t slot = now + pace(&o->pace, now, period);
    // MKW (Switch 2) often presents a 3840×2160 window texture while the 3D pass only filled the
    // top-left ~1704×960 (dynamic res). With crop left at {0,0,0,0} the blit scaled the whole
    // mostly-black buffer and --shot had to hard-crop. Prefer the window crop when set; else, for
    // a 4K present texture, crop to the largest recent colour RT under 1920×1080 when known, else
    // 1704×960 (observed title DRS).
    int crop[4] = {o->crop[0], o->crop[1], o->crop[2], o->crop[3]};
    if ((!crop[2] || !crop[3]) && t && t->d.width == 3840 && t->d.height == 2160) {
        crop[0] = 0;
        crop[1] = 0;
        crop[2] = 1704;
        crop[3] = 960;
        static int crop_log;
        if (crop_log++ < 4)
            rt_log("nvn: present 3840x2160 with empty crop → default %dx%d (MKW DRS)", crop[2], crop[3]);
    }
    gfx_backend()->present(t, crop, slot);
    o->ticket[idx] = o->presents;
    o->avail[idx] = slot + period;
    frame_step_present(slot, o->interval);   // frame_rate.c: the real-time step follows the display times
    rt_frame_presented(t, o->presents);
}

```

`runtime/nvn_ext.c`:

```c
// NVN entry points beyond the core implementation that only report stored object state, attach debugging metadata,
// convert timestamps or take hardware hints. None of them changes rendering
// results. Ported from MacNativeGames games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/totk_nvn_ext.c @ b75be8cf (MIT,
// Copyright (c) 2026 jhaizhou; origin d2r-mobile); mach timing and Metal wording dropped. Its *Deferred binds and
// memory-callback switches live with the command buffer in nvn_api_cmd.c.
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "nvn_tex.h"

// The CPU is about to read what the GPU wrote into pool storage: the back end writes its host-side copies (the Vulkan
// back end's images) back first. TotK invalidates its 260x260 R16 grass maps and 1x1 pick targets this way. A
// CPU-invisible pool has no storage to read.
void nvn_pool_invalidate(const pool_t *p, uint64_t off, uint64_t size) {
    if (!p->mem || nvn_gpu_only((uintptr_t)p->mem) || off >= p->size || !size) return;
    if (size > p->size - off) size = p->size - off;
    gfx_backend()->guest_read((uintptr_t)p->mem + off, size);
}

__attribute__((weak)) void nvn_pool_flushed(const pool_t *p, uint64_t off, uint64_t size) { (void)p, (void)off, (void)size; }

// Ampere / NVN sparse packaged tiles fill one 64 KiB page of compressed blocks
// (nxnative nvn_tex_sparse_tiles). ASTC is always 16 bytes/block.
static void fill_sparse_tile_layout(NVNtextureSparseTileLayout *layout, int target, int format, int levels) {
    if (!layout) return;
    int bw = 1, bh = 1, bpb = 4;
    if (format >= 0x79 && format <= 0x94) {
        static const uint8_t abw[14] = {4, 5, 5, 6, 6, 8, 8, 8, 10, 10, 10, 10, 12, 12};
        static const uint8_t abh[14] = {4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 5, 6, 8, 5, 6, 8, 10, 10, 12};
        int k = (format - 0x79) % 14;
        bw = abw[k];
        bh = abh[k];
        bpb = 16;
    } else {
        switch (format) {
            case 1: case 2: case 3: case 4: case 0x31: case 0x51: case 0x52:
                bpb = 1; break;
            case 5: case 6: case 7: case 8: case 9: case 0xd: case 0xe: case 0xf: case 0x10:
            case 0x32: case 0x39: case 0x3a: case 0x3b: case 0x3c: case 0x53: case 0x54: case 0x57: case 0x58:
            case 0x95: case 0x96: case 0x97: case 0x98:
                bpb = 2; break;
            case 0x16: case 0x17: case 0x18: case 0x29: case 0x2a: case 0x2b: case 0x2c: case 0x2d:
            case 0x36: case 0x5b: case 0x5c: case 0x71: case 0x72: case 0x73: case 0x74: case 0x75:
                bpb = 8; break;
            case 0x2e: case 0x2f: case 0x30: case 0x67: case 0x68: case 0x76: case 0x77: case 0x78:
                bpb = 16; break;
            default:
                bpb = 4; break;
        }
    }
    layout->numLevels = levels > 0 ? levels : 1;
    layout->tileDepth = 1;
    if (format >= 0x79 && format <= 0x94) {
        // One 64 KiB page of ASTC blocks, square on the block grid (ASTC 8x8 → 512×512 texels).
        int blocks = 65536 / bpb, side = 1;
        while ((side + 1) * (side + 1) <= blocks) side++;
        layout->tileWidth = side * bw;
        layout->tileHeight = side * bh;
    } else if (target == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_3D) {
        layout->tileWidth = 32;
        layout->tileHeight = 32;
        layout->tileDepth = 65536 / (32 * 32 * bpb);
        if (layout->tileDepth < 1) layout->tileDepth = 1;
    } else if (bpb <= 1) {
        layout->tileWidth = 256;
        layout->tileHeight = 256;
    } else if (bpb == 2) {
        layout->tileWidth = 256;
        layout->tileHeight = 128;
    } else if (bpb == 4) {
        layout->tileWidth = 128;
        layout->tileHeight = 128;
    } else if (bpb == 8) {
        layout->tileWidth = 128;
        layout->tileHeight = 64;
    } else {
        layout->tileWidth = 64;
        layout->tileHeight = 64;
    }
}
// void nvnTextureBuilderGetSparseTileLayout(const NVNtextureBuilder *b, NVNtextureSparseTileLayout *layout)
NVN_API(nvnTextureBuilderGetSparseTileLayout) {
    const tex_builder_t *b = tb_of(c);
    NVNtextureSparseTileLayout *layout = arg_p(c, 1);
    int target = b ? b->d.target : NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D;
    int format = b ? b->d.format : 0;
    int levels = b ? b->d.levels : 1;
    fill_sparse_tile_layout(layout, target, format, levels);
    NVN_LOG("nvnTextureBuilderGetSparseTileLayout(b=%p, out=%p, levels=%d)", b, layout, layout ? layout->numLevels : 0);
}
// void nvnTextureGetSparseTileLayout(const NVNtexture *t, NVNtextureSparseTileLayout *layout)
NVN_API(nvnTextureGetSparseTileLayout) {
    const tex_t *t = tex_of(c);
    NVNtextureSparseTileLayout *layout = arg_p(c, 1);
    int target = t ? t->d.target : NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D;
    int format = t ? t->d.format : 0;
    int levels = t ? t->d.levels : 1;
    fill_sparse_tile_layout(layout, target, format, levels);
    NVN_LOG("nvnTextureGetSparseTileLayout(tex=%p, out=%p, levels=%d)", t, layout, layout ? layout->numLevels : 0);
}

NVN_API(nvnTextureViewCompare) {
    const view_t *x = view_of(c, 0), *y = view_of(c, 1);
    int same = x->set_levels == y->set_levels && x->set_layers == y->set_layers && x->set_format == y->set_format &&
               x->set_target == y->set_target && x->set_swizzle == y->set_swizzle && x->set_dsmode == y->set_dsmode;
    if (same && x->set_levels) same = x->base_level == y->base_level && x->nlevels == y->nlevels;
    if (same && x->set_layers) same = x->min_layer == y->min_layer && x->nlayers == y->nlayers;
    if (same && x->set_format) same = x->format == y->format;
    if (same && x->set_target) same = x->target == y->target;
    if (same && x->set_swizzle) same = !memcmp(x->swz, y->swz, 4);
    if (same && x->set_dsmode) same = x->dsmode == y->dsmode;
    ret_x(c, same);
}
```
