`runtime/nvn_geometry_control.h`:

```h
// Original host-only metadata for portable Maxwell passthrough GS. This is not
// an NVN1 SDK control layout. The complete control enters shader identity/storage.
#ifndef NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_H
#define NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#define NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_OFFSET 0x800u
#define NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_SIZE 0x40u
#define NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_PORTABLE 1u
#define NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_NATIVE 2u
// Portable metadata made by the host for a lowered native stage (vk_exec_draw.c, native_gs_control). Its body may read
// or declare more locations than it forwards; nothing else may (gfx_shader.c, reflect).
#define NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_LOWERED 3u

static inline uint32_t nvn_geometry_control_u32(const uint8_t *p) {
    return (uint32_t)p[0] | (uint32_t)p[1] << 8 | (uint32_t)p[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[3] << 24;
}
static inline void nvn_geometry_control_put(uint8_t *p, uint32_t n) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) p[i] = (uint8_t)(n >> (8 * i));
}

// Position's four components and whole user Locations only; a set bit means skip.
static inline int nvn_geometry_control_mask_valid(const uint32_t skip[8]) {
    if (!skip || skip[0] != 0x0fffffffu) return 0;
    for (unsigned i = 1; i <= 4; i++) for (unsigned bit = 0; bit < 32; bit += 4) {
        unsigned nibble = skip[i] >> bit & 15;
        if (nibble && nibble != 15) return 0;
    }
    return skip[5] == UINT32_MAX && skip[6] == UINT32_MAX && skip[7] == UINT32_MAX;
}

// Full legacy-shaped code, including its 0x30-byte prefix, never an SPH-only slice.
static inline int nvn_geometry_control_context(const uint8_t *control, size_t control_size,
                                                const uint8_t *code, uint64_t code_size) {
    if (!control || control_size < 0x880 || !code) return 0;
    if (nvn_geometry_control_u32(control) == 0x98761234u &&
        nvn_geometry_control_u32(control + 4) == 0xc9u) return 0;
    uint32_t length = nvn_geometry_control_u32(control + 0x704);
    uint32_t c1 = nvn_geometry_control_u32(control + 0x700);
    if (nvn_geometry_control_u32(control + 0x714) != 2 || length > code_size ||
        c1 > length || c1 < 0x90 || (c1 - 0x30) % 8 || (length - 0x30) % 8 ||
        !memcmp(control + 0x860, "DKC0", 4) || !memcmp(control + 0x860, "DKC1", 4)) return 0;
    uint32_t w0 = nvn_geometry_control_u32(code + 0x30);
    return (w0 & 31) == 1 && (w0 >> 5 & 31) == 3 && (w0 >> 10 & 15) == 4 && (w0 & (1u << 24)) &&
           (nvn_geometry_control_u32(code + 0x38) >> 24) == 1 &&
           (nvn_geometry_control_u32(code + 0x3c) >> 24 & 15) == 7 &&
           (nvn_geometry_control_u32(code + 0x40) & 0xfff) == 1;
}

// 1: canonical portable metadata; 0: absent; -1: malformed or native metadata.
// No native address/context contract is admitted. Output is cleared on failure.
static inline int nvn_geometry_control_get(const uint8_t *control, size_t control_size,
                                            const uint8_t *code, uint64_t code_size, uint32_t skip[8]) {
    static const char magic[8] = {'T','K','G','S','M','E','T','A'};
    if (skip) memset(skip, 0, 32);
    if (!control || control_size < 0x880) return -1;
    if (nvn_geometry_control_u32(control) == 0x98761234u &&
        nvn_geometry_control_u32(control + 4) == 0xc9u) return -1;
    const uint8_t *p = control + NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_OFFSET;
    if (memcmp(p, magic, sizeof magic)) return 0;
    if (nvn_geometry_control_u32(p + 8) != 1 || nvn_geometry_control_u32(p + 12) != NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_SIZE ||
        (nvn_geometry_control_u32(p + 16) != NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_PORTABLE &&
         nvn_geometry_control_u32(p + 16) != NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_LOWERED) ||
        nvn_geometry_control_u32(p + 20) != 1 || !nvn_geometry_control_context(control, control_size, code, code_size)) return -1;
    for (unsigned i = 56; i < 64; i++) if (p[i]) return -1;
    uint32_t words[8];
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; i++) words[i] = nvn_geometry_control_u32(p + 24 + i * 4);
    if (!nvn_geometry_control_mask_valid(words)) return -1;
    if (skip) memcpy(skip, words, sizeof words);
    return 1;
}

// Only an already-owned synthetic control may be changed. A nonempty unrecognized
// region is never overwritten. Failure leaves every destination byte unchanged.
static inline int nvn_geometry_control_pack_portable(uint8_t *control, size_t control_size,
                                                     const uint8_t *code, uint64_t code_size, const uint32_t skip[8]) {
    if (!nvn_geometry_control_context(control, control_size, code, code_size) ||
        !nvn_geometry_control_mask_valid(skip)) return 0;
    uint8_t *p = control + NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_OFFSET;
    int nonzero = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_SIZE; i++) nonzero |= p[i];
    if (nonzero && nvn_geometry_control_get(control, control_size, code, code_size, NULL) != 1) return 0;
    uint8_t envelope[NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_SIZE] = {0};
    memcpy(envelope, "TKGSMETA", 8);
    nvn_geometry_control_put(envelope + 8, 1);
    nvn_geometry_control_put(envelope + 12, NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_SIZE);
    nvn_geometry_control_put(envelope + 16, NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_PORTABLE);
    nvn_geometry_control_put(envelope + 20, 1);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; i++) nvn_geometry_control_put(envelope + 24 + i * 4, skip[i]);
    memcpy(p, envelope, sizeof envelope);
    return 1;
}

// The same metadata, marked as made for a lowered native stage. The mark is part of the control, so it enters the
// shader's identity. Failure leaves every destination byte unchanged.
static inline int nvn_geometry_control_pack_lowered(uint8_t *control, size_t control_size,
                                                    const uint8_t *code, uint64_t code_size, const uint32_t skip[8]) {
    if (!nvn_geometry_control_pack_portable(control, control_size, code, code_size, skip)) return 0;
    nvn_geometry_control_put(control + NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_OFFSET + 16, NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_LOWERED);
    return 1;
}

// For a control nvn_geometry_control_get accepted.
static inline int nvn_geometry_control_is_lowered(const uint8_t *control) {
    return nvn_geometry_control_u32(control + NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_OFFSET + 16) == NVN_GEOMETRY_CONTROL_LOWERED;
}

#endif

```

`runtime/nvn_hmap.h`:

```h
// Ported from MacNativeGames games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_hmap.h @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026
// jhaizhou; origin d2r-mobile); Chinese duplicate comments dropped, code unchanged.
//
// Open-addressing hash table from fixed-length byte keys -> pointers (linear probing + backward shift on deletion, no
// tombstones). The replay hot path uses it instead of a boxed dictionary: keys are not boxed, no allocation, a lookup
// does only one hash + memcmp.
// No locking: callers protect it with their own locks. Ownership of values belongs to the caller (put / del return the
// replaced / deleted old value).
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct { uint8_t *keys; void **vals; uint32_t klen, cap, n; } nvn_hmap;   // vals[i] == NULL means an empty slot

static inline uint64_t nvn_hm_hash(const void *k, uint32_t len) {
    const uint8_t *p = k; uint64_t h = 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull ^ len;
    for (; len >= 8; p += 8, len -= 8) { uint64_t w; memcpy(&w, p, 8); h = (h ^ w) * 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull; h ^= h >> 32; }
    if (len) { uint64_t w = 0; memcpy(&w, p, len); h = (h ^ w) * 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull; }
    h ^= h >> 33; h *= 0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec53ull; h ^= h >> 33;
    return h;
}
static inline void nvn_hm_init(nvn_hmap *m, uint32_t klen) { memset(m, 0, sizeof *m); m->klen = klen; }
static inline void *nvn_hm_get(const nvn_hmap *m, const void *k) {
    if (!m->n) return NULL;
    for (uint32_t i = (uint32_t)nvn_hm_hash(k, m->klen) & (m->cap - 1);; i = (i + 1) & (m->cap - 1)) {
        if (!m->vals[i]) return NULL;
        if (!memcmp(m->keys + (size_t)i * m->klen, k, m->klen)) return m->vals[i];
    }
}
static inline void *nvn_hm_put(nvn_hmap *m, const void *k, void *v);
static inline void nvn_hm_grow(nvn_hmap *m) {
    nvn_hmap o = *m;
    m->cap = o.cap ? o.cap * 2 : 64; m->n = 0;
    m->keys = malloc((size_t)m->cap * m->klen); m->vals = calloc(m->cap, sizeof *m->vals);
    if (!m->keys || !m->vals) abort();
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < o.cap; i++) if (o.vals[i]) nvn_hm_put(m, o.keys + (size_t)i * o.klen, o.vals[i]);
    free(o.keys); free(o.vals);
}
// v must not be NULL; returns the old value for the same key (NULL if none)
static inline void *nvn_hm_put(nvn_hmap *m, const void *k, void *v) {
    if ((m->n + 1) * 4 > m->cap * 3) nvn_hm_grow(m);   // Load factor <= 3/4
    for (uint32_t i = (uint32_t)nvn_hm_hash(k, m->klen) & (m->cap - 1);; i = (i + 1) & (m->cap - 1)) {
        uint8_t *ki = m->keys + (size_t)i * m->klen;
        if (!m->vals[i]) { memcpy(ki, k, m->klen); m->vals[i] = v; m->n++; return NULL; }
        if (!memcmp(ki, k, m->klen)) { void *old = m->vals[i]; m->vals[i] = v; return old; }
    }
}
// After deletion, shift back later entries on the same probe chain to fill the hole, so that a lookup can stop at the
// first empty slot
static inline void *nvn_hm_del(nvn_hmap *m, const void *k) {
    if (!m->n) return NULL;
    uint32_t mask = m->cap - 1, i = (uint32_t)nvn_hm_hash(k, m->klen) & mask;
    for (;; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
        if (!m->vals[i]) return NULL;
        if (!memcmp(m->keys + (size_t)i * m->klen, k, m->klen)) break;
    }
    void *old = m->vals[i];
    for (uint32_t j = i;;) {
        m->vals[i] = NULL;
        for (;;) {
            j = (j + 1) & mask;
            if (!m->vals[j]) { m->n--; return old; }
            uint32_t h = (uint32_t)nvn_hm_hash(m->keys + (size_t)j * m->klen, m->klen) & mask;
            if (i <= j ? (i < h && h <= j) : (i < h || h <= j)) continue;   // Ideal position is within (i, j]: cannot move forward
            break;
        }
        memcpy(m->keys + (size_t)i * m->klen, m->keys + (size_t)j * m->klen, m->klen); m->vals[i] = m->vals[j];
        i = j;
    }
}
// Clear; when rel is non-null, call it once for each value (releasing ownership)
static inline void nvn_hm_clear(nvn_hmap *m, void (*rel)(void *)) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < m->cap; i++) if (m->vals[i]) { if (rel) rel(m->vals[i]); m->vals[i] = NULL; }
    m->n = 0;
}

```

`runtime/nvn_indirect_reset.h`:

```h
// Original CPU-only planning for the NVN 2 indirect-record reset. Targets stay opaque GPU addresses; the caller
// obtains the pointer list in replay order and emits writes only after the complete target validation succeeds.
// Bounds and selected-list overlap policy: Eglantine video_core/indirect_reset.h IndirectResetRange and
// renderer_vulkan/vk_rasterizer.cpp RasterizerVulkan::TryNx2IndirectReset. No shader recognition data is included.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

#define NVN_INDIRECT_RESET_RECORD_BYTES 20u
#define NVN_INDIRECT_RESET_MAX_RECORDS (1u << 20)

typedef struct { uint64_t begin; uint32_t bytes, count; } NvnIndirectResetList;

// Returns 1 only when the complete target range is backed by one contiguous mapping. This callback is a query:
// neither it nor the planner may write records or read GPU memory. `pointers` is the caller's owned CPU copy.
typedef int (*NvnIndirectResetMapped)(void *context, uint64_t address, uint32_t bytes);

static inline int nvn_indirect_reset_list(uint64_t address, uint32_t descriptor_bytes, int64_t first, int64_t count,
                                         NvnIndirectResetList *out) {
    if (!out) return 0;
    *out = (NvnIndirectResetList){0};
    if (!address || first < 0 || count <= 0 || count > NVN_INDIRECT_RESET_MAX_RECORDS) return 0;
    uint64_t entries = descriptor_bytes / sizeof(uint64_t), start = (uint64_t)first, n = (uint64_t)count;
    if (start > entries || n > entries - start) return 0;
    uint64_t offset = start * sizeof(uint64_t), bytes = n * sizeof(uint64_t);
    if (address > UINT64_MAX - offset) return 0;
    uint64_t begin = address + offset;
    if (begin > UINT64_MAX - bytes) return 0;
    *out = (NvnIndirectResetList){begin, (uint32_t)bytes, (uint32_t)n};
    return 1;
}

// Validate every nonnull record before any write. Overlap is checked against the selected first/count pointer
// subrange, not unused descriptor entries. Target duplicates and target-to-target overlaps preserve input order.
static inline int nvn_indirect_reset_targets(const NvnIndirectResetList *list, const uint64_t *pointers,
                                            NvnIndirectResetMapped mapped, void *context) {
    if (!list || !pointers || !mapped || !list->begin || !list->count ||
        list->count > NVN_INDIRECT_RESET_MAX_RECORDS ||
        list->bytes != (uint64_t)list->count * sizeof(uint64_t) || list->begin > UINT64_MAX - list->bytes) return 0;
    uint64_t end = list->begin + list->bytes;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < list->count; i++) {
        uint64_t address = pointers[i];
        if (!address) continue;
        if (address % sizeof(uint32_t) || address > UINT64_MAX - NVN_INDIRECT_RESET_RECORD_BYTES ||
            (address < end && list->begin < address + NVN_INDIRECT_RESET_RECORD_BYTES) ||
            !mapped(context, address, NVN_INDIRECT_RESET_RECORD_BYTES)) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

```

`runtime/nvn_mode_trace.c`:

```c
// TOTK_NVN2_MODE_TRACE: passive scalar metadata only; no mode semantics or command decoding.
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_mode_trace.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

typedef struct {
    uint64_t sequence, command_buffer, handle, submit, elapsed_ns;
    uint32_t kind, thread, value;
} ModeEvent;
static const char *const names[NVN_MODE_EVENT_COUNT] = {
    "initialize", "finalize", "begin", "end", "recording_mode", "geometry_mode", "prepare", "handle"
};
static PlatOnce once = PLAT_ONCE_INIT;
static PlatMutex lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
static int enabled = -1, sealed;
static ModeEvent *events;
static uint64_t seen[NVN_MODE_EVENT_COUNT], emitted[NVN_MODE_EVENT_COUNT], sequence;
static uint32_t used;
static uint32_t start_ms, duration_ms;
static uint64_t origin_ns, start_ns, duration_ns, excluded_before, excluded_after;

static void trace_init(void *unused) {
    (void)unused;
    int on = cfg_bool("TOTK_NVN2_MODE_TRACE");
    if (on) {
        int start = cfg_int("TOTK_NVN2_MODE_TRACE_START_MS");
        int duration = cfg_int("TOTK_NVN2_MODE_TRACE_DURATION_MS");
        if (start < 0 || start > 600000 || duration < 0 || duration > 600000) {
            rt_log("nvn2-mode: window settings outside 0..600000; capture disabled");
            __atomic_store_n(&enabled, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            return;
        }
        start_ms = (uint32_t)start;
        duration_ms = (uint32_t)duration;
        start_ns = (uint64_t)start_ms * 1000000;
        duration_ns = (uint64_t)duration_ms * 1000000;
        events = calloc(NVN_MODE_TRACE_LIMIT, sizeof *events);
        if (!events) {
            rt_log("nvn2-mode: buffer allocation failed; capture disabled");
            on = 0;
        } else {
            origin_ns = plat_now_ns(); // relative to the first enabled hook, not guest/game time
            atexit(nvn_mode_trace_finish);
        }
    }
    __atomic_store_n(&enabled, on, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

static int trace_on(void) {
    int on = __atomic_load_n(&enabled, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (on < 0) {
        plat_once(&once, trace_init, NULL);
        on = __atomic_load_n(&enabled, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    }
    return on;
}

void nvn_mode_trace(unsigned kind, uint64_t command_buffer, uint64_t handle, uint32_t value, uint64_t submit) {
    if (!trace_on() || kind >= NVN_MODE_EVENT_COUNT) return;
    plat_mutex_lock(&lock);
    if (!sealed) {
        uint64_t elapsed = plat_now_ns() - origin_ns;
        if (elapsed < start_ns) excluded_before++;
        else if (duration_ns && elapsed >= start_ns + duration_ns) excluded_after++;
        else {
            uint64_t no = ++sequence;
            seen[kind]++;
            if (used < NVN_MODE_TRACE_LIMIT) {
                // Reserve and publish under one lock, so terminal sealing cannot
                // expose a reserved record before its fields are complete.
                events[used++] = (ModeEvent){no, command_buffer, handle, submit, elapsed, kind, plat_thread_id(), value};
                emitted[kind]++;
            }
        }
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}

void nvn_mode_trace_finish(void) {
    if (!trace_on()) return;
    plat_mutex_lock(&lock);
    if (sealed) { plat_mutex_unlock(&lock); return; }
    sealed = 1;
    __atomic_store_n(&enabled, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    rt_log("nvn2-mode window schema=2 origin=first_hook start_ms=%u duration_ms=%u elapsed_ns=%llu excluded_before=%llu excluded_after=%llu",
           start_ms, duration_ms, (unsigned long long)(plat_now_ns() - origin_ns),
           (unsigned long long)excluded_before, (unsigned long long)excluded_after);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < used; i++) {
        const ModeEvent *e = &events[i];
        rt_log("nvn2-mode event seq=%llu type=%s thread=%u cb=%#llx handle=%#llx value=%u submit=%llu elapsed_ns=%llu",
               (unsigned long long)e->sequence, names[e->kind], e->thread,
               (unsigned long long)e->command_buffer, (unsigned long long)e->handle, e->value,
               (unsigned long long)e->submit, (unsigned long long)e->elapsed_ns);
    }
    rt_log("nvn2-mode capture seen=%llu emitted=%u dropped=%llu limit=%u overflow=%u order=observational sealed=1 nested=untracked",
           (unsigned long long)sequence, used, (unsigned long long)(sequence - used), NVN_MODE_TRACE_LIMIT,
           sequence > used);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < NVN_MODE_EVENT_COUNT; i++)
        rt_log("nvn2-mode summary type=%s seen=%llu emitted=%llu dropped=%llu", names[i],
               (unsigned long long)seen[i], (unsigned long long)emitted[i], (unsigned long long)(seen[i] - emitted[i]));
    plat_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}
```

`runtime/nvn_mode_trace.h`:

```h
// Optional scalar-only observation of unsupported NVN2 modes and recording boundaries.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

enum {
    NVN_MODE_INIT, NVN_MODE_FINALIZE, NVN_MODE_BEGIN, NVN_MODE_END,
    NVN_MODE_RECORDING, NVN_MODE_GEOMETRY, NVN_MODE_PREPARE, NVN_MODE_HANDLE,
    NVN_MODE_EVENT_COUNT
};
#define NVN_MODE_TRACE_LIMIT 65536u

// Tokens are opaque values already available to the caller, never dereferenced.
// Sequence/thread identify observations, not guest or GPU happens-before edges.
// Optional restart settings START_MS/DURATION_MS select elapsed host time from
// the first enabled hook. Start is inclusive; end exclusive; duration 0 is open.
void nvn_mode_trace(unsigned kind, uint64_t command_buffer, uint64_t handle, uint32_t value, uint64_t submit);
// Terminal snapshot: seals once and emits the bounded stream plus exact counters.
// Called by prof_write on the existing process-exit paths, or by normal atexit.
void nvn_mode_trace_finish(void);
```

`runtime/nvn_obj.h`:

```h
// Ported from MacNativeGames games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_obj.h and the two types of nvn_tex.h @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 jhaizhou; origin d2r-mobile); Metal entry points dropped, layouts unchanged.
// NVN host-side object layout and command record format: shared by hle_nvn.c (interface layer, writes) and nvn_mtl.m (Metal replay layer, reads).
// Objects are stored in place in the NVN object memory allocated by the game, with size not exceeding the reserved size in nvn.h (FITS static assertion).
// State objects (Blend / Color / ... 4–0x18 bytes) are small structs the game copies by value; their layout is packed in place with bit-fields.
//
// In this port the interface layer is runtime/nvn_api_*.c and nvn_ext.c, and the replay layers are the back ends of
// gfx.h (GfxBackend).
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "nvn.h"

#define MAGIC(a, b, c, d) ((uint32_t)(a) | (uint32_t)(b) << 8 | (uint32_t)(c) << 16 | (uint32_t)(d) << 24)
#define FITS(T, H) _Static_assert(sizeof(T) <= sizeof(H), #T " exceeds the reserved size of " #H)

// ---------- Texture description and storage layout (nvn_tex.h; the functions over them live in nvn_tex.c) ----------
typedef struct {
    int target, format, flags, samples;   // NVNtextureTarget / NVNformat / NVNtextureFlags / sample count (0 or 1 = single-sampled)
    uint32_t width, height, depth, levels, stride;
    signed int pkg_block_h:8; unsigned int swizzle_r:3,swizzle_g:3,swizzle_b:3,swizzle_a:3,swizzle_pad:12;                      // Byte 0 of the packaged texture layout parameters + 1 (low nibble log2 block height, high nibble log2 block depth); 0 = use the automatic algorithm
} nvn_texdesc;

typedef struct {
    uint64_t size, layer_size;            // Total storage bytes, bytes per layer
    uint32_t align, layers, bpb;          // Alignment, layer count, bytes per block
    unsigned tileH, tileD;                // Block height / block depth (log2 of the GOB count)
} nvn_texlayout;

typedef struct { uint32_t flags; } dev_builder_t;                       FITS(dev_builder_t, NVNdeviceBuilder);
typedef struct { uint32_t magic, flags, origin, depth_mode; void *dbg_cb, *dbg_data; } dev_t_;  FITS(dev_t_, NVNdevice);

typedef struct { NVNdevice *dev; uint32_t flags; uint64_t cmd_sz, comp_sz, ctl_sz, flush; void *mem; uint64_t mem_sz; } queue_builder_t;
FITS(queue_builder_t, NVNqueueBuilder);
typedef struct { uint32_t magic; NVNdevice *dev; uint64_t submits; } queue_t;                 FITS(queue_t, NVNqueue);

typedef struct { NVNdevice *dev; void *mem; uint64_t size; uint32_t flags; } pool_builder_t;  FITS(pool_builder_t, NVNmemoryPoolBuilder);
// game_mem/host/span: TOTK host-owned VM storage for physical/virtual pools (totk_vpool.c); host is NULL for game-backed pools.
typedef struct { uint32_t magic, flags; uint8_t *mem; uint64_t size; uint8_t *game_mem, *host; uint64_t span; } pool_t; FITS(pool_t, NVNmemoryPool);

typedef struct { const pool_t *pool; int64_t off; int32_t n; } dpool_t;                       // Texture / sampler descriptor pool
FITS(dpool_t, NVNtexturePool); FITS(dpool_t, NVNsamplerPool);

// Descriptor table addressing captured by a command, independent of the descriptor-pool object's later lifetime.
typedef struct { uint64_t addr; uint32_t count, pad; } dpool_ref;
#define NVN_DESCRIPTOR_BYTES 32u   // DeviceGetInteger: texture and sampler descriptor sizes
static inline int nvn_dpool_snapshot(const dpool_t *p, uint32_t limit, dpool_ref *out) {
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);
    if (!p) return 1;
    if (!p->pool || p->pool->magic != MAGIC('P', 'O', 'O', 'L') || !p->pool->mem || p->off < 0 ||
        p->n <= 0 || (uint32_t)p->n > limit) return 0;
    uint64_t base = (uintptr_t)p->pool->mem, off = (uint64_t)p->off;
    uint64_t bytes = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)p->n * NVN_DESCRIPTOR_BYTES;
    if (off % NVN_DESCRIPTOR_BYTES || off > p->pool->size || bytes > p->pool->size - off ||
        base > UINT64_MAX - off || base + off > UINT64_MAX - bytes || (base + off) % NVN_DESCRIPTOR_BYTES) return 0;
    *out = (dpool_ref){base + off, (uint32_t)p->n, 0};
    return 1;
}

typedef struct {
    NVNdevice *dev; nvn_texdesc d; pool_t *pool; int64_t off;
    uint8_t has_layout, layout[8];
    const void *pkg_data;                // TOTK: SetPackagedTextureData source, copied into storage at Initialize
} tex_builder_t;                                                                             FITS(tex_builder_t, NVNtextureBuilder);
typedef struct {
    uint32_t magic; nvn_texdesc d; uint8_t has_layout, layout[8];
    nvn_texlayout L; uint8_t *mem; pool_t *pool; int64_t off;
    uint64_t serial;                     // Initialization serial: the back end uses it to find its texture in the host table (the game may copy the object by value, so object pointers cannot be stored)
} tex_t;                                                                                     FITS(tex_t, NVNtexture);
// TOTK: the game reserves 16 bytes for NVNtextureView on its stack (main+0x823398 SetDefaults at sp+0x30, its own
// data at sp+0x40), so the view is packed into 16 bytes. swz = NVN view swizzle selectors. dsmode:
// NVNtextureDepthStencilMode (nxnative nvn_obj.h:42 packs it the same way).
typedef struct {
    uint8_t set_levels : 1, set_layers : 1, set_format : 1, set_target : 1, set_swizzle : 1, set_dsmode : 1, dsmode : 2;
    uint8_t base_level, nlevels, target; uint16_t min_layer, nlayers; uint16_t format; uint8_t swz[4]; uint8_t pad1[2];
} view_t;
_Static_assert(sizeof(view_t) == 16, "NVNtextureView is 16 bytes in TOTK's NVN");
FITS(view_t, NVNtextureView);

// Sampler parameters (one copy shared by builder and object)
typedef struct { uint8_t minf, magf, ws, wt, wr, cmp_mode, cmp_func, reduction; float lod_min, lod_max, lod_bias, aniso, border[4], lod_snap; } samp_par;   // TOTK: lod_snap stored for queries (Metal has no equivalent)   // Enum values are all < 256
typedef struct { NVNdevice *dev; samp_par p; } samp_builder_t;                                FITS(samp_builder_t, NVNsamplerBuilder);
typedef struct { uint32_t magic; samp_par p; } samp_t;                                        FITS(samp_t, NVNsampler);
_Static_assert(sizeof(samp_par) == 44, "TOTK sampler parameters");

typedef struct {
    uint32_t magic, nstage;
    NVNshaderData sd[6];
    uint64_t serial;                    // back-end resolved-result key
    uint8_t *owned_control;             // host-tagged portable controls, retained until replay releases this program
} prog_t;                                                                                FITS(prog_t, NVNprogram);
_Static_assert(sizeof(prog_t) <= 0xa0, "NVN2 program allocation stride");

typedef struct { uint32_t magic, fenced; uint64_t fence; } sync_t;                            FITS(sync_t, NVNsync);
typedef struct { const pool_t *pool; int64_t off; } ev_builder_t;                             FITS(ev_builder_t, NVNeventBuilder);
typedef struct { uint32_t magic; volatile uint32_t *val; } ev_t;                              FITS(ev_t, NVNevent);

typedef struct { NVNdevice *dev; void *native; int32_t ntex, interval, active; NVNtexture *tex[4]; } win_builder_t;
FITS(win_builder_t, NVNwindowBuilder);
// avail[i]: time at which swapchain image i can be acquired again (ns, monotonic clock) = its display time + one present period; pace: target time of this window's present pacer
typedef struct { uint32_t magic; void *native; int32_t ntex, interval, next, active, crop[4]; NVNtexture *tex[4]; uint64_t presents, avail[4], pace, ticket[4]; } win_t;   // ticket[i]: ticket of the most recent present of image i
FITS(win_t, NVNwindow);

// Command records live in host memory; finished copies are owned by guest control memory.
typedef struct {
    uint32_t magic, recording;
    uint8_t *cur;
    uint64_t guest_flags;                // +0x10: NVN 55 inline code writes the dirty flag here
    uint8_t *end;
    // TOTK: NVN 55 headers inline fast paths that read the command write pointer at +0x20 and its end at +0x28
    // (main+0x70644c) and, when 0x30 bytes fit, emit raw GPU methods themselves. ~0 / 0 never fit, so every
    // call takes the API path (the *Deferred entry points).
    uint64_t inline_cur, inline_end;
    PFNNVNCOMMANDBUFFERMEMORYCALLBACKPROC cb; void *cb_data;
    NVNdevice *dev;
    uint8_t *seg;                        // TOTK: start of the host recording buffer (records never go into game memory)
    void *ctl; size_t ctl_size;          // TOTK: control memory given by the game; recording copies live as long as it
    size_t game_size;                    // TOTK: command memory the game added (accounting only; not used for storage)
    uintptr_t cmd_base;                  // TOTK: pool storage address + offset of the command memory the game added
    size_t cmd_used, ctl_used, rec_start;   // rec_start: cmd_used when the current recording began
    size_t hw_used, last_rec, hw_start;            // TOTK: command memory the real NVN driver would have consumed (what GetCommandMemoryUsed reports; the game sizes resource heaps from it), size of the last record           // TOTK: usage reported to the game since the memory was added (main+0x711e4c submits only non-empty buffers)
} cmd_t;                                                                                     FITS(cmd_t, NVNcommandBuffer);
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(cmd_t, guest_flags) == 0x10, "NVN inline dirty flag");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(cmd_t, inline_cur) == 0x20 && __builtin_offsetof(cmd_t, inline_end) == 0x28, "NVN inline fast-path fields");

// ---------- State objects (defaults follow the NVN / GL defaults) ----------
typedef struct { uint32_t blend_en : 8, logic_op : 4, alpha_func : 4; } color_st;            FITS(color_st, NVNcolorState);
typedef struct { uint32_t mask; } chmask_st;            /* 4 bits per target: r=1 g=2 b=4 a=8, bit set = write */ FITS(chmask_st, NVNchannelMaskState);

FITS(ms_st, NVNmultisampleState);

             fail_f : 4, zfail_f : 4, zpass_f : 4, fail_b : 4, zfail_b : 4, zpass_b : 4;

// NVN2 GeometryProcessingMode: 0 = traditional VTG; nonzero selects the mesh pipeline (MKW uses 1 and 2).
```

`runtime/nvn_pool_index.h`:

```h
// Ported from MacNativeGames games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_pool_index.h @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c)
// 2026 jhaizhou; origin d2r-mobile); code unchanged, the Metal residency note of `res` generalised.
#pragma once
/* TOTK: memory pools sorted by guest address.
   The world scene keeps about 3,200 pools alive, and the replay resolves several dozen buffer addresses per draw
   (vertex / index / uniform / storage bindings). A linear scan of all pools for each of them was the largest part of
   the ~87k instructions per draw. Lookups are a binary search on the range start plus a backwards walk that is
   bounded by a running maximum of the range ends, so a pool nested inside or overlapping another is still found.
   Not thread-safe: the caller holds the pool mutex for every call. */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct { uintptr_t lo, hi, base; void *buf; uint64_t gpu; const void *key; int res; } pidx_ent;   // buf, res: back-end data
typedef struct { pidx_ent *e; uintptr_t *maxhi; int n, cap; } pidx;   // maxhi[i] = largest hi among e[0..i]

static inline void pidx_fix_maxhi(pidx *x, int from) {
    for (int i = from > 0 ? from : 0; i < x->n; i++) {
        uintptr_t prev = i ? x->maxhi[i - 1] : 0;
        x->maxhi[i] = x->e[i].hi > prev ? x->e[i].hi : prev;
    }
}
// Number of entries whose range starts at or below addr (index of the first start above it).
static inline int pidx_upper(const pidx *x, uintptr_t addr) {
    int a = 0, b = x->n;
    while (a < b) { int m = (a + b) >> 1; if (x->e[m].lo <= addr) a = m + 1; else b = m; }
    return a;
}
// Returns 0 when memory runs out (the index is left unchanged).
static inline int pidx_insert(pidx *x, const pidx_ent *v) {
    if (x->n == x->cap) {
        int cap = x->cap ? x->cap * 2 : 64;
        pidx_ent *e = realloc(x->e, (size_t)cap * sizeof *e); if (!e) return 0; x->e = e;
        uintptr_t *mh = realloc(x->maxhi, (size_t)cap * sizeof *mh); if (!mh) return 0; x->maxhi = mh;
        x->cap = cap;
    }
    int at = pidx_upper(x, v->lo);
    memmove(x->e + at + 1, x->e + at, (size_t)(x->n - at) * sizeof *x->e);
    x->e[at] = *v; x->n++;
    pidx_fix_maxhi(x, at);
    return 1;
}
// Removes the entry registered for key; returns 0 when there is none.
static inline int pidx_remove(pidx *x, const void *key, pidx_ent *out) {
    for (int i = 0; i < x->n; i++) {
        if (x->e[i].key != key) continue;
        if (out) *out = x->e[i];
        memmove(x->e + i, x->e + i + 1, (size_t)(x->n - i - 1) * sizeof *x->e); x->n--;
        pidx_fix_maxhi(x, i);
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
// A pool whose range [lo, hi] contains [addr, addr + len], or NULL (same containment test as the old linear scan).
static inline const pidx_ent *pidx_find(const pidx *x, uintptr_t addr, uint64_t len) {
    uintptr_t end = addr + (uintptr_t)len;
    if (end < addr) return NULL;
    for (int i = pidx_upper(x, addr) - 1; i >= 0 && x->maxhi[i] >= end; i--)
        if (x->e[i].hi >= end) return &x->e[i];
    return NULL;
}
// The same lookup for callers that update the entry they find (they hold the pool mutex as well).
static inline pidx_ent *pidx_find_mut(pidx *x, uintptr_t addr, uint64_t len) { return (pidx_ent *)pidx_find(x, addr, len); }
// 1 when [lo, hi) overlaps a registered range (diagnostic: real NVN pools do not normally overlap).
static inline int pidx_overlaps(const pidx *x, uintptr_t lo, uintptr_t hi) {
    int at = pidx_upper(x, lo);
    if (at > 0 && x->maxhi[at - 1] > lo) return 1;
    return at < x->n && x->e[at].lo < hi;
}

/* Exact-query memoization, protected by the SAME mutex as the index. The caller
   must invalidate after every successful insertion/removal, including while the
   experiment is disabled. It stores indices, not retained resource pointers.
   Overlapping ranges retain pidx_find's exact selection and zero-length semantics. */
#define PIDX_QUERY_SLOTS 256
typedef struct { uintptr_t address; uint64_t length, epoch; int index; } pidx_query;
typedef struct { pidx_query queries[PIDX_QUERY_SLOTS]; uint64_t epoch, hits, misses; } pidx_query_cache;
static inline void pidx_query_invalidate(pidx_query_cache *cache) {
    if (++cache->epoch == 0) { memset(cache->queries, 0, sizeof cache->queries); cache->epoch = 1; }
}
static inline pidx_ent *pidx_find_cached(pidx *x, pidx_query_cache *cache, uintptr_t address, uint64_t length) {
    if (!cache->epoch) cache->epoch = 1;
    uint64_t hash = (address >> 4) ^ (address >> 20) ^ (length * UINT64_C(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15));
    pidx_query *q = &cache->queries[hash & (PIDX_QUERY_SLOTS - 1)];
    if (q->epoch == cache->epoch && q->address == address && q->length == length && q->index < x->n) {
        cache->hits++;
        return q->index < 0 ? NULL : &x->e[q->index];
    }
    pidx_ent *found = pidx_find_mut(x, address, length);
    *q = (pidx_query){address, length, cache->epoch, found ? (int)(found - x->e) : -1};
    cache->misses++;
    return found;
}
```
