`runtime/perf.c`:

```c
// Frame timing (TOTK_TRACE=perf, the frame-time summary, the performance overlay's counts), the A/B switches (rt_ab,
// rt_knob) and TOTK_ONE_PER_CORE. The sampling profiler (TOTK_PROFILE) is the OS's (prof_win.c); without one the weak
// prof_sampler_* below do nothing.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "flight.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_mode_trace.h"
#include "perfmon.h"
#include "prof.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

volatile uint32_t prof_render_tid, prof_main_tid, prof_replay_tid;

__attribute__((weak)) int prof_sampler_start(void) {
    if (cfg_get("TOTK_PROFILE")) rt_log("prof: TOTK_PROFILE: no sampling profiler on this OS");
    return 0;
}
__attribute__((weak)) void prof_sampler_write(void) {}
__attribute__((weak)) void prof_sampler_frame(uint64_t frame, uint64_t now, uint64_t d) { (void)frame, (void)now, (void)d; }

// TOTK_TRACE=perf, TOTK_FLIGHT=1 or the full performance overlay: event counts are taken. Wait times are always taken
// (frame-time summary). perf_base: the part fixed at start.
static int perf_on, perf_base;
static int overlay;   // performance overlay mode (perf_set_overlay): 0 off, 1 fps, 2 full

void perf_set_overlay(int mode) {
    __atomic_store_n(&overlay, mode, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&perf_on, perf_base || mode == 2, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

int perf_gpu_timing(void) { return (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_PERF) || __atomic_load_n(&overlay, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) == 2; }

static volatile int64_t gpu_busy_total;

void perf_gpu_busy(uint64_t ns) { plat_add64(&gpu_busy_total, (int64_t)ns); }

uint64_t perf_gpu_busy_total(void) { return (uint64_t)__atomic_load_n(&gpu_busy_total, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); }

static volatile int64_t present_gpu_ns, present_timed;

void perf_present_gpu(uint64_t ns) { plat_add64(&present_gpu_ns, (int64_t)ns), plat_inc64(&present_timed); }

void prof_start(void) {
    flight_init();
    atexit(perf_summary_flush);   // boot.c's _exit path goes through prof_write instead
    perf_base = (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_PERF) || flight_on;
    perf_on = perf_base || overlay == 2;
    if (prof_sampler_start()) atexit(prof_write);   // a --seconds run ends in _exit: boot.c calls prof_write itself first
}

void prof_write(void) {
    nvn_mode_trace_finish(); // current callers are process exit paths (boot, window close, ExitProcess)
    perf_summary_flush();
    prof_sampler_write();
}

// ---- TOTK_TRACE=perf: frame interval and the time the render thread spends waiting, logged every 60 presents. The
// flight recorder (TOTK_FLIGHT=1, flight.c) takes the same numbers per frame.
static uint64_t wait_ns[PERF_N], frame_ns[PERF_N], worst_ns[PERF_N];   // window totals, this frame, the slowest frame

uint64_t perf_begin(void) { return kern_now_ns(); }

void perf_replay_thread(void) { prof_replay_tid = plat_thread_id(); }
void perf_main_thread(void) { prof_main_tid = plat_thread_id(); }

void perf_end(int kind, uint64_t t0) {
    if (!t0) return;
    uint32_t tid = plat_thread_id();
    if (tid != prof_render_tid && tid != prof_replay_tid) return;
    uint64_t d = kern_now_ns() - t0;
    if (tid == prof_render_tid && !prof_replay_tid) {   // one thread adds: no atomics on the synchronous path
        wait_ns[kind] += d;
        frame_ns[kind] += d;
        return;
    }
    __atomic_fetch_add(&wait_ns[kind], d, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_fetch_add(&frame_ns[kind], d, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

static volatile int64_t other_wait_ns;     // perf_gpu_wait on threads other than the render thread, over the window
static volatile int64_t render_wait_ns;    // the same on the render thread
void (*perf_gpu_stats)(PerfGpu *out);

void perf_gpu_wait(uint64_t t0) {
    if (!t0 || !__atomic_load_n(&perf_on, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) return;
    int64_t d = (int64_t)(kern_now_ns() - t0);
    plat_add64(plat_thread_id() == prof_render_tid ? &render_wait_ns : &other_wait_ns, d);
}

static volatile int64_t replay_ns;         // perf_replay: summed over the window, any thread
static volatile int64_t frame_replay_ns;   // the same since the previous present (frame-time summary)

void perf_replay(uint64_t t0) {
    if (!t0) return;
    int64_t d = (int64_t)(kern_now_ns() - t0);
    plat_add64(&frame_replay_ns, d);
    if (__atomic_load_n(&perf_on, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) plat_add64(&replay_ns, d);
}

static volatile int64_t counts[PERF_CNT_N];   // running totals: the perf log and the flight recorder take differences

void perf_count(int kind) {
    if (__atomic_load_n(&perf_on, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) plat_inc64(&counts[kind]);
}

// ---- Frame-time summary, always on: every 60 s of play and at exit one line of frame count, mean fps, 1% low and the
// frames over 25/50/100 ms, then the worst frames of the period with the render thread's waits in them. Per frame: a
// histogram increment, the compare against the worst list, a memset of the wait array. No allocation.
#define FT_BINS 1024              // 0.25 ms bins up to 256 ms; slower frames land in the last bin
#define FT_WORST 5
#define FT_PERIOD_NS 60000000000ull
typedef struct { uint64_t frame, ns, wait[PERF_N], replay; } FtWorst;
static struct {
    uint64_t t0, frames, sum, over25, over50, over100;
    uint32_t hist[FT_BINS];
    FtWorst worst[FT_WORST];   // slowest first
    int nworst;
} ft;
static uint64_t summary_t0;   // start of the current period (0: not started)

static void ft_report(uint64_t now, const char *tag) {
    if (ft.frames && ft.sum) {
        uint64_t cut = (ft.frames + 99) / 100, acc = 0, low = 0;   // the slowest 1% of frames
        for (int b = FT_BINS - 1; b >= 0; b--) {
            acc += ft.hist[b];
            if (acc >= cut) { low = (uint64_t)(b + 1) * 250000ull; break; }   // upper edge of the bin
        }
        rt_log("frametime: %s: %llu frames in %.1f s, mean %.1f fps, 1%% low %.1f fps, over 25 ms %llu, 50 ms %llu, 100 ms %llu",
               tag, (unsigned long long)ft.frames, (now - ft.t0) / 1e9, ft.frames * 1e9 / ft.sum, low ? 1e9 / low : 0.0,
               (unsigned long long)ft.over25, (unsigned long long)ft.over50, (unsigned long long)ft.over100);
        for (int i = 0; i < ft.nworst; i++) {
            const FtWorst *w = &ft.worst[i];
            rt_log("frametime:   worst frame %llu: %.1f ms; shader translation %.1f, pipeline build %.1f, texture upload %.1f (astc %.1f), replay %.1f, fence/present wait %.1f, pacing %.1f",
                   (unsigned long long)w->frame, w->ns / 1e6, w->wait[PERF_XLATE] / 1e6, w->wait[PERF_PIPE] / 1e6,
                   w->wait[PERF_TEX] / 1e6, w->wait[PERF_ASTC] / 1e6, w->replay / 1e6,
                   (w->wait[PERF_FENCE] + w->wait[PERF_DRAIN]) / 1e6, w->wait[PERF_PACE] / 1e6);
        }
    }
    memset(&ft, 0, sizeof ft);
    ft.t0 = now;
}

__attribute__((weak)) void gfx_exit_log(void) {}

void perf_summary_flush(void) {   // at exit (prof_write)
    if (summary_t0) {
        ft_report(kern_now_ns(), "exit");
        gfx_exit_log();
    }
    summary_t0 = 0;
}

// Returns the replay time since the previous present.
static uint64_t ft_frame(uint64_t frame, uint64_t now, uint64_t d) {
    int64_t rep = plat_xchg64(&frame_replay_ns, 0);
    if (!summary_t0) {   // the first present starts the period; there is no interval yet
        summary_t0 = now;
        ft.t0 = now;
        return (uint64_t)rep;
    }
    ft.frames++;
    ft.sum += d;
    uint64_t b = d / 250000ull;
    ft.hist[b < FT_BINS ? b : FT_BINS - 1]++;
    if (d > 25000000ull) ft.over25++;
    if (d > 50000000ull) ft.over50++;
    if (d > 100000000ull) ft.over100++;
    if (d > 25000000ull && (ft.nworst < FT_WORST || d > ft.worst[FT_WORST - 1].ns)) {
        int i = ft.nworst < FT_WORST ? ft.nworst++ : FT_WORST - 1;
        while (i > 0 && ft.worst[i - 1].ns < d) ft.worst[i] = ft.worst[i - 1], i--;
        ft.worst[i].frame = frame;
        ft.worst[i].ns = d;
        memcpy(ft.worst[i].wait, frame_ns, sizeof frame_ns);
        ft.worst[i].replay = (uint64_t)rep;
    }
    if (now - summary_t0 >= FT_PERIOD_NS) {
        ft_report(now, "60 s");
        summary_t0 = now;
    }
    return (uint64_t)rep;
}

// The second line of the 60-frame window: GPU busy time (timestamps), the time threads waited for GPU fences, VRAM and
// process memory, and which side holds the frame back. pace: the frame waited for pacing (vsync, the frame limiter) at
// least 15% of the window; gpu: the GPU was busy for 80% of the frame interval or more (without timestamps: threads
// waited for fences for half the interval or more); cpu otherwise.
static void perf_gpu_line(uint64_t frame, double interval_ms, double pace_share, uint64_t n) {
    PerfGpu g;
    memset(&g, 0, sizeof g);
    if (perf_gpu_stats) perf_gpu_stats(&g);
    double rw = plat_xchg64(&render_wait_ns, 0) / 1e6 / n, ow = plat_xchg64(&other_wait_ns, 0) / 1e6 / n;
    double gpu_ms = g.have_gpu ? g.gpu_ns / 1e6 / n : 0;
    char gs[96], vs[96];
    if (g.have_gpu) snprintf(gs, sizeof gs, "gpu avg %.2f ms (%llu parts timed, %llu not)", gpu_ms,
                             (unsigned long long)g.gpu_parts, (unsigned long long)g.gpu_missed);
    else snprintf(gs, sizeof gs, "gpu avg n/a");
    if (g.have_vram) snprintf(vs, sizeof vs, "vram %.0f of %.0f MiB%s", g.vram_used / 1048576.0, g.vram_budget / 1048576.0,
                              g.vram_exact ? "" : " (own allocations of the heap size)");
    else snprintf(vs, sizeof vs, "vram n/a");
    char us[224];   // upload batches and presents: outside the timed submission parts, so not in "gpu avg"
    int64_t pg = plat_xchg64(&present_gpu_ns, 0), pt = plat_xchg64(&present_timed, 0);
    snprintf(us, sizeof us, "uploads %llu batches, %.1f MiB staged, gpu %.2f ms per frame (%llu timed), waited %.2f ms per frame; "
             "present gpu %.2f ms per frame (%lld timed)",
             (unsigned long long)g.up_batches, g.up_bytes / 1048576.0, g.up_gpu_ns / 1e6 / n, (unsigned long long)g.up_timed,
             g.up_wait_ns / 1e6 / n, pg / 1e6 / n, (long long)pt);
    uint64_t res, prv;
    plat_process_memory(&res, &prv);
    double ws = res / 1048576.0, priv = prv / 1048576.0;
    const char *bound = pace_share >= 0.15 ? "pace"
                      : g.have_gpu ? (gpu_ms >= 0.8 * interval_ms ? "gpu" : "cpu")
                      : (rw + ow >= 0.5 * interval_ms ? "gpu" : "cpu");
    rt_log("perf: frame %llu: %s; %s; fence wait per frame: render thread %.2f ms, other threads %.2f ms; %s; ram working "
           "set %.0f MiB, private %.0f MiB; bound: %s",
           (unsigned long long)frame, gs, us, rw, ow, vs, ws, priv, bound);
}

int rt_ab(void) {
    static int64_t period = -1;   // us of world clock; 0: off
    if (period < 0) {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_AB");
        period = e && *e ? (int64_t)(atof(e) * 1e6) : 0;
    }
    int64_t w = period ? frame_step_world_us() : -1;
    if (w < 0) return 0;   // before the world clock: A
    int64_t k = w / period % 4;
    return k == 1 || k == 2;
}

int rt_knob(const char *name, const char *def) {
    char key[64];
    snprintf(key, sizeof key, "TOTK_%s", name);
    const char *e = cfg_get(key);
    if (!e || !*e) e = def;
    return !strcmp(e, "ab") ? 2 : strcmp(e, "0") != 0;
}

// TOTK_ONE_PER_CORE=1: the process keeps the first logical processor of each physical core, so busy threads (the
// render thread, the guest cores, the job workers) never share a core's execution units with another; "ab" switches
// it with the A/B blocks. Off by default until measured here; Savage Wind Recomp
// reported +4-10% from the same rule on an 8-core SMT CPU.
static void cpu_placement(void) {
    static int mode = -1, applied = -1;
    static uint64_t all, one;
    if (mode < 0) {
        mode = rt_knob("ONE_PER_CORE", "0");
        int cores = plat_cpu_cores(&all, &one);
        if (mode && one && one != all)
            rt_log("cpu: %d cores, %d logical processors: one per core%s", cores, __builtin_popcountll(all),
                   mode == 2 ? " in the B blocks" : "");
        else
            mode = 0;
    }
    int on = RT_KNOB_ON(mode);
    if (on == applied) return;
    applied = on;
    plat_process_affinity(on ? one : all);
}

void perf_present(uint64_t frame) {
    static uint64_t last, sum, max, n, win_start, ab_b;
    static int64_t win_prev[PERF_CNT_N];
    prof_render_tid = plat_thread_id();
    if (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_SCHED) kern_sched_report(frame);
    uint64_t now = kern_now_ns(), d = last ? now - last : 0;
    prof_sampler_frame(frame, now, last ? d : 0);
    uint64_t rep = ft_frame(frame, now, d);   // d is 0 on the first present: it only starts the period
    ab_b += rt_ab();
    cpu_placement();
    if (__atomic_load_n(&overlay, __ATOMIC_RELAXED))   // the overlay's only cost while it is off: this branch
        perfmon_frame(now, d, frame_ns, rep, __atomic_load_n(&counts[PERF_CNT_TEX_UP], __ATOMIC_RELAXED));
    kern_core_diag_frame(frame, d);
    if (flight_on) flight_frame(frame, now, d, frame_ns, counts);
    if (!(rt_trace & RT_TRACE_PERF)) {
        memset(frame_ns, 0, sizeof frame_ns);
        last = now;
        return;
    }
    static uint64_t slow_ns;   // TOTK_PERF_SLOW_MS (default 50): frames at least this long get a line of their own
    if (!slow_ns) {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_PERF_SLOW_MS");
        slow_ns = (uint64_t)(e && atoi(e) > 0 ? atoi(e) : 50) * 1000000ull;
    }
    if (last) {
        sum += d;
        n++;
        if (d > max) max = d, memcpy(worst_ns, frame_ns, sizeof worst_ns);
        if (d >= slow_ns)
            rt_log("perf: slow frame %llu: %.1f ms; blocked pipeline %.1f xlate %.1f texture %.1f astc %.1f fence %.1f pacing %.1f",
                   (unsigned long long)frame, d / 1e6, frame_ns[PERF_PIPE] / 1e6, frame_ns[PERF_XLATE] / 1e6,
                   frame_ns[PERF_TEX] / 1e6, frame_ns[PERF_ASTC] / 1e6, frame_ns[PERF_FENCE] / 1e6,
                   frame_ns[PERF_PACE] / 1e6);
    }
    memset(frame_ns, 0, sizeof frame_ns);
    last = now;
    if (!win_start) win_start = now;
    if (frame % 60) return;
    uint64_t span = now - win_start;
    int64_t win[PERF_CNT_N];
    for (int i = 0; i < PERF_CNT_N; i++) {
        int64_t v = __atomic_load_n(&counts[i], __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        win[i] = v - win_prev[i];
        win_prev[i] = v;
    }
    int64_t async = win[PERF_CNT_PIPE_ASYNC], skips = win[PERF_CNT_PIPE_SKIP], up = win[PERF_CNT_TEX_UP];
    int64_t reup = win[PERF_CNT_TEX_REUP], sskip = win[PERF_CNT_SHADER_SKIP], waited = win[PERF_CNT_PIPE_WAIT];
    int64_t oneshot = win[PERF_CNT_ONESHOT_WAIT];
    uint64_t shader_keys, shader_xlated;
    gfx_shader_counts(&shader_keys, &shader_xlated);
    if (n && span)
        rt_log("perf: frame %llu: interval avg %.2f ms max %.2f ms (%.1f fps); render thread blocked: pacing %.0f%% fence %.0f%% drain %.0f%% pipeline build %.0f%% shader xlate %.0f%% texture %.0f%% (astc %.0f%%); pipelines built in background %lld, draws skipped pending %lld, waited %lld, waiting for a shader %lld, one-shot waited %lld; textures uploaded %lld re-uploaded %lld; slowest frame: xlate %.1f ms texture %.1f ms (astc %.1f) pipeline %.1f ms fence %.1f ms; shaders: %llu keys, %llu translated; render busy avg %.2f ms; replay avg %.2f ms; ab %llu/%llu; world %.1f s",
               (unsigned long long)frame, sum / 1e6 / n, max / 1e6, n * 1e9 / sum, 100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_PACE] / span,
               100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_FENCE] / span, 100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_DRAIN] / span,
               100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_PIPE] / span, 100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_XLATE] / span,
               100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_TEX] / span, 100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_ASTC] / span, (long long)async, (long long)skips, (long long)waited, (long long)sskip, (long long)oneshot,
               (long long)up, (long long)reup, worst_ns[PERF_XLATE] / 1e6, worst_ns[PERF_TEX] / 1e6,
               worst_ns[PERF_ASTC] / 1e6, worst_ns[PERF_PIPE] / 1e6, worst_ns[PERF_FENCE] / 1e6,
               (unsigned long long)shader_keys, (unsigned long long)shader_xlated,
               (span > wait_ns[PERF_PACE] ? span - wait_ns[PERF_PACE] : 0) / 1e6 / n,
               plat_xchg64(&replay_ns, 0) / 1e6 / n, (unsigned long long)ab_b, (unsigned long long)n, frame_step_world_us() / 1e6);
    if (n && span) perf_gpu_line(frame, sum / 1e6 / n, (double)wait_ns[PERF_PACE] / span, n);
    sum = max = n = ab_b = 0;
    memset(wait_ns, 0, sizeof wait_ns);
    win_start = now;
}

```

`runtime/perfmon.c`:

```c
// Performance overlay numbers (runtime/perfmon.h). Frame times come from the game's presents (perf_present, only while
// the overlay is on); the per-frame waits from the perf counters prof_win.c keeps. The machine's numbers are sampled
// twice a second on a thread of their own (some calls take milliseconds), which runs only while the overlay is full.
// The OS calls sit behind platform.h (plat_cpu_load, plat_mem_info, plat_gpu_load). Temperature, power and clock come
// from the GPU vendor's driver library, loaded at run time: NVML on NVIDIA, ADL's PM log on AMD; on a machine without
// either their numbers stay -1.
//
// Adapted from SavageWindRecomp's runtime/perfmon.c (https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp @
// 575ad88e02f9a89a9a885d90039d48af33c982f4, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Revivedx and the Savage Wind Recomp contributors,
// Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai): the frame ring and its one-second summary, the NVML calls, the sampler loop. The
// Windows, Linux and macOS sampling moved behind platform.h, GPU load and video memory come from the system's counters
// for every vendor, and the sampler stops when the overlay leaves full.
//
// The ADL declarations (AdapterInfo, ADLSingleSensorData, ADLPMLogDataOutput, the ADL_PMLOG_* sensor numbers and the
// ADL2_* signatures) are copied from AMD's display-library include/adl_structures.h, adl_defines.h and adl_sdk.h
// (https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/display-library @ 84c881cb2136f04287eb3af12de00a9e2867aa9e, MIT,
// Copyright (c) 2016 - 2022 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "perfmon.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "sysinfo.h"

static PlatMutex g_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;   // everything below
static PerfStats g_stats;                    // the machine numbers the sampler wrote; the rest is made per snapshot

// ---- frames
static float g_ring[PERF_HISTORY];
static uint64_t g_ring_at[PERF_HISTORY];   // when each frame ended
static int g_ring_n, g_ring_pos;

// The lows: a histogram of the frame times (perf.c's 0.25 ms bins) over the last LOW_SLICES seconds, kept as one slice
// per second so the oldest second drops out whole. Per frame: one increment. The percentiles are read twice a second.
#define LOW_BINS 1024
#define LOW_SLICES 10
static uint16_t g_low_hist[LOW_SLICES][LOW_BINS];
static int g_low_cur;
static uint64_t g_low_t0;

// The per-frame counters, summed since t0 (the overlay's lines are averages over half a second).
static struct {
    uint64_t t0, frames, gpu0;
    double replay, pipe, xlate, tex;
    int64_t up0, up;
} g_win;

void perfmon_frame(uint64_t now, uint64_t interval_ns, const uint64_t *wait_ns, uint64_t replay_ns,
                   int64_t tex_uploads) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (interval_ns) {
        g_ring[g_ring_pos] = (float)(interval_ns / 1e6);
        g_ring_at[g_ring_pos] = now;
        g_ring_pos = (g_ring_pos + 1) % PERF_HISTORY;
        if (g_ring_n < PERF_HISTORY) g_ring_n++;
        if (now - g_low_t0 >= 1000000000ull) {   // the next second: its slice starts empty
            g_low_cur = (g_low_cur + 1) % LOW_SLICES;
            memset(g_low_hist[g_low_cur], 0, sizeof g_low_hist[0]);
            g_low_t0 = now;
        }
        uint64_t bin = interval_ns / 250000ull;
        uint16_t *h = &g_low_hist[g_low_cur][bin < LOW_BINS ? bin : LOW_BINS - 1];
        if (*h < 65535) (*h)++;
    }
    g_win.frames++;
    g_win.replay += replay_ns / 1e6;
    g_win.pipe += wait_ns[PERF_PIPE] / 1e6;
    g_win.xlate += wait_ns[PERF_XLATE] / 1e6;
    g_win.tex += wait_ns[PERF_TEX] / 1e6;
    g_win.up = tex_uploads;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

static void frames_summary(PerfStats *s, uint64_t now) {   // (lock held)
    double sum = 0, mx = 0;
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ring_n; i++) {
        int k = (g_ring_pos - 1 - i + PERF_HISTORY) % PERF_HISTORY;
        if (now - g_ring_at[k] > 1000000000ull) break;   // the last second
        sum += g_ring[k];
        if (g_ring[k] > mx) mx = g_ring[k];
        n++;
    }
    s->fps = n && sum > 0 ? (float)(n * 1000.0 / sum) : 0;
    s->frame_ms_avg = n ? (float)(sum / n) : 0;
    s->frame_ms_max = (float)mx;
    for (int i = 0; i < PERF_HISTORY; i++) {   // oldest first; frames not seen yet read 0
        int age = PERF_HISTORY - 1 - i;
        s->frame_ms[i] = age < g_ring_n ? g_ring[(g_ring_pos - 1 - age + 2 * PERF_HISTORY) % PERF_HISTORY] : 0;
    }
}

// The fps of the slowest 1% and 0.1% of the frames in the window (the bin's upper edge, as perf.c's summary does); -1
// when the window holds too few frames. (lock held)
static void lows_summary(PerfStats *s) {
    uint32_t total = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < LOW_SLICES; k++)
        for (int b = 0; b < LOW_BINS; b++) total += g_low_hist[k][b];
    s->low1_fps = s->low01_fps = -1;
    if (total < 100) return;
    uint32_t cut1 = (total + 99) / 100, cut01 = (total + 999) / 1000, acc = 0;
    for (int b = LOW_BINS - 1; b >= 0 && s->low1_fps < 0; b--) {
        for (int k = 0; k < LOW_SLICES; k++) acc += g_low_hist[k][b];
        float fps = 1000.0f / ((b + 1) * 0.25f);
        if (s->low01_fps < 0 && acc >= cut01) s->low01_fps = fps;
        if (acc >= cut1) s->low1_fps = fps;
    }
}

// Every half second: the window's sums as per-frame averages into g_stats, and a new window. (lock held)
static void counters_summary(uint64_t now) {
    if (now - g_win.t0 < 500000000ull) return;
    lows_summary(&g_stats);
    uint64_t gpu = perf_gpu_busy_total();
    if (g_win.t0 && g_win.frames) {
        double n = (double)g_win.frames;
        g_stats.replay_ms = (float)(g_win.replay / n);
        g_stats.pipe_wait_ms = (float)(g_win.pipe / n);
        g_stats.xlate_ms = (float)(g_win.xlate / n);
        g_stats.tex_ms = (float)(g_win.tex / n);
        g_stats.tex_uploads = (float)((g_win.up - g_win.up0) / n);
        // no GPU time over a window of frames: no timestamps on this device (or not yet set up)
        g_stats.gpu_ms = gpu > g_win.gpu0 ? (float)((gpu - g_win.gpu0) / 1e6 / n) : -1;
    }
    g_win.t0 = now;
    g_win.frames = 0;
    g_win.gpu0 = gpu;
    g_win.replay = g_win.pipe = g_win.xlate = g_win.tex = 0;
    g_win.up0 = g_win.up;
}

// ---- NVML (NVIDIA): loaded once on the sampler thread, kept for the process
typedef struct { unsigned gpu, memory; } NvmlUtil;
typedef struct { unsigned long long total, free, used; } NvmlMem;
static struct {
    int tried, ok;
    void *dev;
    int (*util)(void *, NvmlUtil *);
    int (*temp)(void *, int, unsigned *);
    int (*mem)(void *, NvmlMem *);
    int (*power)(void *, unsigned *);
    int (*clock)(void *, int, unsigned *);
} nv;

static char g_gpu_name[96];
static uint8_t g_gpu_luid[8];
static int g_gpu_luid_ok;
static int g_gpu_bus = -1;
static float g_vram_total_mb = -1;

void perfmon_set_gpu(const char *name, const uint8_t *luid, int pci_bus, float vram_total_mb) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    snprintf(g_gpu_name, sizeof g_gpu_name, "%s", name ? name : "");
    g_gpu_luid_ok = luid != NULL;
    if (luid) memcpy(g_gpu_luid, luid, sizeof g_gpu_luid);
    g_gpu_bus = pci_bus;
    g_vram_total_mb = vram_total_mb > 0 ? vram_total_mb : -1;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

static void nvml_open(const char *hint) {
    nv.tried = 1;
#ifdef _WIN32
    static const char *const names[] = {"nvml.dll", "C:\\Program Files\\NVIDIA Corporation\\NVSMI\\nvml.dll"};
#else
    static const char *const names[] = {"libnvidia-ml.so.1"};
#endif
    void *lib = NULL;
    for (size_t i = 0; !lib && i < sizeof names / sizeof *names; i++) lib = plat_lib_open(names[i]);
    if (!lib) return;
    int (*init)(void) = (int (*)(void))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlInit_v2");
    int (*count)(unsigned *) = (int (*)(unsigned *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetCount_v2");
    int (*handle)(unsigned, void **) = (int (*)(unsigned, void **))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex_v2");
    int (*name)(void *, char *, unsigned) = (int (*)(void *, char *, unsigned))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetName");
    nv.util = (int (*)(void *, NvmlUtil *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetUtilizationRates");
    nv.temp = (int (*)(void *, int, unsigned *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetTemperature");
    nv.mem = (int (*)(void *, NvmlMem *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo");
    nv.power = (int (*)(void *, unsigned *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetPowerUsage");
    nv.clock = (int (*)(void *, int, unsigned *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetClockInfo");
    if (!init || !count || !handle || init() != 0) return;
    unsigned n = 0;
    if (count(&n) != 0 || !n) return;
    // the device Vulkan renders on (by name; an NVIDIA name only matches an NVIDIA GPU), else none: on a machine
    // that renders on another vendor's GPU, NVML's numbers would belong to the wrong card
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n && !nv.dev; i++) {
        void *d = NULL;
        char nm[96] = "";
        if (handle(i, &d) != 0 || !name || name(d, nm, sizeof nm) != 0 || !nm[0]) continue;
        if (hint[0] && (strstr(hint, nm) || strstr(nm, hint))) nv.dev = d;
    }
    nv.ok = nv.dev != NULL;
    rt_log("perfmon: NVML %s", nv.ok ? "found the rendering GPU" : "has no device matching the rendering GPU");
}

static void nvml_sample(PerfStats *s) {
    if (!nv.ok) return;
    NvmlUtil u;
    NvmlMem m;
    unsigned v;
    if (s->gpu_pct < 0 && nv.util && nv.util(nv.dev, &u) == 0) s->gpu_pct = (float)u.gpu;   // the system's counters first
    if (nv.mem && nv.mem(nv.dev, &m) == 0) {
        if (s->vram_used_mb < 0) s->vram_used_mb = (float)(m.used >> 20);
        s->vram_total_mb = (float)(m.total >> 20);
    }
    if (nv.temp && nv.temp(nv.dev, 0 /* NVML_TEMPERATURE_GPU */, &v) == 0) s->gpu_temp_c = (float)v;
    if (nv.power && nv.power(nv.dev, &v) == 0) s->gpu_power_w = v / 1000.0f;
    if (nv.clock && nv.clock(nv.dev, 0 /* NVML_CLOCK_GRAPHICS */, &v) == 0) s->gpu_clock_mhz = (float)v;
}

// ---- ADL (AMD): loaded once on the sampler thread, kept for the process. ADL2_New_QueryPMLogData_Get reads the PM log
// the driver keeps for Radeon RX 5000 and later (the numbers Adrenalin's overlay shows); older GPUs answer with an
// error and their numbers stay -1. Windows only: the Linux driver gives these through sysfs, which this does not read.
#ifdef _WIN32
#define ADL_MAX_PATH 256
#define ADL_PMLOG_MAX_SENSORS 256
enum {
    ADL_PMLOG_CLK_GFXCLK = 1,
    ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_EDGE = 8,
    ADL_PMLOG_INFO_ACTIVITY_GFX = 19,
    ADL_PMLOG_ASIC_POWER = 23,
    ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_HOTSPOT = 27,
    ADL_PMLOG_BOARD_POWER = 73,
};
typedef struct {   // AdapterInfo, the Windows layout
    int iSize, iAdapterIndex;
    char strUDID[ADL_MAX_PATH];
    int iBusNumber, iDeviceNumber, iFunctionNumber, iVendorID;
    char strAdapterName[ADL_MAX_PATH], strDisplayName[ADL_MAX_PATH];
    int iPresent, iExist;
    char strDriverPath[ADL_MAX_PATH], strDriverPathExt[ADL_MAX_PATH], strPNPString[ADL_MAX_PATH];
    int iOSDisplayIndex;
} AdlAdapterInfo;
typedef struct { int supported, value; } AdlSensor;
typedef struct { int size; AdlSensor sensors[ADL_PMLOG_MAX_SENSORS]; } AdlPmLog;
typedef void *(__stdcall *AdlAlloc)(int);

static struct {
    int tried, ok, index;
    void *ctx;
    int (*pmlog)(void *, int, AdlPmLog *);
    AdlPmLog log;   // the sampler thread's buffer
} adl;

static void *__stdcall adl_alloc(int n) { return malloc((size_t)n); }

// The adapter Vulkan renders on: the PCI bus when the device gave one, else the name. ADL lists one index per display
// output of a GPU; the first whose PM log answers is taken.
static void adl_open(const char *hint, int bus) {
    adl.tried = 1;
    void *lib = plat_lib_open("atiadlxx.dll");
    if (!lib) return;
    int (*create)(AdlAlloc, int, void **) = (int (*)(AdlAlloc, int, void **))plat_lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_Main_Control_Create");
    int (*count)(void *, int *) = (int (*)(void *, int *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_Adapter_NumberOfAdapters_Get");
    int (*info)(void *, AdlAdapterInfo *, int) =
        (int (*)(void *, AdlAdapterInfo *, int))plat_lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_Adapter_AdapterInfo_Get");
    adl.pmlog = (int (*)(void *, int, AdlPmLog *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_New_QueryPMLogData_Get");
    int n = 0;
    if (!create || !count || !info || !adl.pmlog || create(adl_alloc, 1, &adl.ctx) != 0 || count(adl.ctx, &n) != 0 ||
        n <= 0 || n > 256)
        return;
    AdlAdapterInfo *a = (AdlAdapterInfo *)calloc((size_t)n, sizeof *a);
    if (a) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].iSize = sizeof *a;
        if (info(adl.ctx, a, n * (int)sizeof *a) == 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n && !adl.ok; i++) {
                if (a[i].iVendorID != 1002) continue;   // ADL writes the PCI vendor id 0x1002 as decimal 1002
                const char *nm = a[i].strAdapterName;
                if (bus >= 0 ? a[i].iBusNumber != bus : !hint[0] || !nm[0] || !(strstr(hint, nm) || strstr(nm, hint)))
                    continue;
                memset(&adl.log, 0, sizeof adl.log);
                adl.log.size = sizeof adl.log;
                if (adl.pmlog(adl.ctx, a[i].iAdapterIndex, &adl.log) != 0) continue;
                adl.index = a[i].iAdapterIndex;
                adl.ok = 1;
            }
        }
        free(a);
    }
    rt_log("perfmon: ADL %s", adl.ok ? "found the rendering GPU" : "has no PM log for the rendering GPU");
}

static void adl_sample(PerfStats *s) {
    if (!adl.ok) return;
    memset(&adl.log, 0, sizeof adl.log);
    adl.log.size = sizeof adl.log;
    if (adl.pmlog(adl.ctx, adl.index, &adl.log) != 0) return;
    const AdlSensor *v = adl.log.sensors;
    if (s->gpu_pct < 0 && v[ADL_PMLOG_INFO_ACTIVITY_GFX].supported)   // the system's counters first
        s->gpu_pct = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_INFO_ACTIVITY_GFX].value;
    if (v[ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_EDGE].supported) s->gpu_temp_c = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_EDGE].value;
    else if (v[ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_HOTSPOT].supported) s->gpu_temp_c = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_HOTSPOT].value;
    // the whole card's draw where the driver reports it (RDNA 4 reports no ASIC power), else the GPU chip's
    if (v[ADL_PMLOG_BOARD_POWER].supported) s->gpu_power_w = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_BOARD_POWER].value;
    else if (v[ADL_PMLOG_ASIC_POWER].supported) s->gpu_power_w = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_ASIC_POWER].value;
    if (v[ADL_PMLOG_CLK_GFXCLK].supported) s->gpu_clock_mhz = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_CLK_GFXCLK].value;
}
#else
static struct { int tried; } adl;
static void adl_open(const char *hint, int bus) { (void)hint, (void)bus, adl.tried = 1; }
static void adl_sample(PerfStats *s) { (void)s; }
#endif

// ---- the machine sampler: runs while want is set, twice a second
static struct {
    int want, alive;
    PlatCond cv;
} g_smp = {0, 0, PLAT_COND_INIT};

static void machine_clear(PerfStats *s) {
    s->cpu_total_pct = s->cpu_game_pct = s->cpu_temp_c = -1;
    s->ram_used_mb = s->ram_total_mb = s->ram_game_mb = -1;
    s->gpu_pct = s->gpu_temp_c = s->gpu_power_w = s->gpu_clock_mhz = s->vram_used_mb = s->vram_total_mb = -1;
}

static void machine_copy(PerfStats *d, const PerfStats *s) {
    memcpy(d->cpu_name, s->cpu_name, sizeof d->cpu_name);
    memcpy(d->gpu_name, s->gpu_name, sizeof d->gpu_name);
    d->cpu_total_pct = s->cpu_total_pct, d->cpu_game_pct = s->cpu_game_pct, d->cpu_temp_c = s->cpu_temp_c;
    d->ram_used_mb = s->ram_used_mb, d->ram_total_mb = s->ram_total_mb, d->ram_game_mb = s->ram_game_mb;
    d->gpu_pct = s->gpu_pct, d->gpu_temp_c = s->gpu_temp_c, d->gpu_power_w = s->gpu_power_w;
    d->gpu_clock_mhz = s->gpu_clock_mhz, d->vram_used_mb = s->vram_used_mb, d->vram_total_mb = s->vram_total_mb;
}

static void sampler(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    PerfStats s;
    memset(&s, 0, sizeof s);
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    uint8_t luid[8];
    int have_luid = g_gpu_luid_ok;
    memcpy(luid, g_gpu_luid, sizeof luid);
    snprintf(s.gpu_name, sizeof s.gpu_name, "%s", g_gpu_name);
    int bus = g_gpu_bus;
    float vram_total = g_vram_total_mb;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    sysinfo_cpu_name(s.cpu_name, sizeof s.cpu_name);
    if (!nv.tried) nvml_open(s.gpu_name);
    if (!nv.ok && !adl.tried) adl_open(s.gpu_name, bus);
    PlatLoad *l = plat_load_open(have_luid ? luid : NULL, bus);
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    while (g_smp.want) {
        plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
        machine_clear(&s);
        plat_cpu_load(l, &s.cpu_total_pct, &s.cpu_game_pct, &s.cpu_temp_c);
        plat_mem_info(&s.ram_used_mb, &s.ram_total_mb, &s.ram_game_mb);
        plat_gpu_load(l, &s.gpu_pct, &s.vram_used_mb);
        s.vram_total_mb = vram_total;
        nvml_sample(&s);
        adl_sample(&s);
        plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
        machine_copy(&g_stats, &s);
        if (g_smp.want) plat_cond_wait_ns(&g_smp.cv, &g_lock, 500000000ull);
    }
    g_smp.alive = 0;   // in the same locked section as the last want check: a new perfmon_mode(2) starts a new thread
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    plat_load_close(l);
}

void perfmon_mode(int mode) {
    perf_set_overlay(mode);
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (mode == 2) {
        g_smp.want = 1;
        if (!g_smp.alive) {
            machine_clear(&g_stats);   // "-" until the first sample, not the numbers of the last time
            PlatThread *t = plat_thread_new(sampler, NULL, "perfmon");
            g_smp.alive = t != NULL;
            if (t) plat_thread_detach(t);
            else rt_log("perfmon: cannot start the sampling thread; the machine numbers stay empty");
        }
    } else {
        g_smp.want = 0;
        plat_cond_signal(&g_smp.cv);
    }
    if (!mode) {   // the next start begins a new graph and a new counter window
        g_ring_n = g_ring_pos = 0;
        memset(g_low_hist, 0, sizeof g_low_hist);
        g_low_t0 = 0;
        memset(&g_win, 0, sizeof g_win);
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

void perfmon_snapshot(PerfStats *out) {
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    frames_summary(&g_stats, now);
    counters_summary(now);
    *out = g_stats;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}
```

`runtime/perfmon.h`:

```h
// Performance overlay numbers (runtime/perfmon.c): the game's frame rate and frame times, the render thread's waits
// from the perf counters, and the machine's CPU, memory and GPU load and temperatures. A value the machine does not give
// is negative.
//
// Adapted from SavageWindRecomp's runtime/perfmon.h (https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp @
// 575ad88e02f9a89a9a885d90039d48af33c982f4, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Revivedx and the Savage Wind Recomp contributors,
// Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define PERF_HISTORY 120   // frame times kept for the graph

typedef struct {
    // the game's frames (presents), over the last second
    float fps, frame_ms_avg, frame_ms_max;
    // fps of the slowest 1% and 0.1% of the frames over the last ten seconds (-1: too few frames yet)
    float low1_fps, low01_fps;
    float frame_ms[PERF_HISTORY];   // oldest first
    // CPU: the whole machine and this process, percent of all logical processors
    char cpu_name[64];
    float cpu_total_pct, cpu_game_pct, cpu_temp_c;
    // memory, MB
    float ram_used_mb, ram_total_mb, ram_game_mb;
    // GPU: load and dedicated memory from the system's counters, temperature, power and clock from NVML (NVIDIA) or
    // ADL (AMD)
    char gpu_name[96];
    float gpu_pct, gpu_temp_c, gpu_power_w, gpu_clock_mhz, vram_used_mb, vram_total_mb;
    // per frame, averaged over the last half second: replay (NVN to Vulkan recording), GPU busy time (timestamps; -1
    // without them), the render thread's waits for pipeline builds, shader translation and texture uploads, and the
    // textures uploaded
    float replay_ms, gpu_ms, pipe_wait_ms, xlate_ms, tex_ms, tex_uploads;
} PerfStats;

// Overlay mode 0 off, 1 fps, 2 full (TOTK_PERF_OVERLAY), from the present path when the setting changes. Full starts
// the machine sampling thread (twice a second) and turns on the event counts and GPU timestamps; leaving full stops
// them. Off: perf_present skips perfmon_frame and nothing samples.
void perfmon_mode(int mode);
// The Vulkan device the game renders on: its name, its LUID (8 bytes; NULL when the driver gives none), its PCI bus
// (-1 unknown) and its device-local memory. Before the first perfmon_mode(2).
void perfmon_set_gpu(const char *name, const uint8_t *luid, int pci_bus, float vram_total_mb);
// A game frame was presented (perf_present, the render thread, only while the overlay is on): the time since the last
// one, the render thread's waits of this frame (PERF_N entries, host.h), its replay time and the running count of
// texture uploads.
void perfmon_frame(uint64_t now_ns, uint64_t interval_ns, const uint64_t *wait_ns, uint64_t replay_ns,
                   int64_t tex_uploads);
// The latest numbers (the overlay, present path).
void perfmon_snapshot(PerfStats *out);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

`runtime/platform/common.c`:

```c
// The parts of platform.h built on its locks rather than on the OS: recursive mutexes, one-time initialisation and
// events. Every OS shares them.
#include "platform.h"

// ---- recursive mutex: owner is the holder's thread id (0 when free); only the holder writes depth.

void plat_rmutex_lock(PlatRMutex *m) {
    uint32_t me = plat_thread_id();
    if (__atomic_load_n(&m->owner, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) == me) {
        m->depth++;
        return;
    }
    plat_mutex_lock(&m->m);
    __atomic_store_n(&m->owner, me, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    m->depth = 1;
}

void plat_rmutex_unlock(PlatRMutex *m) {
    if (--m->depth) return;
    __atomic_store_n(&m->owner, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&m->m);
}

// ---- once: state 0 not run, 1 running, 2 done. Waiters for a running initialiser sleep on one process-wide
// condition variable; initialisers are rare and short.

static PlatMutex once_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
static PlatCond once_done = PLAT_COND_INIT;

void plat_once(PlatOnce *o, void (*fn)(void *arg), void *arg) {
    if (__atomic_load_n(&o->state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == 2) return;
    int32_t expected = 0;
    if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(&o->state, &expected, 1, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {
        fn(arg);
        plat_mutex_lock(&once_lock);
        __atomic_store_n(&o->state, 2, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        plat_cond_broadcast(&once_done);
        plat_mutex_unlock(&once_lock);
        return;
    }
    plat_mutex_lock(&once_lock);
    while (__atomic_load_n(&o->state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) != 2) plat_cond_wait(&once_done, &once_lock);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&once_lock);
}

// ---- events

void plat_event_init(PlatEvent *e, int manual, int initially_set) {
    plat_mutex_init(&e->m);
    plat_cond_init(&e->c);
    e->manual = manual;
    e->set = initially_set;
}

void plat_event_set(PlatEvent *e) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&e->m);
    e->set = 1;
    if (e->manual) plat_cond_broadcast(&e->c);
    else plat_cond_signal(&e->c);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&e->m);
}

void plat_event_reset(PlatEvent *e) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&e->m);
    e->set = 0;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&e->m);
}

void plat_event_wait(PlatEvent *e) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&e->m);
    while (!e->set) plat_cond_wait(&e->c, &e->m);
    if (!e->manual) e->set = 0;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&e->m);
}

int plat_event_wait_ns(PlatEvent *e, uint64_t ns) {
    uint64_t end = plat_now_ns() + ns;
    plat_mutex_lock(&e->m);
    while (!e->set) {
        uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
        if (now >= end) break;
        plat_cond_wait_ns(&e->c, &e->m, end - now);
    }
    int got = e->set;
    if (got && !e->manual) e->set = 0;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&e->m);
    return got;
}
```

```h
// FP control on x86-64: MXCSR (rounding control bits 13-14, FTZ bit 15, DAZ bit 6, exception flags and masks).
// Inline on purpose: lifted FP code (simd.h) reads and writes it on every operation that depends on the guest FPCR.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include <xmmintrin.h>

#define PLAT_FP_RC_MASK 0x6000u   // rounding control: 0 nearest, 0x2000 down, 0x4000 up, 0x6000 toward zero
#define PLAT_FP_FTZ 0x8000u
#define PLAT_FP_DAZ 0x0040u

static inline uint32_t plat_fp_get(void) { return _mm_getcsr(); }
static inline void plat_fp_set(uint32_t v) { _mm_setcsr(v); }
```

```c
// Linux implementation of platform.h: pthreads, CLOCK_MONOTONIC, futex locks and condition variables, POSIX files,
// /proc and sysfs for the load counters, posix_spawn for child processes.
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <dirent.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <linux/fs.h>
#include <linux/futex.h>
#include <linux/userfaultfd.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <spawn.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <sys/mman.h>
```
