```h
// ---- precision conversions (FCVT, FCVTL/N, FCVTXN); FZ flushes single/double inputs, never halves
SI double simd_s2d(Cpu *c, float x) {
    uint32_t u = fb_s(fz_s(c, x));
    if (isnan_s(u)) {
        if (c->fpcr & FPCR_DN) return fv_d(0x7ff8000000000000ull);
        return fv_d(((uint64_t)(u >> 31) << 63) | 0x7ff8000000000000ull | ((uint64_t)(u & 0x3fffff) << 29));
    }
    return (double)fv_s(u);
}
SN float simd_d2s_slow(Cpu *c, double x) {
#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS ON
    unsigned old = simd_rm_enter(c->fpcr);
    volatile double vx = x;
    volatile float r = (float)vx;
    simd_rm_leave(old);
    return r;
}
SI float simd_d2s(Cpu *c, double x) {
    uint64_t u = fb_d(fz_d(c, x));
    if (isnan_d(u)) {
        if (c->fpcr & FPCR_DN) return fv_s(0x7fc00000u);
        return fv_s((uint32_t)(u >> 63) << 31 | 0x7fc00000u | (uint32_t)((u >> 29) & 0x3fffff));
    }
    x = fv_d(u);
    // FZ: tiny before rounding (host FTZ would keep a result rounded up to the smallest normal)
    if ((c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ) && __builtin_fabs(x) < 0x1p-126 && x != 0) return fv_s((uint32_t)(u >> 63) << 31);
    if (__builtin_expect(c->fpcr & FPCR_RM, 0)) return simd_d2s_slow(c, x);
    return (float)x;
}
// round to odd (FCVTXN)
SI float simd_d2s_odd(Cpu *c, double x) {
    uint64_t u = fb_d(fz_d(c, x));
    if (isnan_d(u)) return simd_d2s(c, x);
    x = fv_d(u);
    if ((c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ) && __builtin_fabs(x) < 0x1p-126 && x != 0) return fv_s((uint32_t)(u >> 63) << 31);
    float f = (float)x;
    if ((double)f != x && x == x) {
        uint32_t b = fb_s(f);
        if (__builtin_fabs((double)f) > __builtin_fabs(x)) b--;
        return fv_s(b | 1);
    }
    return f;
}
SI uint64_t simd_rnd_shift(uint64_t m, int sh, int rm, int neg) {
    if (sh >= 64) return (rm == 1 && !neg && m) || (rm == 2 && neg && m);
    uint64_t q = m >> sh, rem = m & ((1ull << sh) - 1), half = 1ull << (sh - 1);
    if (rm == 0) q += rem > half || (rem == half && (q & 1));
    else if (rm == 1) q += rem && !neg;
    else if (rm == 2) q += rem && neg;
    return q;
}
// double (exact image of the single/double source, NaN payload left-aligned) -> half, FPCR rounding
SI uint16_t simd_d2h(Cpu *c, uint64_t u) {
    uint64_t fpcr = c->fpcr;
    int ahp = !!(fpcr & FPCR_AHP), rm = (fpcr >> 22) & 3, neg = (int)(u >> 63);
    uint16_t s = (uint16_t)(neg << 15);
    int e = (int)((u >> 52) & 0x7ff);
    uint64_t f = u & ((1ull << 52) - 1);
    if (e == 0x7ff) {
        if (f) return ahp ? s : (fpcr & FPCR_DN) ? 0x7e00 : (uint16_t)(s | 0x7e00 | (f >> 42));
        return ahp ? (uint16_t)(s | 0x7fff) : (uint16_t)(s | 0x7c00);
    }
    if (!e && !f) return s;
    uint64_t m = e ? f | (1ull << 52) : f;
    int E = e ? e - 1075 : -1074, ue = e ? e - 1023 : -1023;
    uint64_t q;
    int bits;
    if (ue < -14) {
        q = simd_rnd_shift(m, -24 - E, rm, neg);
        bits = (int)q;
    } else {
        q = simd_rnd_shift(m, 42, rm, neg);
        bits = ((ue + 14) << 10) + (int)q;
    }
    if (ahp) return (uint16_t)(s | (bits > 0x7fff ? 0x7fff : bits));
    if (bits >= 0x7c00) {
        int inf = rm == 0 || (rm == 1 && !neg) || (rm == 2 && neg);
        return (uint16_t)(s | (inf ? 0x7c00 : 0x7bff));
    }
    return (uint16_t)(s | bits);
}
SI uint16_t simd_s2h(Cpu *c, float x) {
    uint32_t u = fb_s(fz_s(c, x));
    uint64_t d = isnan_s(u) ? ((uint64_t)(u >> 31) << 63) | 0x7ff0000000000000ull | ((uint64_t)(u & 0x7fffff) << 29)
                            : fb_d((double)fv_s(u));
    return simd_d2h(c, d);
}
SI uint16_t simd_dd2h(Cpu *c, double x) { return simd_d2h(c, fb_d(fz_d(c, x))); }
SI uint64_t simd_h2dbits(Cpu *c, uint16_t h) {
    uint64_t s = (uint64_t)(h >> 15) << 63;
    int e = (h >> 10) & 31, f = h & 0x3ff;
    if (e == 31 && !(c->fpcr & FPCR_AHP)) {
        if (!f) return s | 0x7ff0000000000000ull;
        if (c->fpcr & FPCR_DN) return 0x7ff8000000000000ull;
        return s | 0x7ff8000000000000ull | ((uint64_t)f << 42);
    }
    if (!e) return fb_d((s ? -1.0 : 1.0) * f * 0x1p-24);
    return s | ((uint64_t)(e - 15 + 1023) << 52) | ((uint64_t)f << 42);
}
SI double simd_h2d(Cpu *c, uint16_t h) { return fv_d(simd_h2dbits(c, h)); }
SI float simd_h2s(Cpu *c, uint16_t h) {
    uint64_t d = simd_h2dbits(c, h);
    if (isnan_d(d)) return fv_s((uint32_t)(d >> 63) << 31 | 0x7fc00000u | (uint32_t)((d >> 29) & 0x3fffff));
    return (float)fv_d(d);
}

// ---- scalar FP instructions (FP data processing)
#define FP_SETS(d, x) (c->v[d] = fb_s(x))
#define FP_SETD(d, x) (c->v[d] = fb_d(x))
SI void fp_op_s(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n, int m) { FP_SETS(d, op_s(c, op, VSF32(n), VSF32(m), 0)); }
SI void fp_op_d(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n, int m) { FP_SETD(d, op_d(c, op, VSF64(n), VSF64(m), 0)); }
// FMADD family: neg_a / neg_n negate the addend / first factor before the fused op
SI void fp_fma_s(Cpu *c, int na, int nn, int d, int n, int m, int a) {
    float x = VSF32(a), y = VSF32(n);
    if (na) x = neg_s(x);
    if (nn) y = neg_s(y);
    FP_SETS(d, op_s(c, FOP_MADD, x, y, VSF32(m)));
}
SI void fp_fma_d(Cpu *c, int na, int nn, int d, int n, int m, int a) {
    double x = VSF64(a), y = VSF64(n);
    if (na) x = neg_d(x);
    if (nn) y = neg_d(y);
    FP_SETD(d, op_d(c, FOP_MADD, x, y, VSF64(m)));
}

// ---- integer lanes (complex ops run lane by lane; constant sizes fold to plain loads/stores)
SI uint64_t lmask(int sz) { return sz == 3 ? ~0ull : (1ull << (8 << sz)) - 1; }
SI int64_t lsx(uint64_t v, int sz) { int s = 64 - (8 << sz); return (int64_t)(v << s) >> s; }
SI uint64_t lget(const u128 *v, int sz, int i) {
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)v + (i << sz);
    switch (sz) {
    case 0: return *p;
    case 1: return *(const sa16 *)p;
    case 2: return *(const sa32 *)p;
    default: return *(const sa64 *)p;
    }
}
SI void lset(u128 *v, int sz, int i, uint64_t x) {
    uint8_t *p = (uint8_t *)v + (i << sz);
    switch (sz) {
    case 0: *p = (uint8_t)x; break;
    case 1: *(sa16 *)p = (uint16_t)x; break;
    case 2: *(sa32 *)p = (uint32_t)x; break;
    default: *(sa64 *)p = x; break;
    }
}
SI uint64_t sat_s(__int128 v, int sz) {
    __int128 hi = ((__int128)1 << ((8 << sz) - 1)) - 1, lo = -hi - 1;
    return (uint64_t)(v > hi ? hi : v < lo ? lo : v) & lmask(sz);
}
SI uint64_t sat_u(__int128 v, int sz) {
    __int128 hi = ((__int128)1 << (8 << sz)) - 1;
    return (uint64_t)(v > hi ? hi : v < 0 ? 0 : v);
}
SI uint64_t sat_uu(unsigned __int128 v, int sz) { return v > lmask(sz) ? lmask(sz) : (uint64_t)v; }
SI __int128 shl128(__int128 v, int s) { return (__int128)((unsigned __int128)v << s); }
// right shift by s >= 1 with optional rounding, as an infinite-precision value
SI __int128 lshr_s(int64_t v, int s, int rnd) {
    if (s > 100) s = 100;
    return rnd ? ((__int128)v + ((__int128)1 << (s - 1))) >> s : (__int128)v >> s;
}
SI unsigned __int128 lshr_u(uint64_t v, int s, int rnd) {
    if (s > 100) s = 100;
    return rnd ? ((unsigned __int128)v + ((unsigned __int128)1 << (s - 1))) >> s : (unsigned __int128)v >> s;
}
SI uint64_t pmul64(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t *hi) { // carry-less
    uint64_t lo = 0, h = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++)
        if ((b >> i) & 1) lo ^= a << i, h ^= i ? a >> (64 - i) : 0;
    if (hi) *hi = h;
    return lo;
}

enum {
    LOP_SQADD, LOP_UQADD, LOP_SQSUB, LOP_UQSUB, LOP_SUQADD, LOP_USQADD,
    LOP_SHL, LOP_RSHL, LOP_QSHL, LOP_QRSHL, // register shifts (b = signed byte), U selects unsigned
    LOP_SHLI, LOP_QSHLI, LOP_QSHLUI, LOP_SHRI, LOP_RSHRI, LOP_SRAI, LOP_RSRAI, LOP_SRI, LOP_SLI,
    LOP_SQDMULH, LOP_SQRDMULH, LOP_PMUL,
    LOP_SQABS, LOP_SQNEG, LOP_ABS, LOP_NEG, LOP_CLS, LOP_CLZ, LOP_CNT, LOP_RBIT, LOP_URECPE, LOP_URSQRTE,
    LOP_HADD, LOP_RHADD, LOP_HSUB, LOP_ABD, LOP_ABA,
    // long: result lanes sz+1
    LOP_ADDL, LOP_SUBL, LOP_ABDL, LOP_ABAL, LOP_MLAL, LOP_MLSL, LOP_MULL, LOP_ADDW, LOP_SUBW,
    LOP_SQDMULL, LOP_SQDMLAL, LOP_SQDMLSL, LOP_PMULL, LOP_SHLL,
    // narrow: sz = destination lane size, a/b are sz+1
    LOP_XTN, LOP_SQXTN, LOP_UQXTN, LOP_SQXTUN, LOP_SHRN, LOP_RSHRN, LOP_QSHRN, LOP_QRSHRN, LOP_QSHRUN,
    LOP_QRSHRUN, LOP_ADDHN, LOP_RADDHN, LOP_SUBHN, LOP_RSUBHN,
    LOP_SHLLI, // SSHLL/USHLL: extend, shift (long)
};
#define LOP_U 256 // unsigned variant flag

SI uint64_t lop(int op, int sz, uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t d) {
    int u = op >> 8, es = 8 << sz;
    op &= 255;
    int64_t sa = lsx(a, sz), sb = lsx(b, sz);
    __int128 xa = u ? (__int128)a : (__int128)sa, xb = u ? (__int128)b : (__int128)sb; // extended operands
    int sh = (int8_t)b;
    switch (op) {
    case LOP_SQADD: return sat_s((__int128)sa + sb, sz);
    case LOP_UQADD: return sat_u((__int128)a + b, sz);
    case LOP_SQSUB: return sat_s((__int128)sa - sb, sz);
    case LOP_UQSUB: return sat_u((__int128)a - b, sz);
    case LOP_SUQADD: return sat_s((__int128)lsx(d, sz) + a, sz);
    case LOP_USQADD: return sat_u((__int128)d + sa, sz);
    case LOP_SHL: case LOP_RSHL: case LOP_QSHL: case LOP_QRSHL: {
        int sat = op == LOP_QSHL || op == LOP_QRSHL, rnd = op == LOP_RSHL || op == LOP_QRSHL;
        if (sh >= 0) {
            if (sat) return u ? sat_uu((unsigned __int128)a << (sh > 64 ? 64 : sh), sz)
                              : sat_s(shl128(sa, sh > 64 ? 64 : sh), sz);
            return sh >= es ? 0 : a << sh;
        }
        return u ? (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, -sh, rnd) : (uint64_t)lshr_s(sa, -sh, rnd);
    }
    case LOP_SHLI: return a << b;
    case LOP_QSHLI: return u ? sat_uu((unsigned __int128)a << b, sz) : sat_s(shl128(sa, (int)b), sz);
    case LOP_QSHLUI: return sat_u(shl128(sa, (int)b), sz);
    case LOP_SHRI: return u ? (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, (int)b, 0) : (uint64_t)lshr_s(sa, (int)b, 0);
    case LOP_RSHRI: return u ? (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, (int)b, 1) : (uint64_t)lshr_s(sa, (int)b, 1);
    case LOP_SRAI: return d + (u ? (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, (int)b, 0) : (uint64_t)lshr_s(sa, (int)b, 0));
    case LOP_RSRAI: return d + (u ? (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, (int)b, 1) : (uint64_t)lshr_s(sa, (int)b, 1));
    case LOP_SRI: {
        uint64_t m = (int)b >= es ? 0 : lmask(sz) >> b;
        return (d & ~m) | ((int)b >= es ? 0 : a >> b);
    }
    case LOP_SLI: { uint64_t m = (lmask(sz) << b) & lmask(sz); return (d & ~m) | ((a << b) & m); }
    case LOP_SQDMULH: return sat_s(((__int128)sa * sb * 2) >> es, sz);
    case LOP_SQRDMULH: return sat_s(((__int128)sa * sb * 2 + ((__int128)1 << (es - 1))) >> es, sz);
    case LOP_PMUL: return pmul64(a, b, 0);
    case LOP_SQABS: return sat_s(sa < 0 ? -(__int128)sa : sa, sz);
    case LOP_SQNEG: return sat_s(-(__int128)sa, sz);
    case LOP_ABS: return sa < 0 ? (uint64_t)-sa : (uint64_t)sa;
    case LOP_NEG: return -a;
    case LOP_CLS: {
        uint64_t x = (uint64_t)(sa ^ (sa >> 1)) & lmask(sz);
        return (x ? (uint64_t)__builtin_clzll(x << (64 - es)) : (uint64_t)es) - 1;
    }
    case LOP_CLZ: return a ? (uint64_t)__builtin_clzll(a << (64 - es)) : (uint64_t)es;
    case LOP_CNT: return (uint64_t)__builtin_popcountll(a);
    case LOP_RBIT: return __builtin_bitreverse8((uint8_t)a);
    case LOP_URECPE: return (a >> 31) ? (uint64_t)(256 | simd_recip_tab[(a >> 23) & 255]) << 23 : 0xffffffffull;
    case LOP_URSQRTE: return (a >> 30) ? (uint64_t)(256 | simd_rsqrt_tab[((a >> 23) & 511) - 128]) << 23 : 0xffffffffull;
    case LOP_HADD: return (uint64_t)((xa + xb) >> 1);
    case LOP_RHADD: return (uint64_t)((xa + xb + 1) >> 1);
    case LOP_HSUB: return (uint64_t)((xa - xb) >> 1);
    case LOP_ABD: return (uint64_t)(xa > xb ? xa - xb : xb - xa);
    case LOP_ABA: return d + (uint64_t)(xa > xb ? xa - xb : xb - xa);
    case LOP_ADDL: return (uint64_t)(xa + xb);
    case LOP_SUBL: return (uint64_t)(xa - xb);
    case LOP_ABDL: return (uint64_t)(xa > xb ? xa - xb : xb - xa);
    case LOP_ABAL: return d + (uint64_t)(xa > xb ? xa - xb : xb - xa);
    case LOP_MLAL: return d + (uint64_t)(xa * xb);
    case LOP_MLSL: return d - (uint64_t)(xa * xb);
    case LOP_MULL: return (uint64_t)(xa * xb);
    case LOP_ADDW: return a + (uint64_t)xb;
    case LOP_SUBW: return a - (uint64_t)xb;
    case LOP_SQDMULL: return sat_s((__int128)sa * sb * 2, sz + 1);
    case LOP_SQDMLAL: return sat_s((__int128)lsx(d, sz + 1) + (__int128)lsx(sat_s((__int128)sa * sb * 2, sz + 1), sz + 1), sz + 1);
    case LOP_SQDMLSL: return sat_s((__int128)lsx(d, sz + 1) - (__int128)lsx(sat_s((__int128)sa * sb * 2, sz + 1), sz + 1), sz + 1);
    case LOP_PMULL: return pmul64(a, b, 0);
    case LOP_SHLL: return a << es;
    // narrowing: a (and b for xHN) are 2*es wide
    case LOP_XTN: return a;
    case LOP_SQXTN: return sat_s(lsx(a, sz + 1), sz);
    case LOP_UQXTN: return sat_u(a, sz);
    case LOP_SQXTUN: return sat_u(lsx(a, sz + 1), sz);
    case LOP_SHRN: return a >> b;
    case LOP_RSHRN: return (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, (int)b, 1);
    case LOP_QSHRN: case LOP_QRSHRN: {
        int rnd = op == LOP_QRSHRN;
        return u ? sat_u((__int128)lshr_u(a, (int)b, rnd), sz) : sat_s(lshr_s(lsx(a, sz + 1), (int)b, rnd), sz);
    }
    case LOP_QSHRUN: return sat_u(lshr_s(lsx(a, sz + 1), (int)b, 0), sz);
    case LOP_QRSHRUN: return sat_u(lshr_s(lsx(a, sz + 1), (int)b, 1), sz);
    case LOP_ADDHN: return (a + b) >> es;
    case LOP_RADDHN: return (a + b + (1ull << (es - 1))) >> es;
    case LOP_SUBHN: return (a - b) >> es;
    case LOP_RSUBHN: return (a - b + (1ull << (es - 1))) >> es;
    case LOP_SHLLI: return (uint64_t)xa << b;
    }
    return 0;
}

// Generic lane loop: ne lanes; result lane i (size szd) goes to lane offd+i of d (other lanes kept when keep,
// else zero); a = n lane offn+i (size szn), b = m lane offm+i (size szm), or lane bidx of m when bidx >= 0,
// or the constant bimm when m < 0; the accumulator is d's old lane offd+i.
SI void sl_gen(Cpu *c, int op, int sz, int ne, int d, int szd, int offd, int keep, int n, int szn, int offn, int m,
               int szm, int offm, int bidx, uint64_t bimm) {
    u128 a = c->v[n], b = m >= 0 ? c->v[m] : 0, o = c->v[d], r = keep ? o : 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
        uint64_t y = m < 0 ? bimm : lget(&b, szm, bidx >= 0 ? bidx : offm + i);
        lset(&r, szd, offd + i, lop(op, sz, lget(&a, szn, offn + i), y, lget(&o, szd, offd + i)));
    }
    c->v[d] = r;
}
// SADDLP/UADDLP/SADALP/UADALP
SI void sl_addlp(Cpu *c, int u, int acc, int Q, int sz, int d, int n) {
    u128 a = c->v[n], o = c->v[d], r = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (4 << Q) >> sz; i++) {
        uint64_t x = lget(&a, sz, 2 * i), y = lget(&a, sz, 2 * i + 1);
        uint64_t s = u ? x + y : (uint64_t)(lsx(x, sz) + lsx(y, sz));
        lset(&r, sz + 1, i, s + (acc ? lget(&o, sz + 1, i) : 0));
    }
    c->v[d] = r;
}
// ADDV, SADDLV/UADDLV, SMAXV/UMAXV, SMINV/UMINV (op 0..3; u = unsigned)
SI void sl_across(Cpu *c, int op, int u, int Q, int sz, int d, int n) {
    u128 a = c->v[n];
    int ne = (8 << Q) >> sz;
    int64_t acc = u ? (int64_t)lget(&a, sz, 0) : lsx(lget(&a, sz, 0), sz);
    for (int i = 1; i < ne; i++) {
        int64_t x = u ? (int64_t)lget(&a, sz, i) : lsx(lget(&a, sz, i), sz);
        if (op <= 1) acc += x;
        else if (op == 2) acc = u ? ((uint64_t)x > (uint64_t)acc ? x : acc) : (x > acc ? x : acc);
        else acc = u ? ((uint64_t)x < (uint64_t)acc ? x : acc) : (x < acc ? x : acc);
    }
    c->v[d] = (uint64_t)acc & lmask(op == 1 ? sz + 1 : sz);
}
// PMULL2/PMULL 1Q (64x64 -> 128 carry-less)
SI void sl_pmull64(Cpu *c, int part, int d, int n, int m) {
    uint64_t hi, lo = pmul64(((sa64 *)&c->v[n])[part], ((sa64 *)&c->v[m])[part], &hi);
    c->v[d] = ((u128)hi << 64) | lo;
}
// SDOT/UDOT (ARMv8.2 DotProd, 8-bit -> 32-bit lanes)
SI void sv_dot(Cpu *c, int Q, int u, int d, int n, int m) {
    u128 a = c->v[n], b = c->v[m], r = c->v[d];
    int ne = 2 << Q;
    for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
        uint32_t acc = (uint32_t)lget(&r, 2, i);
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            uint64_t x = lget(&a, 0, 4 * i + k), y = lget(&b, 0, 4 * i + k);
            acc += u ? (uint32_t)(x * y) : (uint32_t)((int32_t)(int8_t)x * (int32_t)(int8_t)y);
        }
        lset(&r, 2, i, acc);
    }
    if (!Q) r = (uint64_t)r;
    c->v[d] = r;
}

// ---- FP vector helpers: lanes of the 64-bit form are computed on a zero upper half
SI vf32 vsplat_s(vf32 v, int i, int Q) { float x = v[i]; return Q ? (vf32){x, x, x, x} : (vf32){x, x, 0, 0}; }
SI vf64 vsplat_d(vf64 v, int i, int Q) { double x = v[i]; (void)Q; return (vf64){x, x}; }
#define SV_FOP_S(op, Q, d, n, m, a) VW(vf32, Q, d, vop_s(c, op, n, m, a))
#define SV_FOP_D(op, Q, d, n, m, a) VW(vf64, Q, d, vop_d(c, op, n, m, a))
SI vf32 vneg_s(vf32 v) { return (vf32)((vu32)v ^ 0x80000000u); }
SI vf64 vneg_d(vf64 v) { return (vf64)((vu64)v ^ 0x8000000000000000ull); }
SI float pair_s(Cpu *c, int op, float a, float b) { return op_s(c, op, a, b, 0); }
SI double pair_d(Cpu *c, int op, double a, double b) { return op_d(c, op, a, b, 0); }
// FMAXV/FMINV/FMAXNMV/FMINNMV (4S): pairwise tree
SI void sv_fred_s(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n) {
    vf32 v = VREG(vf32, n);
    c->v[d] = fb_s(pair_s(c, op, pair_s(c, op, v[0], v[1]), pair_s(c, op, v[2], v[3])));
}
// lane-wise FP conversions
SI vu32 vtoint_s(Cpu *c, vf32 v, int rm, int fbits, int uns) {
    vu32 r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) r[i] = (uint32_t)toint_s(c, v[i], rm, fbits, 32, uns);
    return r;
}
SI vu64 vtoint_d(Cpu *c, vf64 v, int rm, int fbits, int uns) {
    vu64 r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) r[i] = toint_d(c, v[i], rm, fbits, 64, uns);
    return r;
}
SI vf32 vfromint_s(Cpu *c, vu32 v, int fbits, int uns) {
    vf32 r;
    if (!(c->fpcr & FPCR_RM)) {
        r = uns ? CVT(v, vf32) : CVT((vs32)v, vf32);
        if (fbits) r = r / (float)(1ull << (fbits - 1)) / 2.0f;
        return r;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) r[i] = fromint_s(c, v[i], 32, uns, fbits);
    return r;
}
SI vf64 vfromint_d(Cpu *c, vu64 v, int fbits, int uns) {
    vf64 r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) r[i] = fromint_d(c, v[i], 64, uns, fbits);
    return r;
}
SI vf32 vrecpe_s(Cpu *c, vf32 v) { for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) v[i] = recpe_s(c, v[i]); return v; }
SI vf64 vrecpe_d(Cpu *c, vf64 v) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) v[i] = recpe_d(c, v[i]); return v; }
SI vf32 vrsqrte_s(Cpu *c, vf32 v) { for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) v[i] = rsqrte_s(c, v[i]); return v; }
SI vf64 vrsqrte_d(Cpu *c, vf64 v) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) v[i] = rsqrte_d(c, v[i]); return v; }
SI vu16 vfromint_h_rsqrte(Cpu *c, vu16 v) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) v[i] = simd_s2h(c, rsqrte_s(c, simd_h2s(c, v[i])));
    return v;
}

// FCVTL/FCVTL2 (h->s, s->d), FCVTN/FCVTN2 (s->h, d->s), FCVTXN/FCVTXN2
SI void sv_fcvtl(Cpu *c, int sz, int part, int d, int n) {
    u128 a = c->v[n], r = 0;
    if (sz == 0) {
        vf32 o;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) o[i] = simd_h2s(c, (uint16_t)lget(&a, 1, 4 * part + i));
        r = (u128)o;
    } else {
        vf64 o;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) o[i] = simd_s2d(c, fv_s((uint32_t)lget(&a, 2, 2 * part + i)));
        r = (u128)o;
    }
    c->v[d] = r;
}
SI void sv_fcvtn(Cpu *c, int sz, int part, int odd, int d, int n) {
    u128 a = c->v[n], r = part ? (uint64_t)c->v[d] : 0;
    if (sz == 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) lset(&r, 1, 4 * part + i, simd_s2h(c, fv_s((uint32_t)lget(&a, 2, i))));
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            double x = fv_d(lget(&a, 3, i));
            lset(&r, 2, 2 * part + i, fb_s(odd ? simd_d2s_odd(c, x) : simd_d2s(c, x)));
        }
    }
    c->v[d] = r;
}

// TBL / TBX with len+1 table registers
SI void sv_tbl(Cpu *c, int Q, int len, int tbx, int d, int n, int m) {
    uint8_t tab[64];
    for (int i = 0; i <= len; i++) memcpy(tab + 16 * i, &c->v[(n + i) & 31], 16);
    u128 idx = c->v[m], o = c->v[d], r = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8 << Q; i++) {
        unsigned k = (unsigned)lget(&idx, 0, i);
        lset(&r, 0, i, k < 16u * (len + 1) ? tab[k] : tbx ? lget(&o, 0, i) : 0);
    }
    c->v[d] = r;
}

// ---- CRC32 / CRC32C (bytes = 1, 2, 4, 8)
SI uint32_t simd_crc(const uint32_t *t, uint32_t acc, uint64_t v, int bytes) {
    for (int i = 0; i < bytes; i++) acc = t[(acc ^ (uint8_t)(v >> (8 * i))) & 0xff] ^ (acc >> 8);
    return acc;
}
#define CRC32(acc, v, n) simd_crc(simd_crc32_tab, (uint32_t)(acc), (v), n)
#define CRC32C(acc, v, n) simd_crc(simd_crc32c_tab, (uint32_t)(acc), (v), n)

// ---- crypto (AES, SHA1, SHA256)
SI uint8_t aes_xt(uint8_t x) { return (uint8_t)((x << 1) ^ ((x >> 7) * 0x1b)); }
SI uint8_t aes_mul(uint8_t x, int k) { // k in {9, 11, 13, 14}
    uint8_t x2 = aes_xt(x), x4 = aes_xt(x2), x8 = aes_xt(x4);
    return (uint8_t)(x8 ^ (k & 4 ? x4 : 0) ^ (k & 2 ? x2 : 0) ^ (k & 1 ? x : 0));
}
SI void sv_aes(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n) { // 0 AESE, 1 AESD, 2 AESMC, 3 AESIMC
    uint8_t s[16], r[16];
    u128 v = op < 2 ? c->v[d] ^ c->v[n] : c->v[n];
    memcpy(s, &v, 16);
    if (op == 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) r[i] = simd_aes_sbox[s[(i + 4 * (i & 3)) & 15]];
    } else if (op == 1) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) r[i] = simd_aes_isbox[s[(i - 4 * (i & 3)) & 15]];
    } else {
        for (int col = 0; col < 4; col++) {
            uint8_t *a = s + 4 * col, *o = r + 4 * col;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                uint8_t a0 = a[i], a1 = a[(i + 1) & 3], a2 = a[(i + 2) & 3], a3 = a[(i + 3) & 3];
                o[i] = op == 2 ? (uint8_t)(aes_xt(a0) ^ aes_xt(a1) ^ a1 ^ a2 ^ a3)
                               : (uint8_t)(aes_mul(a0, 14) ^ aes_mul(a1, 11) ^ aes_mul(a2, 13) ^ aes_mul(a3, 9));
            }
        }
    }
    memcpy(&v, r, 16);
    c->v[d] = v;
}
SI uint32_t rol32_(uint32_t x, int s) { return (x << s) | (x >> (32 - s)); }
SI uint32_t ror32_(uint32_t x, int s) { return (x >> s) | (x << (32 - s)); }
SI void sv_sha1hash(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n, int m) { // 0 SHA1C, 1 SHA1P, 2 SHA1M
    uint32_t x[4], w[4], y = (uint32_t)c->v[n];
    memcpy(x, &c->v[d], 16);
    memcpy(w, &c->v[m], 16);
    for (int e = 0; e < 4; e++) {
        uint32_t t = op == 0 ? (((x[2] ^ x[3]) & x[1]) ^ x[3]) : op == 1 ? (x[1] ^ x[2] ^ x[3])
                                                               : ((x[1] & x[2]) | ((x[1] | x[2]) & x[3]));
        y = y + rol32_(x[0], 5) + t + w[e];
        x[1] = rol32_(x[1], 30);
        uint32_t top = x[3];
        x[3] = x[2], x[2] = x[1], x[1] = x[0], x[0] = y, y = top;
    }
    memcpy(&c->v[d], x, 16);
}
SI void sv_sha256hash(Cpu *c, int part1, int d, int n, int m) { // SHA256H (part1), SHA256H2
    uint32_t x[4], y[4], w[4];
    memcpy(part1 ? x : y, &c->v[d], 16);
    memcpy(part1 ? y : x, &c->v[n], 16);
    memcpy(w, &c->v[m], 16);
    for (int e = 0; e < 4; e++) {
        uint32_t chs = ((y[1] ^ y[2]) & y[0]) ^ y[2];
        uint32_t maj = (x[0] & x[1]) | ((x[0] | x[1]) & x[2]);
        uint32_t t1 = y[3] + (ror32_(y[0], 6) ^ ror32_(y[0], 11) ^ ror32_(y[0], 25)) + chs + w[e];
        x[3] = t1 + x[3];
        y[3] = t1 + (ror32_(x[0], 2) ^ ror32_(x[0], 13) ^ ror32_(x[0], 22)) + maj;
        uint32_t t = y[3];
        y[3] = y[2], y[2] = y[1], y[1] = y[0], y[0] = x[3];
        x[3] = x[2], x[2] = x[1], x[1] = x[0], x[0] = t;
    }
    memcpy(&c->v[d], part1 ? x : y, 16);
}
SI void sv_sha_misc(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n, int m) { // 0 SHA1SU0, 1 SHA1SU1, 2 SHA256SU0, 3 SHA256SU1, 4 SHA1H
    uint32_t a[4], b[4], k[4], r[4], t[4];
    memcpy(a, &c->v[d], 16);
    memcpy(b, &c->v[n], 16);
    memcpy(k, &c->v[m], 16);
    switch (op) {
    case 0:
        t[0] = a[2], t[1] = a[3], t[2] = b[0], t[3] = b[1];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) r[i] = t[i] ^ a[i] ^ k[i];
        break;
    case 1:
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) t[i] = a[i] ^ (i < 3 ? b[i + 1] : 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) r[i] = rol32_(t[i], 1);
        r[3] ^= rol32_(t[0], 2);
        break;
    case 2:
        t[0] = a[1], t[1] = a[2], t[2] = a[3], t[3] = b[0];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) r[i] = (ror32_(t[i], 7) ^ ror32_(t[i], 18) ^ (t[i] >> 3)) + a[i];
        break;
    case 3: {
        uint32_t t0[4] = {b[1], b[2], b[3], k[0]};
        for (int e = 0; e < 4; e++) {
            uint32_t x = e < 2 ? k[e + 2] : r[e - 2];
            r[e] = (ror32_(x, 17) ^ ror32_(x, 19) ^ (x >> 10)) + a[e] + t0[e];
        }
        break;
    }
    default:
        c->v[d] = rol32_(b[0], 30);
        return;
    }
    memcpy(&c->v[d], r, 16);
}

// ---- loads / stores of lanes
SI uint64_t simd_ld(uint64_t a, int sz) {
    switch (sz) {
    case 0: return LD8(a);
    case 1: return LD16(a);
    case 2: return LD32(a);
    default: return LD64(a);
    }
}
SI void simd_st(uint64_t a, int sz, uint64_t v) {
    switch (sz) {
    case 0: ST8(a, v); break;
    case 1: ST16(a, v); break;
    case 2: ST32(a, v); break;
    default: ST64(a, v); break;
    }
}
// LDn/STn (multiple structures): selem interleaved registers, rpt repeats (LD1 with 2-4 registers)
SI void sl_ldm(Cpu *c, int Q, int sz, int selem, int rpt, int t, uint64_t ea) {
    u128 r[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    int ne = (8 << Q) >> sz;
    for (int k = 0; k < rpt; k++)
        for (int e = 0; e < ne; e++)
            for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++, ea += 1 << sz) lset(&r[k + s], sz, e, simd_ld(ea, sz));
    for (int i = 0; i < rpt + selem - 1; i++) c->v[(t + i) & 31] = r[i];
}
SI void sl_stm(Cpu *c, int Q, int sz, int selem, int rpt, int t, uint64_t ea) {
    u128 r[4];
    int ne = (8 << Q) >> sz;
    for (int i = 0; i < rpt + selem - 1; i++) r[i] = c->v[(t + i) & 31];
    for (int k = 0; k < rpt; k++)
        for (int e = 0; e < ne; e++)
            for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++, ea += 1 << sz) simd_st(ea, sz, lget(&r[k + s], sz, e));
}
// single structure: lane idx of selem registers; LDnR replicates into every lane
SI void sl_lds(Cpu *c, int sz, int selem, int idx, int t, uint64_t ea) {
    for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++) {
        u128 v = c->v[(t + s) & 31];
        lset(&v, sz, idx, simd_ld(ea + (s << sz), sz));
        c->v[(t + s) & 31] = v;
    }
}
SI void sl_sts(Cpu *c, int sz, int selem, int idx, int t, uint64_t ea) {
    for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++) simd_st(ea + (s << sz), sz, lget(&c->v[(t + s) & 31], sz, idx));
}
SI void sl_ldr(Cpu *c, int Q, int sz, int selem, int t, uint64_t ea) {
    uint64_t x[4];
    for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++) x[s] = simd_ld(ea + (s << sz), sz);
    for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++) {
        u128 v = 0;
        for (int e = 0; e < (8 << Q) >> sz; e++) lset(&v, sz, e, x[s]);
        c->v[(t + s) & 31] = v;
    }
}

```

`runtime/simd_fp.h`:

```h
// Adapted from LAS Recomp runtime/simd_fp.h @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
// FP helpers for one precision; included twice by simd.h (F = s/float, d/double). No include guard.
// Scalar entry points take/return T, vector ones VT (all lanes; callers zero the unused half for Q=0).

#define FN(x) SIMD_CAT(x, F)
#define SGN ((U)1 << (NB - 1))
#define EXPM ((((U)1 << EB) - 1) << MB)
#define QB ((U)1 << (MB - 1))
#define DNAN (EXPM | QB)
#define MINN ((U)1 << MB) // smallest normal
#define VK(v) ((VT){} + (T)(v))
#define K(v) ((T)(v))

SI U FN(fb)(T x) { U u; memcpy(&u, &x, sizeof u); return u; }
SI T FN(fv)(U u) { T x; memcpy(&x, &u, sizeof x); return x; }
SI int FN(isnan)(U u) { return (u & ~SGN) > EXPM; }
SI int FN(issnan)(U u) { return FN(isnan)(u) && !(u & QB); }
SI int FN(isqnan)(U u) { return FN(isnan)(u) && (u & QB); }
SI int FN(isinf)(U u) { return (u & ~SGN) == EXPM; }
SI int FN(iszero)(U u) { return !(u & ~SGN); }
SI int FN(isden)(U u) { return !(u & EXPM) && (u & ~SGN); }
// The asm hides the float origin of u: LLVM turns the bit test into an FP class compare otherwise, and with
// MXCSR.DAZ set (FPCR.FZ) the host compare sees a denormal as zero. Same in FN(vflush).
SI T FN(flush)(T x) {
    U u = FN(fb)(x);
    __asm__("" : "+r"(u));
    return FN(fv)(FN(isden)(u) ? u & SGN : u);
}
// FPCR.FZ input flush for helpers that run host FP.
SI T FN(fz)(Cpu *c, T x) { return c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ ? FN(flush)(x) : x; }
SI T FN(neg)(T x) { return FN(fv)(FN(fb)(x) ^ SGN); }

// FPProcessNaN(s): first signalling NaN (quietened), else first quiet NaN, else (invalid op) default NaN
SN T FN(nan1)(Cpu *c, T a) {
    U x = FN(fb)(a);
    if (!(c->fpcr & FPCR_DN) && FN(isnan)(x)) return FN(fv)(x | QB);
    return FN(fv)(DNAN);
}
SN T FN(nan2)(Cpu *c, T a, T b) {
    U x = FN(fb)(a), y = FN(fb)(b);
    if (!(c->fpcr & FPCR_DN)) {
        if (FN(issnan)(x)) return FN(fv)(x | QB);
        if (FN(issnan)(y)) return FN(fv)(y | QB);
        if (FN(isnan)(x)) return a;
        if (FN(isnan)(y)) return b;
    }
    return FN(fv)(DNAN);
}
SN T FN(nan3)(Cpu *c, T a, T b, T d) {
    U x = FN(fb)(a), y = FN(fb)(b), z = FN(fb)(d);
    if (!(c->fpcr & FPCR_DN)) {
        if (FN(issnan)(x)) return FN(fv)(x | QB);
        if (FN(issnan)(y)) return FN(fv)(y | QB);
        if (FN(issnan)(z)) return FN(fv)(z | QB);
        if (FN(isnan)(x)) return a;
        if (FN(isnan)(y)) return b;
        if (FN(isnan)(z)) return d;
    }
    return FN(fv)(DNAN);
}

// The arithmetic itself, for scalars (KK = K) and vectors (KK = VK). MADD: a + b*d (a = addend).
// RECPS/RSQRTS get their first operand already negated (FPNeg happens before NaN processing).
#define FCALC(op, a, b, d, KK)                                                                       \
    ((op) == FOP_ADD ? (a) + (b) : (op) == FOP_SUB ? (a) - (b)                                     \
   : (op) == FOP_MUL || (op) == FOP_MULX ? (a) * (b) : (op) == FOP_NMUL ? -((a) * (b))              \
   : (op) == FOP_DIV ? (a) / (b) : (op) == FOP_ABD ? __builtin_elementwise_abs((a) - (b))          \
   : (op) == FOP_SQRT ? __builtin_elementwise_sqrt(a)                                              \
   : (op) == FOP_MADD ? __builtin_elementwise_fma(b, d, a)                                         \
   : (op) == FOP_RECPS ? __builtin_elementwise_fma(a, b, KK(2))                                    \
   : (op) == FOP_RSQRTS ? __builtin_elementwise_fma(a, b, KK(3)) * KK(0.5) : (a))

// Lanes whose fast result needs fixing: NaN results (NaN operand or invalid op), RSQRTS overflow.
#define FBAD(op, r) ((op) == FOP_RSQRTS ? ((r) != (r)) | (__builtin_elementwise_abs(r) == K(INFINITY)) : (r) != (r))

// (3 + a*b) / 2 with one rounding (a already negated): halve a normal operand first, so a product beyond
// the format's range (which the fast path rounds to inf, or to the largest normal when rounding down) is exact.
SN T FN(rsqrts)(T a, T b) {
    if (__builtin_elementwise_abs(a) >= FN(fv)(2 * MINN)) return __builtin_elementwise_fma(a * K(0.5), b, K(1.5));
    if (__builtin_elementwise_abs(b) >= FN(fv)(2 * MINN)) return __builtin_elementwise_fma(a, b * K(0.5), K(1.5));
    return __builtin_elementwise_fma(a, b, K(3)) * K(0.5);
}

// ARM result for a lane flagged by FBAD (operands already flushed).
SN T FN(fix)(Cpu *c, int op, T a, T b, T d) {
    U x = FN(fb)(a), y = FN(fb)(b), z = FN(fb)(d);
    int nan = FN(isnan)(x) || FN(isnan)(y);
    switch (op) {
    case FOP_SQRT: return FN(nan1)(c, a); // NaN in, or negative -> default NaN
    case FOP_MADD:
        if (FN(isnan)(x) || FN(isnan)(y) || FN(isnan)(z)) {
            if (FN(isqnan)(x) && ((FN(isinf)(y) && FN(iszero)(z)) || (FN(iszero)(y) && FN(isinf)(z))))
                return FN(fv)(DNAN);
            return FN(nan3)(c, a, b, d);
        }
        return FN(fv)(DNAN);
    case FOP_MULX:
        if (!nan) return FN(fv)(((x ^ y) & SGN) | FN(fb)(K(2)));
        break;
    case FOP_RECPS:
        if (!nan) return K(2);
        break;
    case FOP_RSQRTS:
        if (!nan) {
            if ((FN(isinf)(x) && FN(iszero)(y)) || (FN(iszero)(x) && FN(isinf)(y))) return K(1.5);
            return FN(rsqrts)(a, b);
        }
        break;
    case FOP_NMUL: return FN(neg)(FN(nan2)(c, a, b));
    case FOP_ABD: return FN(fv)(FN(fb)(FN(nan2)(c, a, b)) & ~SGN);
    }
    return FN(nan2)(c, a, b);
}

// FMAX/FMIN/FMAXNM/FMINNM (operands already flushed)
SI T FN(minmax)(Cpu *c, int op, T a, T b) {
    U x = FN(fb)(a), y = FN(fb)(b);
    if (__builtin_expect(FN(isnan)(x) || FN(isnan)(y), 0)) {
        if (op == FOP_MAXNM || op == FOP_MINNM) {
            if (FN(isqnan)(x) && !FN(isnan)(y)) return b;
            if (FN(isqnan)(y) && !FN(isnan)(x)) return a;
        }
        return FN(nan2)(c, a, b);
    }
    if (op == FOP_MAX || op == FOP_MAXNM) return a == b ? FN(fv)(x & y) : a > b ? a : b;
    return a == b ? FN(fv)(x | y) : a < b ? a : b;
}
#define FMINMAX(op) ((op) >= FOP_MAX && (op) <= FOP_MINNM)

// FPCR.FZ / RMode path: flush inputs, round in the FPCR mode, flush tiny results (tininess is detected
// before rounding on ARM: a result rounded up to the smallest normal is recomputed toward zero).
SN T FN(slow)(Cpu *c, int op, T a, T b, T d) {
#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS ON
    uint64_t fpcr = c->fpcr;
    if (fpcr & FPCR_FZ) a = FN(flush)(a), b = FN(flush)(b), d = FN(flush)(d);
    if (FMINMAX(op)) return FN(minmax)(c, op, a, b);
    unsigned old = simd_rm_enter(fpcr);
    volatile T va = a, vb = b, vd = d;
    volatile T vr = op == FOP_RSQRTS ? FN(rsqrts)(va, vb) : FCALC(op, va, vb, vd, K);
    T r = vr;
    if (FBAD(op, r)) vr = FN(fix)(c, op, a, b, d), r = vr;
    if ((fpcr & FPCR_FZ) && (FN(fb)(r) & ~SGN) <= MINN && !FN(iszero)(FN(fb)(r))) {
        if ((FN(fb)(r) & ~SGN) == MINN) {
            simd_rm_rz();
            volatile T vz = FCALC(op, va, vb, vd, K);
            if ((FN(fb)(vz) & ~SGN) < MINN) r = FN(fv)(FN(fb)(r) & SGN);
        } else {
            r = FN(fv)(FN(fb)(r) & SGN);
        }
    }
    simd_rm_leave(old);
    return r;
}

// Fast-path results that need a second look: FBAD lanes, and +-smallest normal. Under FZ the host runs with
// FTZ|DAZ, which flushes denormal inputs and tiny results like ARM, but x86 detects tininess after rounding:
// an exact result just below the smallest normal that rounds up to it is flushed on ARM only. The slow path
// decides both cases with the operands flushed.
#define FREDO(op, r) (FBAD(op, r) | (__builtin_elementwise_abs(r) == FN(fv)(MINN)))
// The complement of FREDO for every op but RSQRTS, as one compare: |r| ordered and not the smallest normal (LLVM folds
// it to fcmp one, a single ucomiss + jne for scalars and one vcmpps for vectors).
#define FOK(r) ((__builtin_elementwise_abs(r) < FN(fv)(MINN)) | (__builtin_elementwise_abs(r) > FN(fv)(MINN)))
SN T FN(redo)(Cpu *c, int op, T a, T b, T d, T r) {
    if (c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ) return FN(slow)(c, op, a, b, d);
    return FBAD(op, r) ? FN(fix)(c, op, a, b, d) : r;
}

// Scalar FP op (constant op folds the selection). RMode = nearest runs on the host, with or without FZ.
SI T FN(op)(Cpu *c, int op, T a, T b, T d) {
    if (simd_directed(c)) return FN(slow)(c, op, a, b, d);
    if (FMINMAX(op)) {
        if (c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ) a = FN(flush)(a), b = FN(flush)(b);
        return FN(minmax)(c, op, a, b);
    }
    T r = FCALC(op, a, b, d, K);
    if (__builtin_expect(op == FOP_RSQRTS ? FREDO(op, r) : !FOK(r), 0)) r = FN(redo)(c, op, a, b, d, r);
    return r;
}

SN VT FN(vslow)(Cpu *c, int op, VT a, VT b, VT d) {
    VT r;
    for (int i = 0; i < NL; i++) r[i] = FN(op)(c, op, a[i], b[i], d[i]);
    return r;
}

SI VTU FN(vsel)(VTS m, VTU x, VTU y) { return (x & (VTU)m) | (y & ~(VTU)m); }

SI VT FN(vflush)(VT a) {
    VTU u = (VTU)a;
    __asm__("" : "+x"(u));
    VTU mag = u & ~((VTU){} + SGN);
    VTS den = (mag != 0) & ((u & EXPM) == 0);
    return (VT)FN(vsel)(den, u & SGN, u);
}

// Vector FP op: native lanes; any lane FREDO flags (or FPCR.RMode) reruns all lanes through the scalar path.
SI VT FN(vop)(Cpu *c, int op, VT a, VT b, VT d) {
    if (simd_directed(c)) return FN(vslow)(c, op, a, b, d);
    VT r;
    if (FMINMAX(op)) {
        if (c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ) a = FN(vflush)(a), b = FN(vflush)(b);
        if (__builtin_expect(__builtin_reduce_or((a != a) | (b != b)) != 0, 0)) return FN(vslow)(c, op, a, b, d);
        VTU x = (VTU)a, y = (VTU)b;
        if (op == FOP_MAX || op == FOP_MAXNM)
            r = (VT)FN(vsel)(a > b, x, FN(vsel)(a == b, x & y, y));
        else
            r = (VT)FN(vsel)(a < b, x, FN(vsel)(a == b, x | y, y));
        return r;
    }
    r = FCALC(op, a, b, d, VK);
    if (__builtin_expect(op == FOP_RSQRTS ? __builtin_reduce_or(FREDO(op, r)) != 0 : __builtin_reduce_and(FOK(r)) == 0, 0))
        return FN(vslow)(c, op, a, b, d);
    return r;
}

SI VT FN(vfz)(Cpu *c, VT a) { return c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ ? FN(vflush)(a) : a; }

// ---- compares
SI uint64_t FN(cmp)(Cpu *c, T a, T b) { // FCMP NZCV
    a = FN(fz)(c, a), b = FN(fz)(c, b);
    return a == b ? 0x60000000ull : a < b ? 0x80000000ull : a > b ? 0x20000000ull : 0x30000000ull;
}
// FCMEQ/FCMGE/FCMGT/FACGE/FACGT (op 0..4)
SI VTU FN(vcmp)(Cpu *c, int op, VT a, VT b) {
    a = FN(vfz)(c, a), b = FN(vfz)(c, b);
    if (op >= 3) a = __builtin_elementwise_abs(a), b = __builtin_elementwise_abs(b);
    switch (op) {
    case 0: return (VTU)(a == b);
    case 1: case 3: return (VTU)(a >= b);
    default: return (VTU)(a > b);
    }
}

// ---- rounding to integral (FRINT*): rm 0 N, 1 P, 2 M, 3 Z, 4 A; 5 X / 6 I = FPCR mode
// (rint = ties-to-even: the host stays in round-to-nearest outside the slow paths; no roundeven in MinGW's CRT)
SI T FN(rnd)(T x, int rm) {
    switch (rm) {
    case 0: return __builtin_elementwise_rint(x);
    case 1: return __builtin_elementwise_ceil(x);
    case 2: return __builtin_elementwise_floor(x);
    case 3: return __builtin_elementwise_trunc(x);
    default: return __builtin_elementwise_round(x);
    }
}
SI T FN(frint)(Cpu *c, T x, int rm) {
    x = FN(fz)(c, x);
    if (rm >= 5) rm = (int)((c->fpcr >> 22) & 3);
    T r = FN(rnd)(x, rm);
    if (__builtin_expect(r != r, 0)) r = FN(nan1)(c, x);
    return r;
}
SI VT FN(vfrint)(Cpu *c, VT x, int rm) {
    x = FN(vfz)(c, x);
    if (rm >= 5) rm = (int)((c->fpcr >> 22) & 3);
    VT r;
    switch (rm) {
    case 0: r = __builtin_elementwise_rint(x); break;
    case 1: r = __builtin_elementwise_ceil(x); break;
    case 2: r = __builtin_elementwise_floor(x); break;
    case 3: r = __builtin_elementwise_trunc(x); break;
    default: r = __builtin_elementwise_round(x); break;
    }
    if (__builtin_expect(__builtin_reduce_or(r != r) != 0, 0))
        for (int i = 0; i < NL; i++)
            if (r[i] != r[i]) r[i] = FN(nan1)(c, x[i]);
    return r;
}

// ---- FP -> integer (FCVT[NPMZA][SU], fixed point): saturating, NaN -> 0. ib = 32/64.
SI uint64_t FN(toint)(Cpu *c, T x, int rm, int fbits, int ib, int uns) {
    x = FN(fz)(c, x);
    if (fbits) x = x * (T)(1ull << (fbits - 1)) * K(2);
    T r = FN(rnd)(x, rm);
    if (r != r) return 0;
    if (uns) {
        if (r <= K(0)) return 0;
        if (ib == 32) return r >= K(4294967296.0) ? 0xffffffffull : (uint32_t)r;
        return r >= K(18446744073709551616.0) ? ~0ull : (uint64_t)r;
    }
    if (ib == 32) return r >= K(2147483648.0) ? 0x7fffffffull : r < K(-2147483648.0) ? 0x80000000ull : (uint32_t)(int32_t)r;
    return r >= K(9223372036854775808.0) ? 0x7fffffffffffffffull : r < K(-9223372036854775808.0) ? 0x8000000000000000ull
                                                                                              : (uint64_t)(int64_t)r;
}

// ---- integer -> FP (SCVTF/UCVTF, fixed point), rounded in the FPCR mode
SN T FN(fromint_slow)(Cpu *c, uint64_t v, int ib, int uns, int fbits) {
#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS ON
    unsigned old = simd_rm_enter(c->fpcr);
    volatile uint64_t vv = v;
    volatile T r;
    if (uns) r = ib == 32 ? (T)(uint32_t)vv : (T)vv;
    else r = ib == 32 ? (T)(int32_t)vv : (T)(int64_t)vv;
    simd_rm_leave(old);
    T x = r;
    if (fbits) x = x / (T)(1ull << (fbits - 1)) / K(2);
    return x;
}
SI T FN(fromint)(Cpu *c, uint64_t v, int ib, int uns, int fbits) {
    if (__builtin_expect(c->fpcr & FPCR_RM, 0)) return FN(fromint_slow)(c, v, ib, uns, fbits);
    T r;
    if (uns) r = ib == 32 ? (T)(uint32_t)v : (T)v;
    else r = ib == 32 ? (T)(int32_t)v : (T)(int64_t)v;
    if (fbits) r = r / (T)(1ull << (fbits - 1)) / K(2);
    return r;
}

// ---- reciprocal estimates (bit-exact ARMv8.0 pseudocode)
SI T FN(recpe)(Cpu *c, T a) {
    U x = FN(fb)(FN(fz)(c, a)), s = x & SGN;
    if (FN(isnan)(x)) return FN(nan1)(c, a);
    if (FN(isinf)(x)) return FN(fv)(s);
    if (FN(iszero)(x)) return FN(fv)(s | EXPM);
    U mag = x & ~SGN;
    if (mag < ((U)1 << (MB - 2))) { // |x| < 2^(emin - 2): result overflows
        int rm = (c->fpcr >> 22) & 3;
        int inf = rm == 0 || (rm == 1 && !s) || (rm == 2 && s);
        return FN(fv)(s | (inf ? EXPM : EXPM - 1));
    }
    int64_t e = (int64_t)(mag >> MB);
    U frac = mag & (((U)1 << MB) - 1);
    if ((c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ) && e >= (int64_t)((1 << EB) - 3)) return FN(fv)(s); // result would be tiny
    if (e == 0) {
        if (!(frac >> (MB - 1))) e = -1, frac = (frac << 2) & (((U)1 << MB) - 1);
        else frac = (frac << 1) & (((U)1 << MB) - 1);
    }
    int scaled = 256 | (int)(frac >> (MB - 8));
    int64_t re = (int64_t)((1 << EB) - 3) - e;
    U est = (U)simd_recip_tab[scaled - 256]; // 8 fraction bits
    U f = est << (MB - 8);
    if (re == 0) f = (f >> 1) | ((U)1 << (MB - 1));
    else if (re == -1) f = (f >> 2) | ((U)1 << (MB - 2)), re = 0;
    return FN(fv)(s | ((U)re << MB) | f);
}
SI T FN(rsqrte)(Cpu *c, T a) {
    U x = FN(fb)(FN(fz)(c, a)), s = x & SGN;
    if (FN(isnan)(x)) return FN(nan1)(c, a);
    if (FN(iszero)(x)) return FN(fv)(s | EXPM);
    if (s) return FN(fv)(DNAN);
    if (FN(isinf)(x)) return K(0);
    int64_t e = (int64_t)(x >> MB);
    U frac = x & (((U)1 << MB) - 1);
    if (e == 0) {
        while (!(frac >> (MB - 1))) frac <<= 1, e--;
        frac = (frac << 1) & (((U)1 << MB) - 1);
    }
    int scaled = (e & 1) ? 128 | (int)(frac >> (MB - 7)) : 256 | (int)(frac >> (MB - 8));
    int64_t re = ((int64_t)(3 * ((1 << (EB - 1)) - 1) - 1) - e) / 2; // (380 - e) / 2, (3068 - e) / 2
    U est = (U)simd_rsqrt_tab[scaled - 128];
    return FN(fv)(((U)re << MB) | (est << (MB - 8)));
}
SI T FN(recpx)(Cpu *c, T a) {
    U x = FN(fb)(FN(fz)(c, a)), s = x & SGN;
    if (FN(isnan)(x)) return FN(nan1)(c, a);
    if (!(x & EXPM)) return FN(fv)(s | (EXPM - MINN));
    return FN(fv)(s | (~x & EXPM));
}

#undef FN
#undef SGN
#undef EXPM
#undef QB
#undef DNAN
#undef MINN
#undef VK
#undef K
```

`runtime/svc.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/services.c @ b75be8c (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames
// contributors), lines 304-382.
// The SVC entry of the lifted code: preemption checkpoint, trace, then the thread and
// synchronization SVCs (kernel.c), IPC (ipc.c), memory (memory.c), Break, OutputDebugString, GetInfo and ExitProcess. The 21 SVCs
// TotK has but never reaches on MNG's boot path stop with a named fatal, the caller and the guest backtrace.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "fs.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define R_OK 0u
#define ST_FREE 0u
#define ST_STACK 0xBu
#define PERM_RW 3u
#define PROGRAM_ID RT_APPLICATION_ID

static uint64_t g_svcs;
void (*volatile svc_test_exit_hook)(unsigned code);

RtStats rt_stats(void) {
    return (RtStats){__atomic_load_n(&g_svcs, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), kern_threads_created(), hostfn_calls()};
}

static int readable(uint64_t a, uint64_t n) { return plat_mem_readable(a, n); }

void kern_backtrace(const Cpu *c) {
    char d[160];
    rt_logf("  lr %s\n", ldr_describe(c->x[30], d, sizeof d));
    uint64_t fp = c->x[29];
    for (int n = 0; n < 32 && fp && !(fp & 7) && readable(fp, 16); n++) {
        uint64_t next = LD64(fp), lr = LD64(fp + 8);
        rt_logf("  guest frame %2d: %s\n", n, ldr_describe(lr, d, sizeof d));
        if (next <= fp || next - fp > (64u << 20)) break;
        fp = next;
    }
}

static const struct { uint32_t imm; const char *name; } unimplemented[] = {
    {0x13, "MapSharedMemory"}, {0x14, "UnmapSharedMemory"},
    {0x23, "SendAsyncRequestWithUserBuffer"}, {0x28, "ReturnFromException"}, {0x2A, "FlushEntireDataCache"},
    {0x2F, "GetLastThreadInfo"}, {0x32, "SetThreadActivity"}, {0x33, "GetThreadContext3"},
    {0x36, "SynchronizePreemptionState"}, {0x40, "CreateSession"}, {0x41, "AcceptSession"},
    {0x43, "ReplyAndReceive"}, {0x44, "ReplyAndReceiveWithUserBuffer"}, {0x48, "MapPhysicalMemoryUnsafe"},
    {0x49, "UnmapPhysicalMemoryUnsafe"}, {0x4B, "CreateCodeMemory"}, {0x50, "CreateSharedMemory"},
    {0x51, "MapTransferMemory"}, {0x52, "UnmapTransferMemory"}, {0x70, "CreatePort"}, {0x72, "ConnectToPort"},
};

static __attribute__((noreturn)) void svc_fatal(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc, const char *why) {
    const char *name = "unknown";
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof unimplemented / sizeof *unimplemented; i++)
        if (unimplemented[i].imm == imm) name = unimplemented[i].name;
    char at[160];
    fflush(stdout);
    rt_logf("FATAL: svc #%#x %s at %s: %s\n  x0 %#llx x1 %#llx x2 %#llx x3 %#llx\n", imm, name,
            ldr_describe(pc, at, sizeof at), why, (unsigned long long)c->x[0], (unsigned long long)c->x[1],
            (unsigned long long)c->x[2], (unsigned long long)c->x[3]);
    kern_backtrace(c);
    rt_fatal("svc #%#x %s is not implemented", imm, name);
}

// QueryMemory sees the guest main thread's stack, which memory.c does not know: Stack inside it, free ranges
// around it clipped (the way memory.c clips moved stacks).
static void main_stack_query(uint64_t a, RtMemoryInfo *r) {
    uint64_t mb, ms;
    kern_main_stack(&mb, &ms);
    if (!ms) return;
    uint64_t me = mb + ms;
    if (a >= mb && a < me) {
        *r = (RtMemoryInfo){.base = mb, .size = ms, .state = ST_STACK, .perm = PERM_RW};
        return;
    }
    if (r->state != ST_FREE) return;
    uint64_t lo = r->base, hi = r->base + r->size;
    if (me <= a && me > lo) lo = me;
    if (mb > a && mb < hi) hi = mb;
    r->base = lo;
    r->size = hi - lo;
}

static int on_main_stack(uint64_t a, uint64_t n) {
    uint64_t mb, ms;
    kern_main_stack(&mb, &ms);
    return ms && a < mb + ms && mb < a + n;
}

static uint64_t user_exception_context(void) {
    static void *page;
    void *p = __atomic_load_n(&page, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (!p) {
        void *mine = mem_kernel_alloc(0x1000, 0x1000), *expected = NULL;
        if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(&page, &expected, mine, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) p = mine;
        else {
            mem_kernel_free(mine, 0x1000);
            p = expected;
        }
    }
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p;
}

// GetInfo(w1 id, w2 handle, x3 sub id -> x1)
static void get_info(Cpu *c, uint64_t pc) {
    uint32_t id = (uint32_t)c->x[1];
    uint64_t v = 0;
    if (mem_info(id, &v)) {
        c->x[0] = R_OK;
        c->x[1] = v;
        return;
    }
    switch (id) {
    case 0: v = 0x3f; break;                    // core mask: cores 0-5 on Switch 2 (kernel.c NCORE)
    case 1: v = 0x0ffffffff0000000ull; break;   // priority mask
    case 8: v = 0; break;                       // debugger attached
    case 10: v = 0; break;                      // idle tick count
    case 11:                                    // random entropy
        if (!plat_random(&v, sizeof v)) rt_fatal("GetInfo 11: no random bytes from the system");
        break;
    case 18: v = PROGRAM_ID; break;
    case 20: v = user_exception_context(); break;   // the SDK keeps e.g. the dying message at +0x1C0
    case 23: v = 1; break;
    // Switch 2 (Switchbrew "SVC", GetInfo [S2]): RemoteRegionAddress/Size, RemoteMemoryUsage/Peak, ProcessPageSize.
    // No remote region is given to the process, so its address, size and usage are all 0.
    case 29: case 30: case 31: case 32: v = 0; break;
    case 33: v = 0x1000; break;
    default: {
        char why[64];
        snprintf(why, sizeof why, "GetInfo id %u (handle %#x, sub id %#llx)", id, (uint32_t)c->x[2],
                 (unsigned long long)c->x[3]);
        svc_fatal(c, 0x29, pc, why);
    }
    }
    c->x[0] = R_OK;
    c->x[1] = v;
}

static void svc_body(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc);

void rt_svc(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) {
    kern_checkpoint();
    if (__builtin_expect(!kern_host_track || !c->thread, 1)) {
        svc_body(c, imm, pc);
        return;
    }
    void *t = c->thread;   // kern_host_track: the SVC counted in the thread's host depth (hostfn.c hostfn_tracked)
    int *d = kern_host_depth(t);
    __atomic_store_n(d, *d + 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    svc_body(c, imm, pc);
    int n = *d - 1;
    __atomic_store_n(d, n, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (!n && kern_preempt_pending(t)) kern_host_left(t);
}

static void svc_body(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) {
    __atomic_fetch_add(&g_svcs, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_SVC) {
        char at[160];
        rt_log("svc %#x at %s x0=%#llx x1=%#llx x2=%#llx x3=%#llx", imm, ldr_describe(pc, at, sizeof at),
               (unsigned long long)c->x[0], (unsigned long long)c->x[1], (unsigned long long)c->x[2],
               (unsigned long long)c->x[3]);
    }
    if (kern_svc(c, imm)) return;
    uint64_t *x = c->x;
    switch (imm) {
    case 0x15: case 0x1F: case 0x21: case 0x22:
        if (ipc_svc(c, imm)) return;
        svc_fatal(c, imm, pc, "not handled by ipc.c");
    case 0x01: {   // SetHeapSize(x1 size -> x1 address)
        uint64_t a = 0;
        uint32_t r = mem_set_heap_size(x[1], &a);
        rt_log("svc: SetHeapSize req=%#llx -> ret %#x, addr %#llx", (unsigned long long)x[1], r, (unsigned long long)a);
        x[0] = r;
        if (!r) x[1] = a;
        return;
    }
    case 0x02: x[0] = mem_set_permission(x[0], x[1], (uint32_t)x[2]); return;
    case 0x03: x[0] = mem_set_attribute(x[0], x[1], (uint32_t)x[2], (uint32_t)x[3]); return;
    case 0x04: {  // MapMemory(x0 dst, x1 src, x2 size)
        uint32_t r = on_main_stack(x[0], x[2]) ? KERN_R_INVALID_STATE_MEM : mem_map(x[0], x[1], x[2]);
        rt_log("svc: MapMemory dst=%#llx src=%#llx size=%#llx -> ret %#x",
               (unsigned long long)x[0], (unsigned long long)x[1], (unsigned long long)x[2], r);
        x[0] = r;
        return;
    }
    case 0x05: x[0] = mem_unmap(x[0], x[1], x[2]); return;
    case 0x06: {   // QueryMemory(x0 MemoryInfo*, x2 address -> w1 page info)
        RtMemoryInfo mi;
        uint32_t r = mem_query(x[2], &mi);
        main_stack_query(x[2], &mi);
        if (!r && x[0]) memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)x[0], &mi, sizeof mi);
        x[0] = r;
        x[1] = 0;
        return;
    }
    case 0x2C: x[0] = mem_map_physical(x[0], x[1]); return;
    case 0x2D: x[0] = mem_unmap_physical(x[0], x[1]); return;
    case 0x26: {   // Break(x0 reason, x1 info, x2 info size); bit 31 of the reason: notification only
        uint32_t result = 0;
        if (x[1] && x[2] >= 4 && readable(x[1], 4)) memcpy(&result, (const void *)(uintptr_t)x[1], 4);
        char at[160];
        rt_log("guest Break reason %#llx result %#x at %s", (unsigned long long)x[0], result,
               ldr_describe(pc, at, sizeof at));
        if (x[0] & 0x80000000ull) {
            x[0] = R_OK;
            return;
        }
        svc_fatal(c, imm, pc, "Break (the SDK aborted)");
    }
    case 0x27: {   // OutputDebugString(x0 text, x1 size)
        uint64_t n = x[1];
        if (n > 65536) svc_fatal(c, imm, pc, "debug string longer than 64 KiB");
        if (n) {
            fflush(stdout);
            rt_log_raw((const char *)(uintptr_t)x[0], n);
        }
        x[0] = R_OK;
        return;
    }
    case 0x29: get_info(c, pc); return;
    case 0x07: {   // ExitProcess, as closing the window (gfx_window_closed): pipeline cache, shader records and
                   // profile saved, logs flushed, exit code 0
        char at[160];
        rt_log("guest ExitProcess at %s; exiting", ldr_describe(pc, at, sizeof at));
        fs_save_flush();
        vk_pipeline_save();
        prof_write();
        fflush(NULL);
        if (svc_test_exit_hook) return svc_test_exit_hook(0);
        plat_exit(0);
    }
    }
    svc_fatal(c, imm, pc, "not implemented");
}

```

`runtime/swkbd.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/swkbd_host.c @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames
// contributors): the ShowKeyboardArg offsets, the UTF-8/UTF-16 conversions, the disabled-key filter and the result codes.
// The macOS text bar is replaced by a window of the host (swkbd.h text_entry_run: swkbd_win.c with Win32, swkbd_sdl.c
// with SDL).
//
// nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard: text entry for the game. On the Switch the call starts the keyboard library applet, which
// takes the screen until the player confirms or cancels. TotK calls it in one place, naming a horse at a stable
// (main+0x1ecbf64 -> main+0x1b2b3a0: UserName preset, at most 9 characters, '@' '%' '\' disabled, UTF-16 out, no
// header, guide or initial text; an empty answer counts as not named).
//
// Front end: text_entry_run (swkbd.h), run on the guest thread that called (the call blocks, as on the Switch). The thread gives its virtual core up meanwhile, so the other guest threads keep running; it holds no
// lock across the wait. The text starts as the game's initial text, else a default name from the catalog (ui_text.c),
// selected, so a controller can confirm it: A = OK, B = cancel (each after it was seen released); Enter / Esc and the
// buttons work too. While the window is open, and after it closes until everything is released, the game reads no
// input (input_block). text_entry_run is the only front-end seam: an overlay (ImGui) can replace it.
//
// Environment:
//   TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER=<text>|<cancel>|<initial>   answer without a window (probes, scripted runs); <initial> keeps the
//                                                 starting text (the game's, else the default name)
//   TOTK_SWKBD_TEST=ok|cancel                     open the window, then press OK / Cancel on the first timer tick
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "input.h"
#include "ui_text.h"
#include "swkbd.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

// KeyboardConfig then the work buffer {pointer, size}: offsets read from the SDK setters (MNG) and checked against
// the SDK by --probe-services. SDK 20.5 (1.4.3) put a text-check callback at +0x4c8 and grew KeyboardConfig from
// 0x4d0 to 0x518 bytes (SetInitialText, SetUserWordList read the work buffer there); the fields below +0x3d8 stay.
#define ARG_WORK (RT_V143 ? 0x518 : 0x4d0)
#define ARG_WORK_SIZE (ARG_WORK + 8)
enum {
    KB_TYPE = 0x00, KB_OK_TEXT = 0x04, KB_DISABLED = 0x1c, KB_HEADER = 0x24, KB_SUB = 0xa6, KB_GUIDE = 0x1a8,
    KB_MAX_LEN = 0x3ac, KB_MIN_LEN = 0x3b0, KB_PASSWORD = 0x3b4, KB_UTF8 = 0x3bd, KB_INIT_OFF = 0x3c0, KB_INIT_LEN = 0x3c4,
    KB_TYPE_NUMPAD = 1, SWKBD_CANCELED = 0x29f,
};

static uint32_t rd32(const uint8_t *p) { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }
static uint64_t rd64(const uint8_t *p) { uint64_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 8); return v; }
static size_t u16_len(const uint16_t *s, size_t max) { size_t n = 0; while (n < max && s[n]) n++; return n; }

// UTF-16 (n units) -> NUL-terminated UTF-8 in cap bytes, cut at a character boundary. Returns the bytes written.
size_t swkbd_utf16_to_utf8(const uint16_t *s, size_t n, char *out, size_t cap) {
    size_t o = 0;
    if (!cap) return 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint32_t c = s[i];
        if (c >= 0xd800 && c < 0xdc00 && i + 1 < n && s[i + 1] >= 0xdc00 && s[i + 1] < 0xe000)
            c = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xd800) << 10) + (s[++i] - 0xdc00);
        else if (c >= 0xd800 && c < 0xe000) c = 0xfffd;
        char b[4];
        size_t k;
        if (c < 0x80) { b[0] = (char)c; k = 1; }
        else if (c < 0x800) { b[0] = (char)(0xc0 | c >> 6); b[1] = (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3f)); k = 2; }
        else if (c < 0x10000) { b[0] = (char)(0xe0 | c >> 12); b[1] = (char)(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3f)); b[2] = (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3f)); k = 3; }
        else { b[0] = (char)(0xf0 | c >> 18); b[1] = (char)(0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 0x3f)); b[2] = (char)(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3f)); b[3] = (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3f)); k = 4; }
        if (o + k + 1 > cap) break;
        memcpy(out + o, b, k);
        o += k;
    }
    out[o] = 0;
    return o;
}

// UTF-8 -> UTF-16, at most cap units (a character that does not fit whole is dropped); bad bytes become U+FFFD.
size_t swkbd_utf8_to_utf16(const char *s, uint16_t *out, size_t cap) {
    const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)s;
    size_t n = 0;
    while (*p) {
        uint32_t c;
        int k;
        if (*p < 0x80) { c = *p; k = 0; }
        else if ((*p & 0xe0) == 0xc0) { c = *p & 0x1f; k = 1; }
        else if ((*p & 0xf0) == 0xe0) { c = *p & 0x0f; k = 2; }
        else if ((*p & 0xf8) == 0xf0) { c = *p & 0x07; k = 3; }
        else { c = 0xfffd; k = 0; }
        p++;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++, p++) {
            if ((*p & 0xc0) != 0x80) { c = 0xfffd; break; }
            c = c << 6 | (*p & 0x3f);
        }
        if (c > 0x10ffff || (c >= 0xd800 && c < 0xe000)) c = 0xfffd;
        if (c >= 0x10000) {
            if (n + 2 > cap) break;
            out[n++] = (uint16_t)(0xd800 + ((c - 0x10000) >> 10));
            out[n++] = (uint16_t)(0xdc00 + ((c - 0x10000) & 0x3ff));
        } else {
            if (n + 1 > cap) break;
            out[n++] = (uint16_t)c;
        }
    }
    return n;
}

// Whether the applet would let this character through (single UTF-16 units; pairs are always allowed). Disabled-key
// bits as the applet's: 1 space, 2 '@', 3 '%', 4 '/', 5 '\', 6 digits.
int swkbd_allowed(uint16_t c, uint32_t disabled, int digits_only) {
    int digit = c >= '0' && c <= '9';
    if (digits_only && !digit) return 0;
    if (c < 0x20 || c == 0x7f) return 0;
    if ((disabled & 1u << 1 && c == ' ') || (disabled & 1u << 2 && c == '@') || (disabled & 1u << 3 && c == '%')) return 0;
    if ((disabled & 1u << 4 && c == '/') || (disabled & 1u << 5 && c == '\\') || (disabled & 1u << 6 && digit)) return 0;
    return 1;
}

// Drop disallowed characters and keep at most max units without splitting a surrogate pair.
static size_t clean(uint16_t *t, size_t n, size_t max, uint32_t disabled, int digits_only) {
    size_t o = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int pair = t[i] >= 0xd800 && t[i] < 0xdc00 && i + 1 < n;
        size_t k = pair ? 2 : 1;
        if (!pair && !swkbd_allowed(t[i], disabled, digits_only)) continue;
        if (o + k > max) break;
        t[o++] = t[i];
        if (pair) t[o++] = t[++i];
    }
    return o;
}

// ---- nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard
static void request_from(const uint8_t *arg, SwkbdRequest *r) {
    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
    int32_t max_len = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_MAX_LEN), min_len = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_MIN_LEN);
    r->max_len = max_len <= 0 || max_len > KB_LIMIT ? KB_LIMIT : max_len;
    r->min_len = min_len < 0 ? 0 : min_len > r->max_len ? r->max_len : min_len;
    r->password = rd32(arg + KB_PASSWORD) != 0;
    r->numeric = rd32(arg + KB_TYPE) == KB_TYPE_NUMPAD;
    r->disabled = rd32(arg + KB_DISABLED);
    static const struct { int off; size_t max; } texts[] = {{KB_HEADER, 0x40}, {KB_GUIDE, 0x100}, {KB_SUB, 0x80}};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 3 && !r->prompt[0]; i++) {
        const uint16_t *t = (const uint16_t *)(arg + texts[i].off);
        size_t n = u16_len(t, texts[i].max);
        memcpy(r->prompt, t, n * 2);
        r->prompt[n] = 0;
    }
    uint64_t work = rd64(arg + ARG_WORK), work_size = rd64(arg + ARG_WORK_SIZE);
    int32_t init_off = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_INIT_OFF), init_len = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_INIT_LEN);
    size_t n = 0;
    if (init_len > 0 && work && init_off >= 0 && (uint64_t)init_off + (uint64_t)init_len * 2 <= work_size) {
        const uint16_t *t = (const uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(work + (uint64_t)init_off);
        n = u16_len(t, (size_t)(init_len > KB_LIMIT ? KB_LIMIT : init_len));
        memcpy(r->initial, t, n * 2);
        r->game_initial = n > 0;
    }
    if (!n) n = swkbd_utf8_to_utf16(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_DEFAULT_NAME), r->initial, KB_LIMIT);
    n = clean(r->initial, n, (size_t)r->max_len, r->disabled, r->numeric);
    r->initial[n] = 0;
}

// Result ShowKeyboard(String *out, const ShowKeyboardArg &arg); String = {pointer, byte size}
static void ov_show_keyboard(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t *str = arg_p(c, 0);
    const uint8_t *arg = arg_p(c, 1);
    char lr[96];
    if (!str || !arg) rt_fatal("nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard from %s: null argument", ldr_describe(c->x[30] - 4, lr, sizeof lr));
    static SwkbdRequest req;   // one keyboard at a time (the applet is modal too)
    static PlatMutex one = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
    int utf8 = arg[KB_UTF8] != 0;
    uint16_t u[KB_LIMIT * 2 + 1];
    size_t n = 0;
    int confirmed;
    const char *forced = cfg_get("TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER");
    int away = kern_core_away();
    plat_mutex_lock(&one);
    request_from(arg, &req);
    if (forced && *forced) {
        confirmed = strcmp(forced, "<cancel>") != 0;
        if (!strcmp(forced, "<initial>")) n = u16_len(req.initial, KB_LIMIT), memcpy(u, req.initial, n * 2);
        else if (confirmed) n = swkbd_utf8_to_utf16(forced, u, KB_LIMIT * 2);
    } else {
        input_block(1);
        confirmed = text_entry_run(&req, u, KB_LIMIT * 2, &n);
        input_block(0);
    }
    n = confirmed ? clean(u, n, (size_t)req.max_len, req.disabled, req.numeric) : 0;
    if (confirmed && (int)n < req.min_len) confirmed = 0, n = 0;
    uint64_t buf = str[0], size = str[1];
    if (buf && size) {
        if (utf8) swkbd_utf16_to_utf8(u, n, (char *)(uintptr_t)buf, size);
        else {
            size_t units = size / 2;   // one kept for the terminator
            if (units) {
                if (n > units - 1) { n = units - 1; if (n && u[n - 1] >= 0xd800 && u[n - 1] < 0xdc00) n--; }
                memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)buf, u, n * 2);
                ((uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)buf)[n] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    char prompt[0x101 * 3 + 1], shown[KB_LIMIT * 3 + 1];
    swkbd_utf16_to_utf8(req.prompt, u16_len(req.prompt, 0x100), prompt, sizeof prompt);
    swkbd_utf16_to_utf8(u, n, shown, sizeof shown);
    if (req.password) snprintf(shown, sizeof shown, "(password, %zu units, not logged)", n);
    rt_log("swkbd: from %s: \"%s\" (%d-%d units, disabled keys %#x, %s out, %s start)%s -> %s%s%s",
           ldr_describe(c->x[30] - 4, lr, sizeof lr), prompt, req.min_len, req.max_len, req.disabled,
           utf8 ? "UTF-8" : "UTF-16", req.game_initial ? "game" : "default", forced && *forced ? " [TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER]" : "",
           confirmed ? "\"" : "cancelled", confirmed ? shown : "", confirmed ? "\"" : "");
    plat_mutex_unlock(&one);
    kern_core_back(&away);
    ret_x(c, confirmed ? 0 : SWKBD_CANCELED);
}

HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn5swkbd12ShowKeyboardEPNS0_6StringERKNS0_15ShowKeyboardArgE", ov_show_keyboard);
```

`runtime/swkbd.h`:

```h
// nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard (swkbd.c) and its front end, the window that takes the text (swkbd_win.c with Win32,
// swkbd_sdl.c with SDL).
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define KB_LIMIT 500   // the applet's longest text

// The request, front-end independent.
typedef struct {
    uint16_t prompt[0x101];              // header, else guide, else sub text (UTF-16, NUL-terminated; may be empty)
    uint16_t initial[KB_LIMIT + 1];      // starting text (the game's, else the catalog's default name)
    int game_initial;                    // the starting text is the game's
    int max_len, min_len, password, numeric;
    uint32_t disabled;
} SwkbdRequest;

// Shows the text entry and waits for the answer, on the guest thread that called (its virtual core given up, the
// game's input blocked). Returns 1 with the text in out (n units), 0 when cancelled.
int text_entry_run(const SwkbdRequest *req, uint16_t *out, size_t cap, size_t *n);

// UTF-16 (n units) -> NUL-terminated UTF-8 in cap bytes, cut at a character boundary; the bytes written.
size_t swkbd_utf16_to_utf8(const uint16_t *s, size_t n, char *out, size_t cap);
// UTF-8 -> UTF-16, at most cap units (a character that does not fit whole is dropped); bad bytes become U+FFFD.
size_t swkbd_utf8_to_utf16(const char *s, uint16_t *out, size_t cap);
// Whether the applet would let this character through (single UTF-16 units). Disabled-key bits as the applet's: 1 space,
// 2 '@', 3 '%', 4 '/', 5 '\', 6 digits.
int swkbd_allowed(uint16_t c, uint32_t disabled, int digits_only);
```

`runtime/swkbd_sdl.c`:

```c
// The software keyboard's front end for SDL windows (swkbd.h). Until the in-game text field exists (an ImGui entry in
// the menu overlay, which SDL_StartTextInput can pair with the Steam Deck's on-screen keyboard), the text entry takes
// the starting text at once, as TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER=<initial> does: the game's initial text, else the default name from
// the catalog. TotK asks only for a horse's name. TOTK_SWKBD_TEST=cancel stands for Cancel pressed, as in the Win32
// window.
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "swkbd.h"

int text_entry_run(const SwkbdRequest *req, uint16_t *out, size_t cap, size_t *n) {
    const char *test = cfg_get("TOTK_SWKBD_TEST");
    if (test && !strcmp(test, "cancel")) { *n = 0; return 0; }
    size_t k = 0;
    while (k < cap && req->initial[k]) k++;
    memcpy(out, req->initial, k * 2);
    *n = k;
    rt_log("swkbd: no text entry window on this host yet: the %s name is taken", req->game_initial ? "game's" : "default");
    return k > 0;
}
```

`runtime/swkbd_win.c`:

```c
// The Win32 front end of the software keyboard (swkbd.h): a modal window owned by the game window, run on the guest
// thread that called. The text starts as the game's initial text, else a default name from the catalog (ui_text.c),
// selected, so a controller can confirm it: A = OK, B = cancel (each after it was seen released); Enter / Esc and the
// buttons work too.
//   TOTK_SWKBD_TEST=ok|cancel   open the window, then press OK / Cancel on the first timer tick
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "input.h"
#include "input_win.h"
#include "swkbd.h"
#include "ui_text.h"
#include "vk.h"

enum { B_A = 0, B_B = 1, B_PLUS = 10 };   // input.h bits

#define TIMER_ID 1
#define TIMER_MS 16
typedef struct {
    const SwkbdRequest *req;
    HWND wnd, edit;
    WNDPROC edit_proc;
    uint16_t text[KB_LIMIT * 2 + 1];
    size_t n;
    int result;                          // 0 open, 1 OK, -1 cancelled
    uint64_t armed;                      // buttons seen released since the window opened
    int test;                            // TOTK_SWKBD_TEST: 1 press OK, -1 press Cancel
} Entry;

static wchar_t *wide(const char *utf8, wchar_t *buf, int cap) {
    if (!MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8, -1, buf, cap)) buf[0] = 0;
    return buf;
}

static void finish(Entry *e, int result) {
    if (e->result) return;
    if (result > 0) {
        int n = GetWindowTextW(e->edit, (wchar_t *)e->text, KB_LIMIT * 2 + 1);
        e->n = n > 0 ? (size_t)n : 0;
    }
    e->result = result;
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK edit_proc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    Entry *e = (Entry *)GetWindowLongPtrW(GetParent(h), GWLP_USERDATA);
    if (m == WM_CHAR && w >= 0x20 && !(w >= 0xd800 && w < 0xe000) &&
        !swkbd_allowed((uint16_t)w, e->req->disabled, e->req->numeric)) {
        MessageBeep(MB_OK);
        return 0;
    }
    return CallWindowProcW(e->edit_proc, h, m, w, l);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK entry_proc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    Entry *e = (Entry *)GetWindowLongPtrW(h, GWLP_USERDATA);
    switch (m) {
    case WM_COMMAND:
        if (LOWORD(w) == IDOK) finish(e, 1);
        else if (LOWORD(w) == IDCANCEL) finish(e, -1);
        return 0;
    case WM_CLOSE:
        finish(e, -1);
        return 0;
    case WM_TIMER: {
        if (e->test) { finish(e, e->test); return 0; }
        uint64_t b;
        int32_t lx, ly, rx, ry;
        input_poll_ui(&b, &lx, &ly, &rx, &ry);
        uint64_t pressed = b & e->armed;   // down now, up at the previous tick
        e->armed = ~b;
        if (pressed & (1ull << B_A | 1ull << B_PLUS)) finish(e, 1);
        else if (pressed & 1ull << B_B) finish(e, -1);
        return 0;
    }
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}

static HWND child(HWND parent, const wchar_t *cls, const wchar_t *text, DWORD style, int x, int y, int w, int h, int id,
                  HFONT font) {
    HWND c = CreateWindowExW(0, cls, text, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | style, x, y, w, h, parent, (HMENU)(intptr_t)id,
                             GetModuleHandleW(NULL), NULL);
    if (c) SendMessageW(c, WM_SETFONT, (WPARAM)font, FALSE);
    return c;
}

// Shows the window and waits for the answer. Returns 1 with the text in out (n units), 0 when cancelled.
int text_entry_run(const SwkbdRequest *req, uint16_t *out, size_t cap, size_t *n) {
    static const wchar_t cls[] = L"TotKTextEntry";
    HINSTANCE inst = GetModuleHandleW(NULL);
    WNDCLASSEXW wc = {.cbSize = sizeof wc, .lpfnWndProc = entry_proc, .hInstance = inst,
                      .hCursor = LoadCursorW(NULL, (LPCWSTR)IDC_ARROW), .hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_BTNFACE + 1),
                      .lpszClassName = cls};
    if (!RegisterClassExW(&wc) && GetLastError() != ERROR_CLASS_ALREADY_EXISTS)
        rt_fatal("nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard: RegisterClassEx (error %lu)", GetLastError());

    Entry e = {.req = req, .armed = 0};
    const char *test = cfg_get("TOTK_SWKBD_TEST");
    if (test && *test) e.test = !strcmp(test, "cancel") ? -1 : 1;
    // The process is per-monitor DPI aware: the font and the layout below are measured at the game window's DPI, the
    // monitor the dialog opens on, not at the system DPI that plain SystemParametersInfo and AdjustWindowRectEx use.
    HWND owner = gfx_window_handle();
    UINT dpi = owner ? GetDpiForWindow(owner) : GetDpiForSystem();
    NONCLIENTMETRICSW ncm = {.cbSize = sizeof ncm};
    SystemParametersInfoForDpi(SPI_GETNONCLIENTMETRICS, sizeof ncm, &ncm, 0, dpi);
    HFONT font = CreateFontIndirectW(&ncm.lfMessageFont);
    HDC dc = GetDC(NULL);
    HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(dc, font);
    TEXTMETRICW tm;
    GetTextMetricsW(dc, &tm);
    SelectObject(dc, old);
    ReleaseDC(NULL, dc);
    int u = tm.tmHeight > 8 ? tm.tmHeight : 16, pad = u, cw = 26 * u, bw = 6 * u, bh = u * 9 / 5;
    int y_prompt = pad, h_prompt = u * 5 / 2, y_edit = y_prompt + h_prompt + u / 4, h_edit = u * 9 / 5;
    int y_hint = y_edit + h_edit + u / 2, y_btn = y_hint + u * 3 / 2, ch = y_btn + bh + pad;

    RECT wr = {0, 0, cw + 2 * pad, ch};
    DWORD style = WS_POPUP | WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU, ex = WS_EX_DLGMODALFRAME | WS_EX_CONTROLPARENT;
    AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&wr, style, FALSE, ex, dpi);
    int ww = wr.right - wr.left, wh = wr.bottom - wr.top, x = CW_USEDEFAULT, y = CW_USEDEFAULT;
    RECT orc;
    if (owner && GetWindowRect(owner, &orc)) {
        x = orc.left + (orc.right - orc.left - ww) / 2;
        y = orc.top + (orc.bottom - orc.top - wh) / 2;
    }
    wchar_t title[128], ok[64], cancel[64], hint[160];
    e.wnd = CreateWindowExW(ex, cls, wide(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_TITLE), title, 128), style, x, y, ww, wh, owner, NULL, inst,
                            NULL);
    if (!e.wnd) rt_fatal("nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard: CreateWindowEx (error %lu)", GetLastError());
    SetWindowLongPtrW(e.wnd, GWLP_USERDATA, (LONG_PTR)&e);
    wchar_t prompt[0x102];
    if (req->prompt[0]) memcpy(prompt, req->prompt, sizeof req->prompt), prompt[0x101] = 0;
    else wide(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_PROMPT), prompt, 0x102);
    child(e.wnd, L"STATIC", prompt, SS_LEFT | SS_NOPREFIX, pad, y_prompt, cw, h_prompt, -1, font);
    e.edit = child(e.wnd, L"EDIT", (const wchar_t *)req->initial,
                   WS_TABSTOP | WS_BORDER | ES_AUTOHSCROLL | (req->password ? ES_PASSWORD : 0) | (req->numeric ? ES_NUMBER : 0),
                   pad, y_edit, cw, h_edit, 100, font);
    child(e.wnd, L"STATIC", wide(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_PAD_HINT), hint, 160), SS_LEFT | SS_NOPREFIX, pad, y_hint, cw, u * 3 / 2,
          -1, font);
    child(e.wnd, L"BUTTON", wide(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_OK), ok, 64), WS_TABSTOP | BS_DEFPUSHBUTTON, pad + cw - 2 * bw - u / 2,
          y_btn, bw, bh, IDOK, font);
    child(e.wnd, L"BUTTON", wide(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_CANCEL), cancel, 64), WS_TABSTOP | BS_PUSHBUTTON, pad + cw - bw, y_btn,
          bw, bh, IDCANCEL, font);
    SendMessageW(e.edit, EM_LIMITTEXT, (WPARAM)req->max_len, 0);
    e.edit_proc = (WNDPROC)SetWindowLongPtrW(e.edit, GWLP_WNDPROC, (LONG_PTR)edit_proc);

    if (owner) EnableWindow(owner, FALSE);
    ShowWindow(e.wnd, SW_SHOW);
    SetForegroundWindow(e.wnd);
    SetFocus(e.edit);
    SendMessageW(e.edit, EM_SETSEL, 0, -1);
    SetTimer(e.wnd, TIMER_ID, TIMER_MS, NULL);
    MSG msg;
    int quit = 0;
    while (!e.result) {
        BOOL got = GetMessageW(&msg, NULL, 0, 0);
        if (got <= 0) { quit = got == 0; finish(&e, -1); break; }
        if (msg.message == WM_KEYDOWN && (msg.wParam == VK_RETURN || msg.wParam == VK_ESCAPE) &&
            (msg.hwnd == e.wnd || IsChild(e.wnd, msg.hwnd))) {
            // Enter on the Cancel button cancels; elsewhere it confirms
            finish(&e, msg.wParam == VK_ESCAPE || GetDlgCtrlID(msg.hwnd) == IDCANCEL ? -1 : 1);
            continue;
        }
        if (IsDialogMessageW(e.wnd, &msg)) continue;
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessageW(&msg);
    }
    KillTimer(e.wnd, TIMER_ID);
    if (owner) EnableWindow(owner, TRUE);   // before the window goes, so activation returns to the game window
    DestroyWindow(e.wnd);
    if (owner) SetForegroundWindow(owner);
    DeleteObject(font);
    if (quit) PostQuitMessage((int)msg.wParam);
    if (e.result < 0) return 0;
    *n = e.n < cap ? e.n : cap;
    memcpy(out, e.text, *n * 2);
    return 1;
}
```

`runtime/sysinfo.c`:

```c
// What a bug report needs about the machine (sysinfo.h). The OS calls sit behind platform.h; the GPU and driver come
// from the Vulkan device the game renders on.
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
#include <cpuid.h>
#endif

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "sysinfo.h"
#include "vk.h"

void sysinfo_cpu_name(char *out, size_t n) {
    out[0] = 0;
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
    unsigned r[12];
    if (__get_cpuid_max(0x80000000, NULL) < 0x80000004) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++) __get_cpuid(0x80000002 + i, &r[i * 4], &r[i * 4 + 1], &r[i * 4 + 2], &r[i * 4 + 3]);
    char b[49];
    memcpy(b, r, 48);
    b[48] = 0;
    const char *p = b;
    while (*p == ' ') p++;
    snprintf(out, n, "%s", p);
    for (char *e = out + strlen(out); e > out && e[-1] == ' '; e--) e[-1] = 0;
#endif
}

int sysinfo_log_folder(char *out, size_t n) {
    const char *log = rt_log_path();
    if (log) snprintf(out, n, "%s", log);
    else if (!plat_stderr_path(out, n) && !plat_exe_path(out, n)) return 0;
    char *s = strrchr(out, '\\'), *f = strrchr(out, '/');
    if (f > s) s = f;
    if (!s) return 0;
    *s = 0;
    return 1;
}

typedef struct { char *buf; size_t n, at; } Out;

static void put(Out *o, const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
static void put(Out *o, const char *fmt, ...) {
    if (o->at + 1 >= o->n) return;
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    int k = vsnprintf(o->buf + o->at, o->n - o->at, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    if (k > 0) o->at = o->at + (size_t)k < o->n ? o->at + (size_t)k : o->n - 1;
}

static void put_setting(const char *key, const char *value, int from_env, void *ctx) {
    put(ctx, from_env ? "  TOTK_%s=%s (environment)\n" : "  %s = %s\n", key, value);
}

int sysinfo_text(char *buf, size_t n) {
    if (!n) return 0;
    Out o = {buf, n, 0};
    buf[0] = 0;
    char s[256];
    put(&o, "TotK Recomp system info\n");
    put(&o, "OS: %s\n", plat_os_version(s, sizeof s) ? s : "unknown");
    sysinfo_cpu_name(s, sizeof s);
    put(&o, "CPU: %s, %u logical processors\n", s[0] ? s : "unknown", plat_cpu_count());
    float used, total, proc;
    plat_mem_info(&used, &total, &proc);
    if (total > 0) put(&o, "RAM: %.1f GB, %.1f GB in use, the game %.1f GB\n", total / 1024, used / 1024, proc / 1024);
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (c) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceDriverProperties dp = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DRIVER_PROPERTIES};
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &dp};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(c->phys, &p2);
        const VkPhysicalDeviceProperties *p = &p2.properties;
        uint64_t vram = 0;
        for (uint32_t h = 0; h < c->mem_props.memoryHeapCount; h++)
            if (c->mem_props.memoryHeaps[h].flags & VK_MEMORY_HEAP_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT) vram += c->mem_props.memoryHeaps[h].size;
        put(&o, "GPU: %s (vendor 0x%04x, device 0x%04x), %.1f GB device-local memory\n", p->deviceName, p->vendorID,
            p->deviceID, vram / 1073741824.0);
        put(&o, "Driver: %s %s, driver version 0x%08x, Vulkan %u.%u.%u\n", dp.driverName, dp.driverInfo,
            p->driverVersion, VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(p->apiVersion), VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(p->apiVersion),
            VK_API_VERSION_PATCH(p->apiVersion));
    } else {
        put(&o, "GPU: no Vulkan device yet\n");
    }
    put(&o, "Settings with a value:\n");
    size_t before = o.at;
    cfg_each_active(put_setting, &o);
    if (o.at == before) put(&o, "  none\n");
    return (int)o.at;
}
```
