```h
// CPU-side texture code: block-linear <-> linear copies, ASTC decode, NVN format -> VkFormat. Vulkan memory and
// the texture objects are in vk_memory.c and vk_texture.c.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include "nvn_obj.h"
#include "nvn_tex.h"
#include "vk.h"

// ---- tex_deswizzle.c (MacNativeGames nvn_deswizzle.c, MIT) ----
// Block-linear <-> linear for one level and layer of a texture. The linear side is laid out by block rows: dst_pitch
// bytes per row (>= row bytes of the level), compressed formats one block row per row, 3D textures slice k at
// dst + k * dst_pitch * block rows. LINEAR / LINEAR_RENDER_TARGET storage is copied by pitch. Multisampled and BUFFER
// textures return -1; success returns 0.
int nvn_deswizzle(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, const void *src_storage, void *dst_linear,
                  size_t dst_pitch);
int nvn_swizzle(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, const void *src_linear, size_t src_pitch,
                void *dst_storage);
// One box of a level and layer, [x, x + wb) bytes by [y, y + h) block rows of slice z (3D textures), between the storage
// and caller rows of pitch bytes, touching nothing else of the level: ReadTexels / WriteTexels of a region cost the
// region, not the level. Same textures as nvn_deswizzle; -1 for others and for a box outside the level.
int nvn_texels_box(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z, uint32_t wb,
                   uint32_t h, void *storage, void *rows, size_t pitch, int to_linear);
// Byte offset of (x byte, y block row, z slice) inside one level of block height 2^th and block depth 2^td GOBs.
uint64_t nvn_bl_offset(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z, uint32_t row_bytes, uint32_t rows, unsigned th, unsigned td);
// Geometry of a level as the two functions above use it; -1 for textures they reject.
int nvn_deswizzle_geom(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, uint32_t *row_bytes, uint32_t *rows,
                       uint32_t *slices, uint64_t *base, unsigned *th, unsigned *td, uint32_t *bpb);
// The copy loop on its own, for callers that know the level geometry (bl points at the level's first byte).
void tex_bl_copy(uint8_t *bl, uint8_t *lin, size_t pitch, uint32_t row_bytes, uint32_t rows, uint32_t slices,
                 unsigned th, unsigned td, int to_linear);

// ---- tex_astc.c (LAS Recomp runtime/nvn/astc.c, MIT) ----
// ASTC LDR 2D to RGBA8, bit-exact with astcenc's 8-bit decode. blocks: row-major 16-byte blocks covering
// ceil(width/bw) x ceil(height/bh); rgba_out: width*height*4 bytes. srgb only selects the sRGB endpoint expansion.
// Error blocks and HDR content decode to magenta.
void astc_decode_ldr(const uint8_t *blocks, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb,
                     uint8_t *rgba_out);
bool astc_decode_block(const uint8_t block[16], uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb, uint8_t *rgba_out);
// tex_astc_mt.c: the same bytes as astc_decode_ldr, large images split by block rows over a worker pool; blocks.
void astc_decode_ldr_mt(const uint8_t *blocks, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb,
                        uint8_t *rgba_out);

// ---- vk_formats.c (LAS Recomp runtime/nvn/vulkan/textures.c format table, MIT) ----
typedef struct TexVkFormat {
    VkFormat vk;                  // format of the image created on this GPU
    VkFormat ideal;               // format the NVN format maps to by itself; differs from vk after a fallback
    VkFormatFeatureFlags need;    // optimal-tiling features vk must report for sampling and upload
    uint8_t expand_rgb;           // 3-component format: the upload expands each texel to 4 components (alpha / integer 1)
    uint8_t alpha_one;            // "X" format: sample alpha as 1 (view swizzle)
    uint8_t chan[4];              // nonzero chan[0]: vk stands in with another component order; chan[i] is the
                                  // NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_R..A selector of the image component holding R, G, B, A
    uint8_t astc_bw, astc_bh;     // nonzero: ASTC decoded into vk (RGBA8, same colour space) by vk_astc.c or tex_astc.c;
                                  // zero for native ASTC (vk == ideal, raw blocks as for BC)
    uint8_t astc_srgb;
    uint8_t astc_bc;              // ASTC decoded and then encoded to BC3 (vk BC3, TOTK_ASTC_BC; vk_astc.c)
    uint8_t depth, stencil;       // aspect flags of depth / stencil formats
    const char *note;             // why a fallback or an expansion was chosen; NULL when the mapping is direct
    const char *reason;           // unmapped formats only: why there is no Vulkan format
} TexVkFormat;

// 1 when nvn_format (an NVNformat value) has a Vulkan mapping, 0 otherwise (out->reason says why). The mapping is
// fixed per device: ASTC decodes to RGBA8 unless vk_astc_native (TOTK_ASTC) takes the format as it is, D24S8 is
// D32S8, DEPTH24 is D32. Whether the GPU reports the features is a separate question (tex_vk_format_supported).
int tex_vk_format(int nvn_format, TexVkFormat *out);
// 1 when vk_ctx()->phys reports every bit of f->need for f->vk in optimal tiling. Needs vk_init().
int tex_vk_format_supported(const TexVkFormat *f);
```

```c
// ASTC LDR decoder, 2D only (Khronos Data Format spec, ASTC chapter). Matches ARM astcenc's 8-bit
// decode bit for bit (the decode_unorm8 path its CLI uses for -dl / -ds into 8-bit images):
//   endpoints expand to 16 bits (linear: v * 257, sRGB: v << 8 | 0x80, all four channels),
//   texel = (e0 * (64 - w) + e1 * w + 32) >> 6, output = top 8 bits.

_Static_assert(sizeof wunq_data == 142 && sizeof cunq_data == 936, "unquantization table size");

// ---- bits ----

typedef struct { uint64_t lo, hi; } Bits128;

static inline uint64_t load64(const uint8_t *p) {
    uint64_t v = 0;
    for (int i = 7; i >= 0; i--) v = v << 8 | p[i];
    return v;
}

// n (<= 32) bits at pos; bits past 127 read as zero.
static inline uint32_t rbits(const Bits128 *b, int pos, int n) {
    if (n == 0 || pos >= 128) return 0;
    uint64_t v;
    if (pos >= 64) v = b->hi >> (pos - 64);
    else if (pos == 0) v = b->lo;
    else v = b->lo >> pos | b->hi << (64 - pos);
    return (uint32_t)(v & ((1ull << n) - 1));
}

static inline uint64_t bitrev64(uint64_t v) {
    v = (v >> 1 & 0x5555555555555555ull) | (v & 0x5555555555555555ull) << 1;
    v = (v >> 2 & 0x3333333333333333ull) | (v & 0x3333333333333333ull) << 2;
    v = (v >> 4 & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0Full) | (v & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0Full) << 4;
    v = (v >> 8 & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFull) | (v & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFull) << 8;
    v = (v >> 16 & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFFull) | (v & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFFull) << 16;
    return v >> 32 | v << 32;
}

// ---- integer sequence encoding ----

static int ise_bitcount(int count, int q) {
    int n = count * q_bits[q];
    if (q_trits[q]) n += (8 * count + 4) / 5;
    if (q_quints[q]) n += (7 * count + 2) / 3;
    return n;
}

static void trits_of(uint32_t T, int t[5]) {
    uint32_t C;
    if ((T >> 2 & 7) == 7) {
        C = (T >> 5 & 7) << 2 | (T & 3);
        t[4] = t[3] = 2;
    } else {
        C = T & 0x1F;
        if ((T >> 5 & 3) == 3) { t[4] = 2; t[3] = T >> 7 & 1; }
        else { t[4] = T >> 7 & 1; t[3] = T >> 5 & 3; }
    }
    if ((C & 3) == 3) {
        t[2] = 2; t[1] = C >> 4 & 1;
        t[0] = (C >> 3 & 1) << 1 | ((C >> 2 & 1) & ~(C >> 3) & 1);
    } else if ((C >> 2 & 3) == 3) {
        t[2] = 2; t[1] = 2; t[0] = C & 3;
    } else {
        t[2] = C >> 4 & 1; t[1] = C >> 2 & 3;
        t[0] = (C >> 1 & 1) << 1 | ((C & 1) & ~(C >> 1) & 1);
    }
}

static void quints_of(uint32_t Q, int q[3]) {
    if ((Q >> 1 & 3) == 3 && (Q >> 5 & 3) == 0) {
        uint32_t q0 = Q & 1;
        q[2] = (int)(q0 << 2 | ((Q >> 4 & 1) & ~q0 & 1) << 1 | ((Q >> 3 & 1) & ~q0 & 1));
        q[1] = q[0] = 4;
        return;
    }
    uint32_t C;
    if ((Q >> 1 & 3) == 3) { q[2] = 4; C = (Q >> 3 & 3) << 3 | (~(Q >> 5) & 3) << 1 | (Q & 1); }
    else { q[2] = Q >> 5 & 3; C = Q & 0x1F; }
    if ((C & 7) == 5) { q[1] = 4; q[0] = C >> 3 & 3; }
    else { q[1] = C >> 3 & 3; q[0] = C & 7; }
}

// Decodes count raw ISE values (tq << bits | bits) starting at bit pos.
static void ise_decode(const Bits128 *b, int pos, int count, int q, uint8_t *out) {
    int nb = q_bits[q];
    if (q_trits[q]) {
        static const uint8_t tb[5] = {2, 2, 1, 2, 1}, ts[5] = {0, 2, 4, 5, 7};
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i += 5) {
            uint32_t m[5], T = 0;
            int k = 0, t[5];
            for (; k < 5 && i + k < count; k++) {
                m[k] = rbits(b, pos, nb); pos += nb;
                T |= rbits(b, pos, tb[k]) << ts[k]; pos += tb[k];
            }
            trits_of(T, t);
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) out[i + j] = (uint8_t)((uint32_t)t[j] << nb | m[j]);
        }
    } else if (q_quints[q]) {
        static const uint8_t qb[3] = {3, 2, 2}, qs[3] = {0, 3, 5};
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i += 3) {
            uint32_t m[3], Q = 0;
            int k = 0, v[3];
            for (; k < 3 && i + k < count; k++) {
                m[k] = rbits(b, pos, nb); pos += nb;
                Q |= rbits(b, pos, qb[k]) << qs[k]; pos += qb[k];
            }
            quints_of(Q, v);
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) out[i + j] = (uint8_t)((uint32_t)v[j] << nb | m[j]);
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++, pos += nb) out[i] = (uint8_t)rbits(b, pos, nb);
    }
}

// ---- block mode ----

typedef struct { int wx, wy, dual, quant, wbits; } BlockMode;

static bool block_mode_2d(uint32_t m, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, BlockMode *bm) {
    uint32_t r = m >> 4 & 1, h = m >> 9 & 1, d = m >> 10 & 1, a = m >> 5 & 3;
    int wx, wy;
    if (m & 3) {
        r |= (m & 3) << 1;
        uint32_t b = m >> 7 & 3;
        switch (m >> 2 & 3) {
        case 0: wx = b + 4; wy = a + 2; break;
        case 1: wx = b + 8; wy = a + 2; break;
        case 2: wx = a + 2; wy = b + 8; break;
        default:
            b &= 1;
            if (m & 0x100) { wx = b + 2; wy = a + 2; }
            else { wx = a + 2; wy = b + 6; }
            break;
        }
    } else {
        r |= (m >> 2 & 3) << 1;
        if ((m >> 2 & 3) == 0) return false;
        uint32_t b = m >> 9 & 3;
        switch (m >> 7 & 3) {
        case 0: wx = 12; wy = a + 2; break;
        case 1: wx = a + 2; wy = 12; break;
        case 2: wx = a + 6; wy = b + 6; d = 0; h = 0; break;
        default:
            if (a == 0) { wx = 6; wy = 10; }
            else if (a == 1) { wx = 10; wy = 6; }
            else return false;
            break;
        }
    }
    int count = wx * wy * (int)(d + 1);
    bm->wx = wx; bm->wy = wy; bm->dual = (int)d;
    bm->quant = (int)(r - 2 + 6 * h);
    bm->wbits = ise_bitcount(count, bm->quant);
    return count <= 64 && bm->wbits >= 24 && bm->wbits <= 96 && wx <= (int)bw && wy <= (int)bh;
}

// ---- partitions ----

static uint32_t hash52(uint32_t p) {
    p ^= p >> 15; p -= p << 17; p += p << 7; p += p << 4;
    p ^= p >> 5;  p += p << 16; p ^= p >> 7; p ^= p >> 3;
    p ^= p << 6;  p ^= p >> 17;
    return p;
}

typedef struct { int s[8]; uint32_t r[4]; int count; } PartSel;

static void part_init(PartSel *ps, int seed, int count) {
    seed += (count - 1) * 1024;
    uint32_t rnum = hash52((uint32_t)seed);
    int s[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { int v = (int)(rnum >> (4 * i) & 0xF); s[i] = v * v; }
    int sh1, sh2;
    if (seed & 1) { sh1 = seed & 2 ? 4 : 5; sh2 = count == 3 ? 6 : 5; }
    else { sh1 = count == 3 ? 6 : 5; sh2 = seed & 2 ? 4 : 5; }
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) ps->s[i] = s[i] >> (i & 1 ? sh2 : sh1);
    ps->r[0] = rnum >> 14; ps->r[1] = rnum >> 10; ps->r[2] = rnum >> 6; ps->r[3] = rnum >> 2;
    ps->count = count;
}

static inline int part_of(const PartSel *ps, int x, int y) {
    // z = 0 for 2D, so seeds 9..12 drop out
    int a = (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[0] * x + ps->s[1] * y) + ps->r[0]) & 0x3F;
    int b = (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[2] * x + ps->s[3] * y) + ps->r[1]) & 0x3F;
    int c = ps->count >= 3 ? (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[4] * x + ps->s[5] * y) + ps->r[2]) & 0x3F : 0;
    int d = ps->count >= 4 ? (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[6] * x + ps->s[7] * y) + ps->r[3]) & 0x3F : 0;
    if (a >= b && a >= c && a >= d) return 0;
    if (b >= c && b >= d) return 1;
    if (c >= d) return 2;
    return 3;
}

// ---- colour endpoints ----

static inline int clamp255(int v) { return v < 0 ? 0 : v > 255 ? 255 : v; }

// e[0..3] endpoint 0, e[4..7] endpoint 1 (8-bit). Returns false for an HDR mode.
static bool unpack_endpoints(int cem, const uint8_t *v, int e0[4], int e1[4]) {
    switch (cem) {
    case 0:  // L direct
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = v[0]; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = v[1];
        e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    case 1: {  // L delta
        int l0 = v[0] >> 2 | (v[1] & 0xC0);
        int l1 = l0 + (v[1] & 0x3F);
        if (l1 > 255) l1 = 255;
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = l0; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = l1;
        e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    }
    case 4:  // LA direct
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = v[0]; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = v[1];
        e0[3] = v[2]; e1[3] = v[3];
        return true;
    case 5: {  // LA delta
        int l0 = v[0], l1 = v[1], a0 = v[2], a1 = v[3];
        l0 |= (l1 & 0x80) << 1; a0 |= (a1 & 0x80) << 1;
        l1 &= 0x7F; a1 &= 0x7F;
        if (l1 & 0x40) l1 -= 0x80;
        if (a1 & 0x40) a1 -= 0x80;
        l0 >>= 1; a0 >>= 1; l1 >>= 1; a1 >>= 1;  // arithmetic shift of the signed deltas
        l1 = clamp255(l1 + l0); a1 = clamp255(a1 + a0);
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = l0; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = l1;
        e0[3] = a0; e1[3] = a1;
        return true;
    }
    case 6:  // RGB scale
    case 10: {  // RGB scale + two alphas
        int s = v[3];
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { e1[c] = v[c]; e0[c] = v[c] * s >> 8; }
        if (cem == 6) e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        else { e0[3] = v[4]; e1[3] = v[5]; }
        return true;
    }
    case 8:  // RGB(A) direct
    case 12: {
        int a[4] = {v[0], v[2], v[4], cem == 12 ? v[6] : 0};
        int b[4] = {v[1], v[3], v[5], cem == 12 ? v[7] : 0};
        if (a[0] + a[1] + a[2] > b[0] + b[1] + b[2]) {  // blue contraction: swap + uncontract
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = b[c]; e1[c] = a[c]; }
            e0[0] = (e0[0] + e0[2]) >> 1; e0[1] = (e0[1] + e0[2]) >> 1;
            e1[0] = (e1[0] + e1[2]) >> 1; e1[1] = (e1[1] + e1[2]) >> 1;
        } else {
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = a[c]; e1[c] = b[c]; }
        }
        if (cem == 8) e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    }
    case 9:  // RGB(A) base + delta
    case 13: {
        int n = cem == 13 ? 4 : 3;
        int a[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0}, b[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
            int base = v[2 * c], delta = v[2 * c + 1];
            a[c] = base >> 1 | (delta & 0x80);
            b[c] = delta >> 1 & 0x3F;
            if (b[c] & 0x20) b[c] -= 0x40;
        }
        int sum = b[0] + b[1] + b[2];
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) b[c] += a[c];
        if (sum < 0) {  // swap + uncontract
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = b[c]; e1[c] = a[c]; }
            e0[0] = (e0[0] + e0[2]) >> 1; e0[1] = (e0[1] + e0[2]) >> 1;
            e1[0] = (e1[0] + e1[2]) >> 1; e1[1] = (e1[1] + e1[2]) >> 1;
        } else {
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = a[c]; e1[c] = b[c]; }
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = clamp255(e0[c]); e1[c] = clamp255(e1[c]); }
        if (cem == 9) e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    }
    default:  // 2, 3, 7, 11, 14, 15: HDR
        return false;
    }
}

// ---- block ----

static void fill_error(uint8_t *out, int texels) {
    for (int i = 0; i < texels; i++) {
        out[4 * i + 0] = 0xFF; out[4 * i + 1] = 0x00; out[4 * i + 2] = 0xFF; out[4 * i + 3] = 0xFF;
    }
}

bool astc_decode_block(const uint8_t block[16], uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb, uint8_t *out) {
    if (bw < 4 || bh < 4 || bw > 12 || bh > 12) return false;  // not an ASTC 2D footprint
    int texels = (int)(bw * bh);
    Bits128 b = {load64(block), load64(block + 8)};
    uint32_t mode = (uint32_t)(b.lo & 0x7FF);

    if ((mode & 0x1FF) == 0x1FC) {  // void extent
        if (mode & 0x200) goto error;           // HDR (fp16) constant: error in LDR
        if ((b.lo >> 10 & 3) != 3) goto error;  // reserved bits
        uint32_t s0 = rbits(&b, 12, 13), s1 = rbits(&b, 25, 13);
        uint32_t t0 = rbits(&b, 38, 13), t1 = rbits(&b, 51, 13);
        bool all_ones = s0 == 0x1FFF && s1 == 0x1FFF && t0 == 0x1FFF && t1 == 0x1FFF;
        if ((s0 >= s1 || t0 >= t1) && !all_ones) goto error;
        uint8_t c[4] = {block[9], block[11], block[13], block[15]};  // top 8 bits of the UNORM16s
        for (int i = 0; i < texels; i++) memcpy(out + 4 * i, c, 4);
        return true;
    }

    BlockMode bm;
    if (!block_mode_2d(mode, bw, bh, &bm)) goto error;
    int pcount = (int)(b.lo >> 11 & 3) + 1;
    int wcount = bm.wx * bm.wy;

    // Weights, read backwards from the top of the block.
    uint8_t raw[64];
    Bits128 rev = {bitrev64(b.hi), bitrev64(b.lo)};
    ise_decode(&rev, 0, wcount << bm.dual, bm.quant, raw);
    if (bm.dual && pcount == 4) goto error;

    const uint8_t *wt = wunq_data + wunq_off[bm.quant];
    uint8_t grid[2][80];
    memset(grid, 0, sizeof grid);
    if (bm.dual) {
        for (int i = 0; i < wcount; i++) { grid[0][i] = wt[raw[2 * i]]; grid[1][i] = wt[raw[2 * i + 1]]; }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < wcount; i++) grid[0][i] = wt[raw[i]];
    }

    // Colour endpoint modes.
    int cem[4];
    int below = 128 - bm.wbits, high = 0;
    if (pcount == 1) {
        cem[0] = (int)(b.lo >> 13 & 0xF);
    } else {
        high = 3 * pcount - 4;
        below -= high;
        uint32_t enc = (uint32_t)(b.lo >> 23 & 0x3F) | rbits(&b, below, high) << 6;
        uint32_t base = enc & 3;
        if (base == 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) cem[i] = (int)(enc >> 2 & 0xF);
            below += high;
            high = 0;
        } else {
            base--;
            for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) cem[i] = (int)(((enc >> (2 + i) & 1) + base) << 2);
            for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) cem[i] |= (int)(enc >> (2 + pcount + 2 * i) & 3);
        }
    }
    int ccount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) ccount += ((cem[i] >> 2) + 1) * 2;
    if (ccount > 18) goto error;
    int cbits = (pcount == 1 ? 111 : 99) - bm.wbits - high - (bm.dual ? 2 : 0);
    if (cbits < 0) cbits = 0;
    int cq = -1;
    for (int q = 20; q >= 0; q--) {
        if (ise_bitcount(ccount, q) <= cbits) { cq = q; break; }
    }
    if (cq < QUANT_6) goto error;
    uint8_t cv[18];
    ise_decode(&b, pcount == 1 ? 17 : 29, ccount, cq, cv);
    if (cq != QUANT_256) {
        const uint8_t *ct = cunq_data + cunq_off[cq - QUANT_6];
        for (int i = 0; i < ccount; i++) cv[i] = ct[cv[i]];
    }
    int ccs = bm.dual ? (int)rbits(&b, below - 2, 2) : -1;

    // Endpoints, expanded to 16 bits.
    int ep[4][2][4];
    for (int p = 0, k = 0; p < pcount; p++) {
        int *e0 = ep[p][0], *e1 = ep[p][1];
        if (!unpack_endpoints(cem[p], cv + k, e0, e1)) {
            static const int magenta[4] = {0xFF, 0x00, 0xFF, 0xFF};
            memcpy(e0, magenta, sizeof magenta);
            memcpy(e1, magenta, sizeof magenta);
        }
        k += ((cem[p] >> 2) + 1) * 2;
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
            e0[c] = srgb ? e0[c] << 8 | 0x80 : e0[c] * 257;
            e1[c] = srgb ? e1[c] << 8 | 0x80 : e1[c] * 257;
        }
    }

    // Weight grid -> texel weights (bilinear infill), per axis.
    int xi[12], xf[12], yi[12], yf[12];
    for (uint32_t x = 0; x < bw; x++) {
        int v = (int)(((1024 + bw / 2) / (bw - 1)) * x * (uint32_t)(bm.wx - 1) + 32) >> 6;
        xi[x] = v >> 4; xf[x] = v & 0xF;
    }
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < bh; y++) {
        int v = (int)(((1024 + bh / 2) / (bh - 1)) * y * (uint32_t)(bm.wy - 1) + 32) >> 6;
        yi[y] = (v >> 4) * bm.wx; yf[y] = v & 0xF;
    }

    PartSel ps = {0};
    if (pcount > 1) part_init(&ps, (int)(b.lo >> 13 & 0x3FF), pcount);
    int small = texels < 32;

    uint8_t *o = out;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < bh; y++) {
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < bw; x++, o += 4) {
            int fs = xf[x], ft = yf[y];
            int w11 = (fs * ft + 8) >> 4, w10 = fs - w11, w01 = ft - w11, w00 = 16 - fs - ft + w11;
            int i0 = yi[y] + xi[x];
            int w[2];
            for (int pl = 0; pl <= bm.dual; pl++) {
                const uint8_t *g = grid[pl];
                w[pl] = (g[i0] * w00 + g[i0 + 1] * w10 + g[i0 + bm.wx] * w01 + g[i0 + bm.wx + 1] * w11 + 8) >> 4;
            }
            int p = pcount > 1 ? part_of(&ps, small ? (int)x << 1 : (int)x, small ? (int)y << 1 : (int)y) : 0;
            const int *e0 = ep[p][0], *e1 = ep[p][1];
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                int wc = c == ccs ? w[1] : w[0];
                o[c] = (uint8_t)((e0[c] * (64 - wc) + e1[c] * wc + 32) >> 14);  // >> 6, then top 8 bits
            }
        }
    }
    return true;

error:
    fill_error(out, texels);
    return false;
}

void astc_decode_ldr(const uint8_t *blocks, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh,
                     bool srgb, uint8_t *rgba_out) {
    if (bw < 4 || bh < 4 || bw > 12 || bh > 12) return;
    uint32_t bx = (width + bw - 1) / bw, by = (height + bh - 1) / bh;
    uint8_t tmp[12 * 12 * 4];
    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < by; j++) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bx; i++) {
            const uint8_t *src = blocks + 16 * ((size_t)j * bx + i);
            uint32_t x0 = i * bw, y0 = j * bh;
            uint32_t cw = width - x0 < bw ? width - x0 : bw, ch = height - y0 < bh ? height - y0 : bh;
            // decode in place when the block's rows are contiguous in the output
            uint8_t *dst = width == bw && ch == bh ? rgba_out + (size_t)y0 * width * 4 : tmp;
            astc_decode_block(src, bw, bh, srgb, dst);
            if (dst == tmp) {
                for (uint32_t y = 0; y < ch; y++)
                    memcpy(rgba_out + ((size_t)(y0 + y) * width + x0) * 4, tmp + y * bw * 4, cw * 4);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`runtime/tex_astc_mt.c`:

```c
// astc_decode_ldr_mt: astc_decode_ldr with the block rows of one image spread over a persistent worker pool. Each block
// goes through astc_decode_block and lands where astc_decode_ldr puts it, so the output is the same bytes. The caller
// takes part and returns when every row is done. One image at a time: a second caller while the pool is busy, or an
// image under MT_MIN_BLOCKS, decodes on its own thread.
#include <string.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "tex.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define MT_MIN_BLOCKS 1024   // below this, waking the pool costs about as much as the decode
#define MT_MAX_THREADS 8

static struct {
    PlatOnce once;
    PlatMutex busy;                    // held by the caller for the whole image
    PlatMutex lock;
    PlatCond work, done;
    int threads;                             // workers, the caller not counted
    uint64_t gen;                            // bumped per image; a worker joins each generation once
    int active;                              // workers that have not finished the current generation
    // the current image (written under lock before gen is bumped)
    const uint8_t *blocks;
    uint8_t *out;
    uint32_t width, height, bw, bh, bx, by, chunk;
    bool srgb;
    volatile int32_t next;                      // first block row not yet claimed
} P = {PLAT_ONCE_INIT, .lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT, .work = PLAT_COND_INIT, .done = PLAT_COND_INIT};

// Block rows [j0, j1) of the current image, as astc_decode_ldr's loop does them.
static void decode_rows(uint32_t j0, uint32_t j1) {
    uint32_t bw = P.bw, bh = P.bh, width = P.width, height = P.height;
    uint8_t tmp[12 * 12 * 4];
    for (uint32_t j = j0; j < j1; j++) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < P.bx; i++) {
            const uint8_t *src = P.blocks + 16 * ((size_t)j * P.bx + i);
            uint32_t x0 = i * bw, y0 = j * bh;
            uint32_t cw = width - x0 < bw ? width - x0 : bw, ch = height - y0 < bh ? height - y0 : bh;
            uint8_t *dst = width == bw && ch == bh ? P.out + (size_t)y0 * width * 4 : tmp;
            astc_decode_block(src, bw, bh, P.srgb, dst);
            if (dst == tmp)
                for (uint32_t y = 0; y < ch; y++)
                    memcpy(P.out + ((size_t)(y0 + y) * width + x0) * 4, tmp + y * bw * 4, cw * 4);
        }
    }
}

static void claim_rows(void) {
    for (;;) {
        int32_t j0 = plat_xadd32(&P.next, (int32_t)P.chunk);
        if ((uint32_t)j0 >= P.by) return;
        uint32_t j1 = (uint32_t)j0 + P.chunk;
        decode_rows((uint32_t)j0, j1 < P.by ? j1 : P.by);
    }
}

static void worker(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    uint64_t seen = 0;
    plat_mutex_lock(&P.lock);
    for (;;) {
        while (P.gen == seen) plat_cond_wait(&P.work, &P.lock);
        seen = P.gen;
        plat_mutex_unlock(&P.lock);
        claim_rows();
        plat_mutex_lock(&P.lock);
        if (!--P.active) plat_cond_broadcast(&P.done);
    }
    return;
}

// Hardware threads minus 2 (the render and the main guest thread), 1 to MT_MAX_THREADS; the caller is one of them.
static void pool_init(void *param) {
    (void)param;
    int cpus = (int)plat_cpu_usable() - 2;
    int n = (cpus < 1 ? 1 : cpus > MT_MAX_THREADS ? MT_MAX_THREADS : cpus) - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!plat_thread_spawn(worker, NULL, "astc", 0)) break;
        P.threads++;
    }
    rt_log("tex_astc: %d ASTC decode workers", P.threads);
    return;
}

void astc_decode_ldr_mt(const uint8_t *blocks, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb,
                        uint8_t *rgba_out) {
    if (bw < 4 || bh < 4 || bw > 12 || bh > 12) return;
    uint32_t bx = (width + bw - 1) / bw, by = (height + bh - 1) / bh;
    if ((uint64_t)bx * by < MT_MIN_BLOCKS || by < 2) {
        astc_decode_ldr(blocks, width, height, bw, bh, srgb, rgba_out);
        return;
    }
    plat_once(&P.once, pool_init, NULL);
    if (!P.threads || !plat_mutex_trylock(&P.busy)) {
        astc_decode_ldr(blocks, width, height, bw, bh, srgb, rgba_out);
        return;
    }
    plat_mutex_lock(&P.lock);
    P.blocks = blocks, P.out = rgba_out, P.width = width, P.height = height, P.bw = bw, P.bh = bh, P.bx = bx, P.by = by;
    P.srgb = srgb;
    uint32_t parts = (uint32_t)(P.threads + 1) * 4;   // a few chunks per thread evens out uneven blocks
    P.chunk = by / parts ? by / parts : 1;
    P.next = 0;
    P.active = P.threads;
    P.gen++;
    plat_cond_broadcast(&P.work);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&P.lock);
    claim_rows();
    plat_mutex_lock(&P.lock);
    while (P.active) plat_cond_wait(&P.done, &P.lock);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&P.lock);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&P.busy);
}
```

`runtime/tex_deswizzle.c`:

```c
// Tegra X1 block-linear <-> linear copies.
// Ported from MacNativeGames games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/tex/nvn_deswizzle.c @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 jhaizhou); comments translated, the copy loop split out as tex_bl_copy.
//
// Layout (public descriptions: deko3d, Ryujinx BlockLinearLayout):
//   GOB = 64 bytes x 8 rows = 512 bytes; offset of (x byte, y row) within a GOB =
//     (x%64/32)*256 + (y%8/2)*64 + (x%32/16)*32 + (y%2)*16 + x%16
//   block = 1 GOB wide x 2^th GOBs high x 2^td GOBs deep, ordered y first then z inside a block; blocks fill the level
//   in x -> y -> z row-major order.
// Level and layer start offsets and the block height and depth of a level come from nvn_tex.c; this file only does the
// addressing inside a level and the copy.
#include "tex.h"
#include <string.h>

// Byte offset inside a 64 x 8 GOB in the Switch 2 layout: x[3:0] -> bits 0-3, y[0] -> 4, y[1] -> 5, x[4] -> 6, y[2] -> 7,
// x[5] -> 8. It is the Switch 1 GOB with bits 5 and 6 swapped (Eglantine, video_core/textures/decoders.cpp,
// NativeGobOffset, which ChannelState::Init turns on for every nx2 image through EnableNativeTiling).
static uint32_t gob_off(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    return (x % 64 / 32) * 256 + (y % 8 / 4) * 128 + (x % 32 / 16) * 64 + (y % 4 / 2) * 32 + (y % 2) * 16 + x % 16;
}

uint64_t nvn_bl_offset(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z, uint32_t row_bytes, uint32_t rows, unsigned th, unsigned td) {
    uint32_t bh = 1u << th, bd = 1u << td;
    uint64_t gobs_x = (row_bytes + 63) / 64, blocks_y = (rows + 8 * bh - 1) / (8 * bh);
    uint64_t block = 512ull * bh * bd;                                  // bytes in one block
    return (z / bd) * gobs_x * blocks_y * block                        // which block layer (along depth)
         + (y / (8 * bh)) * gobs_x * block                             // which block row
         + (x / 64) * block                                            // which block column
         + ((z % bd) * bh + (y % (8 * bh)) / 8) * 512ull               // which GOB within the block
         + gob_off(x, y);
}

static uint32_t mip(uint32_t s, unsigned l) { s >>= l; return s ? s : 1; }

// Geometry of one level: bytes per row of blocks, block rows, slices, where the level and layer start in the storage,
// and the level's block height and depth. -1 for textures the copy does not handle.
int nvn_deswizzle_geom(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer,
                       uint32_t *row_bytes, uint32_t *rows, uint32_t *slices, uint64_t *base, unsigned *th, unsigned *td, uint32_t *bpb) {
    if (d->target == 5 || d->target == 6 || d->target == 10 || nvn_tex_is_linear(d) || d->samples > 1) return -1;   // MS / BUFFER / LINEAR
    int bw, bh; *bpb = (uint32_t)nvn_fmt_bpb(d->format, &bw, &bh);
    if (!*bpb || level >= (d->levels ? d->levels : 1)) return -1;
    nvn_texlayout L; nvn_tex_layout(d, &L);
    if (layer >= L.layers) return -1;
    int one_d = d->target == 0 || d->target == 3;
    uint32_t w = mip(d->width, level), h = one_d ? 1 : mip(d->height, level);
    *slices = d->target == 2 ? mip(d->depth ? d->depth : 1, level) : 1;
    *row_bytes = (w + bw - 1) / bw * *bpb; *rows = (h + bh - 1) / bh;
    *base = (uint64_t)layer * L.layer_size + nvn_tex_level_offset(d, level);
    nvn_tex_level_tiles(d, level, th, td);
    return 0;
}

// nvn_bl_offset per row instead of per 16 bytes: within a row, GOB column k starts k blocks further, and the four
// 16-byte segments of a GOB row (x % 64 = 0, 16, 32, 48) sit at 0, 64, 256 and 320 of it.
void tex_bl_copy(uint8_t *bl, uint8_t *lin, size_t pitch, uint32_t row_bytes, uint32_t rows, uint32_t slices,
                 unsigned th, unsigned td, int to_linear) {
    static const uint32_t seg[4] = {0, 64, 256, 320};
    uint64_t block = 512ull << th << td;
    for (uint32_t z = 0; z < slices; z++)
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
            uint8_t *row = lin + ((size_t)z * rows + y) * pitch, *g = bl + nvn_bl_offset(0, y, z, row_bytes, rows, th, td);
            uint32_t x = 0;
            if (to_linear)
                for (; x + 64 <= row_bytes; x += 64, g += block)
                    for (int s = 0; s < 4; s++) memcpy(row + x + 16 * s, g + seg[s], 16);
            else
                for (; x + 64 <= row_bytes; x += 64, g += block)
                    for (int s = 0; s < 4; s++) memcpy(g + seg[s], row + x + 16 * s, 16);
            for (int s = 0; x < row_bytes; s++, x += 16) {   // a partial GOB at the row's end
                uint32_t n = row_bytes - x < 16 ? row_bytes - x : 16;
                if (to_linear) memcpy(row + x, g + seg[s], n); else memcpy(g + seg[s], row + x, n);
            }
        }
}

static int move(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, uint8_t *bl, uint8_t *lin, size_t pitch, int to_linear) {
    if (nvn_tex_is_linear(d)) {
        if (level || layer || d->samples > 1 || (d->target != 0 && d->target != 1 && d->target != 7)) return -1;
        int bw, bh, bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(d->format, &bw, &bh);
        if (!bpb) return -1;
        size_t row = (size_t)((d->width + bw - 1) / bw) * bpb;
        uint32_t rows = d->target == 0 ? 1 : (d->height + bh - 1) / bh, stride = nvn_tex_linear_stride(d);
        if (pitch < row || stride < row) return -1;
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
            if (to_linear) memcpy(lin + y * pitch, bl + (size_t)y * stride, row);
            else memcpy(bl + (size_t)y * stride, lin + y * pitch, row);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    uint32_t row_bytes, rows, slices, bpb; uint64_t base; unsigned th, td;
    if (nvn_deswizzle_geom(d, level, layer, &row_bytes, &rows, &slices, &base, &th, &td, &bpb)) return -1;
    if (pitch < row_bytes) return -1;
    tex_bl_copy(bl + base, lin, pitch, row_bytes, rows, slices, th, td, to_linear);
    return 0;
}

int nvn_texels_box(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z, uint32_t wb,
                   uint32_t h, void *storage, void *rows, size_t pitch, int to_linear) {
    uint8_t *st = storage, *ln = rows;
    if (nvn_tex_is_linear(d)) {
        if (level || layer || z || d->samples > 1 || (d->target != 0 && d->target != 1 && d->target != 7)) return -1;
        int bw, bh, bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(d->format, &bw, &bh);
        if (!bpb) return -1;
        size_t row = (size_t)((d->width + bw - 1) / bw) * bpb;
        uint32_t nrows = d->target == 0 ? 1 : (d->height + bh - 1) / bh, stride = nvn_tex_linear_stride(d);
        if (stride < row || x + (size_t)wb > row || y + (uint64_t)h > nrows) return -1;
        for (uint32_t r = 0; r < h; r++) {
            uint8_t *p = st + (size_t)(y + r) * stride + x, *q = ln + r * pitch;
            if (to_linear) memcpy(q, p, wb); else memcpy(p, q, wb);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    uint32_t row_bytes, nrows, slices, bpb; uint64_t base; unsigned th, td;
    if (nvn_deswizzle_geom(d, level, layer, &row_bytes, &nrows, &slices, &base, &th, &td, &bpb)) return -1;
    if (x + (uint64_t)wb > row_bytes || y + (uint64_t)h > nrows || z >= slices) return -1;
    for (uint32_t r = 0; r < h; r++) {
        uint8_t *q = ln + r * pitch;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < wb;) {
            uint32_t xb = x + i, n = 16 - xb % 16;   // contiguous up to the end of its 16-byte segment
            if (n > wb - i) n = wb - i;
            uint8_t *p = st + base + nvn_bl_offset(xb, y + r, z, row_bytes, nrows, th, td);
            if (to_linear) memcpy(q + i, p, n); else memcpy(p, q + i, n);
            i += n;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int nvn_deswizzle(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, const void *src, void *dst, size_t dst_pitch) {
    return move(d, level, layer, (uint8_t *)src, (uint8_t *)dst, dst_pitch, 1);
}
int nvn_swizzle(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, const void *src, size_t src_pitch, void *dst) {
    return move(d, level, layer, (uint8_t *)dst, (uint8_t *)src, src_pitch, 0);
}

```

`runtime/tex_probe.c`:

```c
// totk.exe --probe-vkmem: texture memory checks. The CPU part: block-linear copies against an
// independent reference, ASTC void-extent blocks, and the NVN -> VkFormat table against GPU0. The GPU part:
// guest heap imported as a VkBuffer, write watch against CPU, GPU and ReadFile writes, the virtual-pool page table,
// and textures uploaded from block-linear storage and read back.
// The reference swizzler walks the GOBs in storage order and places each byte by bit operations, so it shares no
// addressing code with nvn_bl_offset.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "tex.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

static uint64_t g_rng = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
static uint8_t rnd8(void) {
    g_rng ^= g_rng << 13; g_rng ^= g_rng >> 7; g_rng ^= g_rng << 17;
    return (uint8_t)(g_rng >> 32);
}

// Byte offset inside a 64 x 8 GOB from the Switch 2 bit layout: x[3:0] -> 0-3, y[0] -> 4, y[1] -> 5, x[4] -> 6,
// y[2] -> 7, x[5] -> 8.
static unsigned gob_bits(unsigned x, unsigned y) {
    return (x & 15) | (y & 1) << 4 | (y >> 1 & 1) << 5 | (x >> 4 & 1) << 6 | (y >> 2 & 1) << 7 | (x >> 5 & 1) << 8;
}

// lin: slices * rows * row_bytes (tight). bl: block-linear storage, pre-filled with a marker.
static void ref_swizzle(const uint8_t *lin, uint8_t *bl, uint32_t row_bytes, uint32_t rows, uint32_t slices,
                        unsigned th, unsigned td) {
    uint32_t bh = 1u << th, bd = 1u << td;
    uint32_t gx = (row_bytes + 63) / 64, by = (rows + 8 * bh - 1) / (8 * bh), bz = (slices + bd - 1) / bd;
    uint8_t *p = bl;
    for (uint32_t kz = 0; kz < bz; kz++)
        for (uint32_t ky = 0; ky < by; ky++)
            for (uint32_t kx = 0; kx < gx; kx++)
                for (uint32_t z = 0; z < bd; z++)          // GOBs of a block: y fastest, then z
                    for (uint32_t g = 0; g < bh; g++) {
                        for (unsigned y = 0; y < 8; y++)
                            for (unsigned x = 0; x < 64; x++) {
                                uint32_t ax = kx * 64 + x, ay = (ky * bh + g) * 8 + y, az = kz * bd + z;
                                if (ax < row_bytes && ay < rows && az < slices)
                                    p[gob_bits(x, y)] = lin[((size_t)az * rows + ay) * row_bytes + ax];
                            }
                        p += 512;
                    }
}

static size_t bl_size(uint32_t row_bytes, uint32_t rows, uint32_t slices, unsigned th, unsigned td) {
    uint32_t bh = 1u << th, bd = 1u << td;
    return (size_t)((row_bytes + 63) / 64) * ((rows + 8 * bh - 1) / (8 * bh)) * ((slices + bd - 1) / bd) * 512 * bh * bd;
}

static unsigned g_cases;

static int check_swizzle(uint32_t row_bytes, uint32_t rows, uint32_t slices, unsigned th, unsigned td, uint32_t bpb) {
    size_t n = (size_t)row_bytes * rows * slices, bn = bl_size(row_bytes, rows, slices, th, td);
    uint8_t *lin = malloc(n), *back = malloc(n), *ref = malloc(bn), *got = malloc(bn);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) lin[i] = rnd8();
    memset(ref, 0xEE, bn);
    memset(got, 0xEE, bn);
    ref_swizzle(lin, ref, row_bytes, rows, slices, th, td);
    tex_bl_copy(got, lin, row_bytes, row_bytes, rows, slices, th, td, 0);
    int bad = 0;
    if (memcmp(ref, got, bn)) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL swizzle bpb=%u th=%u td=%u %ux%ux%u differs from the reference\n", bpb, th, td, row_bytes, rows, slices); bad = 1; }
    memset(back, 0, n);
    tex_bl_copy(ref, back, row_bytes, row_bytes, rows, slices, th, td, 1);
    if (!bad && memcmp(lin, back, n)) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL deswizzle bpb=%u th=%u td=%u %ux%ux%u differs from the source\n", bpb, th, td, row_bytes, rows, slices); bad = 1; }
    g_cases++;
    free(lin); free(back); free(ref); free(got);
    return bad;
}

static int test_deswizzle(void) {
    static const uint32_t bpbs[] = {1, 2, 4, 8, 16};
    for (unsigned b = 0; b < 5; b++)
        for (unsigned th = 0; th <= 5; th++) {
            uint32_t w = 37 * bpbs[b];
            if (check_swizzle(w, 61, 1, th, 0, bpbs[b])) return 1;        // spans several blocks in x and y
            if (check_swizzle(bpbs[b], 1, 1, th, 0, bpbs[b])) return 1;   // one block
            if (check_swizzle(70 * bpbs[b], 9, 1, th, 0, bpbs[b])) return 1;
        }
    for (unsigned td = 1; td <= 3; td++)                                  // 3D: depth 5 against block depths 2, 4, 8
        for (unsigned th = 0; th <= 2; th++)
            if (check_swizzle(23 * 4, 19, 5, th, td, 4)) return 1;

    // Through a descriptor: RGBA8 2D with mip levels, level 1 and 2, layer 0, against the reference on the same geometry.
    nvn_texdesc d = {.target = 1, .format = 0x25, .width = 200, .height = 150, .depth = 1, .levels = 4};
    nvn_texlayout L;
    nvn_tex_layout(&d, &L);
    uint8_t *store = malloc(L.size), *lin;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < L.size; i++) store[i] = rnd8();
    for (unsigned lv = 0; lv < 4; lv++) {
        uint32_t rb, rows, sl, bpb; uint64_t base; unsigned th, td;
        if (nvn_deswizzle_geom(&d, lv, 0, &rb, &rows, &sl, &base, &th, &td, &bpb)) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL geometry of level %u\n", lv); return 1; }
        size_t pitch = rb + 16, n = (size_t)pitch * rows;
        lin = calloc(1, n);
        if (nvn_deswizzle(&d, lv, 0, store, lin, pitch)) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL nvn_deswizzle level %u\n", lv); return 1; }
        size_t bn = bl_size(rb, rows, sl, th, td);
        uint8_t *tight = malloc((size_t)rb * rows), *ref0 = malloc(bn), *ref1 = malloc(bn);
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < rows; y++) memcpy(tight + (size_t)y * rb, lin + (size_t)y * pitch, rb);
        memset(ref0, 0x00, bn);
        memset(ref1, 0xFF, bn);
        ref_swizzle(tight, ref0, rb, rows, sl, th, td);
        ref_swizzle(tight, ref1, rb, rows, sl, th, td);
        // bytes where both fills agree were written by the reference; the untouched storage must hold the same
        for (size_t i = 0; i < bn; i++)
            if (ref0[i] == ref1[i] && store[base + i] != ref0[i]) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL level %u differs from the reference at byte %zu\n", lv, i); return 1; }
        // swizzling the linear copy back leaves the storage unchanged
        uint8_t *keep = malloc(bn);
        memcpy(keep, store + base, bn);
        if (nvn_swizzle(&d, lv, 0, lin, pitch, store)) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL nvn_swizzle level %u\n", lv); return 1; }
        if (memcmp(keep, store + base, bn)) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL swizzle round trip level %u\n", lv); return 1; }
        free(keep); free(ref0); free(ref1);
        g_cases++;
        free(lin); free(tight);
    }
    free(store);
    return 0;
}

// nvn_texels_box against the whole-level path on random boxes: a box read equals the box cut from the deswizzled level,
// and a box write leaves the storage as deswizzle, overwrite the box, swizzle does (nothing outside the box changes).
static int check_box(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned lv, unsigned layer) {
    uint32_t rb, rows, sl, bpb; uint64_t base; unsigned th, td;
    if (nvn_deswizzle_geom(d, lv, layer, &rb, &rows, &sl, &base, &th, &td, &bpb)) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL box geometry\n"); return 1; }
    nvn_texlayout L;
    nvn_tex_layout(d, &L);
    uint8_t *store = malloc(L.size), *want = malloc(L.size), *lin = malloc((size_t)rb * rows * sl);
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < L.size; i++) store[i] = rnd8();
    uint32_t cols = rb / bpb;
    for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        uint32_t bx = rnd8() % cols, bn = 1 + rnd8() % (cols - bx), y = rnd8() % rows, h = 1 + rnd8() % (rows - y);
        uint32_t z = sl > 1 ? rnd8() % sl : 0, x = bx * bpb, wb = bn * bpb;
        size_t pitch = wb + 8;
        uint8_t *box = malloc(pitch * h), *ref = malloc(pitch * h);
        // read
        if (nvn_deswizzle(d, lv, layer, store, lin, rb)) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL box deswizzle\n"); return 1; }
        memset(box, 0xAB, pitch * h), memset(ref, 0xAB, pitch * h);
        for (uint32_t r = 0; r < h; r++) memcpy(ref + r * pitch, lin + ((size_t)z * rows + y + r) * rb + x, wb);
        if (nvn_texels_box(d, lv, layer, x, y, z, wb, h, store, box, pitch, 1) || memcmp(box, ref, pitch * h)) {
            printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL box read format %#x level %u layer %u box %u,%u,%u %ux%u\n", d->format, lv, layer, x, y, z, wb, h);
            return 1;
        }
        // write
        for (size_t i = 0; i < pitch * h; i++) box[i] = rnd8();
        memcpy(want, store, L.size);
        for (uint32_t r = 0; r < h; r++) memcpy(lin + ((size_t)z * rows + y + r) * rb + x, box + r * pitch, wb);
        if (nvn_swizzle(d, lv, layer, lin, rb, want)) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL box swizzle\n"); return 1; }
        if (nvn_texels_box(d, lv, layer, x, y, z, wb, h, store, box, pitch, 0) || memcmp(store, want, L.size)) {
            printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL box write format %#x level %u layer %u box %u,%u,%u %ux%u\n", d->format, lv, layer, x, y, z, wb, h);
            return 1;
        }
        g_cases++;
        free(box), free(ref);
    }
    free(store), free(want), free(lin);
    return 0;
}

static int test_box(void) {
    // one format per block size: 1, 8 and 16 bytes per texel, 8 and 16 bytes per 4x4 block
    int fmt[5] = {0}, n = 0;
    static const int want_bpb[5] = {1, 8, 16, 8, 16}, want_bw[5] = {1, 1, 1, 4, 4};
    for (int f = 1; f < 0x200 && n < 5; f++) {
        int bw, bh, bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(f, &bw, &bh);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
            if (!fmt[i] && bpb == want_bpb[i] && bw == want_bw[i] && bh == bw) fmt[i] = f, n++;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        if (!fmt[i]) continue;
        nvn_texdesc d2 = {.target = 1, .format = fmt[i], .width = 300, .height = 170, .depth = 1, .levels = 3};
        nvn_texdesc da = {.target = 4, .format = fmt[i], .width = 96, .height = 80, .depth = 3, .levels = 2};
        nvn_texdesc d3 = {.target = 2, .format = fmt[i], .width = 72, .height = 40, .depth = 5, .levels = 2};
        for (unsigned lv = 0; lv < 2; lv++)
            if (check_box(&d2, lv, 0) || check_box(&da, lv, 2) || check_box(&d3, lv, 0)) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

// ---- ASTC ----
static void void_block(uint8_t b[16], uint16_t r, uint16_t g, uint16_t bl, uint16_t a, int hdr) {
    uint64_t lo = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFDFCull;     // 0x1FC mode, LDR, reserved bits 11, extent all ones
    if (hdr) lo |= 0x200;
    memcpy(b, &lo, 8);
    uint16_t c[4] = {r, g, bl, a};
    memcpy(b + 8, c, 8);
}

static unsigned g_astc_blocks;

static int test_astc(void) {
    static const uint8_t dims[14][2] = {{4, 4}, {5, 4}, {5, 5}, {6, 5}, {6, 6}, {8, 5}, {8, 6},
                                        {8, 8}, {10, 5}, {10, 6}, {10, 8}, {10, 10}, {12, 10}, {12, 12}};
    for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
        unsigned bw = dims[i][0], bh = dims[i][1];
        // a 3x2 grid of void-extent blocks cropped to a size that cuts the last column and row
        unsigned w = bw * 3 - 1, h = bh * 2 - 1;
        uint8_t blocks[6 * 16];
        uint8_t want[6][4];
        for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
            uint8_t c[4];
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) c[j] = rnd8();
            // UNORM16 = c * 257 gives back c in the top 8 bits, plus noise in the low byte that must be dropped
            uint16_t v[4];
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) v[j] = (uint16_t)(c[j] << 8 | rnd8());
            void_block(blocks + 16 * k, v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3], 0);
            memcpy(want[k], c, 4);
        }
        uint8_t *out = calloc(1, (size_t)w * h * 4);
        for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
            astc_decode_ldr(blocks, w, h, bw, bh, s, out);
            for (unsigned y = 0; y < h; y++)
                for (unsigned x = 0; x < w; x++)
                    if (memcmp(out + ((size_t)y * w + x) * 4, want[y / bh * 3 + x / bw], 4)) {
                        printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL astc %ux%u void extent at (%u,%u)\n", bw, bh, x, y);
                        return 1;
                    }
        }
        free(out);
        // HDR void extent is an error block in LDR: magenta, and astc_decode_block reports it
        uint8_t hb[16], tmp[12 * 12 * 4];
        void_block(hb, 0x1234, 0x5678, 0x9ABC, 0xDEF0, 1);
        if (astc_decode_block(hb, bw, bh, false, tmp) || memcmp(tmp, "\xff\x00\xff\xff", 4)) {
            printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL astc %ux%u HDR void extent is not an error block\n", bw, bh);
            return 1;
        }
        g_astc_blocks += 7;
    }
    // sRGB void extent: the colour is the stored top byte as well (no transfer curve for constant blocks)
    uint8_t b[16], px[16 * 4];
    void_block(b, 0xFF00, 0x8000, 0x0100, 0xFFFF, 0);
    astc_decode_block(b, 4, 4, true, px);
    if (memcmp(px, "\xff\x80\x01\xff", 4)) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL astc sRGB void extent\n"); return 1; }
    g_astc_blocks++;
    // the worker-pool decode gives the same bytes: random blocks (every mode, error blocks included), cropped edges
    for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
        unsigned bw = dims[i][0], bh = dims[i][1], w = 1021, h = 517, n = (w + bw - 1) / bw * ((h + bh - 1) / bh);
        uint8_t *blk = malloc((size_t)n * 16), *a = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4), *m = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
        for (size_t k = 0; k < (size_t)n * 16; k++) blk[k] = rnd8();
        for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
            memset(a, 0x11, (size_t)w * h * 4), memset(m, 0x22, (size_t)w * h * 4);
            astc_decode_ldr(blk, w, h, bw, bh, s, a);
            astc_decode_ldr_mt(blk, w, h, bw, bh, s, m);
            if (memcmp(a, m, (size_t)w * h * 4)) {
                printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL astc %ux%u: the worker-pool decode differs from astc_decode_ldr\n", bw, bh);
                return 1;
            }
        }
        free(blk), free(a), free(m);
        g_astc_blocks += n;
    }
    return 0;
}

// ---- formats ----
static unsigned n_mapped, n_supported, n_unmapped, n_unsupported, n_fallback;

static int test_formats(void) {
    if (!vk_init()) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL vk_init\n"); return 1; }
    printf("probe-vkmem: GPU %s\n", vk_ctx()->props.deviceName);
    for (int f = 0; f <= 0x9C; f++) {
        TexVkFormat t;
        int ok = tex_vk_format(f, &t);
        if (!ok) {
            n_unmapped++;
            printf("probe-vkmem: unmapped %#x: %s\n", f, t.reason ? t.reason : "(no reason)");
            if (!t.reason) return 1;
            continue;
        }
        n_mapped++;
        if (t.vk != t.ideal) n_fallback++;
        int bw, bh, bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(f, &bw, &bh);
        if (t.astc_bw && (bpb != 16 || bw != t.astc_bw || bh != t.astc_bh)) {
            printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL ASTC format %#x: block %dx%d/%d bytes, table says %ux%u\n", f, bw, bh, bpb, t.astc_bw, t.astc_bh);
            return 1;
        }
        if (tex_vk_format_supported(&t)) n_supported++;
        else {
            n_unsupported++;
            printf("probe-vkmem: unsupported %#x: VkFormat %d lacks features %#x on this GPU\n", f, (int)t.vk, (unsigned)t.need);
        }
    }
    // The GPU-side promises of the fallbacks: RGBA8 and D32S8 must be usable, otherwise the fallback is empty.
    TexVkFormat t;
    tex_vk_format(0x79, &t);
    int ok_astc = tex_vk_format_supported(&t);
    tex_vk_format(0x35, &t);
    int ok_d = tex_vk_format_supported(&t) && t.vk == VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT;
    if (!ok_astc || !ok_d) { printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL fallback formats (RGBA8 %d, D32S8 %d)\n", ok_astc, ok_d); return 1; }
    return 0;
}

// ---- GPU part ----
#define GCHECK(cond, ...)                                                                                              \
    do {                                                                                                               \
        if (!(cond)) {                                                                                                 \
            printf("probe-vkmem: FAIL ");                                                                              \
            printf(__VA_ARGS__);                                                                                       \
            printf("\n");                                                                                              \
            return 1;                                                                                                  \
        }                                                                                                              \
    } while (0)

static unsigned g_gpu_checks;
static uint64_t g_gpu_seen, g_rf_seen[2], g_rf_us[2];

static void copy_wait(VkBuffer src, VkDeviceSize so, VkBuffer dst, VkDeviceSize doff, VkDeviceSize n) {
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_upload_begin();
    VkBufferCopy rg = {so, doff, n};
    vkCmdCopyBuffer(cb, src, dst, 1, &rg);
    VkMemoryBarrier2 mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT,
                           .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT,
                           .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &mb};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
    vk_upload_end();
    vk_upload_flush(1);
}

// A CPU-visible pool over the guest heap: GPU writes land in guest memory, CPU writes are read by the GPU, write watch
// reports the CPU writes and the explicit ones. GPU writes are noted and reported as the replay does
// (vk_mem_gpu_pending, vk_gpu_written at the fence), and a GPU read follows vk_mem_shadow_sync as a submit does: with
// shadow storage that is what moves the bytes; with an import they are already in place.
static int test_import(pool_t *pool) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    uint8_t *m = pool->mem;
    uint64_t a = (uintptr_t)m, pages[64], n;
    GCHECK(vk_pool_init(pool), "vk_pool_init of a CPU-visible pool at %#llx", (unsigned long long)a);
    VkMemSpan sp;
    GCHECK(vk_mem_resolve(a + 0x1000, 0x20000, &sp) && sp.buffer && sp.offset == 0x1000 && sp.avail == pool->size - 0x1000,
           "resolve inside the imported pool (offset %#llx, avail %#llx)", (unsigned long long)sp.offset,
           (unsigned long long)sp.avail);
    GCHECK(!vk_mem_resolve(a + pool->size - 0x10, 0x20, &sp), "a range past the pool end resolved");
    g_gpu_checks += 2;

    VkBuffer sb;
    VmaAllocation sa;
    uint8_t *s = vk_staging(0x20000, &sb, &sa);
    for (int i = 0; i < 0x20000; i++) s[i] = rnd8();
    vmaFlushAllocation(c->vma, sa, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    vk_mem_resolve(a + 0x1000, 0x20000, &sp);
    mem_written_pages(a, pool->size, pages, 64);
    vk_mem_gpu_pending(a + 0x1000, 0x20000);
    copy_wait(sb, 0, sp.buffer, sp.offset, 0x20000);
    vk_gpu_written(a + 0x1000, 0x20000);
    GCHECK(!memcmp(m + 0x1000, s, 0x20000), "GPU copy into the imported heap range differs from the source");
    n = mem_written_pages(a, pool->size, pages, 64);
    g_gpu_seen = n;
    printf("probe-vkmem: GPU copy of 128 KiB into the imported heap: equal; write watch reported %llu of 32 pages\n",
           (unsigned long long)n);

    // CPU writes: reported exactly, and the GPU reads them through the same buffer
    for (int i = 0; i < 0x4000; i++) m[0x30000 + i] = rnd8();
    n = mem_written_peek(a, pool->size, pages, 64);
    GCHECK(n == 4 && pages[0] == a + 0x30000 && pages[3] == a + 0x33000, "CPU writes to 4 pages: %llu reported",
           (unsigned long long)n);
    vk_mem_resolve(a + 0x30000, 0x4000, &sp);
    vk_mem_shadow_sync();
    copy_wait(sp.buffer, sp.offset, sb, 0, 0x4000);
    vmaInvalidateAllocation(c->vma, sa, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    GCHECK(!memcmp(s, m + 0x30000, 0x4000), "GPU read of CPU-written heap differs");
    VkMemInspect inspect;
    if (vk_mem_inspect(a + 0x30000, 0x4000, &inspect) && inspect.shadow_storage) {
        // Two overlapping pending GPU writes protect their union from a newer CPU write. The copy check exercises
        // the same CPU -> shadow sync used by submits, without depending on scheduling a GPU write during the test.
        memset(m + 0x30000, 0x11, 0x4000);
        vk_mem_resolve(a + 0x30000, 0x4000, &sp);
        vk_mem_shadow_sync();
        vk_mem_gpu_pending(a + 0x31000, 0x1800);
        vk_mem_gpu_pending(a + 0x32000, 0x1800);
        memset(m + 0x30000, 0x22, 0x4000);
        vk_mem_resolve(a + 0x30000, 0x4000, &sp);
        vk_mem_shadow_sync();
        copy_wait(sp.buffer, sp.offset, sb, 0, 0x4000);
        vmaInvalidateAllocation(c->vma, sa, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
        int equal = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 0x4000; i++)
            if (s[i] != (i >= 0x1000 && i < 0x3800 ? 0x11 : 0x22)) { equal = 0; break; }
        GCHECK(equal, "shadow sync copied bytes covered by overlapping pending GPU writes");
        vk_gpu_written(a + 0x31000, 0x1800);
        vk_gpu_written(a + 0x32000, 0x1800);
        memset(m + 0x30000, 0x33, 0x4000);
        vk_mem_resolve(a + 0x30000, 0x4000, &sp);
        vk_mem_shadow_sync();
        copy_wait(sp.buffer, sp.offset, sb, 0, 0x4000);
        vmaInvalidateAllocation(c->vma, sa, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
        for (int i = 0; i < 0x4000; i++)
            if (s[i] != 0x33) { equal = 0; break; }
        GCHECK(equal, "shadow sync retained a completed GPU write in its pending index");
        g_gpu_checks += 2;
    }
    vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, sb, sa);

    // generations: written after `since` -> 1, then 0, explicit host write -> 1
    uint32_t g0, g1, g2, g3;
    vk_mem_changed(a, pool->size, 0, &g0);
    m[0x8000] = 1;
    GCHECK(vk_mem_changed(a + 0x8000, 0x1000, g0, &g1) == 1, "a CPU write after a generation is not seen");
    GCHECK(vk_mem_changed(a, pool->size, g1, &g2) == 0, "no write since the last generation is reported as written");
    vk_guest_written(a + 0x9000, 4);
    GCHECK(vk_mem_changed(a + 0x9000, 0x1000, g2, &g3) == 1, "an explicit guest_written range is not seen");
    GCHECK(vk_mem_changed(RT_KERNEL_BASE, 0x1000, 0, &g3) == -1, "the kernel region is reported as tracked");
    printf("probe-vkmem: write watch: CPU writes reported page-exact; generations see CPU and explicit writes\n");
    g_gpu_checks += 7;
    return 0;
}

// ReadFile into a watched page, buffered and unbuffered: timed, and whether write watch saw the kernel's write.
static int test_readfile(uint8_t *dst) {
    char dir[PLAT_PATH_MAX], path[PLAT_PATH_MAX + 64];
    GCHECK(plat_temp_dir(dir, sizeof dir), "temp directory");
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/tvk-%u.tmp", dir, plat_process_id());
    static uint8_t data[0x2000];
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof data; i++) data[i] = rnd8();
    GCHECK(plat_file_write(path, data, sizeof data), "temp file write");
    for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
        uint8_t *p = dst + (size_t)k * 0x2000;
        uint64_t pages[8];
        PlatFile *h = k ? plat_file_open_unbuffered(path) : plat_file_open(path);
        GCHECK(h, "temp file open");
        mem_written_pages((uintptr_t)p, 0x2000, pages, 8);
        uint64_t t0 = plat_now_ns();
        int64_t got = plat_file_pread(h, p, 0x2000, 0);
        uint64_t t1 = plat_now_ns();
        plat_file_close(h);
        GCHECK(got == 0x2000 && !memcmp(p, data, sizeof data), "ReadFile (%s) result", k ? "unbuffered" : "buffered");
        g_rf_seen[k] = mem_written_pages((uintptr_t)p, 0x2000, pages, 8);
        g_rf_us[k] = (t1 - t0) / 1000;
        printf("probe-vkmem: ReadFile %s of 8 KiB into a watched page: %llu us, write watch saw %llu of 2 pages\n",
               k ? "unbuffered" : "buffered", (unsigned long long)g_rf_us[k], (unsigned long long)g_rf_seen[k]);
    }
    plat_file_delete(path);
    g_gpu_checks += 2;
    return 0;
}

// A physical pool, a virtual pool mapping 64 KiB pages of it, resolution and unmapping; the GPU writes through a
// virtual address and the bytes are read through the physical one.
static int test_virtual(pool_t *phys, pool_t *virt) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    GCHECK(vk_pool_init(phys) && vk_pool_init(virt), "vk_pool_init of physical / virtual pools");
    uint64_t p = (uintptr_t)phys->mem, v = (uintptr_t)virt->mem;
    nvn_mapping_t rq[2] = {{(const NVNmemoryPool *)(const void *)phys, 0x20000, 0, 0x20000, 0, 0},
                           {(const NVNmemoryPool *)(const void *)phys, 0, 0x50000, 0x10000, 0, 0}};
    GCHECK(vk_pool_map_virtual(virt, 2, rq), "MapVirtual of 2 requests");
    VkMemSpan ps, sp;
    GCHECK(vk_mem_resolve(p, 0x40000, &ps) && ps.offset == 0 && ps.alloc, "resolve of the physical pool");
    GCHECK(vk_mem_resolve(v + 8, 4, &sp) && sp.buffer == ps.buffer && sp.offset == 0x20008, "virtual page 0 -> %#llx",
           (unsigned long long)sp.offset);
    GCHECK(vk_mem_resolve(v + 0x10010, 0x10, &sp) && sp.offset == 0x30010, "virtual page 1 -> %#llx", (unsigned long long)sp.offset);
    GCHECK(vk_mem_resolve(v + 0x8000, 0x18000, &sp) && sp.avail == 0x18000, "contiguous pages 0-1 (avail %#llx)",
           (unsigned long long)sp.avail);
    GCHECK(!vk_mem_resolve(v + 0x18000, 0x10000, &sp), "a range into unmapped page 2 resolved");
    GCHECK(!vk_mem_resolve(v + 0x20000, 4, &sp), "unmapped page 2 resolved");
    GCHECK(vk_mem_resolve(v + 0x50000, 0x10000, &sp) && sp.offset == 0 && sp.alloc_offset == 0, "virtual page 5 -> %#llx",
           (unsigned long long)sp.offset);
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_upload_begin();
    vkCmdFillBuffer(cb, sp.buffer, sp.offset + 0x100, 0x100, 0xA5C3A5C3u);
    VkMemoryBarrier2 mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_CLEAR_BIT,
                           .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT,
                           .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &mb};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
    vk_upload_end();
    VkBuffer rb;
    VmaAllocation ra;
    uint32_t *r = vk_staging(0x100, &rb, &ra);
    copy_wait(ps.buffer, 0x100, rb, 0, 0x100);
    vmaInvalidateAllocation(c->vma, ra, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    int same = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 0x40; i++) same &= r[i] == 0xA5C3A5C3u;
    vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, rb, ra);
    GCHECK(same, "a GPU fill through virtual page 5 is not in physical page 0");
    nvn_mapping_t un = {NULL, 0, 0, 0x10000, 0, 0};
    GCHECK(vk_pool_map_virtual(virt, 1, &un), "MapVirtual unmap");
    GCHECK(!vk_mem_resolve(v + 8, 4, &sp), "unmapped page 0 still resolves");
    GCHECK(vk_mem_resolve(v + 0x10000, 4, &sp) && sp.offset == 0x30000, "page 1 lost by unmapping page 0");
    printf("probe-vkmem: virtual pool: 3 pages mapped, 1 unmapped, resolution and a GPU write through the alias correct\n");
    g_gpu_checks += 12;
    return 0;
}

static tex_t make_tex(pool_t *pool, uint64_t off, int format, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t levels, uint64_t serial) {
    tex_t t;
    memset(&t, 0, sizeof t);
    t.magic = MAGIC('T', 'E', 'X', 0);
    t.d.target = 1, t.d.format = format, t.d.width = w, t.d.height = h, t.d.depth = 1, t.d.levels = levels;
    nvn_tex_layout(&t.d, &t.L);
    t.pool = pool, t.off = (int64_t)off, t.mem = pool->mem + off, t.serial = serial;
    return t;
}

// Fills every level of t's storage with random texels through the reference swizzler; lin[lv] keeps them tight.
static int fill_storage(const tex_t *t, uint8_t **lin) {
    for (unsigned lv = 0; lv < t->d.levels; lv++) {
        uint32_t rb, rows, sl, bpb; uint64_t base; unsigned th, td;
        GCHECK(!nvn_deswizzle_geom(&t->d, lv, 0, &rb, &rows, &sl, &base, &th, &td, &bpb), "geometry of level %u", lv);
        size_t n = (size_t)rb * rows;
        if (!lin[lv]) lin[lv] = malloc(n);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) lin[lv][i] = rnd8();
        ref_swizzle(lin[lv], t->mem + base, rb, rows, 1, th, td);
    }
    return 0;
}

static int read_back(const tex_t *t, unsigned lv, uint8_t *const *lin, int gpu, const char *what) {
    uint32_t rb, rows, sl, bpb; uint64_t base; unsigned th, td;
    nvn_deswizzle_geom(&t->d, lv, 0, &rb, &rows, &sl, &base, &th, &td, &bpb);
    view_t v;
    memset(&v, 0, sizeof v);
    v.set_levels = 1, v.base_level = (uint8_t)lv, v.nlevels = 1;
    NVNcopyRegion r = {0, 0, 0, (int)(t->d.width >> lv ? t->d.width >> lv : 1), (int)(t->d.height >> lv ? t->d.height >> lv : 1), 1};
    size_t n = (size_t)rb * rows;
    uint8_t *got = calloc(1, n);
    int ok = gpu ? vk_texture_read_image(t, &v, &r, got, rb, n) : (vk_read_texels(t, &v, &r, got, rb, n), 1);
    int same = ok && !memcmp(got, lin[lv], n);
    free(got);
    GCHECK(same, "%s level %u (%ux%u, format %#x) read back %s the CPU reference", what, lv, r.width, r.height,
           t->d.format, ok ? "differs from" : "failed against");
    g_gpu_checks++;
    return 0;
}

static int test_textures(pool_t *tpool, pool_t *phys) {
    uint8_t *lin[4] = {0};
    // block-linear RGBA8 with 3 levels in a CPU-visible pool: uploaded through the GPU, read back from the image
    tex_t t = make_tex(tpool, 0, 0x25, 200, 120, 3, 1);
    if (fill_storage(&t, lin)) return 1;
    const VkTexImage *img = vk_texture_get(&t);
    GCHECK(img && img->mirrored && img->levels == 3 && img->format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, "RGBA8 texture image");
    for (unsigned lv = 0; lv < 3; lv++)
        if (read_back(&t, lv, lin, 1, "RGBA8")) return 1;
    // CPU writes to the storage: write watch -> re-upload on the next use
    uint64_t up0, re0, re1;
    vk_texture_stats(NULL, &up0, &re0);
    if (fill_storage(&t, lin)) return 1;
    for (unsigned lv = 0; lv < 3; lv++)
        if (read_back(&t, lv, lin, 1, "RGBA8 rewritten")) return 1;
    vk_texture_stats(NULL, NULL, &re1);
    GCHECK(re1 == re0 + 1, "storage rewritten: %llu re-uploads (want 1)", (unsigned long long)(re1 - re0));
    if (read_back(&t, 1, lin, 0, "RGBA8 ReadTexels from storage")) return 1;

    // BC1, 64x48: blocks uploaded as they are, read back from the image
    uint8_t *bl[4] = {0};
    tex_t b = make_tex(tpool, 0x40000, 0x42, 64, 48, 1, 2);
    if (fill_storage(&b, bl)) return 1;
    img = vk_texture_get(&b);
    GCHECK(img && img->format == VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGBA_UNORM_BLOCK, "BC1 texture image");
    if (read_back(&b, 0, bl, 1, "BC1")) return 1;

    // RGBA8 in a physical pool: aliases the pool memory; WriteTexels then ReadTexels through the image
    tex_t g = make_tex(phys, 0, 0x25, 64, 64, 1, 3);
    img = vk_texture_get(&g);
    GCHECK(img && !img->mirrored && img->bound, "texture in a physical pool (mirrored %d, bound %d)", img ? img->mirrored : -1,
           img ? img->bound : -1);
    uint8_t *gl[1] = {malloc(64 * 64 * 4)};
    for (int i = 0; i < 64 * 64 * 4; i++) gl[0][i] = rnd8();
    NVNcopyRegion all = {0, 0, 0, 64, 64, 1};
    vk_write_texels(&g, NULL, &all, gl[0], 256, 256 * 64);
    if (read_back(&g, 0, gl, 0, "physical-pool RGBA8 WriteTexels")) return 1;

    // a slot of a finalized texture follows the live texture at the same storage (MNG hle_nvn.c)
    dpool_ref descriptors = {.addr = (uintptr_t)tpool->mem + 0xf0000, .count = 6};
    vk_texture_register(&descriptors, 5, &b, NULL);
    vk_texture_release(&b);
    tex_t b2 = make_tex(tpool, 0x40000, 0x25, 16, 12, 1, 4);
    const VkTexImage *live = vk_texture_get(&b2);
    VkImage live_img = live ? live->image : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    const VkTexImage *slot = vk_texture_by_id(&descriptors, 5, NULL, NULL);
    GCHECK(live && slot && slot->image == live_img, "slot 5 does not follow the live texture at its storage");
    samp_par sp;
    memset(&sp, 0, sizeof sp);
    sp.minf = NVN_MIN_FILTER_LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR, sp.magf = NVN_MAG_FILTER_LINEAR, sp.ws = sp.wt = sp.wr = NVN_WRAP_MODE_REPEAT;
    sp.lod_max = 1000, sp.aniso = 16;
    vk_sampler_register(&descriptors, 0, &sp);
    VkSampler s0 = vk_sampler_by_id(&descriptors, 0), s1 = vk_sampler_for(&sp);
    GCHECK(s0 && s0 == s1 && !vk_sampler_by_id(&descriptors, 1), "sampler slots");
    g_gpu_checks += 7;
    vk_texture_release(&t), vk_texture_release(&b2), vk_texture_release(&g);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) free(lin[i]), free(bl[i]);
    free(gl[0]);
    uint64_t images, ups, reups;
    vk_texture_stats(&images, &ups, &reups);
    printf("probe-vkmem: textures: RGBA8 3 levels and BC1 equal to the CPU reference after upload, re-upload after CPU "
           "writes, physical-pool alias WriteTexels/ReadTexels, slot redirect, samplers (%llu images, %llu uploads, "
           "%llu re-uploads)\n", (unsigned long long)images, (unsigned long long)ups, (unsigned long long)reups);
    return 0;
}

static int test_gpu(void) {
    uint64_t heap = 0;
    GCHECK(mem_set_heap_size(16ull << 20, &heap) == 0 && heap, "SetHeapSize 16 MiB");
    uint8_t *h = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)heap;
    pool_t pool = {.magic = NVN_POOL_MAGIC, .flags = 0x24, .mem = h + 0x100000, .size = 0x40000, .game_mem = h + 0x100000};
    pool_t tpool = {.magic = NVN_POOL_MAGIC, .flags = 0x22, .mem = h + 0x400000, .size = 0x100000, .game_mem = h + 0x400000};
    pool_t phys = {.magic = NVN_POOL_MAGIC, .flags = 0x189, .mem = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(RT_GPU_VA_BASE + 0x100000000ull),
                   .size = 0x40000, .game_mem = h + 0x800000, .span = 0x40000};
    pool_t virt = {.magic = NVN_POOL_MAGIC, .flags = 0x2a1, .mem = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(RT_GPU_VA_BASE + 0x200000000ull),
                   .size = 0x80000, .span = 0x80000};
    if (test_import(&pool) || test_readfile(pool.mem + 0x38000) || test_virtual(&phys, &virt)) return 1;
    GCHECK(vk_pool_init(&tpool), "vk_pool_init of the texture pool");
    if (test_textures(&tpool, &phys)) return 1;
    VkMemStats st;
    vk_mem_stats(&st);
    GCHECK(st.imported_pools == 2 && st.physical_pools == 1 && st.virtual_pools == 1 && !st.import_failures,
           "pool counts %llu/%llu/%llu, %llu import failures", (unsigned long long)st.imported_pools,
           (unsigned long long)st.physical_pools, (unsigned long long)st.virtual_pools, (unsigned long long)st.import_failures);
    vk_pool_fini(&virt), vk_pool_fini(&phys), vk_pool_fini(&tpool), vk_pool_fini(&pool);
    vk_mem_stats(&st);
    GCHECK(!st.imported_pools && !st.physical_pools && !st.virtual_pools, "pools left after fini");
    g_gpu_checks += 2;
    return 0;
}

int probe_vkmem(void) {
    if (test_deswizzle() || test_box() || test_astc() || test_formats()) return 1;
    printf("probe-vkmem: cpu part passed (%u deswizzle cases, %u astc blocks, formats: %u mapped, %u supported by the GPU, "
           "%u unsupported by the GPU, %u unmapped, %u with a fallback)\n",
           g_cases, g_astc_blocks, n_mapped, n_supported, n_unsupported, n_unmapped, n_fallback);
    int bad = test_gpu();
    vk_mem_shutdown();
    vk_shutdown();
    long errors = vk_validation_errors_total();
    if (bad || errors) {
        printf("probe-vkmem: FAILED (%s, %ld validation errors)\n", bad ? "a GPU check failed" : "GPU checks passed", errors);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("probe-vkmem: passed (%u deswizzle cases, %u astc blocks, %u formats mapped, %u GPU checks, GPU writes seen by "
           "write watch %llu/32 pages, ReadFile seen %llu/2 buffered and %llu/2 unbuffered, 0 validation errors)\n",
           g_cases, g_astc_blocks, n_mapped, g_gpu_checks, (unsigned long long)g_gpu_seen,
           (unsigned long long)g_rf_seen[0], (unsigned long long)g_rf_seen[1]);
    return 0;
}
```

```hpp
// boost::container::flat_set for suyu's shader_recompiler: a sorted vector.
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <functional>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
namespace boost::container {
template <typename T, typename Compare = std::less<T>, typename Container = std::vector<T>>
class flat_set {
    Container v;
    Compare cmp;

public:
    using value_type = T;
    using iterator = typename Container::iterator;
    using const_iterator = typename Container::const_iterator;
    std::pair<iterator, bool> insert(const T& x) {
        auto it = std::lower_bound(v.begin(), v.end(), x, cmp);
        if (it != v.end() && !cmp(x, *it)) return {it, false};
        return {v.insert(it, x), true};
    }
    template <typename... A>
    std::pair<iterator, bool> emplace(A&&... a) { return insert(T(std::forward<A>(a)...)); }
    iterator find(const T& x) {
        auto it = std::lower_bound(v.begin(), v.end(), x, cmp);
        return it != v.end() && !cmp(x, *it) ? it : v.end();
    }
    const_iterator find(const T& x) const {
        auto it = std::lower_bound(v.begin(), v.end(), x, cmp);
        return it != v.end() && !cmp(x, *it) ? it : v.end();
    }
    bool contains(const T& x) const { return find(x) != v.end(); }
    std::size_t index_of(const_iterator it) const { return static_cast<std::size_t>(it - v.begin()); }
    std::size_t index_of(iterator it) { return static_cast<std::size_t>(it - v.begin()); }
    const T& operator[](std::size_t i) const { return v[i]; }
    T& operator[](std::size_t i) { return v[i]; }
    std::size_t count(const T& x) const { return contains(x) ? 1 : 0; }
    iterator erase(const_iterator it) { return v.erase(it); }
    std::size_t erase(const T& x) {
        auto it = find(x);
        if (it == v.end()) return 0;
        v.erase(it);
        return 1;
    }
    iterator begin() { return v.begin(); }
    iterator end() { return v.end(); }
    const_iterator begin() const { return v.begin(); }
    const_iterator end() const { return v.end(); }
    std::size_t size() const { return v.size(); }
    bool empty() const { return v.empty(); }
    void clear() { v.clear(); }
    void reserve(std::size_t n) { v.reserve(n); }
};
} // namespace boost::container
```
