```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "host.h"
#include "vk.h"

enum { CW = 8, CH = 6, CL = 3, PIXELS = CW * CH * CL, STENCIL_OFFSET = PIXELS * 4 };

static void probe_barrier(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    VkMemoryBarrier2 mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2,
                           .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                           .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                           .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT,
                           .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &mb};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
}

static int clear_case(VkSampleCountFlagBits samples, unsigned *checks) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    VkImage image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImageView view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkBuffer buffer = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VmaAllocation ia = NULL, ba = NULL;
    int bad = 1;
    VkImageCreateInfo ii = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D,
                             .format = VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT, .extent = {CW, CH, 1}, .mipLevels = 1,
                             .arrayLayers = CL, .samples = samples, .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
                             .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT |
                                      VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
    if (vmaCreateImage(c->vma, &ii, &ai, &image, &ia, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) goto done;
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = image,
                                 .viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, .format = ii.format,
                                 .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT | VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT, 0, 1, 1, 1}};
    if (vkCreateImageView(c->device, &vi, NULL, &view) != VK_SUCCESS) goto done;
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = PIXELS * 5,
                              .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    ai = (VmaAllocationCreateInfo){.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_HOST,
                                   .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT};
    VmaAllocationInfo mapped;
    if (vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &ai, &buffer, &ba, &mapped) != VK_SUCCESS) goto done;
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_upload_begin();
    VkImageSubresourceRange range = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT | VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT, 0, 1, 0, CL};
    VkImageMemoryBarrier2 ib = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2,
                                 .oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, .newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                                 .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                                 .image = image, .subresourceRange = range,
                                 .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                                 .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1, .pImageMemoryBarriers = &ib};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
    VkClearDepthStencilValue initial = {.depth = 0.375f, .stencil = 0xa6};
    vkCmdClearDepthStencilImage(cb, image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, &initial, 1, &range);
    probe_barrier(cb);
    vk_clear_stencil_masked(cb, ii.format, samples, range.aspectMask, view, CW, CH,
                             (VkRect2D){{2, 1}, {3, 4}}, 0x15, 0x11);
    probe_barrier(cb);
    // A second masked clear must preserve the first clear's other bits, including in their overlap.
    vk_clear_stencil_masked(cb, ii.format, samples, range.aspectMask, view, CW, CH,
                             (VkRect2D){{3, 2}, {4, 2}}, 0x42, 0x40);
    probe_barrier(cb);
    if (samples == VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT) {
        VkBufferImageCopy copy[2] = {
            {.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT, 0, 0, CL}, .imageExtent = {CW, CH, 1}},
            {.bufferOffset = STENCIL_OFFSET, .imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT, 0, 0, CL},
             .imageExtent = {CW, CH, 1}},
        };
        vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, buffer, 2, copy);
        probe_barrier(cb);
    }
    vk_upload_end();
    vk_upload_flush(1);
    if (samples == VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT) {
        vmaInvalidateAllocation(c->vma, ba, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
        const float *depth = mapped.pMappedData;
        const uint8_t *stencil = (const uint8_t *)mapped.pMappedData + STENCIL_OFFSET;
        for (int layer = 0; layer < CL; layer++)
            for (int y = 0; y < CH; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < CW; x++) {
                    int p = (layer * CH + y) * CW + x;
                    uint8_t want = 0xa6;
                    if (layer == 1 && x >= 2 && x < 5 && y >= 1 && y < 5) want = (want & ~0x15) | 0x11;
                    if (layer == 1 && x >= 3 && x < 7 && y >= 2 && y < 4) want = (want & ~0x42) | 0x40;
                    if (depth[p] != 0.375f || stencil[p] != want) {
                        printf("probe-vkclear: FAIL %d,%d layer %d depth %g stencil %#x expected %#x\n",
                               x, y, layer, depth[p], stencil[p], want);
                        goto done;
                    }
                    *checks += 2;
                }
    } else {
        // Multisampled images cannot be copied to a buffer. This case validates the actual all-sample draw path;
        // exact stencil/depth readback above covers single-sample images only.
        (*checks)++;
    }
    bad = 0;
done:
    if (view) vkDestroyImageView(c->device, view, NULL);
    if (image) vmaDestroyImage(c->vma, image, ia);
    if (buffer) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, buffer, ba);
    return bad;
}

int probe_vkclear(void) {
    if (!vk_init()) return 1;
    unsigned checks = 0;
    int bad = clear_case(VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, &checks);
    VkImageFormatProperties format;
    VkResult supported = vkGetPhysicalDeviceImageFormatProperties(vk_ctx()->phys, VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT,
        VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
        VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT,
        0, &format);
    if (!bad && supported == VK_SUCCESS && (format.sampleCounts & VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_4_BIT))
        bad = clear_case(VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_4_BIT, &checks);
    vk_mem_shutdown();
    vk_shutdown();
    long errors = vk_validation_errors_total();
    printf("probe-vkclear: %s (%u checks, %ld validation errors; multisample draw has no readback)\n",
           bad || errors ? "FAILED" : "passed", checks, errors);
    return bad || errors;
}

```

`runtime/vk_color.c`:

```c
// Colour adjustment on the present (vk_color.h): brightness, contrast, saturation and gamma of the game's picture, after
// the game and before the FSR 1 pass or the blit scale it to the window. Settings TOTK_COLOR_BRIGHTNESS (-30..30, %
// added), TOTK_COLOR_CONTRAST and TOTK_COLOR_SATURATION (%, 100 = unchanged) and TOTK_COLOR_GAMMA (exponent, 1 =
// unchanged), read when the settings change; the menu's colour profiles only write these four. At the default values
// nothing is recorded and the present is what it was. Design and preset values: STS78721's colour profiles (issue #136).
//
// One compute pass (shaders/color_grade.comp) reads the crop rectangle of the game's image and writes an RGBA16F image
// of its size, which present_image then hands to FSR or the blit in place of the game's image. The HUD is part of that
// picture and is adjusted with it; the in-game menu is drawn later, straight into the swapchain image, and is not.
// The source view of slot s is destroyed when slot s records again (present_image has waited for that slot's fence);
// the output image is shared by all slots, and each frame's first barrier orders it after the previous frame's reads.
#include "vk.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "color_grade_spv.h"
#include "host.h"

#define SLOTS 8

static struct {
    int tried, ok;
    PFN_vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR push;
    VkDescriptorSetLayout dsl;
    VkPipelineLayout layout;
    VkPipeline pipe;
    VkSampler sampler;
    VkImage img;                   // the adjusted picture, RGBA16F at the crop size
    VmaAllocation alloc;
    VkImageView view;
    uint32_t w, h;
    VkImageView src_view[SLOTS];   // the source view each slot's last frame read
    unsigned seen;                 // cfg_version the values below were read at
    float adj[4];                  // brightness (added), contrast, saturation, gamma
} C = {.seen = ~0u};

static int init(VkCtx *c) {
    C.tried = 1;
    C.push = (PFN_vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(c->device, "vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR");
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b[2] = {
        {.binding = 0, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, .descriptorCount = 1,
         .stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT},
        {.binding = 1, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_IMAGE, .descriptorCount = 1,
         .stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT}};
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo dci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
                                           .flags = VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_KHR,
                                           .bindingCount = 2, .pBindings = b};
    VkPushConstantRange pr = {VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, 32};
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo li = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .setLayoutCount = 1,
                                     .pSetLayouts = &C.dsl, .pushConstantRangeCount = 1, .pPushConstantRanges = &pr};
    VkSamplerCreateInfo si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO, .magFilter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST,
                              .minFilter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST, .mipmapMode = VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_NEAREST,
                              .addressModeU = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE,
                              .addressModeV = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE,
                              .addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE, .maxLod = 0};
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo mi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO, .codeSize = sizeof color_grade_spv,
                                   .pCode = color_grade_spv};
    VkShaderModule m = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (!C.push || vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(c->device, &dci, NULL, &C.dsl) != VK_SUCCESS ||
        vkCreatePipelineLayout(c->device, &li, NULL, &C.layout) != VK_SUCCESS ||
        vkCreateSampler(c->device, &si, NULL, &C.sampler) != VK_SUCCESS ||
        vkCreateShaderModule(c->device, &mi, NULL, &m) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        rt_log("vk: colour adjustment off: its pipeline could not be created");
        return 0;
    }
    VkComputePipelineCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO,
                                      .stage = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO,
                                                .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, .module = m, .pName = "main"},
                                      .layout = C.layout};
    VkResult r = vkCreateComputePipelines(c->device, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &ci, NULL, &C.pipe);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(c->device, m, NULL);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        rt_log("vk: colour adjustment off: its pipeline could not be created");
        return 0;
    }
    return C.ok = 1;
}

static void free_image(VkCtx *c) {
    if (C.view) vkDestroyImageView(c->device, C.view, NULL);
    if (C.img) vmaDestroyImage(c->vma, C.img, C.alloc);
    C.view = VK_NULL_HANDLE, C.img = VK_NULL_HANDLE, C.w = C.h = 0;
}

static int ensure_image(VkCtx *c, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    if (C.img && C.w == w && C.h == h) return 1;
    // another crop size (a resolution change): earlier presents may still read the old image
    vk_queue_lock();
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(c->device);
    vk_queue_unlock();
    free_image(c);
    VkImageCreateInfo ii = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D,
                            .format = VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT, .extent = {w, h, 1}, .mipLevels = 1, .arrayLayers = 1,
                            .samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
                            .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
    if (vmaCreateImage(c->vma, &ii, &ai, &C.img, &C.alloc, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        C.img = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        return 0;
    }
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = C.img,
                                .viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, .format = VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT,
                                .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
    if (vkCreateImageView(c->device, &vi, NULL, &C.view) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        C.view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        free_image(c);
        return 0;
    }
    C.w = w, C.h = h;
    return 1;
}

// The four values from the settings, re-read when they change. 1 when any differs from "unchanged".
static int adjusting(void) {
    unsigned v = cfg_version();
    if (v != C.seen) {
        C.seen = v;
        C.adj[0] = (float)cfg_double("TOTK_COLOR_BRIGHTNESS") / 100.0f;
        C.adj[1] = (float)cfg_double("TOTK_COLOR_CONTRAST") / 100.0f;
        C.adj[2] = (float)cfg_double("TOTK_COLOR_SATURATION") / 100.0f;
        C.adj[3] = (float)cfg_double("TOTK_COLOR_GAMMA");
    }
    return C.adj[0] != 0.0f || C.adj[1] != 1.0f || C.adj[2] != 1.0f || C.adj[3] != 1.0f;
}

static void barrier(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage img, VkImageLayout from, VkPipelineStageFlags2 ss, VkAccessFlags2 sa,
                    VkPipelineStageFlags2 ds, VkAccessFlags2 da) {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier2 b = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = ss, .srcAccessMask = sa,
                               .dstStageMask = ds, .dstAccessMask = da, .oldLayout = from,
                               .newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                               .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, .image = img,
                               .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
    VkDependencyInfo d = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1,
                          .pImageMemoryBarriers = &b};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &d);
}

VkImage vk_color_record(VkCommandBuffer cb, unsigned slot, VkImage src, VkFormat fmt, const int crop[4]) {
    if (!adjusting()) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!C.tried) init(c);
    if (!C.ok || !ensure_image(c, (uint32_t)crop[2], (uint32_t)crop[3])) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    slot %= SLOTS;
    if (C.src_view[slot]) vkDestroyImageView(c->device, C.src_view[slot], NULL);
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = src,
                                .viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, .format = fmt,
                                .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
    if (vkCreateImageView(c->device, &vi, NULL, &C.src_view[slot]) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        C.src_view[slot] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    const VkPipelineStageFlags2 CS = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, ALL = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT;
    // the game's writes to src are visible; last frame's reads of the output are done (UNDEFINED: its old content goes)
    barrier(cb, src, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, ALL, VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT, CS, VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_SAMPLED_READ_BIT);
    barrier(cb, C.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, ALL, 0, CS, VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_WRITE_BIT);
    VkDescriptorImageInfo ii = {C.sampler, C.src_view[slot], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL},
                          oi = {VK_NULL_HANDLE, C.view, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL};
    VkWriteDescriptorSet w[2] = {
        {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstBinding = 0, .descriptorCount = 1,
         .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, .pImageInfo = &ii},
        {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstBinding = 1, .descriptorCount = 1,
         .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_IMAGE, .pImageInfo = &oi}};
    vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, C.pipe);
    rec_push(C.push, cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, C.layout, 0, 2, w);
    struct { int32_t offset[2], size[2]; float adj[4]; } pc = {{crop[0], crop[1]}, {crop[2], crop[3]},
                                                              {C.adj[0], C.adj[1], C.adj[2], C.adj[3]}};
    vkCmdPushConstants(cb, C.layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, sizeof pc, &pc);
    vkCmdDispatch(cb, ((uint32_t)crop[2] + 7) / 8, ((uint32_t)crop[3] + 7) / 8, 1);
    // later submissions that write src wait for this read; FSR and the blit read the output
    barrier(cb, src, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, CS, 0, ALL, 0);
    barrier(cb, C.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, CS, VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_WRITE_BIT, ALL,
            VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT);
    return C.img;
}

void vk_color_release(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    for (int i = 0; i < SLOTS; i++)
        if (C.src_view[i]) vkDestroyImageView(c->device, C.src_view[i], NULL), C.src_view[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    free_image(c);
    if (C.pipe) vkDestroyPipeline(c->device, C.pipe, NULL);
    if (C.sampler) vkDestroySampler(c->device, C.sampler, NULL);
    if (C.layout) vkDestroyPipelineLayout(c->device, C.layout, NULL);
    if (C.dsl) vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(c->device, C.dsl, NULL);
    C.pipe = VK_NULL_HANDLE, C.sampler = VK_NULL_HANDLE, C.layout = VK_NULL_HANDLE, C.dsl = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    C.tried = C.ok = 0;
}

```

`runtime/vk_copy_probe.c`:

```c
// --probe-vkcopy-astc: original valid ASTC blocks through OP_COPY_B2T/OP_COPY_T2T and the real Vulkan replay.
// No game, shader census or translated guest program. Requires GPU decode to RGBA8, synchronous replay and no splits.
// The first texture is uploaded normally and waited for before replay: first-decode table staging in a replay
// submission has a separate known lifetime gap. This probe deliberately does not exercise that gap.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "tex.h"
#include "vk_exec.h"

enum { SOURCE_BYTES = 0x1000, TEXTURE_OFFSET = 0x10000, POOL_BYTES = 0x100000 };
static const uint8_t sentinel[4] = {17, 34, 51, 255};
static const uint8_t colors[8][4] = {
    {255, 0, 0, 255}, {0, 255, 0, 255}, {0, 0, 255, 255}, {255, 255, 255, 255},
    {0, 255, 255, 255}, {255, 0, 255, 255}, {255, 255, 0, 255}, {0, 0, 0, 255},
};

typedef struct {
    const char *name;
    uint32_t width, height, levels, layers, source_offset;
    int32_t row_stride;
    int has_view, copied;
    view_t view;
    NVNcopyRegion region;
} CopyCase;

#define REQUIRE(cond, ...) do { \
    if (!(cond)) { printf("probe-vkcopy-astc: FAIL %s: ", one->name); printf(__VA_ARGS__); \
        printf("\n"); goto done; } \
    (*checks)++; \
} while (0)

// An LDR void-extent block with all four extent coordinates 0x1fff. Each channel is exact UNORM16 byte * 257.
// This is a constant-color ASTC block, independent of the decoder's own color/weight reconstruction.
static void solid_block(uint8_t block[16], const uint8_t rgba[4]) {
    const uint64_t low = UINT64_C(0xfffffffffffffdfc);
    memcpy(block, &low, 8);
    for (unsigned c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
        uint16_t value = (uint16_t)(rgba[c] * 257u);
        memcpy(block + 8 + 2 * c, &value, 2);
    }
}

static uint32_t level_size(uint32_t n, uint32_t level) { n >>= level; return n ? n : 1; }

// Every mip/layer starts with a distinct nonzero sentinel. nvn_swizzle supplies the normal texture upload layout;
// the separate buffer-to-texture source below is linear ASTC blocks, as the NVN copy command requires.
static int fill_storage(tex_t *t) {
    uint8_t blocks[8 * 8 * 16];
    for (uint32_t level = 0; level < t->d.levels; level++) {
        uint32_t w = level_size(t->d.width, level), h = level_size(t->d.height, level);
        uint32_t columns = (w + 3) / 4, rows = (h + 3) / 4;
        if ((uint64_t)columns * rows * 16 > sizeof blocks) return 0;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < columns * rows; i++) solid_block(blocks + i * 16, sentinel);
        for (uint32_t layer = 0; layer < t->d.depth; layer++)
            if (nvn_swizzle(&t->d, level, layer, blocks, columns * 16, t->mem)) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

static void fill_source(uint8_t *memory, const CopyCase *one) {
    memset(memory, 0xa5, SOURCE_BYTES);
    const uint8_t padding[4] = {241, 129, 65, 255};
    uint32_t row = one->row_stride ? (uint32_t)one->row_stride : 32;
    for (int z = 0; z < one->region.depth; z++)
        for (unsigned y = 0; y < 2; y++) {
            uint8_t *at = memory + one->source_offset + (uint32_t)z * row * 2 + y * row;
            solid_block(at, colors[z * 4 + y * 2]);
            solid_block(at + 16, colors[z * 4 + y * 2 + 1]);
            for (unsigned off = 32; off < row; off += 16) solid_block(at + off, padding);
        }
}

static uint8_t *put_op(uint8_t *p, int op, const void *payload, size_t size) {
    size_t n = (sizeof(op_hdr) + size + 7) & ~(size_t)7;
    memset(p, 0, n);
    *(op_hdr *)p = (op_hdr){(uint16_t)op, (uint32_t)n};
    if (size) memcpy(p + sizeof(op_hdr), payload, size);
    return p + n;
}

static void read_barrier(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    VkMemoryBarrier2 mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2,
        .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
        .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
        .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT,
        .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &mb};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
}

// Read the actual decoded image, not read_texels: that API intentionally rejects ASTC image readback.
static int read_level(const VkTexImage *image, uint32_t level, uint8_t *out) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    uint32_t w = level_size(image->width, level), h = level_size(image->height, level);
    VkDeviceSize size = (VkDeviceSize)w * h * image->layers * 4;
    VkBuffer buffer = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VmaAllocation allocation = NULL;
    VmaAllocationInfo mapped;
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = size,
        .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_HOST,
        .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT};
    if (vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &ai, &buffer, &allocation, &mapped) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_upload_begin();
    read_barrier(cb);
    VkBufferImageCopy copy = {.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, level, 0, image->layers},
        .imageExtent = {w, h, 1}};
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, image->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, buffer, 1, &copy);
    read_barrier(cb);
    vk_upload_end();
    vk_upload_flush(1);
    VkResult result = vmaInvalidateAllocation(c->vma, allocation, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    if (result == VK_SUCCESS) memcpy(out, mapped.pMappedData, (size_t)size);
    vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, buffer, allocation);
    return result == VK_SUCCESS;
}

static const uint8_t *expected(const CopyCase *one, uint32_t level, uint32_t layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t target_level = one->has_view ? one->view.base_level : 0;
    uint32_t first_layer = (one->has_view ? one->view.min_layer : 0) + (uint32_t)one->region.zoffset;
    uint32_t rx = (uint32_t)one->region.xoffset, ry = (uint32_t)one->region.yoffset;
    if (!one->copied || level != target_level || layer < first_layer ||
        layer - first_layer >= (uint32_t)one->region.depth || x < rx || x >= rx + 8 || y < ry || y >= ry + 8)
        return sentinel;
    return colors[(layer - first_layer) * 4 + ((y - ry) / 4) * 2 + (x - rx) / 4];
}

static int copy_case(const GfxBackend *backend, uint8_t *guest, const CopyCase *one, unsigned index, unsigned *checks) {
    int bad = 1, initialized = 0;
    pool_t pool = {.magic = NVN_POOL_MAGIC, .flags = 0x22, .mem = guest, .size = POOL_BYTES, .game_mem = guest};
    tex_t texture;
    memset(&texture, 0, sizeof texture);
    uint8_t *pixels = NULL;
    uint8_t source_before[SOURCE_BYTES];
    REQUIRE(backend->pool_init(&pool), "CPU-visible pool initialization");
    initialized = 1;
    REQUIRE(vk_astc_mode() == VK_ASTC_GPU && vk_astc_gpu() && !vk_astc_bc(),
        "GPU ASTC decode to RGBA8 is unavailable");
    REQUIRE(!gfx_replay_async(), "requires the synchronous copy replay path");
    texture.magic = NVN_TEX_MAGIC;
    texture.d.target = one->layers == 1 ? NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D : NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D_ARRAY;
    texture.d.format = NVN_FORMAT_RGBA_ASTC_4x4;
    texture.d.width = one->width, texture.d.height = one->height;
    texture.d.depth = one->layers, texture.d.levels = one->levels;
    nvn_tex_layout(&texture.d, &texture.L);
    texture.pool = &pool, texture.off = TEXTURE_OFFSET, texture.mem = pool.mem + TEXTURE_OFFSET;
    texture.serial = 0x41535400u + index;
    REQUIRE(texture.L.size <= POOL_BYTES - TEXTURE_OFFSET, "texture layout leaves its owned pool");
    REQUIRE(fill_storage(&texture), "sentinel storage layout");
    fill_source(pool.mem, one);
    memcpy(source_before, pool.mem, sizeof source_before);

    // First-use decode and its table staging belong to this normal upload batch, never to the replay below.
    uint64_t warm_before, warm_after, ignored_texels;
    vk_astc_stats(&warm_before, &ignored_texels);
    const VkTexImage *image = vk_texture_get(&texture);
    REQUIRE(image && image->format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM && image->layers == one->layers &&
        image->levels == one->levels, "requires decoded RGBA8 with every requested mip/layer");
    vk_upload_flush(1);
    vk_astc_stats(&warm_after, &ignored_texels);
    REQUIRE(warm_after > warm_before, "normal upload did not warm the GPU decoder");
    int owned_before = !!image->gpu_owned;
    REQUIRE(!owned_before, "normal initial upload unexpectedly owns guest storage");
    uint64_t before, after;
    vk_astc_stats(&before, &ignored_texels);
    VkMemSpan source_span;
    REQUIRE(vk_mem_resolve((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(pool.mem + one->source_offset), 64, &source_span), "source span");
    REQUIRE(source_span.offset == one->source_offset, "buffer offset %llu expected %u",
        (unsigned long long)source_span.offset, one->source_offset);

    _Alignas(8) uint8_t stream[512];
    uint8_t *end = put_op(stream, OP_BEGIN, NULL, 0);
    const p_copy_stride stride = {one->row_stride};
    end = put_op(end, OP_COPY_STRIDE, &stride, sizeof stride);
    p_copy_b2t copy;
    memset(&copy, 0, sizeof copy);
    copy.src = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(pool.mem + one->source_offset), copy.tex = &texture;
    copy.has_view = (uint8_t)one->has_view, copy.view = one->view, copy.r = one->region;
    end = put_op(end, OP_COPY_B2T, &copy, sizeof copy);
    end = put_op(end, OP_END, NULL, 0);
    REQUIRE((size_t)(end - stream) <= sizeof stream, "recording size");
    uint64_t handle = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)stream;
    uint64_t fence = backend->submit(&handle, 1, rt_ticks());
    REQUIRE(backend->fence_wait(fence, 5000000000ull), "copy fence wait");
    vk_astc_stats(&after, &ignored_texels);
    uint64_t want_dispatches = one->copied ? (uint32_t)one->region.depth : 0;
    REQUIRE(after - before == want_dispatches, "ASTC dispatch delta %llu expected %llu",
        (unsigned long long)(after - before), (unsigned long long)want_dispatches);
    image = vk_texture_get(&texture);   // a subsequent normal lookup must retain the copy, not re-upload the sentinel
    REQUIRE(image && !!image->gpu_owned == (one->copied ? 1 : owned_before), "ownership after subsequent lookup");
    REQUIRE(!memcmp(source_before, pool.mem, sizeof source_before), "source/prefix/padding/suffix bytes changed");
    pixels = malloc((size_t)one->width * one->height * one->layers * 4);
    REQUIRE(pixels, "readback allocation");
    for (uint32_t level = 0; level < one->levels; level++) {
        uint32_t w = level_size(one->width, level), h = level_size(one->height, level);
        REQUIRE(read_level(image, level, pixels), "direct image readback mip %u", level);
        for (uint32_t layer = 0; layer < one->layers; layer++)
            for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++)
                for (uint32_t x = 0; x < w; x++) {
                    const uint8_t *got = pixels + (((size_t)layer * h + y) * w + x) * 4;
                    const uint8_t *want = expected(one, level, layer, x, y);
                    REQUIRE(!memcmp(got, want, 4), "mip %u layer %u pixel %u,%u = %u,%u,%u,%u expected %u,%u,%u,%u",
                        level, layer, x, y, got[0], got[1], got[2], got[3], want[0], want[1], want[2], want[3]);
                }
    }
    printf("probe-vkcopy-astc: %s passed (offset %u, row stride %d, %llu decoder dispatches, ownership %d)\n",
        one->name, one->source_offset, one->row_stride, (unsigned long long)(after - before), one->copied);
    if (!one->copied)
        printf("probe-vkcopy-astc: unsupported padded-row policy retained pixels/ownership without a decode\n");
    bad = 0;
done:
    if (initialized) {
        backend->finish();
        backend->texture_release(&texture);
        backend->pool_fini(&pool);
    }
    free(pixels);
    return bad;
}

typedef struct {
    const char *name;
    uint32_t width, height, levels, source_layers, destination_layers;
    int has_sv, has_dv, copied, same_image;
    view_t sv, dv;
    NVNcopyRegion sr, dr;
} T2tCase;

static const uint8_t *t2t_color(uint32_t level, uint32_t layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    return colors[(level * 3 + layer * 5 + (y / 8) * 2 + x / 8) % 8];
}

static int fill_t2t_storage(tex_t *t, int source) {
    uint8_t blocks[4 * 4 * 16];
    for (uint32_t level = 0; level < t->d.levels; level++) {
        uint32_t w = level_size(t->d.width, level), h = level_size(t->d.height, level);
        uint32_t columns = (w + 7) / 8, rows = (h + 7) / 8;
        if ((uint64_t)columns * rows * 16 > sizeof blocks) return 0;
        for (uint32_t layer = 0; layer < t->d.depth; layer++) {
            for (uint32_t y = 0; y < rows; y++)
                for (uint32_t x = 0; x < columns; x++)
                    solid_block(blocks + (y * columns + x) * 16,
                        source ? t2t_color(level, layer, x * 8, y * 8) : sentinel);
            if (nvn_swizzle(&t->d, level, layer, blocks, columns * 16, t->mem)) return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

static const uint8_t *t2t_expected(const T2tCase *one, uint32_t level, uint32_t layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t dl = one->has_dv && one->dv.set_levels ? one->dv.base_level : 0;
    uint32_t first = (one->has_dv && one->dv.set_layers ? one->dv.min_layer : 0) + (uint32_t)one->dr.zoffset;
    uint32_t dx = (uint32_t)one->dr.xoffset, dy = (uint32_t)one->dr.yoffset;
    if (!one->copied || level != dl || layer < first || layer - first >= (uint32_t)one->dr.depth ||
        x < dx || x - dx >= (uint32_t)one->dr.width || y < dy || y - dy >= (uint32_t)one->dr.height) return sentinel;
    uint32_t sl = one->has_sv && one->sv.set_levels ? one->sv.base_level : 0;
    uint32_t source_layer = (one->has_sv && one->sv.set_layers ? one->sv.min_layer : 0) +
        (uint32_t)one->sr.zoffset + layer - first;
    return t2t_color(sl, source_layer, (uint32_t)one->sr.xoffset + x - dx, (uint32_t)one->sr.yoffset + y - dy);
}

static int t2t_case(const GfxBackend *backend, uint8_t *guest, const T2tCase *one, unsigned index, unsigned *checks) {
    int bad = 1, initialized[2] = {0};
    pool_t pools[2] = {{0}};
    tex_t textures[2] = {{0}};
    const VkTexImage *images[2] = {0};
    uint8_t *pixels = NULL, *storage_before = NULL;
    REQUIRE(vk_astc_mode() == VK_ASTC_GPU && vk_astc_gpu() && !vk_astc_bc(), "requires GPU ASTC decode to RGBA8");
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        pool_t *pool = &pools[i];
        *pool = (pool_t){.magic = NVN_POOL_MAGIC, .flags = 0x22, .mem = guest + i * POOL_BYTES,
            .size = POOL_BYTES, .game_mem = guest + i * POOL_BYTES};
        REQUIRE(backend->pool_init(pool), "T2T pool %u initialization", i);
        initialized[i] = 1;
        memset(pool->mem, 0xa5, POOL_BYTES);
        tex_t *t = &textures[i];
        t->magic = NVN_TEX_MAGIC;
        t->d.target = (i ? one->destination_layers : one->source_layers) == 1 ?
            NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D : NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D_ARRAY;
        t->d.format = NVN_FORMAT_RGBA_ASTC_8x8_SRGB;
        t->d.width = one->width, t->d.height = one->height, t->d.levels = one->levels;
        t->d.depth = i ? one->destination_layers : one->source_layers;
        t->pool = pool, t->off = TEXTURE_OFFSET, t->mem = pool->mem + TEXTURE_OFFSET;
        t->serial = 0x54325400u + index * 2 + i;
        nvn_tex_layout(&t->d, &t->L);
        REQUIRE(t->L.size <= POOL_BYTES - TEXTURE_OFFSET, "T2T texture %u storage bounds", i);
        REQUIRE(fill_t2t_storage(t, !i), "T2T texture %u original block layout", i);
        images[i] = vk_texture_get(t);
        REQUIRE(images[i] && images[i]->format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB && !images[i]->bound &&
            images[i]->type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D && images[i]->samples == 1 &&
            images[i]->levels == one->levels && images[i]->layers == t->d.depth && !images[i]->gpu_owned,
            "T2T texture %u must be a separately allocated decoded RGBA8 sRGB image", i);
    }
    REQUIRE(images[0]->image != images[1]->image, "T2T images must be distinct");
    vk_upload_flush(1);   // normal uploads, including first-decode staging, finish before replay
    pixels = malloc((size_t)one->width * one->height *
        (one->source_layers > one->destination_layers ? one->source_layers : one->destination_layers) * 4);
    storage_before = malloc(2 * POOL_BYTES);
    REQUIRE(pixels && storage_before, "T2T comparison allocations");
    memcpy(storage_before, pools[0].mem, POOL_BYTES);
    memcpy(storage_before + POOL_BYTES, pools[1].mem, POOL_BYTES);
    uint64_t before, after, ignored_texels;
    vk_astc_stats(&before, &ignored_texels);
    _Alignas(8) uint8_t stream[512];
    uint8_t *end = put_op(stream, OP_BEGIN, NULL, 0);
    p_copy_t2t copy = {.src = &textures[0], .dst = &textures[one->same_image ? 0 : 1],
        .sv = one->sv, .dv = one->dv, .has_sv = (uint8_t)one->has_sv, .has_dv = (uint8_t)one->has_dv,
        .sr = one->sr, .dr = one->dr};
    end = put_op(end, OP_COPY_T2T, &copy, sizeof copy);
    end = put_op(end, OP_END, NULL, 0);
    REQUIRE((size_t)(end - stream) <= sizeof stream, "T2T recording size");
    uint64_t handle = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)stream;
    uint64_t fence = backend->submit(&handle, 1, rt_ticks());
    REQUIRE(backend->fence_wait(fence, 5000000000ull), "T2T fence wait");
    vk_astc_stats(&after, &ignored_texels);
    REQUIRE(after == before, "T2T must copy existing RGBA8 texels without another ASTC decode");
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        images[i] = vk_texture_get(&textures[i]);
        REQUIRE(images[i], "T2T texture %u after subsequent lookup", i);
        REQUIRE(!memcmp(storage_before + i * POOL_BYTES, pools[i].mem, POOL_BYTES),
            "T2T texture %u guest storage/pool canaries changed", i);
        for (uint32_t level = 0; level < one->levels; level++) {
            uint32_t w = level_size(one->width, level), h = level_size(one->height, level);
            REQUIRE(read_level(images[i], level, pixels), "T2T texture %u mip %u direct readback", i, level);
            for (uint32_t layer = 0; layer < images[i]->layers; layer++)
                for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++)
                    for (uint32_t x = 0; x < w; x++) {
                        const uint8_t *got = pixels + (((size_t)layer * h + y) * w + x) * 4;
                        const uint8_t *want = i ? t2t_expected(one, level, layer, x, y) : t2t_color(level, layer, x, y);
                        REQUIRE(!memcmp(got, want, 4),
                            "T2T texture %u mip %u layer %u pixel %u,%u = %u,%u,%u,%u expected %u,%u,%u,%u",
                            i, level, layer, x, y, got[0], got[1], got[2], got[3], want[0], want[1], want[2], want[3]);
                    }
        }
        REQUIRE(!!images[i]->gpu_owned == (int)(i && one->copied),
            "T2T texture %u ownership after subsequent lookup", i);
    }
    printf("probe-vkcopy-astc: %s passed (%s; source and all untouched pixels/mips/layers preserved)\n",
        one->name, one->copied ? "T2T copied" : "unsupported T2T policy skipped");
    bad = 0;
done:
    backend->finish();
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        if (initialized[i]) {
            backend->texture_release(&textures[i]);
            backend->pool_fini(&pools[i]);
        }
    free(storage_before);
    free(pixels);
    return bad;
}

void vk_exec_draw_shutdown(void);
void vk_exec_xfer_shutdown(void);

int probe_vkcopy_astc(void) {
    // Keep configuration explicit: otherwise a passing CPU/native/BC fallback would not cover this decoder path.
    if (strcmp(cfg_value("TOTK_ASTC"), "gpu") || cfg_bool("TOTK_ASTC_BC") ||
        cfg_bool("TOTK_REPLAY_ASYNC") || strcmp(cfg_value("TOTK_SPLIT_DRAWS"), "0")) {
        printf("probe-vkcopy-astc: requires TOTK_ASTC=gpu TOTK_ASTC_BC=0 TOTK_REPLAY_ASYNC=0 TOTK_SPLIT_DRAWS=0\n");
        return 1;
    }
    uint64_t heap = 0;
    if (mem_set_heap_size(16ull << 20, &heap) || !heap) return 1;
    const CopyCase cases[] = {
        {.name = "tight rows", .width = 8, .height = 8, .levels = 1, .layers = 1, .copied = 1,
            .region = {0, 0, 0, 8, 8, 1}},
        {.name = "explicit tight rows/nonzero buffer offset", .width = 8, .height = 8, .levels = 1, .layers = 1,
            .source_offset = 0x100, .row_stride = 32, .copied = 1, .region = {0, 0, 0, 8, 8, 1}},
        {.name = "padded rows skipped", .width = 8, .height = 8, .levels = 1, .layers = 1,
            .source_offset = 0x100, .row_stride = 64, .region = {0, 0, 0, 8, 8, 1}},
        {.name = "two layers/derived tight layer pitch", .width = 8, .height = 8, .levels = 1, .layers = 2,
            .source_offset = 0x100, .copied = 1, .region = {0, 0, 0, 8, 8, 2}},
        {.name = "view/mip/layer/subrectangle", .width = 32, .height = 32, .levels = 2, .layers = 4,
            .source_offset = 0x100, .has_view = 1, .copied = 1,
            .view = {.set_levels = 1, .base_level = 1, .nlevels = 1, .set_layers = 1, .min_layer = 1, .nlayers = 3},
            .region = {4, 4, 1, 8, 8, 2}},
    };
    const T2tCase t2t_cases[] = {
        {.name = "T2T 8x8 sRGB 2D to array", .width = 16, .height = 16, .levels = 1,
            .source_layers = 1, .destination_layers = 2, .copied = 1,
            .sr = {0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 1}, .dr = {0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 1}},
        {.name = "T2T offset subrectangle", .width = 32, .height = 32, .levels = 3,
            .source_layers = 1, .destination_layers = 2, .copied = 1,
            .sr = {8, 0, 0, 16, 16, 1}, .dr = {0, 8, 1, 16, 16, 1}},
        {.name = "T2T selected mip and view layer", .width = 32, .height = 32, .levels = 3,
            .source_layers = 1, .destination_layers = 3, .copied = 1, .has_sv = 1, .has_dv = 1,
            .sv = {.set_levels = 1, .base_level = 1, .nlevels = 1},
            .dv = {.set_levels = 1, .base_level = 1, .nlevels = 1, .set_layers = 1, .min_layer = 1, .nlayers = 2},
            .sr = {0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 1}, .dr = {0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 1}},
        {.name = "T2T two layers with view offsets", .width = 16, .height = 16, .levels = 2,
            .source_layers = 4, .destination_layers = 4, .copied = 1, .has_sv = 1, .has_dv = 1,
            .sv = {.set_layers = 1, .min_layer = 1, .nlayers = 3},
            .dv = {.set_layers = 1, .min_layer = 0, .nlayers = 3},
            .sr = {0, 0, 1, 16, 16, 2}, .dr = {0, 0, 1, 16, 16, 2}},
        {.name = "T2T 4x4 mip edge", .width = 32, .height = 32, .levels = 6,
            .source_layers = 1, .destination_layers = 2, .copied = 1, .has_sv = 1, .has_dv = 1,
            .sv = {.set_levels = 1, .base_level = 3, .nlevels = 1},
            .dv = {.set_levels = 1, .base_level = 3, .nlevels = 1},
            .sr = {0, 0, 0, 4, 4, 1}, .dr = {0, 0, 1, 4, 4, 1}},
        {.name = "T2T 2x2 mip edge", .width = 32, .height = 32, .levels = 6,
            .source_layers = 1, .destination_layers = 2, .copied = 1, .has_sv = 1, .has_dv = 1,
            .sv = {.set_levels = 1, .base_level = 4, .nlevels = 1},
            .dv = {.set_levels = 1, .base_level = 4, .nlevels = 1},
            .sr = {0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 1}, .dr = {0, 0, 1, 2, 2, 1}},
        {.name = "T2T 1x1 mip edge", .width = 32, .height = 32, .levels = 6,
            .source_layers = 1, .destination_layers = 2, .copied = 1, .has_sv = 1, .has_dv = 1,
            .sv = {.set_levels = 1, .base_level = 5, .nlevels = 1},
            .dv = {.set_levels = 1, .base_level = 5, .nlevels = 1},
            .sr = {0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1}, .dr = {0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1}},
        {.name = "T2T explicit format view skipped", .width = 16, .height = 16, .levels = 1,
            .source_layers = 1, .destination_layers = 2, .has_sv = 1,
            .sv = {.set_format = 1, .format = NVN_FORMAT_RGBA_ASTC_8x8_SRGB},
            .sr = {0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 1}, .dr = {0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 1}},
        {.name = "T2T nonoverlapping self-copy skipped", .width = 16, .height = 16, .levels = 1,
            .source_layers = 1, .destination_layers = 2, .same_image = 1,
            .sr = {0, 0, 0, 8, 8, 1}, .dr = {8, 8, 0, 8, 8, 1}},
    };
    printf("probe-vkcopy-astc: normal upload warmup precedes replay; first-decode replay lifetime gap excluded\n");
    unsigned checks = 0, completed = 0, skipped = 0;
    int bad = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof cases / sizeof cases[0] && !bad; i++) {
        bad = copy_case(&gfx_vulkan_backend, (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)heap, &cases[i], i, &checks);
        if (!bad) completed++, skipped += !cases[i].copied;
    }
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof t2t_cases / sizeof t2t_cases[0] && !bad; i++) {
        bad = t2t_case(&gfx_vulkan_backend, (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)heap, &t2t_cases[i], i, &checks);
        if (!bad) completed++, skipped += !t2t_cases[i].copied;
    }
    gfx_vulkan_backend.finish();
    vk_pipeline_shutdown();
    vk_exec_draw_shutdown();
    vk_exec_xfer_shutdown();
    vk_backend_shutdown();
    long errors = vk_validation_errors_total();
    unsigned total = sizeof cases / sizeof cases[0] + sizeof t2t_cases / sizeof t2t_cases[0];
    printf("probe-vkcopy-astc: %s (%u/%u cases, %u intentional skips, %u checks, %ld validation errors)\n",
        bad || errors ? "FAILED" : "passed", completed, total, skipped, checks, errors);
    printf("probe-vkcopy-astc: independent image pitch, compute-program restoration, native/CPU/BC modes not covered\n");
    return bad || errors;
}

```

`runtime/vk_crumbs.c`:

```c
// GPU breadcrumbs for a lost device (vk.h vk_crumb). VK_AMD_buffer_marker writes a 32-bit code into a buffer from
// the command stream: at TOP_OF_PIPE once the command processor reaches the marker, at BOTTOM_OF_PIPE once every
// command before it has finished. Each crumb writes both, into two words of one host-coherent buffer, so after a
// device loss word 0 names the newest point the GPU reached and word 1 the newest point it had finished: the hang lies
// between them. A code is the crumb kind in the top 4 bits and its number in the low 28. The markers cost two small
// writes per crumb, and crumbs mark submissions, upload batches, ASTC chunks and presents, not draws.
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "vk.h"

static PFN_vkCmdWriteBufferMarkerAMD write_marker;
static VkBuffer buf;
static VmaAllocation alloc;
static volatile uint32_t *words;

// NVIDIA (VK_NV_device_diagnostic_checkpoints, MKW_GPU_CHECKPOINTS=1): every pipeline bind sets a checkpoint whose marker
// is the VkPipeline; after a device loss the queue reports the checkpoints the GPU reached. The registry maps a pipeline
// to the NVN 2 names of its stages (what the bind site knows), filled at bind time, so the report names the shaders.
static PFN_vkCmdSetCheckpointNV set_cp;
static PFN_vkGetQueueCheckpointDataNV get_cp;
static PFN_vkGetQueueCheckpointData2NV get_cp2;
// Handles cannot be reused while the registry is read, only because bound pipelines live until vk_pipeline_shutdown.
// When programs share one VkPipeline the last bind wins. Work after the last bind (clear, ASTC, FSR, copies) is
// attributed to that pipeline.
enum { CP_SLOTS = 8192, CP_PROBES = 64 };   // ponytail: open addressing, a full table drops new pipelines; enlarge if the report shows "unknown"
static struct { VkPipeline pipe; uint64_t stage[3]; } cp_reg[CP_SLOTS];   // vertex, geometry, fragment (or compute, 0, 0)
static PlatMutex cp_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
static volatile uint32_t cp_tag_n;   // next tag slot, see vk_checkpoint_tag

// High bits of a Fibonacci multiply (pointers have constant low bits), as find_stage in vk_exec_draw.c.
static uint32_t cp_slot(const void *p) { return (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) >> 51); }

// Device address bindings (VK_EXT_device_address_binding_report, with the checkpoints on): the driver reports every
// range of GPU virtual addresses it binds or unbinds to a debug utils messenger, tens of thousands of events in a long
// run. A ring of the newest events loses the mapping of a long-lived allocation, so the bound ranges are kept as a live
// set (open addressing keyed by base address, linear probing, backward-shift delete: a bind inserts, an unbind removes)
// and only the newest AB_UNBINDS unbinds are kept, to name a range freed before a fault (use after free). The callback
// runs on driver threads, so one spinlock guards both; the device-lost report only try-locks it.
enum { AB_LIVE = 1 << 17, AB_UNBINDS = 8192 };
typedef struct { uint64_t seq, base, size, handle; uint32_t flags, type; } AbEvent;   // seq 0 marks a free slot
static AbEvent ab_live[AB_LIVE];
static AbEvent ab_unb[AB_UNBINDS];
static uint64_t ab_n, ab_nlive, ab_dropped, ab_nunb;   // events seen, live entries, binds not stored, unbinds seen
static volatile int ab_lock;
static VkDebugUtilsMessengerEXT ab_messenger;

static uint32_t ab_home(uint64_t base) { return (uint32_t)((base * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) >> 47); }   // 17 bits
static void ab_acquire(void) { while (__atomic_exchange_n(&ab_lock, 1, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) { } }
static void ab_release(void) { __atomic_store_n(&ab_lock, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }

// Caller holds the lock.
static void ab_bind(const AbEvent *e) {
    if (ab_nlive >= AB_LIVE - 1) { ab_dropped++; return; }   // keep one slot free so probes terminate
    uint32_t i = ab_home(e->base);
    while (ab_live[i].seq) i = (i + 1) & (AB_LIVE - 1);
    ab_live[i] = *e;
    ab_nlive++;
}

static void ab_unbind(const AbEvent *e) {
    uint32_t i = ab_home(e->base), hit = AB_LIVE;
    for (; ab_live[i].seq; i = (i + 1) & (AB_LIVE - 1)) {
        if (ab_live[i].base != e->base) continue;
        if (ab_live[i].handle == e->handle) { hit = i; break; }
        if (hit == AB_LIVE) hit = i;   // same base, other handle: take it if nothing matches better
    }
    if (hit != AB_LIVE) {
        // Backward-shift delete: pull later entries of the probe run into the hole when their home allows it.
        uint32_t j = hit;
        for (;;) {
            j = (j + 1) & (AB_LIVE - 1);
            if (!ab_live[j].seq) break;
            uint32_t h = ab_home(ab_live[j].base);
            if (((j - h) & (AB_LIVE - 1)) >= ((j - hit) & (AB_LIVE - 1))) ab_live[hit] = ab_live[j], hit = j;
        }
        memset(&ab_live[hit], 0, sizeof ab_live[hit]);
        ab_nlive--;
    }
    ab_unb[ab_nunb++ % AB_UNBINDS] = *e;   // kept even if the bind was never seen or was dropped
}

static VKAPI_ATTR VkBool32 VKAPI_CALL ab_callback(VkDebugUtilsMessageSeverityFlagBitsEXT sev,
                                                  VkDebugUtilsMessageTypeFlagsEXT type,
                                                  const VkDebugUtilsMessengerCallbackDataEXT *d, void *user) {
    (void)sev, (void)type, (void)user;
    for (const VkBaseInStructure *s = d->pNext; s; s = s->pNext) {
        if (s->sType != VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BINDING_CALLBACK_DATA_EXT) continue;
        const VkDeviceAddressBindingCallbackDataEXT *b = (const void *)s;
        AbEvent e = {.base = b->baseAddress, .size = b->size, .flags = b->flags,
                     .type = d->objectCount ? (uint32_t)d->pObjects[0].objectType : 0,
                     .handle = d->objectCount ? d->pObjects[0].objectHandle : 0};
        ab_acquire();
        e.seq = ++ab_n;
        if (b->bindingType == VK_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BINDING_TYPE_UNBIND_EXT) ab_unbind(&e);
        else ab_bind(&e);
        ab_release();
    }
    return VK_FALSE;
}

static const char *ab_object(uint32_t t) {
    return t == VK_OBJECT_TYPE_DEVICE_MEMORY ? "memory" : t == VK_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER ? "buffer" : t == VK_OBJECT_TYPE_IMAGE ? "image" : "object";
}

static void ab_print(const char *why, const AbEvent *e, uint64_t a) {
    rt_log("vk: address binding #%llu %s: %#llx..%#llx (%llu bytes) %s %#llx%s, address is %#llx %s the start", (unsigned long long)e->seq, why,
           (unsigned long long)e->base, (unsigned long long)(e->base + e->size), (unsigned long long)e->size,
           ab_object(e->type), (unsigned long long)e->handle,
           e->flags & VK_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BINDING_INTERNAL_OBJECT_BIT_EXT ? " (driver internal)" : "",
           (unsigned long long)(a >= e->base ? a - e->base : e->base - a), a >= e->base ? "past" : "before");
}

void vk_crumbs_report_address(uint64_t a) {
    if (!ab_messenger) return;
    // The device is lost, but a driver thread may still hold the lock (or have died holding it): spin briefly, then read
    // without it. An unlocked read can show a torn entry, never crash: the tables are static.
    int locked = 0;
    for (uint32_t spin = 0; spin < 200000 && !locked; spin++) locked = !__atomic_exchange_n(&ab_lock, 1, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    uint64_t total = ab_n;
    rt_log("vk: address %#llx: %llu binding events seen, %llu live ranges, %llu binds dropped (live set full)%s",
           (unsigned long long)a, (unsigned long long)total, (unsigned long long)ab_nlive,
           (unsigned long long)ab_dropped, locked ? "" : "; lock busy, reading the tables without it (best effort)");
    uint32_t shown = 0;
    const AbEvent *below = NULL, *above = NULL;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < AB_LIVE; i++) {
        const AbEvent *e = &ab_live[i];
        if (!e->seq) continue;
        if (a >= e->base && a - e->base < e->size) {
            if (shown++ < 16) ab_print("is live and contains the address", e, a);
        } else if (e->base + e->size <= a) {
            if (!below || e->base + e->size > below->base + below->size) below = e;
        } else if (e->base > a && (!above || e->base < above->base)) {
            above = e;
        }
    }
    if (shown > 16) rt_log("vk: address %#llx: %u more live ranges contain it", (unsigned long long)a, shown - 16);
    if (!shown) {
        rt_log("vk: address %#llx: no live range contains it", (unsigned long long)a);
        if (below) ab_print("nearest live range below", below, a);
        if (above) ab_print("nearest live range above", above, a);
    }
    uint64_t nunb = ab_nunb, first = nunb > AB_UNBINDS ? nunb - AB_UNBINDS : 0;
    uint32_t freed = 0;
    for (uint64_t k = nunb; k > first && freed < 8; k--) {   // newest first
        const AbEvent *e = &ab_unb[(k - 1) % AB_UNBINDS];
        if (!e->seq || a < e->base || a - e->base >= e->size) continue;
        freed++;
        rt_log("vk: address %#llx: UNBOUND before the fault, %llu binding events ago:", (unsigned long long)a,
               (unsigned long long)(total - e->seq));
        ab_print("(unbind)", e, a);
    }
    if (!freed) rt_log("vk: address %#llx: no recent unbind (last %u kept) contains it", (unsigned long long)a, AB_UNBINDS);
    if (locked) ab_release();
}

void vk_crumbs_init(VkCtx *c) {
    if (c->has_address_binding_report) {
        PFN_vkCreateDebugUtilsMessengerEXT f =
            (PFN_vkCreateDebugUtilsMessengerEXT)vkGetInstanceProcAddr(c->instance, "vkCreateDebugUtilsMessengerEXT");
        VkDebugUtilsMessengerCreateInfoEXT mi = {
            .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSENGER_CREATE_INFO_EXT,
            .messageSeverity = VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_INFO_BIT_EXT | VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_WARNING_BIT_EXT |
                               VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_ERROR_BIT_EXT,
            .messageType = VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_TYPE_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BINDING_BIT_EXT,
            .pfnUserCallback = ab_callback};
        if (f && f(c->instance, &mi, NULL, &ab_messenger) == VK_SUCCESS)
            rt_log("vk: device address bindings recorded (VK_EXT_device_address_binding_report)");
        else rt_log("vk: device address binding report unavailable");
    } else if (c->has_nv_checkpoints) {
        rt_log("vk: device address binding report not available (VK_EXT_device_address_binding_report): fault addresses stay unmapped");
    }
    if (c->has_nv_checkpoints) {
        set_cp = (PFN_vkCmdSetCheckpointNV)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(c->device, "vkCmdSetCheckpointNV");
        get_cp = (PFN_vkGetQueueCheckpointDataNV)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(c->device, "vkGetQueueCheckpointDataNV");
        get_cp2 = (PFN_vkGetQueueCheckpointData2NV)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(c->device, "vkGetQueueCheckpointData2NV");
        if (!set_cp || !(get_cp || get_cp2)) set_cp = NULL;
        rt_log(set_cp ? "vk: GPU checkpoints on (VK_NV_device_diagnostic_checkpoints)" : "vk: GPU checkpoints unavailable");
    }
    if (!c->has_buffer_marker) return;
    write_marker = (PFN_vkCmdWriteBufferMarkerAMD)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(c->device, "vkCmdWriteBufferMarkerAMD");
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = 16,
                             .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_HOST,
                                  .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT,
                                  .requiredFlags = VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT};
    VmaAllocationInfo info;
    if (!write_marker || vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &ai, &buf, &alloc, &info) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        rt_log("vk: GPU breadcrumbs unavailable");
        write_marker = NULL;
        return;
    }
    words = info.pMappedData;
    words[0] = words[1] = 0;
    rt_log("vk: GPU breadcrumbs on (VK_AMD_buffer_marker)");
}

// isa_dump state (below), reset on release.
static uint32_t pipes;
static uint64_t written;
static PFN_vkGetPipelineExecutablePropertiesKHR get_props;
static PFN_vkGetPipelineExecutableStatisticsKHR get_stats;
static PFN_vkGetPipelineExecutableInternalRepresentationsKHR get_irs;

void vk_crumbs_release(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (ab_messenger && c) {
        PFN_vkDestroyDebugUtilsMessengerEXT f =
            (PFN_vkDestroyDebugUtilsMessengerEXT)vkGetInstanceProcAddr(c->instance, "vkDestroyDebugUtilsMessengerEXT");
        if (f) f(c->instance, ab_messenger, NULL);
    }
    ab_messenger = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    ab_acquire();
    ab_n = ab_nlive = ab_dropped = ab_nunb = 0;
    memset(ab_live, 0, sizeof ab_live);
    memset(ab_unb, 0, sizeof ab_unb);
    ab_release();
    cp_tag_n = 0;
    if (buf && c) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, buf, alloc);
    buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE, alloc = NULL, words = NULL, write_marker = NULL;
    set_cp = NULL, get_cp = NULL, get_cp2 = NULL;
    get_props = NULL, get_stats = NULL, get_irs = NULL, pipes = 0, written = 0;
    plat_mutex_lock(&cp_lock);
    memset(cp_reg, 0, sizeof cp_reg);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&cp_lock);
}

int vk_checkpoints_on(void) { return set_cp != NULL; }

void vk_checkpoint(VkCommandBuffer cb, const void *marker) {
    if (set_cp && cb) set_cp(cb, marker);
}

VkPipelineCreateFlags vk_pipeline_capture_flags(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    return c && c->has_pipeline_exec_info && set_cp
               ? VK_PIPELINE_CREATE_CAPTURE_STATISTICS_BIT_KHR | VK_PIPELINE_CREATE_CAPTURE_INTERNAL_REPRESENTATIONS_BIT_KHR
               : 0;
}

// MKW_GPU_CHECKPOINTS=1 with VK_KHR_pipeline_executable_properties: one log line per executable of a pipeline (its
// statistics, which include the compiled binary size on NVIDIA) and its internal representations (the driver's ISA text
// or binary) saved next to mkw.log, so a faulting shader binary of a known size and code offset can be matched to the
// NVN 2 stages that built it. The files hold code derived from the game: local only, ignored by git.
enum { ISA_MAX_PIPES = 4096, ISA_MAX_BYTES = 512u << 20 };

static void isa_dump(VkPipeline p, uint64_t vs, uint64_t gs, uint64_t fs) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!c || !c->has_pipeline_exec_info || __atomic_fetch_add(&pipes, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) >= ISA_MAX_PIPES) return;
    plat_mutex_lock(&cp_lock);   // the entry points load once, the byte budget is shared
    if (!get_irs) {
        get_props = (PFN_vkGetPipelineExecutablePropertiesKHR)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(c->device, "vkGetPipelineExecutablePropertiesKHR");
        get_stats = (PFN_vkGetPipelineExecutableStatisticsKHR)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(c->device, "vkGetPipelineExecutableStatisticsKHR");
        get_irs = (PFN_vkGetPipelineExecutableInternalRepresentationsKHR)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(
            c->device, "vkGetPipelineExecutableInternalRepresentationsKHR");
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&cp_lock);
    if (!get_props || !get_stats || !get_irs) return;
    uint32_t ne = 0;
    VkPipelineInfoKHR pinfo = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_INFO_KHR, .pipeline = p};
    if (get_props(c->device, &pinfo, &ne, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS || !ne) return;
    VkPipelineExecutablePropertiesKHR *pr = calloc(ne, sizeof *pr);
    if (!pr) return;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ne; i++) pr[i].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_EXECUTABLE_PROPERTIES_KHR;
    get_props(c->device, &pinfo, &ne, pr);
    const char *lp = rt_log_path();
    const char *cut = lp ? strrchr(lp, '/') : NULL;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
        VkPipelineExecutableInfoKHR ei = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_EXECUTABLE_INFO_KHR, .pipeline = p, .executableIndex = i};
        const char *stage = pr[i].stages & VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT ? "vertex" : pr[i].stages & VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT ? "fragment"
                          : pr[i].stages & VK_SHADER_STAGE_GEOMETRY_BIT ? "geometry" : "other";
        char line[2048];
        int n = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "vk: pipeline %p (NVN 2 stages %016llx %016llx %016llx) executable %u %s \"%s\" \"%s\":", (void *)p,
                         (unsigned long long)vs, (unsigned long long)gs, (unsigned long long)fs, i, stage, pr[i].name, pr[i].description);
        uint32_t ns = 0;
        VkPipelineExecutableStatisticKHR *st = NULL;
        if (get_stats(c->device, &ei, &ns, NULL) == VK_SUCCESS && ns && (st = calloc(ns, sizeof *st))) {
            for (uint32_t j = 0; j < ns; j++) st[j].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_EXECUTABLE_STATISTIC_KHR;
            get_stats(c->device, &ei, &ns, st);
            for (uint32_t j = 0; j < ns && n > 0 && (size_t)n < sizeof line; j++) {
                const VkPipelineExecutableStatisticValueKHR *v = &st[j].value;
                switch (st[j].format) {
                case VK_PIPELINE_EXECUTABLE_STATISTIC_FORMAT_BOOL32_KHR: n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - n, " %s=%u", st[j].name, v->b32); break;
                case VK_PIPELINE_EXECUTABLE_STATISTIC_FORMAT_INT64_KHR: n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - n, " %s=%lld", st[j].name, (long long)v->i64); break;
                case VK_PIPELINE_EXECUTABLE_STATISTIC_FORMAT_UINT64_KHR: n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - n, " %s=%llu", st[j].name, (unsigned long long)v->u64); break;
                default: n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - n, " %s=%g", st[j].name, v->f64); break;
                }
            }
            free(st);
        }
        rt_log("%s", line);
        uint32_t nr = 0;
        if (get_irs(c->device, &ei, &nr, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS || !nr) continue;
        VkPipelineExecutableInternalRepresentationKHR *ir = calloc(nr, sizeof *ir);
        if (!ir) continue;
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < nr; j++) ir[j].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_EXECUTABLE_INTERNAL_REPRESENTATION_KHR;
        if (get_irs(c->device, &ei, &nr, ir) == VK_SUCCESS) {   // sizes only: pData is NULL
            for (uint32_t j = 0; j < nr; j++) {
                size_t sz = ir[j].dataSize;
                if (!sz || __atomic_fetch_add(&written, sz, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) + sz > ISA_MAX_BYTES) {   // reserve before malloc
                    if (sz) __atomic_fetch_sub(&written, sz, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
                    rt_log("vk: pipeline %p executable %u representation \"%s\" (%zu bytes) not saved (budget)", (void *)p, i, ir[j].name, sz);
                    continue;
                }
                if (!(ir[j].pData = malloc(sz))) __atomic_fetch_sub(&written, sz, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
            }
            get_irs(c->device, &ei, &nr, ir);   // fills the buffers just allocated
            {
                for (uint32_t j = 0; j < nr; j++) {
                    if (!ir[j].pData) continue;
                    char path[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 3 + 96], suffix[24] = "";
                    if (i || j) snprintf(suffix, sizeof suffix, "-%u-%u", i, j);
                    if (cut) snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%.*s/mkw-isa-%llx-%s%s.%s", (int)(cut - lp), lp, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)p, stage,
                                      suffix, ir[j].isText ? "txt" : "bin");
                    if (cut && plat_file_write_atomic(path, ir[j].pData, ir[j].dataSize)) {
                        rt_log("vk: pipeline %p executable %u representation \"%s\" saved: %s (%zu bytes)", (void *)p, i, ir[j].name, path, ir[j].dataSize);
                    } else __atomic_fetch_sub(&written, ir[j].dataSize, __ATOMIC_RELAXED), rt_log("vk: pipeline %p executable %u representation \"%s\": cannot save", (void *)p, i, ir[j].name);
                }
            }
            for (uint32_t j = 0; j < nr; j++) free(ir[j].pData);
        }
        free(ir);
    }
    free(pr);
}

void vk_checkpoint_note(VkPipeline p, uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t c) {
    if (!set_cp || !p) return;
    plat_mutex_lock(&cp_lock);
    uint32_t i = cp_slot(p);
    int n = 0;
    while (n < CP_PROBES && cp_reg[i].pipe && cp_reg[i].pipe != p) n++, i = (i + 1) % CP_SLOTS;
    int fresh = n < CP_PROBES && !cp_reg[i].pipe;
    if (n < CP_PROBES) cp_reg[i].pipe = p, cp_reg[i].stage[0] = a, cp_reg[i].stage[1] = b, cp_reg[i].stage[2] = c;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&cp_lock);
    if (fresh) isa_dump(p, a, b, c);   // first bind of this pipeline: its stage names are known now
}

// Non-pipeline checkpoints (dispatch, copies, blits, clears; vk_rec.c): the marker points into this ring and names the
// command, plus the compute pipeline last bound on the recording thread for a dispatch. The ring wraps: a checkpoint
// older than CP_TAGS tags would read a newer tag, far more than the frames in flight hold.
enum { CP_TAGS = 1 << 16 };
static struct { const char *kind; VkPipeline compute; } cp_tags[CP_TAGS];

static _Thread_local VkPipeline cp_compute;

// The last-bound pipeline is per recording thread, not per command buffer, so a dispatch may carry the pipeline another
// buffer bound last on that thread (diagnostic only).
void vk_checkpoint_compute(VkPipeline p) { cp_compute = p; }

const void *vk_checkpoint_tag(const char *kind) {
    if (!set_cp) return NULL;
    uint32_t i = __atomic_fetch_add(&cp_tag_n, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) % CP_TAGS;
    cp_tags[i].kind = kind;
    cp_tags[i].compute = !strncmp(kind, "dispatch", 8) ? cp_compute : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    return &cp_tags[i];
}

static void pipeline_name(const void *m, char *o, size_t size);

static void checkpoint_name(const void *m, char *o, size_t size) {
    if ((const char *)m >= (const char *)cp_tags && (const char *)m < (const char *)(cp_tags + CP_TAGS)) {
        int n = snprintf(o, size, "%s", ((const typeof(cp_tags[0]) *)m)->kind);
        if (((const typeof(cp_tags[0]) *)m)->compute && n > 0 && (size_t)n < size) {
            snprintf(o + n, size - (size_t)n, ", last bound compute ");
            n = (int)strlen(o);
            pipeline_name(((const typeof(cp_tags[0]) *)m)->compute, o + n, size - (size_t)n);
        }
        return;
    }
    pipeline_name(m, o, size);
}

static void pipeline_name(const void *m, char *o, size_t size) {
    snprintf(o, size, "marker %p, pipeline not registered", m);
    plat_mutex_lock(&cp_lock);
    uint32_t i = cp_slot(m);
    for (int n = 0; n < CP_PROBES && cp_reg[i].pipe; n++, i = (i + 1) % CP_SLOTS)
        if ((const void *)cp_reg[i].pipe == m) {
            snprintf(o, size, "pipeline %p, NVN 2 stages %016llx %016llx %016llx (vertex or compute, geometry, fragment)", m,
                     (unsigned long long)cp_reg[i].stage[0], (unsigned long long)cp_reg[i].stage[1],
                     (unsigned long long)cp_reg[i].stage[2]);
            break;
        }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&cp_lock);
}

static void checkpoints_report(void) {
    VkCheckpointData2NV d2[16];
    VkCheckpointDataNV d1[16];
    uint32_t n = 16;
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!c) return;
    VkQueue q = c->gfx_queue;
    if (get_cp2) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) d2[i] = (VkCheckpointData2NV){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_CHECKPOINT_DATA_2_NV};
        get_cp2(q, &n, d2);
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) d1[i] = (VkCheckpointDataNV){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_CHECKPOINT_DATA_NV};
        get_cp(q, &n, d1);
    }
    rt_log("vk: GPU checkpoints: %u reported on the graphics queue", n);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && i < 16; i++) {
        char name[256];
        const void *m = get_cp2 ? d2[i].pCheckpointMarker : d1[i].pCheckpointMarker;
        checkpoint_name(m, name, sizeof name);
        unsigned long long st = get_cp2 ? (unsigned long long)d2[i].stage : (unsigned long long)d1[i].stage;
        if (st == 0x1) rt_log("vk: GPU checkpoint %u: stage TOP_OF_PIPE, %s", i, name);
        else if (st == 0x2000) rt_log("vk: GPU checkpoint %u: stage BOTTOM_OF_PIPE, %s", i, name);
        else rt_log("vk: GPU checkpoint %u: stage %#llx, %s", i, st, name);
    }
}

void vk_crumb(VkCommandBuffer cb, int kind, uint64_t n) {
    if (!write_marker || !cb) return;
    uint32_t code = (uint32_t)kind << 28 | (uint32_t)(n & 0x0fffffff);
    write_marker(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, buf, 0, code);
    write_marker(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, buf, 4, code);
}

static void describe(uint32_t code, char *o, size_t size) {
    static const char *const kinds[] = {"nothing", "the start of a part of submission", "the end of submission",
                                        "the start of upload batch", "the end of upload batch",
                                        "ASTC decode chunk", "the start of present",
                                        "the end of present"};
    unsigned k = code >> 28;
    if (!code) snprintf(o, size, "nothing yet");
    else if (k < sizeof kinds / sizeof *kinds) snprintf(o, size, "%s %u", kinds[k], code & 0x0fffffff);
    else snprintf(o, size, "unknown code %#x", code);
}

void vk_crumbs_report(void) {
    if (set_cp) checkpoints_report();
    if (!words) return;
    char reached[96], finished[96];
    describe(words[0], reached, sizeof reached);
    describe(words[1], finished, sizeof finished);
    rt_log("vk: GPU breadcrumbs: the GPU last reached %s; everything before %s had finished", reached, finished);
}

```

`runtime/vk_device.c`:

```c
// Vulkan instance, physical device choice, logical device, VMA, timeline semaphore and the validation messenger.
// Ported from LAS Recomp, runtime/nvn/vulkan/device.c:33-330
// (https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp @ da35b83a9611d046a9a681aae668d7085954d37f, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai),
// without SDL. The VMA implementation is runtime/vk_vma.cpp (VMA is C++ only).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

static VkCtx g_vk;
static int g_ready;
static PlatMutex g_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;

static VKAPI_ATTR VkBool32 VKAPI_CALL debug_cb(VkDebugUtilsMessageSeverityFlagBitsEXT sev, VkDebugUtilsMessageTypeFlagsEXT type,
                                               const VkDebugUtilsMessengerCallbackDataEXT *d, void *user) {
    (void)type, (void)user;
    int err = (sev & VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_ERROR_BIT_EXT) != 0;
    if (err) plat_inc32(&g_vk.validation_errors);
    static volatile int32_t logged;
    if (plat_inc32(&logged) <= 500) rt_log("vk validation %s: %s", err ? "error" : "warning", d->pMessage);
    return VK_FALSE;
}

static int has_ext(const VkExtensionProperties *e, uint32_t n, const char *name) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!strcmp(e[i].extensionName, name)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static int layer_present(const char *name) {
    uint32_t n = 0;
    vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties(&n, NULL);
    VkLayerProperties *l = calloc(n ? n : 1, sizeof *l);
    vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties(&n, l);
    int found = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!strcmp(l[i].layerName, name)) found = 1;
    free(l);
    return found;
}

// Mesa's drivers (RADV on Linux and the Steam Deck) keep a shader cache of their own beside our pipeline cache, by
// default in ~/.cache and up to 1 GB: about 35 MB in a minute of the title screen. A Deck's /home is small and the game
// usually sits on the SD card, so unless MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DIR names a folder, it goes to mesa-cache beside the exe.
static void mesa_cache_beside_exe(void) {
    char dir[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2];
    if (plat_getenv("MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DIR", dir, sizeof dir)) return;
    int len = plat_exe_path(dir, sizeof dir - 16);
    char *cut = len ? plat_last_sep(dir) : NULL;
    if (!cut) return;
    strcpy(cut + 1, "mesa-cache");
    plat_setenv("MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DIR", dir);
}

static int create_instance(void) {
    mesa_cache_beside_exe();
    const char *ext[24];
    uint32_t n_ext = (uint32_t)gfx_window_vk_extensions(ext, 16);
    const char *layers[] = {"VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation"};
    int validate = cfg_bool("TOTK_VK_VALIDATION");
    if (validate && !layer_present(layers[0])) {
        rt_log("vk: TOTK_VK_VALIDATION set but %s is not installed; continuing without", layers[0]);
        validate = 0;
    }
    // The checkpoints also want debug utils, for the device address binding messenger (vk_crumbs.c).
    int utils = validate;
    const char *ck = cfg_get("TOTK_GPU_CHECKPOINTS");
    if (!utils && ck && !strcmp(ck, "1")) {
        uint32_t ni = 0;
        vkEnumerateInstanceExtensionProperties(NULL, &ni, NULL);
        VkExtensionProperties *ip = calloc(ni ? ni : 1, sizeof *ip);
        if (ip) {
            vkEnumerateInstanceExtensionProperties(NULL, &ni, ip);
            utils = has_ext(ip, ni, VK_EXT_DEBUG_UTILS_EXTENSION_NAME);
            free(ip);
        } else utils = 0;
    }
    if (utils) ext[n_ext++] = VK_EXT_DEBUG_UTILS_EXTENSION_NAME;
    g_vk.debug_utils = utils;
    VkApplicationInfo app = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, .pApplicationName = "TotK Recomp",
                             .pEngineName = "TotK Recomp", .apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3};
    VkInstanceCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, .pApplicationInfo = &app,
                               .enabledExtensionCount = n_ext, .ppEnabledExtensionNames = ext,
                               .enabledLayerCount = validate ? 1 : 0, .ppEnabledLayerNames = layers};
    rdoc_init();
    VkResult r = vkCreateInstance(&ci, NULL, &g_vk.instance);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) { rt_log("vk: vkCreateInstance failed (%d); is a Vulkan 1.3 driver installed?", (int)r); return 0; }
    g_vk.validation = validate;
    if (validate) {
        PFN_vkCreateDebugUtilsMessengerEXT f =
            (PFN_vkCreateDebugUtilsMessengerEXT)vkGetInstanceProcAddr(g_vk.instance, "vkCreateDebugUtilsMessengerEXT");
        VkDebugUtilsMessengerCreateInfoEXT mi = {
            .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSENGER_CREATE_INFO_EXT,
            .messageSeverity = VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_WARNING_BIT_EXT | VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_ERROR_BIT_EXT,
            .messageType = VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_TYPE_GENERAL_BIT_EXT | VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_TYPE_VALIDATION_BIT_EXT |
                           VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_TYPE_PERFORMANCE_BIT_EXT,
            .pfnUserCallback = debug_cb};
        if (f) f(g_vk.instance, &mi, NULL, &g_vk.messenger);
    }
    return 1;
}

static const char *const k_required_ext[] = {
    VK_KHR_SWAPCHAIN_EXTENSION_NAME, VK_KHR_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_EXTENSION_NAME, VK_EXT_DEPTH_CLIP_CONTROL_EXTENSION_NAME,
    VK_EXT_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HOST_EXTENSION_NAME};

// Name of the first missing required extension, or NULL.
static const char *missing_required(VkPhysicalDevice pd) {
    uint32_t n = 0;
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(pd, NULL, &n, NULL);
    VkExtensionProperties *e = calloc(n ? n : 1, sizeof *e);
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(pd, NULL, &n, e);
    const char *miss = NULL;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof k_required_ext / sizeof *k_required_ext && !miss; i++)
        if (!has_ext(e, n, k_required_ext[i])) miss = k_required_ext[i];
    free(e);
    return miss;
}

// Graphics+compute family that can present to the window.
static uint32_t find_gfx_family(VkPhysicalDevice pd, const VkQueueFamilyProperties *qp, uint32_t nq) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nq; i++)
        if ((qp[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT) && (qp[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT) &&
            gfx_window_vk_presentable(g_vk.instance, pd, i))
            return i;
    return UINT32_MAX;
}

static int name_has(const char *s, const char *sub) {
    for (size_t n = strlen(sub); *s; s++)
        if (!strncasecmp(s, sub, n)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

// First discrete GPU with Vulkan 1.3, the required extensions and a graphics+present queue; TOTK_GPU_INDEX (index) or
// TOTK_GPU_NAME (case-insensitive part of the name) overrides.
static int pick_device(void) {
    uint32_t n = 0;
    vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(g_vk.instance, &n, NULL);
    if (!n) { rt_log("vk: no Vulkan device"); return 0; }
    VkPhysicalDevice *pd = calloc(n, sizeof *pd);
    vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(g_vk.instance, &n, pd);
    const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_GPU_INDEX");   // no fixed default: the best device when unset
    int want = e && *e ? atoi(e) : -1;
    const char *name = cfg_get("TOTK_GPU_NAME");
    int best = -1, best_score = -1;
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties best_p = {0};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties p;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(pd[i], &p);
        rt_log("vk: gpu %u: %s (type %d, api %u.%u.%u)", i, p.deviceName, (int)p.deviceType, VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(p.apiVersion),
               VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(p.apiVersion), VK_API_VERSION_PATCH(p.apiVersion));
        if (want >= 0 && (int)i != want) continue;
        if (name && *name && !name_has(p.deviceName, name)) continue;
        if (p.apiVersion < VK_API_VERSION_1_3) { rt_log("vk: gpu %u skipped: Vulkan below 1.3", i); continue; }
        const char *miss = missing_required(pd[i]);
        if (miss) { rt_log("vk: gpu %u skipped: missing extension %s", i, miss); continue; }
        uint32_t nq = 0;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(pd[i], &nq, NULL);
        VkQueueFamilyProperties *qp = calloc(nq ? nq : 1, sizeof *qp);
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(pd[i], &nq, qp);
        uint32_t fam = find_gfx_family(pd[i], qp, nq);
        free(qp);
        if (fam == UINT32_MAX) { rt_log("vk: gpu %u skipped: no graphics+compute+present queue family", i); continue; }
        int score = (int)i == want ? 100 : p.deviceType == VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_DISCRETE_GPU ? 3
                  : p.deviceType == VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_INTEGRATED_GPU ? 2 : 1;
        // The loader lists the same GPU twice when an old driver's ICD json is left behind, and the old driver can come
        // first. On a tie in score between entries with the same vendor and device ID, the newer driverVersion wins.
        // Follows ocarina-recomp runtime/vk_device.c (Hookshot, ef4c2b0), at 14566bd, GPL-3.0.
        int dup = best >= 0 && score == best_score && p.vendorID == best_p.vendorID && p.deviceID == best_p.deviceID;
        if (dup) rt_log("vk: gpu %u and gpu %d are the same GPU (leftover driver); keeping the newer driver",
                        i, best);
        if (score > best_score || (dup && p.driverVersion > best_p.driverVersion)) {
            best_score = score; best = (int)i; best_p = p;
        }
    }
    if (best < 0) {
        if (want >= 0) rt_log("vk: TOTK_GPU_INDEX=%d is not usable (see above)", want);
        else if (name && *name) rt_log("vk: no usable gpu matches TOTK_GPU_NAME=%s (see above)", name);
        else rt_log("vk: no device with Vulkan 1.3 and the required extensions (see above)");
        free(pd);
        return 0;
    }
    g_vk.phys = pd[best];
    g_vk.device_index = best;
    free(pd);
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(g_vk.phys, &g_vk.props);
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(g_vk.phys, &g_vk.mem_props);
    uint32_t nq = 0;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(g_vk.phys, &nq, NULL);
    VkQueueFamilyProperties *qp = calloc(nq ? nq : 1, sizeof *qp);
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(g_vk.phys, &nq, qp);
    g_vk.gfx_family = find_gfx_family(g_vk.phys, qp, nq);
    g_vk.xfer_family = g_vk.gfx_family;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nq; i++)   // a family that does transfer only (async DMA engine)
        if ((qp[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_TRANSFER_BIT) && !(qp[i].queueFlags & (VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT | VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT))) {
            g_vk.xfer_family = i;
            break;
        }
    free(qp);
    g_vk.gpu_is_nvidia = g_vk.props.vendorID == 0x10de;
    g_vk.gpu_is_rtx50 = g_vk.gpu_is_nvidia &&
                        (strstr(g_vk.props.deviceName, "RTX 50") != NULL || g_vk.props.deviceID >= 0x2b00);
    g_vk.gpu_is_rtx40_plus = g_vk.gpu_is_rtx50 ||
                             (g_vk.gpu_is_nvidia &&
                              (strstr(g_vk.props.deviceName, "RTX 40") != NULL || g_vk.props.deviceID >= 0x2600));
    g_vk.gpu_is_rx9000 = g_vk.props.vendorID == 0x1002 &&
                         (strstr(g_vk.props.deviceName, "RX 90") != NULL || strstr(g_vk.props.deviceName, "RX90") != NULL);
    g_vk.gpu_is_intel = g_vk.props.vendorID == 0x8086;
```
