```c
    g_vk.gpu_is_intel_arc = g_vk.gpu_is_intel &&
                            (strstr(g_vk.props.deviceName, "Arc") != NULL ||
                             strstr(g_vk.props.deviceName, "ARC") != NULL ||
                             strstr(g_vk.props.deviceName, "Battlemage") != NULL ||
                             strstr(g_vk.props.deviceName, "Alchemist") != NULL);
    rt_log("vk: using gpu %d: %s (nvidia=%d, rtx40+=%d, rtx50=%d, rx9000=%d, intel=%d, intel_arc=%d)", best, g_vk.props.deviceName,
           g_vk.gpu_is_nvidia, g_vk.gpu_is_rtx40_plus, g_vk.gpu_is_rtx50, g_vk.gpu_is_rx9000, g_vk.gpu_is_intel, g_vk.gpu_is_intel_arc);
    vk_mem_class_log(&g_vk.props, &g_vk.mem_props);
    return 1;
}

typedef struct {
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 f2;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan11Features f11;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features f12;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features f13;
    VkPhysicalDeviceDepthClipControlFeaturesEXT clip;
    VkPhysicalDeviceCustomBorderColorFeaturesEXT cbc;
    VkPhysicalDeviceExtendedDynamicStateFeaturesEXT eds;
    VkPhysicalDeviceExtendedDynamicState2FeaturesEXT eds2;
    VkPhysicalDeviceExtendedDynamicState3FeaturesEXT eds3;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVertexInputDynamicStateFeaturesEXT vids;
    VkPhysicalDeviceConditionalRenderingFeaturesEXT cond;
    VkPhysicalDeviceTransformFeedbackFeaturesEXT xfb;
    VkPhysicalDeviceProvokingVertexFeaturesEXT pv;
    VkPhysicalDeviceRobustness2FeaturesEXT rob2;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFaultFeaturesEXT fault;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFragmentShaderInterlockFeaturesEXT fsi;
    VkPhysicalDeviceGraphicsPipelineLibraryFeaturesEXT gpl;
    VkPhysicalDeviceAttachmentFeedbackLoopLayoutFeaturesEXT fbl;
    VkPhysicalDeviceDynamicRenderingLocalReadFeaturesKHR lr;
    VkPhysicalDeviceAddressBindingReportFeaturesEXT abr;
    VkPhysicalDevicePipelineExecutablePropertiesFeaturesKHR pei;
    VkPhysicalDeviceMeshShaderFeaturesEXT mesh;
    VkPhysicalDevicePrimitiveTopologyListRestartFeaturesEXT lrs;
} FeatureChain;

static int create_device(void) {
    uint32_t ne = 0;
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(g_vk.phys, NULL, &ne, NULL);
    VkExtensionProperties *ep = calloc(ne ? ne : 1, sizeof *ep);
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(g_vk.phys, NULL, &ne, ep);
    const char *ext[48];
    uint32_t n_ext = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof k_required_ext / sizeof *k_required_ext; i++) ext[n_ext++] = k_required_ext[i];

    FeatureChain *c = calloc(1, sizeof *c);
    void **tail = &c->f2.pNext;
#define CHAIN(member, stype) do { c->member.sType = stype; *tail = &c->member; tail = &c->member.pNext; } while (0)
    c->f2.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2;
    CHAIN(f11, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_1_FEATURES);
    CHAIN(f12, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES);
    CHAIN(f13, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES);
    CHAIN(clip, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DEPTH_CLIP_CONTROL_FEATURES_EXT);
#define OPTIONAL_EXT(flag, name, member, stype) do { \
        if (has_ext(ep, ne, name)) { g_vk.flag = 1; ext[n_ext++] = name; CHAIN(member, stype); } } while (0)
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_custom_border_color, VK_EXT_CUSTOM_BORDER_COLOR_EXTENSION_NAME, cbc, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_CUSTOM_BORDER_COLOR_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_eds, VK_EXT_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_EXTENSION_NAME, eds, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_eds2, VK_EXT_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_2_EXTENSION_NAME, eds2, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_2_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_eds3, VK_EXT_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_3_EXTENSION_NAME, eds3, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_3_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_vertex_input_dynamic_state, VK_EXT_VERTEX_INPUT_DYNAMIC_STATE_EXTENSION_NAME, vids, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VERTEX_INPUT_DYNAMIC_STATE_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_conditional_rendering, VK_EXT_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_EXTENSION_NAME, cond, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_transform_feedback, VK_EXT_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_EXTENSION_NAME, xfb, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_provoking_vertex, VK_EXT_PROVOKING_VERTEX_EXTENSION_NAME, pv, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROVOKING_VERTEX_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_robustness2, VK_EXT_ROBUSTNESS_2_EXTENSION_NAME, rob2, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_ROBUSTNESS_2_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_device_fault, VK_EXT_DEVICE_FAULT_EXTENSION_NAME, fault, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FAULT_FEATURES_EXT);
    // Ryujinx's SPIR-V declares fragment shader interlock whenever the host reports it (vk_pipeline.c spirv_fixup).
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_fragment_shader_interlock, VK_EXT_FRAGMENT_SHADER_INTERLOCK_EXTENSION_NAME, fsi,
                 VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_INTERLOCK_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_mesh_shader, VK_EXT_MESH_SHADER_EXTENSION_NAME, mesh,
                 VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_MESH_SHADER_FEATURES_EXT);
    // Maxwell applies primitive restart to list draws too (docs/maxwell.md 5.2); core Vulkan only to strips and fans.
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_list_restart, VK_EXT_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_LIST_RESTART_EXTENSION_NAME, lrs,
                 VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_LIST_RESTART_FEATURES_EXT);
    // Feedback loops (vk.h VkCtx.feedback): the layout, and barriers inside dynamic rendering
    int has_fbl = 0, has_lr = 0;
    if (has_ext(ep, ne, VK_EXT_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_LAYOUT_EXTENSION_NAME) &&
        has_ext(ep, ne, VK_KHR_DYNAMIC_RENDERING_LOCAL_READ_EXTENSION_NAME)) {
        has_fbl = has_lr = 1;
        ext[n_ext++] = VK_EXT_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_LAYOUT_EXTENSION_NAME;
        ext[n_ext++] = VK_KHR_DYNAMIC_RENDERING_LOCAL_READ_EXTENSION_NAME;
        CHAIN(fbl, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_LAYOUT_FEATURES_EXT);
        CHAIN(lr, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DYNAMIC_RENDERING_LOCAL_READ_FEATURES_KHR);
    }
    if (has_ext(ep, ne, VK_EXT_MEMORY_BUDGET_EXTENSION_NAME)) { g_vk.has_memory_budget = 1; ext[n_ext++] = VK_EXT_MEMORY_BUDGET_EXTENSION_NAME; }
    // GPU breadcrumbs for a lost device (vk_crumbs.c): AMD's drivers and RADV report it.
    if (has_ext(ep, ne, VK_AMD_BUFFER_MARKER_EXTENSION_NAME)) { g_vk.has_buffer_marker = 1; ext[n_ext++] = VK_AMD_BUFFER_MARKER_EXTENSION_NAME; }
    // NVIDIA's counterpart, opt-in because every pipeline bind then carries a checkpoint command.
    {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_GPU_CHECKPOINTS");
        if (e && !strcmp(e, "1") && has_ext(ep, ne, VK_NV_DEVICE_DIAGNOSTIC_CHECKPOINTS_EXTENSION_NAME)) {
            g_vk.has_nv_checkpoints = 1;
            ext[n_ext++] = VK_NV_DEVICE_DIAGNOSTIC_CHECKPOINTS_EXTENSION_NAME;
            // Which VAs the driver maps and unmaps, to name the memory a fault address falls in (vk_crumbs.c).
            if (g_vk.debug_utils && has_ext(ep, ne, VK_EXT_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BINDING_REPORT_EXTENSION_NAME)) {
                g_vk.has_address_binding_report = 1;
                ext[n_ext++] = VK_EXT_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BINDING_REPORT_EXTENSION_NAME;
                CHAIN(abr, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BINDING_REPORT_FEATURES_EXT);
            }
            // The driver's compiled code size and ISA per pipeline, to map a faulting shader binary to our stages.
            OPTIONAL_EXT(has_pipeline_exec_info, VK_KHR_PIPELINE_EXECUTABLE_PROPERTIES_EXTENSION_NAME, pei,
                         VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PIPELINE_EXECUTABLE_PROPERTIES_FEATURES_KHR);
        }
    }
    // Graphics pipeline library: chained last so it can be dropped again when vk_caps_gpl declines it.
    void **gpl_link = NULL;
    if (has_ext(ep, ne, VK_KHR_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_EXTENSION_NAME) && has_ext(ep, ne, VK_EXT_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_EXTENSION_NAME)) {
        ext[n_ext++] = VK_KHR_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_EXTENSION_NAME;
        ext[n_ext++] = VK_EXT_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_EXTENSION_NAME;
        gpl_link = tail;
        CHAIN(gpl, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_FEATURES_EXT);
    }
    free(ep);

    // The driver fills the chain with what it supports; the same chain then enables all of it (robustBufferAccess
    // stays on: guest shaders index constant buffers freely and out-of-range reads must stay harmless).
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(g_vk.phys, &c->f2);
    vk_caps_driver(g_vk.phys);
    vk_caps_features(&c->f2.features);
    c->f2.features.robustBufferAccess = VK_TRUE;
    if (g_vk.has_robustness2) {
        c->rob2.robustBufferAccess2 = VK_TRUE;
        c->rob2.nullDescriptor = VK_TRUE;
    }
    if (gpl_link) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceGraphicsPipelineLibraryPropertiesEXT gp = {
            .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_PROPERTIES_EXT};
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &gp};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(g_vk.phys, &p2);
        if (!vk_caps_gpl(&c->gpl, &gp)) { *gpl_link = NULL; n_ext -= 2; }
    }
    const VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures *h = &c->f2.features;
    const char *miss = NULL;
    if (!c->f12.timelineSemaphore) miss = "timelineSemaphore";
    else if (!c->f13.dynamicRendering) miss = "dynamicRendering";
    else if (!c->f13.synchronization2) miss = "synchronization2";
    else if (!h->shaderStorageImageWriteWithoutFormat) miss = "shaderStorageImageWriteWithoutFormat";
    else if (!c->clip.depthClipControl) miss = "depthClipControl";
    else if (!h->shaderInt64) miss = "shaderInt64";
    else if (!h->samplerAnisotropy) miss = "samplerAnisotropy";
    else if (!h->independentBlend) miss = "independentBlend";
    else if (!h->geometryShader) miss = "geometryShader";
    else if (!h->textureCompressionBC) miss = "textureCompressionBC";
    if (miss) { rt_log("vk: required feature missing on %s: %s", g_vk.props.deviceName, miss); free(c); return 0; }
    if (g_vk.has_mesh_shader && (!c->mesh.taskShader || !c->mesh.meshShader)) g_vk.has_mesh_shader = 0;
    // Only the stages we record. Leaving multiview / fragment-shading-rate mesh features on has
    // made NVIDIA lose the device on vkCmdDrawMeshTasksEXT even with (0,0,0) workgroups.
    if (g_vk.has_mesh_shader) {
        c->mesh.multiviewMeshShader = VK_FALSE;
        c->mesh.primitiveFragmentShadingRateMeshShader = VK_FALSE;
        c->mesh.meshShaderQueries = VK_FALSE;
    }
    if (!c->fault.deviceFault) g_vk.has_device_fault = 0;   // vkGetDeviceFaultInfoEXT needs the feature, not just the extension
    if (g_vk.has_list_restart && !c->lrs.primitiveTopologyListRestart) g_vk.has_list_restart = 0;
    rt_log("vk: primitive restart on list draws: %s", g_vk.has_list_restart ? "yes (primitiveTopologyListRestart)"
           : "no: a list draw's restart index is fetched as a vertex");
    if (g_vk.has_address_binding_report && !c->abr.reportAddressBinding) g_vk.has_address_binding_report = 0;
    if (g_vk.has_pipeline_exec_info && !c->pei.pipelineExecutableInfo) g_vk.has_pipeline_exec_info = 0;
    g_vk.has_buffer_device_address = c->f12.bufferDeviceAddress;
    g_vk.has_astc_ldr = h->textureCompressionASTC_LDR;
    {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_FEEDBACK");
        int layout_ok = has_fbl && has_lr && c->fbl.attachmentFeedbackLoopLayout && c->lr.dynamicRenderingLocalRead;
        // Under RADV the feedback layout is not the default: an RX 6600 hung (ring gfx timeout, no page fault) on the
        // first frame that used it; TOTK_FEEDBACK=layout opts back in.
        int layout_wanted = e && !strcmp(e, "layout") ? 1 : !vk_caps.radv;
        g_vk.feedback = e && !strcmp(e, "0") ? VK_FEEDBACK_OFF
                      : layout_ok && layout_wanted && !(e && !strcmp(e, "restart")) ? VK_FEEDBACK_LAYOUT : VK_FEEDBACK_RESTART;
        rt_log("vk: feedback loops: %s (attachmentFeedbackLoopLayout %d, dynamicRenderingLocalRead %d)",
               g_vk.feedback == VK_FEEDBACK_LAYOUT ? "feedback layout + by-region barrier"
               : g_vk.feedback == VK_FEEDBACK_RESTART ? "pass restart + full barrier" : "off (TOTK_FEEDBACK=0)",
               has_fbl && c->fbl.attachmentFeedbackLoopLayout, has_lr && c->lr.dynamicRenderingLocalRead);
    }

    float prio = 1.0f;
    VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qi[2] = {
        {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO, .queueFamilyIndex = g_vk.gfx_family, .queueCount = 1,
         .pQueuePriorities = &prio}};
    uint32_t nqi = 1;
    if (g_vk.xfer_family != g_vk.gfx_family) {
        qi[1] = (VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO,
                                          .queueFamilyIndex = g_vk.xfer_family, .queueCount = 1, .pQueuePriorities = &prio};
        nqi = 2;
    }
    VkDeviceCreateInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO, .pNext = &c->f2, .queueCreateInfoCount = nqi,
                             .pQueueCreateInfos = qi, .enabledExtensionCount = n_ext, .ppEnabledExtensionNames = ext};
    VkResult r = vkCreateDevice(g_vk.phys, &di, NULL, &g_vk.device);
    free(c);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) { rt_log("vk: vkCreateDevice failed (%d)", (int)r); return 0; }
    if (g_vk.has_mesh_shader) {
        g_vk.cmd_draw_mesh_tasks = (PFN_vkCmdDrawMeshTasksEXT)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(g_vk.device, "vkCmdDrawMeshTasksEXT");
        g_vk.cmd_draw_mesh_tasks_indirect =
            (PFN_vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectEXT)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(g_vk.device, "vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectEXT");
        g_vk.cmd_draw_mesh_tasks_indirect_count = (PFN_vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectCountEXT)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(
            g_vk.device, "vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectCountEXT");
        if (!g_vk.cmd_draw_mesh_tasks) g_vk.has_mesh_shader = 0;
    }
    vkGetDeviceQueue(g_vk.device, g_vk.gfx_family, 0, &g_vk.gfx_queue);
    if (g_vk.xfer_family != g_vk.gfx_family) vkGetDeviceQueue(g_vk.device, g_vk.xfer_family, 0, &g_vk.xfer_queue);
    else { g_vk.xfer_queue = g_vk.gfx_queue; g_vk.xfer_shared = 1; }

    VkPhysicalDeviceExternalMemoryHostPropertiesEXT emh = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HOST_PROPERTIES_EXT};
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &emh};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(g_vk.phys, &p2);
    g_vk.min_imported_host_alignment = (uint32_t)emh.minImportedHostPointerAlignment;
    vk_caps_init(&g_vk);

    VmaAllocatorCreateInfo ai = {.physicalDevice = g_vk.phys, .device = g_vk.device, .instance = g_vk.instance,
                                 .vulkanApiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3,
                                 .flags = (g_vk.has_buffer_device_address ? VMA_ALLOCATOR_CREATE_BUFFER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT : 0) |
                                          (g_vk.has_memory_budget ? VMA_ALLOCATOR_CREATE_EXT_MEMORY_BUDGET_BIT : 0),
                                 .pDeviceMemoryCallbacks = vk_headroom_callbacks()};
    if ((r = vmaCreateAllocator(&ai, &g_vk.vma)) != VK_SUCCESS) { rt_log("vk: vmaCreateAllocator failed (%d)", (int)r); return 0; }

    VkSemaphoreTypeCreateInfo st = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_TYPE_CREATE_INFO,
                                    .semaphoreType = VK_SEMAPHORE_TYPE_TIMELINE, .initialValue = 0};
    VkSemaphoreCreateInfo si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO, .pNext = &st};
    if ((r = vkCreateSemaphore(g_vk.device, &si, NULL, &g_vk.timeline)) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        rt_log("vk: timeline semaphore creation failed (%d)", (int)r);
        return 0;
    }
    vk_crumbs_init(&g_vk);
    return 1;
}

static long g_errors_total;     // outlives the device so the probe can print it after vk_shutdown

static void destroy_all(void) {
    gfx_window_release_vk();
    if (g_vk.device) vkDeviceWaitIdle(g_vk.device);
    if (g_vk.device) vk_clear_shutdown(g_vk.device);
    if (g_vk.device) vk_astc_release();
    if (g_vk.device) vk_crumbs_release();
    if (g_vk.timeline) vkDestroySemaphore(g_vk.device, g_vk.timeline, NULL);
    vk_headroom_stop();
    if (g_vk.vma) vmaDestroyAllocator(g_vk.vma);
    if (g_vk.device) vkDestroyDevice(g_vk.device, NULL);
    if (g_vk.messenger) {
        PFN_vkDestroyDebugUtilsMessengerEXT f =
            (PFN_vkDestroyDebugUtilsMessengerEXT)vkGetInstanceProcAddr(g_vk.instance, "vkDestroyDebugUtilsMessengerEXT");
        if (f) f(g_vk.instance, g_vk.messenger, NULL);
    }
    if (g_vk.instance) vkDestroyInstance(g_vk.instance, NULL);
    g_errors_total += g_vk.validation_errors;
    memset(&g_vk, 0, sizeof g_vk);
}

long vk_validation_errors_total(void) { return g_errors_total + (g_ready ? g_vk.validation_errors : 0); }

int vk_init(void) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (!g_ready) {
        memset(&g_vk, 0, sizeof g_vk);
        if (create_instance() && pick_device() && create_device()) { g_ready = 1; vk_headroom_start(); }
        else destroy_all();
    }
    int ok = g_ready;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    return ok;
}

void vk_shutdown(void) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (g_ready) { destroy_all(); g_ready = 0; }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

VkCtx *vk_ctx(void) { return g_ready ? &g_vk : NULL; }

static const char *fault_address_type(VkDeviceFaultAddressTypeEXT t) {
    switch (t) {
    case VK_DEVICE_FAULT_ADDRESS_TYPE_NONE_EXT: return "none";
    case VK_DEVICE_FAULT_ADDRESS_TYPE_READ_INVALID_EXT: return "read invalid";
    case VK_DEVICE_FAULT_ADDRESS_TYPE_WRITE_INVALID_EXT: return "write invalid";
    case VK_DEVICE_FAULT_ADDRESS_TYPE_EXECUTE_INVALID_EXT: return "execute invalid";
    case VK_DEVICE_FAULT_ADDRESS_TYPE_INSTRUCTION_POINTER_UNKNOWN_EXT: return "instruction pointer (unknown)";
    case VK_DEVICE_FAULT_ADDRESS_TYPE_INSTRUCTION_POINTER_INVALID_EXT: return "instruction pointer (invalid)";
    case VK_DEVICE_FAULT_ADDRESS_TYPE_INSTRUCTION_POINTER_FAULT_EXT: return "instruction pointer (fault)";
    default: return "unknown type";
    }
}

// The query runs once per process. Threads that hit the loss at the same time wait on the lock until it is logged, so
// none of them reaches its rt_fatal and ends the process before the report is written.
void vk_device_fault_report(VkResult r) {
    static PlatMutex lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
    static int done;
    if (r != VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST) return;
    plat_mutex_lock(&lock);
    if (done) { plat_mutex_unlock(&lock); return; }
    done = 1;
    vk_crumbs_report();
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (c && c->vma) {   // how full each heap was: a fault under memory pressure reads differently
        VmaBudget b[VK_MAX_MEMORY_HEAPS];
        vmaGetHeapBudgets(c->vma, b);
        VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mp;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(c->phys, &mp);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mp.memoryHeapCount; i++)
            rt_log("vk: device lost: heap %u usage %llu MiB of budget %llu MiB (VMA blocks %llu MiB)", i,
                   (unsigned long long)(b[i].usage >> 20), (unsigned long long)(b[i].budget >> 20),
                   (unsigned long long)(b[i].statistics.blockBytes >> 20));
    }
    PFN_vkGetDeviceFaultInfoEXT get =
        c && c->has_device_fault ? (PFN_vkGetDeviceFaultInfoEXT)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(c->device, "vkGetDeviceFaultInfoEXT")
                                 : NULL;
    if (!get) {
        rt_log("vk: device lost; no fault report (VK_EXT_device_fault %s)", c && c->has_device_fault ? "has no entry point"
                                                                                                    : "not enabled");
        plat_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        return;
    }
    VkDeviceFaultCountsEXT n = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_FAULT_COUNTS_EXT};
    VkResult q = get(c->device, &n, NULL);
    VkDeviceFaultAddressInfoEXT *ai = calloc(n.addressInfoCount + 1, sizeof *ai);
    VkDeviceFaultVendorInfoEXT *vi = calloc(n.vendorInfoCount + 1, sizeof *vi);
    VkDeviceFaultInfoEXT info = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_FAULT_INFO_EXT, .pAddressInfos = ai, .pVendorInfos = vi};
    uint64_t binary = n.vendorBinarySize;
    // The vendor binary is fetched only under MKW_GPU_CHECKPOINTS=1 and within a sane size; otherwise its size alone is
    // logged. Per the spec the first call returns sizes and the second fills the data pointers.
    void *bin = NULL;
    if (vk_checkpoints_on() && binary > 0 && binary <= (64ull << 20)) bin = malloc((size_t)binary);
    n.vendorBinarySize = bin ? binary : 0;
    info.pVendorBinaryData = bin;
    if (q == VK_SUCCESS && ai && vi) q = get(c->device, &n, &info);
    if (bin && (q == VK_SUCCESS || q == VK_INCOMPLETE)) {
        // Best effort: any failure here is a log line only. The dump can hold derived shader code, so it stays in the
        // local logs folder next to mkw.log and is never attached to reports.
        const VkDeviceFaultVendorBinaryHeaderVersionOneEXT *h = bin;
        if (n.vendorBinarySize >= sizeof *h)
            rt_log("vk: device fault binary header: vendor %#x device %#x driver %#x app name offset %u app version %#x "
                   "engine version %#x api version %#x", h->vendorID, h->deviceID, h->driverVersion, h->applicationNameOffset,
                   h->applicationVersion, h->engineVersion, h->apiVersion);
        const char *lp = rt_log_path();
        char path[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 3 + 48];
        const char *cut = lp ? strrchr(lp, '/') : NULL;
        if (cut) {
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%.*s/mkw-fault-%llu.bin", (int)(cut - lp), lp, (unsigned long long)time(NULL));
            if (plat_file_write_atomic(path, bin, (size_t)n.vendorBinarySize))
                rt_log("vk: device fault binary saved: %s (%llu bytes)", path, (unsigned long long)n.vendorBinarySize);
            else rt_log("vk: device fault binary: cannot write %s", path);
        } else rt_log("vk: device fault binary not saved (no log file)");
    }
    free(bin);
    if (q != VK_SUCCESS && q != VK_INCOMPLETE) {
        rt_log("vk: device lost; vkGetDeviceFaultInfoEXT failed (%d)", (int)q);
    } else {
        rt_log("vk: device fault: \"%s\" (%u address infos, %u vendor infos, vendor binary %llu bytes)", info.description,
               n.addressInfoCount, n.vendorInfoCount, (unsigned long long)binary);
        // The faulting access lies in the precision-aligned range around the reported address.
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n.addressInfoCount; i++)
        {
            rt_log("vk: device fault address %u: %s at %#llx, precision %#llx", i, fault_address_type(ai[i].addressType),
                   (unsigned long long)ai[i].reportedAddress, (unsigned long long)ai[i].addressPrecision);
            vk_crumbs_report_address(ai[i].reportedAddress);
        }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n.vendorInfoCount; i++)
            rt_log("vk: device fault vendor info %u: \"%s\" code %#llx data %#llx", i, vi[i].description,
                   (unsigned long long)vi[i].vendorFaultCode, (unsigned long long)vi[i].vendorFaultData);
    }
    free(ai);
    free(vi);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}

int vk_selftest(void) {
    if (!vk_init()) return 1;
    VkCtx *c = &g_vk;
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = 64 << 10,
                             .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo aci = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO, .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_BIT};
    VkBuffer buf;
    VmaAllocation alloc;
    VkResult r = vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &aci, &buf, &alloc, NULL);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) { rt_log("vk selftest: vmaCreateBuffer failed (%d)", (int)r); return 2; }
    vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, buf, alloc);

    VkSemaphoreSignalInfo sig = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_SIGNAL_INFO, .semaphore = c->timeline, .value = 1};
    if ((r = vkSignalSemaphore(c->device, &sig)) != VK_SUCCESS) { rt_log("vk selftest: vkSignalSemaphore failed (%d)", (int)r); return 3; }
    uint64_t value = 1;
    VkSemaphoreWaitInfo wi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_WAIT_INFO, .semaphoreCount = 1, .pSemaphores = &c->timeline,
                              .pValues = &value};
    if ((r = vkWaitSemaphores(c->device, &wi, 1000000000ull)) != VK_SUCCESS) { rt_log("vk selftest: vkWaitSemaphores failed (%d)", (int)r); return 4; }
    uint64_t now = 0;
    vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue(c->device, c->timeline, &now);
    if (now != 1) { rt_log("vk selftest: timeline value %llu, expected 1", (unsigned long long)now); return 5; }
    return 0;
}

// --probe-vkdevice (host.h)
int probe_vkdevice(void) {
    int rc = vk_selftest();
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (rc || !c) { printf("probe-vkdevice: FAILED (selftest %d)\n", rc ? rc : 1); vk_shutdown(); return 1; }
    uint32_t v = c->props.apiVersion;
    printf("probe-vkdevice: device %d \"%s\" api %u.%u.%u, gfx queue family %u, transfer family %u%s, host import alignment %#x\n",
           c->device_index, c->props.deviceName, VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(v), VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(v), VK_API_VERSION_PATCH(v),
           c->gfx_family, c->xfer_family, c->xfer_shared ? " (shared queue)" : "", c->min_imported_host_alignment);
    printf("probe-vkdevice: optional: custom_border=%d eds=%d eds2=%d eds3=%d vertex_input=%d cond_render=%d xfb=%d provoking=%d "
           "robustness2=%d fault=%d budget=%d bda=%d interlock=%d validation=%d\n",
           c->has_custom_border_color, c->has_eds, c->has_eds2, c->has_eds3, c->has_vertex_input_dynamic_state,
           c->has_conditional_rendering, c->has_transform_feedback, c->has_provoking_vertex, c->has_robustness2,
           c->has_device_fault, c->has_memory_budget, c->has_buffer_device_address, c->has_fragment_shader_interlock,
           c->validation);
    vk_shutdown();
    printf("probe-vkdevice: %s (validation errors %ld)\n", g_errors_total ? "FAILED" : "passed", g_errors_total);
    return g_errors_total ? 1 : 0;
}
int vk_gpu_is_nvidia(void) { return g_ready && g_vk.gpu_is_nvidia; }
int vk_gpu_is_rtx40_plus(void) { return g_ready && g_vk.gpu_is_rtx40_plus; }
int vk_gpu_is_rtx50(void) { return g_ready && g_vk.gpu_is_rtx50; }
int vk_gpu_is_rx9000(void) { return g_ready && g_vk.gpu_is_rx9000; }
int vk_gpu_is_intel(void) { return g_ready && g_vk.gpu_is_intel; }
int vk_gpu_is_intel_arc(void) { return g_ready && g_vk.gpu_is_intel_arc; }

```

`runtime/vk_dump.c`:

```c
// TOTK_DUMP=<frame>: a frame dump for the Vulkan back end, which RenderDoc cannot capture (it hides
// VK_EXT_external_memory_host). Between presents frame-1 and frame, the replay's command buffers also copy, after each
// render pass, its colour and depth targets and, after each dispatch, the storage images it writes into host buffers;
// the completion thread turns them into 8-bit PNGs once the submission is done. 3D textures (LUTs, volumes) sampled or
// written in the frame are copied once each, slices side by side. Files in TOTK_DUMP_DIR (default "dump"):
//   pass_<seq>_t<i>_<w>x<h>_<vkformat>_<name>.png   colour target i (td: depth; img<slot>: storage image; lut<id>: 3D;
//                                                    a BC target drawn through a block view: its blocks as that view)
//   ..._tm.png                                       float formats: x/(1+x) of the same image (the plain one clamps)
//   ..._nan.png                                      an image with NaN texels: those in magenta over the _tm image
//                                                    at a third of its brightness
//   passes.txt   per pass or dispatch: targets, draws, each distinct pipeline + texture set with its shaders' SPIR-V
//                hashes (sh_<hash>.spv written once) and the bound textures with their samplers
//   images.txt   per image: channel min/max, distinct texel values over the image and over its top quarter
// Sampled 8-bit 2D textures up to TEX2D_CAP texels are copied once each as pass_<seq>_tex<id>_... at the end of the pass
// that samples them; texture lines carry the storage address, mirror state, upload count and the image's and slot's
// swizzle. Copies and texture clears are logged as "copy/clear after pass N". TOTK_DUMP_LOG=<from> also logs the
// frames from..frame-1 to passes.txt, with PNGs only of targets up to 64K texels. TOTK_DUMP_BUF=<addr>:<size>[:...]
// snapshots one GPU buffer range after every logged pass (buf_<pass>.bin and bufs.txt, see buf_snap).
// PNGs are opaque (alpha dropped). Integer formats are scaled by the image maximum, depth by its min..max range, SNORM
// as x/2+1/2, UNORM and sRGB bytes written as stored. Caps: MAX_PASSES passes copied, PNG_CAP bytes of PNGs.
// TOTK_DUMP_TEX=<id>|<w>x<h>[,...]: those texture slots, or 2D textures of that size, are copied where first sampled,
// whatever their format.
// TOTK_DUMP_UBO=1: each listed pipeline also prints the first 16 vec4 of its user uniform blocks (c3 and up), read from
// guest memory when the entry is listed. A block the submission rewrites with UpdateUniformBuffer shows its value from
// before the submission (vk_exec_draw.c upd_note).
// TOTK_DUMP_SKIP_RUNS=1: a render pass with the same targets as the render pass before it is logged but not copied
// (the terrain decals draw one pass each into the G-buffer and would use up both caps).
#include <math.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "vk_exec.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define MAX_PASSES 400
#define PNG_CAP (2ull << 30)
#define INFLIGHT_CAP (3ull << 30)   // host buffers waiting for their submission
#define MAX_ENTS 48                 // distinct pipeline + texture sets listed per pass
#define MAX_LUTS 256                // 3D textures and small sampled 8-bit 2D textures dumped per frame
#define TEX2D_CAP (1u << 20)        // texels of a sampled 2D texture that is dumped

int vk_dump_armed;
static uint64_t dump_frame, log_from;   // log_from: TOTK_DUMP_LOG, first frame logged to passes.txt without images
static char dir[400];
static FILE *passes_f, *images_f;
static int seq, finished, copied;      // copied: passes and dispatches of the dump frame whose images were copied
static int skip_runs, dump_ubo;        // TOTK_DUMP_SKIP_RUNS, TOTK_DUMP_UBO
static uint32_t want_tex[16][2];       // TOTK_DUMP_TEX: slot id and 0, or width and height
static int nwant_tex;
static uint64_t last_targets;          // targets_sig of the last render pass; 0 after a dispatch
static const char *pass_skip;          // why the current pass copies nothing, or NULL
static volatile int64_t png_bytes, inflight;
static PlatMutex rec_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT, img_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;

// ---- formats

enum { K_UNORM, K_SNORM, K_UINT, K_SINT, K_FLOAT, K_RGB10A2, K_BGR10A2, K_RG11B10, K_E5, K_R5G6B5, K_D16, K_D24, K_D32F };
enum { M_UNORM, M_SNORM, M_INT, M_FLOAT, M_DEPTH };
typedef struct { VkFormat vk; const char *name; uint8_t bytes, nc, bits, kind, bgr; } Fmt;

#define F(v, n, by, nc, bi, k) {VK_FORMAT_##v, n, by, nc, bi, k, 0}
static const Fmt fmts[] = {
    F(R8_UNORM, "r8", 1, 1, 8, K_UNORM), F(R8_SNORM, "r8sn", 1, 1, 8, K_SNORM), F(R8_UINT, "r8ui", 1, 1, 8, K_UINT),
    F(R8_SINT, "r8i", 1, 1, 8, K_SINT), F(R8_SRGB, "r8srgb", 1, 1, 8, K_UNORM),
    F(R8G8_UNORM, "rg8", 2, 2, 8, K_UNORM), F(R8G8_SNORM, "rg8sn", 2, 2, 8, K_SNORM),
    F(R8G8_UINT, "rg8ui", 2, 2, 8, K_UINT), F(R8G8_SINT, "rg8i", 2, 2, 8, K_SINT),
    F(R8G8B8A8_UNORM, "rgba8", 4, 4, 8, K_UNORM), F(R8G8B8A8_SNORM, "rgba8sn", 4, 4, 8, K_SNORM),
    F(R8G8B8A8_UINT, "rgba8ui", 4, 4, 8, K_UINT), F(R8G8B8A8_SINT, "rgba8i", 4, 4, 8, K_SINT),
    F(R8G8B8A8_SRGB, "rgba8srgb", 4, 4, 8, K_UNORM),
    {VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, "bgra8", 4, 4, 8, K_UNORM, 1}, {VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB, "bgra8srgb", 4, 4, 8, K_UNORM, 1},
    F(A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32, "rgb10a2", 4, 4, 10, K_RGB10A2), F(A2R10G10B10_UNORM_PACK32, "bgr10a2", 4, 4, 10, K_BGR10A2),
    F(R5G6B5_UNORM_PACK16, "r5g6b5", 2, 3, 5, K_R5G6B5),
    F(R16_UNORM, "r16", 2, 1, 16, K_UNORM), F(R16_SNORM, "r16sn", 2, 1, 16, K_SNORM), F(R16_UINT, "r16ui", 2, 1, 16, K_UINT),
    F(R16_SINT, "r16i", 2, 1, 16, K_SINT), F(R16_SFLOAT, "r16f", 2, 1, 16, K_FLOAT),
    F(R16G16_UNORM, "rg16", 4, 2, 16, K_UNORM), F(R16G16_SNORM, "rg16sn", 4, 2, 16, K_SNORM),
    F(R16G16_UINT, "rg16ui", 4, 2, 16, K_UINT), F(R16G16_SINT, "rg16i", 4, 2, 16, K_SINT),
    F(R16G16_SFLOAT, "rg16f", 4, 2, 16, K_FLOAT),
    F(R16G16B16A16_UNORM, "rgba16", 8, 4, 16, K_UNORM), F(R16G16B16A16_SNORM, "rgba16sn", 8, 4, 16, K_SNORM),
    F(R16G16B16A16_UINT, "rgba16ui", 8, 4, 16, K_UINT), F(R16G16B16A16_SINT, "rgba16i", 8, 4, 16, K_SINT),
    F(R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT, "rgba16f", 8, 4, 16, K_FLOAT),
    F(R32_UINT, "r32ui", 4, 1, 32, K_UINT), F(R32_SINT, "r32i", 4, 1, 32, K_SINT), F(R32_SFLOAT, "r32f", 4, 1, 32, K_FLOAT),
    F(R32G32_UINT, "rg32ui", 8, 2, 32, K_UINT), F(R32G32_SINT, "rg32i", 8, 2, 32, K_SINT),
    F(R32G32_SFLOAT, "rg32f", 8, 2, 32, K_FLOAT),
    F(R32G32B32A32_UINT, "rgba32ui", 16, 4, 32, K_UINT), F(R32G32B32A32_SINT, "rgba32i", 16, 4, 32, K_SINT),
    F(R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT, "rgba32f", 16, 4, 32, K_FLOAT),
    F(B10G11R11_UFLOAT_PACK32, "r11g11b10f", 4, 3, 11, K_RG11B10), F(E5B9G9R9_UFLOAT_PACK32, "rgb9e5", 4, 3, 9, K_E5),
    // depth aspect of depth formats, as vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer writes it
    F(D16_UNORM, "d16", 2, 1, 16, K_D16), F(D16_UNORM_S8_UINT, "d16s8", 2, 1, 16, K_D16),
    F(X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32, "d24", 4, 1, 24, K_D24), F(D24_UNORM_S8_UINT, "d24s8", 4, 1, 24, K_D24),
    F(D32_SFLOAT, "d32f", 4, 1, 32, K_D32F), F(D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT, "d32fs8", 4, 1, 32, K_D32F),
};
#undef F

static const Fmt *fmt_of(VkFormat f) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof fmts / sizeof fmts[0]; i++)
        if (fmts[i].vk == f) return &fmts[i];
    return NULL;
}

static const char *fmt_name(VkFormat f, char tmp[16]) {
    const Fmt *d = fmt_of(f);
    if (d) return d->name;
    snprintf(tmp, 16, "vk%d", (int)f);
    return tmp;
}

static int mode_of(const Fmt *f) {
    switch (f->kind) {
    case K_SNORM: return M_SNORM;
    case K_UINT: case K_SINT: return M_INT;
    case K_FLOAT: case K_RG11B10: case K_E5: return M_FLOAT;
    case K_D16: case K_D24: case K_D32F: return M_DEPTH;
    default: return M_UNORM;
    }
}

// Unsigned small float with a 5-bit exponent and mbits of mantissa (half: 10, R11G11B10: 6 and 5).
static float ufloat(uint32_t v, int mbits) {
    uint32_t e = v >> mbits, m = v & ((1u << mbits) - 1);
    if (e == 0) return ldexpf((float)m, -14 - mbits);
    if (e == 31) return m ? NAN : INFINITY;
    return ldexpf((float)(m | 1u << mbits), (int)e - 15 - mbits);
}

static int32_t sext(uint32_t v, int bits) { return bits >= 32 ? (int32_t)v : (int32_t)(v << (32 - bits)) >> (32 - bits); }

static void decode(const Fmt *f, const uint8_t *p, float o[4]) {
    uint32_t u = 0;
    o[0] = o[1] = o[2] = 0, o[3] = 1;
    switch (f->kind) {
    case K_RGB10A2: case K_BGR10A2:
        memcpy(&u, p, 4);
        o[0] = (u & 1023) / 1023.f, o[1] = (u >> 10 & 1023) / 1023.f, o[2] = (u >> 20 & 1023) / 1023.f, o[3] = (u >> 30) / 3.f;
        if (f->kind == K_BGR10A2) { float t = o[0]; o[0] = o[2], o[2] = t; }
        return;
    case K_RG11B10:
        memcpy(&u, p, 4);
        o[0] = ufloat(u & 2047, 6), o[1] = ufloat(u >> 11 & 2047, 6), o[2] = ufloat(u >> 22 & 1023, 5);
        return;
    case K_E5: {
        memcpy(&u, p, 4);
        float s = ldexpf(1.f, (int)(u >> 27) - 24);
        o[0] = (u & 511) * s, o[1] = (u >> 9 & 511) * s, o[2] = (u >> 18 & 511) * s;
        return;
    }
    case K_R5G6B5:
        memcpy(&u, p, 2);
        o[0] = (u >> 11 & 31) / 31.f, o[1] = (u >> 5 & 63) / 63.f, o[2] = (u & 31) / 31.f;
        return;
    case K_D16: memcpy(&u, p, 2); o[0] = u / 65535.f; return;
    case K_D24: memcpy(&u, p, 4); o[0] = (u & 0xffffff) / 16777215.f; return;
    case K_D32F: memcpy(&o[0], p, 4); return;
    }
    int cb = f->bits / 8;
    for (int c = 0; c < f->nc; c++) {
        u = 0;
        memcpy(&u, p + c * cb, (size_t)cb);
        float x;
        switch (f->kind) {
        case K_UNORM: x = (float)u / (float)((1ull << f->bits) - 1); break;
        case K_SNORM: x = fmaxf((float)sext(u, f->bits) / (float)((1u << (f->bits - 1)) - 1), -1.f); break;
        case K_UINT: x = (float)u; break;
        case K_SINT: x = (float)sext(u, f->bits); break;
        default:
            if (f->bits == 16) x = (u & 0x8000 ? -1.f : 1.f) * ufloat(u & 0x7fff, 10);
            else memcpy(&x, &u, 4);
        }
        o[c] = x;
    }
    if (f->bgr) { float t = o[0]; o[0] = o[2], o[2] = t; }
}

// ---- conversion on the completion thread

typedef struct {
    VkBuffer buf;
    VmaAllocation alloc;
    const uint8_t *map;
    uint64_t bytes;
    const Fmt *f;
    uint32_t w, h, d;   // d: 3D slices, laid side by side in the PNG
    char name[160];
} Job;

// Distinct raw texel values among rows [y0, y1) of every slice.
static uint64_t distinct(const Job *j, uint32_t y0, uint32_t y1) {
    uint64_t n = (uint64_t)j->w * (y1 - y0) * j->d, cap = 1024;
    while (cap < 2 * n) cap *= 2;
    uint64_t *set = calloc(cap, sizeof *set), count = 0;
    if (!set) return 0;
    for (uint32_t z = 0; z < j->d; z++)
        for (uint32_t y = y0; y < y1; y++)
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < j->w; x++) {
                const uint8_t *p = j->map + (((uint64_t)z * j->h + y) * j->w + x) * j->f->bytes;
                uint64_t a = 0, b = 0;
                memcpy(&a, p, j->f->bytes < 8 ? j->f->bytes : 8);
                if (j->f->bytes > 8) memcpy(&b, p + 8, j->f->bytes - 8u);
                uint64_t k = (a ^ (b * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull)) + 1;
                if (!k) k = 1;
                uint64_t i = (k * 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull) >> 17;
                for (;; i++) {
                    uint64_t *s = &set[i & (cap - 1)];
                    if (*s == k) break;
                    if (!*s) { *s = k, count++; break; }
                }
            }
    free(set);
    return count;
}

static uint8_t u8(float x) { return x > 0 ? x < 1 ? (uint8_t)(x * 255.f + .5f) : 255 : 0; }

static void write_images(const Job *j) {
    uint32_t pw = j->w * j->d, ph = j->h;
    uint64_t n = (uint64_t)pw * ph;
    float *px = malloc(n * 16);
    uint8_t *out = malloc(n * 4), *nanm = calloc(n, 1);
    if (!px || !out || !nanm) rt_fatal("vk_dump: out of memory for %s", j->name);
    float mn[4] = {INFINITY, INFINITY, INFINITY, INFINITY}, mx[4] = {-INFINITY, -INFINITY, -INFINITY, -INFINITY};
    uint64_t nans = 0;
    for (uint32_t z = 0; z < j->d; z++)
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < j->h; y++)
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < j->w; x++) {
                float *o = px + 4 * ((uint64_t)y * pw + (uint64_t)z * j->w + x);
                decode(j->f, j->map + (((uint64_t)z * j->h + y) * j->w + x) * j->f->bytes, o);
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                    if (isnan(o[c])) { nans++, o[c] = 0, nanm[(uint64_t)y * pw + (uint64_t)z * j->w + x] = 1; continue; }
                    if (o[c] < mn[c]) mn[c] = o[c];
                    if (o[c] > mx[c]) mx[c] = o[c];
                }
            }
    int mode = mode_of(j->f), grey = j->f->nc == 1;
    float scale = 1, lo = mn[0], range = mx[0] - mn[0];
    if (mode == M_INT) {
        float m = 1;
        for (int c = 0; c < j->f->nc && c < 3; c++) m = fmaxf(m, fmaxf(fabsf(mx[c]), fabsf(mn[c])));
        scale = 1.f / m;
    }
    for (int pass = 0; pass < (mode == M_FLOAT ? 2 : 1); pass++) {
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const float *o = px + 4 * i;
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
                float x = o[grey ? 0 : c];
                if (mode == M_SNORM) x = x * .5f + .5f;
                else if (mode == M_INT) x *= scale;
                else if (mode == M_DEPTH) x = range > 0 ? (x - lo) / range : 0;
                else if (mode == M_FLOAT && pass) x = x > 0 ? x / (1 + x) : 0;
                out[4 * i + c] = u8(x);
            }
            out[4 * i + 3] = 255;
        }
        char path[600];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s%s.png", dir, j->name, pass ? "_tm" : "");
        rt_write_png(path, out, pw, ph);
    }
    if (nans) {   // out holds the last image written: _tm for float formats
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) out[4 * i + c] = nanm[i] ? (c == 1 ? 0 : 255) : (uint8_t)(out[4 * i + c] / 3);
        char path[600];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s_nan.png", dir, j->name);
        rt_write_png(path, out, pw, ph);
    }
    free(nanm);
    uint64_t all = distinct(j, 0, j->h), top = distinct(j, 0, j->h / 4 ? j->h / 4 : 1);
    plat_mutex_lock(&img_lock);
    if (images_f) {
        fprintf(images_f, "%s %ux%ux%u min %g %g %g %g max %g %g %g %g distinct %llu top-quarter %llu nan %llu\n", j->name,
                j->w, j->h, j->d, mn[0], mn[1], mn[2], mn[3], mx[0], mx[1], mx[2], mx[3], (unsigned long long)all,
                (unsigned long long)top, (unsigned long long)nans);
        fflush(images_f);
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&img_lock);
    free(out);
    free(px);
}

static void job_done(void *arg) {
    Job *j = arg;
    VmaAllocator vma = vk_ctx()->vma;
    vmaInvalidateAllocation(vma, j->alloc, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    write_images(j);
    vmaDestroyBuffer(vma, j->buf, j->alloc);
    plat_add64(&inflight, -(int64_t)j->bytes);
    free(j);
}

// ---- recording

// Records the copy of one subresource into a host buffer and queues its PNGs. Returns NULL, or why it was skipped.
// The buffer is w x h x d texels of vf; the image region is `ext` image texels at depth plane z (differs for the
// blocks of a BC image read as an uncompressed format of the block size, and for a 3D slice).
static const char *copy_region(VkExec *ex, VkImage image, VkFormat vf, VkImageAspectFlags aspect, uint32_t level,
                               uint32_t layer, uint32_t z, VkExtent3D ext, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t d,
                               const char *name) {
    const Fmt *f = fmt_of(vf);
    if (!f) return "format not decoded";
    if (__atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) + 1 != dump_frame && (uint64_t)w * h * d > 65536)
        return "logged frame, large image";
    if (aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT) aspect = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT;
    else if (aspect != VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT) return "stencil only";
    uint64_t bytes = (uint64_t)w * h * d * f->bytes;
    uint64_t est = ((uint64_t)h * (1 + 4ull * w * d) + 128) * (mode_of(f) == M_FLOAT ? 2 : 1);
    if ((uint64_t)png_bytes + est > PNG_CAP) return "PNG cap reached";
    if ((uint64_t)inflight + bytes > INFLIGHT_CAP) return "too many copies in flight";
    Job *j = calloc(1, sizeof *j);
    if (!j) rt_fatal("vk_dump: out of memory");
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = bytes,
                             .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO,
                                  .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT};
    VmaAllocationInfo info;
    if (vmaCreateBuffer(vk_ctx()->vma, &bi, &ai, &j->buf, &j->alloc, &info) != VK_SUCCESS || !info.pMappedData) {
        free(j);
        return "host buffer allocation failed";
    }
    j->map = info.pMappedData, j->bytes = bytes, j->f = f, j->w = w, j->h = h, j->d = d;
    snprintf(j->name, sizeof j->name, "%s", name);
    VkMemoryBarrier2 pre = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2,
                            .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                            .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                            .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT,
                            .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT};
    VkMemoryBarrier2 post = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2,
                             .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT,
                             .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT,
                             .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT,
                             .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &pre};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(ex->cb, &di);
    VkBufferImageCopy r = {.imageSubresource = {aspect, level, layer, 1}, .imageOffset = {0, 0, (int32_t)z},
                           .imageExtent = ext};   // packed rows: a BC row of ext.width texels is w blocks
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(ex->cb, image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, j->buf, 1, &r);
    di.pMemoryBarriers = &post;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(ex->cb, &di);
    ex->recorded += 3;
    plat_add64(&png_bytes, (int64_t)est);
    plat_add64(&inflight, (int64_t)bytes);
    vk_completion_add(ex->fence, job_done, j);
    return NULL;
}

static const char *copy_out(VkExec *ex, VkImage image, VkFormat vf, VkImageAspectFlags aspect, uint32_t level,
                            uint32_t layer, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t d, const char *name) {
    return copy_region(ex, image, vf, aspect, level, layer, 0, (VkExtent3D){w, h, d}, w, h, d, name);
}

// ---- TOTK_DUMP_BUF=<addr>:<size>[:<off>:<stride>:<w>:<h>]: after every pass and dispatch that is logged, the GPU
// buffer range is copied to a host buffer; when it differs from the previous copy it goes to buf_<pass>.bin, and
// bufs.txt gets the changed bytes' extent plus, with the grid arguments, one map per dword of the w x h records of
// `stride` bytes at `off` (each record a letter: its value's index in the table under the map).

static uint64_t bd_addr, bd_size, bd_off, bd_stride;
static uint32_t bd_w, bd_h;
static uint8_t *bd_prev;
static FILE *bufs_f;

typedef struct { VkBuffer buf; VmaAllocation alloc; const uint8_t *map; int pass; } BufJob;

static void buf_grid(const uint8_t *m) {
    for (uint32_t dw = 0; dw < bd_stride / 4; dw++) {
        uint32_t vals[52];
        int nv = 0, over = 0;
        fprintf(bufs_f, "  dword %u:\n", dw);
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < bd_h; y++) {
            char line[260];
            uint32_t x;
            for (x = 0; x < bd_w && x < 256; x++) {
                uint64_t o = bd_off + ((uint64_t)y * bd_w + x) * bd_stride + dw * 4;
                if (o + 4 > bd_size) { line[x] = ' '; continue; }
                uint32_t v;
                memcpy(&v, m + o, 4);
                int k = 0;
                while (k < nv && vals[k] != v) k++;
                if (k == nv) {
                    if (nv < 52) vals[nv++] = v;
                    else { over = 1; line[x] = '?'; continue; }
                }
                line[x] = (char)(k < 26 ? 'a' + k : 'A' + k - 26);
            }
            line[x] = 0;
            fprintf(bufs_f, "    %2u %s\n", y, line);
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < nv; k++) fprintf(bufs_f, "%s%c=%08x", k % 8 ? " " : "    ", k < 26 ? 'a' + k : 'A' + k - 26, vals[k]);
        fprintf(bufs_f, "%s\n", over ? " (more: ?)" : "");
    }
}

static void buf_done(void *arg) {
    BufJob *j = arg;
    vmaInvalidateAllocation(vk_ctx()->vma, j->alloc, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE);
    plat_mutex_lock(&img_lock);
    if (bufs_f) {
        uint64_t lo = bd_size, hi = 0;
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < bd_size; i++)
            if (!bd_prev || j->map[i] != bd_prev[i]) { if (i < lo) lo = i; hi = i + 1; }
        if (hi) {
            char path[600];
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/buf_%04d.bin", dir, j->pass);
            FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
            if (f) fwrite(j->map, 1, bd_size, f), fclose(f);
            fprintf(bufs_f, "after pass %04d: bytes %#llx..%#llx changed\n", j->pass, (unsigned long long)lo,
                    (unsigned long long)hi);
            if (bd_stride) buf_grid(j->map);
            fflush(bufs_f);
            if (!bd_prev) bd_prev = malloc(bd_size);
            if (bd_prev) memcpy(bd_prev, j->map, bd_size);
        }
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&img_lock);
    vmaDestroyBuffer(vk_ctx()->vma, j->buf, j->alloc);
    free(j);
}

static void buf_snap(VkExec *ex, int pass) {
    if (!bd_size) return;
    VkMemSpan s;
    if (!vk_mem_resolve(bd_addr, bd_size, &s) || s.avail < bd_size) return;
    VK_MEM_PICK(s);   // the GPU's view of the buffer
    BufJob *j = calloc(1, sizeof *j);
    if (!j) rt_fatal("vk_dump: out of memory");
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = bd_size,
                             .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO,
                                  .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT};
    VmaAllocationInfo info;
    if (vmaCreateBuffer(vk_ctx()->vma, &bi, &ai, &j->buf, &j->alloc, &info) != VK_SUCCESS || !info.pMappedData) {
        free(j);
        return;
    }
    j->map = info.pMappedData, j->pass = pass;
    VkMemoryBarrier2 mb[2] = {
        {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
         .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT, .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT,
         .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT},
        {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT,
         .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT,
         .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
         .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT}};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &mb[0]};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(ex->cb, &di);
    VkBufferCopy c = {s.offset, 0, bd_size};
    vkCmdCopyBuffer(ex->cb, s.buffer, j->buf, 1, &c);
    di.pMemoryBarriers = &mb[1];
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(ex->cb, &di);
    ex->recorded += 3;
    vk_completion_add(ex->fence, buf_done, j);
}

static int active(void) {
    uint64_t f = __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) + 1;
    return !finished && (f == dump_frame || (log_from && f >= log_from && f < dump_frame));
}
static uint64_t frame_now(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) + 1; }

typedef struct { char *s; size_t n, cap; } Str;

__attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3))) static void sp(Str *b, const char *fmt, ...) {
    va_list a;
    va_start(a, fmt);
    int k = vsnprintf(NULL, 0, fmt, a);
    va_end(a);
    if (k < 0) return;
    if (b->n + (size_t)k + 1 > b->cap) {
        b->cap = (b->n + (size_t)k + 1) * 2;
        b->s = realloc(b->s, b->cap);
        if (!b->s) rt_fatal("vk_dump: out of memory");
    }
    va_start(a, fmt);
    vsnprintf(b->s + b->n, (size_t)k + 1, fmt, a);
    va_end(a);
    b->n += (size_t)k;
}

// SPIR-V hash of a shader; the first time, its SPIR-V goes to sh_<hash>.spv.
static uint64_t shader_hash(const GfxShader *s) {
    static struct { const GfxShader *s; uint64_t h; } tab[1024];
    static int n;
    if (!s) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (tab[i].s == s) return tab[i].h;
    uint64_t words = 0, h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
    const uint32_t *w = gfx_shader_spirv(s, &words);
    const uint8_t *b = (const uint8_t *)w;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < words * 4; i++) h = (h ^ b[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
    char path[600];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/sh_%016llx.spv", dir, (unsigned long long)h);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (f) fwrite(w, 4, (size_t)words, f), fclose(f);
    if (n < 1024) tab[n].s = s, tab[n].h = h, n++;
    return h;
}

// Per pass: distinct pipeline + texture sets, draws, 3D textures to copy at its end.
typedef struct { VkPipeline p; uint64_t th; int draws; char *text; } Ent;
static Ent ents[MAX_ENTS];
static int nents, ents_over, pass_draws;
typedef struct { VkImage image; VkFormat format; uint32_t w, h, d; int id, is2d; uint32_t layers, levels; } Lut;
static int dump_layers_level = -1;   // TOTK_DUMP_LAYERS=<host level>: every layer of sampled 2D arrays at that level
static Lut luts[MAX_LUTS];          // queued for the next pass end or dispatch
static int nluts;
static VkImage luts_done[MAX_LUTS];
static int nluts_done;

static void queue_lut(const VkTexImage *t, int id) {
    if (frame_now() != dump_frame) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < nluts_done; i++)
        if (luts_done[i] == t->image) return;
    if (nluts_done == MAX_LUTS) return;
    luts_done[nluts_done++] = t->image;
    luts[nluts++] = (Lut){t->image, t->format, t->width, t->height, t->type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D ? t->depth : 1, id,
                          t->type != VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D, t->layers, t->levels};
}

// The uncompressed format of a BC format's block size, UNDEFINED for other formats: a BC texture is dumped as its raw
// blocks (one texel per block), which shows at least whether it was ever written.
static VkFormat block_format(VkFormat f) {
    if (f == VK_FORMAT_BC4_UNORM_BLOCK || f == VK_FORMAT_BC4_SNORM_BLOCK ||
        (f >= VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGB_UNORM_BLOCK && f <= VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGBA_SRGB_BLOCK))
        return VK_FORMAT_R32G32_UINT;
    if (f >= VK_FORMAT_BC2_UNORM_BLOCK && f <= VK_FORMAT_BC7_SRGB_BLOCK) return VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_UINT;
    return VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
}

static void flush_luts(VkExec *ex, int n) {
    char fn[16];
    for (int i = 0; i < nluts; i++) {
        const Lut *l = &luts[i];
        char name[160];
        if (l->is2d && l->layers > 1 && dump_layers_level >= 0 && (uint32_t)dump_layers_level < l->levels) {
            uint32_t lv = (uint32_t)dump_layers_level, w = l->w >> lv ? l->w >> lv : 1, h = l->h >> lv ? l->h >> lv : 1;
            for (uint32_t ly = 0; ly < l->layers && ly < 128; ly++) {
                snprintf(name, sizeof name, "arr_tex%d_lv%u_ly%02u_%ux%u_%d", l->id, lv, ly, w, h, (int)l->format);
                const char *why = copy_out(ex, l->image, l->format, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, lv, ly, w, h, 1, name);
                fprintf(passes_f, "  array tex %d level %u layer %u -> %s.png%s%s\n", l->id, lv, ly, name,
                        why ? " skipped: " : "", why ? why : "");
            }
            continue;
        }
        VkFormat bf = block_format(l->format);
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "pass_%04d_%s%d_%ux%ux%u_%d_%s%s", n, l->is2d ? "tex" : "lut", l->id, l->w, l->h, l->d,
                 (int)l->format, fmt_name(l->format, fn), bf ? "_blocks" : "");
        const char *why = bf ? copy_region(ex, l->image, bf, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 0,
                                           (VkExtent3D){l->w, l->h, l->d}, (l->w + 3) / 4, (l->h + 3) / 4, l->d, name)
                             : copy_out(ex, l->image, l->format, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, l->w, l->h, l->d, name);
        fprintf(passes_f, "  %s tex %d -> %s.png%s%s\n", l->is2d ? "2D" : "3D", l->id, name, why ? " skipped: " : "",
                why ? why : "");
    }
    nluts = 0;
}

static int nvn_stage(int gfx_stage) { return gfx_stage == GFX_STAGE_VS ? 0 : gfx_stage == GFX_STAGE_FS ? 1 : 5; }

static const char *decl_type(uint16_t t, char tmp[24]) {
    static const char *base[] = {"?", "1D", "buffer", "2D", "3D", "cube"};
    snprintf(tmp, 24, "%s%s%s%s", base[(t & 0xff) < 6 ? t & 0xff : 0], t & 0x100 ? "Array" : "", t & 0x200 ? "MS" : "",
             t & 0x400 ? "Shadow" : "");
    return tmp;
}

static const char *wrap_name(int w) {
    static const char *n[] = {"clamp", "repeat", "mirror_clamp", "mirror_clamp_edge", "mirror_clamp_border",
                              "clamp_border", "mirrored_repeat", "clamp_edge"};
    return w >= 0 && w < 8 ? n[w] : "?";
}

static uint64_t handle_of(const VkExec *ex, int st, int slot, int img) {
    if (img) return slot >= 0 && slot < 32 ? ex->img[st][slot] : 0;
    return slot >= 0 && slot < 128 ? ex->tex[st][slot] : 0;
}

// The textures, images and samplers of info's bindings; 3D textures are queued for a copy.
static void describe_bindings(Str *b, const VkExec *ex, const VkPipeInfo *info) {
    static const char *stn[6] = {"vs", "fs", "?", "?", "?", "cs"};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < info->n_bindings; i++) {
        const VkPipeBinding *bd = &info->bindings[i];
        const GfxShaderRes *r = bd->res;
        if (r && bd->kind == GFX_RES_SSBO) {   // where the address lives (c0: the stage's NVN slot table) and the stage's slots
            int st = nvn_stage(bd->stage);
            sp(b, "    %s ssbo at c%d+%#x%s, bound:", stn[st], r->cbuf_slot, r->handle * 4, r->flags & 1 ? " written" : "");
            for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++)
                if (ex->ssbo[st][k].addr)
                    sp(b, " %d=%#llx+%#llx", k, (unsigned long long)ex->ssbo[st][k].addr, (unsigned long long)ex->ssbo[st][k].size);
            sp(b, "\n");
            continue;
        }
        if (r && bd->kind == GFX_RES_UBO && dump_ubo && r->slot >= 3 && r->slot - 3 < 18) {
            int st = nvn_stage(bd->stage);
            const p_bind_buf *u = &ex->ubo[st][r->slot - 3];
            VkMemSpan ms;
            sp(b, "    %s ubo c%d addr %#llx size %#llx", stn[st], r->slot, (unsigned long long)u->addr, (unsigned long long)u->size);
            if (u->addr && vk_mem_resolve(u->addr, 1, &ms)) {
                uint64_t n = u->size && u->size < ms.avail ? u->size : ms.avail;
                const float *f = (const float *)(uintptr_t)u->addr;
                for (uint64_t k = 0; k < 16 && (k + 1) * 16 <= n; k++)
                    sp(b, "%s[%llu] %g %g %g %g", k % 4 ? " " : "\n      ", (unsigned long long)k, f[4 * k], f[4 * k + 1],
                       f[4 * k + 2], f[4 * k + 3]);
            } else {
                sp(b, " (not mapped)");
            }
            sp(b, "\n");
            continue;
        }
        if (!r || (bd->kind != GFX_RES_TEX && bd->kind != GFX_RES_IMG)) continue;
        int st = nvn_stage(bd->stage), img = bd->kind == GFX_RES_IMG;
        char dt[24], fn[16];
        if (bd->type == VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_TEXEL_BUFFER || bd->type == VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_TEXEL_BUFFER) {
            sp(b, "    %s %s slot %d: buffer texture (zero view bound)\n", stn[st], img ? "img" : "tex", r->slot);
            continue;
        }
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < (bd->count ? bd->count : 1u); k++) {
            int slot = r->slot + (int)k;
            uint64_t h = handle_of(ex, st, slot, img);
            sp(b, "    %s %s slot %d decl %s%s: ", stn[st], img ? "img" : "tex", slot, decl_type(r->type, dt),
               img && (r->flags & 4) ? " store" : "");
            if (!h) { sp(b, "no handle (dummy)\n"); continue; }
            view_t v;
            int hv = 0;
            const VkTexImage *t = vk_texture_by_id(&ex->tex_pool, NVN_HANDLE_TEX(h), &v, &hv);
            if (!t) { sp(b, "tex %d unresolved (dummy)\n", NVN_HANDLE_TEX(h)); continue; }
            static const char *vt[] = {"1D", "2D", "3D", "cube", "1DArray", "2DArray", "cubeArray"};
            sp(b, "tex %d %s(%d) %ux%ux%u levels %u layers %u image %s", NVN_HANDLE_TEX(h), fmt_name(t->format, fn),
               (int)t->format, t->width, t->height, t->depth, t->levels, t->layers,
               t->view_type <= 6 ? vt[t->view_type] : "?");
            if (hv && v.set_format) sp(b, " view-nvn-fmt %#x", v.format);
            if (hv && v.set_levels) sp(b, " view-levels %u+%u", v.base_level, v.nlevels);
            if (hv && v.set_layers) sp(b, " view-layers %u+%u", v.min_layer, v.nlayers);
            samp_par s;
            if (img) {
                // storage image: no sampler
            } else if (r->separate) {
                sp(b, " | separate sampler (not replayed: default sampler)");
            } else if (vk_sampler_params(&ex->samp_pool, NVN_HANDLE_SAMP(h), &s)) {
                static const char *minn[] = {"N", "L", "N_mipN", "L_mipN", "N_mipL", "L_mipL"};
                int mf = s.minf;
                sp(b, " | samp %d: mag %s min %s (vk min %s mip %s) wrap %s/%s/%s aniso %g lod %g..%g bias %g%s",
                   NVN_HANDLE_SAMP(h), s.magf == 1 ? "L" : "N", mf < 6 ? minn[mf] : "?",
                   mf == 1 || mf == 3 || mf == 5 ? "L" : "N", mf <= 1 ? "none" : mf >= 4 ? "L" : "N",
                   wrap_name(s.ws), wrap_name(s.wt), wrap_name(s.wr), s.aniso, s.lod_min, s.lod_max, s.lod_bias,
                   s.cmp_mode ? " compare" : "");
            } else {
                sp(b, " | samp %d empty (default sampler)", NVN_HANDLE_SAMP(h));
            }
            uint32_t ups;
            int last, wr;
            vk_texture_debug(t, &ups, &last, &wr);
            sp(b, " | addr %#llx mirrored %d gpu_owned %d bound %d uploads %u last-check %d written-since %d",
               (unsigned long long)t->addr, t->mirrored, t->gpu_owned, t->bound, ups, last, wr);
            uint8_t ssw[4] = {0};
            vk_texture_slot_swz(&ex->tex_pool, NVN_HANDLE_TEX(h), ssw);
            sp(b, " | swz image %u%u%u%u slot %u%u%u%u", t->swz[0], t->swz[1], t->swz[2], t->swz[3], ssw[0], ssw[1], ssw[2],
               ssw[3]);
            if (hv && v.set_swizzle) sp(b, " view %u%u%u%u", v.swz[0], v.swz[1], v.swz[2], v.swz[3]);
            sp(b, "\n");
            int wanted = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < nwant_tex; k++)
                wanted |= want_tex[k][1] ? want_tex[k][0] == t->width && want_tex[k][1] == t->height
                                         : want_tex[k][0] == (uint32_t)NVN_HANDLE_TEX(h);
            if (t->type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D) queue_lut(t, NVN_HANDLE_TEX(h));
            else if (wanted && t->type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D && t->samples == 1) queue_lut(t, NVN_HANDLE_TEX(h));
            else if (!img && t->type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D && t->samples == 1 && (uint64_t)t->width * t->height <= TEX2D_CAP &&
                     (t->format == VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM || t->format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM ||
                      t->format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM || t->format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB ||
                      t->format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM || t->format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB))
                queue_lut(t, NVN_HANDLE_TEX(h));
        }
    }
}

static uint64_t bindings_hash(const VkExec *ex, const VkPipeInfo *info) {
    uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < info->n_bindings; i++) {
        const VkPipeBinding *bd = &info->bindings[i];
        if (bd->res && bd->kind == GFX_RES_SSBO) {
            int st = nvn_stage(bd->stage), slot = bd->res->slot;
            if (slot >= 0 && slot < 16) h = (h ^ ex->ssbo[st][slot].addr) * 0x100000001b3ull;
            continue;
        }
        if (!bd->res || (bd->kind != GFX_RES_TEX && bd->kind != GFX_RES_IMG)) continue;
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < (bd->count ? bd->count : 1u); k++)
            h = (h ^ handle_of(ex, nvn_stage(bd->stage), bd->res->slot + (int)k, bd->kind == GFX_RES_IMG)) * 0x100000001b3ull;
    }
    return h;
}

void vk_dump_draw(VkExec *ex, const VkPipeState *s, VkPipeline p, const VkPipeInfo *info) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&rec_lock);
    if (!active()) goto out;
    pass_draws++;
    uint64_t th = bindings_hash(ex, info);
    for (int i = 0; i < nents; i++)
        if (ents[i].p == p && ents[i].th == th) {
            ents[i].draws++;
            goto out;
        }
    if (nents == MAX_ENTS) {
        ents_over++;
        goto out;
    }
    Str b = {0};
    sp(&b, "vs %016llx fs %016llx prog %llu prim %d", (unsigned long long)shader_hash(s->vs),
       (unsigned long long)shader_hash(s->fs), (unsigned long long)(ex->prog ? ex->prog->serial : 0), s->prim);
    for (uint32_t k = 0; ex->prog && k < ex->prog->nstage && k < 6; k++) {   // NVN 2 stages: their MKW_SHADER_DUMP names
        uint64_t o = nvn2_origin((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)ex->prog->sd[k].data);
        if (o) sp(&b, " nvn2 %016llx", (unsigned long long)o);
    }
    sp(&b, "\n");
    describe_bindings(&b, ex, info);
    ents[nents++] = (Ent){p, th, 1, b.s};
out:
    plat_mutex_unlock(&rec_lock);
}

static void target_line(VkExec *ex, const VkExecTarget *t, const char *tag, int n) {
    char fn[16], name[160];
    if (!t->image) {
        fprintf(passes_f, "  %s: nvn %#x target %d %ux%u: not renderable, left out\n", tag, t->tex->d.format,
                t->tex->d.target, t->tex->d.width, t->tex->d.height);
        return;
    }
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "pass_%04d_%s_%ux%u_%d_%s", n, tag, t->width, t->height, (int)t->format,
             fmt_name(t->format, fn));
    // a block view: the plane's blocks, read as the view format (one texel per block)
    uint32_t tw = t->tex->d.width >> t->level ? t->tex->d.width >> t->level : 1;
    uint32_t th = t->tex->d.height >> t->level ? t->tex->d.height >> t->level : 1;
    (void)n;
    const char *why = pass_skip ? pass_skip : t->samples > 1 ? "multisampled" :
                      t->blocks ? copy_region(ex, t->image, t->format, t->aspect, t->level, t->is3d ? 0 : t->base_layer,
                                              t->is3d ? t->base_layer : 0, (VkExtent3D){tw, th, 1}, t->width,
                                              t->height, 1, name) :
                      t->is3d ? "3D slice (the volume is dumped as lut<id> where it is sampled)" :
                      copy_out(ex, t->image, t->format, t->aspect, t->level, t->base_layer, t->width, t->height, 1, name);
    fprintf(passes_f, "  %s: nvn %#x %s(%d) %ux%u level %u layers %u+%u samples %u addr %#llx -> %s.png%s%s\n", tag,
            t->nvn_format, fmt_name(t->format, fn), (int)t->format, t->width, t->height, t->level, t->base_layer,
            t->layers, t->samples, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)t->tex->mem, name, why ? " skipped: " : "",
            why ? why : "");
}

static uint64_t targets_sig(const VkExec *ex) {
    uint64_t h = 1469598103934665603ull;
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        const VkExecTarget *t = i < 8 ? &ex->color[i] : &ex->depth;
        uint64_t v[3] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)t->image, t->level, t->base_layer};
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) h = (h ^ v[k]) * 1099511628211ull;
    }
    return h;
}

// Sets pass_skip for the pass or dispatch being logged and counts it when it copies.
static void pass_decide(int same_targets) {
    if (frame_now() != dump_frame) copied = 0;
    pass_skip = copied >= MAX_PASSES ? "pass cap" : same_targets ? "same targets as the previous pass" : NULL;
    if (!pass_skip) copied++;
}

void vk_dump_pass_end(VkExec *ex) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&rec_lock);
    if (!active()) goto out;
    int n = seq++;
    uint64_t sig = targets_sig(ex);
    pass_decide(skip_runs && sig == last_targets);
    last_targets = sig;
    fprintf(passes_f, "pass %04d: render pass, draws %d, area %ux%u layers %u, fence %llu, frame %llu\n", n, pass_draws,
            ex->pass_w, ex->pass_h, ex->pass_layers, (unsigned long long)ex->fence, (unsigned long long)frame_now());
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        if (!ex->color[i].tex) continue;
        char tag[8];
        snprintf(tag, sizeof tag, "t%d", i);
        target_line(ex, &ex->color[i], tag, n);
    }
    if (ex->depth.tex) target_line(ex, &ex->depth, "td", n);
    for (int i = 0; i < nents; i++) {
        fprintf(passes_f, "  pipe %d (draws %d): %s", i, ents[i].draws, ents[i].text);
        free(ents[i].text);
    }
    if (ents_over) fprintf(passes_f, "  ... %d more draws with other pipeline/texture sets\n", ents_over);
    if (!pass_skip) flush_luts(ex, n);
    else nluts = 0;
    buf_snap(ex, n);
    fflush(passes_f);
    nents = ents_over = pass_draws = 0;
out:
    plat_mutex_unlock(&rec_lock);
}

void vk_dump_dispatch(VkExec *ex, const GfxShader *cs, VkPipeline p, const VkPipeInfo *info, const p_dispatch *d) {
    (void)p;
    plat_mutex_lock(&rec_lock);
    if (!active()) goto out;
    int n = seq++;
    pass_decide(0);
    last_targets = 0;
    Str b = {0};
    uint64_t origin = 0;
    if (ex->prog) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ex->prog->nstage && i < 6; i++) {
            if (!ex->prog->sd[i].control || !ex->prog->sd[i].data) continue;
            uint32_t stage = 0;
            memcpy(&stage, ex->prog->sd[i].control + 0x714, sizeof stage);
            if (stage == 5) {
                origin = nvn2_origin((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)ex->prog->sd[i].data);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    describe_bindings(&b, ex, info);
    fprintf(passes_f, "pass %04d: dispatch %dx%dx%d cs %016llx nvn2 %016llx prog %llu caller %#llx, fence %llu\n%s", n, d->x, d->y,
            d->z, (unsigned long long)shader_hash(cs), (unsigned long long)origin, (unsigned long long)(ex->prog ? ex->prog->serial : 0),
            (unsigned long long)d->caller, (unsigned long long)ex->fence, b.s ? b.s : "");
    free(b.s);
    fflush(passes_f);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < info->n_bindings && !pass_skip; i++) {   // storage images the dispatch writes
        const VkPipeBinding *bd = &info->bindings[i];
        if (!bd->res || bd->kind != GFX_RES_IMG || !(bd->res->flags & 4) || bd->type != VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_IMAGE)
            continue;
        uint64_t h = handle_of(ex, 5, bd->res->slot, 1);
        view_t v;
        int hv = 0;
        const VkTexImage *t = h ? vk_texture_by_id(&ex->tex_pool, NVN_HANDLE_TEX(h), &v, &hv) : NULL;
        if (!t) continue;
        uint32_t lv = hv && v.set_levels ? v.base_level : 0, layer = hv && v.set_layers ? v.min_layer : 0;
        if (lv >= t->levels || layer >= t->layers) continue;
        uint32_t w = t->width >> lv ? t->width >> lv : 1, hh = t->height >> lv ? t->height >> lv : 1;
        uint32_t dd = t->type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D ? (t->depth >> lv ? t->depth >> lv : 1) : 1;
        char fn[16], name[160];
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "pass_%04d_img%d_%ux%u%s_%d_%s", n, bd->res->slot, w, hh, dd > 1 ? "x3d" : "",
                 (int)t->format, fmt_name(t->format, fn));
        if (t->type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D) {   // a written volume: this copy replaces the sampled-3D one
            for (int k = 0; k < nluts_done; k++)
                if (luts_done[k] == t->image) luts_done[k] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        }
        const char *why = t->samples > 1 ? "multisampled" :
                          copy_out(ex, t->image, t->format, t->aspect, lv, layer, w, hh, dd, name);
        fprintf(passes_f, "  writes img slot %d level %u layer %u depth %u -> %s.png%s%s\n", bd->res->slot, lv, layer,
                dd, name, why ? " skipped: " : "", why ? why : "");
    }
    if (!pass_skip) flush_luts(ex, n);
    else nluts = 0;
    buf_snap(ex, n);
    fflush(passes_f);
out:
    plat_mutex_unlock(&rec_lock);
}

static const char *tex_desc(const tex_t *t, char *buf, size_t n) {
    if (!t) return "null";
    snprintf(buf, n, "addr %#llx nvn-fmt %#x %ux%ux%u", (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)t->mem, t->d.format, t->d.width,
             t->d.height, t->d.depth);
    return buf;
}

static void region_desc(const NVNcopyRegion *r, char *buf, size_t n) {
    snprintf(buf, n, "(%d,%d,%d %dx%dx%d)", r->xoffset, r->yoffset, r->zoffset, r->width, r->height, r->depth);
}

void vk_dump_copy(VkExec *ex, uint32_t op, const void *payload) {
    (void)ex;
    plat_mutex_lock(&rec_lock);
    if (!active()) goto out;
    char a[96], b[96], ra[64], rb[64];
    switch (op) {
    case OP_COPY_B2B: {
        const p_copy_b2b *p = payload;
        fprintf(passes_f, "copy after pass %d: buffer %#llx -> buffer %#llx, %llu bytes\n", seq - 1,
                (unsigned long long)p->src, (unsigned long long)p->dst, (unsigned long long)p->size);
        break;
    }
    case OP_COPY_B2T: case OP_COPY_T2B: {
        const p_copy_b2t *p = payload;
        region_desc(&p->r, ra, sizeof ra);
        fprintf(passes_f, "copy after pass %d: %s buffer %#llx %s texture %s region %s flags %#x\n", seq - 1,
                op == OP_COPY_B2T ? "buffer->texture" : "texture->buffer", (unsigned long long)p->src,
                op == OP_COPY_B2T ? "->" : "<-", tex_desc(p->tex, a, sizeof a), ra, p->flags);
        break;
    }
    case OP_COPY_T2T: {
        const p_copy_t2t *p = payload;
        region_desc(&p->sr, ra, sizeof ra);
        region_desc(&p->dr, rb, sizeof rb);
        fprintf(passes_f, "copy after pass %d: texture %s %s -> texture %s %s flags %#x\n", seq - 1,
                tex_desc(p->src, a, sizeof a), ra, tex_desc(p->dst, b, sizeof b), rb, p->flags);
        break;
    }
    case OP_CLEAR_TEX: {
        const p_clear_tex *p = payload;
        region_desc(&p->r, ra, sizeof ra);
        fprintf(passes_f, "clear after pass %d: texture %s region %s mask %#x\n", seq - 1, tex_desc(p->tex, a, sizeof a),
                ra, p->mask);
        break;
    }
    default: break;
    }
out:
    plat_mutex_unlock(&rec_lock);
}

static void make_dirs(char *path) { plat_file_mkdir_p(path); }

// TOTK_DUMP=key: armed with no frame; F12 in the game window dumps the frame two presents later (once per run).
static int dump_on_key;
void vk_dump_key(void) {
    if (!dump_on_key || dump_frame != UINT64_MAX) return;
    uint64_t f = frame_now() + 2;
    __atomic_store_n(&dump_frame, f, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    rt_log("vk_dump: F12 pressed: dumping frame %llu to %s", (unsigned long long)f, dir);
}

void vk_dump_init(void) {
    const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_DUMP");
    if (e && !strcmp(e, "key")) dump_on_key = 1, dump_frame = UINT64_MAX;
    else if (!e || !*e || !(dump_frame = strtoull(e, NULL, 10))) return;
    const char *lf = cfg_get("TOTK_DUMP_LOG");
    if (lf && *lf) log_from = strtoull(lf, NULL, 10);
    const char *sr = cfg_get("TOTK_DUMP_SKIP_RUNS");
    skip_runs = sr && *sr && *sr != '0';
    const char *du = cfg_get("TOTK_DUMP_UBO");
    dump_ubo = du && *du && *du != '0';
    const char *dl = cfg_get("TOTK_DUMP_LAYERS");
    if (dl && *dl) dump_layers_level = atoi(dl);
    const char *wt = cfg_get("TOTK_DUMP_TEX");
    for (char *q = (char *)wt; q && *q && nwant_tex < 16; q += *q == ',') {
        uint32_t *w = want_tex[nwant_tex++];
        w[0] = (uint32_t)strtoul(q, &q, 10);
        w[1] = *q == 'x' ? (uint32_t)strtoul(q + 1, &q, 10) : 0;
    }
    const char *d = cfg_get("TOTK_DUMP_DIR");
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", d && *d ? d : "dump");
    make_dirs(dir);
    char path[600];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/passes.txt", dir);
    passes_f = fopen(path, "w");
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/images.txt", dir);
    images_f = fopen(path, "w");
    if (!passes_f || !images_f) rt_fatal("vk_dump: cannot write to %s", dir);
    const char *bf = cfg_get("TOTK_DUMP_BUF");
    if (bf && *bf) {
        char *q;
        bd_addr = strtoull(bf, &q, 0);
        if (*q == ':') bd_size = strtoull(q + 1, &q, 0);
        if (*q == ':') bd_off = strtoull(q + 1, &q, 0);
        if (*q == ':') bd_stride = strtoull(q + 1, &q, 0) & ~3ull;
        if (*q == ':') bd_w = (uint32_t)strtoul(q + 1, &q, 0);
        if (*q == ':') bd_h = (uint32_t)strtoul(q + 1, &q, 0);
        if (!bd_w || !bd_h) bd_stride = 0;
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/bufs.txt", dir);
        if (bd_size && !(bufs_f = fopen(path, "w"))) bd_size = 0;
    }
    vk_dump_armed = 1;
    rt_log("vk_dump: frame %llu goes to %s", (unsigned long long)dump_frame, dir);
}

void vk_dump_present(uint64_t frame) {
    if (frame != dump_frame) return;
    plat_mutex_lock(&rec_lock);
    finished = 1;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&rec_lock);
    vk_sync_finish();   // the frame's copies are converted and written
    plat_mutex_lock(&img_lock);
    fclose(images_f);
    images_f = NULL;
    if (bufs_f) fclose(bufs_f), bufs_f = NULL;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&img_lock);
    fclose(passes_f);
    passes_f = NULL;
    rt_log("vk_dump: frame %llu: %d passes and dispatches, about %llu MB of PNGs in %s", (unsigned long long)frame, seq,
           (unsigned long long)(png_bytes >> 20), dir);
}

```

`runtime/vk_exec.c`:

```c
// The op-stream replay core of the Vulkan back end: walks the command handles of
// one submission into its command buffer, keeps render targets and fixed-function state, opens and closes dynamic
// rendering passes and records clears and barriers. Draws, binds and dispatches go to vk_exec_op_draw
// (vk_exec_draw.c); copies, counters, events and conditional rendering to vk_exec_op_xfer (vk_exec_xfer.c). Images
// stay in VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL (vk_texture.c); full memory barriers order passes, clears and whatever those two
// record between them.
//
// The op loop (END / BEGIN / JUMP / CALL, which ops are pure state, the state defaults, render targets kept until they
// change, clears skipped while rendering is disabled) follows MacNativeGames
// games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_mtl.m:10588-10700, 7409-7460, 5449-5457
// (https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames @ b75be8cfa704df3701e86130c8ced268e79d6b11, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026
// jhaizhou). Pass begin and end (GENERAL-layout attachments, LOAD/STORE, render area from the smallest attachment, a
// full barrier before each pass), the scissor clip and attachment clears follow LAS Recomp
// runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c:855-1149, 3553-3778 (https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp @
// da35b83a9611d046a9a681aae668d7085954d37f, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
#include <math.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "nvn_tex.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "tex.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "vk_exec.h"
#include "vk_mesh.h"

#define WEAK __attribute__((weak))
#define CALL_DEPTH 8

typedef struct {
    VkImage image;
    VkFormat format;
    VkImageViewType type;
    VkImageAspectFlags aspect;
    uint32_t level, base, layers;
    VkImageView view;
} ViewEnt;

static VkExec X;
static int x_ready;
static _Thread_local int x_here;   // this thread is inside vk_exec_record (vk_exec_inline_begin)

// ---- TOTK_TRACE=gfx frame counters

VkExecFrame vk_exec_frame;
static struct { const uint8_t *mem; uint32_t w, h, fmt, n; } fw[64];   // textures written this frame
static int nfw;

uint64_t vk_exec_recording_fence(void) { return x_here ? X.fence : 0; }

void vk_exec_frame_written(const tex_t *t) {
    if (!(rt_trace & RT_TRACE_GFX) || !t) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < nfw; i++)
        if (fw[i].mem == t->mem) { fw[i].n++; return; }
    if (nfw == 64) return;
    fw[nfw].mem = t->mem, fw[nfw].w = t->d.width, fw[nfw].h = t->d.height, fw[nfw].fmt = (uint32_t)t->d.format;
    fw[nfw++].n = 1;
}

void vk_exec_frame_log(const tex_t *p, uint64_t frame) {
    if (!(rt_trace & RT_TRACE_GFX)) return;
    VkExecFrame *f = &vk_exec_frame;
    int hit = 0;
    char list[512] = "";
    size_t o = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nfw; i++) {
        if (p && fw[i].mem == p->mem) hit = 1;
        if (o < sizeof list - 48)
            o += (size_t)snprintf(list + o, sizeof list - o, " %p:%ux%u/%#x*%u", (const void *)fw[i].mem, fw[i].w,
                                  fw[i].h, fw[i].fmt, fw[i].n);
    }
    rt_log("frame %llu: submits %llu passes %llu draws %llu/%llu clears %llu copies %llu dispatches %llu; present %p "
           "%ux%u/%#x written %d; feedback draws %llu barriers %llu restarts %llu layouts %llu; targets%s",
           (unsigned long long)frame, (unsigned long long)f->submits,
           (unsigned long long)f->passes, (unsigned long long)f->draws, (unsigned long long)f->draws_seen,
           (unsigned long long)f->clears, (unsigned long long)f->copies, (unsigned long long)f->dispatches,
           p ? (const void *)p->mem : NULL, p ? p->d.width : 0, p ? p->d.height : 0, p ? (uint32_t)p->d.format : 0,
           hit, (unsigned long long)f->fb_draws, (unsigned long long)f->fb_barriers, (unsigned long long)f->fb_restarts,
           (unsigned long long)f->fb_layouts, list);
    memset(f, 0, sizeof *f);
    nfw = 0;
}

WEAK void vk_exec_op_draw(VkExec *ex, uint32_t op, const void *payload) {
```
