```c
    LB.t0 = now_ms();
    LB.running = t;
    int started = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < t; i++)
        if ((LB.th[started] = plat_thread_new(lb_worker, NULL, "lib prebuild"))) started++;
    plat_add32(&LB.running, started - t);
    LB.threads = started;
    rt_log("vk_pipeline: stage library prebuild: %zu compute pipelines and %zu recorded variants' libraries "
           "(TOTK_LIB_PREBUILD_KEEP %d) on %d idle-priority threads; library state clamp %u, polygon mode %u, depth "
           "-w..w %u, samples %u", n_cs < n ? n_cs : n, n > n_cs ? n - n_cs : 0, LB.keep_n, started, LB.clamp, LB.poly,
           LB.minus_w, LB.samples);
}

static void lb_stop(void) {
    plat_xchg32(&LB.stop, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < LB.threads; i++)
        if (LB.th[i]) plat_thread_join(LB.th[i]), LB.th[i] = NULL;
    LB.threads = 0;
}

// Preparation: one prepared variant at a time into the driver's disk cache (private shader copy, nothing kept).
static void lb_warm_worker(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    for (;;) {
        size_t i = (size_t)plat_inc64(&LB.next) - 1;
        if (i >= LB.n) return;
        int owned = 0;
        const GfxShader *sh = gfx_shader_load_private(LB.e[i].iid, &owned);
        int st = sh ? gfx_shader_stage(sh) : -1;
        if (!sh) {
            plat_mutex_lock(&LB.stat);
            LB.noshader++;
            plat_mutex_unlock(&LB.stat);
        } else if (st == GFX_STAGE_CS) {
            Bindings B = {0};
            const char *why = NULL;
            lb_lock();
            Layout *l = compute_layout(sh, &B, &why);
            lb_unlock();
            double t0 = now_ms();
            VkPipeline pipe = l ? compute_create(sh, l) : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            if (pipe) vkDestroyPipeline(P.device, pipe, NULL);
            lb_count(2, pipe ? 3 : 2, now_ms() - t0);
        } else if (st == GFX_STAGE_VS || st == GFX_STAGE_FS) {
            if (P.gpl) lb_library(sh, st == GFX_STAGE_VS, 0);
            else lb_skip_lib();
        }
        if (owned) gfx_shader_release_private(sh);
        plat_mutex_lock(&LB.stat);
        uint64_t d = ++LB.done;
        plat_mutex_unlock(&LB.stat);
        if (d % 4000 == 0) lb_report("preparation progress");
    }
}

// Preparation: every variant of <dir>/shader-prepared.bin on every core at normal priority.
static void lb_warm_prepared(const char *dir) {
    char path[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2 + 32];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/shader-prepared.bin", dir);
    uint64_t size = 0;
    uint8_t *f = plat_file_read(path, &size);
    size_t n = f && size >= 16 ? (size_t)(size - 16) / 36 : 0;
    LB.e = n ? calloc(n, sizeof *LB.e) : NULL;
    for (size_t i = 0; LB.e && i < n; i++)
        memcpy(LB.e[i].iid, f + 16 + 36 * i + 4, 32), LB.e[i].stage = f[16 + 36 * i], LB.e[i].prio = f[16 + 36 * i + 1];
    free(f);
    if (!LB.e) return;
    LB.n = n, LB.idle = 0, LB.t0 = now_ms();
    static const uint32_t no_pr[16], no_fs[4];
    lb_state(no_pr, no_fs);
    int cpus = (int)plat_cpu_usable(), k = 0;
    PlatThread *t[64];
    for (int i = 0; i < cpus && i < 64; i++)
        if ((t[k] = plat_thread_new(lb_warm_worker, NULL, "lib warm"))) k++;
    if (!k) lb_warm_worker(NULL);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) plat_thread_join(t[i]);
    lb_report("preparation done");
    // with gpl off only compute variants are built: say so, rather than count the skipped ones as built
    if (LB.nolib)
        printf("prepare-shaders: %zu variants on %d threads in %.0f ms, %llu vertex/fragment variants skipped (graphics "
               "pipeline library off, they build at their first draw)\n", n, k, now_ms() - LB.t0, (unsigned long long)LB.nolib);
    else
        printf("prepare-shaders: %zu variants built into the driver cache on %d threads in %.0f ms\n", n, k, now_ms() - LB.t0);
    free(LB.e), LB.e = NULL, LB.n = 0, LB.next = 0, LB.done = 0;
}

// totk.exe --prepare-shaders (tools/prepare_shaders.py): the device sets the translator's host answers (they are in every
// cache key), the seed next to totk.exe is translated on every core, then every prepared variant's stage library or
// compute pipeline is built once into the driver's disk cache (lb_warm_prepared). No game runs.
int vk_pipeline_prepare_shaders(void) {
    if (!ensure_init()) {
        fprintf(stderr, "prepare-shaders: no Vulkan device\n");
        return 1;
    }
    char dir[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2];
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", P.cache_path);
    char *cut = plat_last_sep(dir);
    if (!cut) return 1;
    *cut = 0;
    int cpus = (int)plat_cpu_usable();
    const char *pe = cfg_get("TOTK_PREWARM_XLATE");   // no fixed default: half the CPUs, at most 16, when unset
    int procs = pe && *pe ? atoi(pe) : cpus / 2 > 16 ? 16 : cpus / 2;
    int rc = gfx_shader_prepare_seed(dir, cpus, procs < 1 ? 1 : procs);
    if (!rc) lb_warm_prepared(dir);
    return rc;
}

// totk.exe --warm-shaders: every variant of shader-prepared.bin built into the driver's disk cache again from the shader
// cache, without translating the seed. The AMD cache is keyed to the exe path (a relink keeps it: 29,587 variants in
// 1.8 s) and holds a limited amount: preparing another build dir evicted this one's libraries, and a library a draw
// needed then took 40-220 ms in play instead of 0.2 ms. Seconds when the libraries are still there.
int vk_pipeline_warm_shaders(void) {
    if (!ensure_init()) {
        fprintf(stderr, "warm-shaders: no Vulkan device\n");
        return 1;
    }
    char dir[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2];
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", P.cache_path);
    char *cut = plat_last_sep(dir);
    if (!cut) return 1;
    *cut = 0;
    char prp[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2 + 32];
    snprintf(prp, sizeof prp, "%s/shader-prepared.bin", dir);
    if (!plat_file_exists(prp)) {
        // Prepare shaders into cache if prepared bundle is not present
        return vk_pipeline_prepare_shaders();
    }
    lb_warm_prepared(dir);
    return 0;
}

// ---- dynamic state

void vk_pipeline_set_dynamic(VkCommandBuffer cb, const VkPipeState *s) {
    vk_pipeline_set_dynamic_ex(cb, s, 0);
}

// mesh=1: omit topology, restart and vertex-input dynamics (mesh pipelines drop those from pDynamicState;
// NVIDIA has AVed inside the driver when those cmds were recorded against a bound mesh pipeline).
void vk_pipeline_set_dynamic_ex(VkCommandBuffer cb, const VkPipeState *s, int mesh) {
    if (!ensure_init()) return;
    const poly_st *pl = &s->poly;
    const ds_st *d = &s->ds;
    // The front face maps unchanged: TOTK sets the upper-left window origin, and the y-flipped viewport (y_flip) puts
    // NDC +y at row 0 as NVN does, so the framebuffer winding Vulkan tests is the one NVN tests (MacNativeGames passes
    // it to Metal unchanged; LAS Recomp exec.c mirrors it only for the lower-left origin).
    int front_cw = pl->front == NVN_FRONT_FACE_CW;
    vkCmdSetCullMode(cb, (VkCullModeFlags)(pl->cull & 3));   // NVN_FACE_* has VkCullModeFlagBits' values
    vkCmdSetFrontFace(cb, front_cw ? VK_FRONT_FACE_CLOCKWISE : VK_FRONT_FACE_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE);
    if (!mesh) {
        vkCmdSetPrimitiveTopology(cb, vk_pipeline_topology(s->prim));
        vkCmdSetPrimitiveRestartEnable(cb, s->prim_restart != 0);
    }
    vkCmdSetDepthTestEnable(cb, d->dt);
    vkCmdSetDepthWriteEnable(cb, d->dw);
    vkCmdSetDepthCompareOp(cb, compare_op(d->df));
    vkCmdSetStencilTestEnable(cb, d->st);
    vkCmdSetStencilOp(cb, VK_STENCIL_FACE_FRONT_BIT, stencil_op(d->fail_f), stencil_op(d->zpass_f), stencil_op(d->zfail_f),
                      compare_op(d->sf_f));
    vkCmdSetStencilOp(cb, VK_STENCIL_FACE_BACK_BIT, stencil_op(d->fail_b), stencil_op(d->zpass_b), stencil_op(d->zfail_b),
                      compare_op(d->sf_b));
    // NVN_POLYGON_OFFSET_ENABLE_* bit of the polygon mode in use: point 1, line 2, fill 4
    unsigned mode = pl->mode <= NVN_POLYGON_MODE_FILL ? pl->mode : NVN_POLYGON_MODE_FILL;
    vkCmdSetDepthBiasEnable(cb, (pl->offset_en >> mode & 1) != 0);
    vkCmdSetRasterizerDiscardEnable(cb, s->raster_discard != 0);
    if (!mesh && P.dyn_vi && s->vs) {
        VtxInput v;
        vertex_input(s, &v);
        rec_vertex_input(P.set_vi, cb, v.n_bind, v.b, v.n_attr, v.a);
    }
    if (P.dyn_clamp) rec_bool(P.set_clamp, cb, s->depth_clamp != 0);
    if (P.dyn_poly) rec_polygon_mode(P.set_poly, cb, polygon_mode(pl->mode));
    if (P.dyn_a2c) rec_bool((PFN_vkCmdSetDepthClampEnableEXT)P.set_a2c, cb, s->ms.a2c != 0);   // the same signature
    int n = target_count(s);
    if (!n) return;
    VkBool32 en[8];
    VkColorBlendEquationEXT eq[8];
    VkColorComponentFlags wm[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const blend_st *b = &s->blend[i];
        en[i] = (s->color.blend_en >> i & 1) && blendable(target_format(s->color_fmt[i], NULL, NULL));
        eq[i] = (VkColorBlendEquationEXT){blend_factor(b->src_rgb), blend_factor(b->dst_rgb), blend_op(b->eq_rgb),
                                          blend_factor(b->src_a), blend_factor(b->dst_a), blend_op(b->eq_a)};
        wm[i] = target_wmask(s, i);
    }
    if (P.dyn_blend_en) rec_blend_enable(P.set_blend_en, cb, 0, (uint32_t)n, en);
    if (P.dyn_blend_eq) rec_blend_equation(P.set_blend_eq, cb, 0, (uint32_t)n, eq);
    if (P.dyn_wmask) rec_write_mask(P.set_wmask, cb, 0, (uint32_t)n, wm);
}

// ---- statistics, persistence, teardown

void vk_pipeline_stats(VkPipeStats *s) {
    plat_mutex_lock_shared(&P.lock);
    *s = P.stats;
    plat_mutex_unlock_shared(&P.lock);
}

static PlatMutex save_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;   // one cache save at a time; shutdown takes it to destroy the cache

void vk_pipeline_save(void) {
    if (P.ready) keys_flush();
    if (P.ready && P.gpl) {
        rt_log("vk_pipeline: gpl: %llu fast links (%llu by workers; avg %.2f ms, max %.2f ms, %llu failed), %llu draws "
               "lookups found shader libraries missing (left to a worker), %llu optimised pipelines swapped in (%llu queued "
               "low after their fast link), %llu drawing-thread links over 5 ms; %llu waiting draws built their libraries "
               "(avg %.2f ms, max %.2f ms)",
               (unsigned long long)P.g.links, (unsigned long long)P.g.wlinks, P.g.links ? P.g.link_ms / P.g.links : 0.0,
               P.g.link_max, (unsigned long long)P.g.link_fail, (unsigned long long)P.g.defer,
               (unsigned long long)P.g.swaps, (unsigned long long)P.g.requeued, (unsigned long long)P.g.slow,
               (unsigned long long)P.g.dlinks, P.g.dlinks ? P.g.dlink_ms / P.g.dlinks : 0.0, P.g.dlink_max);
        if (U.waits || U.queued)
            rt_log("vk_pipeline: gpl: library jobs for waiting draws: %llu queued, %llu built by a worker, %llu by the "
                   "thread that needed them (no worker free), %llu waits ended at their limit",
                   (unsigned long long)U.queued, (unsigned long long)U.by_worker, (unsigned long long)U.stolen,
                   (unsigned long long)U.timeouts);
        static const char *const kn[4] = {"vertex input", "pre-rasterization", "fragment shader", "fragment output"};
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            rt_log("vk_pipeline: gpl: %s libraries %llu (avg %.2f ms, max %.2f ms)", kn[i], (unsigned long long)P.g.lib_n[i],
                   P.g.lib_n[i] ? P.g.lib_ms[i] / P.g.lib_n[i] : 0.0, P.g.lib_max[i]);
        if (LB.n)
            rt_log("vk_pipeline: gpl: prebuilt libraries a draw used: pre-rasterization %llu, fragment shader %llu; "
                   "compute pipelines built on the replay thread %llu", (unsigned long long)P.g.pre_used[LIB_PR],
                   (unsigned long long)P.g.pre_used[LIB_FS], (unsigned long long)LB.cs_draw);
    }
    gfx_shader_record_flush(1);
    if (!P.ready || !P.cache || !P.cache_path[0]) return;
    // Not under P.lock: the driver synchronises P.cache, and holding P.lock through the copy and the file write (about
    // 60 ms on the 1.4.3 fight) stopped every pipeline lookup of the replay, a freeze at each 20 s autosave.
    plat_mutex_lock(&save_lock);
    if (!P.cache) {   // vk_pipeline_shutdown destroyed it
        plat_mutex_unlock(&save_lock);
        return;
    }
    size_t size = 0;
    void *data = NULL;
    if (vkGetPipelineCacheData(P.device, P.cache, &size, NULL) == VK_SUCCESS && size && (data = malloc(size)) &&
        vkGetPipelineCacheData(P.device, P.cache, &size, data) == VK_SUCCESS) {
        if (!plat_file_write_atomic(P.cache_path, data, size)) rt_log("vk_pipeline: cannot write %s", P.cache_path);
    }
    free(data);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&save_lock);
}

// The game never shuts the device down (boot.c and the window end the process), so the cache is saved while it
// runs: at most every 20 s, and only after new pipelines were built. New pipeline keys are appended every 2 s.
static void autosave_once(void) {
    static uint64_t last_n, last_ms, last_keys;
    if (!P.ready) return;
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ms();
    if (*(volatile uint32_t *)&K.pend_n && now - last_keys >= 2000) last_keys = now, keys_flush();
    gfx_shader_record_flush(0);
    if (now - last_ms < 20000) return;
    VkPipeStats s;
    vk_pipeline_stats(&s);
    if (s.graphics + s.compute == last_n) return;
    last_n = s.graphics + s.compute, last_ms = now;
    vk_pipeline_save();
}

// On its own thread: the save (vkGetPipelineCacheData and the file write, about 60 ms) and the key appends (a flush to
// the disk each) ran on the present thread, and the render thread waited for it to take the next frame.
static void autosave_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    plat_thread_priority(PLAT_PRIO_BELOW_NORMAL);
    for (;;) {
        plat_sleep_ms(500);
        autosave_once();
    }
}

void vk_pipeline_autosave(void) {
    static int32_t started;
    if (!P.ready || plat_xchg32(&started, 1)) return;
    if (!plat_thread_spawn(autosave_main, NULL, "pipe autosave", 0))
        rt_log("vk_pipeline: cannot start the autosave thread; the cache is saved at exit only");
}

void vk_pipeline_shutdown(void) {
    if (!P.ready) return;
    lb_stop();
    workers_drain();   // jobs point at layouts and Pipe entries freed below
    vk_pipeline_save();
    plat_mutex_lock(&P.lock);
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(P.device);
    for (int i = 0; i < PIPE_BUCKETS; i++) {
        for (Pipe *p = pipes[i], *n; p; p = n) {
            n = p->next;
            if (p->info.pipeline) vkDestroyPipeline(P.device, p->info.pipeline, NULL);
            if (p->fast && p->fast != p->info.pipeline) vkDestroyPipeline(P.device, p->fast, NULL);
            free(p->bindings), free(p);
        }
        pipes[i] = NULL;
    }
    libs_destroy();
    for (int i = 0; i < LAYOUT_BUCKETS; i++) {
        for (Layout *l = layouts[i], *n; l; l = n) {
            n = l->next;
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++)
                if (l->tpl[k]) P.tpl_destroy(P.device, l->tpl[k], NULL);
            vkDestroyPipelineLayout(P.device, l->layout, NULL);
            for (int h = 0; h < 2; h++)
                if (l->half[h]) vkDestroyPipelineLayout(P.device, l->half[h], NULL);
            vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(P.device, l->set, NULL);
            if (l->set1) vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(P.device, l->set1, NULL);
            free(l);
        }
        layouts[i] = NULL;
    }
    plat_mutex_lock(&save_lock);   // not while the autosave thread copies it
    if (P.cache) vkDestroyPipelineCache(P.device, P.cache, NULL);
    P.cache = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&save_lock);
    memset(&P.stats, 0, sizeof P.stats);
    plat_xchg32(&P.ready, 0);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&P.lock);
}

// ---- self-test: census shaders (probe_census_dir, tools/shader_census.py) through gfx_shader_get into pipelines.
// Graphics pairs are a fragment shader and a vertex shader of the same source file, spread over the census; compute
// shaders are spread the same way. Every pipeline is built twice (the second call must hit the cache) and the
// dynamic state of the first graphics pipeline is recorded into a throwaway command buffer.

typedef struct { const char *key, *c1, *src; size_t c1_len, src_len; int stage; uint32_t local[3]; } CensusEntry;

static const char *st_field(const char *from, const char *to, const char *name, size_t *len) {
    char pat[32];
    snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "\"%s\": \"", name);
    const char *p = strstr(from, pat);
    if (!p || p >= to) return NULL;
    p += strlen(pat);
    const char *e = memchr(p, '"', (size_t)(to - p));
    if (!e) return NULL;
    *len = (size_t)(e - p);
    return p;
}

static int census_cmp(const void *x, const void *y) {
    const CensusEntry *a = x, *b = y;
    size_t n = a->src_len < b->src_len ? a->src_len : b->src_len;
    int c = memcmp(a->src, b->src, n);
    if (c) return c;
    if (a->src_len != b->src_len) return a->src_len < b->src_len ? -1 : 1;
    return a->stage - b->stage;
}

static char *census_read(const char *root, size_t *size) {
    char path[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2 + 64];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/jobs.json", root);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    char *b = malloc((size_t)n + 1);
    if (b && fread(b, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) free(b), b = NULL;
    fclose(f);
    if (b) b[n] = 0, *size = (size_t)n;
    return b;
}

static int census_parse(const char *jobs, CensusEntry *out, int max) {
    int n = 0;
    for (const char *p = jobs; n < max && (p = strstr(p, "\"job\": {")); p += 8) {
        const char *end = strstr(p, "\"origin\": ");
        if (!end) break;
        size_t kl, sl, cl, rl;
        const char *k = st_field(p, end, "key", &kl), *s = st_field(p, end, "stage", &sl), *c = st_field(p, end, "c1", &cl),
                   *r = st_field(p, end, "source", &rl);
        if (!k || !s || !c || !r || kl != 64) continue;
        CensusEntry *e = &out[n++];
        e->key = k, e->c1 = c, e->c1_len = cl / 2, e->src = r, e->src_len = rl;
        e->stage = !strncmp(s, "vs", sl) ? GFX_STAGE_VS : !strncmp(s, "ps", sl) ? GFX_STAGE_FS : GFX_STAGE_CS;
        e->local[0] = e->local[1] = e->local[2] = 1;
        const char *l = strstr(p, "\"local\": [");
        if (l && l < end) {
            l += 10;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                while (*l == ' ' || *l == '\n' || *l == '\r' || *l == ',') l++;
                e->local[i] = (uint32_t)strtoul(l, (char **)&l, 10);
            }
        }
    }
    return n;
}

static int hexv(char c) { return c <= '9' ? c - '0' : (c | 32) - 'a' + 10; }

// The program the game would hand NVN for a census entry, translated with default answers (as gfx_shader_probe.c).
static const GfxShader *census_shader(const char *root, const CensusEntry *e) {
    char path[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2 + 128];
    static uint8_t c1[8192];
    uint8_t control[0x880] = {0};
    if (e->c1_len > sizeof c1) return NULL;
    for (size_t b = 0; b < e->c1_len; b++) c1[b] = (uint8_t)(hexv(e->c1[b * 2]) << 4 | hexv(e->c1[b * 2 + 1]));
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/code/%.64s.code", root, e->key);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long body = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    size_t skip = e->stage == GFX_STAGE_CS ? 0 : 0x30, total = skip + (size_t)body;
    uint8_t *code = calloc(1, total);
    int ok = code && fread(code + skip, 1, (size_t)body, f) == (size_t)body;
    fclose(f);
    if (!ok) return free(code), NULL;
    uint32_t c1_off = (uint32_t)(total - e->c1_len), length = (uint32_t)total;
    memcpy(control + 0x700, &c1_off, 4), memcpy(control + 0x704, &length, 4);
    GfxShaderAnswers a = {0};
    if (e->stage == GFX_STAGE_CS) for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) a.local[k] = (uint16_t)e->local[k];
    const GfxShader *s = gfx_shader_get(e->stage, control, code, total, c1, &a);
    free(code);
    return s;
}

// A state for a census pair: one target per fragment output (RGBA8 of the output's type), D32S8 depth with the test on,
// alpha blending on target 0, one RGBA32 attribute per vertex input, interleaved in stream 0.
static void selftest_state(VkPipeState *s, const GfxShader *vs, const GfxShader *fs) {
    vk_pipe_state_defaults(s);
    s->vs = vs, s->fs = fs;
    GfxShaderIo io[32];
    uint32_t outs = gfx_shader_outputs(fs, io);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        if (outs >> i & 1)
            s->color_fmt[i] = io[i].type == GFX_TYPE_UINT ? NVN_FORMAT_RGBA8UI : io[i].type == GFX_TYPE_SINT ? NVN_FORMAT_RGBA8I
                                                                                                            : NVN_FORMAT_RGBA8;
    s->depth_fmt = NVN_FORMAT_DEPTH32F_STENCIL8;
    s->ds.dt = 1;
    s->color.blend_en = 1;
    s->blend[0].src_rgb = NVN_BLEND_FUNC_SRC_ALPHA, s->blend[0].dst_rgb = NVN_BLEND_FUNC_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA;
    s->poly.cull = NVN_FACE_BACK;
    uint32_t ins = gfx_shader_inputs(vs, io), off = 0;
    for (int l = 0; l < 16; l++)
        if (ins >> l & 1) {
            va_st a = {io[l].type == GFX_TYPE_UINT ? NVN_FORMAT_RGBA32UI : io[l].type == GFX_TYPE_SINT ? NVN_FORMAT_RGBA32I
                                                                                                      : NVN_FORMAT_RGBA32F,
                       off, 0};
            memcpy(&s->vattr[l], &a, sizeof a);
            off += 16;
        }
    s->vstream[0].stride = off ? off : 16;
}

// Records the dynamic state of a pipeline into a command buffer that is never submitted (validation checks the calls).
static int selftest_record(const VkPipeState *s, VkPipeline pipe) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo pi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .queueFamilyIndex = c->gfx_family};
    VkCommandPool pool;
    if (vkCreateCommandPool(c->device, &pi, NULL, &pool) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO, .commandPool = pool,
                                      .level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY, .commandBufferCount = 1};
    VkCommandBuffer cb;
    int ok = vkAllocateCommandBuffers(c->device, &ai, &cb) == VK_SUCCESS;
    if (ok) {
        VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO,
                                       .flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT};
        vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &bi);
        vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipe);
        vk_pipeline_set_dynamic(cb, s);
        ok = vkEndCommandBuffer(cb) == VK_SUCCESS;
    }
    vkDestroyCommandPool(c->device, pool, NULL);
    return ok;
}

int vk_pipeline_selftest(void) {
    enum { MAXN = 20000, WANT_PAIRS = 64, WANT_CS = 16 };
    char root[PLAT_PATH_MAX * 2];
    if (!vk_init() || !ensure_init()) { printf("vk_pipeline selftest: FAILED: no Vulkan device\n"); return 1; }
    if (!probe_census_dir(root, sizeof root)) {   // the census folder, build/<version>/shaders
        printf("vk_pipeline selftest: FAILED: no build/v%d/shaders/jobs.json above the exe\n", rt_game_version);
        return 1;
    }
    size_t size;
    char *jobs = census_read(root, &size);
    CensusEntry *e = malloc(sizeof *e * MAXN);
    int n = jobs && e ? census_parse(jobs, e, MAXN) : 0;
    if (!n) { printf("vk_pipeline selftest: FAILED: no census entries\n"); free(jobs), free(e); return 1; }
    qsort(e, (size_t)n, sizeof *e, census_cmp);
    long err0 = vk_validation_errors_total();
    VkPipeStats st0;
    vk_pipeline_stats(&st0);

    // candidate pairs: each fragment shader of a source file with one of the file's vertex shaders (round robin)
    int (*pairs)[2] = malloc(sizeof *pairs * (size_t)n), np = 0, *cs = malloc(sizeof *cs * (size_t)n), nc = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n;) {
        int j = i, v0 = -1, nv = 0, nf = 0;
        for (; j < n && e[j].src_len == e[i].src_len && !memcmp(e[j].src, e[i].src, e[i].src_len); j++) {
            if (e[j].stage == GFX_STAGE_VS && v0 < 0) v0 = j;   // sorted by stage within a file: vertex shaders first
            nv += e[j].stage == GFX_STAGE_VS;
            if (e[j].stage == GFX_STAGE_CS) cs[nc++] = j;
        }
        for (int k = i; k < j && nv; k++)
            if (e[k].stage == GFX_STAGE_FS) pairs[np][0] = v0 + nf++ % nv, pairs[np][1] = k, np++;
        i = j;
    }
    int tried = 0, built = 0, cached = 1, shader_fail = 0, ctried = 0, cbuilt = 0, recorded = 0, varying_fix = 0;
    for (int t = 0; t < WANT_PAIRS && t < np; t++) {
        const int *pr = pairs[(long long)t * np / (np < WANT_PAIRS ? np : WANT_PAIRS)];
        tried++;
        const GfxShader *vs = census_shader(root, &e[pr[0]]), *fs = census_shader(root, &e[pr[1]]);
        if (!vs || !fs) { shader_fail++; continue; }
        if (gfx_shader_inputs(fs, NULL) & ~gfx_shader_outputs(vs, NULL)) varying_fix++;
        VkPipeState s;
        selftest_state(&s, vs, fs);
        GfxShaderAnswers fa = {0};
        vk_pipeline_answers(&s, NULL, &fa);
        const VkPipeInfo *info;
        VkPipeline p = vk_pipeline_graphics(&s, &info);
        if (!p) continue;
        built++;
        const VkPipeInfo *again;
        if (vk_pipeline_graphics(&s, &again) != p || again != info) cached = 0;
        if (!recorded) recorded = selftest_record(&s, p);
    }
    for (int t = 0; t < WANT_CS && t < nc; t++) {
        const CensusEntry *c = &e[cs[(long long)t * nc / (nc < WANT_CS ? nc : WANT_CS)]];
        ctried++;
        const GfxShader *s = census_shader(root, c);
        if (!s) { shader_fail++; continue; }
        const VkPipeInfo *info;
        VkPipeline p = vk_pipeline_compute(s, &info);
        if (!p) continue;
        cbuilt++;
        const VkPipeInfo *again;
        if (vk_pipeline_compute(s, &again) != p || again != info) cached = 0;
    }
    vk_pipeline_save();
    VkPipeStats st;
    vk_pipeline_stats(&st);
    long errors = vk_validation_errors_total() - err0;
    printf("vk_pipeline selftest: graphics %d/%d census pairs (%d needed vertex outputs added), compute %d/%d, "
           "%d shaders failed to translate; layouts %llu (%llu push); cache hits %llu; dynamic state recorded %d; "
           "validation errors %ld\n",
           built, tried, varying_fix, cbuilt, ctried, shader_fail, (unsigned long long)(st.layouts - st0.layouts),
           (unsigned long long)(st.push_layouts - st0.push_layouts), (unsigned long long)(st.hits - st0.hits), recorded,
           errors);
    free(pairs), free(cs), free(e), free(jobs);
    int ok = built > 0 && cbuilt > 0 && cached && recorded && errors == 0;
    printf("vk_pipeline selftest: %s\n", ok ? "passed" : "FAILED");
    return ok ? 0 : 1;
}

```

`runtime/vk_pool_probe.c`:

```c
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// --probe-vkpool: original sampled-texture shader through the real NVN recorder and Vulkan replay.
// No game/census shader or direct descriptor injection. CPU preparation checks this exact instruction array.
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "vk_exec.h"

#define NVN_PROC(n) void nvnp_##n(Cpu *c);
#include "nvn_procs.inc"
#undef NVN_PROC

// Original Maxwell: MOV32I R0,1.25; MOV32I R1,0.5; MOV R2,c0[0x20];
// TEX.B.2D.LZ R8..R11,[R0,R1],R2; MOV R4/R5,c0[0x10/0x14]; STG.E.B128 [R4],R8; EXIT.
// DKC1: zero root words, one storage buffer and one texture. Its handle is reflected to slot 0, not read as a pointer.
static const uint64_t pool_probe_code[] = {
    UINT64_C(0x001f8000fc0007e0), UINT64_C(0x0103fa000007f000), UINT64_C(0x0103f0000007f001), UINT64_C(0x4c98078000870002),
    UINT64_C(0x001f8000fc0007e0), UINT64_C(0xdeb80027a0270008), UINT64_C(0x4c98078000470004), UINT64_C(0x4c98078000570005),
    UINT64_C(0x001f8000fc0007e0), UINT64_C(0xeede200000070408), UINT64_C(0xe30000000007000f), UINT64_C(0x0000000000000000),
};

enum { POOL_BYTES = 0x100000, TABLE_A = 0x40000, TABLE_B = 0x50000,
       TABLE_REPEAT = 0x60000, TABLE_CLAMP = 0x70000, COMMAND_OFF = 0x80000,
       OUTPUT_OFF = 0xa0000, OUTPUT_BYTES = 0x10000, CONTROL_BYTES = 4096 };
#define U(p) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(p))
#define OBJECT(type, name) static _Alignas(16) type name
OBJECT(NVNdeviceBuilder, device_builder);
OBJECT(NVNdevice, device);
OBJECT(NVNmemoryPoolBuilder, memory_builder);
OBJECT(NVNmemoryPool, memory_pool);
OBJECT(NVNtextureBuilder, texture_builder);
OBJECT(NVNtexture, red_texture);
OBJECT(NVNtexture, green_texture);
OBJECT(NVNtexture, pattern_texture);
OBJECT(NVNsamplerBuilder, sampler_builder);
OBJECT(NVNsampler, repeat_sampler);
OBJECT(NVNsampler, clamp_sampler);
OBJECT(NVNtexturePool, texture_a);
OBJECT(NVNtexturePool, texture_b);
OBJECT(NVNsamplerPool, sampler_repeat);
OBJECT(NVNsamplerPool, sampler_clamp);
OBJECT(NVNprogram, program);
OBJECT(NVNcommandBuffer, command);
static _Alignas(16) uint8_t control[0x880];
static Cpu cpu;
static unsigned checks, failures;

static uint64_t call(void (*fn)(Cpu *), const uint64_t a[8]) {
    memcpy(cpu.x, a, sizeof cpu.x[0] * 8);
    fn(&cpu);
    return cpu.x[0];
}
#define CALL(n, ...) call(nvnp_##n, (const uint64_t[8]){__VA_ARGS__})
#define REQUIRE(cond, text) do { checks++; if (!(cond)) { \
    printf("probe-vkpool: FAIL %s\n", text); failures++; goto done; } } while (0)

static int make_texture(NVNtexture *texture, uint64_t off, const uint8_t pixels[8]) {
    CALL(nvnTextureBuilderSetDevice, U(&texture_builder), U(&device));
    CALL(nvnTextureBuilderSetDefaults, U(&texture_builder));
    CALL(nvnTextureBuilderSetTarget, U(&texture_builder), NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D);
    CALL(nvnTextureBuilderSetSize2D, U(&texture_builder), 2, 1);
    CALL(nvnTextureBuilderSetLevels, U(&texture_builder), 1);
    CALL(nvnTextureBuilderSetFormat, U(&texture_builder), NVN_FORMAT_RGBA8);
    CALL(nvnTextureBuilderSetStorage, U(&texture_builder), U(&memory_pool), off);
    uint64_t bytes = CALL(nvnTextureBuilderGetStorageSize, U(&texture_builder));
    if (!bytes || bytes > 0x10000) return 0;
    if (!(uint8_t)CALL(nvnTextureInitialize, U(texture), U(&texture_builder))) return 0;
    NVNcopyRegion region = {0, 0, 0, 2, 1, 1};
    CALL(nvnTextureWriteTexels, U(texture), 0, U(&region), U(pixels));
    return 1;
}

static int make_sampler(NVNsampler *sampler, int wrap) {
    CALL(nvnSamplerBuilderSetDevice, U(&sampler_builder), U(&device));
    CALL(nvnSamplerBuilderSetDefaults, U(&sampler_builder));
    CALL(nvnSamplerBuilderSetMinMagFilter, U(&sampler_builder), NVN_MIN_FILTER_NEAREST, NVN_MAG_FILTER_NEAREST);
    CALL(nvnSamplerBuilderSetWrapMode, U(&sampler_builder), wrap, NVN_WRAP_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE, NVN_WRAP_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    return (uint8_t)CALL(nvnSamplerInitialize, U(sampler), U(&sampler_builder));
}

static int run_case(const char *name, uint8_t *memory, void *command_control, uint64_t handle,
                    const NVNtexturePool *const textures[3], const NVNsamplerPool *const samplers[3],
                    const uint32_t expected[3][4], unsigned phases, size_t stride) {
    const GfxBackend *backend = &gfx_vulkan_backend;
    memset(memory + OUTPUT_OFF, 0xa5, OUTPUT_BYTES);
    CALL(nvnMemoryPoolFlushMappedRange, U(&memory_pool), OUTPUT_OFF, OUTPUT_BYTES);
    // Re-adding this exact owned range retires the preceding recording only after its fence completed below.
    CALL(nvnCommandBufferAddControlMemory, U(&command), U(command_control), CONTROL_BYTES);
    CALL(nvnCommandBufferBeginRecording, U(&command));
    CALL(nvnCommandBufferBindProgram, U(&command), U(&program), NVN_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT);
    CALL(nvnCommandBufferBindTexture, U(&command), NVN_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE, 0, handle);
    for (unsigned phase = 0; phase < phases; phase++) {
        CALL(nvnCommandBufferSetTexturePool, U(&command), U(textures[phase]));
        CALL(nvnCommandBufferSetSamplerPool, U(&command), U(samplers[phase]));
        CALL(nvnCommandBufferBindStorageBuffer, U(&command), NVN_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE, 0,
             U(memory + OUTPUT_OFF + (phase + 1) * stride), 16);
        // SetPool alone changes descriptor identity: no handle/program bind or registration occurs between dispatches.
        for (unsigned repeat = 0; repeat < 2; repeat++) {
            CALL(nvnCommandBufferDispatchCompute, U(&command), 1, 1, 1);
        }
    }
    uint64_t commands = CALL(nvnCommandBufferEndRecording, U(&command));
    checks++;
    if (!commands) { printf("probe-vkpool: FAIL %s: no recording\n", name); failures++; return 0; }
    uint64_t fence = backend->submit(&commands, 1, rt_ticks());
    checks++;
    if (!backend->fence_wait(fence, UINT64_C(10000000000))) {
        printf("probe-vkpool: FAIL %s: fence did not complete\n", name); failures++; return 0;
    }
    backend->cpu_synced(fence);
    // The completion frontier publishes SSBO writes before fence_wait returns. Compare every word and untouched byte.
    unsigned before = failures;
    for (unsigned phase = 0; phase < phases; phase++) {
        const uint32_t *actual = (const uint32_t *)(memory + OUTPUT_OFF + (phase + 1) * stride);
        for (unsigned component = 0; component < 4; component++) {
            checks++;
            if (actual[component] != expected[phase][component]) {
                printf("probe-vkpool: FAIL %s phase %u component %u: %08x expected %08x\n",
                    name, phase, component, actual[component], expected[phase][component]);
                failures++;
            }
        }
    }
    int canary_ok = 1;
    for (size_t off = 0; off < OUTPUT_BYTES; off++) {
        size_t slot = off / stride;
        if (slot >= 1 && slot <= phases && off % stride < 16) continue;
        if (memory[OUTPUT_OFF + off] != 0xa5) { canary_ok = 0; break; }
    }
    checks++;
    if (!canary_ok) { printf("probe-vkpool: FAIL %s: output canary changed\n", name); failures++; }
    printf("probe-vkpool: %s: %s (%u pool selections, two dispatches each)\n", name,
        failures == before ? "passed" : "FAILED", phases);
    return 1;   // A semantic failure is accumulated; the following independent case still runs.
}

void vk_exec_draw_shutdown(void);
void vk_exec_xfer_shutdown(void);

int probe_vkpool(void) {
    const GfxBackend *backend = &gfx_vulkan_backend;
    checks = failures = 0;
    if (gfx_backend() != backend || !cfg_bool("TOTK_FIX_C0")) {
        printf("probe-vkpool: requires TOTK_GPU=vulkan and TOTK_FIX_C0=1\n");
        return 1;
    }
    uint64_t heap = 0;
    uint8_t *memory = NULL;
    void *command_control = NULL;
    int device_live = 0, pool_live = 0, program_live = 0, command_live = 0;
    unsigned textures_live = 0, samplers_live = 0, descriptor_pools_live = 0;
    uint64_t shader_failures = gfx_shader_failures();
    REQUIRE(!mem_set_heap_size(16ull << 20, &heap) && heap, "SetHeapSize");
    memory = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)heap;
    command_control = mem_kernel_alloc(CONTROL_BYTES, 16);
    REQUIRE(command_control, "owned command control allocation");
    CALL(nvnDeviceBuilderSetDefaults, U(&device_builder));
    REQUIRE((uint8_t)CALL(nvnDeviceInitialize, U(&device), U(&device_builder)), "DeviceInitialize");
    device_live = 1;
    CALL(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults, U(&memory_builder));
    CALL(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice, U(&memory_builder), U(&device));
    CALL(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage, U(&memory_builder), U(memory), POOL_BYTES);
    CALL(nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags, U(&memory_builder),
        NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_CPU_CACHED | NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_GPU_CACHED);
    REQUIRE((uint8_t)CALL(nvnMemoryPoolInitialize, U(&memory_pool), U(&memory_builder)), "MemoryPoolInitialize");
    pool_live = 1;
    static const uint8_t red[8] = {255, 0, 0, 255, 255, 0, 0, 255};
    static const uint8_t green[8] = {0, 255, 0, 255, 0, 255, 0, 255};
    static const uint8_t pattern[8] = {255, 0, 0, 255, 0, 255, 0, 255};
    REQUIRE(make_texture(&red_texture, 0x10000, red), "red texture"); textures_live = 1;
    REQUIRE(make_texture(&green_texture, 0x20000, green), "green texture"); textures_live = 2;
    REQUIRE(make_texture(&pattern_texture, 0x30000, pattern), "pattern texture"); textures_live = 3;
    REQUIRE(make_sampler(&repeat_sampler, NVN_WRAP_MODE_REPEAT), "repeat sampler"); samplers_live = 1;
    REQUIRE(make_sampler(&clamp_sampler, NVN_WRAP_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE), "clamp sampler"); samplers_live = 2;
    int texture_reserved = 0, sampler_reserved = 0;
    CALL(nvnDeviceGetInteger, U(&device), NVN_DEVICE_INFO_RESERVED_TEXTURE_DESCRIPTORS, U(&texture_reserved));
    CALL(nvnDeviceGetInteger, U(&device), NVN_DEVICE_INFO_RESERVED_SAMPLER_DESCRIPTORS, U(&sampler_reserved));
    REQUIRE(texture_reserved >= 0 && texture_reserved < 2044 && sampler_reserved >= 0 && sampler_reserved < 2044,
        "bounded reserved descriptor counts");
    int ti = texture_reserved + 1, si = sampler_reserved + 1;
    REQUIRE((uint8_t)CALL(nvnTexturePoolInitialize, U(&texture_a), U(&memory_pool), TABLE_A, ti + 2), "TexturePool A");
    descriptor_pools_live = 1;
    REQUIRE((uint8_t)CALL(nvnTexturePoolInitialize, U(&texture_b), U(&memory_pool), TABLE_B, ti + 2), "TexturePool B");
    descriptor_pools_live = 2;
    REQUIRE((uint8_t)CALL(nvnSamplerPoolInitialize, U(&sampler_repeat), U(&memory_pool), TABLE_REPEAT, si + 2), "SamplerPool repeat");
    descriptor_pools_live = 3;
    REQUIRE((uint8_t)CALL(nvnSamplerPoolInitialize, U(&sampler_clamp), U(&memory_pool), TABLE_CLAMP, si + 2), "SamplerPool clamp");
    descriptor_pools_live = 4;
    CALL(nvnTexturePoolRegisterTexture, U(&texture_a), ti, U(&red_texture), 0);
    CALL(nvnSamplerPoolRegisterSampler, U(&sampler_repeat), si, U(&repeat_sampler));
    uint64_t handle = CALL(nvnDeviceGetTextureHandle, U(&device), ti, si);
    REQUIRE(handle == (uint64_t)ti + ((uint64_t)si << 20), "unchanged combined handle");
    uint32_t length = sizeof pool_probe_code, stage = NVN_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE, one = 1;
    memcpy(control + 0x700, &length, 4); memcpy(control + 0x704, &length, 4);
    memcpy(control + 0x714, &stage, 4);
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < 3; k++) memcpy(control + 0x748 + 4 * k, &one, 4);
    memcpy(control + 0x860, "DKC1", 4);
    control[0x866] = 1; control[0x867] = 1;   // storage buffers, texture handles; roots/shared remain zero
    REQUIRE((uint8_t)CALL(nvnProgramInitialize, U(&program), U(&device)), "ProgramInitialize"); program_live = 1;
    NVNshaderData shader = {U(pool_probe_code), control};
    REQUIRE((uint8_t)CALL(nvnProgramSetShaders, U(&program), 1, U(&shader)), "original ProgramSetShaders");
    REQUIRE((uint8_t)CALL(nvnCommandBufferInitialize, U(&command), U(&device)), "CommandBufferInitialize"); command_live = 1;
    CALL(nvnCommandBufferAddCommandMemory, U(&command), U(&memory_pool), COMMAND_OFF, 0x10000);
    size_t stride = vk_ctx()->props.limits.minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment;
    if (stride < 256) stride = 256;
    REQUIRE(!(stride & (stride - 1)) && stride <= OUTPUT_BYTES / 8, "bounded aligned output stride");
    static const uint32_t trip[3][4] = {{0x3f800000, 0, 0, 0x3f800000}, {0, 0x3f800000, 0, 0x3f800000},
                                       {0x3f800000, 0, 0, 0x3f800000}};
    const NVNtexturePool *tp[3] = {&texture_a, &texture_b, &texture_a};
    const NVNsamplerPool *sp[3] = {&sampler_repeat, &sampler_repeat, &sampler_repeat};
    REQUIRE(run_case("one-table red control", memory, command_control, handle, tp, sp, trip, 1, stride), "control completed");
    // No registration occurs between A -> B -> A. The handle and program stay unchanged.
    CALL(nvnTexturePoolRegisterTexture, U(&texture_b), ti, U(&green_texture), 0);
    REQUIRE(run_case("texture A/B/A", memory, command_control, handle, tp, sp, trip, 3, stride), "texture case completed");
    CALL(nvnTexturePoolRegisterTexture, U(&texture_a), ti, U(&pattern_texture), 0);
    CALL(nvnSamplerPoolRegisterSampler, U(&sampler_clamp), si, U(&clamp_sampler));
    tp[1] = &texture_a; sp[1] = &sampler_clamp;
    REQUIRE(run_case("sampler repeat/clamp/repeat", memory, command_control, handle, tp, sp, trip, 3, stride), "sampler case completed");
    REQUIRE(gfx_shader_failures() == shader_failures, "no shader translation failures");
done:
    if (pool_live) backend->finish();
    if (command_live) {
        if (command_control) CALL(nvnCommandBufferAddControlMemory, U(&command), U(command_control), CONTROL_BYTES);
        CALL(nvnCommandBufferFinalize, U(&command));
    }
    if (program_live) CALL(nvnProgramFinalize, U(&program));
    if (descriptor_pools_live >= 4) CALL(nvnSamplerPoolFinalize, U(&sampler_clamp));
    if (descriptor_pools_live >= 3) CALL(nvnSamplerPoolFinalize, U(&sampler_repeat));
    if (descriptor_pools_live >= 2) CALL(nvnTexturePoolFinalize, U(&texture_b));
    if (descriptor_pools_live >= 1) CALL(nvnTexturePoolFinalize, U(&texture_a));
    if (samplers_live >= 2) CALL(nvnSamplerFinalize, U(&clamp_sampler));
    if (samplers_live >= 1) CALL(nvnSamplerFinalize, U(&repeat_sampler));
    if (textures_live >= 3) CALL(nvnTextureFinalize, U(&pattern_texture));
    if (textures_live >= 2) CALL(nvnTextureFinalize, U(&green_texture));
    if (textures_live >= 1) CALL(nvnTextureFinalize, U(&red_texture));
    if (pool_live) CALL(nvnMemoryPoolFinalize, U(&memory_pool));
    if (device_live) CALL(nvnDeviceFinalize, U(&device));
    vk_pipeline_shutdown();
    vk_exec_draw_shutdown();
    vk_exec_xfer_shutdown();
    vk_backend_shutdown();
    long errors = vk_validation_errors_total();
    printf("probe-vkpool: %s (%u checks, %u failures, %ld validation errors)\n",
        failures || errors ? "FAILED" : "passed", checks, failures, errors);
    printf("probe-vkpool: same-type compute resources; graphics bind-skip and type-changing answers are not covered\n");
    return failures || errors;
}

```

`runtime/vk_rec.c`:

```c
// The recorder thread: see vk_rec.h. One producer (the submitting thread, between rec_begin and rec_end) and one
// consumer (the recorder) share a ring of 64-bit words. A packet is a header word (op, length in words) and the
// call's arguments; its pointers point into the packet itself, so the recorder passes the payload to the driver as
// it is. A packet never wraps: one that does not fit before the end is preceded by a pad. The producer publishes head
// after each packet, or every TOTK_REC_BATCH packets when that is set; the recorder makes the calls and advances tail, which the producer waits on when the ring is
// full and in rec_drain. While a part is recorded the recorder spins on head; idle, it sleeps on an event.
// Design: Savage Wind Recomp #189 and LAS Recomp runtime/nvn/vulkan/record.c (https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp
// @ a4b53a3, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai); the code is ours.
#define VK_REC_IMPL
#include <immintrin.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define RING_WORDS (1u << 21)   // 16 MiB: a part of a submission is ~1-2 MiB of packets in the town
static uint64_t ring[RING_WORDS];
// head and tail each own a cache line: the recorder spins on head, so head must be written only when published and
// share its line with nothing the producer writes per packet (put_h, unpub, RS_).
typedef struct { _Alignas(64) volatile uint64_t v; } CacheLine;   // sizeof 64: nothing else shares the line
static CacheLine head_line, tail_line;
#define head head_line.v   // words published by the producer
#define tail tail_line.v   // words consumed by the recorder
static volatile int32_t sleeping;        // the recorder waits for wake_ev
static PlatEvent wake_ev;              // auto-reset
static uint64_t put_h;                 // producer: words written (published up to head)
static VkCommandBuffer rec_cb;         // the part being recorded (set while the recorder is idle)
static int rec_live;                   // producer: rec_begin started the recorder for rec_cb
static PlatThread *rec_thread;
static int rec_prio;                   // the submitting thread's priority, which the recorder takes

// Producer statistics, logged by rec_stats_log.
static struct { uint64_t packets, words, drains, fallbacks, drain_ns, full_waits, parts, parts_on; } RS_;

enum {
    R_PAD, R_BeginQuery, R_BeginRendering, R_BindDescriptorSets, R_BindIndexBuffer, R_BindPipeline, R_BindVertexBuffers2,
    R_BlitImage, R_ClearAttachments, R_ClearColorImage, R_ClearDepthStencilImage, R_CopyBuffer, R_CopyBufferToImage,
    R_CopyImage, R_CopyImageToBuffer, R_Dispatch, R_DispatchIndirect, R_Draw, R_DrawIndexed, R_DrawIndexedIndirect,
    R_DrawIndexedIndirectCount,
    R_EndQuery, R_EndRendering, R_FillBuffer, R_PipelineBarrier2, R_PushConstants, R_ResetQueryPool, R_ResolveImage,
    R_SetBlendConstants, R_SetCullMode, R_SetDepthBias, R_SetDepthBiasEnable, R_SetDepthCompareOp, R_SetDepthTestEnable,
    R_SetDepthWriteEnable, R_SetFrontFace, R_SetPrimitiveRestartEnable, R_SetPrimitiveTopology,
    R_SetRasterizerDiscardEnable, R_SetScissorWithCount, R_SetStencilCompareMask, R_SetStencilOp, R_SetStencilReference,
    R_SetStencilTestEnable, R_SetStencilWriteMask, R_SetViewportWithCount, R_WriteTimestamp, R_WriteTimestamp2,
    R_PushTpl, R_Push, R_VertexInput, R_Bool, R_PolygonMode, R_BlendEnable, R_BlendEquation, R_WriteMask, R_EndCb, R_Crumb, R_Checkpoint,
    R_DrawMeshTasks, R_DrawMeshTasksIndirect, R_DrawMeshTasksIndirectCount,
};

static uint64_t now_ns(void) { return plat_now_ns(); }

// ---- consumer

static void exec_packet(uint32_t op, void *p);

static void rec_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    plat_thread_priority(rec_prio);
    uint64_t t = 0;
    for (;;) {
        uint64_t h = __atomic_load_n(&head, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
        if (t == h) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 4096 && t == h; i++) _mm_pause(), h = __atomic_load_n(&head, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
            if (t == h) {
                __atomic_store_n(&sleeping, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
                h = __atomic_load_n(&head, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
                if (t == h) plat_event_wait_ns(&wake_ev, 2000000);   // a missed wake costs at most 2 ms
                __atomic_store_n(&sleeping, 0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
                continue;
            }
        }
        for (int k = 0; t != h; k++) {
            uint64_t w = ring[t % RING_WORDS];
            uint32_t op = (uint32_t)(w & 0xffff), n = (uint32_t)(w >> 32);
            if (op != R_PAD) exec_packet(op, &ring[t % RING_WORDS + 1]);
            t += n;
            if ((k & 63) == 63) __atomic_store_n(&tail, t, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        }
        __atomic_store_n(&tail, t, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    return;
}

// ---- producer

// TOTK_REC_BATCH=N (0 off): head is published every N packets, not after each, so the recorder's spin does not read a
// cache line the producer rewrites constantly. Every wait or handoff (wait_space, rec_drain) publishes the rest.
static int rec_batch;     // read once in rec_begin
static int unpub;         // producer: packets written since head was last stored

static void wake(void) {
    __atomic_thread_fence(__ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    if (__atomic_load_n(&sleeping, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) plat_event_set(&wake_ev);
}

static void wait_space(uint64_t need) {
    if (put_h + need - __atomic_load_n(&tail, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) <= RING_WORDS) return;
    RS_.full_waits++;
    unpub = 0;
    __atomic_store_n(&head, put_h, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    wake();
    while (put_h + need - __atomic_load_n(&tail, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) > RING_WORDS) _mm_pause();
}

// Room for a packet of bytes of arguments; the caller fills it and calls pub().
static void *put(uint32_t op, size_t bytes) {
    uint64_t n = 1 + (bytes + 7) / 8, pos = put_h % RING_WORDS;
    if (n > RING_WORDS / 4) rt_fatal("vk_rec: a packet of %llu bytes", (unsigned long long)bytes);
    if (pos + n > RING_WORDS) {
        uint64_t pad = RING_WORDS - pos;
        wait_space(pad);
        ring[pos] = (uint64_t)R_PAD | pad << 32;
        put_h += pad, pos = 0;
    }
    wait_space(n);
    ring[pos] = (uint64_t)op | n << 32;
    put_h += n;
    RS_.packets++, RS_.words += n;
    return &ring[pos + 1];
}

static void pub(void) {
    if (rec_batch) {
        if (++unpub < rec_batch) return;
        unpub = 0;
        __atomic_store_n(&head, put_h, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        wake();   // the recorder sleeps more often when batched; a missed wake costs up to 2 ms
        return;
    }
    __atomic_store_n(&head, put_h, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    if (__atomic_load_n(&sleeping, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) plat_event_set(&wake_ev);
}

void rec_drain(void) {
    if (!rec_thread || __atomic_load_n(&tail, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == put_h) return;
    uint64_t t0 = now_ns();
    unpub = 0;
    __atomic_store_n(&head, put_h, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    wake();
    for (int i = 0; __atomic_load_n(&tail, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) != put_h; i++)
        if (i < 20000) _mm_pause();
        else plat_yield();
    RS_.drains++, RS_.drain_ns += now_ns() - t0;
}

void rec_begin(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    static int mode = -1;
    if (mode < 0) {
        // Default off on AMD GPUs: with the recorder their drivers lost the device within the first frames, at menu
        // opens or after sustained play on RX 9070 XT / RDNA GPUs (issue #5); TOTK_VK_RECORDER=0 ended it for three
        // users; under RADV the kernel saw an illegal opcode at the end of a command buffer (issue #40).
        const char *set = cfg_get("TOTK_VK_RECORDER");
        mode = rt_knob("VK_RECORDER", vk_caps.amd ? "0" : "1");
        if (!mode && vk_caps.amd && !(set && *set))
            rt_log("vk_rec: no recorder thread on AMD GPUs (TOTK_VK_RECORDER=1 turns it on)");
        if (mode) {
            rec_batch = cfg_int("TOTK_REC_BATCH");
            if (rec_batch < 0) rec_batch = 0;
            if (rec_batch > 64) rec_batch = 64;
            if (rec_batch) rt_log("vk_rec: batched head publish every %d packets (TOTK_REC_BATCH=%d)", rec_batch, rec_batch);
            plat_event_init(&wake_ev, 0, 0);
            rec_prio = plat_thread_priority_get();
            rec_thread = plat_thread_new(rec_main, NULL, "vk recorder");
            if (!rec_thread) {
                rt_log("vk_rec: no recorder thread: the replay makes its Vulkan calls itself");
                mode = 0;
            } else {
                rt_log("vk_rec: the replay's Vulkan commands are made by a recorder thread%s",
                       mode == 2 ? " in the B blocks (TOTK_AB)" : "");
            }
        }
    }
    RS_.parts++;
    if (!RT_KNOB_ON(mode)) return;
    RS_.parts_on++;
    rec_cb = cb;   // the recorder is idle: rec_end drained it
    rec_live = 1;
}

void rec_end(void) {
    if (!rec_live) return;
    rec_drain();
    rec_live = 0;
}

// TOTK_REC_END (default 1): the thread that recorded the part also ends it, after the breadcrumb crumb (kind 0: none)
// that vk_sync.c writes at the end of a submission. On an RX 6700 XT (driver 26.10.1, issue #5) parts the recorder
// recorded and the submitting thread ended broke when a submission was split (vk_sync.c vk_sync_split): the GPU hung
// or the scene turned green, then white. The handoff in rec_drain orders the two threads, so Vulkan allows the old
// split; the driver did not cope with it. TOTK_REC_END=0 brings the old split back.
typedef struct { int kind; uint64_t n; } A_EndCb;
int rec_end_cb(VkCommandBuffer cb, int crumb, uint64_t n) {
    static int mode = -1;
    if (mode < 0) {
        mode = rt_knob("REC_END", "1");
        rt_log("vk_rec: a part the recorder records is ended by %s (TOTK_REC_END=%d)",
               mode ? "the recorder" : "the submitting thread", mode);
    }
    if (!rec_live || cb != rec_cb || !mode) {
        rec_end();
        if (crumb) vk_crumb(cb, crumb, n);
        return 0;
    }
    A_EndCb *a = put(R_EndCb, sizeof *a);
    *a = (A_EndCb){crumb, n};
    pub();
    rec_drain();
    rec_live = 0;
    return 1;
}

void rec_stats_log(void) {
    if (!(rt_trace & RT_TRACE_PERF) || !RS_.parts) return;
    rt_log("vk_rec: %llu of %llu parts recorded by the recorder: %llu packets (%.1f MiB), %llu drains (%llu for a call "
           "without a packet) waited %.2f ms in all, ring full %llu times",
           (unsigned long long)RS_.parts_on, (unsigned long long)RS_.parts, (unsigned long long)RS_.packets,
           RS_.words * 8 / 1048576.0, (unsigned long long)RS_.drains, (unsigned long long)RS_.fallbacks,
           RS_.drain_ns / 1e6, (unsigned long long)RS_.full_waits);
    memset(&RS_, 0, sizeof RS_);
}

#define OWNED(cb) (rec_live && (cb) == rec_cb)
// A call the ring takes no packet for: everything queued first, then the call here.
#define FALLBACK() (rec_drain(), RS_.fallbacks++)

// Copies n elements of arr after the fixed part at *at and returns where they went (NULL for none).
static void *tail_copy(uint8_t **at, const void *arr, size_t bytes) {
    if (!arr || !bytes) return NULL;
    void *d = *at;
    memcpy(d, arr, bytes);
    *at += (bytes + 7) & ~(size_t)7;
    return d;
}
#define A8(x) (((x) + 7) & ~(size_t)7)

// ---- fixed-size commands: the arguments after cb, as a struct

#define FIXED(name, params, call_args, ...)                                                                             \
    typedef struct { __VA_ARGS__; } A_##name;                                                                          \
    void rc_vkCmd##name params {                                                                                       \
        if (!OWNED(cb)) { vkCmd##name call_args; return; }                                                             \
        A_##name *a = put(R_##name, sizeof *a);                                                                        \
        PACK_##name;                                                                                                    \
        pub();                                                                                                          \
    }

#define PACK_BeginQuery *a = (A_BeginQuery){p, q, f}
FIXED(BeginQuery, (VkCommandBuffer cb, VkQueryPool p, uint32_t q, VkQueryControlFlags f), (cb, p, q, f),
      VkQueryPool p; uint32_t q; VkQueryControlFlags f)
#define PACK_BindIndexBuffer *a = (A_BindIndexBuffer){b, o, t}
FIXED(BindIndexBuffer, (VkCommandBuffer cb, VkBuffer b, VkDeviceSize o, VkIndexType t), (cb, b, o, t), VkBuffer b;
      VkDeviceSize o; VkIndexType t)
// MKW_GPU_CHECKPOINTS=1: a checkpoint in front of a dispatch, copy, blit or clear (vk_crumbs.c vk_checkpoint_tag), so a
// lost device names that command and not only the pipeline bound before it. The dispatch checkpoints carry the compute
// pipeline last bound here, which is why the binds are written by hand. Nothing happens with the checkpoints off.
static void mark(VkCommandBuffer cb, const char *kind) {
    if (vk_checkpoints_on()) rec_checkpoint(cb, vk_checkpoint_tag(kind));
}

typedef struct { VkPipelineBindPoint bp; VkPipeline p; } A_BindPipeline;
void rc_vkCmdBindPipeline(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkPipelineBindPoint bp, VkPipeline p) {
    if (bp == VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE && vk_checkpoints_on()) vk_checkpoint_compute(p);

    A_BindPipeline *a = put(R_BindPipeline, sizeof *a);
    *a = (A_BindPipeline){bp, p};
    pub();
}

typedef struct { uint32_t first, n; const VkBuffer *b; const VkDeviceSize *o, *sz, *st; } A_BindVertexBuffers2;

                                const VkDeviceSize *sz, const VkDeviceSize *st) {
    if (!OWNED(cb)) { vkCmdBindVertexBuffers2(cb, first, n, b, o, sz, st); return; }
    size_t e = sizeof(VkDeviceSize) * n;
    A_BindVertexBuffers2 *a = put(R_BindVertexBuffers2, sizeof *a + A8(sizeof *b * n) + 3 * A8(e));
    uint8_t *at = (uint8_t *)(a + 1);
    a->first = first, a->n = n;
    a->b = tail_copy(&at, b, sizeof *b * n), a->o = tail_copy(&at, o, e);
    a->sz = sz ? tail_copy(&at, sz, e) : NULL, a->st = st ? tail_copy(&at, st, e) : NULL;
    pub();
}

typedef struct { VkImage s; VkImageLayout sl; VkImage d; VkImageLayout dl; uint32_t n; const void *r; VkFilter f; } A_Img;
#define IMG_CMD(name, rtype, params, call, ...)                                                                         \
    void rc_vkCmd##name params {                                                                                       \
        mark(cb, #name);                                                                                                \
        if (!OWNED(cb)) { vkCmd##name call; return; }                                                                  \
        A_Img *a = put(R_##name, sizeof *a + sizeof(rtype) * n);                                                       \
        uint8_t *at = (uint8_t *)(a + 1);                                                                              \
        *a = (A_Img){__VA_ARGS__};                                                                                      \
        a->r = tail_copy(&at, r, sizeof(rtype) * n);                                                                   \
        pub();                                                                                                          \
    }
IMG_CMD(BlitImage, VkImageBlit, (VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage s, VkImageLayout sl, VkImage d, VkImageLayout dl, uint32_t n,
        const VkImageBlit *r, VkFilter f), (cb, s, sl, d, dl, n, r, f), s, sl, d, dl, n, NULL, f)
IMG_CMD(CopyImage, VkImageCopy, (VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage s, VkImageLayout sl, VkImage d, VkImageLayout dl, uint32_t n,
        const VkImageCopy *r), (cb, s, sl, d, dl, n, r), s, sl, d, dl, n, NULL, 0)
IMG_CMD(ResolveImage, VkImageResolve, (VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage s, VkImageLayout sl, VkImage d, VkImageLayout dl,
        uint32_t n, const VkImageResolve *r), (cb, s, sl, d, dl, n, r), s, sl, d, dl, n, NULL, 0)

    }

void rc_vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(VkCommandBuffer cb, const VkDependencyInfo *di) {
    if (!OWNED(cb)) { vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, di); return; }
    int chained = di->pNext != NULL;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < di->memoryBarrierCount; i++) chained |= di->pMemoryBarriers[i].pNext != NULL;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < di->bufferMemoryBarrierCount; i++) chained |= di->pBufferMemoryBarriers[i].pNext != NULL;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < di->imageMemoryBarrierCount; i++) chained |= di->pImageMemoryBarriers[i].pNext != NULL;
    if (chained) { FALLBACK(); vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, di); return; }
    size_t m = sizeof *di->pMemoryBarriers * di->memoryBarrierCount;
    size_t b = sizeof *di->pBufferMemoryBarriers * di->bufferMemoryBarrierCount;
    size_t im = sizeof *di->pImageMemoryBarriers * di->imageMemoryBarrierCount;
    VkDependencyInfo *a = put(R_PipelineBarrier2, sizeof *a + A8(m) + A8(b) + A8(im));
    uint8_t *at = (uint8_t *)(a + 1);
    *a = *di;
    a->pMemoryBarriers = tail_copy(&at, di->pMemoryBarriers, m);
    a->pBufferMemoryBarriers = tail_copy(&at, di->pBufferMemoryBarriers, b);
    a->pImageMemoryBarriers = tail_copy(&at, di->pImageMemoryBarriers, im);
    pub();
}

void rc_vkCmdBeginRendering(VkCommandBuffer cb, const VkRenderingInfo *ri) {
    if (!OWNED(cb)) { vkCmdBeginRendering(cb, ri); return; }
    int chained = ri->pNext != NULL || (ri->pDepthAttachment && ri->pDepthAttachment->pNext) ||
                  (ri->pStencilAttachment && ri->pStencilAttachment->pNext);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ri->colorAttachmentCount; i++) chained |= ri->pColorAttachments[i].pNext != NULL;
    if (chained) { FALLBACK(); vkCmdBeginRendering(cb, ri); return; }
    size_t c = sizeof *ri->pColorAttachments * ri->colorAttachmentCount, one = sizeof(VkRenderingAttachmentInfo);
    VkRenderingInfo *a = put(R_BeginRendering, sizeof *a + A8(c) + 2 * A8(one));
    uint8_t *at = (uint8_t *)(a + 1);
    *a = *ri;
    a->pColorAttachments = tail_copy(&at, ri->pColorAttachments, c);
    a->pDepthAttachment = ri->pDepthAttachment ? tail_copy(&at, ri->pDepthAttachment, one) : NULL;
    a->pStencilAttachment = ri->pStencilAttachment ? tail_copy(&at, ri->pStencilAttachment, one) : NULL;
    pub();
}

typedef struct { PFN_vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR fn; VkPipelineBindPoint bp; VkPipelineLayout l; uint32_t set, n;
                 VkWriteDescriptorSet *w; } A_Push;
void rec_push(PFN_vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, VkPipelineBindPoint bp, VkPipelineLayout layout,
              uint32_t set, uint32_t n, const VkWriteDescriptorSet *w) {
    if (!OWNED(cb)) { fn(cb, bp, layout, set, n, w); return; }
    size_t bytes = A8(sizeof *w * n);
    int chained = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        chained |= w[i].pNext != NULL;
        if (w[i].pBufferInfo) bytes += A8(sizeof *w[i].pBufferInfo * w[i].descriptorCount);
        if (w[i].pImageInfo) bytes += A8(sizeof *w[i].pImageInfo * w[i].descriptorCount);
        if (w[i].pTexelBufferView) bytes += A8(sizeof *w[i].pTexelBufferView * w[i].descriptorCount);
    }
    if (chained) { FALLBACK(); fn(cb, bp, layout, set, n, w); return; }
    A_Push *a = put(R_Push, sizeof *a + bytes);
    uint8_t *at = (uint8_t *)(a + 1);
    *a = (A_Push){fn, bp, layout, set, n, NULL};
    a->w = tail_copy(&at, w, sizeof *w * n);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint32_t k = w[i].descriptorCount;
        a->w[i].pBufferInfo = tail_copy(&at, w[i].pBufferInfo, w[i].pBufferInfo ? sizeof *w[i].pBufferInfo * k : 0);
        a->w[i].pImageInfo = tail_copy(&at, w[i].pImageInfo, w[i].pImageInfo ? sizeof *w[i].pImageInfo * k : 0);
        a->w[i].pTexelBufferView =
            tail_copy(&at, w[i].pTexelBufferView, w[i].pTexelBufferView ? sizeof *w[i].pTexelBufferView * k : 0);
    }
    pub();
}

typedef struct { PFN_vkCmdSetVertexInputEXT fn; uint32_t nb, na; const VkVertexInputBindingDescription2EXT *b;
                 const VkVertexInputAttributeDescription2EXT *v; } A_VertexInput;
void rec_vertex_input(PFN_vkCmdSetVertexInputEXT fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, uint32_t nb,
                      const VkVertexInputBindingDescription2EXT *b, uint32_t na,
                      const VkVertexInputAttributeDescription2EXT *v) {
    if (!OWNED(cb)) { fn(cb, nb, b, na, v); return; }
    A_VertexInput *a = put(R_VertexInput, sizeof *a + A8(sizeof *b * nb) + A8(sizeof *v * na));
    uint8_t *at = (uint8_t *)(a + 1);
    *a = (A_VertexInput){fn, nb, na, NULL, NULL};
    a->b = tail_copy(&at, b, sizeof *b * nb), a->v = tail_copy(&at, v, sizeof *v * na);   // pNext: always NULL there
    pub();
}

typedef struct { PFN_vkCmdSetDepthClampEnableEXT fn; VkBool32 v; } A_Bool;
void rec_bool(PFN_vkCmdSetDepthClampEnableEXT fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, VkBool32 v) {
    if (!OWNED(cb)) { fn(cb, v); return; }
    A_Bool *a = put(R_Bool, sizeof *a);
    *a = (A_Bool){fn, v};
    pub();
}

typedef struct { PFN_vkCmdSetPolygonModeEXT fn; VkPolygonMode m; } A_PolygonMode;
void rec_polygon_mode(PFN_vkCmdSetPolygonModeEXT fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, VkPolygonMode m) {
    if (!OWNED(cb)) { fn(cb, m); return; }
    A_PolygonMode *a = put(R_PolygonMode, sizeof *a);
    *a = (A_PolygonMode){fn, m};
    pub();
}

typedef struct { void *fn; uint32_t first, n; const void *v; } A_Targets;
#define TARGET_CMD(fname, R, PFN, T)                                                                                    \
    void fname(PFN fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, uint32_t first, uint32_t n, const T *v) {                                    \
        if (!OWNED(cb)) { fn(cb, first, n, v); return; }                                                               \
        A_Targets *a = put(R, sizeof *a + sizeof *v * n);                                                              \
        uint8_t *at = (uint8_t *)(a + 1);                                                                              \
        *a = (A_Targets){(void *)fn, first, n, NULL};                                                                   \
        a->v = tail_copy(&at, v, sizeof *v * n);                                                                       \
        pub();                                                                                                          \
    }
TARGET_CMD(rec_blend_enable, R_BlendEnable, PFN_vkCmdSetColorBlendEnableEXT, VkBool32)
TARGET_CMD(rec_blend_equation, R_BlendEquation, PFN_vkCmdSetColorBlendEquationEXT, VkColorBlendEquationEXT)
TARGET_CMD(rec_write_mask, R_WriteMask, PFN_vkCmdSetColorWriteMaskEXT, VkColorComponentFlags)

// ---- the recorder's side

static void exec_packet(uint32_t op, void *p) {
    VkCommandBuffer cb = rec_cb;
    switch (op) {
#define F(name, ...) case R_##name: { A_##name *a = p; vkCmd##name(cb, __VA_ARGS__); break; }
    F(BeginQuery, a->p, a->q, a->f)
    F(BindIndexBuffer, a->b, a->o, a->t)
    F(BindPipeline, a->bp, a->p)
    F(Dispatch, a->x, a->y, a->z)
    F(DispatchIndirect, a->b, a->o)
    F(Draw, a->n, a->i, a->f, a->fi)
    F(DrawIndexed, a->n, a->i, a->f, a->v, a->fi)
    F(DrawIndexedIndirect, a->b, a->o, a->n, a->s)
    F(DrawIndexedIndirectCount, a->b, a->o, a->cbuf, a->co, a->max, a->s)
    F(EndQuery, a->p, a->q)
    F(FillBuffer, a->b, a->o, a->n, a->v)
    F(ResetQueryPool, a->p, a->f, a->n)
    F(SetBlendConstants, a->c)
    F(SetCullMode, a->v)
    F(SetDepthBias, a->c, a->cl, a->s)
    F(SetDepthBiasEnable, a->v)
    F(SetDepthCompareOp, a->v)
    F(SetDepthTestEnable, a->v)
    F(SetDepthWriteEnable, a->v)
    F(SetFrontFace, a->v)
    F(SetPrimitiveRestartEnable, a->v)
    F(SetPrimitiveTopology, a->v)
    F(SetRasterizerDiscardEnable, a->v)
    F(SetStencilCompareMask, a->f, a->v)
    F(SetStencilOp, a->f, a->x, a->y, a->z, a->d)
    F(SetStencilReference, a->f, a->v)
    F(SetStencilTestEnable, a->v)
    F(SetStencilWriteMask, a->f, a->v)
    F(WriteTimestamp, a->s, a->p, a->q)
    F(WriteTimestamp2, a->s, a->p, a->q)
    F(SetViewportWithCount, a->n, a->v)
    F(SetScissorWithCount, a->n, a->r)
    F(BindDescriptorSets, a->bp, a->l, a->first, a->n, a->s, a->nd, a->d)
    F(BindVertexBuffers2, a->first, a->n, a->b, a->o, a->sz, a->st)
    F(ClearAttachments, a->na, a->a, a->nr, a->r)
    case R_ClearColorImage: { A_ClearImage *a = p; vkCmdClearColorImage(cb, a->i, a->l, &a->v.c, a->n, a->r); break; }
    case R_ClearDepthStencilImage: {
        A_ClearImage *a = p;
        vkCmdClearDepthStencilImage(cb, a->i, a->l, &a->v.ds, a->n, a->r);
        break;
    }
    F(PushConstants, a->l, a->st, a->o, a->n, a->v)
#undef F
    case R_EndRendering: vkCmdEndRendering(cb); break;
    case R_BlitImage: { A_Img *a = p; vkCmdBlitImage(cb, a->s, a->sl, a->d, a->dl, a->n, a->r, a->f); break; }
    case R_CopyImage: { A_Img *a = p; vkCmdCopyImage(cb, a->s, a->sl, a->d, a->dl, a->n, a->r); break; }
    case R_ResolveImage: { A_Img *a = p; vkCmdResolveImage(cb, a->s, a->sl, a->d, a->dl, a->n, a->r); break; }
    case R_CopyBuffer: { A_Xfer *a = p; vkCmdCopyBuffer(cb, (VkBuffer)a->s, (VkBuffer)a->d, a->n, a->r); break; }
    case R_CopyBufferToImage: {
        A_Xfer *a = p;
        vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, (VkBuffer)a->s, (VkImage)a->d, a->l, a->n, a->r);
        break;
    }
    case R_CopyImageToBuffer: {
        A_Xfer *a = p;
        vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, (VkImage)a->s, a->l, (VkBuffer)a->d, a->n, a->r);
        break;
    }
    case R_PipelineBarrier2: vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, p); break;
    case R_BeginRendering: vkCmdBeginRendering(cb, p); break;
    case R_PushTpl: { A_PushTpl *a = p; a->fn(cb, a->tpl, a->l, a->set, a->data); break; }
    case R_Push: { A_Push *a = p; a->fn(cb, a->bp, a->l, a->set, a->n, a->w); break; }
    case R_VertexInput: { A_VertexInput *a = p; a->fn(cb, a->nb, a->b, a->na, a->v); break; }
    case R_Bool: { A_Bool *a = p; a->fn(cb, a->v); break; }
    case R_PolygonMode: { A_PolygonMode *a = p; a->fn(cb, a->m); break; }
    case R_BlendEnable: { A_Targets *a = p; ((PFN_vkCmdSetColorBlendEnableEXT)a->fn)(cb, a->first, a->n, a->v); break; }
    case R_BlendEquation: { A_Targets *a = p; ((PFN_vkCmdSetColorBlendEquationEXT)a->fn)(cb, a->first, a->n, a->v); break; }
    case R_WriteMask: { A_Targets *a = p; ((PFN_vkCmdSetColorWriteMaskEXT)a->fn)(cb, a->first, a->n, a->v); break; }
    case R_Checkpoint: { A_Checkpoint *a = p; vk_checkpoint(cb, a->marker); break; }
    case R_Crumb: { A_Crumb *a = p; vk_crumb(cb, a->kind, a->n); break; }
    case R_DrawMeshTasks: {
        A_DrawMeshTasks *a = p;
        PFN_vkCmdDrawMeshTasksEXT fn = vk_ctx()->cmd_draw_mesh_tasks;
        if (fn) fn(cb, a->x, a->y, a->z);
        break;
    }
    case R_DrawMeshTasksIndirect: {
        A_DrawMeshTasksIndirect *a = p;
        PFN_vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectEXT fn = vk_ctx()->cmd_draw_mesh_tasks_indirect;
        if (fn) fn(cb, a->b, a->o, a->n, a->s);
        break;
    }
    case R_DrawMeshTasksIndirectCount: {
        A_DrawMeshTasksIndirectCount *a = p;
        PFN_vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectCountEXT fn = vk_ctx()->cmd_draw_mesh_tasks_indirect_count;
        if (fn) fn(cb, a->b, a->o, a->cbuf, a->co, a->max, a->s);
        break;
    }
    case R_EndCb: {
        A_EndCb *a = p;
        if (a->kind) vk_crumb(cb, a->kind, a->n);
        vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
        break;
    }
    default: rt_fatal("vk_rec: unknown packet %u", op);
    }
}

```

`runtime/vk_rec.h`:

```h
// The recorder thread (vk_rec.c): the Vulkan calls the replay makes into its command buffer are made by a thread of
// their own. vk_sync.c brackets each part of a submission with rec_begin (after vkBeginCommandBuffer) and rec_end
// (before vkEndCommandBuffer). In between, every vkCmd* on that command buffer copies its arguments into a packet of a
// ring, in call order, and the recorder makes the real call in that order; calls into any other command buffer (uploads,
// the window, probes) are made at once. A call the ring has no packet for (a structure with a pNext chain) waits for
// the recorder to empty the ring and is then made at once on the calling thread. rec_end returns once the recorder made
// every call. vk_sync.c ends a part through rec_end_cb: the recorder makes the last calls into a part it recorded,
// vkEndCommandBuffer included; submitting and the command pool stay on the submitting thread.
//
// Every vkCmd* the runtime calls through vk.h goes through the rc_* wrappers below (the macros at the end); the
// extension commands called through function pointers have rec_* wrappers of their own. TOTK_VK_RECORDER=0 makes every
// call at once (the same calls in the same order), =ab switches it with the A/B blocks (rt_ab), per submission part.
//
// The design follows Savage Wind Recomp's and LAS Recomp's recorder threads (LAS Recomp runtime/nvn/vulkan/record.c,
// MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai): the driver's work behind the commands depends on nothing the replay decides next.
#pragma once

void rec_begin(VkCommandBuffer cb);   // the submitting thread, sub_lock held
void rec_end(void);                   // waits for the recorder; no-op when rec_begin did not start it
// The end of part cb: the breadcrumb crumb (0: none, vk_crumbs.c), then vkEndCommandBuffer, both made by the recorder
// when it records cb, and the wait for it (1); otherwise rec_end and the breadcrumb, and the caller ends cb (0).
int rec_end_cb(VkCommandBuffer cb, int crumb, uint64_t n);
void rec_drain(void);                 // waits until the recorder made every call queued so far
void rec_stats_log(void);             // TOTK_TRACE=perf: packets, bytes, drains and waits since the last call

// Extension commands called through device function pointers.
void rec_crumb(VkCommandBuffer cb, int kind, uint64_t n);   // vk_crumb in order with this command buffer's packets
void rec_checkpoint(VkCommandBuffer cb, const void *marker);   // vk_checkpoint in order with this command buffer's packets
void rec_push_tpl(PFN_vkCmdPushDescriptorSetWithTemplateKHR fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, VkDescriptorUpdateTemplate tpl,
                  VkPipelineLayout layout, uint32_t set, const void *data, uint32_t bytes);   // data: bytes read by tpl
void rec_push(PFN_vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, VkPipelineBindPoint bp, VkPipelineLayout layout,
              uint32_t set, uint32_t n, const VkWriteDescriptorSet *w);
void rec_vertex_input(PFN_vkCmdSetVertexInputEXT fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, uint32_t nb,
                      const VkVertexInputBindingDescription2EXT *b, uint32_t na,
                      const VkVertexInputAttributeDescription2EXT *a);
void rec_bool(PFN_vkCmdSetDepthClampEnableEXT fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, VkBool32 v);   // also alpha to coverage
void rec_polygon_mode(PFN_vkCmdSetPolygonModeEXT fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, VkPolygonMode m);
void rec_blend_enable(PFN_vkCmdSetColorBlendEnableEXT fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, uint32_t first, uint32_t n, const VkBool32 *v);
void rec_blend_equation(PFN_vkCmdSetColorBlendEquationEXT fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, uint32_t first, uint32_t n,
                        const VkColorBlendEquationEXT *v);
void rec_write_mask(PFN_vkCmdSetColorWriteMaskEXT fn, VkCommandBuffer cb, uint32_t first, uint32_t n,
                    const VkColorComponentFlags *v);
void rec_draw_mesh_tasks(VkCommandBuffer cb, uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z);
void rec_draw_mesh_tasks_indirect(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkBuffer b, VkDeviceSize o, uint32_t n, uint32_t s);
void rec_draw_mesh_tasks_indirect_count(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkBuffer b, VkDeviceSize o, VkBuffer cbuf, VkDeviceSize co,
                                        uint32_t max, uint32_t s);

#define REC_CMDS(X)                                                                                                       \
    X(BeginQuery, (VkCommandBuffer cb, VkQueryPool p, uint32_t q, VkQueryControlFlags f), (cb, p, q, f))                  \
    X(BeginRendering, (VkCommandBuffer cb, const VkRenderingInfo *ri), (cb, ri))                                          \

    X(Dispatch, (VkCommandBuffer cb, uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z), (cb, x, y, z))                                 \
    X(DispatchIndirect, (VkCommandBuffer cb, VkBuffer b, VkDeviceSize o), (cb, b, o))                                    \
    X(Draw, (VkCommandBuffer cb, uint32_t n, uint32_t i, uint32_t f, uint32_t fi), (cb, n, i, f, fi))                    \
    X(DrawIndexed, (VkCommandBuffer cb, uint32_t n, uint32_t i, uint32_t f, int32_t v, uint32_t fi), (cb, n, i, f, v, fi)) \

    X(EndQuery, (VkCommandBuffer cb, VkQueryPool p, uint32_t q), (cb, p, q))                                             \

    X(FillBuffer, (VkCommandBuffer cb, VkBuffer b, VkDeviceSize o, VkDeviceSize n, uint32_t v), (cb, b, o, n, v))        \

    X(PushConstants, (VkCommandBuffer cb, VkPipelineLayout l, VkShaderStageFlags st, uint32_t o, uint32_t n,             \
                      const void *v), (cb, l, st, o, n, v))                                                              \
    X(ResetQueryPool, (VkCommandBuffer cb, VkQueryPool p, uint32_t f, uint32_t n), (cb, p, f, n))                        \
```

`runtime/vk_reset_probe.c`:

```c
// --probe-vkreset: original pointer lists and indirect records through the active replay and recorder lifecycle.
// GPU copies replace host-decoy list entries before reset; full-window readbacks check reset, later counts and canaries.
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "vk_exec.h"

enum { POOL_BYTES = 0x10000, WINDOW_OFF = 0x1000, WINDOW_BYTES = 512, LIST_ENTRIES = 7, LIST_BYTES = 56 };
#define CANARY UINT32_C(0xa5c35a7e)
#define U(p) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(p))
static unsigned checks, failures;

typedef struct { uint64_t address, size; } WriteRange;
typedef struct {
    const char *name;
    uint64_t list, target, read_target;
    VkBuffer producer, readback;
    uint64_t pointers[LIST_ENTRIES];
    WriteRange writes[4];
    unsigned nwrites;
    int reject, warm, device, applied, failed, warmed_mirror;
} ResetCase;

#define CHECK(c, text) do { checks++; if (!(c)) { failures++; printf("probe-vkreset: FAIL %s\n",text); } } while (0)

static void written(void *context) {
    const WriteRange *range = context;
    vk_gpu_written(range->address, range->size);
}

static void publish(VkExec *ex, ResetCase *test, const VkMemSpan *span, uint64_t address, uint64_t size) {
    vk_mem_gpu_wrote(span, size);
    vk_usnap_drop(address, size);
    if (nvn_gpu_only(address)) return;
    if (test->nwrites == sizeof test->writes / sizeof *test->writes) rt_fatal("probe-vkreset: publication capacity");
    WriteRange *range = &test->writes[test->nwrites++];
    *range = (WriteRange){address, size};
    vk_mem_gpu_pending(address, size);
    vk_completion_add(ex->fence, written, range);
}

static int span_of(ResetCase *test, uint64_t address, uint64_t bytes, VkMemSpan *span) {
    if (!vk_mem_resolve(address, bytes, span) || span->offset % 4) {
        printf("probe-vkreset: FAIL %s: original range is not backed/aligned\n", test->name);
        test->failed = 1;
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

static int snapshot(VkExec *ex, ResetCase *test, unsigned phase) {
    VkMemSpan target;
    if (!span_of(test, test->read_target, WINDOW_BYTES, &target)) return 0;
    // This is the first indirect-consumer-like USE of the target in the cold case. A reset that wrote only the
    // imported buffer before a mirror existed leaves this consumer on stale bytes, which the exact check detects.
    VK_MEM_USE(target);
    vk_exec_barrier(ex);
    VkBufferCopy copy = {target.offset, (VkDeviceSize)phase * WINDOW_BYTES, WINDOW_BYTES};
    vkCmdCopyBuffer(ex->cb, target.buffer, test->readback, 1, &copy);
    ex->recorded++;
    return 1;
}

static void work(VkExec *ex, void *context) {
    ResetCase *test = context;
    VkMemSpan target, list;
    if (test->device) {
        if (!span_of(test, test->read_target, WINDOW_BYTES, &target)) return;
        vk_exec_barrier(ex);
        vkCmdFillBuffer(ex->cb, target.buffer, target.offset, WINDOW_BYTES, CANARY);
        ex->recorded++;
    } else if (test->warm) {
        if (!span_of(test, test->target, WINDOW_BYTES, &target)) return;
        VkBuffer original = target.buffer;
        VK_MEM_USE(target);
        test->warmed_mirror = target.buffer != original;
    }

    // LIST and TARGET are distinct pools. Resolving/using the list cannot create the target's first mirror.
    if (!span_of(test, test->list, LIST_BYTES, &list)) return;
    VK_MEM_USE(list);
    vk_exec_barrier(ex);
    VkBufferCopy producer = {0, list.offset, LIST_BYTES};
    vkCmdCopyBuffer(ex->cb, test->producer, list.buffer, 1, &producer);
    ex->recorded++;
    publish(ex, test, &list, test->list, LIST_BYTES);

    // Entries 0 and 6 are deliberately outside the selection; the selected entries contain a null and a duplicate.
    test->applied = vk_exec_reset_indirect(ex, test->list, LIST_BYTES, 1, 5);
    if (!snapshot(ex, test, 0)) return;
    if (!test->reject) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            uint64_t address = test->target + 0x40 + 0x40 * i;
            if (!span_of(test, address, 4, &target)) return;
            VK_MEM_USE(target);
            vk_exec_barrier(ex);
            vkCmdFillBuffer(ex->cb, target.buffer, target.offset, 4, 3);
            ex->recorded++;
            publish(ex, test, &target, address, 4);
        }
    }
    if (!snapshot(ex, test, 1)) return;
    VkMemoryBarrier2 host = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2,
        .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
        .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT, .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT};
    VkDependencyInfo dependency = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO,
        .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &host};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(ex->cb, &dependency);
    ex->recorded++;
}

static int record(VkCommandBuffer cb, uint64_t fence, uint64_t ticks, void *context) {
    return vk_exec_record_work(cb, fence, ticks, work, context);
}

static uint32_t expected_word(unsigned word, unsigned phase, int reject) {
    if (!reject) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            unsigned first = (0x40 + 0x40 * i) / 4;
            if (word >= first && word < first + 5) {
                if (word == first + 1) return 1;
                return word == first && phase ? 3 : 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return CANARY;
}
```
