```c
static void compare_window(const char *name, const uint32_t *words, unsigned phase, int reject) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < WINDOW_BYTES / 4; i++) {
        uint32_t expected = expected_word(i, phase, reject);
        checks++;
        if (words[i] != expected) {
            if (failures < 12) printf("probe-vkreset: FAIL %s phase %u word %u: %08x expected %08x\n",
                name, phase, i, words[i], expected);
            failures++;
        }
    }
}

static int buffer(VkBufferUsageFlags usage, VkDeviceSize bytes, int write, VkBuffer *out, VmaAllocation *allocation,
                  void **mapping) {
    VkBufferCreateInfo info = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = bytes,
        .usage = usage, .sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo memory = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO,
        .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT | (write ? VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_BIT :
                                                          VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT)};
    VmaAllocationInfo actual;
    VkBuffer created = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VmaAllocation storage = NULL;
    if (vmaCreateBuffer(vk_ctx()->vma, &info, &memory, &created, &storage, &actual) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    if (!actual.pMappedData) {
        vmaDestroyBuffer(vk_ctx()->vma, created, storage);
        return 0;
    }
    *out = created;
    *allocation = storage;
    *mapping = actual.pMappedData;
    return 1;
}

static int run_case(uint8_t *heap, const char *name, int warm, int reject, int device) {
    unsigned before = failures;
    pool_t list_pool = {.magic = NVN_POOL_MAGIC, .flags = 0x24, .mem = heap + 0x100000,
        .size = POOL_BYTES, .game_mem = heap + 0x100000};
    pool_t target_pool = {.magic = NVN_POOL_MAGIC, .flags = 0x24, .mem = heap + 0x200000,
        .size = POOL_BYTES, .game_mem = heap + 0x200000};
    pool_t physical = {.magic = NVN_POOL_MAGIC, .flags = 0x189,
        .mem = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(RT_GPU_VA_BASE + UINT64_C(0x100000000)),
        .size = POOL_BYTES, .game_mem = heap + 0x300000, .span = POOL_BYTES};
    pool_t virtual = {.magic = NVN_POOL_MAGIC, .flags = 0x2a1,
        .mem = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(RT_GPU_VA_BASE + UINT64_C(0x200000000)),
        .size = POOL_BYTES, .span = POOL_BYTES};
    ResetCase test = {.name = name, .list = U(list_pool.mem + WINDOW_OFF),
        .target = U(target_pool.mem + WINDOW_OFF), .read_target = U(target_pool.mem + WINDOW_OFF),
        .reject = reject, .warm = warm, .device = device};
    VmaAllocation producer_allocation = NULL, readback_allocation = NULL;
    void *producer_map = NULL, *readback_map = NULL;
    int list_live = 0, target_live = 0, physical_live = 0, virtual_live = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < POOL_BYTES / 4; i++) {
        ((uint32_t *)list_pool.mem)[i] = CANARY;
        ((uint32_t *)target_pool.mem)[i] = CANARY;
    }
    if (!vk_pool_init(&list_pool)) { CHECK(0, "list pool initialization"); goto done; }
    list_live = 1;
    if (device) {
        if (!vk_pool_init(&physical)) { CHECK(0, "physical pool initialization"); goto done; }
        physical_live = 1;
        if (!vk_pool_init(&virtual)) { CHECK(0, "virtual pool initialization"); goto done; }
        virtual_live = 1;
        nvn_mapping_t map = {(const NVNmemoryPool *)(const void *)&physical, 0, 0, POOL_BYTES, 0, 0};
        if (!vk_pool_map_virtual(&virtual, 1, &map)) { CHECK(0, "virtual target maps physical storage"); goto done; }
        test.target = U(virtual.mem) + WINDOW_OFF;
        test.read_target = U(physical.mem) + WINDOW_OFF;
    } else {
        if (!vk_pool_init(&target_pool)) { CHECK(0, "target pool initialization"); goto done; }
        target_live = 1;
    }
    uint64_t decoys[LIST_ENTRIES] = {test.target + 0x100, test.target + 0x140, test.target + 0x180, 0,
                                    test.target + 0x140, test.target + 0x1c0, test.target + 0x120};
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)test.list, decoys, sizeof decoys);
    test.pointers[0] = test.target + 0x100;
    test.pointers[1] = test.target + 0x40;
    test.pointers[2] = test.target + 0x80;
    test.pointers[3] = 0;
    test.pointers[4] = test.target + 0x40;
    test.pointers[5] = reject ? UINT64_C(0xfffffff000000000) : test.target + 0xc0;
    test.pointers[6] = test.target + 0x120;
    if (!buffer(VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT, LIST_BYTES, 1, &test.producer, &producer_allocation, &producer_map) ||
        !buffer(VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT, 2 * WINDOW_BYTES, 0, &test.readback, &readback_allocation, &readback_map)) {
        CHECK(0, "owned producer/readback allocations"); goto done;
    }
    memcpy(producer_map, test.pointers, sizeof test.pointers);
    if (vmaFlushAllocation(vk_ctx()->vma, producer_allocation, 0, LIST_BYTES) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        CHECK(0, "producer flush"); goto done;
    }
    uint64_t fence = vk_sync_submit_record(record, &test, rt_ticks());
    CHECK(fence != 0 && vk_sync_fence_wait(fence, UINT64_C(10000000000)), "original reset submission completed");
    vk_sync_finish();   // All callbacks that refer to this stack context finish before cleanup, including failures.
    CHECK(!test.failed, "all probe commands use backed aligned ranges");
    CHECK(test.applied == !reject, "reset accepts valid lists and rejects the late-invalid target");
    if (warm && vk_mirror_on) CHECK(test.warmed_mirror, "pre-existing target mirror was exercised");
    if (vmaInvalidateAllocation(vk_ctx()->vma, readback_allocation, 0, 2 * WINDOW_BYTES) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        CHECK(0, "readback invalidation"); goto done;
    }
    compare_window(name, readback_map, 0, reject);
    compare_window(name, (const uint32_t *)((uint8_t *)readback_map + WINDOW_BYTES), 1, reject);
    CHECK(!memcmp((const void *)(uintptr_t)test.list, test.pointers, sizeof test.pointers), "GPU list producer publishes its bytes to guest memory");
    uint32_t prefix, suffix;
    memcpy(&prefix, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(test.list - 4), 4);
    memcpy(&suffix, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(test.list + LIST_BYTES), 4);
    CHECK(prefix == CANARY && suffix == CANARY, "list producer/reset preserve list border canaries");
    if (!device) compare_window(name, (const uint32_t *)(target_pool.mem + WINDOW_OFF), 1, reject);

done:
    if (list_live || target_live || physical_live) vk_sync_finish();
    if (test.readback) vmaDestroyBuffer(vk_ctx()->vma, test.readback, readback_allocation);
    if (test.producer) vmaDestroyBuffer(vk_ctx()->vma, test.producer, producer_allocation);
    if (virtual_live) vk_pool_fini(&virtual);
    if (physical_live) vk_pool_fini(&physical);
    if (target_live) vk_pool_fini(&target_pool);
    if (list_live) vk_pool_fini(&list_pool);
    printf("probe-vkreset: %s: %s\n", name, failures == before ? "passed" : "FAILED");
    return failures != before;
}

void vk_exec_draw_shutdown(void);
void vk_exec_xfer_shutdown(void);

int probe_vkreset(void) {
    checks = failures = 0;
    if (gfx_backend() != &gfx_vulkan_backend) {
        printf("probe-vkreset: requires TOTK_GPU=vulkan\n");
        return 1;
    }
    uint64_t heap = 0;
    CHECK(!mem_set_heap_size(UINT64_C(16) << 20, &heap) && heap, "owned heap allocation");
    if (failures) return 1;
    vk_sync_start();
    int bad = run_case((uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)heap, "first target use", 0, 0, 0);
    if (!bad) bad = run_case((uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)heap, "pre-existing target backing", 1, 0, 0);
    if (!bad) bad = run_case((uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)heap, "late-invalid target is atomic rejection", 0, 1, 0);
    if (!bad) bad = run_case((uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)heap, "virtual reset targets / physical readback", 0, 0, 1);
    vk_sync_finish();
    vk_pipeline_shutdown();
    vk_exec_draw_shutdown();
    vk_exec_xfer_shutdown();
    vk_backend_shutdown();
    long errors = vk_validation_errors_total();
    printf("probe-vkreset: %s (%u checks, %u failures, %ld validation errors)\n",
        bad || errors ? "FAILED" : "passed", checks, failures, errors);
    printf("probe-vkreset: reset helper and transfer count ordering; shader recognition, geometry and indirect rasterization are not covered\n");
    return bad || errors;
}

```

`runtime/vk_sync.c`:

```c
// Submission, fences and the completion thread of the Vulkan back end.
// One timeline semaphore (VkCtx.timeline) orders everything: each submission records its command handles into a
// primary command buffer (vk_exec_record) and signals the next timeline value, which is the NVN fence value
// the front end hands to syncs. The completion thread waits on the timeline and, in submit order, runs the CPU side
// effects queued for each value (event writes, counter reports, sync state), then frees the memory and texture objects whose users
// completed. A value counts as done only after its side effects ran, so a guest woken by fence_wait sees them.
//
// The submission shape (one timeline value per submission, signalled at ALL_COMMANDS, vkWaitSemaphores for waits, a
// failed wait treated as a lost device) follows LAS Recomp runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c:39-110, 355-397
// (https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp @ da35b83a9611d046a9a681aae668d7085954d37f, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
// Side effects written after GPU completion, as MacNativeGames does: games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/hle_nvn.c:7-9
// (https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames @ b75be8cfa704df3701e86130c8ced268e79d6b11, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026
// jhaizhou; origin d2r-mobile).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define WEAK __attribute__((weak))

typedef struct { uint64_t fence; void (*fn)(void *); void *arg; } Pending;
typedef struct { VkCommandBuffer cb; uint64_t fence; } CmdSlot;   // reusable once the timeline reached fence

static PlatMutex start_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
static int started;
static PlatThread *completion_thread;

// Submissions: one at a time, so timeline values are signalled in the order they are handed out.
static PlatMutex sub_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
static VkCommandPool cmd_pool;
static CmdSlot *slots;
static int nslots;
static int cur_slot;          // the slot vk_sync_submit records into now (an index: take_slot may move slots)
static uint64_t cur_fence;    // the value of the submission being recorded

// Shared with the completion thread (st_lock).
static PlatMutex st_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
static PlatCond cv_work = PLAT_COND_INIT;   // a submission, a callback or stop
static PlatCond cv_done = PLAT_COND_INIT;   // done advanced
static uint64_t issued, done;     // newest submitted value; newest value whose side effects ran
static uint64_t reserved;         // asynchronous replay: newest value handed out before its submission (>= issued)
static int stop;
static Pending *queue;            // side effects in the order they were added
static int qhead, qn, qcap;

// ---- GPU time (TOTK_TRACE=perf): each submission part (vk_sync_split) writes a timestamp when it starts and when it
// ends, into a ring of query pairs. The completion thread reads a pair once the part's value is reached and adds the
// part's interval to the busy time, counting overlap with the previous part once. Off (one log line) when the queue
// family has no timestamp bits or the period is 0. Upload batches (vk_memory.c) are not timed.
#define TS_PAIRS 1024
static VkQueryPool ts_pool;
static int ts_state;                       // 0 not set up, 1 on, -1 off
static double ts_period;                   // ns per tick
static uint64_t ts_mask;                   // valid bits of a timestamp
static uint32_t ts_next;                   // submitting thread (sub_lock): next pair
static volatile uint8_t ts_busy[TS_PAIRS]; // written until the completion thread read the pair
static int ts_cur = -1;                    // the pair of the part being recorded, -1 untimed
static uint64_t ts_last_end;               // completion thread: end of the latest part read (ticks)
static volatile int64_t ts_busy_ns, ts_parts, ts_missed;

// On the first submission that wants timing (perf_gpu_timing: TOTK_TRACE=perf or the full performance overlay).
static void ts_setup(VkCtx *c) {
    ts_state = -1;
    uint32_t nq = 0;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(c->phys, &nq, NULL);
    VkQueueFamilyProperties *qp = calloc(nq ? nq : 1, sizeof *qp);
    if (!qp) return;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(c->phys, &nq, qp);
    uint32_t bits = c->gfx_family < nq ? qp[c->gfx_family].timestampValidBits : 0;
    free(qp);
    float period = c->props.limits.timestampPeriod;
    if (!bits || period <= 0) {
        rt_log("vk: no GPU timestamps on this queue (valid bits %u, period %.3f ns): the perf line shows no GPU time", bits, period);
        return;
    }
    VkQueryPoolCreateInfo qi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUERY_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .queryType = VK_QUERY_TYPE_TIMESTAMP,
                                .queryCount = 2 * TS_PAIRS};
    VkResult r = vkCreateQueryPool(c->device, &qi, NULL, &ts_pool);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        rt_log("vk: timestamp query pool failed (%d): the perf line shows no GPU time", (int)r);
        return;
    }
    ts_period = period;
    ts_mask = bits >= 64 ? ~0ull : (1ull << bits) - 1;
    ts_state = 1;
}

// What the replay part being timed draws and dispatches (vk_sync_note), kept with its pair: a part that runs on the GPU
// for at least TOTK_PERF_SLOW_GPU_MS (default 100) gets a line naming its work, at most 200 lines. A respawn in the
// Ingot Isle Cave-In section (#10) spent about 16.8 s of GPU time per frame inside the replay's parts.
#define NOTE_PAIRS 6
#define NOTE_ARGS 65536   // indirect argument addresses and storage writes kept per part
// size 0: an indirect draw's arguments at addr, drawn by stages a/b; else a storage write of [addr, addr+size) by
// stage a, in recording order with the draws.
typedef struct { uint64_t addr, a, b, size; } NoteArg;
typedef struct {
    uint32_t draws, draws_ind, dispatches, dispatches_ind, pairs;
    uint64_t max_work, max_a, max_b;               // the largest direct draw (vertices x instances) or dispatch (groups)
    uint64_t a[NOTE_PAIRS], b[NOTE_PAIRS];         // the first distinct stage names: vertex/fragment, or compute/0
    uint64_t last_a, last_b;                       // the stages of the last noted draw or dispatch
    NoteArg *args;                                 // indirect draws whose arguments the host can read (malloc'd)
    uint32_t nargs, cap;
} PartNote;
static PartNote note;   // the part being recorded (sub_lock, like ts_cur)

int vk_sync_noting(void) { return ts_cur >= 0; }

static void note_push(NoteArg e) {
    if (ts_cur < 0 || note.nargs >= NOTE_ARGS) return;
    if (note.nargs == note.cap) {
        uint32_t cap = note.cap ? 2 * note.cap : 256;
        NoteArg *p = realloc(note.args, cap * sizeof *p);
        if (!p) return;
        note.args = p, note.cap = cap;
    }
    note.args[note.nargs++] = e;
}

void vk_sync_note_args(uint64_t addr) { note_push((NoteArg){addr, note.last_a, note.last_b, 0}); }

void vk_sync_note_write(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t stage) {
    if (size) note_push((NoteArg){addr, stage, 0, size});
}

void vk_sync_note(int kind, uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t work) {
    if (ts_cur < 0) return;
    note.last_a = a, note.last_b = b;
    if (kind == 0) note.draws++;
    else if (kind == 1) note.draws_ind++;
    else if (kind == 2) note.dispatches++;
    else note.dispatches_ind++;
    if (work > note.max_work) note.max_work = work, note.max_a = a, note.max_b = b;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < note.pairs; i++)
        if (note.a[i] == a && note.b[i] == b) return;
    if (note.pairs < NOTE_PAIRS) note.a[note.pairs] = a, note.b[note.pairs] = b, note.pairs++;
}

typedef struct { uint32_t pair, noted; uint64_t fence; PartNote note; } TsRead;

static void slow_part(const TsRead *t, double ms) {
    static double slow_ms = -1;
    static int lines;
    if (slow_ms < 0) {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_PERF_SLOW_GPU_MS");
        slow_ms = e && atof(e) > 0 ? atof(e) : 100;
    }
    if (!t->noted || ms < slow_ms || lines >= 200) return;
    lines++;
    const PartNote *n = &t->note;
    char st[NOTE_PAIRS * 36 + 8] = "", *p = st;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n->pairs; i++)
        p += snprintf(p, (size_t)(st + sizeof st - p), " %016llx/%016llx", (unsigned long long)n->a[i], (unsigned long long)n->b[i]);
    rt_log("perf: a GPU part of submission %llu ran %.1f ms: %u draws (%u indirect), %u dispatches (%u indirect); largest "
           "direct one %llu (%016llx/%016llx); stages%s%s", (unsigned long long)t->fence, ms, n->draws + n->draws_ind,
           n->draws_ind, n->dispatches + n->dispatches_ind, n->dispatches_ind, (unsigned long long)n->max_work,
           (unsigned long long)n->max_a, (unsigned long long)n->max_b, n->pairs ? st : " none",
           n->pairs == NOTE_PAIRS ? " ..." : "");
    // The indirect draws' arguments as they are now, after the GPU used them: the game may already have written the
    // next frame's, and a pool freed meanwhile is skipped (plat_mem_readable).
    uint64_t total = 0, max = 0;
    uint32_t read = 0, best = 0, w[5] = {0}, bw[5] = {0};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n->nargs; i++) {
        if (n->args[i].size || !plat_mem_readable(n->args[i].addr, sizeof w)) continue;
        memcpy(w, (const void *)(uintptr_t)n->args[i].addr, sizeof w);
        uint64_t work = (uint64_t)w[0] * w[1];   // indices x instances
        read++, total += work;
        if (work >= max) max = work, best = i, memcpy(bw, w, sizeof w);
    }
    if (n->draws_ind)
        rt_log("perf:   its indirect draws: %u of %u arguments read back, %llu indices x instances in all; the largest "
               "%llu (%u indices from %u, vertex offset %d, %u instances from %u; %016llx/%016llx)", read, n->draws_ind,
               (unsigned long long)total, (unsigned long long)max, bw[0], bw[2], (int32_t)bw[3], bw[1], bw[4],
               (unsigned long long)(read ? n->args[best].a : 0), (unsigned long long)(read ? n->args[best].b : 0));
    if (!read) return;
    // Who stored over those arguments earlier in this part: the last shader write that covers them before the draw.
    // None means the CPU or an earlier part wrote them, or a shader whose storage the host bound to a stand-in.
    uint64_t at = n->args[best].addr, by = 0;
    uint32_t writes = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < best; i++)
        if (n->args[i].size && at + sizeof w > n->args[i].addr && at < n->args[i].addr + n->args[i].size)
            writes++, by = n->args[i].a;
    if (writes)
        rt_log("perf:   the largest one's arguments at %#llx were written in this part by %u shader stores, the last by %016llx",
               (unsigned long long)at, writes, (unsigned long long)by);
    else
        rt_log("perf:   the largest one's arguments at %#llx were not written by a shader earlier in this part",
               (unsigned long long)at);
}

static void ts_read_cb(void *arg) {   // completion thread, in submission order
    TsRead *t = arg;
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    uint64_t v[2];
    if (vkGetQueryPoolResults(c->device, ts_pool, 2 * t->pair, 2, sizeof v, v, sizeof v[0], VK_QUERY_RESULT_64_BIT) == VK_SUCCESS) {
        uint64_t s = v[0] & ts_mask, e = v[1] & ts_mask;
        if (e >= s) {
            slow_part(t, (double)(e - s) * ts_period / 1e6);
            uint64_t from = s > ts_last_end ? s : ts_last_end;
            if (e > from) {
                int64_t ns = (int64_t)((double)(e - from) * ts_period);
                plat_add64(&ts_busy_ns, ns);
                perf_gpu_busy((uint64_t)ns);
            }
            if (e > ts_last_end) ts_last_end = e;
            plat_inc64(&ts_parts);
        } else plat_inc64(&ts_missed);   // the counter wrapped
    } else plat_inc64(&ts_missed);
    __atomic_store_n(&ts_busy[t->pair], 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    free(t->note.args);
    free(t);
}

// At the start of a command buffer (sub_lock held): the pair it times, -1 untimed.
static int ts_open(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    if (ts_state != 1 || !perf_gpu_timing()) {
        if (ts_state || !perf_gpu_timing()) return -1;
        ts_setup(vk_ctx());   // the overlay turned full: timestamps from now on
        if (ts_state != 1) return -1;
    }
    uint32_t p = ts_next % TS_PAIRS;
    if (__atomic_load_n(&ts_busy[p], __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) { plat_inc64(&ts_missed); return -1; }
    ts_next++;
    ts_busy[p] = 1;
    vkCmdResetQueryPool(cb, ts_pool, 2 * p, 2);
    vkCmdWriteTimestamp(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, ts_pool, 2 * p);
    return (int)p;
}

// At its end, before vkEndCommandBuffer; fence: the value whose completion covers it. The note's argument list moves
// to the reader.
static void ts_close(VkCommandBuffer cb, int pair, uint64_t fence, PartNote *n) {
    if (pair < 0) {
        if (n) free(n->args), n->args = NULL;
        return;
    }
    vkCmdWriteTimestamp(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, ts_pool, 2 * (uint32_t)pair + 1);
    TsRead *t = calloc(1, sizeof *t);
    if (!t) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory");
    t->pair = (uint32_t)pair, t->fence = fence;
    if (n) t->note = *n, t->noted = 1, n->args = NULL;
    vk_completion_add(fence, ts_read_cb, t);
}

// The pair of the part being recorded.
static void ts_begin(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    ts_cur = ts_open(cb);
    memset(&note, 0, sizeof note);
}

static void ts_end(VkCommandBuffer cb, uint64_t fence) {
    ts_close(cb, ts_cur, fence, &note);
    ts_cur = -1;
}

// An empty submission records no command buffer: its pair is never written.
static void ts_drop(void) {
    free(note.args), note.args = NULL;
    if (ts_cur < 0) return;
    __atomic_store_n(&ts_busy[ts_cur], 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    ts_cur = -1;
}

static void gpu_stats(PerfGpu *g) {
    g->have_gpu = ts_state == 1;
    g->gpu_ns = (uint64_t)plat_xchg64(&ts_busy_ns, 0);
    g->gpu_parts = (uint64_t)plat_xchg64(&ts_parts, 0);
    g->gpu_missed = (uint64_t)plat_xchg64(&ts_missed, 0);
    g->have_vram = vk_mem_vram(&g->vram_used, &g->vram_budget, &g->vram_exact);
    vk_upload_perf(&g->up_gpu_ns, &g->up_timed, &g->up_batches, &g->up_wait_ns, &g->up_bytes);
}

// Weak stand-in for vk_exec.c's replay: only empty recordings ({OP_BEGIN, OP_END}) can be submitted.
WEAK int vk_exec_record(VkCommandBuffer cb, const uint64_t *handles, int n, uint64_t fence, uint64_t submitted_ticks) {
    (void)cb, (void)fence, (void)submitted_ticks;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const op_hdr *h = handles[i] ? nvn_op_first(handles[i]) : NULL;
        if (!h || h->op != OP_BEGIN || h->size < sizeof *h || nvn_op_next(h)->op != OP_END)
            rt_fatal("vk: op replay is not linked");
    }
    return 0;
}

static void completion_main(void *arg) {
    VkCtx *c = arg;
    plat_mutex_lock(&st_lock);
    for (;;) {
        while (!stop && done == issued && !(qn && queue[qhead].fence <= done))
            plat_cond_wait(&cv_work, &st_lock);
        if (stop) break;
        uint64_t reached = done;
        if (issued > done) {
            uint64_t want = done + 1;
            plat_mutex_unlock(&st_lock);
            VkSemaphoreWaitInfo wi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_WAIT_INFO, .semaphoreCount = 1,
                                      .pSemaphores = &c->timeline, .pValues = &want};
            VkResult r = vkWaitSemaphores(c->device, &wi, 100000000ull);   // 100 ms: stop is checked between waits
            if (r != VK_SUCCESS && r != VK_TIMEOUT) {
                vk_device_fault_report(r);
                rt_fatal("vk: vkWaitSemaphores failed (%d; device lost?)", (int)r);
            }
            vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue(c->device, c->timeline, &reached);
            plat_mutex_lock(&st_lock);
            if (reached > issued) reached = issued;
        }
        while (qn && queue[qhead].fence <= reached) {
            Pending p = queue[qhead++];
            qn--;
            plat_mutex_unlock(&st_lock);
            p.fn(p.arg);
            plat_mutex_lock(&st_lock);
        }
        if (reached > done) {
            plat_mutex_unlock(&st_lock);
            vk_mem_collect();
            plat_mutex_lock(&st_lock);
            __atomic_store_n(&done, reached, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            plat_cond_broadcast(&cv_done);
        }
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&st_lock);
    return;
}

void vk_sync_start(void) {
    if (__atomic_load_n(&started, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) return;
    plat_mutex_lock(&start_lock);
    if (!started) {
        if (!vk_init()) rt_fatal("vk: no usable Vulkan device (see the vk: lines above; TOTK_GPU=null runs without a GPU)");
        VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
        VkCommandPoolCreateInfo pi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO,
                                      .flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT,
                                      .queueFamilyIndex = c->gfx_family};
        if (vkCreateCommandPool(c->device, &pi, NULL, &cmd_pool) != VK_SUCCESS) rt_fatal("vk: submission command pool");
        if (!ts_state && perf_gpu_timing()) ts_setup(c);
        perf_gpu_stats = gpu_stats;
        uint64_t now = 0;
        vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue(c->device, c->timeline, &now);
        if (issued > now) {   // a new device after vk_shutdown: values keep increasing for the front end
            VkSemaphoreSignalInfo si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_SIGNAL_INFO, .semaphore = c->timeline,
                                        .value = issued};
            if (vkSignalSemaphore(c->device, &si) != VK_SUCCESS) rt_fatal("vk: timeline restart at %llu", (unsigned long long)issued);
            now = issued;
        }
        plat_mutex_lock(&st_lock);
        issued = done = now;
        if (reserved < now) reserved = now;
        stop = 0;
        plat_mutex_unlock(&st_lock);
        vk_mem_protect_until(now);
        completion_thread = plat_thread_new(completion_main, c, "vk completion");
        if (!completion_thread) rt_fatal("vk: cannot start the completion thread");
        __atomic_store_n(&started, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        vk_astc_mode();   // decides TOTK_ASTC and builds the ASTC decoder now, not at the first ASTC upload
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&start_lock);
}

// The index of a command buffer the GPU no longer uses, claimed for value `fence`. Called with sub_lock held; may move
// slots[].
static int claim_slot(VkCtx *c, uint64_t fence) {
    uint64_t gpu = 0;
    vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue(c->device, c->timeline, &gpu);
    for (int i = 0; i < nslots; i++)
        if (slots[i].fence <= gpu) {
            slots[i].fence = fence;
            return i;
        }
    CmdSlot *n = realloc(slots, sizeof *n * (size_t)(nslots + 1));
    if (!n) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory (command buffers)");
    slots = n;
    CmdSlot *s = &slots[nslots];
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO, .commandPool = cmd_pool,
                                      .level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY, .commandBufferCount = 1};
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(c->device, &ai, &s->cb) != VK_SUCCESS) rt_fatal("vk: command buffer allocation");
    s->fence = fence;
    return nslots++;
}

static CmdSlot *take_slot(VkCtx *c, uint64_t fence) {
    cur_slot = claim_slot(c, fence);
    return &slots[cur_slot];
}

// The copies the replay's first accesses to VRAM mirrors queued (vk_memory.c), in a command buffer of their own that is
// submitted right before the part that needs them and timed like a part; VK_NULL_HANDLE when there are none. After the
// part was recorded, sub_lock held; may move slots[].
// First brings the shadow storage up to date with the CPU's writes, which needs no command buffer.
static VkCommandBuffer prologue(VkCtx *c, uint64_t fence) {
    vk_mem_shadow_sync();   // shadow storage: the CPU's writes go in before the part is submitted
    if (!vk_mem_mirror_pending()) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    int i = claim_slot(c, fence);   // before reading slots: the claim may move it
    VkCommandBuffer cb = slots[i].cb;
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO,
                                   .flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT};
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &bi);
    int pair = ts_open(cb);
    vk_mem_mirror_prologue(cb);
    ts_close(cb, pair, fence, NULL);
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    return cb;
}

static VkCommandBuffer split_impl(int wait) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    VkFence prefix = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (wait) {
        VkFenceCreateInfo fi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO};
        if (vkCreateFence(c->device, &fi, NULL, &prefix) != VK_SUCCESS) rt_fatal("vk: prefix fence allocation");
    }
    VkCommandBuffer cb = slots[cur_slot].cb;
    ts_end(cb, cur_fence);
    if (!rec_end_cb(cb, 0, 0)) vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);   // every command of the part is in cb, ended by its recorder
    vk_upload_flush(0);   // the uploads this part asked for precede it in queue order
    VkCommandBuffer pro = prologue(c, cur_fence);
    VkCommandBufferSubmitInfo cbi[2] = {{.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_SUBMIT_INFO, .commandBuffer = pro},
                                        {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_SUBMIT_INFO, .commandBuffer = cb}};
    VkSubmitInfo2 si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO_2, .commandBufferInfoCount = pro ? 2 : 1,
                        .pCommandBufferInfos = pro ? cbi : cbi + 1};
    vk_queue_lock();
    VkResult r = vkQueueSubmit2(c->gfx_queue, 1, &si, prefix);
    vk_queue_unlock();
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        vk_device_fault_report(r);
        rt_fatal("vk: vkQueueSubmit2 of a part of value %llu failed (%d)", (unsigned long long)cur_fence, (int)r);
    }
    if (wait) {
        // The full submission's timeline value is not signalled yet. Wait only for this prefix, without running its
        // final completion callbacks or releasing the resources/command slots protected by cur_fence.
        uint64_t t0 = perf_begin();
        r = vkWaitForFences(c->device, 1, &prefix, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);
        perf_end(PERF_FENCE, t0);
        perf_gpu_wait(t0);
        if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
            vk_device_fault_report(r);
            rt_fatal("vk: wait for a prefix of value %llu failed (%d)", (unsigned long long)cur_fence, (int)r);
        }
        vkDestroyFence(c->device, prefix, NULL);
    }
    CmdSlot *s = take_slot(c, cur_fence);   // the submitted part keeps its slot until the value is reached
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO,
                                   .flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT};
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(s->cb, &bi);
    vk_crumb(s->cb, VK_CRUMB_SUBMIT, cur_fence);
    ts_begin(s->cb);
    rec_begin(s->cb);
    return s->cb;
}

VkCommandBuffer vk_sync_split(void) { return split_impl(0); }

VkCommandBuffer vk_sync_split_wait(void) { return split_impl(1); }

// Asynchronous replay (vk_backend.c): the value the next queued submission or present will signal. Values are handed
// out in queue order and the replay thread submits them in that order, so each vk_sync_submit gets exactly its value.
uint64_t vk_sync_reserve(void) {
    vk_sync_start();
    plat_mutex_lock(&st_lock);
    if (reserved < issued) reserved = issued;
    uint64_t v = ++reserved;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&st_lock);
    return v;
}

uint64_t vk_sync_submit_record(VkSyncRecordFn record, void *context, uint64_t submitted_ticks) {
    if (!record) rt_fatal("vk: submission without a recorder");
    vk_sync_start();
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    plat_mutex_lock(&sub_lock);
    vk_mem_dirty_submit();   // TOTK_TRACE=perf: what a mirror would upload before this submit
    uint64_t fence = __atomic_load_n(&issued, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) + 1;
    cur_fence = fence;
    // A texture alias can retire an image or view used earlier in this recording. Collection must wait for this
    // submission, including every split part, before the first command can reference those objects.
    vk_mem_protect_until(fence);
    CmdSlot *s = take_slot(c, fence);
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO,
                                   .flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT};
    uint64_t t0 = perf_begin();
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(s->cb, &bi);
    vk_crumb(s->cb, VK_CRUMB_SUBMIT, fence);
    ts_begin(s->cb);
    rec_begin(s->cb);
    int recorded = record(s->cb, fence, submitted_ticks, context);
    s = &slots[cur_slot];   // the last part (vk_sync_split)
    if (recorded) ts_end(s->cb, fence);
    else ts_drop();
    // The recorder is done with the part: the end-of-submission crumb, then the end, by the recorder when it records.
    if (!rec_end_cb(s->cb, VK_CRUMB_SUBMIT_END, fence)) vkEndCommandBuffer(s->cb);
    perf_replay(t0);
    // After the recording: the uploads it asked for (and every earlier one) precede it in queue order.
    vk_upload_flush(0);
    VkCommandBuffer pro = prologue(c, fence);
    s = &slots[cur_slot];
    VkCommandBufferSubmitInfo cbi[2] = {{.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_SUBMIT_INFO, .commandBuffer = pro},
                                        {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_SUBMIT_INFO, .commandBuffer = s->cb}};
    VkSemaphoreSubmitInfo sig = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_SUBMIT_INFO, .semaphore = c->timeline,
                                 .value = fence, .stageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT};
    VkSubmitInfo2 si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO_2,
                        .commandBufferInfoCount = (pro ? 1u : 0u) + (recorded ? 1u : 0u),
                        .pCommandBufferInfos = pro ? cbi : cbi + 1, .signalSemaphoreInfoCount = 1,
                        .pSignalSemaphoreInfos = &sig};
    vk_queue_lock();
    VkResult r = vkQueueSubmit2(c->gfx_queue, 1, &si, VK_NULL_HANDLE);
    vk_queue_unlock();
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        vk_device_fault_report(r);
        rt_fatal("vk: vkQueueSubmit2 of value %llu failed (%d)", (unsigned long long)fence, (int)r);
    }
    s->fence = recorded ? fence : 0;
    plat_mutex_lock(&st_lock);
    __atomic_store_n(&issued, fence, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    plat_cond_broadcast(&cv_work);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&st_lock);
    static unsigned subs;
    if (++subs % 4096 == 0) rec_stats_log();
    plat_mutex_unlock(&sub_lock);
    return fence;
}

typedef struct { const uint64_t *handles; int n; } ReplayHandles;

static int record_handles(VkCommandBuffer cb, uint64_t fence, uint64_t submitted_ticks, void *context) {
    const ReplayHandles *r = context;
    return vk_exec_record(cb, r->handles, r->n, fence, submitted_ticks);
}

uint64_t vk_sync_submit(const uint64_t *handles, int n, uint64_t submitted_ticks) {
    ReplayHandles r = {handles, n};
    return vk_sync_submit_record(record_handles, &r, submitted_ticks);
}

void vk_completion_add(uint64_t fence, void (*fn)(void *), void *arg) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&st_lock);
    if (qhead + qn == qcap) {
        if (qhead) {
            memmove(queue, queue + qhead, sizeof *queue * (size_t)qn);
            qhead = 0;
        } else {
            int cap = qcap ? qcap * 2 : 256;
            Pending *q = realloc(queue, sizeof *q * (size_t)cap);
            if (!q) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory (completion queue)");
            queue = q, qcap = cap;
        }
    }
    queue[qhead + qn++] = (Pending){fence, fn, arg};
    // The completion thread sleeps only while nothing is issued beyond done: a callback for a later value (the replay's,
    // for the submission it records: counter reports, freed resources) becomes due through the submit, which wakes it.
    if (fence <= done) plat_cond_broadcast(&cv_work);
    plat_mutex_unlock(&st_lock);
}

static int fence_wait_impl(uint64_t value, uint64_t timeout_ns);

int vk_sync_fence_wait(uint64_t value, uint64_t timeout_ns) {
    uint64_t p0 = perf_begin();
    int ok = fence_wait_impl(value, timeout_ns);
    perf_end(PERF_FENCE, p0);
    perf_gpu_wait(p0);
    return ok;
}

static int fence_wait_impl(uint64_t value, uint64_t timeout_ns) {
    vk_sync_start();
    plat_mutex_lock(&st_lock);
    int ok;
    if (value > issued && value > reserved) {
        ok = 0;   // never submitted nor queued: never reached (as in the null back end)
    } else {
        uint64_t t0 = kern_now_ns();
        while (done < value) {
            if (timeout_ns < (1ull << 62)) {
                uint64_t el = kern_now_ns() - t0;
                if (el >= timeout_ns) break;
                plat_cond_wait_ns(&cv_done, &st_lock, timeout_ns - el);
            } else {
                plat_cond_wait(&cv_done, &st_lock);
            }
        }
        ok = done >= value;
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&st_lock);
    return ok;
}

uint64_t vk_sync_fence_done(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&done, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

uint64_t vk_sync_issued(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&issued, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

void vk_sync_finish(void) {
    vk_sync_start();
    vk_sync_fence_wait(__atomic_load_n(&issued, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE), UINT64_MAX);
    vk_upload_flush(1);
}

void vk_sync_shutdown(void) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&start_lock);
    if (started) {
        vk_sync_finish();
        plat_mutex_lock(&st_lock);
        stop = 1;
        plat_cond_broadcast(&cv_work);
        plat_mutex_unlock(&st_lock);
        plat_thread_join(completion_thread);
        completion_thread = NULL;
        plat_mutex_lock(&st_lock);
        qhead = qn = 0;   // callbacks of values never submitted
        plat_mutex_unlock(&st_lock);
        plat_mutex_lock(&sub_lock);
        VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
        if (c && cmd_pool) vkDestroyCommandPool(c->device, cmd_pool, NULL);
        perf_gpu_stats = NULL;
        if (c && ts_pool) vkDestroyQueryPool(c->device, ts_pool, NULL);
        ts_pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        ts_state = 0;
        ts_last_end = 0;
        memset((void *)ts_busy, 0, sizeof ts_busy);
        cmd_pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        free(slots);
        slots = NULL;
        nslots = 0;
        plat_mutex_unlock(&sub_lock);
        __atomic_store_n(&started, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&start_lock);
}

```

`runtime/vk_texture.c`:

```c
// Vulkan textures of the graphics layer: a VkImage cache keyed by storage
// GPU address plus descriptor, uploads through staging buffers with block-linear deswizzle and ASTC decode (vk_astc.c),
// re-uploads when page write generations (vk_memory.c) show the storage written, ReadTexels / WriteTexels, the texture
// and sampler descriptor slots, and VkSamplers.
//
// Behaviour ported from MacNativeGames games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026
// jhaizhou; origin d2r-mobile): which textures mirror their pool memory (nvn_mtl.m tex_mirrored, 3347-3362), the
// "GPU-owned" rule that stops re-uploads once the GPU rendered into a mirrored texture (nvn_mtl.m tex_mtl, 3366-3372),
// the live texture at a storage address that a slot of a finalized texture follows (hle_nvn.c:373-393), and
// ReadTexels / WriteTexels (nvn_mtl.m:10105-10195). Image creation, upload regions and samplers are ported from LAS
// Recomp runtime/nvn/vulkan/textures.c:235-330, 778-844 @ da35b83a (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
//
// Every image lives in VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL. Uploads are recorded into the upload batch of vk_memory.c; the replay
// submits it (vk_upload_flush) before a submission that samples the textures.
#include <math.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "nvn_hmap.h"
#include "nvn_tex.h"
#include "tex.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "vk_exec.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

typedef struct {
    uint64_t addr;
    nvn_texdesc d;
    uint8_t has_layout, layout[8], pad[7];
} TexKey;

typedef struct Tex {
    VkTexImage pub;               // first: vk_texture_get hands out &pub
    TexKey key;
    tex_t t;                      // the newest texture object seen with this key
    TexVkFormat f;
    VmaAllocation alloc;          // own memory; NULL when bound into pool memory
    VmaAllocation bound_to;       // the pool memory it is bound into
    uint32_t wgen;                // page generation of the last upload check
    uint32_t checked;             // submit_epoch of the last check from a draw binding
    int uploaded, released;
    uint32_t n_up;                // uploads of this entry (vk_texture_debug)
    int last_ch;                  // last vk_mem_changed result of make_fresh: 1 written, 0 clean, -1 not tracked
    uint8_t hashed;               // chash holds the storage hash taken just before the last upload (untracked pages)
    uint64_t chash;
    struct Tex *next_at;          // other entries at the same storage address
    uint8_t gpu_dirty;            // mirrored, and the GPU wrote the image after the last write-back to the storage
    uint32_t gpu_gen;             // page generation when the GPU write that set gpu_dirty was recorded
    uint64_t gpu_seq;             // order of that GPU write among all of them (gpu_writes)
    uint64_t gpu_fence;           // fence of the submission that made that write (0: not recorded in one)
    uint64_t wr_fence;            // any entry: newest submission recorded to write its image (render, copy, clear,
                                  // storage binding); ReadTexels waits for it instead of draining the replay queue
    uint8_t listed;               // in owned[]
    uint8_t *snap;                // a texture that fills no page: its storage bytes when the GPU write was recorded
    uint32_t wt_n;                // WriteTexels into the storage since the last upload
    struct Tex *rel_prev, *rel_next;   // while released: the list of released entries, oldest first
} Tex;

// A slot keeps what vk_texture_by_id resolved for it, so a draw binding skips the key lookup and the address chain: the
// entry (ce), valid while the generation of its address (agen) is still cgen, the view and has_view handed out with it,
// and the submit_epoch of the last freshness check through the slot (cepoch). Hot fields first: a lookup that hits
// touches one or two cache lines.
typedef struct {
    struct Tex *ce;               // NULL: nothing cached (registered since, or never resolved)
    uint32_t cgen;                // agen of the slot's address when ce was resolved
    uint32_t cepoch;
    view_t cview;
    uint8_t chas_view, used, has_view;
    view_t v;
    tex_t t;
} TexSlot;
typedef struct { samp_par p; VkSampler s, sp; uint8_t used; } SampSlot;   // s: vk_sampler_for(&p) once looked up; sp:
                                                                           // its point-sampled form (vk_sampler_point_by_id_locked)
enum { DESC_TEXTURE = 1, DESC_SAMPLER };
typedef struct {
    uint32_t kind, serial;
    union { TexSlot tex; SampSlot sampler; } u;
} DescSlot;

static PlatRMutex tex_lock;
static PlatOnce tex_once = PLAT_ONCE_INIT;
static nvn_hmap by_key = {.klen = sizeof(TexKey)};
static nvn_hmap by_addr = {.klen = 8};
static nvn_hmap descriptors = {.klen = sizeof(VkDescKey)};
static nvn_hmap samplers = {.klen = sizeof(samp_par)};
static int nreleased;
static Tex *rel_head, *rel_tail;   // released entries in release order (sweep_released drops from the head)
static uint64_t n_uploads, n_reuploads;
// Re-uploads since the last perf line (tex_lock): all, and those of textures a WriteTexels wrote since their last upload.
static uint64_t ru_n, ru_bytes, ru_ns, ru_wt_n, ru_wt_bytes, ru_wt_ns;
static uint64_t n_hash_kept;   // untracked checks whose storage hash matched the last upload's (untracked_same)
// TOTK_TEX_ALIAS (default on; =0: a new image over live storage starts empty): a new descriptor over the storage of a
// live image that the GPU wrote gets that image's content (alias_copy). Counts since the last log line.
static int tex_alias = -1;
static uint64_t n_alias_copied, n_alias_upload, n_alias_uninit;
static uint32_t submit_epoch = 1;   // bumped per queue submit: draw bindings check a texture's storage once per submit
// Mirrored textures the GPU wrote into, sorted by address (vk_texture_cpu_stale, vk_texture_write_back). Changed under
// tex_lock and owned_lock; read under either.
static PlatMutex owned_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;
static Tex **owned;
static int nowned, cowned;
static uint64_t max_owned;   // largest storage size in owned[]
static uint64_t gpu_writes;  // GPU writes into mirrored textures so far: Tex.gpu_seq
// Bumped whenever the entry a slot resolves to can change: an entry created or destroyed, released or taken back into
// use (the slot lookup and the follow of a finalized slot read only by_key, by_addr and the released flags).
static uint32_t tex_gen = 1;
// Bumped with tex_gen and whenever a slot is registered: what vk_texture_by_id returns for any slot may have changed.
static uint32_t slots_gen = 1;
static uint32_t samp_gen = 1;   // bumped whenever a sampler slot is registered: vk_sampler_by_id may answer otherwise
static uint64_t n_checks;    // draw-binding storage checks (make_fresh_snap) since the last perf line
// tex_gen per storage address (hashed): a slot resolves through the entries at its own address only (slot_resolve), so
// a slot's resolution stays valid while its address's generation does. TotK finalizes and initializes transient
// textures every frame: about 90 tex_gen and 160 slots_gen bumps per frame in the monsters fight, one every 16 draws,
// which emptied every cache keyed on the global generations.
#define AGEN_N 4096
static uint32_t agen[AGEN_N];
static uint32_t reg_serial;

static uint32_t agen_idx(uint64_t addr) { return (uint32_t)(addr * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull >> 52); }

static void tex_gen_bump(uint64_t addr) {
    if (!++tex_gen) tex_gen = 1;
    slots_gen++;
    uint32_t *g = &agen[agen_idx(addr)];
    __atomic_store_n(g, *g + 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

static volatile int32_t tex_ready;
static void tex_init(void *p) {
    (void)p;
    __atomic_store_n(&tex_ready, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    return;
}
static void lock(void) {
    if (!__atomic_load_n(&tex_ready, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) plat_once(&tex_once, tex_init, NULL);
    plat_rmutex_lock(&tex_lock);
}
static void unlock(void) { plat_rmutex_unlock(&tex_lock); }

static uint32_t umax(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) { return a > b ? a : b; }
static uint32_t mip(uint32_t v, unsigned lv) { return umax(v >> lv, 1); }

// Host bytes for a mip chain (bpt ≈ 4 for RGBA8, 1 for BC3). Used to trim huge Switch 2 ASTC arrays.
static uint64_t est_tex_bytes(uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t depth, uint32_t levels, uint32_t layers, uint32_t bpt) {
    uint64_t sum = 0;
    for (uint32_t lv = 0; lv < levels; lv++) {
        uint32_t mw = mip(w, lv), mh = mip(h, lv), md = depth > 1 ? mip(depth, lv) : 1;
        sum += (uint64_t)mw * mh * md * layers * bpt;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Eglantine CompactLayers: drop top guest mips until the host image fits. Default 256 MiB keeps MKW's
// 8192×68 arrays at 1024 (~91 MiB) — stable with the ~2.3 GiB buffer mirror. Raise with
// TOTK_COMPACT_ASTC_MB=384 (edge still ≤2048) when VRAM allows; room is also clamped to the live
// device-local budget minus a mirror reserve so a high cap cannot device-lose mid-boot.
enum { COMPACT_ASTC_BUDGET_DEFAULT_MB = 512u };
enum { COMPACT_ASTC_MAX_EDGE = 2048u };
enum { COMPACT_ASTC_MIRROR_RESERVE = 3ull << 30 };   // leave room for MKW's large cached pool mirror

static uint64_t compact_astc_budget_cap(void) {
    static int64_t bytes = -1;
    if (bytes < 0) {
        const char *s = cfg_get("TOTK_COMPACT_ASTC_MB");
        int mb = s && *s ? atoi(s) : (int)COMPACT_ASTC_BUDGET_DEFAULT_MB;
        if (mb < 64) mb = 64;
        if (mb > 2048) mb = 2048;
        bytes = (int64_t)mb << 20;
        rt_log("vk: CompactLayers ASTC budget %d MiB (edge ≤ %u)%s", mb, COMPACT_ASTC_MAX_EDGE,
               s && *s ? "" : ", TOTK_COMPACT_ASTC_MB= to raise when VRAM allows");
    }
    return (uint64_t)bytes;
}

// Per-texture: never take more than the configured cap, and never more than free VRAM past the mirror reserve.
static uint64_t compact_astc_budget(uint64_t want) {
    uint64_t cap = compact_astc_budget_cap();
    if (want && want < cap) cap = want;
    uint64_t used = 0, budget = 0;
    int exact = 0;
    if (vk_mem_vram(&used, &budget, &exact) && budget > COMPACT_ASTC_MIRROR_RESERVE) {
        uint64_t room = budget - COMPACT_ASTC_MIRROR_RESERVE;
        if (used < room) {
            uint64_t free = room - used;
            if (cap > free) cap = free;
        } else {
            // Past reserve: still allow one huge RGBA8 CompactLayers host (~363 MiB at 1024×68).
            // The old 64 MiB floor crushed 8192×68 arrays to 256² (soft / missing ground).
            cap = 400ull << 20;
        }
    }
    if (cap < (64ull << 20)) cap = 64ull << 20;
    return cap;
}

// Huge MKW terrain arrays: one locked host edge. Must be a power-of-two guest mip size (8192→1024 /
// 512 / …): a non-POT lock like 768 made over_edge keep skipping to 512 (n09/n10 soft ground).
// 1024 RGBA8 is ~363 MiB each; keep the live-budget trim from dropping huge arrays further (below).
// 2048 RGBA8×68 ≈ 1.45 GiB blew VRAM (n78: mirrors refused at 13/14.6 GiB, title lost all
// background / foliage into a dark void). 1024 (~363 MiB) keeps room for mesh SSBO mirrors.
enum { COMPACT_ASTC_HUGE_EDGE = 1024u };
static uint32_t huge_astc_host_edge(uint32_t guest_w, uint32_t guest_h, uint32_t guest_levels, uint32_t layers,
                                    uint32_t bpt) {
    static uint32_t locked;
    static int logged;
    (void)guest_w; (void)guest_h; (void)guest_levels; (void)layers; (void)bpt;
    if (locked) return locked;
    locked = COMPACT_ASTC_HUGE_EDGE;
    if (!logged) {
        logged = 1;
        rt_log("vk: CompactLayers huge ASTC arrays locked to host edge %u (same for all)", locked);
    }
    return locked;
}

static void make_key(const tex_t *t, TexKey *k) {
    memset(k, 0, sizeof *k);
    k->addr = (uintptr_t)t->mem;
    k->d = t->d;
    k->has_layout = t->has_layout;
    memcpy(k->layout, t->layout, 8);
}

// Keys equal apart from the descriptor's swizzle selectors: the same storage, format and geometry.
static int same_but_swizzle(const TexKey *a, const TexKey *b) {
    TexKey x = *a, y = *b;
    x.d.swizzle_r = x.d.swizzle_g = x.d.swizzle_b = x.d.swizzle_a = 0;
    y.d.swizzle_r = y.d.swizzle_g = y.d.swizzle_b = y.d.swizzle_a = 0;
    return !memcmp(&x, &y, sizeof x);
}

// MNG nvn_mtl.m tex_mirrored: textures whose content the CPU provides in pool memory. Display, compressible, zcull,
// depth, multisample and GPU-only storage stays GPU-owned.
static int tex_mirrored(const tex_t *t) {
    if (!t->mem || nvn_gpu_only((uintptr_t)t->mem)) return 0;
    if (t->has_layout) return 1;
    const pool_t *p = t->pool;
    if (!p || !(p->flags & (NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_CPU_UNCACHED | NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_CPU_CACHED))) return 0;
    if (t->d.flags & (NVN_TEXTURE_FLAGS_DISPLAY | NVN_TEXTURE_FLAGS_COMPRESSIBLE | NVN_TEXTURE_FLAGS_ADAPTIVE_ZCULL |
                      NVN_TEXTURE_FLAGS_DEPTH16_PREFER_FAST_CLEAR | NVN_TEXTURE_FLAGS_ZCULL_SUPPORT_STENCIL))
        return 0;
    if (t->d.samples > 1 || t->d.target == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_BUFFER) return 0;
    if (t->d.format >= 0x31 && t->d.format <= 0x36) return 0;   // stencil / depth formats
    return 1;
}

static void log_limited(volatile int32_t *n, const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
static void log_limited(volatile int32_t *n, const char *fmt, ...) {
    if (plat_inc32(n) > 16) return;
    char buf[512];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vsnprintf(buf, sizeof buf, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    rt_log("vk: %s", buf);
}

static void barrier(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkPipelineStageFlags2 src, VkAccessFlags2 sa, VkPipelineStageFlags2 dst,
                    VkAccessFlags2 da) {
    VkMemoryBarrier2 mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = src, .srcAccessMask = sa,
                           .dstStageMask = dst, .dstAccessMask = da};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &mb};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
}
#define ALL_RW VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- images
static VkFormatFeatureFlags features_of(VkFormat f) {
    VkFormatProperties p;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(vk_ctx()->phys, f, &p);
    return p.optimalTilingFeatures;
}

static VkImageAspectFlags aspect_of(const TexVkFormat *f) {
    VkImageAspectFlags a = 0;
    if (f->depth) a |= VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT;
    if (f->stencil) a |= VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT;
    return a ? a : VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
}

// Binds img into the pool memory behind its GPU address (physical pools, virtual pools through the page table) when
// the memory type, alignment and contiguous size allow; 0 otherwise.
// A depth / stencil image that needs more bytes than its NVN storage (guest_size) is not bound: AMD's RDNA2 driver
// (26.10.1) puts the depth compression metadata after the depth data, and above 1080p that tail lies over the next
// texture of the game's heap; each depth write then scrambled it (garbage band at the top, pink glow, blocks in the
// grass, a blue checkered scene in the menu). Colour images keep their place: the RX 9070 also sizes some of them
// above their storage, and nothing there showed that the GPU writes the excess.
static int format_compressed(VkFormat f) {   // vkCmdClearColorImage takes no block-compressed format
    return (f >= VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGB_UNORM_BLOCK && f <= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_12x12_SRGB_BLOCK) ||
           (f >= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_4x4_SFLOAT_BLOCK && f <= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_12x12_SFLOAT_BLOCK);
}

static int bind_pool_memory(VkCtx *c, Tex *e, VkImage img, uint64_t guest_size) {
    VkMemoryRequirements req;
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(c->device, img, &req);
    if ((e->f.depth || e->f.stencil) && req.size > guest_size) return 0;
    VkMemSpan sp;
    if (!req.size) return 0;   // an image the device could not lay out (image_size)
    if (!vk_mem_resolve(e->pub.addr, req.size, &sp) || !sp.alloc || sp.alloc_offset % req.alignment) return 0;
    VmaAllocationInfo info;
    vmaGetAllocationInfo(c->vma, sp.alloc, &info);
    if (!(req.memoryTypeBits >> info.memoryType & 1)) return 0;
    if (vmaBindImageMemory2(c->vma, sp.alloc, sp.alloc_offset, img, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    e->bound_to = sp.alloc;
    return 1;
}

// agl's BC4 encoder draws a BC texture's blocks through an RGBA16UI view, one texel per 8-byte block (refs/nxnative
// docs/agents/04-graphics.md, Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom sections). Vulkan does it with an uncompressed
// view of a BLOCK_TEXEL_VIEW_COMPATIBLE image; EXTENDED_USAGE lets the BC image carry the COLOR_ATTACHMENT usage that
// only such views support. Whether the device takes that combination for this format and shape:
static int block_views_ok(const VkImageCreateInfo *ci) {
    VkPhysicalDeviceImageFormatInfo2 fi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_IMAGE_FORMAT_INFO_2,
                                           .format = ci->format, .type = ci->imageType, .tiling = ci->tiling,
                                           .usage = ci->usage, .flags = ci->flags};
    VkImageFormatProperties2 p = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_FORMAT_PROPERTIES_2};
    if (vkGetPhysicalDeviceImageFormatProperties2(vk_ctx()->phys, &fi, &p) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    const VkImageFormatProperties *q = &p.imageFormatProperties;
    return ci->extent.width <= q->maxExtent.width && ci->extent.height <= q->maxExtent.height &&
           ci->extent.depth <= q->maxExtent.depth && ci->mipLevels <= q->maxMipLevels &&
           ci->arrayLayers <= q->maxArrayLayers;
}

// The memory the device wants for an image made from ci: 0 when it cannot lay it out. RADV on GFX9 (Vega, Renoir)
// hands back a 0-byte image for a mipmapped block-compressed 3D image at least as deep as it is wide in blocks, with
// COLOR_ATTACHMENT usage and no STORAGE: that usage asks for a thin 3D layout (Mesa radv_image.c), for which the GFX9
// address library has no swizzle mode left (gfx9addrlib.cpp), and the error is dropped; VMA then refuses the 0-byte
// allocation. The format properties call it supported, so only the size shows it.
static VkDeviceSize image_size(const VkImageCreateInfo *ci) {
    VkDeviceImageMemoryRequirements q = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_IMAGE_MEMORY_REQUIREMENTS, .pCreateInfo = ci};
    VkMemoryRequirements2 r = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_REQUIREMENTS_2};
    vkGetDeviceImageMemoryRequirements(vk_ctx()->device, &q, &r);
    return r.memoryRequirements.size;
}

// UNDEFINED -> GENERAL; new depth / stencil images start cleared (LAS textures.c: the game copies depth
// without stencil, and the stencil of those images must not be whatever the memory held).
static void init_image(Tex *e, VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier2 ib = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_NONE,
                                .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                                .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                                .oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, .newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                                .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                                .image = e->pub.image, .subresourceRange = {e->pub.aspect, 0, VK_REMAINING_MIP_LEVELS, 0, VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS}};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1, .pImageMemoryBarriers = &ib};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
    if (e->f.depth || e->f.stencil) {
        VkClearDepthStencilValue zero = {0.0f, 0};
        VkImageSubresourceRange rg = {e->pub.aspect, 0, VK_REMAINING_MIP_LEVELS, 0, VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS};
        vkCmdClearDepthStencilImage(cb, e->pub.image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, &zero, 1, &rg);
        barrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_CLEAR_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, ALL_RW);
    } else if (!e->bound_to && !format_compressed(e->f.vk) &&
               ((vk_fix_zero() && !e->pub.mirrored) || e->pub.host_mip0)) {
        // GPU-only own-memory starts at zero (pool alloc_physical). Mirrored images usually upload from
        // CPU storage on first use — except CompactLayers (host_mip0 > 0): those stay mirrored for
        // MapVirtual tile refresh but the GPU image is a trimmed RGBA8 fold whose layers are filled
        // only as ASTC decodes arrive. Leaving them UNDEFINED showed as rainbow cliffs (n173–n215).
        VkClearColorValue zero = {0};
        VkImageSubresourceRange rg = {e->pub.aspect, 0, VK_REMAINING_MIP_LEVELS, 0, VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS};
        vkCmdClearColorImage(cb, e->pub.image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, &zero, 1, &rg);
        barrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_CLEAR_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, ALL_RW);
    }
}

// defer_init: the caller records the image's first transition (init_image or alias_copy).
static Tex *create_tex(const tex_t *t, const TexKey *k, int defer_init) {
    static volatile int32_t n_unmapped, n_unsupported, n_failed, n_unbound, n_thick;
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    const nvn_texdesc *d = &t->d;
    if (!c || d->target == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_BUFFER) return NULL;
    TexVkFormat f;
    if (!tex_vk_format(d->format, &f)) {
        log_limited(&n_unmapped, "texture format %#x has no Vulkan format: %s", d->format, f.reason);
        return NULL;
    }
    if (!tex_vk_format_supported(&f)) {
        log_limited(&n_unsupported, "texture format %#x: VkFormat %d lacks features %#x", d->format, (int)f.vk, (unsigned)f.need);
        return NULL;
    }
    nvn_texlayout L;
    nvn_tex_layout(d, &L);
    uint32_t w = umax(d->width, 1), h = umax(d->height, 1), depth = 1, layers = 1;
    VkImageType type = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    switch (d->target) {
    case NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_1D: type = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D; h = 1; break;
    case NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_1D_ARRAY: type = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D; h = 1; layers = L.layers; break;
    case NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_3D: type = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D; depth = umax(d->depth, 1); break;
    case NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D_ARRAY: case NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D_MULTISAMPLE_ARRAY:
    case NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_CUBEMAP: case NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_CUBEMAP_ARRAY: layers = L.layers; break;
    default: break;
    }
    uint32_t levels = umax(d->levels, 1), most = 1;
    for (uint32_t s = umax(umax(w, h), depth); s > 1; s >>= 1) most++;
    if (levels > most) levels = most;
    uint32_t samples = d->samples > 1 ? (uint32_t)d->samples : 1;
    if (samples > 1) levels = 1;
    VkFormatFeatureFlags ff = features_of(f.vk);
    VkImageUsageFlags usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
    int ds = f.depth || f.stencil;
    if (ds && (ff & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT)) usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
    if (!ds && (ff & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT)) usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
    // Storage usage for every single-sample colour texture whose format allows it, not only those created with
    // NVN_TEXTURE_FLAGS_IMAGE: NVN 2 binds textures made without the flag as images (the NVN 2 reference title's upscaler writes its
    // 2880x1620 r11g11b10f output, flags 0), and an image without the usage got a stand-in, so the frame stayed the
    // clear colour. Vulkan cannot add the usage later.
    int mutable_storage = 0;
    if (!ds && samples == 1) {
        if (ff & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_STORAGE_IMAGE_BIT) usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT;
        else if (f.vk == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB &&
                 (features_of(VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_STORAGE_IMAGE_BIT))
            usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT, mutable_storage = 1;
        else if (f.vk == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB &&
                 (features_of(VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM) & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_STORAGE_IMAGE_BIT))
            usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT, mutable_storage = 1;
    }
    VkImageCreateFlags flags = ds ? 0 : VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT;   // format-reinterpreting views
    if (mutable_storage) flags |= VK_IMAGE_CREATE_EXTENDED_USAGE_BIT;
    // Cube compatible only for cube targets: the replay makes cube views of nothing else (vk_exec_draw.c get_view checks
    // the image's own view type). The flag on every square array of 6+ layers changed how AMD's Windows driver lays such
    // an image out, and terrain material arrays sampled through it came out in rainbow blocks that moved with the mip
    // level (Savage Wind Recomp issue #59, BotW on an RX 580 and a 7800 XT).
    if (type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D && layers >= 6 && w == h && samples == 1 &&
        (d->target == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_CUBEMAP || d->target == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_CUBEMAP_ARRAY))
        flags |= VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT;
    // NVN renders into a 3D texture slice by slice (a view's min layer is the depth plane, nvn_mtl.m), e.g. the
    // grading LUT of the menu background blur. Vulkan needs a 2D view of the slice for that.
    if (type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D && (usage & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT)) flags |= VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2D_ARRAY_COMPATIBLE_BIT;
    VkImageCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .flags = flags, .imageType = type, .format = f.vk,
                            .extent = {w, h, depth}, .mipLevels = levels, .arrayLayers = layers,
                            .samples = (VkSampleCountFlagBits)samples, .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL, .usage = usage,
                            .initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED};
    int bw, bh, block_views = 0;
    // TOTK_BLOCK_VIEWS_3D (default 0): a 3D BC image also gets block views. On RDNA2 cards (driver 26.10.1, issue #5)
    // the 32x32x32 BC4 volume the game creates at the logo, made BLOCK_TEXEL_VIEW_COMPATIBLE and 2D_ARRAY_COMPATIBLE,
    // took a GPU write just past the end of its memory: device lost at the first submit after it when the image ended
    // its memory block. Draws into a 3D BC image go through a stand-in instead (vk_exec.c bc_target).
    static int bv3d = -1;
    if (bv3d < 0) {
        bv3d = rt_knob("BLOCK_VIEWS_3D", "0");
        rt_log("vk: 3D BC textures %s (TOTK_BLOCK_VIEWS_3D=%d)", bv3d ? "get block views (renderable)" : "have no block views",
               bv3d);
    }
    if (!ds && samples == 1 && f.vk == f.ideal && nvn_fmt_bpb(d->format, &bw, &bh) && bw == 4 && bh == 4 &&
        (type != VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D || bv3d)) {
        VkImageCreateInfo bc = ci;   // BC formats: renderable through views of their blocks (block_views_ok)
        bc.usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
        bc.flags |= VK_IMAGE_CREATE_BLOCK_TEXEL_VIEW_COMPATIBLE_BIT | VK_IMAGE_CREATE_EXTENDED_USAGE_BIT;
        if (type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D) bc.flags |= VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2D_ARRAY_COMPATIBLE_BIT;
        VkImageUsageFlags hidden = 0;   // creation usage the replay never uses (views restrict theirs, vk_exec.c)
        int ok = block_views_ok(&bc);
        if (ok && type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D && !image_size(&bc)) {
            // STORAGE usage keeps RADV on GFX9 from the thin layout (image_size), so agl's BC4 encoder still renders
            // into the volume; else the image is made without block views and its encoder passes are left out
            bc.usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT, hidden = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT;
            ok = block_views_ok(&bc) && image_size(&bc);
            log_limited(&n_thick, "texture fmt %#x %ux%ux%u: the device cannot lay out a 3D image with block views; %s",
                        d->format, w, h, depth, ok ? "made with storage usage (a thick layout)" : "made without them");
        }
        if (ok) ci = bc, usage = bc.usage & ~hidden, flags = bc.flags, block_views = 1;
    }
    // Feedback loops (vk.h VkCtx.feedback): every attachable image may be sampled by a draw of a pass that renders it,
    // so it gets the usage now; adding it when a loop shows up would mean recreating the image (that lost the
    // grass tile maps once).
    int fb_usage = c->feedback == VK_FEEDBACK_LAYOUT && !block_views &&
                   (usage & (VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT));
    if (fb_usage) ci.usage = usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_BIT_EXT;
    uint32_t host_mip0 = 0, guest_w = w, guest_h = h, guest_levels = levels;
    // CompactLayers (Eglantine PR #570): MKW's 8192x8192x68 ASTC terrain arrays do not fit as full RGBA8/BC3.
    // Drop top guest mips until the host image is under COMPACT_ASTC_BUDGET (or 1024px), then create that size.
    if (f.astc_bw && samples == 1 && type != VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D) {
        // Estimate with BC density when the global knob is on, but do not convert CompactLayers to BC:
        // T2T folds from decoded staging need RGBA8 blits (BC CopyImage cannot scale → missing ground).
        uint32_t bpt_est = f.astc_bc || vk_astc_bc() ? 1u : 4u;
        uint64_t need = est_tex_bytes(w, h, depth, levels, layers, bpt_est);
        uint64_t budget = compact_astc_budget(need);
        int huge = layers >= 16 && umax(w, h) >= 4096;
        if (huge || need > budget) {
            uint32_t edge_cap = huge ? huge_astc_host_edge(guest_w, guest_h, guest_levels, layers, bpt_est)
                                     : COMPACT_ASTC_MAX_EDGE;
            // CompactLayers stay RGBA8 (4 B/texel) so folds blit; size the host for that density.
            // Huge arrays: never trim below the locked edge for budget alone — n09 dropped 768→512
            // under live VRAM pressure and soft-grounded the title. Create/retry still handles true OOM.
            uint32_t bpt = 4u;
            while (levels > 1) {
                int over_edge = umax(w, h) > edge_cap;
                int over_budget = !huge && est_tex_bytes(w, h, depth, levels, layers, bpt) > compact_astc_budget(0);
                if (!over_edge && !over_budget) break;
                if (huge && !over_edge) break;
                host_mip0++;
                w = mip(guest_w, host_mip0);
                h = mip(guest_h, host_mip0);
                levels = guest_levels > host_mip0 ? guest_levels - host_mip0 : 1;
            }
            // Keep uncompressed host format even when TOTK_ASTC_BC=1.
            if (f.astc_bc) {
                f.astc_bc = 0;
                f.vk = f.astc_srgb ? VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB : VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
                ci.format = f.vk;
            }
            ci.extent.width = w;
            ci.extent.height = h;
            ci.mipLevels = levels;
            if (host_mip0)
                rt_log("vk: CompactLayers ASTC %#x %ux%u x%u -> host %ux%u levels %u (skip %u guest mips, ~%.0f MiB, RGBA8 folds) addr %#llx",
                       d->format, guest_w, guest_h, layers, w, h, levels, host_mip0,
                       est_tex_bytes(w, h, depth, levels, layers, bpt) / 1048576.0, (unsigned long long)k->addr);
        } else if (!f.astc_bc && vk_astc_bc()) {
            // Large few-layer ASTC is the decoded staging the game blits into CompactLayers. BC3
            // here left fmt BC3→RGBA8 folds skipped (8192 vs 0, empty ground). Keep RGBA8 so the
            // scale-fold blit in copy_decoded_astc can run; BC stays for smaller / many-layer tex.
            int fold_src = layers <= 4 && umax(guest_w, guest_h) >= 4096;
            if (!fold_src) {
                f.vk = f.astc_srgb ? VK_FORMAT_BC3_SRGB_BLOCK : VK_FORMAT_BC3_UNORM_BLOCK;
                f.astc_bc = 1;
                ci.format = f.vk;
            }
        }
    }
    Tex *e = calloc(1, sizeof *e);
    if (!e) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory for a texture");
    e->key = *k;
    e->t = *t;
    e->f = f;
    e->pub.addr = k->addr;
    VkImage img = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    // Trimmed ASTC arrays are smaller than the guest pool allocation: always take own memory.
    if (!host_mip0 && nvn_gpu_only(k->addr)) {   // storage in a physical or virtual pool: alias the pool memory (section 3.2)
        if (vkCreateImage(c->device, &ci, NULL, &img) == VK_SUCCESS && !bind_pool_memory(c, e, img, L.size)) {
            vkDestroyImage(c->device, img, NULL);
            img = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            log_limited(&n_unbound, "texture %#llx (%ux%u fmt %#x) cannot alias its pool memory; own memory instead",
                        (unsigned long long)k->addr, w, h, d->format);
        }
    }
    if (!img) {
        VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
        // Drop released textures first when CompactLayers is about to take a large own-memory image
        // (Ryujinx-style: prefer surviving device-local pressure over a mid-create device-lost).
        if (host_mip0 || (uint64_t)w * h * layers >= (256ull << 10)) {
            uint32_t bpt = f.astc_bw ? (f.astc_bc || vk_astc_bc() ? 1u : 4u) : 4u;
            uint64_t need = est_tex_bytes(w, h, depth > 1 ? depth : 1, levels, layers, bpt);
            vk_texture_free_for_vram(need);
        }
        VkResult r = vmaCreateImage(c->vma, &ci, &ai, &img, &e->alloc, NULL);
        if (r != VK_SUCCESS && f.astc_bw && !f.astc_bc) {
            f.vk = f.astc_srgb ? VK_FORMAT_BC3_SRGB_BLOCK : VK_FORMAT_BC3_UNORM_BLOCK;
            f.astc_bc = 1;
            ci.format = f.vk;
            r = vmaCreateImage(c->vma, &ci, &ai, &img, &e->alloc, NULL);
            if (r == VK_SUCCESS) {
                e->f = f;
                rt_log("vk: mega-texture %ux%ux%u layers %u fell back to BC3 (%s)", guest_w, guest_h, depth, layers,
                       f.astc_srgb ? "SRGB" : "UNORM");
            }
        }
        // Still over budget: keep trimming top mips until create succeeds or only 1x1 remains.
        while (r != VK_SUCCESS && f.astc_bw && levels > 1) {
            host_mip0++;
            w = mip(guest_w, host_mip0);
            h = mip(guest_h, host_mip0);
            levels = guest_levels > host_mip0 ? guest_levels - host_mip0 : 1;
            ci.extent.width = w;
            ci.extent.height = h;
            ci.mipLevels = levels;
            r = vmaCreateImage(c->vma, &ci, &ai, &img, &e->alloc, NULL);
            if (r == VK_SUCCESS)
                rt_log("vk: CompactLayers retry ASTC %#x host %ux%u levels %u (skip %u)", d->format, w, h, levels,
                       host_mip0);
        }
        if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
            log_limited(&n_failed, "image creation failed (%d): nvn fmt %#x %ux%ux%u target %d levels %u layers %u", (int)r,
                        d->format, guest_w, guest_h, depth, d->target, guest_levels, layers);
            free(e);
            return NULL;
        }
    }
    VkTexImage *p = &e->pub;
    p->image = img;
    p->format = f.vk;
    p->type = type;
    p->usage = usage;
    p->aspect = aspect_of(&f);
    p->width = w, p->height = h, p->depth = depth, p->levels = levels, p->layers = layers, p->samples = samples;
    p->host_mip0 = (uint8_t)(host_mip0 > 255 ? 255 : host_mip0);
    e->f = f;
    p->view_type = type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D ? (d->target == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_1D_ARRAY ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D_ARRAY : VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D)
                 : type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D
                 : d->target == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_CUBEMAP && (flags & VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT) ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE
                 : d->target == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_CUBEMAP_ARRAY && (flags & VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT) ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY
                 : layers > 1 || d->target == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D_ARRAY || d->target == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D_MULTISAMPLE_ARRAY
                     ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY : VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    p->alpha_one = f.alpha_one;
    memcpy(p->chan, f.chan, sizeof p->chan);
    p->swz[0] = (uint8_t)d->swizzle_r, p->swz[1] = (uint8_t)d->swizzle_g;
    p->swz[2] = (uint8_t)d->swizzle_b, p->swz[3] = (uint8_t)d->swizzle_a;
    if (!(p->swz[0] | p->swz[1] | p->swz[2] | p->swz[3]))   // descriptors built without nvnTextureBuilderSetDefaults
        p->swz[0] = NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_R, p->swz[1] = NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_G, p->swz[2] = NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_B,
        p->swz[3] = NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_A;
    p->mirrored = (uint8_t)tex_mirrored(t);
    p->bound = e->bound_to != NULL;
    p->block_views = (uint8_t)block_views;
    p->fb_usage = (uint8_t)fb_usage;

    if (!defer_init) {
        init_image(e, vk_upload_begin());
        vk_upload_end();
    }
    return e;
}

static int owned_lower(uint64_t a) {
    int lo = 0, hi = nowned;
    while (lo < hi) {
        int m = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (owned[m]->pub.addr < a) lo = m + 1;
        else hi = m;
    }
    return lo;
}

static void own_add(Tex *e) {
    if (e->listed) return;
    plat_mutex_lock(&owned_lock);
    if (nowned == cowned) {
        cowned = cowned ? 2 * cowned : 256;
        if (!(owned = realloc(owned, sizeof *owned * (size_t)cowned))) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory for the owned-texture list");
    }
    int i = owned_lower(e->pub.addr);
    memmove(owned + i + 1, owned + i, sizeof *owned * (size_t)(nowned - i));
    owned[i] = e;
    __atomic_store_n(&nowned, nowned + 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    if (e->t.L.size > max_owned) max_owned = e->t.L.size;
    e->listed = 1;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&owned_lock);
}

static void own_remove(Tex *e) {
    if (!e->listed) return;
    plat_mutex_lock(&owned_lock);
    for (int i = owned_lower(e->pub.addr); i < nowned && owned[i]->pub.addr == e->pub.addr; i++)
        if (owned[i] == e) {
            memmove(owned + i, owned + i + 1, sizeof *owned * (size_t)(nowned - i - 1));
            __atomic_store_n(&nowned, nowned - 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            break;
        }
    e->listed = 0;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&owned_lock);
}

static void rel_append(Tex *e) {
    e->rel_next = NULL;
    e->rel_prev = rel_tail;
    if (rel_tail) rel_tail->rel_next = e;
    else rel_head = e;
    rel_tail = e;
}

static void rel_unlink(Tex *e) {
    if (e->rel_prev) e->rel_prev->rel_next = e->rel_next;
    else rel_head = e->rel_next;
    if (e->rel_next) e->rel_next->rel_prev = e->rel_prev;
    else rel_tail = e->rel_prev;
    e->rel_prev = e->rel_next = NULL;
}

static void destroy_tex(Tex *e) {
    own_remove(e);
    tex_gen_bump(e->key.addr);
    nvn_hm_del(&by_key, &e->key);
    Tex *head = nvn_hm_get(&by_addr, &e->key.addr);
    if (head == e) {
        if (e->next_at) nvn_hm_put(&by_addr, &e->key.addr, e->next_at);
        else nvn_hm_del(&by_addr, &e->key.addr);
    } else {
        for (Tex *p = head; p; p = p->next_at)
            if (p->next_at == e) { p->next_at = e->next_at; break; }
    }
    if (e->released) nreleased--, rel_unlink(e);
    vk_exec_image_gone(e->pub.image);
    vk_defer_image(e->pub.image, e->alloc);
    free(e->snap);
    free(e);
}

// Released entries with another descriptor at the same address are replaced; past RELEASED_MAX released entries the
// oldest one goes at each release (it comes back on demand, a mirrored one re-uploaded from its storage). TotK
// finalizes and initializes transient textures every frame, so a released entry is mostly taken back within frames.
// Dropping all of them at once when the count passed 4096 destroyed thousands of images in one frame: 333-422 ms
// frames every 40-50 s on a GTX 1050 Ti, then the textures still in use were created and uploaded again.
#define RELEASED_MAX 2048
static void sweep_released(void) {
    while (nreleased > RELEASED_MAX && rel_head) destroy_tex(rel_head);
}

// TOTK_TEX_VRAM_PRESSURE (percent of the device-local budget, default 90; 0 = off): above it, each submit drops up to
// PRESSURE_STEP of the oldest released entries, so a 4 GiB card does not keep RELEASED_MAX released images (each ASTC
// one decoded to RGBA8) while the heap spills into system memory. A few per submit, for the reason above. Only entries
// that come back intact are dropped: mirrored ones the GPU never wrote, re-uploaded from their storage. A render target
// lives only in its image; dropping it brought the texture back empty (black flashes in a Depths boss fight, ~170
// "left uninitialised" aliases a minute).
#define PRESSURE_STEP 32
static int vram_pressure = -1;
static uint64_t n_pressure_drops;

static void sweep_pressure(void) {   // tex_lock held
    if (vram_pressure < 0) {
        const char *s = cfg_get("TOTK_TEX_VRAM_PRESSURE");
        vram_pressure = s && *s ? atoi(s) : 90;
        if (vram_pressure < 0 || vram_pressure > 100) vram_pressure = 90;
        rt_log("vk: released textures under VRAM pressure: %s%d%%", vram_pressure ? "dropped above " : "off", vram_pressure);
    }
    if (!vram_pressure || !rel_head || submit_epoch & 7) return;   // the budget query every 8 submits
    uint64_t used, budget;
    int exact;
    if (!vk_mem_vram(&used, &budget, &exact) || used <= budget / 100 * (uint64_t)vram_pressure) return;
    int dropped = 0;
    for (Tex *e = rel_head, *next; e && dropped < PRESSURE_STEP; e = next) {
        next = e->rel_next;
        if (!e->pub.mirrored || e->pub.gpu_owned || e->gpu_dirty) continue;
        destroy_tex(e);
        dropped++, n_pressure_drops++;
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- uploads
static uint32_t texel_alpha_one(int format, uint32_t *elem) {
    switch (format) {
    case 0x19: *elem = 1; return 0xFF;
```
